records.text: It did come back... then Professor Lisandro borrowed it for the Dimmr Plains expedition.
records.zh: 它回来过……然后又被利桑德教授借去黯原了……

records.text: Wait... a Dimmr Plains expedition? The same one you applied for?
records.zh: 等等……黯原的科考计划，你之前报名了对吧？

records.text: "Baldur, whose heart once illuminated the Roya, shall be destroyed once and for all..."
records.zh: “巴德尔曾献出心脏照耀的罗伊，将毁于一旦……”

records.text: That's the right call. President Lucilla's speech at the review conference was absolute cinema.
records.zh: 你是对的，洛瑟菈校长在审查会上表现很精彩。

records.text: And the project's led by Professor Mornye! I'd love to join her research group.
records.zh: 这个项目也是莫宁教授主持的！真想进她的课题组啊。

records.text: The latest findings from the Dimmr Plains suggest there are frequencies that "escaped" from the Void Storms...
records.zh: 黯原最新的勘探结果说明存在着从磁暴中“逃逸”的频率……

records.text: The Dimmr Plains expedition teams are already on their way, and surface expeditions on the frostlands have resumed too. The chance of a Void Storm is basically zero at this point, but you still need to watch out for Voidmatter-contaminated remnants. Hmm? Oh, it's you.
records.zh: 黯原科考队伍已经出发，地表冰原科考已经恢复……虽然虚质磁暴发生概率基本为零，但务必小心虚质侵蚀残留……嗯？是你？

records.text: We still don't know if these remnant zones only exist in the Dimmr Plains or not...
records.zh: 现在还无法确认这类残留区是否只出现在黯原……

records.text: Did you hear? About that Dimmr Plains expedition?
records.zh: 听说了吗……黯原科考队……

records.text: Did you hear about the Dimmr Plains expedition? Someone heard the voices of the dead through their FCR.
records.zh: 听说了吗……黯原科考队……有人在频录装置里听到了亡者的声音。

records.text: The Soliskin that climbed reached the high grounds of Bjartr Woods… actually, they never returned to the Reactor Drive…
records.zh: 日灵攀上浮光林高处……其实没有回归炉芯……

records.text: Chisa's performance during the Void Storm was absolutely textbook!
records.zh: 千咲同学在磁暴中的表现简直就是教科书级标准案例！

records.text: Others performed just as impressively. Why don't you try asking Lynae again?
records.zh: 其他人的应对也很精彩啊，你再私下联络琳奈同学试试呢？

records.text: Ah, it's you, 漂泊者. I was just about to make adjustments to the majoring policies, and President Lucilla suggested I get your input on it.
records.zh: 是你啊漂泊者同学，我正准备调整分部制度，洛瑟菈校长建议我征询一下你的看法。

records.text: Yes. Now that the Spacetrek Executive Committee has finally approved President Lucilla's proposal to revamp Rabelle College's curriculum and keep the funding flowing...
records.zh: 对……既然深空联合理事会最终接受了洛瑟菈校长的提案，接受拉贝尔学部变更教学目标，并继续投资……

records.text: But here's the thing. Like President Lucilla said during the review, Rabelle College's future challenge isn't Aleph-1 anymore. It's the Etheric Sea... something nobody's ever broken through.
records.zh: 但……正如洛瑟菈校长在审查会上所说，拉贝尔学部未来要面对的不再是阿列夫一，而是……从未被突破的那片天空海。

records.text: ...If it was really that big, wouldn't it have left a scar?
records.zh: ……真有那么粗……得扎个洞出来吧？

records.text: That's Old Tao. Mengzhou cuisine's living authority!
records.zh: 陶老啊！梦州菜老吃家了！

records.text: You look toward "Aemeath." She is quietly resting on the sofa, eyes closed.
records.zh: 你看向「爱弥斯」，她正倚靠在小屋的沙发上，安静地闭着双眼。

records.text: You look toward "Aemeath." She hunches over the workbench, head tilted as she pores over the display.
records.zh: 你看向「爱弥斯」，她正专注着站在工作台前，歪着脑袋凝视着眼前的一切。

records.text: This was where you used to work and the usual haunt for young Aemeath. When you were busy, she would sit beside you and draw in silence, like a small, loyal guardian keeping watch.
records.zh: 这是过去的你工作时使用的地方，也是年幼的爱弥斯常来的地方。有时候你在忙，她就坐在一旁的椅子上自个儿画画，像个忠实的小守卫。

records.text: You look toward "Aemeath." She sits motionless by the shore of the Ginnungamere, her gaze fixed on the water, where glistening lights dance on the ripples
records.zh: 你看向「爱弥斯」，她正一动不动地坐在渐湖的湖畔，目光投向眼前闪动着瑰丽色彩的湖面。

records.text: 漂泊者, is that Phrolova actually studying the Dark Tide?
records.zh: 漂泊者大人，这位叫弗洛洛的小姐难道是在研究黑潮吗？

records.text: You should be grateful you saved Lenore back when you'd forgotten your memories.
records.zh: 庆幸自己失忆时救了伊诺尔吧。

records.text: …As for where I'm going next, have you heard about a bard called Ciaccona, spreading rumors in Ragunna lately?
records.zh: 去哪？嗯……漂泊者大人，您是否听说最近有一位名叫夏空的诗人在拉古那散布了一些流言？

records.text: Oh, Miss Lenore... I was once a warrior, one who stood by the Sentinel's side. Only those who give everything for glory earn a place in Septimont.
records.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，我们是与岁主并肩的战士，只有为荣誉献上一切的人才能得到七丘的垂青。

records.text: Or, if you prefer, I'll give you the Lumenstone locations and stay behind with Miss Lenore. She's a sharp mind. Conversing with her has been enlightening.
records.zh: 或者我将灵炬的位置告知于您，我在这里保护伊诺尔小姐。伊诺尔小姐是一位非常渊博的学者，跟她交流我很有收获。

records.text: (If I waste time here, Phrolova might get away again.)
records.zh: （弗洛洛随时可能离开，要抓紧）

records.text: (If I leave Lenore alone with this thing, she might be in danger...)
records.zh: （再让它和伊诺尔待着并不安全）

records.text: Tell me where the Lumenstones are. I'll take Lenore with me. You stay here.
records.zh: 把地点告诉我，我带伊诺尔过去，你留在这。

records.text: Miss Lenore, is this the 漂泊者 you've been going on about?
records.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，这位就是您一直提及的漂泊者大人吗？

records.text: This place is far more dangerous than Nimbus Sanctum.
records.zh: 这里比云海危险得多。

records.text: But when I arrived, she was nowhere to be found. An employee with exceptionally dark circles told me she'd headed off to the Riccioli Islands. So I scraped together everything I had and got myself a ticket.
records.zh: 但等我到金库之后转了一圈都没找到。一个黑眼圈很重的员工跟我说菲比去了黎乔利群岛，所以我又花了好大力气买了票赶到那边去。

records.text: Is this an illusion from the past? It looks similar to what we saw in the Nimbus Sanctum, but the frequency is stronger.
records.zh: 这是过去的幻影？和氤柔水境见到的很像，但频率更加强烈。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森首段_1_1
records.text: 漂泊者, what are you up to? Busy? If you've got a sec, you should swing by the Dimmr Plains.
records.zh: 漂泊者同学最近在做什么，有空来黯原一趟吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森首段_1_1
records.text: Coordinates sent. Heads up though, Solisia Landing can be a nightmare to navigate. Plus, there are reports of rampaging Exoswarm in the area. Victims of past Void Storms.
records.zh: 坐标已经发送给你，落日堤屿路况复杂，基站周遭隐蔽着不少受磁暴影响的隧群，请注意安全。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森首段_1_6
records.text: So Shepherds and Soliskin come to the Dimmr Plains too?
records.zh: 牧者和日灵们也来黯原了吗？

records.text: But some of these are just nonsense. Check this one out—five boxes of Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles. "Hypothermia setting in at the Sealed Fissure. Requesting noodles to keep our research passion from freezing solid."
records.zh: 但是有些申请简直是乱写一气，你看这条申请5箱午夜妙妙杯面的，“封存地实在太冷了需要泡面让科研热情回暖”……

records.text: Felicity, I noticed you applied for a transfer to a research team near the Dimmr Deep?
records.zh: 菲莉希蒂你在申请调去恒黯之原附近的科研组？

records.text: Is it ok we talk about it? Voidmatter levels in the Dimmr Plains are holding steady, and the probability of a Void Storm is basically zero, but... The Dimmr Deep is still more dangerous than other areas.
records.zh: 方便和我说说吗？虽然黯原的虚质浓度一直没有升高，发生磁暴的概率几近于零，但恒黯之原……还是要比其他区域危险一些。

records.text: Oh, no, I should've been clearer. It's my younger sister, Solstafir. She's a big admirer of Sigrika and wants to apply to Startorch...
records.zh: 不不，怪我没说清楚。是我妹妹塞莱斯托，她很崇拜西格莉卡，因此想要报考星炬学院……

records.text: Ecological restoration in the Dimmr Plains is looking promising! If we keep this up...
records.zh: 黯原区域生态修复进度非常理想！保持当前效率……

records.text: You want to go back to Bjartr Woods? Bask in the sun? Very well. When the expedition ends, home we go.
records.zh: 想回浮光林晒太阳？没问题，等科考活动结束我们就回去。

records.text: Hehe, you bet it is. You'll see when you get there. We're talking a racetrack near the Dimmr Deep! You hear the mournful cries of people disappeared by Void Storms in the wind. Whaddya say, up for a race?
records.zh: 嘿嘿，包的包的，去了你就知道了。那可是恒黯之原附近的赛道，风声里还有被虚质磁暴吞噬之人的悲泣，敢不敢过去和我比一场？

records.text: A race? You're on. I've been training with Lynae. Learnt a bunch of new techniques. I could beat you with one hand tied behind my back.
records.zh: 比就比，谁怕你，我可是跟琳奈同学潜心学习过摩托驾驶技术，让你一只手都能赢。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森尾段_1_1
records.text: Thank you. The expedition fares well. Most of the little ones have returned with their teams. Bada remains in the Sealed Fissure to complete its task.
records.zh: 好的，科考进度一切顺利，除了巴达还在封存地，其他孩子现在都跟着各自的科考小组回到了基站。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森尾段_1_5
records.text: Budee is also remarkably sharp. It's much more familiar with the terrain of the Silent Crag than Finella is, so it always brings me back "surprises."
records.zh: 巴迪也很聪明，寂静断崖的地形它比菲尼安记得更熟，所以它总能给我带回来一些“惊喜”。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森尾段_1_5
records.text: The last time I was interviewed for a magazine, I was still a visiting scholar in the New Federation... That must have been over a decade ago.
records.zh: 我上次接受杂志采访时还在新联邦访学，算算也已经过去十几年了……

records.text: (Buried deep in Bjartr Woods... Guess the Void Storm carried it here.)
records.zh: （埋在浮光林深处……应该是被磁暴卷进来的。）

records.text: "...Fine. I will go back. Say sorry to Professor Lisandro and Dorien. Field experiments are so hard... I want to go back to Bjartr Woods."
records.zh: “……好吧，那我去跟利桑德教授和多里安道歉……出来做试验好难啊，我想回浮光林了呜呜。”

records.text: The snow and ice in the Sealed Fissure show no signs of melting...
records.zh: 封存地的冰雪，没有丝毫消融迹象……

records.text: A Huanglong fiction magazine, a New Federation Entertainment Weekly from CoLynch Press, and even some compound thistle capsules from Harmoway Medicine...
records.zh: 瑝珑小说杂志、柯林奇报业发行的《新联邦娱乐周刊》，还有哈默韦制药的复合双蓟胶囊之类的……

records.text: The terrain of the Dimmr Plains is difficult, and several areas are still contaminated by Voidmatter.
records.zh: 黯原的地形复杂，并且部分地区仍有残留的虚质污染。

records.text:
Report No.: 94001

After extensive preparations, we finally crossed Desorock Highland and reached Norfall Valley within two weeks.

However, due to the presence of the Groundwave Barrier, even with our specialized protective gear, it was impossible to deploy our full force into the valley at once. As a result, the Outriders were sent ahead to conduct reconnaissance and prepare for the moment anticipated by the General and foretold by the Sentinel.

In the Battle Beneath the Crescent, the crescent moon of doom hung high in the sky... That battle is now in the past, yet upon returning to this valley, the echoes of tragic wails still linger in the air. It is impossible to tell if they are TD simulations or the "phantoms" of fallen warriors... Countless soldiers perished in unimaginable agony and desperation during that conflict, where allies and enemies were indistinguishable. I can hardly bring myself to remember those moments... Pushed by General Jiyan, Huaxu Academy developed the Retroact Rain antidote, meaning we were not completely defenseless. But when the Retroact Rain was enhanced by the Threnodian force, only those with Resonance powers could withstand its unrelenting strain on the mind. Ordinary soldiers were powerless to bear its crushing weight...
 
Due to limited intelligence and reckless decisions, we paid a heavy price in the Battle Beneath the Crescent. General Jiyan led us through a narrow breach out of the Norfall Barrens, establishing Vanguard Base just outside Norfall Valley, where we have held our ground ever since. We cannot afford to let such a tragedy unfold again.

General Jiyan has drawn the attention of most TDs outside Norfall Valley, buying us crucial time to conduct reconnaissance. The Groundwave Barrier disrupts all communication signals, so if anyone is separated from the main force, the positioning system won't be able to track them again. Getting lost here is as good as a death sentence. From this point on, we're on our own. Every step must be taken with the utmost caution.

...

After a long journey spent covering our tracks, dodging the TDs, and bearing the pressure of the Groundwave Barrier, the team is utterly exhausted. But finally, we've made it to the cliff.
 
From what we've seen along the way, transportation within Norfall Valley is severely restricted—far too narrow for large military machines, especially with the constant risk of falling rocks. If a conflict erupts here, the idea of ordinary people navigating heavy Tacetite machinery is practically impossible. This must be why General Jiyan shifted tactics, allowing only Resonators with Resonance Energy to join Vanguard Base.
 
Looking toward the depths of the Norfall Barrens, we can see that the Ruins still hover in the distance. We set up the long-range recon device, revealing a swarm of highly agitated TDs moving restlessly amid eerie shrieks echoing through the air. That sound brings back memories of the monster in the Battle Beneath the Crescent.
records.zh:
《报告编号：94001》
历时半个月，在做好万全准备后，我们终于跨越荒石高地，抵达了北落峡谷。
由于地波气障的存在，即使配备了特殊的防护装置，北落峡谷也无法容许我们的大部队批量进入，为此才需要踏白小队提前探知情报，在将军所说的……岁主预言的时刻到来之前，做好准备。
弯刀之役，虚月当空，月如弯刀……那场战役已经过去了，但时至今日，我们重新回到这峡谷里，仍能听见那些凄厉的嚎哭，分不清究竟是残象的模拟还是将士们的“幽灵”……多少人，在这场战役中，于分不清敌我的厮杀中，带着最痛苦的迷茫与绝望死去，我已经不敢回忆……在忌炎将军的推动下，华胥研究院已经配备出了抗溯洄雨药剂，我们面对溯洄雨并非无能为力。但在被鸣式力量增强的溯洄雨中作战，除非共鸣力加持，普通人根本无法承受那种心灵上的重压……
曾经，因情报不足而导致的冒进，在弯刀之役中给予了我们惨痛的教训。忌炎将军带领我们从北落野的腹地杀出重围，随即在北落峡谷外就近建立破阵营，坚守至今，一刻不敢懈怠……同样的惨剧，我们绝对不能再经历第二次了。
忌炎将军已带队在北落峡谷外吸引了大部分残象的注意，为我们争取到了宝贵的时间，必须抓紧机会进行勘察……地波气障会阻碍通讯信号的传输，个人一旦与大部队脱节，便很难再被定位系统追踪到。若在此处失去音讯……几乎与死亡无异。之后的路程，只能靠我们自己了，我们的每一步行动都必须慎之又慎。
……
一边隐匿踪迹躲避残象，一边对抗着地波气障的重压，队员们已经疲惫不堪……但终于，我们抵达了那道断崖。
就沿途的经历来看，北落峡谷的运输能力严重不足，大型军工设备根本无法进入，甚至需要时刻提防落石的威胁。如果战斗在此爆发，普通人想要依靠驾驶重型黑石军械参与到这场战斗中来，几乎是无稽之谈。想来，也是因为考虑到这种情况，将军才会选择改制，仅允许具有拥有共鸣力的共鸣者们加入破阵营吧。
向北落野的腹地望去，残破的废墟仍旧悬浮在那里。我们架设起远距离观测设备——那里充斥着异常狂躁的残象，空气里还常常能听到尖锐的怪声……那声音就像是，弯刀之役时的那只怪物。

records.text:
The first page of the New Branch Employee Handbook, distributed by KU-Tata. It provides an overview of the Black Shores ground level.
 
As the think tank for Lament prediction and world salvation, the Black Shores is also referred to as the "singularity for observing the Lament." Over the course of civilization, it has focused on studying the Lament and Waveworn Phenomena. Black Shores members travel globally to collect Reverberation samples from Lament zones, using the Tethys System to reverse-engineer them. Their goal is to replicate the premonitions and processes of the Lament in order to pinpoint its original source. By feeding a large volume of Reverberation specimens into the system, they aim to improve the accuracy of the Lament and Waveworn Phenomenon forecasts, reducing losses for their allies.

The Black Shores Archipelago is built on a massive piece of Tacetite, rich in high-dimensional Remnant Energy, which powers the endless computational cost of the Tethys System. Additionally, the vast energy field generated by the Tacetite's frequency forms a natural barrier that conceals the Black Shores within the seas. For those outside the organization, entry to the Black Shores is by invitation only, under the guidance of the Shorekeeper.
records.zh:
库塔塔发给新枝的员工手册第一页，这是一份关于黑海岸上层的基础信息汇总。

作为救世与悲鸣预警的智库，黑海岸在过去也被称作“悲鸣观测的奇点”，与文明同行，在漫长的时间里负责悲鸣与海蚀现象观测。黑海岸的成员会去往世界各地的悲鸣区域收集遗留的残响样本，借助“泰缇斯系统”逆向解析悲鸣区遗留的残响，加以复现悲鸣发生的前兆与历程，并以此接近悲鸣的原点。借由残响样本的大量输入，以进一步提高悲鸣与海蚀现象预警的精度，从而帮助同盟降低悲鸣带来的损失。

黑海岸岛链本身就是一块巨大的、蕴含着高维回音能量的黑石，这也成为了支持黑海岸“泰缇斯系统”巨大能耗的核心。而黑石频率的形成的巨大能量场，成为了黑海岸隐匿于海中的天然屏障。对组织外人员而言，需要得到黑海岸的邀请，才能因循守岸人的指引到达。

records.text:
Jinzhou, the fortress city that guards the border of Huanglong, also stands as Huanglong's first border of entry for those arriving from overseas. The Mountains of Spirits stretch from north to south, splitting Huanglong into two regions: Inner Huanglong, home to six cities, and Outer Huanglong, where Jinzhou stands vigilant. These mountains form a natural barrier, with the gorges acting as the only gateway into Inner Huanglong, protected day and night by Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers.
 
The establishment of the first fortress in Outer Huanglong began with the emergence of the Norfall Barrens Tacet Field, where TD Outbreaks began to ravage the region. After enduring months of grueling combat, the army could no longer withstand the onslaught of the TD Outbreaks and was forced to retreat to the Gorges of Spirits, making their final stand. The warriors held their ground for days, fiercely battling as the defense lines were breached and reclaimed multiple times. During this time, the Waveworn Phenomenon across Huanglong appeared to be in an active phase, and it seemed as though the TDs were being led by a mysterious leader, aiming to converge in Inner Huanglong.

At the critical moment, reinforcements from the six cities were dispatched to the Gorges of Spirits, where the border warriors were still fighting with unwavering resolve. As the battle reached its peak, the appearance of the Crownless shattered the stalemate. Wherever the Crownless manifested, darkness enveloped the sky, and an oppressive atmosphere took hold, suffocating the warriors. Still, they held the line, willing to sacrifice themselves to buy time to destroy the entrance to the Gorges of Spirits and halt the TD Outbreak. They did so knowing it would trap most of them in Outer Huanglong with the TDs forever.
 
In that moment of life and death, a mighty Loong's roar emerged from the depths of the Gorges of Spirits, reverberating like thunder across the land. The roar burst forth from the Gorge, forcing back the TD army poised to flood in. In the blink of an eye, a Loong soared through the sky, scattering the dark clouds and bringing sunlight back to the land. Then, an otherworldly figure with golden eyes appeared, standing between the TDs and the warriors, confronting the Crownless in a fierce standoff. As the poem goes, "Armors gleam golden with Loong scales in the sun." As reinforcements from the six cities arrived, the united forces drove the TD Outbreaks and the Crownless back to the northern reaches of the Central Plains.
 
After this battle, Outer Huanglong was reborn from the ashes. The emergence of both the Threnodian and the holy creature signaled the need for a new city to rise and serve as Huanglong's border stronghold. Drawing inspiration from the "Jin" sound in "Guan Jin," meaning "the pass," and the form of Jin from the character symbolizing the roar of a Loong, this city was named Jinzhou.
records.zh:
这今州是瑝珑边境的要塞关城，也是由外海进入瑝珑的第一道陆上口岸。那一道纵贯南北的云陵山脉将瑝珑分隔开来，六州关内，今州在关外。这山脉形同天堑，谷中则是入关的必经之路，也是瑝珑的咽喉，长久以来都由今州夜归的众将士昼夜把守。
说起这瑝珑关外第一要塞的建制契机，却是始于昔日北落野无音区的生成，那不断引发残象潮的无音区祸害得关外满目疮痍。数月的战火过去，戍边的军团不敌源源不断的残象潮，只得一路退守至云陵谷，以此为最终界限。那最后的守关一役连绵数日，将士殊死奋战，阵地数次易手。此时瑝珑各州的海蚀现象亦进入活跃期，残象们似有首脑指引，意图在关内集聚。
危难关头，六州向边关派来增援，戍士们死守云陵谷不退。拉锯战进行到极致时，那无冠者的诞生却霎时间打破了艰难维持的僵局。那无冠者所至时乌云蔽日、四野昏沉，众将士只觉呼吸都凝滞住，仅凭吊着一口气维系着战线，让其不至于崩溃，以牺牲换得时间，试图摧毁云陵谷口以阻隔残象潮——但，这也意味着大部戍士将随着残象一同被永远阻隔在关外。
此攸关存亡之际，云陵谷深处传来了低沉的龙吟。那龙吟在谷中不断回荡，变得愈发声势浩荡，形同怒啸。吼声冲出谷口，冲开了试图涌入云陵谷的残象大军，戍士们忽见天空中游弋的龙影，云霞明灭之间拨云见日，万顷天光回落大地。但见金瞳异人的身影亘于残象潮与戍士间，与无冠者呈对垒之势，六州的增援旋即赶到。甲光向日，金鳞洞开。劫后余生的戍士们同仇敌忾，终于将残象潮和那无冠者退治到中曲以北。
此役后，关外大地浴火重生。鸣式与神兽皆现，建都则势在必行，而这第七州就承担瑝珑关城的职责，取「关津」之「津」音，「龙吟解困」之「吟」形，定名为「今」，故名今州。

records.text:
Each area within the Black Shores Archipelago serves a specific function, including personnel management, issuing warnings, hosting international envoys, and providing living and preparation areas for Black Shores Consultants and Bloom Bearers.

Its true core, however, lies deep underground in Tethys' Deep—a highly classified zone off-limits to anyone outside the organization.

For years, the Black Shores has been collecting Reverberation data, recruiting skilled personnel, and liaising with other nations to advance efforts in analyzing the Lament.

As a global salvation organization, the Black Shores aims to minimize the impact of the Lament on civilization, help allies avoid threats, assist with reconstruction, and offer neutral advisory services during disasters. Notably, only the ground level is accessible to international envoys, where visitors are welcomed, daily affairs are managed, and information is exchanged.
records.zh:
黑海岸的地上的群岛以岛屿为单位划分职能，分别用于人事管理、发布预警信息、接待外国使节，或作为黑海岸客卿与执花的生活区、整备区。
而黑海岸真正的核心工作区位于地下的“泰缇斯之底”，也是任何非黑海岸成员无法进入的机密场所。

长久以来，黑海岸持续收集残响数据、招贤纳士，与各国接洽以推进解析悲鸣的协同计划。
作为救世组织，黑海岸需要降低文明遭受侵害，协助同盟势力进行避险，并提供重建支援，或以中立身份作为灾害应对的顾问，不过值得一提的是，黑海岸仅地表区域对各国使节开放，地表地区负责访客接待、日常事务与信息收发。

records.text:
Report on Lampylumen
 
The Tiger's Maw Mine primarily produces Lampylumen along with other ore deposits, as well as a minor quantity of Tacetite ores.

Following years of joint research by Huaxu Academy and the Ministry of Development, a unanimous conclusion has been reached regarding the formation of the Tiger's Maw.

They found that tectonic shifts caused by the Waveworn Phenomenon altered the plate tectonics in Jinzhou, uplifting ore deposits formed tens of millions of years ago to the upper crust and introducing Lampylumen into the domain of human knowledge.

The initial survey of the Lampylumen veins has led to the following conclusions:

Form: Lampylumen typically has a cubic structure, often found as singular cubes or stacked formations, and its rectangular shape allows for easy extraction. It melts at high temperatures, making it easy to shape.

Properties: Due to its unique formation, Lampylumen has an internal structure arranged like an electrical network, making it an ideal material for semiconductor sheets.

Application: Lampylumen can be used in chips for Terminals and Resonance Beacons, as well as in the manufacturing of various high-precision components (further assessment required).
records.zh:
《关于辉萤矿的报告》

虎口矿场为复合型矿场，主要产出资源为辉萤石，同时有多种伴生矿物与少量黑石矿产出。

关于虎口矿坑的形成，华胥研究院与天工经过历时多年联合考察一致得出结论——
海蚀现象引发的地壳变动，改变了今州的板块结构，将千万年前的矿石翻到了上层，辉萤石继而进入了人类的视野。
关于辉萤石矿脉的初步勘察结论如下：

形态：大部分辉萤石的结构为立方体单体或多个穿插，其方正的形状也为采集提供了一定的便利。高温可融，融化后易塑形。
特性：辉萤石因其特殊的形成方式，使得辉萤石的内部结构呈现出如同电路一般的排布方式，是绝佳的半导体片材。
应用：可作为终端与信标的晶片，用于各类精密元器件的制造（需进一步评估）。

records.text:
A tourism guide penned by the Pioneer Association, featuring reports on the Hongzhen hot spring in Mt. Firmament.

[Tranquility’s Healing Touch] Spring's Taste

Spring's Taste is a centuries-old hot spring inn nestled in Hongzhen, set against the foothills beside a natural hot spring and known for its distinctive architectural style. After the slowed time flow on Mt. Firmament was lifted, the inn has finally opened to outside visitors. Here, snowflakes drift down as steam rises into the warm glow of lantern light, creating a serene atmosphere for guests soaking in the hot spring, with views of the undulating, snow-laden mountains in Mt. Firmament. This experience promises to dissolve all fatigue and stress! Many visitors leave Hongzhen with a lingering sense of awe and wonder, as though they've glimpsed a celestial realm—making Spring's Taste the top hot spring destination in all of Huanglong!
 
[Hot Spring Egg Challenge] Perfect Coddled Egg
 
As the oldest hot spring inn on Solaris-3, Spring's Taste offers food and lodging that reflect the authentic essence of Mt. Firmament, earning unanimous praise from its guests. The owner is a renowned foodie with a deep love for life and gourmet cuisine. Taking full advantage of the natural hot spring, he invented a unique method of "hot spring slow cooking," where food is sealed in jars and soaked in the hot spring to cook slowly.
 
Each year, Spring's Taste hosts a Hot Spring Egg Challenge, where participants compete to cook the perfect egg with a custard-like yolk. The winner is said to earn a year of free accommodations at the inn!
records.zh:
一份先行公约撰写的旅游指南，是关于乘霄山虹镇温泉的特别报道。

【极致治愈的仙境旅馆】落泉居！
落泉居是虹镇传承数百年的温泉旅馆，依山而建，靠泉坐落，和其他店家一样保有着独特建筑的风貌。自乘霄山的时流解封后，落泉居也终于开放了对外接待的服务——清冷的白雪飘舞，蒸汽在橘黄灯光中升腾，躺在这样惬意的温泉中凝望乘霄山上层层叠叠的山峦和朦胧雪景，能够治愈您心中一切疲惫和创伤！大部分游客都在离开虹镇后有种亦真亦幻、如访仙境的留恋感，使这里一跃成为全瑝珑最受欢迎的温泉圣地！

【温泉蛋挑战】完美流心！
作为全索拉里斯至今传承最久的温泉旅馆，落泉居从住宿到吃食，都完整地保留了原汁原味的乘霄山特色，受到广大住客的一致好评。落泉居的旅馆老板是远近闻名的饕餮，最懂得享受生活，享受美食。依靠温泉得天独厚的优势，他独创了温泉漫煮烹饪法，可以将食物放入密封陶罐，再放于温泉水中浸煮。
每年落泉居会举办温泉蛋挑战赛，根据参赛者煮出温泉蛋的流心状态来决定胜负，据说冠军可以获得一年的免费住宿权！

records.text:
A page of the New Branch Employee Handbook, distributed by KU-Tata. It provides an overview of the Black Shores underground level.

The underground of the Black Shores is where its data space intersects with reality, also known as Tethys' Deep.

In other words, the underground space of the Black Shores is the Tethys System itself. Space Anchors, stabilizing devices positioned throughout the surface and underground levels, act as firewalls to maintain the balance between the data zone and reality, ensuring they do not interfere with each other.

If the Space Anchors malfunction, the data zone within the Tethys System can "invade" reality, triggering anomalies that, according to the records, include but are not limited to:

Regional overlap between the digital space and the physical world, an increased likelihood of Consultants and Bloom Bearers developing spatial perception disorders, and simulated objects from the Sand Table escaping into reality.
records.zh:
库塔塔发给新枝的员工手册的中间一页，这是一份关于黑海岸下层信息的简要说明。

黑海岸的地下是数据空间与现实的交界地，也被称作泰缇斯之底。

换言之，黑海岸地下空间即是泰缇斯系统本机。贯穿地上与地下的四柱空间稳定锚如同防火墙般，稳定着数据区域与现实区域的平衡，使二者的运转互不干扰。
而稳定锚一旦出现故障，【泰缇斯系统】内的数据区域将对现实区域产生“入侵”，根据卷宗的记录，包括但不限于：
数据空间对现实世界产生区域性覆盖；执花与客卿出现空间认知障碍的概率提升；沙盘系统中的模拟造物逃逸至现实等异常现象。

records.text:
[Theory III: Water is Reflective]
The Ragunnesi believe that water reflects everything without discrimination, allowing humans to see another version of themselves within it.

Water mirrors the appearance of the Ragunnesi, and the Ragunnesi, in turn, see their reflections in the water. If the world is like an ocean, then the frequencies of humans and the world influence and shape one another. The wondrous water has been imbued with the human spirit, symbolizing the cycle of life and death. If water represents the subconscious, it also serves as a harbor for fantasies and desires.

This is why research into the Remnant domain is also prevalent within the Order.

The Seminary of the Forgotten in Rinascita was once flooded by Nimbus Sanctum, which later proved to be a manifestation of Remnant Energy, recording the emotions and memories of humans without distinction, and then reflecting them in reality.

With the old site of the Seminary still present, Nimbus Sanctum holds a special allure for Acolytes of the Order, who visit to pray or salvage ancient texts.
Some scholars believe the Remnant Cloud is a higher-dimensional form of water, while others speculate that another world exists beneath Nimbus Sanctum.

[Theory IV: Water is All-Encompassing]
This all-encompassing nature is why Ragunna, under the guidance of the Order, is a city that welcomes exiles from all walks of life and grants them equal rights. The Carnevale is the epitome of this inclusiveness. Ragunnesi from various isles unite to honor their hometowns and families lost in the Lament. Dressed in their traditional clothing and wearing masks symbolizing ancestors and totems, they perform a variety of dramas. The diversity and inclusiveness lie at the core of the performances during the Carnevale.

[Theory V: Unity]
Taking inspiration from the all-encompassing nature of water, Primus Fenrico, upon assuming power, developed the doctrine of Unity and enshrined it in the Codex.

For the exiled people of Rinascita, formed after the Lament, religion is not merely a practice in the Order but a collection of science, philosophy, politics, individual identity, and the hope for salvation. The civilization of Rinascita is anchored around faith, meaning religion is not just a personal pursuit but a universal truth that explains the world and defines one's place within it.

Any heretical theory that undermines or challenges this faith is seen as a dagger aimed at the heart of truth itself. Such ideas threaten the existence of those around them and risk tearing apart the fabric of society, bringing calamity and destruction to this city by the sea.

The Primus believes that whenever the ideology of Division reaches its zenith, the calamity of the Dark Tide will descend from above, endangering the very existence of Rinascita. For this reason, even the Carnevale, which embodies the spirit of inclusiveness, must be overseen by the Order.
records.zh:
【其三：水具有反身性】
拉古那人认为，水会无差别地反映一切，人们能够在水中看见另一个自我。
水照映出拉古那人的面貌，拉古那人在水中窥见自我。如果将世界视作一片汪洋，人与世界的频率相互影响，相互塑造。这奇妙的「水」，被灌输了人类的精神，代表着生与死的循环。 如果水是潜意识生活的形象，那么它也就是离奇幻觉与欲望的港湾。
正因如此，对于回音领域的研究也在修会之中颇为盛行。
黎那汐塔的旧神学院曾被云海淹没，后被证实此地蔓延的云海，实为一种回音能量——它们会无差别地记录一切人类的情感与记忆，并将其反映在现实之中。
加之神学院旧址的存在，云海对于修会的教士们有着一种特别的吸引力。教士们常会前去巡礼，或在云海中打捞旧日的典籍。
有部分学者认为，回音云是「水」的一种高维表现。也有人认为，云海之下或许已经生成了「另一个世界」。
【其四：水包容一切】
因而修会所带领的拉古那也是一座开放的城，它包容不同出身的流亡者，给予所有人平等的权利。而狂欢节也成为了这种包容性的最佳见证。来自各个岛邦，又重新团聚在一起的拉古那人，为了纪念在悲鸣中消失的家乡与逝去的家人，穿上了各自的民族衣装，戴上了象征先祖与图腾的面具，演绎着不同的戏剧。多元与兼容，构成了狂欢节各式剧目的精神内核。
【其五：联结】
基于水的包容性，芬莱克主座即位后，从中引申出「联结」的教义，将之编入圣典。
对于悲鸣过后，由无数流亡者建立起来的黎那汐塔人来说，宗教不只是人们在教堂里实践的东西，它就是科学、哲学、政治、个人身份和拯救的希望。黎那汐塔的文明以「信仰」作为锚点，如此，宗教对于黎那汐塔人而言，不单是一种个人爱好，而是一种永恒普遍的，用以解释世界，定义自身的真理。
任何可能否定，动摇信仰的异端学说，就成了插在此种真理心脏上的利刃，它不但会危及周围人的「存在」，还会令社会结构四分五裂，给这座摇摇欲坠的海上城邦带来灭顶之灾。
芬莱克主座认为，每当这种「分裂」的思潮到达顶峰，名为「黑潮」的灾难便会从天而降，为黎那汐塔带来危机。故即使是彰显「包容」一义的狂欢节，也理应需要修会的管控。

records.text:
I once joked to a friend that if, one day, you find yourself wanted across all of Solaris-3 for illegal actions like short selling or trading in debts, then, based on my experience, apart from digging your own grave, your best bet would be to hide in Averardo Vault in Rinascita. As long as you can prove your worth, the Montelli family will keep you safe—even if it means turning a blind eye. They'll go so far as to pay your bail out of their own pockets and assemble a professional international legal team for you, with only one condition: that you build strong business ties with them.

Trust me on this, I deal a lot with the Montellis. They value the so-called "spirit of the contract" more than most businessmen.
 
Back when I was younger, I couldn't stand those brash islanders. They didn't play by the rules, were full of energy, and always spoke their minds. They were nothing like the Rinascitan people I knew, who were all about dance and performance. But over time, I came to recognize a trait in them that others lacked. They always price everything upfront. The Montellis are by far the easiest businessmen to understand because their world operates on just one principle: the contract. And the only thing driving that principle? Profit.

 —Excerpt from How to Get Unlimited Shell Credits
records.zh:
我曾经和朋友开过一个玩笑，我说如果你有一天做空或者债务买卖的事情败露了，被全索拉里斯人通缉……那么相信我的判断，除了直接给自己修个坟，你最好的选择就是藏在黎那汐塔的埃弗拉德金库里，只要你能证明自己的价值，莫塔里人就算捏着鼻子也要把你保住——他们甚至会出钱帮你取保候审，组一个专业的国际法务团队，前提只有一个：只要你和他们建立足够的业务联系。
相信我，我经常和莫塔里人打交道。他们比大多数商人更尊重所谓的“契约精神”。
在几十年前我还年轻的时候，我最讨厌这些海岛来的愣头青，他们不懂规矩，干劲满满，口无遮拦，和从前认识的那些只会歌舞的黎那汐塔人截然不同；可后来我发现，他们这些人做生意有一个特点是其他人模仿不来的……那就是他们的服务向来明码标价。他们简直就是世界上最好懂的商人，因为莫塔里人的世界只遵循一个规则：合同！而驱动这个规则的载体永远只有一个：利益。

——节选自《如何实现贝币自由》

records.text:
10 Fun Facts You May Have Missed in the Pioneer Association's Historical Documentary: Land of the Sentinel!

1. All scenes depicting miracles and myths were filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula, the only location abundant with the distinctive Viscum Viride. Interestingly, plant lineage studies suggest that Viscum Viride is most likely not native to Rinascita.
 
2. For scenes featuring Napoli the Second, the Order of the Deep denied the crew access to film within their Cathedral. Instead, the crew used ruins in the Fagaceae Peninsula to complete these shots. The reason for the denial was that the actor portraying Napoli the Second had previously played a merchant who falls in love with an Acolyte in another documentary.

3. The backstory of the Fisalia family's rise to prominence is loosely based on a legendary wealthy merchant from the New Federation, as the Fisalia family declined to share their own history for the documentary.

4. In the documentary, the Blessed Maiden is shown helping villagers pick fruit as a child. However, there are no fruit trees near Egla Town. This scene was actually filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula.
records.zh:
关于先行公约出品的黎那汐塔历史纪录片「岁主之国」，你所不知道十个彩蛋！

1，片中所有关于神迹和传说的取景地都在槲生半岛，因为只有这里大片生长着标志性的的青枝。事实上，从植物系谱上来分类，这种植物很大概率不是黎那汐塔的本地产物。

2，关于那不盖勒二世的部分，隐海修会拒绝在圣堂建筑内部提供取景，最后剧组跑到槲生半岛的遗迹完成了这场戏。原因是因为扮演那不盖勒二世的演员曾在其他记录片中扮演过一个爱上神职人员的商人。

3，片中的翡萨烈发家史其实以新联邦的传奇富商故事为原型，而关于真正的历史翡萨烈人则拒绝提供资料。

4，片中的圣女小时候会帮助村民采摘水果，但事实上埃格拉镇附近没有果树，这段是在槲生半岛拍的。

records.text:
5. The Divine Envoys featured in the documentary were actually portrayed by the Echoes from Reserved Terminals, as the Order refused to allow the actual Divine Envoys to participate in any form of entertainment filming.

6. The battle scenes involving Napoli the Second and the Blessed Maiden were largely performed by sponsors, many of whom were contractors from Lollo Logistics. Locals from Rinascita only made up a small part of the cast, but they spent an entire day teaching the couriers how to charge into their enemies like knights.

7. In the bar fight scene, the director personally contributed to the fighting choreography due to having consumed too much of the special brew made in the Fagaceae Peninsula.

8. The iconic scene of the first Pilgrim's Sail setting off was filmed in a single take because the crew was only able to lease the ship for half a day.

9. The current head of the Montelli family made a cameo appearance, playing the role of the first family head of the Montellis.

10. The documentary has yet to be shown in local cinemas in Ragunna.
records.zh:
5，片中出镜的神使全部都是私人终端中的声骸假扮的，修会拒绝了让神使参与这种拍摄娱乐制品的行为。

6，片中随那不盖勒二世或圣女出征的场面其实都是由赞助商扮演的，其中，有许多是来自呜呜物流的临时工。黎那汐塔的本地员工只占一小部分，但他们用一天教会了配送员们如何像个骑士一样冲锋。

7，酒馆室内打架那段戏，导演自己也抡拳上去了，原因是因为在片场喝了太多槲生半岛的特酿酒。

8，扮演初代朝圣船出海的那场戏只拍了一遍，因为那艘船剧组只能租半天。

9，莫塔里家族的初代家族长由他们这一代家族长友情客串。

10，这部纪录片至今未在拉古那城本地上映。

records.text:
The Employee Manual for all staff members of the Averardo Vault. Below is the content from the first page:

Welcome to the Averardo Vault. Your arrival brings fresh energy to the Vault, and we sincerely look forward to your exceptional performance.

In keeping with the principle of "the sanctity and inviolability of private property," the Averardo Vault houses a vast collection of priceless Echoes and artworks. It is the safest and most secure place in Rinascita. Your every word and action reflect the Vault's image, and we trust this manual will help you gain a comprehensive understanding of the Averardo Vault.

Vault Overview:

The Vault is located east of Ragunna City, where it stores a vast array of Echoes and artworks. The Vault is divided into two zones: the Upper Management Zone, positioned above a chasm with a commanding view of the sea of clouds, and the Underground Depository Zone, situated beneath the clouds and connected to the upper zone by an elevator tower.

The Vault's security system is comprised of Echoes.
records.zh:
埃弗拉德金库在职员工均持有的手册，以下是手册第一页所记载的内容。

欢迎您入职埃弗拉德金库。您的到来为金库注入了新的血液，衷心期待您接下来的优异表现。
秉持着私有“私有财产神圣不可侵犯”的条例，埃弗拉德金库内存储有大量珍贵声骸与艺术品，是黎那汐塔最为安全、稳固的场所。您的一言一行时刻代表着金库的形象，相信这本手册将会帮助您全面地了解埃弗拉德金库。

金库简介：
金库坐落于拉古那城的东侧，其中贮藏着难以计数的大量声骸和艺术品。金库分为上下两层，上层的管理区位于天堑之上，能够睥睨云海；下层的藏馆区则在云海之下，由电梯发射塔将两处相连。
金库的保全设施由声骸构成。

records.text:

records.zh:

职员和声骸，可活动的主要区块有以下：

records.text:
A poster advertising tourism in Riccioli Islands

Discover Riccioli Islands, a hidden paradise nestled amidst Rinascita's turbulent waters.
Named after the renowned astronomer and seafarer of the Order, Sir Riccioli, this archipelago has been a sanctuary of natural wonders since its discovery during Rinascita's founding years. From the elusive Riccioli Black Pearls to the ethereal Stygian Phantoms and strange Yarn Eels, the archipelago is teeming with life and natural beauties thanks to the unique qualities of its geographic location with much more yet to be discovered.
records.zh:
一份有关于黎乔利群岛观光季的宣传海报。

在黎那汐塔诸多风暴海域之间，有着这样一处平和静谧、风光旖旎的人间天堂——黎乔利群岛。
早在黎那汐塔建立之初，就已经被当时的航海家发现了的群岛，最终以修会的天文学家和航海家黎乔利的名字命名。独特的地理位置成就了此处的天然美景，也成就了生活于这片海域的百余种奇异生物，你将在此处看到珍贵的黎乔利黑珍珠，优雅的冥河水母，奇特的毛线团鳗，以及更多、更多尚未被人们所发掘的未知物种。

records.text:
Embark on adventures to encounter the mysterious ancient Echo of the sea in secluded coves and hunt for pearls washed ashore. As the tide recedes in the sunset, join friendly locals in nearby Riccioli settlements for a refreshing drink.
And last but not least, don't miss out on the signature Riccioli fishing experience!
There you have it, an enchanted wonderland filled with life where infinite possibilities are immersed in aromas of the sea.
Come to the Riccioli Islands and let your heart race as you discover life's new wonders.
records.zh:
在海湾之中，你能邂逅神秘的巨大古老声骸；在滩脊边缘，你能收获落在沙砾里的点点珍珠。当浪潮褪去，余晖洒向这岛屿，你也可以前往黎乔利聚落，与热情的当地人共饮一杯。
当然，最不容错过的，还是最具黎乔利特色的——捕鱼活动！
就是这样一个充满着生机与魅力的奇特地域，能让你在椰香与海风中无限邂逅新的故事。
来黎乔利群岛，体验美景震撼，捕获精彩人生！

records.text:
A tourism guide penned by the Pioneer Association, featuring reports on the Central Plains of Jinzhou.
 
[Celebrate the New Year with Winter Training] Liondance Troupe
 
Every winter, the Liondance Troupe goes on hiatus as its members travel to the Central Plains to train in seclusion at their training grounds in Taoyuan Vale.
 
Contrary to popular belief, the troupe's hiatus is far from a period of rest. During this time, members focus intensely on refining characters, honing skills, crafting props, rehearsing upcoming performances, and building energy for their performance at the Suan'ni New Year Parade, when the lion truly "awakens."
 
During the off-season, if the Liondance Troupe members happen to pass through Jinzhou, they're often met with playful remarks like, "Hey, Lingyang, when will you 'wake up' this year?" or "Mr. Wufang, time to 'rouse' the lion!"
 
[Liondance Troupe Training Grounds] Liondancer's Practice
 
These are Plum Blossom Poles, arranged in a zigzag pattern with decreasing density, creating a challenging course for two competing lion heads as they vie for landing spots and reach for the red pepper perched atop the tallest pole. Due to limited space in Jinzhou, the Liondance Troupe set up this formation in their courtyard at Taoyuan Vale.
 
Amidst drifting peach blossom petals, young liondancers step gracefully across the poles, creating a striking scene unique to the Central Plains.
records.zh:
一份先行公约撰写的旅游指南，是关于今州地区中曲台地的报道。

【冬歇休演，辞旧迎新】瑞狮会馆！
 瑞狮会馆的休演季是为冬季。瑞狮会馆的大家会前往中曲台地，来到位于桃源乡的演武场闭关修习。
 闭关也不似大家想象中悠哉，而是要利用好这段时间打磨心性，精进技艺——从制作狮具，到为来年排演新的剧目，还要为年关的「狻猊巡岁」养精蓄锐。直到辞旧迎新，瑞狮方「醒」。
这段时间内，瑞狮会馆的各位要是出入今州，都会被打趣道：“凌阳，今年什么时候「醒」？”或是 “五方先生，该「醒」狮啦？”

【瑞狮会馆的演武场】：狮童修行！
进入呈入字分布的梅花桩阵。梅花桩由密而疏，两方狮首若为撷得阵中高杆上的朝天椒，必然以步法争夺落足处。今州内的区域有限，因此瑞狮会馆在中曲台地的桃源乡有一处院落，瑞师团将其称作「演武场」，梅花桩阵就在其中！
桃华簌簌而落，年少的狮子郎在桩阵上踏花而行。这也成为了中曲台地的别样风景。

records.text:
...
 
The Roya once walked the surface, on ancient plains where the Glommoths and Glommothas thundered in their thousands. In the subarctic fjords, their ancestors lived as nomads, and even now, the shepherd's instinct still flows in their blood.
 
Within Roya society, three distinguished callings exist: the Shepherd, the Solsworn, and the Heliodic Six. Those recognized by the Soliskin become Shepherds, tasked with tending to the Exoswarm in their growth and renewal. Only those gifted in reckoning calendars and possessing a degree of resonance with both Soliskin and the Exostrider may enter the Solisylum, there to be named among the Solsworns. These Solsworns also stand as potential successors to the Heliodic Six.
 
Thus, gaining the acknowledgment of the Soliskin and Exoswarm is essential, whether one seeks to become a Shepherd, a Solsworn, or one of the Heliodic Six. To the Roya, the Soliskin, the Exoswarm, and all living beings in Lahai-Roi hold profound importance. Respect for life and reverence for the world shaped by the Exostrider's Reactor Drive is a lesson every Roya must master upon coming of age.
 
...
 
Within the vast underground cavern of Lahai-Roi lies Bjartr Woods, one of the rare regions untouched by the ravages of Void Storms. It is here that the Roya built the Solisylum. In ordinary seasons, they guide the Exoswarm in their growth and migration, while during periods of intense Void Storm activity, they cease shepherding and lead the Exoswarm to shelter within the Solisylum.
 
When an Exoswarm reaches full maturity, it joins a great migration. Its final destination is the Exostrider slumbering in the frostlands. The Exoswarm offer up their components to repair this ancient mecha form.
 
Beyond safeguarding Exoswarm parts, the Solisylum also serves as the central hub of data and records. Roya from every settlement bring their observational data here, where the Heliodic Six and their assisting Solsworns compile and calculate it. Each season, they determine whether the Reactor Drive remains stable, how many new Exoswarm have emerged and matured, and how many have completed their return to the Exostrider.
 
Once this information is consolidated, the Heliodic Six establishes the next season's calendar based on the Reactor Drive's activity, thereby charting the future focus of all Royan life and work.
records.zh:
……

罗伊人来自地表，来自万千年前奔腾着格洛犸图与格洛犸提的原野。
在寒带的峡湾中，他们的祖先以游牧为生，直至如今，牧人的天赋仍流淌在他们的血脉中。

在罗伊族中，有牧者，昭日者以及秘日六席这三大特殊身份。
被日灵认可的罗伊人，将成为引导日灵的“牧羊人”，获得引导隧群繁衍生息的职责。
而在筹算历法方面具备天赋，并与日灵和隧者具备一定程度共感能力的人，才能步入引日殿，成为昭日者的一员，他们同时也是秘日六席的候选人。

可以看到，被日灵与隧群认可，是成为牧者，昭日者以及秘日六席的必要条件。
在罗伊人心中，日灵，隧群，乃至拉海洛的万物生灵都至关重要——对生命的尊重，对隧者献出炉芯造就的天地的尊重，是每个罗伊人成年时的必修课。

……

在拉海洛的地下空洞中，浮光林是少有的不受虚质磁暴影响的地区，基于这一性质，罗伊人在此处修建了引日殿。
平日里，罗伊人引导隧群成长、迁徙，而在虚质磁暴高的时期，罗伊人则会休牧，带领它们聚集于引日殿避难。
当隧群完全长成之际，它们将亲历迁徙，最终回归冰原上的隧者，以对隧者的身躯进行修复。

引日殿除了承担着保管隧群部件的职责，也是罗伊人的数据与记录的集散中心。
各个聚落的罗伊人会将自己记录的观测数据带往此处，并交给秘日六席以及辅佐的昭日者汇总计算。
在每一季，炉芯的运转是否稳定，有多少隧群新生、长成，又有多少最终回归了隧者的身体，都在引日殿的测算之内。
信息汇总后，秘日六席将结合炉芯的运转状态测定下一季的历法，以此引导罗伊族未来生活或工作的重心。

records.text:
The Exoswarm are mimetic mechs, fragmented from the Exostrider's own mecha form. They are indispensable for its eventual renewal and reconstruction.

For centuries unbroken, the Roya have guided the Exoswarm up from the depths to the frostlands, toward the site of the Exostrider's slumber.
 
Before the Starward Riseway was constructed, the Roya had no choice but to climb treacherous cliffs of impossible heights, where overhanging slopes greater than ninety degrees were not uncommon. This perilous ascent is known among the Roya as the "Sky Ladder."
 
When they finally crested the frostlands, Glommoths and Glommothas would come into view. Such formidable Exoswarm escort the Roya for the final leg of the journey, then return with the other Exoswarm to the slumbering Exostrider.
 
Royan mythology is woven with cycles of the old giving way to the new, and it is through this lens that they interpret both themselves and the world around them. In ages long past, the ancestors of the Glommoths, vast elephantine beasts, roamed these plains in great herds, carrying their lineage forward.
 
And now, the Exoswarm tread across the ice, returning the lives they were granted to the one who created them.
records.zh:
……

隧群是隧者躯体碎片分化而成的拟态机械，是修复和重构隧者的必备因素。
为了帮助隧者，罗伊族千百年如一日地引导着隧群攀上冰原，向着隧者的沉眠地进发。

在联运椎骨建成前，罗伊族必须在高不可攀的陡峭崖壁上跋涉。
冰原外沿的悬崖锐利险峻，有时还会形成大于九十度的不可能倒角——这条险途被罗伊人称为“天梯”。

在终于攀上冰原后，格洛犸图与格洛犸提便会映入罗伊人的眼帘。
这种强大的隧群会护送罗伊人，并与其他隧群一起回归隧者的躯体。

在罗伊族的神话中充满了新旧交替的概念，而他们也以此来诠释自己以及周身的万物：
亘古以前，格洛犸图的祖先，巨大的象族动物在这片原野上肆意奔腾，将族群的生命延续。
而如今，隧群踏破冰雪，将被给予的生命交还给自己的创造者。

records.text:
Following multiple rounds of negotiation, the Roya and the Polar Collective reached an agreement to jointly construct scientific facilities around three key sites: the Exostrider's greatsword on the frostlands, Sundermere in the underground cavern, and the Etching Plains.
 
The Solisylum provided critical data on the Reactor Drive's operational cycles and Void Storm zone metrics, enabling large-scale infrastructure planning. Concurrently, Royan Shepherds coordinated the Exoswarm in excavation, transport, and logistical support, ensuring the project's continuous advancement.
 
Through this cooperation, the Polar Collective completed the first phase of its expansion: the Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, followed by the completion of the Starward Riseway, a massive vertical transport elevator constructed directly on the Exostrider's greatsword.
 
At the same time, the New Federation contributed its most advanced spatial-engineering technology to construct the Spacetrek Research Institute. This ring-shaped facility operates within a local low-gravity band, maintaining a stable orbital trajectory to perform continuous scans and deep-range probing of the greatsword left behind by the Exostrider.
 
Based on extensive non-invasive analysis of the Exostrider and Exoswarm, combined with data provided by the Roya, the Polar Collective has reached the following conclusions:
 
1. On the Relationship Between the Exostrider and the Sentinel
The Exostrider exhibits extremely high biological homology with the Sentinel, yet its functional profile is sharply divergent. It lacks the Sentinel's cognitive capacity for prophetic insight and civilizational guidance.
 
Its strengths lie instead in specialized combat capabilities, exceptional mobility, and pronounced biomechanical adaptability. From these traits, researchers propose the hypothesis that the Exostrider is a ███ within the ███ system, fulfilling the roles of transportation and warfare. To distinguish the two, the Institute formally designates the Exostrider as a "Sentinel Analog."
 
2. On the Physical Nature of the Exostrider
Under exposure to and catalysis from the Reactor Drive, components detached from the Exostrider's body differentiate into two classes of Exoswarm entities: animal-type and plant-type. These unique lifeforms replace the extinct fauna and flora of Lahai-Roi, stabilizing and supporting its fragile ecosystem. When sufficiently fed or charged, the Exoswarm return to the Exostrider and fuse back into its frame, repairing damaged sections.
 
However, long-term Royan records on the Exoswarm differentiation and generational cycling reveal that this bio-mechanical restoration process is finite. Like human cells, the Exoswarm possess an upper limit to their number of divisions. Over time, regeneration intervals lengthen, the rate of new differentiation decays, and eventually the process will stop completely.
 
Our projections are even more concerning. Calculations show that the total number of Exoswarm units that have already been reabsorbed, combined with the maximum potential yield from future differentiation, is still insufficient to achieve the Exostrider's complete structural restoration. This indicates a severe, long-term depletion of the Exoswarm population. While a portion of this loss is accounted for by Voidworm predation, a significant volume of missing components remains unaccounted for.
records.zh:
经多轮协商后，罗伊人与「极地联合」完成磋商，决定围绕冰原上的隧者巨剑、地下坠剑湖与蚀刻平原三地，联合建设科研设施。
其中，「引日殿」提供了关键性的炉芯运转周期，与磁暴区数据，使得基建规划得以实现；罗伊人中的「牧者」则指挥隧群参与施工与物资运输，确保工程顺利进行。
在双方协作下，「极地联合」的一期工程——冰原极地科考站，以及依附于隧者巨剑而建的巨型垂直运载电梯「联运椎骨」相继落成。
与此同时，新联邦亦提供了其最尖端的空间工程技术，于弱重力带建造了环形研究设施——「深空研究院」。「深空研究院」将环绕既定的轨道运行，对隧者留下的巨剑进行进一步的探知与扫描。
在对隧者及隧群展开非破坏性研究，并与罗伊人提供的数据进行综合比对后，「极地联合」得出下属结论：

其一：关于隧者与岁主的关系：
隧者与岁主具备高度同源性，但功能存在显著差异，并不具备岁主那种可“晓示预言”、引导文明的知能。
其优势在于极高的战斗能力、机动性与生物化特性。由此，研究院提出假说：隧者是▇▇▇体系中承担运输与战斗职能的▇▇▇▇▇。
为区分之，研究院将隧者定义为「拟岁主」。

其二：关于隧者的机体特性：
在炉芯辐照与催化作用下，脱离隧者躯体的零件会分化为动物类与植物类隧群。
这些隧群将替代灭绝的动植物，以稳固、维持拉海洛脆弱的生态圈。通过进食与充能，隧群将在能量密度达到最高时回归隧者，并与之融合，修复其受损部分。

然而，罗伊人提供的隧群分化与世代更迭数据表明：这一生物化修复过程并非无限。
隧群的分化次数存在上限，与人类细胞相似——随着时间推移，其再生间隔不断延长，新生隧群的分化速度逐渐减缓，直至停滞。
进一步的计算显示：已回归隧者的隧群总量，加上未来可能分化出的隧群数量，仍不足以完成隧者的整体修复。
这意味着隧群在漫长的世代更迭中损耗严重。部分隧群已确认被虚诞虫吞噬，且有相当数量的零件下落不明。

records.text:
...

It wasn't until midnight that the oceangoing vessel finally crossed the Void Storm Monitoring Zone and drew close to the Roya Frostlands.

Beyond the porthole, through veils of sea mist, rose an icebound cliff stretching endlessly in both directions. I kept my eyes fixed on them, breath unconsciously quickening as the towering "white wall" loomed nearer. Until now, the frostlands had existed for me only in headlines, and the transnational Polar Collective felt impossibly distant. Yet here they were. I was about to see them with my own eyes. The ship's mooring broadcast blended with the deep groan of capstans and the strain of hawsers, announcing our arrival at the Roya Icebreak Port.

After enduring several rounds of rigorous inspections, I joined the research team and departed the port. Together, we boarded a transfer elevator bound for the frostlands' central region. The car was large enough to carry supplies sufficient to sustain a small research station for six months. But barely two minutes after it began its ascent, my sense of scale was shattered completely. As the massive elevator crawled up the frozen cliff face, it felt like an ant struggling to climb the side of a mountain.

...

With the assistance of the research team, my journey to the Polar Research Outpost went smoothly. After registration, the captain led me to the storage room, where I was issued all the necessities required for surviving in the frostlands. I was then shown to my quarters—the room that I would spend every morning and night during my stay.

I left my personal luggage there and began exploring the station's facilities. Thanks to the Pioneer Association's advance notice to the researchers perhaps, I was able to move through most of the station without obstruction, aside from a handful of restricted areas. From what I could tell, Phase One of the Polar Collective's construction, namely the Frostlands Transit Port, had already been fully completed. According to the researchers, the local inhabitants, the Roya, along with the Exoswarm they herded, had played a significant role in the construction process.

However, when I asked about the plans for Phase Two, no one gave me a clear answer. Most of the personnel were absorbed in their own research and construction duties. Though none of them said it outright, their expressions made it clear enough: they had no time for a mere "visitor" from the Pioneer Association.

...

Based on my observations, the research station had received a total of ninety-two trucks over the past three days. Of the supplies they carried, only a very small portion was distributed to other areas across the frostlands. Most were sent underground via the light-rail system. From this, I concluded that Phase Two of the project was not focused on the frostlands themselves, but on the subterranean Lahai-Roi region—accessible only through the Starward Riseway.

...

On the sixth day, I woke as usual in the Polar Research Outpost. After breakfast in the dining area, I sought out the expedition leader once more and submitted my request to visit Lahai-Roi for the third time. As expected, my request was denied again. I couldn't hide my disappointment, but I understood their caution. Everything here—the discoveries, the implications—was too extraordinary, too deeply unsettling to established knowledge. Even with the Pioneer Association backing me, they had every reason to proceed with caution.
...
records.zh:
……
直到午夜时，远航船才穿过磁暴检测区，到达了罗伊冰原附近。
从舷窗向外望，隔着海雾，我看到了山脉般高耸的冰崖，它们如无际的白色城墙般向两侧绵延。
我睁大双眼，看着那冰崖逐渐向我压近，感到呼吸越来越急促，昔日只存在于秘密报道中的罗伊冰原，诸国联合共建的「极地联合」——我终于要亲眼目睹这一切了。
船只系泊的广播响起，伴随着缆绞机拉紧缆绳的低沉声响，我们抵达了罗伊不冻港。
经过十数项严格的审查后，我和前来接应我的科考队会合，一起离开港口，坐上了前往冰原腹地的运载电梯。
这座电梯的规模十分巨大，单次运送的物资便能支持一座小型营地半年的科考工作。
但是当其启动后过了不过两分钟，我的感受便完全变了——这座巨大的电梯在冰崖上爬升时，就像蚂蚁在攀登一座山峰。
……
在科考队的带领下，我顺利到达了极地科考站。
在登记后，队长把我叫到了物资仓，带我领取了在冰原上活下去所需的一切东西。
随后，我被分配了一个房间，在访问期内，这个小屋将成为我每天入眠和醒来的地方。
我把随身的行李留在了房间里，然后便开始观察科考站内的各个设施。也许是先约那边提前通知过研究员们，除少部分禁止通行的区域外，我可以毫无阻碍地前往大部分地方。
根据我的观察，「极地联合」的一期工程，即我所在的冰原运输港此时已完全建成。据研究人员的说法，当地的罗伊族以及其引导的隧群也在建设工作中提供了极大的帮助。
但当我询问二期工程的规划时，营地内的人员并未给我答复。
大部分人忙于自己手头的研究和建设任务——虽然他们并未直接这么说，但当我问东问西时，他们的眼神告诉我：我没空管来自先约的“游客”。
……
经过我的计算，前三天一共有九十二辆重载型运输车抵达科考站，而它们所携带的物资中，只有极少数被运往了冰原其他区域，其余全部经轻轨输往了地下。
我推测，「极地联合」二期工程的重心并非位于罗伊冰原，而是在地下，在经由「联运椎骨」才能抵达的拉海洛地区。
……
第六天，我如往常一般从极地科考站中醒来，到用餐区吃过早饭后，再次找到了科考队的队长，第三次向他递交了拉海洛的访问申请。
不出意料，她再次拒绝了我的请求。
虽然感到十分遗憾，但我能够理解。
这里的一切发现都太过轰动，太过颠覆常理，即使有先行公约为我背书，他们依然要谨慎行事。
……

records.text:
...

Just before the day I was scheduled to return, the captain sought me out. She said there was somewhere she wanted to show me. And so, wearing a protective suit for the first and last time in this journey, I boarded the expedition boat called Icecleaver with the rest of the research team.

After around an hour of jolting through broken ice, I forced back the nausea and stumbled down the gangway.

It was a day I would never forget.

Amid clusters of white, blue, and violet structures stood people dressed in unfamiliar garments. Nearby, a gigantic white, bear-shaped mech lay half-asleep. Seeing my stunned expression, the captain explained, "The Polar Collective's construction work is highly classified, so I can't take you to Lahai-Roi. But you can meet the Roya. They're the natives here. Most live underground, though a few have settled in the frostlands."

I remember every detail of that day. We spent the entire afternoon there, yet it passed far too quickly.

I couldn't understand their language. Every exchange had to be relayed through the captain, who was fluent in their tongue. Even so, their kindness came through unmistakably. They told me they were shepherds who herd the Exoswarm. At regular intervals, they led the Exoswarm up to the frostlands, where they gathered with larger units such as the Glommoths and Glommothas. Together, they would journey toward the Exostrider. In the end, all Exoswarm returned to the colossal Exostrider, which was said to slumber at the edge of the frostlands, the origin from which the Exoswarm were born.

Inside one of their dwellings, they shared a meal with me: roasted vegetables shaped into compact clusters, and a cured fish dish with a unique fragrance. Before we parted, we took a photograph together. I printed it on the spot and gave them copies. In return, they presented me with a strange seashell. Its surface was marked with countless small hollows, arranged in a precise spiral. According to the captain, it was a tool they used for counting.

…

When the ice cliffs finally sank below the horizon, I closed the porthole. Waves struck the hull in a steady rhythm—clang, clang—like a muted bell. I listened quietly as drowsiness crept in.

In my dream, I saw the Roya again. Against the howling wind and snow beyond the window, they sang a farewell song for me:

Walk onward, walk onward.
So quiet, in this gentle night,
I walk onward.

Not far away, right beneath my feet.
Through the open door,
Toward the dusk, toward the distant land.
Leaving the world behind,
Laying all worries to rest.
No more fear, no more doubt.

Parents wait with hopeful eyes,
Old friends gather once again.
Those familiar faces,
Those familiar faces.

在返航的前一天下午，队长找到了我，说想带我去一个地方。
这天是我第一次，也是最后一次穿上防护服，我和其他科考人员一起乘上了破冰者号科考艇。
经过了数十分钟的颠簸后，我忍着呕吐感，颤颤巍巍地走下了载具。
那是我毕生难忘的一天——在一座白色、蓝色与紫色交织的建筑里，坐着几位身着异域服饰的人，在他们的身旁，一头机械的白色巨熊正在打瞌睡。
我一脸震惊地望向队长，她告诉我说：“「极地联合」在进行保密性建设，我没法让你到拉海洛去，但我可以带你认识一下这里的原住民‘罗伊族’。他们主要生活在地下，但在冰原上也有少量营地。”
我记得那天的每一个细节，我们待了一整个下午，却感觉十分短暂。
我听不懂他们说话，必须经过熟知他们语言的队长转述才能与他们交流，即便如此，我也能感受到他们十分友善。
他们介绍自己是负责引导隧群的牧者，每隔一段时间都会引导地下的隧群来到冰原，与格洛犸图还有格洛马提等冰原上的大型隧群会合，并一起向着隧者跋涉。
最终，这些隧群会回归隧者——祂是沉眠在冰原尽头的巨大机械，据说一切隧群都来自于祂。
在屋中，他们与我分享了一种团状的烤蔬菜，以及一种香味独特的腌制鱼肉料理。
在离开前我们合了影，我当场影印出来赠送给了他们，而他们则赠与了我一个奇异的海螺——那上面有多得数不清的空格，以一种螺旋状的纹路规则排列。根据队长的说法，这是他们用于计算的工具。
……
当冰崖逐渐消失在地平线上时，我关上了舷窗。
海浪敲打着船底，传来有节奏的“铛——铛”声，我静静听着，感到睡意渐浓。
在梦中，我又见到了那几位罗伊族，他们伴着窗外冰原的风雪，为我奏响了告别的歌谣——
“踏上前路，踏上前路
如此宁静，在安详的夜里
我正踏上前路

并不遥远，就在脚下
迎着敞开的门
向黄昏，向远方
将尘事完结，将忧虑尽卸
无需再恐惧彷徨

父母正翘首以盼
旧友亦齐聚一堂
那些熟悉的面庞
那些熟悉的面庞”

Strange Tales from Huanglong: Three-Headed Calamity
 
Desorock Highland, once a fertile river valley, was the source of many streams that nourished the lands downstream.
 
After the onset of the Waveworn Phenomenon, abnormal weather patterns drained most of these water sources, leaving the lake area dry and giving rise to Tacet Fields and TDs.
 
No one knows when the bird first appeared, but like a carrion-hunting vulture, it looms over the land as an omen of disaster, appearing wherever death may be found.
 
As the frontline in the fight against TD Outbreaks, Desorock Highland became a graveyard for countless warriors. The Bird of Calamity lingered so long that it even built its nest on the Olecranon Cliff by the lake, waiting for death to claim those nearby.
 
Some believe its departure from the Highland signals the end of the endless battles in Jinzhou, but fear remains, for no one knows where its next nest will be built.
records.zh:
《瑝珑志异：三头灾鸟》
荒石高地，曾经是一片水土丰美的河谷，从这里发源的诸多水流滋养着下游。
海蚀现象发生后的异常天气使得水源大部分枯竭，湖区只剩下残余少许水体，无音区和残象也随之出现。
没有人知道那只三头凶鸟是何时诞生的，它如同食腐的秃鹫一般窥视着灾殃，出现在任何可能孕育“死亡”的地方。
而荒石高地作为人类抗击残象潮的前线，历年来已有无数战士流血牺牲于此，灾厄之鸟久久盘踞，乃至如同真正的鸟类一般，构筑了自己的巢穴，在湖区旁边的鹰嘴崖上静候着生灵的死亡。
人们总说，当它离开了荒石高地的巢穴，或许预示着今州无止无休的战事即将停止，但却又有人对此心怀忧惧——毕竟无人能够知晓，它的下一个巢穴将筑在何处。

records.text:
...

As the Pioneer Association set foot in Lahai-Roi, the land long sealed from the outside world encountered the so-called civilized world for the first time. Within the Roya, this encounter gave rise to two sharply divergent attitudes.

Most of the Roya remained unmoved by the outside world. They held fast to their mission and cultural traditions, preserving the way of life their people had upheld for generations. A small group, however, found their curiosity toward the world beyond ice outweighed the disciplines of their people. They attempted to barter fragments of the Exostrider and the Exoswarm, treating these relics as an "entrance ticket" into the civilized world. Such individuals were deemed to have forgotten and betrayed their vision. They were cast out by their kin and came to be known as the Outcasts.

During the chaotic early period when independent expedition teams flooded into Lahai-Roi, these Outcasts once styled themselves as the "enlightened" among the Roya, believing they alone were fit to bridge the gap between Lahai-Roi and the civilized world. Yet as the Polar Collective was established, and the Roya themselves took seats at the negotiating table as active agents shaping Lahai-Roi's future, the Outcasts were recognized by neither side and gradually became marginalized.

…

As exploration of the Roya Frostlands advanced, excavation of the Upphaf Forest Ruins yielded significant breakthroughs, leading to the construction of the Upphaf Life Chamber. Through it, scholars reconstructed a vision of the vast primeval forest as it once was. 

This discovery offered the Outcasts a new direction. Gathering near the Upphaf Forest Ruins, they sought traces of an ancient homeland, hoping to reclaim a sense of origin and to find a place of belonging for a people long without roots.
records.zh:
……
随着先行公约的踏足，与世隔绝的拉海洛得以初次与文明世界相遇。而此时罗伊族人内部出现了两种截然不同的态度。
大部分罗伊族人对外界的事物不为所动，他们坚持着自身的使命与文化传统，坚持着族中一直以来的生活方式。
但也有少部分人，他们对于外部世界的好奇心压过了对于族中的规训——他们试图出卖隧者与隧群的残骸，以此作为进入文明世界的“入场券”。这些人被认定为忘却与唾弃了使命的罗伊族，他们被族人驱逐，被称作为“流民”。
在进入拉海洛的调查团野蛮生长的时期，这些“流民”曾自诩为族人中的“开化者”，认为自己才是与文明世界接轨的人。
但是，随着「极地联合」建立，以及罗伊族人自身也坐上谈判桌成为了影响拉海洛局势的一环，这些“流民”最终成为了不被任何一方所承认的游荡势力。
……
随着罗伊冰原的探索工作推进，元林遗址的挖掘行动获得了突出进展，元林再生舱得以建立——它为人们描摹出了远古时期广袤的元林的图景。
这一发现为背弃族群的流民们提供了新的方向——他们来到元林遗址附近，期望找到远古时期的家园，为没有根基的流民群体找到新的归宿。

Presenter: Lucilla
Recipient: Strategic Risk Assessment Committee, Spacetrek Collective

I. Investigation Background and Objective
Since the third week of this fiscal year, the following anomalies have been observed across Lahai-Roi:

1. The active cycle of Void Storms has abruptly shortened to 72 standard hours, with frequency increasing by approximately 40%.
2. Regional Voidmatter concentrations have increased by 31.7% compared to the same period last year, with the curve growth showing no signs of flattening.
3. Low-frequency Threnodian interference phenomena are occurring frequently, with several monitoring stations recording harmonic fluctuations of unknown origin.

In accordance with the "Lahai-Roi Voidmatter Protection and Safety Regulations," and given that the above anomalous indicators closely match the precursor characteristics of a Threnodian overflow event, a special consultant has been commissioned to conduct an emergency reinspection of the Sealed Fissure site in the Dimmr Plains.

Operator: Hiyuki (Counter-Threnodian Response Force Specialist)
Investigation Site: Dimmr Plains Sealed Fissure - Ceased Court

II. Operator Investigation Record
The following content is compiled from Hiyuki's oral account and Terminal records:

The blade at the Ceased Court is still in place, but the ground where its edge makes contact shows traces of Voidmatter contamination.
Correct. The entity on the other side of the Stridergate is intensifying its power accumulation, but I cannot determine when it will act.
...I have reinfused my frequency into the blade. At the very least, Aleph-1's power cannot cross this point for the time being.

End of record.

III. Investigation Conclusions
Based on Hiyuki's on-site survey and subsequent spectrum data analysis, the following conclusion has been reached regarding the state of the Dimmr Plains' Sealed Fissure:

The primary structure of the seal remains intact, with no signs of substantial rupture or overflow. However, Voidmatter activity beneath the fissure shows a sustained upward trend, positively correlating with the recent increase in Void Storm frequency and concentration. Based on the above, the window of time before the seal on the Threnodian Aleph-1 fails is narrowing.

IV. Recommendations and Matters for Review
Given the current situation, I respectfully submit the following matters for review by the Spacetrek Collective Department of Voidmatters:

• Immediately lift the preparatory phase of Duskveil and raise the Voidmatter disaster early warning level across Lahai-Roi to Level Two.
• Accelerate the calibration process for combat and counter-Voidmatter Mechascouts, prioritizing the completion of repairs to the Exostrider's basic framework and dynamic load testing.
• Authorize the formation of a Voidmatter Rapid Response Team, with Hiyuki serving as Tactical Director, responsible for dynamic monitoring and emergency response in the Dimmr Plains area.

The above investigation conclusions and recommendations are submitted for joint review.

提交人：洛瑟菈
呈报对象：深空联合战略风险评估委员会
一、调查背景与目的
自本年度第三周以来，拉海洛全境观测到以下异常现象：
1，虚质磁暴活跃周期骤缩至72标准时，频次提升约40%；
2，区域虚质浓度较去年同期环比增长31.7%，且增长曲线尚未出现平缓趋势；
3，低频段鸣式频率干扰现象频发，部分监测站记录到来源不明的谐振波动。
依据《拉海洛虚质防护安全条例》,并鉴于上述异常指标与鸣式外溢事件的前兆特征高度吻合，故委托特聘顾问对黯原地区封存地进行紧急复查。
执行人员：绯雪（鸣式对策组专员）
调查地点：黯原封存地·止庭
二、执行人员调查记录
以下内容根据绯雪口述及行动终端记录整理：
止庭的刀还在，但是刃口接触的地面有虚质熔蚀的痕迹。
是。隧门另一边的东西正在加剧积蓄力量，但我无法判断它具体什么时候行动。
……我为这把刀重新注入了频率，至少短期内，阿列夫一的力量无法逾越这里。
记录完毕。
三、调查结论
综合绯雪的实地勘验及后续频谱数据分析，现就黯原封存地状况形成以下结论：
封印主体结构仍保持完整，未出现实质破裂或外溢迹象；
但裂隙下方的虚质活性反应呈持续上升趋势，与近期磁暴频次、浓度增长形成正相关佐证；
基于上述，判断鸣式“阿列夫一”封印失效的时间窗口正在缩短。
四、建议与提请事项
鉴于当前形势，本人提请深空联合虚质科学部审议以下事项：
立即解封“夜幕”计划预备阶段，提升拉海洛全境虚质灾害预警等级至二级响应；
加速实战用机兵及虚质对策机兵的机体调试进程，优先完成对隧者基础框架的修复与动态负载测试；
授权组建虚质快速反应小组，由绯雪担任战术指导，负责黯原周边区域的动态监测及应急处置；
以上调查结论及建议，请联合审议。

records.text:
During the subsequent survey of the Dimmr Plains, the investigation team discovered a large-scale material accumulation zone beneath the Silent Crag.

Preliminary identification shows the deposits in this area fall into two main categories:

1. Structural remains bearing the architectural characteristics of the early Spacetrek Collective — including but not limited to prefabricated alloy bulkheads, energy transmission conduits, and partial functional module frameworks.
2. Fragments of Exoswarm components in various forms, their biological activity completely halted and confirmed to be in a dormant state.

These findings raise an urgent question: how did this batch of materials end up in the barren Dimmr Plains, far from any planned infrastructure zones?

While tracing the component models of these abandoned assets, the investigation team noticed a previously overlooked archive entry. In the early stages of Startorch Academy's establishment, a shipment of materials from the New Federation arrived in Lahai-Roi. According to the transport dispatch report at the time, the convoy encountered a sudden Void Storm near Sundermere. Subsequent inventory records show that the Void Storm caused significant loss of assets and construction materials, which were then registered as "permanent loss."

However, as the investigation progressed, several discrepancies emerged in the records of that Void Storm:

1. Among the incident records kept by different departments, the categories, quantities, and specific models of lost materials show multiple inconsistencies. Some data contradict each other, making it impossible to form a unified write-off basis.
2. Data from Voidmatter monitoring stations from the same period indicates that the intensity and duration of the Void Storm fell short of the threshold needed to completely dissolve industrial-grade materials. Furthermore, notes in that day's transport manifest show that certain assets in this shipment had already been treated with a Voidmatter-resistant coating.
3. If the materials in this accumulation zone had once dissolved in Voidmatter and been abandoned in the Dimmr Plains, the residual Voidmatter frequency should be evenly dispersed, not concentrated on the surface protective layer.

These contradictions point to one possibility: the material loss recorded as an "accident" that year may not have been the result of a Void Storm at all. It is more likely that after arriving in Lahai-Roi, this batch of materials was diverted through some other means, and the Void Storm happened to provide natural cover for the transfer.

The investigation team has now marked the coordinates of this zone and collected samples. Given that the sealed early Exoswarm component fragments still hold some reference value for studying the differentiation limits and degradation mechanisms of Exoswarms, it is recommended that they be included in the subsequent recovery inventory. As for how this batch of materials reached the Dimmr Plains, and what those mismatched numbers in the Void Storm records ultimately mean, those questions may have to be left for future verification.

Research Group Annotation:
Regarding the formation time of this accumulation zone, its stratigraphic sequence, and its correlation with Void Storm activity during the same period, further cross-departmental data comparison is still needed. It is recommended to coordinate the retrieval of all original records from those who participated in the transport and inventory work that year, in order to restore the full picture of the event as much as possible.

在针对黯原地区的后续勘察中，调查组于「寂静断崖」下方发现了一处大规模的物质堆积区。
经初步辨识，该区域的堆积物主要呈现为以下两类：
其一，具备深空联合早期建筑特征的结构残骸，包括但不限于预制合金舱壁、能源输送管路及部分功能模块框架；
其二，形态各异的隧群零件残片，其生物化特征已完全停滞，确认进入失活状态。
上述发现引出一个亟待解答的问题：这批物资为何会出现在远离基建规划区的黯原荒原？
在追溯了相关废弃资产的零件型号记录时，调查组注意到一条曾被忽视的历史条目——在星炬学院建立初期，曾有一批自新联邦的物资运抵拉海洛。当时的运输播报显示，运输队在坠剑湖附近遭遇了一场突发的虚质磁暴。根据事后清点，此次磁暴造成了大量资产与建筑材料的损失，该批物资遂被登记为“完全损失”。
然而，随着调查的深入，当年磁暴事件的记载暴露出若干疑点：
其一，不同部门留存的事故记录中，损失物资的种类、数量及具体型号存在多处出入，部分数据相互矛盾，难以形成统一的核销依据；
其二，同期虚质监测站的数据显示，当日磁暴的强度与持续时间均未达到足以完全消解工业级材料的阈值。此外，根据当日运输物资清单的备注，该批物资的部分资产已做过抗虚质涂料处理；
其三，若该堆积区物质曾于虚质中消融并被弃置至黯原地区，则其中残余虚质频率应呈均匀弥散状态，而非集中在表面防护层。
上述矛盾指向一种可能性：当年那场被定义为“意外”的物资损失，或许并非虚质磁暴的作用结果。更有可能是，这批物资在抵达拉海洛后，经由某种途径被转移——而虚质磁暴，恰好为这次转移提供了天然的掩护。
目前，调查组已对该区域进行坐标标记与样本采集。鉴于堆积物中封存的早期隧群零件残片对于研究隧者的分化极限与损耗机制仍具备一定参考价值，建议将其纳入后续回收清单。至于这批物资如何抵达黯原，以及当年磁暴记录中那些对不上的数字究竟意味着什么——这些问题，或许只能留待日后查证。
课题组备注：
关于该堆积区的形成时间、堆积层序及其与同期虚质磁暴活动的关联性，仍有待进一步跨部门数据比对。建议协调调取当年参与运输及清点工作的全部原始记录，以尽可能还原事件全貌。

records.text:
As written in "Golden Scales of Outer Huanglong," the Gorges of Spirits Battle is given particular emphasis as a campaign part of the "Fortress and Gorges War." The "Fortress" refers to Yuan Fortress, a place whose origins trace back to before the founding of Jinzhou.

Before that, the region lay in ruins, with only a few Huanglong border garrisons stationed there. Their duties included re‑surveying the Jinzhou territories after the Lament and responding to small‑scale Tacet Discord outbreaks.
Although Mt. Firmament in the southeastern corner also showed signs of Waveworn Phenomenon, Jué’s descent preserved the people of Hongzhen from the flow of time.

However, Jué had already been gravely wounded upon Its arrival and began experiencing frequency overflow. It was then that Norfall Barrens saw a Tacet Discord outbreak emerge, targeting Hongzhen... For beings that feed on frequency, the Sentinel's frequency was a magnificent feast.

 To protect the newborn flame of civilization from being extinguished, and to prevent the Tacet Discords of Norfall Barrens from spreading to the other cities of Huanglong, Mengzhou, being the closest, made the choice to construct a City of Mechanisms at one of its passes to serve as a blockade. That pass is the Land of Xuanfang.

During this time, Mengzhou's Zhuojun Atelier dispatched large numbers of personnel to support the Ministry of Development, working together to complete Yuan Fortress, which delayed the Tacet Discord outbreak's advance into Mengzhou.

Yuan Fortress, built using Automata Mechanics by human hands, became the predecessor to the Xuanfang Hold that would later hang suspended among the peaks and mists. The aforementioned "Fortress and Gorges War," which erupted at the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress, led to the completion of Xuanfang Hold, granting the Land of Xuanfang and Jinzhou a completely different future.
records.zh:
在《关外金铃》中，着重描写了今州的云陵谷之役，而此役乃是“云渊之役”的一部分。“云渊之役”的“渊”字，指的是渊城，而此城的渊源则需要追溯到今州建立之前。
在今州建立前，地域内百废待兴，只有几支戍边瑝珑军驻扎于此，重新勘探着悲鸣后的今州地块，并应对地域内的小规模残象潮。
位于东南角的乘霄山虽也有海蚀现象出现，但由于角的降临，人们居住的虹镇得以被时流保全。
然而，角于此处降临时自身已受重伤，并开始了频率外溢。北落野于此时出现了残象潮，并以虹镇为目的地开始移动——对以频率为食的存在而言，岁主的频率正是一席饕餮盛宴。
为了保护新生的文明之火不至于熄灭，并阻止北落野的残像潮向瑝珑其他州域扩散，距离最近的梦州决定于关隘处建设一处机关城，阻止北落野的残象涌入梦州——而这处关隘，正是玄方地界。
在此过程中，梦州的琢钧堂派出了大量的人手支援天工部，协力建成了名为渊城的机关要塞，延缓了残象潮往梦州侵袭的进程。
这座以人力所建的机关城“渊城”，成为了后来高悬于山峦云雾间的玄方城的前身。前文所说的爆发于云陵谷与渊城的“云渊之役”，促成了玄方城的落成，给了玄方地界与今州一个完全不同的未来。

records.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, today we set aside tales of Sentinels and speak instead of a curious old legend from the Land of Xuanfang, a hundred years past!

In those bygone days, in the Western Fang Peaks of the Land of Xuanfang, there lived a family by the name of "Bi." From the moment Bizhong drew his first breath, he was unlike any other child of his age. While others Twistscales and teased Opus Otters, chattering and clamoring through the days, he remained quiet and reserved. Day in and day out, he loved only to crouch by the wall, stacking stones and dismantling wooden locks.

Time passed, and by the time Bizhong reached his twenties, he had grown into a towering figure—eight feet tall, broad of shoulder, thick of back, built like a mountain of iron. With that size and a perpetually stern face, he rarely cracked a smile. After his mother passed, he had no one left to speak with from the heart. But to mistake him for a simple brute? That would be a grave error!

For when it came to crafting and mechanisms, Bizhong was nothing short of a prodigy. A blueprint that would take an ordinary Artisan half a month to puzzle over, he'd glance at it once and spot every flaw in its load-bearing and joinery. The most intricate puzzle arrays, the grandest city reconstructions—it all came to him as easily as turning his hand. He was unmatched across the Western Peaks, and his resolve was unshakable. Once he had a design in his mind, he held it as absolute truth. There was no obstacle too great, no risk too daunting to face head-on.

Do you know, my fellow listeners? That the magnificent "Skyworks," which now stands towering between the Western Peaks, is intimately connected to this man!

It happened one year. The load-bearing hub of the Hundred-Span Corridor, the entrance to the Skyworks, suddenly tilted. Bricks and stones rained down like a storm, and the whole structure threatened to collapse! If it fell, countless beams of wood, jade, and metal would come crashing down from the peak, straight toward the village below. Panic swept through the people as they fled in terror!

In that moment, when the lives of the Western Peaks' folks hung by a thread, what did Bizhong do? How did he rise to the occasion? Find out in the next telling!
records.zh:
诸位，今日咱们不说那岁主逸事，单表一段玄方地界百年前的旧日奇闻！
话回当年。玄方地界，方擎西峰，住着一户姓毕的人家，其独子单名一个“重”字。这毕重自打落地，就与人不同——别的孩童追追卷鳞甲，逗逗敲浪獭，叽叽喳喳终日闹腾，他却是沉默寡言。一天到晚，他只爱蹲在墙根码石头、拆木锁。
岁月如梭，毕重二十有余时，已长成一条铁塔般的汉子。身长八尺，宽肩厚背，膀大腰圆。这人生得高大健硕，搭配一副冷面孔，日常里不苟言笑。家中老母病逝后，身边竟没个能说贴心话的亲近人。但若当他是个莽汉，那可就大错特错！
毕重在机巧工艺一道，可称是天赋异禀。寻常工匠钻研半个月的图纸，他扫一眼就能瞧出承重与榫卯的缺漏；再复杂的千机阵盘、高城重构，他皆是信手捏来。不仅如此，他心性之坚，执念之深，堪称西峰一绝。一旦画定了图纸，便是坚信其确凿无误，多大的险阻都定要迎难而上。
诸位可知？那如今矗立于西峰间，宏伟通天的「悬天构」，正与这毕重息息相关！
却说那年西峰之上，「悬天构」入口——「百节廊」之承重枢纽突发倾斜，砖石如雨，濒临崩塌！若是一倒，数不胜数的巨木、玉石、金属便要从山巅滚落，直逼山脚村落，一时百姓惊呼奔逃不断！
真确是千钧一发之际，西峰百姓安危如何？毕重在此局面，又能有怎样作为？且听下回分解！

records.text:
Each evening, as the last gold of sunset spills across the riverbanks of the Eastern Xuan Peaks, the people of Xuanfang lay down their tools in silent accord. Across the tranquil waters, they wait for the gentle creatures on the far shore to finish their foraging and begin the day's final clamor.

Long before the Land of Xuanfang's ancestors learned to fell wood and craft stringed instruments, these waters already possessed their own natural musicians—Opus Otters.

Their plump, rounded bodies are covered in dense fur, which helps them maintain warmth in the frigid waters. Yet their most curious feature is the smooth, lustrous Opus Stone embedded in their bellies. The very verse every Xuanfang child learns by heart springs from this marvel:

"Water harbors Otters, cradling stones in song,
their voices bright and clear, echoing through the shadowed mountains."

After a meal, the Otters recline on the riverbank, full and at ease. Their plump yet nimble forepaws grasp pebbles or hard shells, striking them in rhythm against the Opus Stone on their bellies. The crisp percussion, woven with piercing calls from deep within their throats, blends into a natural, refined melody that fills the twilight valley.

This is no mere post-meal leisure, nor simply a ritual for transmitting breeding signals. It has become a healing solace for the Xuanfang folk. Workers weary from the day's toil often sit and listen in silence. Sometimes, a musician ventures to the lakeside, draws a bamboo flute, and from across the waters joins in a passage of song. Humans and Otters do not disturb each other, yet in the dusk and notes between them, they achieve a tacit resonance that transcends species.

Yet this harmony is not without its discipline. The communal law of the Opus Otters is governed by something altogether peculiar: a "stern scrutiny."

A young Opus Otter, eager to prove itself, shatters the languid rhythm—striking wildly, without pattern. The sharp, chaotic sounds and coarse cries provoke a strikingly human response from the others. They cease their performance, discard their pebbles and shells, raise their forepaws to clamp over their ears—some even squeeze their eyes shut, as if bracing against a sudden storm. Pushed to their limit, several Otters rush toward the "troublemaker," driving their Opus Stones against it until the noise ceases. Under the protest and pressure of the group, the rule-breaker slinks shamefully to the periphery.

In the world of the Opus Otters, consensus around harmony is the secret bond that holds their order together. Adults often point toward the riverbank, seizing the moment to teach the befuddled children at their side:

"See that? If you're trying to show off and cause a ruckus, even these Opus Otters will butt you out the door!"
records.zh:
「敲浪獭」
每日夕阳的余晖，将玄幽东岳的河滩染成一片金黄时，住在山野中的玄方人会有默契地停下手头的劳作，隔着静谧的水面，期待对岸那群温和的生灵结束觅食，开启一日中最后的喧闹。
早在玄方地界的先民懂得斫木制琴之前，这片水域便已有了属于自己的天然乐师——敲浪獭。
圆润而丰满的身躯长满硬毛，帮助敲浪獭在冰冷的水域中保持体温。不过，它们最为奇特的演化，是腹部那颗光泽圆润的「洄音石」。每个玄方地界的孩子都背过的那首诗便源自于此。
“水有灵獭，怀石叩音，其声清越，回荡幽山。”
在吃饱喝足后，敲浪獭们会惬意地仰躺在河滩上，用肥胖而灵活的前爪捧起水边的卵石或是坚硬的贝壳，用它们有节奏地拍打腹部的「洄音石」。清脆的撞击声，伴随着它们喉咙深处发出的高亢鸣唱，在黄昏的河谷中交织成一支浑然天成的雅乐。
这不仅是獭群饭后的消遣与传递繁衍信号的社交仪式，也成了玄方人心中充满治愈的慰藉，劳作一日的乡民常常会席地而坐，静静聆听；偶尔，也会有乐师来到湖畔，取出随身的竹笛，隔着水面遥遥和上一段。 人与獭互不惊扰，却在暮色与音符中达成了一种跨越物种的默契共鸣。
有趣的是，这种和谐的旋律并非随意为之，敲浪獭的群居法则还伴随着与众不同的……“严苛审视”。
一只年轻的敲浪獭似乎渴望展现自我，它打破了原有的舒缓节拍，开始毫无章法地剧烈敲击，尖锐杂乱的声响和粗野的嗓音，震得其他的敲浪獭展现出了十分拟人化的应激反应。
它们停下演奏，丢掉手上的卵石、贝壳，抬起双爪死死捂住耳朵，甚至紧闭双眼，仿佛在抵御狂风骤雨。有几只敲浪獭已经忍耐到极限，它们跑向那“害群之獭”，用肚子上的洄音石顶向它，中止这噪音。
在族群的抗议与挤压下，这只“破坏规则”的个体只能灰溜溜地退到边缘，在敲浪獭的世界中，对于和谐旋律的共识，正是它们维系生存秩序的隐秘纽带。
大人们常常会指着河滩，借机教导身旁懵懂的孩童：
“瞧见没？若是为了出风头，瞎折腾惹人嫌，连这敲浪獭都会把你顶出门去！”

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_奥古斯塔_2_7_3_1
records.text: And so, you and Augusta walk side by side, from the Titanbone Expanse arena to the stone walls of Capitoline Hill.
records.zh: 就这样，你与奥古斯塔并肩而行，从巨石原的竞技场走到卡庇托山城的石墙下。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_奥古斯塔_2_7_4_1
records.text: The night sky of Titanbone Expanse bears witness to your fierce battle with Augusta. Without a single pause, you fight until dawn, the sparks from your clashing blades igniting the horizon.
records.zh: 就这样，巨石原的夜色见证了你与奥古斯塔的酣战。你们未曾停歇，直到晨光破晓，炽烈的剑芒点燃天际。

records.text: Malice without end... flooding Nimbus Sanctum. O nightfall... drown all beneath your veil...
records.zh: 无穷的恶意满溢云海……夜幕啊……淹没一切……

records.text: As you know, the Threnodian and Sentinel once clashed here, so it's no surprise that anomalies run rampant throughout Avinoleum.
records.zh: 之前我提过，由于鸣式、岁主的力量曾共同干涉此地，所以在「阿维纽林」神学院，发生任何异常现象都不足为奇。

records.text: Still, it highlights just how unpredictable these residual frequencies in Avinoleum can be. That's definitely worth a focused simulation.
records.zh: 但由此可见残留于「阿维纽林」的频率会如何变化，难以预判，值得进行专门的演算！

records.text: What's more, the terrain of Avinoleum itself becomes unpredictable too! Stay alert to your surroundings!
records.zh: 而且这变化可不只是说频率可能重现战斗的回音，甚至连「阿维纽林」本身都会发生异常，可要时刻注意周遭环境的影响哦！

records.text: This simulation models that exact scenario: a hacked defense grid and Overlord Class Tacet Discords running wild in Tethys's Deep.
records.zh: 我们就演算出了一种十分可怕的情景，被篡改的防卫系统和怒涛级的数据残象肆虐于泰缇斯之底……

records.text: Avinoleum Theological Seminary remains a mystery to the Black Shores. Threnodian and Sentinel forces once clashed there.
records.zh: 「阿维纽林」神学院对于黑海岸来说都还充满尚未可知的秘密，鸣式、岁主的力量共同对此地产生过干涉。

records.text: Lorelei, the Queen of the Night... embraced isolation to protect the Nimbus Sanctum, locking herself in a lonely prison.
records.zh: 「夜之女皇」罗蕾莱……为保护云海，甘愿承受陷入孤独囚笼之苦。

records.text: Is there a guy in a red straitjacket with a scar on his face among them?
records.zh: 不会有个穿着红色拘束衣，脸上还有疤的男人吧……

records.text: You tell Brant that you're the current Apex Duelist in Septimont.
records.zh: 你告诉布兰特，你就是七丘目前的“巅峰决斗家”。

records.text: There's Peaks of Prestige in the New Federation?
records.zh: 新联邦也有荣耀之丘？

records.text: (If Encore gets into this, I bet Aalto's wallet won't stand a chance.)
records.zh: （要是让安可知道这个游戏，秋水的钱包恐怕又要大出血了吧。）

records.text: I'm Loftus, Chief Security Officer of the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: 我是联运椎骨的安检总负责人，洛夫图斯。

records.text: I don't know who started the rumor about a "secret platform" on the Starward Riseway, but now I've got geniuses headbutting this pillar daily...
records.zh: 也不知道是谁传的谣，说什么联运椎骨有个隐藏站台，没事总有人往这根柱子上撞……

records.text: We're already at the Starward Riseway. You can "decompress" it with hot water after you get back to the dorms.
records.zh: 我们已经到联运椎骨了，一会儿回宿舍，你用热水泡会儿就能“解压缩”了。

records.text: I stay here to see my daughter attending the Academy. Same reason most here stay. Near the Starward Riseway we made our camp, to be close to them.
records.zh: 我嘛，主要是想没事多看看在学院里上学的女儿。这片营地里的罗伊人，也大都是出于类似的想法，才将营地搭建在了联运椎骨附近。

records.text: See the Starward Riseway? Lollo Logistics oversaw its construction.
records.zh: 你看这个联运椎骨，当年也是在呜呜物流的指导下建成的。

records.text: Maji said it best. To really unlock Lahai-Roi's economic potential, you gotta streamline the foundational pipeline, build a synergistic vertical, and create a seamless UX loop for user onboarding and retention...
records.zh: 马计师傅说的好啊，要想为拉海洛的区块经济赋能，就得先打通底层逻辑，创造垂直矩阵，实现端到端用户跃迁无缝流转的闭环……

records.text: Oh! You're... you're 漂泊者! Maji's told me all about you! Thanks for supporting us at Lollo Logistics!
records.zh: 啊，您是……漂泊者{Male=先生;Female=女士}！我听马计师傅经常提起您！感谢您对呜呜物流一直以来的支持！

records.text: Oh, I'm pretty new! Just got assigned under Maji myself.
records.zh: 嗨，我也是才入行不久，刚被分到马计师傅的手下。

records.text: Maji's got his hands full with a Lollo Campaign right now. Said a rookie like me could use the field experience, so he… graciously passed this opportunity to me!
records.zh: 马计师傅业务繁忙，光是「呜呜企划」的活动就够他操劳的了。师傅说，年轻人应该多出来历练一下，就把这个宝贵的机会“让”给了我。

records.text: Oh, for the love of... The Thermostat Array ends past the Starward Riseway. Wanna be a popsicle? Suit up!
records.zh: 唉，你……离开了联运椎骨可就没有温控阵列了，如果不想在外面被冻成冰雕，就赶紧把防寒服穿上！

records.text: That Clockatoo has been here ever since the Starward Riseway was built.
records.zh: ……这只“叫早鸟”，自联运椎骨开始搭建的那天就已经存在了。

records.text: It broke its own code. Woke in the dead of night and screamed an alarm across the entire Starward Riseway. Because of that, researchers at the Institute made it to shelter.
records.zh: 它突破了自己的代码，在深夜启程，以嘹亮的声音对整个联运椎骨发出了全域警报，研究院的成员们这才得以躲避这场灾难。
