records.text: Ground was broken for the Polar Research Station, and next the foundation was laid for the great freight elevator built into the Exostrider's greatsword itself, the Starward Riseway...
records.zh: 冰原上的极地科考站破土而出，而依托隧者巨剑建造的巨型垂直运载电梯「联运椎骨」也随之奠基……

records.speakerZh: 正在为新生讲解的老师
records.text: Ground was broken for the Polar Research Station, and next, the foundation was laid for the great freight elevator built into the Exostrider's greatsword itself— the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: 冰原上的极地科考站破土而出，而依托隧者巨剑建造的巨型垂直运载电梯「联运椎骨」也随之奠基。

records.speakerZh: 正在为新生讲解的老师
records.text: All right. Does anyone know what this project surrounding the Starward Riseway is?
records.zh: 好了，那么有哪位同学知道，这一期围绕“联运椎骨”进行建设的工程是什么吗？

records.text: This old heart wishes to pass that joy along. Let me tell you a secret. At the end of each year, I take my mech reindeer sleigh to the Starward Riseway and leave presents...
records.zh: 老头子我啊，也想把这份美好传递下去——悄悄告诉你，每年快年底的时候，我都会驾着机麋雪橇车，偷偷在联运椎骨的运输带上放上礼物……

records.text: Looks wrecked... I should find a way to get it back to the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: 看起来已经无法正常使用了……想办法将它送回联运椎骨吧。

records.text: Let me see it... That won't get anyone. Here—"Social Project at the Starward Riseway. With credits. Come ASAP."
records.zh: 我看看……你这样写不行，得这样写——联运椎骨，社会实践，算学分，速来。

records.text: You know how I get bored with life in Bjartr Woods. Besides, the Exoswarm in the frostlands need someone to herd.
records.zh: 可我早已厌倦在浮光林的生活，冰原的隧群也需要引导。

records.text: That massive ship we saw today... Was it from Triumph Avionics? You know, the company from the New Federation?
records.zh: 今天那艘大船，是不是来自新联邦的凯旋航电啊！

records.text: Let's bring their instruments back. To Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 把这些遗物带回去吧，带回浮光林。

records.text: So the Starward Riseway was built alongside the Exostrider's greatsword—wait, no one told me the hilt alone was this huge!
records.zh: 联运椎骨依托隧者之剑建造——光剑柄就这么大！

records.text: Bond of Ice, the downhill skiing at Mt. Firmament; Emerging Might, the kayaking in the rapids of Riccioli Islands—and so on. All eight of them, scattered across Solaris.
records.zh: 在乘霄山速降滑雪的“冰之固结”，于黎乔利群岛激流中划艇的“力之涌现”等等……共有八项，地点则分布于世界各处。

records.text: You look where Fulmine points to—some Plushies are playing as knights, wielding the rock-hard, dry baton bread Old Bake made as swords.
records.zh: 你看向斐林手指的方向，布偶们正在用老焙烤出来的面包玩骑士游戏。又干又硬的面包用来做骑士剑正合适。

records.text: (Did Fulmine help them take this photo? I should ask him about this.)
records.zh: （是斐林给他们拍的吗，问问他吧）

records.text: Sitting across from Changli, you recount the stories of your recent journey as the chess pieces click against the board.
records.zh: 你与长离面对面，一边下棋，一边谈及之前一路经历的事。

records.text: So, you met Qingxiao the Perfected in the Land of Xuanfang... Master used to take me to her back then, hoping to find a way to handle this flame of mine.
records.zh: 原来你已在玄方地界见过清宵真人了。过去师父曾带我一同寻过那位前辈，想为我在她那里求得离火的解决之法。

records.text: 漂泊者, before I even realized it, your journey has become so vibrant. I'm certain many more wondrous encounters await you in the future.
records.zh: 漂泊者，不知不觉，你的旅途已如此多彩，想必未来还会有更多这样的奇妙际遇。

records.text: It's been a while, Changli. And don't worry, things are almost settled there.
records.zh: 好久不见，长离。放心吧，事情基本都解决了。

records.text: What about you? I heard you went to Mingting to deliver your report. How did it go?
records.zh: 你呢，我听说你去了明庭述职，事情还顺利吗？

records.text: Yes. From Jinzhou to Mingting... you have no shortage of admirers across Huanglong.
records.zh: 自然。瑝珑看重你的人有许多，明庭有，今州亦有。

records.text: Your care for Jinhsi is appreciated as well. She handles Jinzhou's affairs with far more ease these days, leaving very little that requires my oversight.
records.zh: 今汐也蒙你关照。如今，她也比过去更加有余裕处理今州的事务，许多事也不再需要我看顾太多。

records.text: Leave the paperwork to Brant. It's part of his responsibilities.
records.zh: 这些文书工作就交给明天的布兰特吧，别担心，那是他该做的事。

records.text: Aye! She's a regular at Trattoria Margherita. Loves their pizzas. I run into her all the time!
records.zh: 是的，她常去玛格烈特餐厅吃披萨，只要不出航，她就要去那里吃晚餐，我经常去那里找她！

records.text: Margherita, two glasses of Nectarwine please, and top off Bella's drink. On my tab.
records.zh: 玛格烈特，两杯「蜜露果酒」，再给这位朋友满上一杯，记在我账上就好。

records.text: ALL EYES ON ME! I, Brant of the Troupe of Fools, have a grand announcement to make!
records.zh: 全体目光看向我，我——愚人剧团的布兰特，要在这里宣布一件大事！

records.text: Margherita says they're out for a few days. Can you believe it? Even the simplest pleasures conspire against me!
records.zh: 老板说，橄榄用完了，得过两天才有货。我真是……吃口凉水都塞牙。

records.text: It might surprise you to learn that Brant lost a bet.
records.zh: 他打赌输了。

records.text: (Ah... Brant is playing the crowd. Heh, a clever move.)
records.zh: （他应该是想看看周围人对硬币的反应……还真是「即兴」。）

records.text: Is that Brant...? What are those two doing? Better find out.
records.zh: 那不是布兰特吗……？他们在那做什么……过去看看吧。

records.text: Brant, look over there! There's another Lottie Lost.
records.zh: 布兰特，那边也有个和你一样的寂寞小姐。

records.text: For this momentous day, we braved the fog of Penitent's End to bring back the Golden Fleece and the Bell-Ringing Crab!
records.zh: 为了这一天，我们穿过海雾，去墓岛寻来黄金的羊毛和撞钟的螃蟹！

records.text: As Brant and Battier heatedly discuss the stakes, you notice the fishing rod twitching, the line pulling tight—
records.zh: 布兰特和巴蒂尔就赌局讨论得热火朝天，而你注意到他们身后的鱼竿正在抖动——

records.text: As if to chase away any worries, Brant hums softly.
records.zh: 像是要安抚这段旅程，布兰特轻柔地哼起歌来。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_1_角色_布兰特线_1_35
records.text: After finding out that Brant is the Flaming Returned, the pirates immediately surrender.
records.zh: 这些海盗认出布兰特是「火焰舞台的归亡者」，他们不想打了。

records.text: Splendid! Brant took us to Septimont once, so we know that route well.
records.zh: 稳妥的方案，之前布兰特带我们去过七丘演出，这条航线我们熟。

records.text: Normally, Captain Brant calls the shots, but since the helm is yours, I'm all ears!
records.zh: 平时都是布兰特做决定，但今天你才是船长，按照准则，我得来问你。

records.text: Brant might not look like your typical captain, but he gets the job done.
records.zh: 虽然他看起来想一出是一出，但还是会把自己的工作做好。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_角色_坎特蕾拉线_副本_9_1
records.text: A tarnished reputation? You could have walked away from this, Cantarella.
records.zh: 只获得了骂名，对吧？这骂名本不应该由你来承受，坎特蕾拉。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_角色_坎特蕾拉线_副本_9_6
records.text: In that hellish duel, Cantarella shielded us with illusions.
records.zh: 在那场地狱般的试炼中，是坎特蕾拉姐姐用幻术救了我们。

records.text: I've conducted over a hundred visits and interviews, traveling between Thessaleo Fells and Egla Town. Finally, I think I have a theory...
records.zh: 我从狄萨莱海脊访查到埃格拉小镇，来回做了上百次访谈和调查，几乎可以得出一个结论……

records.text: Cantarella taps the music box, but it doesn't work as expected.
records.zh: 坎特蕾拉轻轻拍了拍八音盒，它并没有如预料中那般发出音节。

records.text: You need a proper rest… and we're not far from Thessaleo Fells.
records.zh: 是该好好休息下了……这里离狄萨莱海脊不远。

records.text: Hmmm, the nearest land with a noble house is Thessaleo Fells, which belongs to… the Fisalias?
records.zh: 离这儿最近的贵族领地是狄萨莱海脊……是翡萨烈家的？

records.text: (How could there be any Tacet Discords in Mt. Firmament?)
records.zh: （乘霄山中怎么会有残象？）

records.text: I, I heard about Mt. Firmament's legend... So I came to find its secret...
records.zh: 我，我只是听到乘霄山里的传说……所以想来找找……

records.text: I must get back... Fuling... She's still waiting for me...
records.zh: 我得快点回去……伏翎……还在等我……

records.text: I'm experienced. Dealt with Jinhsi's riddles already.
records.zh: 似曾相识的做法，这次更简单些。

records.text: I remember he went on sabbatical months ago, and he left with Fuling...
records.zh: 只听说几个月前他申请了长假……和伏翎一起离开了。

records.text: Yes, Fuling, his girlfriend. I think they're visiting Hongzhen together. They're staying at the inn over there.
records.zh: 啊，伏翎是他的恋人，这次也和他一起来虹镇了，就在那边的旅馆落脚。

records.text: Oh, Fuling asked us about his whereabouts not long ago. She seemed quite worried.
records.zh: 伏翎不久前还来打听他的消息，看上去挺担心的。

records.text: No, I'm not going... Fuling... She's waiting for me...
records.zh: 不，不去医馆……伏翎……她在等我……

records.text: You carry an exhausted and unconscious Wuli to a doctor to treat his injuries.
records.zh: 将力竭昏睡的梧黎送去医馆，请医师处理了伤势。

records.text: Thank you, 漂泊者, Lady Changli. You saved his life...
records.zh: 漂泊者还有长离大人，谢谢你们救了他……

records.text: May I please ask... what on earth happened? I've never seen Wuli like that...
records.zh: 请问……究竟发生了什么？我从来没有见过梧黎那副样子……

records.text: It's not unusual for Wuli to be out of touch for a few days when he goes on long trips. This time, however, seemed longer than usual. If it weren't for you two showing up, I would have asked the Midnight Rangers to help me search for him in the mountains.
records.zh: 因为他经常出远门，三四日无音讯的情况也是常事，只是这次实在太久，如果不是两位及时出现，我就要去请求夜归军带我进山寻人了……

records.text: I used to work as a landscape painter. Wuli and I met through work, and we traveled to many places together.
records.zh: 我原本是一个风景画师，因为工作和梧黎结识，我们一起游历了很多地方。

records.text: *cough*... Thank you. I'm okay now. Who are you? ... And Wuli, is he...
records.zh: 咳……谢谢你，我没事，请问你们是……还有梧黎他……

records.text: A few months ago, I got really sick. It affected my ability to walk, which got worse over time. We couldn't go on our adventures like we used to. Wuli stopped taking on work and traveled all over the world to find a cure for me.
records.zh: 半年前我生了一场重病，行动越来越困难，已经不能像以前那样和他一起探险写生……梧黎就推掉了所有委托，为我四处寻医问药。

records.text: Mt. Firmament's "Secret of Immortality", I presume?
records.zh: 是指乘霄山中的「长生秘法」，对吗？

records.text: Yes... Wuli told me that he's researched and found an untouched paradise on Mt. Firmament. A place where time stands still. He said if I lived there, my condition would never worsen...
records.zh: 嗯……梧黎说，他查阅了很多资料，得知乘霄山中有一片不被打扰的世外桃源，那里有着永恒停滞的时间，只要在那里生活，我的病就永远也不会恶化。

records.text: Those were my thoughts as well, but Wuli seemed very certain.
records.zh: 我原本也是这样猜测，但梧黎非常肯定地对我说，他寻找的那个传说是真实存在的。

records.text: So there are still unaddressed Temporal Disruptions in the mountains. And unfortunately, Wuli has stumbled upon one, mistaking it for the legendary cure he was searching for.
records.zh: ……也就是说，山中还存在被隐藏的时间乱流，而梧黎出于某种原因误入，认为它便是自己追寻的传说。

records.text: Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.
records.zh: 等梧黎醒来的时候，我会和他好好解释的。

records.text: 漂泊者, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.
records.zh: 漂泊者，事发突然，先去向辛夷大人说明情况吧。

records.text: Wuli... You're hurt?! I've been looking for you... You didn't pick up my calls...
records.zh: 你……你受伤了？！我一直在找你，你的终端一直没有回应……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_17
records.text: At the hotel, you meet Fuling, the gravely ill girlfriend of the adventurer Wuli. He had gone into the mountains seeking a way to slow her condition but mistakenly believed that the Temporal Disruptions held the key to immortality. Accepting her fate, Fuling pleads with you to put a stop to the dangerous Disruptions.
records.zh: 你们在旅馆见到了等待梧黎的少女伏翎。原来伏翎身患重疾，梧黎进山是为了找延缓她病情的办法。他很可能将山中的时间乱流误认为了传说中的「长生秘法」。伏翎并不在意能否得救，反而拜托你们解决危险的时间乱流。

records.text: It must've appeared after Wuli entered the mountains.
records.zh: 那它的出现一定晚于梧黎进山。

records.text: Fuling's "legend" differs from the situation at Mt. Firmament we're familiar with. In that tale, mortals were spared the cost of losing years from their lives.
records.zh: 伏翎提到的“传说”不同于我们认知中乘霄山的时间乱流，它不存在代价，只是时间的绝对静止。

records.text: About Fuling's attitude towards all of this...
records.zh: 关于伏翎的态度……

records.text: But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.
records.zh: 他对于乘霄山的了解，远远超过了一个初来的旅客。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_19
records.text: Through discussions with Xinyi, you begin to question Wuli's motives and his sources of information. You suspect that the Temporal Disruption might be part of a larger scheme and could be connected to the Weiqi record you are searching for.
records.zh: 你们与辛夷交换信息，认为梧黎的行为有许多疑点，他很可能隐瞒了其他的信息来源。所谓的时间乱流或许另有真相，而且这些异变似乎与你们想要寻找的“传说中的棋谱”有关。

records.text: What do you make of Fuling's words from earlier, Rover?
records.zh: 方才伏翎讲述的事情……你怎么看？

records.text: I'm just making an educated guess from what we've collected. And honestly, Fuling isn't exactly good at keeping things to herself.
records.zh: 只是基于得到的信息做出推测罢了，更何况伏翎那孩子，并不是擅长掩饰自己想法的人啊。

records.text: Let's stay focused on the issue. While the diary is cryptic, it still exposes the true intentions of whoever misled Wuli.
records.zh: 还是让我们关注眼前的问题吧，虽然日记中写得很隐晦……但向梧黎提供真假参半信息的那个人，他的目的还是显露了出来。

records.text: According to the information in my master's notes, and Wuli's map...
records.zh: 根据手记中留下的信息，还有梧黎笔记中的地图……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_23
records.text: While investigating Wuli's camp, you learn that Fuling has accepted her fate and doesn't want Wuli to sacrifice his future as an adventurer for her. Wuli's diary reveals ties to the Fractsidus, suggesting someone is trying to connect the Temporal Disruption to the Weiqi game.
records.zh: 搜索营地后，你们了解了伏翎的真实想法——少女已接受自己将死的事实，不愿梧黎为了她放弃身为探险家的未来。梧黎的日记表明他的行为背后有残星会的影子。长离推测，或许有人想让你们将时间乱流与棋局传说联系在一起。

records.text: Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.
records.zh: 伏翎早已接受自己将死的事实，不寄希望于缥缈的“长生”，而是希望在活着的时间里，尽可能地完成她和梧黎的梦想。

records.text: If Wuli wants to reach that so-called "paradise," he'll be trapped inside forever. It also means he'll have to give up his entire future as an explorer.
records.zh: 若是真的进入了那个传说中的“世外桃源”，便永远不能再离开，也意味着梧黎放弃了身为探险家的未来。

records.text: Traces of excavation on the ground... Looks like someone was trying to dig a hole with their bare hands. Could it be Wuli?
records.zh: 地上有被挖掘过的痕迹……看起来像是有人徒手挖出来的，难道是梧黎？

records.text: ...Don't assume you'll always be in control, Changli.
records.zh: ……不要总以为一切都在你的掌控范围内，长离。

records.text: Hmph... I say you're underestimating Changli's trickery.
records.zh: 哼……我看啊，是你太小看长离的手段。

records.text: Changli will remember your teachings by heart, master.
records.zh: 我都记得，师父。

records.text: Wuli, this is the miracle we've been waiting to see! It's hope reborn after destruction...
records.zh: 梧黎，这就是我们一直想要追寻的，跨越毁灭后新生的奇景啊。

records.text: Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.
records.zh: 多亏了医生，梧黎已经没有大碍了，至于我……现在多少还是能走一些路的。

records.text: As for the truth behind the so-called Secret of Immortality... Fuling has told me everything.
records.zh: 至于那长生秘法的真相……伏翎已经和我说过了。

records.text: I've talked about it with Fuling. From now on, I'll take her on more trips to see more new places together.
records.zh: 我已经和伏翎谈过了，从今以后，我还会带她继续去更多地方，探索更多风景。

records.text: Lady Changli, I truly can't thank you enough...
records.zh: 长离大人，我真的不知道该如何感谢才好……

records.text: Hmm... If you're feeling generous and want to repay me, I hope to see Fuling's work in the next issue of "Artists of Huanglong".
records.zh: 嗯……希望下次在《写意瑝珑》上，还能看到伏翎的作品。

records.text: Me? Well, I think Lady Xinyi could use the extra help with dealing with the aftermath.
records.zh: 此次事件的善后和收尾还需要有人协助辛夷大人处理，就交给我吧。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_32
records.text: You and Changli manage to escape the burning Sonoro and reunite with Xinyi, Wuli, and Fuling. The remaining members of the Fractsidus have been captured by the Midnight Rangers, and the Temporal Disruptions have ceased. Wuli and Fuling understand each other's true feelings and plan to explore more places together, continuing their pursuit of shared dreams. Changli asks you to rest while she assists Xinyi in wrapping up loose ends.
records.zh: 你与长离从燃烧的蜃境中脱离，与等候的辛夷和梧黎、伏翎相见。山中残星会余党已被夜归军抓捕，时间乱流不复存在。梧黎和伏翎也相互理解，今后将去探索更多风景，继续追求彼此的梦想。长离让你先行休息，她将协助辛夷处理善后事宜。

records.text: Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
records.zh: 怎么感觉这里的人对长离的评价那么两极分化啊？

records.text: (Xinyi and Changli have a mutual trust as acquaintances. It should be fine to ask Xinyi instead...)
records.zh: （辛夷与长离相识，又互相信任，向她请教应该也无妨。）

records.text: You tell Xinyi about your encounter with Changli and what the passersby said about her.
records.zh: 向辛夷讲述了刚才遇到长离以及询问路人的经过。

records.text: Hmm... I see. That sounds like something Changli would do.
records.zh: 嗯……原来如此，的确是长离的风格。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_5
records.text: The people you speak with have varying opinions on Changli, but you deduce the meeting location from their insights. You encounter Xinyi, who identifies the accessory as one of Changli's prized possessions, suggesting that understanding her intentions will require personal involvement.
records.zh: 附近的人们对长离有着褒贬不一的评价。你在与他们交谈的过程中解读出了纸条所暗示的地点。辛夷在得知经过后，指出你手中挂饰是长离的珍贵之物，建议你亲自去领会她的真意。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_34
records.text: Two days later, you visit Xinyi in the Meeting Room, learning that the Fractsidus was indeed seeking the Temporal Mandate referenced in the Weiqi game legend. However, their scheme was thwarted by you and Changli. The Fractsidus Overseer who had entered the Sonoro has vanished. As for Changli, she awaits you at the pavilion.
records.zh: 两天后，你来到会客厅见辛夷，得知残星会确是为了棋局传说所指的控制时间之法而来，但阴谋已被你与长离化解。曾一度进入蜃境的残星会会监也已销声匿迹。至于长离，她将会在乘霄山的那座凉亭中等你。

records.text: Wuli is an experienced adventurer, always wary of hidden dangers. He's highly cautious and never lets his communication get cut off.
records.zh: 梧黎是经验丰富的探险家，他最常说的一句话就是“越是美丽的奇景就意味着成倍的危险”，他从来都是谨慎的，绝对不会让自己陷入通讯断绝的境地。

records.text: However, since I became unable to accompany him on his journeys, Wuli has given up chasing his dreams.
records.zh: 可自从我不再能与和他一起行动，他就再也没有关注过他曾经想要追寻的梦想……

records.text: It's okay. Jinhsi had explained your reasons.
records.zh: 无妨，今汐已经解释过了。

records.text: Two days have passed since Changli told me that she and Xinyi would handle the aftermath. I wonder how she's doing...
records.zh: 之前长离说过善后交给她和辛夷，已经过去两天了，不知道她现在怎么样……

records.text: Might as well. Changli can be difficult to find. Let's go ask Xinyi first.
records.zh: 也好，长离行踪不定，先去辛夷那里看看吧。

records.text: Yuppers! It's where all the Wooly stories begin. Cosmos and Cloudy's home!
records.zh: 对呀对呀，那是羊咩故事的起点，黑咩白咩的故乡！

records.text: Encore was wondering if you'd come, and even had Cosmos and Cloudy go scouting for you.
records.zh: 刚才安可还在想你会不会来，还让黑咩白咩去看看。

records.text: It was right around that time when Cosmos and Cloudy appeared from the stories.
records.zh: 而黑咩白咩，也是这时候从故事里走出来，陪伴在安可身边。

records.text: That's why after I went on this journey alone, Cosmos and Cloudly came out of the land of imagination.
records.zh: 于是，当安可独自踏上旅途时，黑咩白咩穿过幻想的帷幔，来到了安可身边。

records.text: That's right! Verina loves flowers, she's a flower's best friend!
records.zh: 对呀，维里奈姐姐那么喜欢花，她是花朵的好朋友。

records.text: So I told her about Warrior Cosmos, Fairy Cloudy, and many other things.
records.zh: 于是，我和她讲黑咩勇士、讲白咩仙子，讲很多很多。

records.text: Hi Verina, er, not exactly. we're here to ask you how we can make the Wreath of Hope.
records.zh: 维里奈姐姐，我们想知道怎样才能编出希望之花冠。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_角色_安可线新_1_21
records.text: With Verina's guidance, you and Encore set out to find the perfect flowers that represent your feelings, weaving them together into a beautiful wreath.
records.zh: 在维里奈的帮助下，你和安可决定去寻找能够代表自己的感受的花，将自己的感受编织进花冠里，把大家想要实现愿望的想法告诉小盈。

records.text: Check this one out, Cosmos. It's all golden and shiny, just like Rover's eyes!
records.zh: 黑咩，你看这朵花的颜色，金灿灿的，好像漂泊者的眼睛呀！

records.text: Uh huh! Oh, one more thing, Verina. Can you leave a spot here on the wreath?
records.zh: 嗯！还有还有，维里奈姐姐，可不可以在花冠这里空出一块来呀？

records.text: "Hmph. Give us some extra time, and we can make one bigger than that giant gate of Jinzhou. Baa!" Says Cosmos.
records.zh: 哼，要是再给我们多点时间，给你做出个比今州城的门还大的咩！黑咩是这样说的。

records.text: See this little stage? Cosmos and Cloudy helped me set it up. Pretty impressive, don'tcha think?
records.zh: 你看这个简易小舞台，这是我和黑咩白咩一起搭的，是不是非常棒！

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_忌炎线_副本临时_11_1
records.text: And they were not the only ones who lost their lives in the Desorock Highland.
records.zh: 除了他们，还有很多人都留在了荒石高地的战场上。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_忌炎线_副本临时_11_1
records.text: A decade ago, shortly after the conclusion of the previous Riverside Games, a sudden TD Outbreak struck the Desorock Highland.
records.zh: 十年前那场竞渡会结束后不久，荒石高地爆发了一场始料未及的残象潮。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_忌炎线_副本临时_15_1
records.text: During that past battle in Desorock Highland, did you...
records.zh: 荒石高地的那场战役，你和他们……

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_忌炎线_副本临时_21_1
records.text: Jiyan... Let's go bid them farewell one last time.
records.zh: 我陪你，一起去告别吧。

records.text: On the other hand, we couldn't have brought the situation at the borders under control without Jiyan's prudence...
records.zh: 不过也正因为有他这样未雨绸缪的领军人，如今边境的情势才能得到控制……

records.text: I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.
records.zh: 并无此意，只是……他们对于我意义不同。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_忌炎线_4_1
records.text: Jiyan gives Mortefi the recorded frequency samples, and Mortefi promises the Academy will use them well.
records.zh: 忌炎将他在领域中记录的频率样本交给了莫特斐，莫特斐表示研究院一定会小心对待、认真研究这份珍贵的样本。

records.text: 漂泊者, I heard you've returned to the city with General Jiyan?
records.zh: 漂泊者，我听说你和忌炎已经回到今州了？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_忌炎线_6_2
records.text: Wenshu shares the full story of the temporary team and gives you a photo of you and Jiyan's team as a keepsake.
records.zh: 文叔向你讲述了十年前竞渡会上那支临时小队比赛时的故事，并将你与忌炎组队时留下的照片送给了你。

records.text: Jiyan and I are joining the relay race together.
records.zh: 我和忌炎一起参加比赛。

records.text: I suppose that's why you asked me to check the monitoring data for you, Jiyan?
records.zh: 你也是发现了这一点，才会让我收集水域监测数据的，对吧？

records.text: The lack of perceivable warning signs typically suggests unknown risks. Jiyan, 漂泊者, stay safe.
records.zh: 没被预警的突发状况，往往意味着未知的风险，两位，注意安全。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_忌炎线_1_5
records.text: You invite Jiyan to join the team. He agrees to be a substitute after careful consideration.
records.zh: 你向忌炎发出邀请，希望他能作为临时队员一起参加比赛，忌炎思考过后，接受了你的邀请。

records.chapter: 剧情_任务专用冒泡_忌炎线_6_1
records.text: My dad is a super hero who fights monsters in the Norfall Barrens!
records.zh: 我爸爸可是在北落野打大怪兽的英雄呢！

records.text: Wow, so even General Jiyan has heard of that race!
records.zh: 原来将军也知道那场比赛！

records.text: Hmm... As for General Jiyan and 漂泊者, I think...
records.zh: 嗯……至于漂泊者和将军，我是这么想的。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_忌炎线_副本临时_29_1
records.text: That's why the Desorock Highland didn't fall.
records.zh: 所以荒石高地才没有陷落。

records.text: You can call me Lingyang, glad to make your acquaintance! Fare thee well, blessings swell!
records.zh: 我叫凌阳，很高兴遇见你！祝你所行皆坦途，所求皆如愿！

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_凌阳线_副本_20_1
records.text: Lingyang recounts every detail of the events to you.
records.zh: 凌阳和你把事情的经过一五一十地讲述了一遍……

records.text: 漂泊者, Lingyang, we'll be going home now. Sorry for the trouble I caused.
records.zh: 漂泊者，凌阳，我们先回去了……抱歉，害得你们也为我担心了。

records.text: Lingyang! You're finally here! Master's been looking for you!
records.zh: 凌阳！你可算回来了！师父一直在找你！

records.text: It records in details all the popular Lucky Greetings from Huanglong, including the ones often spoken by Lingyang.
records.zh: 详细记录着市面上流行的吉祥话，其中有不少都从凌阳的口中听到过。

records.text: 漂泊者, do you know what the secret is about the Jingle Beast Lingyang was talking about?
records.zh: 漂泊者，你知道凌阳说的，关于“丁零当啷兽”的秘密是什么吗？

records.text: Uh... I read it in an old book in Huanglong. Said they lived under that giant Violet Banyan tree in the Dim Forest.
records.zh: 是从瑝珑的古书里看来的啦，据说他们还在无光之森的紫月榕下栖居过呢。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_凌阳线新_1_55
records.text: After talking with the client, Lingyang agrees to celebrate an elderly person's birthday during tomorrow's performance.
records.zh: 凌阳与委托人交谈，最终谈妥他会将为老人祝寿的需求融入到明天的狮舞表演中。

records.text: One day, these weird spores suddenly showed up in the Dim Forest, after the Lament hit.
records.zh: 那些“毒雾孢子”，是在一次悲鸣之后突然产生的。

records.text: Aww, that's so sweet. Did you learn that from Lingyang?
records.zh: 哎呀，漂泊者也这么会说话！

records.text: My granddaughter said you and Lingyang did a lot for me. Thank you so much.
records.zh: 我从我孙女那听说了，有劳你和凌阳为我费心了。

records.text: Have fun watching the show! Tell Lingyang I said hi!
records.zh: 祝你看得开心！替我向凌阳问声好啊！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_凌阳线新_1_56
records.text: After talking with the clients, Lingyang agrees to include the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony in tomorrow's performance to celebrate their wedding.
records.zh: 凌阳与委托人交谈，最终谈妥他会将证婚仪式融入到明天的狮舞表演中。

records.text: Haha, looks like Lingyang has made a new friend.
records.zh: 看来凌阳是又交到新朋友了呀。

records.speakerZh: 严肃的瑞狮团工作成员
records.text: Lingyang's busy getting ready for the performance, so he can't meet you.
records.zh: 凌阳现在正在进行演出前的最后准备，暂时无法走动，还请您理解。

records.text: The teahouse Lingyang mentioned is in the residential area, just past the square. Keep walking and you'll find it...
records.zh: 凌阳说的茶馆就在居民区里，穿过这个广场再往里走走就能看到……

records.text: I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. This is 漂泊者.
records.zh: 我是瑞狮团的凌阳，这位，是漂泊者。

records.text: If even the Dim Forest can be restored to what it once was...
records.zh: 如果无光之森的危机都能被解决的话……

records.text: Roccia remarks as she hurries back to the tent.
records.zh: 洛可可说完，着急地走回医疗帐篷。

records.text: It can wait. I'll go see if Roccia needs anything.
records.zh: 先不用了，我也去帮忙照顾孩子。

records.text: Tina and Roccia manage to treat the little girl's wounds. Her breathing gradually steadies.
records.zh: 蒂娜和洛可可又为小女孩做了一些医疗措施，小女孩的呼吸逐渐平缓起来。

records.text: It took me back to Margherita's, having the usual from their brunch menu... Oh, that's something I thought I'd get to enjoy for the rest of my life.
records.zh: 就好像我还坐在玛格烈特餐馆里，吃着熟悉的早午餐……唉，本来以为能吃一辈子的。

records.text: Umm... Brant and Bardolino are away, and they put me in charge of the welcoming proceedings.
records.zh: 嗯……布兰特和巴多里奥出了门，把剧团的迎新工作全权交给了洛可可。

records.text: A frown begins to form on Roccia's face. She wants to comfort Luca but struggles to come up with the right words.
records.zh: 洛可可有些为难的样子，似乎想努力说些什么安慰卢卡，但不知道怎么说更合适。

records.text: Fenrico may be a phony hiding behind a mask, but I'm sure he wouldn't go back on his word as Primus.
records.zh: 唔……芬莱克虽然戴着虚伪的假面，但为了维护“主座的尊严”，应当不会食言。

records.text: This Pilgrim's Sail probably left Ragunna before Fenrico gave his word.
records.zh: 而这艘「朝圣船」，在你夺得「桂冠」之前，就已经驶出拉古那。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_1_角色_洛可可线_1_3
records.text:
You repel the Tacet Discords, saving both the pilgrims and the troupe members. 
Roccia thanks you and explains the origins of the pilgrims.
records.zh:
你击退了残象，救下朝圣者和剧团众人。
洛可可对你表示了感谢，并说明这些朝圣者的由来。

records.text: Roccia instructs Pero to bring out some water and rations from her box for the elderly man.
records.zh: 洛可可立刻示意佩洛从箱中掏出水和干粮，递给老人家。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_1_角色_洛可可线_1_5
records.text:
Together, you and Roccia rescue the pilgrims. 
Some are badly injured, others are starving, and none are in good shape.
records.zh:
你和洛可可一起救助朝圣者。
有人身受重伤，有人饥肠辘辘，大家的状况都不是太好。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_角色_洛可可线_副本_2_7
records.text: Roccia asks Pero to bring along the Echoes and their items as they all return to the Troupe.
records.zh: 洛可可让佩洛带上这些布偶声骸以及声骸们收集的物品，大家一起回到了剧团。

records.text: Mm-hmm, but now you've won the Laurel and forced Fenrico to finally back down.
records.zh: 嗯，不过好在你夺得了「桂冠」，芬莱克做出了让步。

records.text: Ah, the Laureate. How could I forget? Then I guess Roccia is in safe hands.
records.zh: 啊，有「桂冠」在，确实没啥好担心的。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_87_1
records.text: The name's Yinlin. I am also a Patroller… Here's my ID.
records.zh: 我叫吟霖，也是一名巡尉……这是我的证件。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_69_1
records.text: Yinlin reactivates the puppet. It turns back into Yuanyuan's form.
records.zh: 吟霖唤醒了人偶，人偶再次变成了小女孩媛媛的样子。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_58_1
records.text: (You received a message right after hanging up with Chixia.)
records.zh: （在炽霞挂断通讯之后，忽然收到了一封新的邮件。）

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_58_1
records.text: (Chixia just called me. I wonder what's happening...)
records.zh: （是炽霞发来的通讯，不知道有什么事呢……）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_21_1
records.text: Yinlin tries to mediate between the Séance Society and the Fractsidus, but the negotiations fail.
records.zh: 吟霖想要缓和残星会和归魂互助会的关系，但最终双方谈判失败。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_83_1
records.text: Why you insolent little whippersnapper. Show some manners when you're talking to Miss Yinlin.
records.zh: 你这年轻人怎么这么没有礼貌，和吟霖小姐说话要客气点。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_25_1
records.text: Thanks for asking, Miss Yinlin. I'm feeling a lot better now.
records.zh: 谢谢吟霖小姐的关心，我已经好很多了。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_6_1
records.text: Yinlin, you made it. Have those cops entered the factory?
records.zh: 吟霖你终于来了吗，治安署的人还没能进入工厂吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_6_1
records.text: Yinlin... I thought at least you would understand me.
records.zh: 吟霖，我还以为你一定能够理解我……

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_6_1
records.text: My identity must stay hidden. Use explosives to stop them if necessary, Yinlin.
records.zh: 我的身份和行踪绝不能暴露，必要时就用工厂里的炸药，阻止他们。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_6_1
records.text: Same as before, Yinlin. Just knock {Male=him;Female=her} out.
records.zh: 和之前一样，吟霖你把这家伙弄晕之后带走……

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_6_1
records.text: I'll take care of the data transfer. Yinlin, you deal with this person. Be quick!
records.zh: 我来负责转移数据，吟霖你去把这家伙解决掉，抓紧时间！

records.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_11_1
records.text: You too, Yinlin! You had the chance to reunite with your family! Why are you doing this to me?!
records.zh: 你也一样，明明可以有与家人重聚的机会，为什么要妨碍我！

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_94_1
records.text: Yinlin heads off to retrieve some medicine from Dr. Wu Sheng.
records.zh: 吟霖暂时离开这里，去向吴盛医生拿取伤药。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_7_5
records.text: Yinlin reminds you to use your Terminal to record the prototype puppet data.
records.zh: 吟霖提醒你，帮她用终端记录下来这里的原型人偶资料。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_96_1
records.text: (I should check this place out while Yinlin's gone. Might find something about that Dollmaker.)
records.zh: （趁吟霖不在的时候，调查一下这里吧，说不定有关于那个偃师的线索。）

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_97_1
records.text: But... Indeed, he hasn't visited this place for a long time now... Maybe Miss Yinlin was right...
records.zh: 不过偃师大人确实已经很久没有出现在这里了，难道真的和吟霖小姐说的那样……

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_102_1
records.text: After a while, Yinlin came back with some first-aid supplies to treat Quxiu's wounds.
records.zh: 稍等了一会，吟霖便带着伤药回来，替曲秀的伤口做了简单的处理。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_102_1
records.text: Thank you, Miss Yinlin! It's just a scratch... Nothing to worry about.
records.zh: 感激不尽！在下这只是小伤……不用记挂。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_107_2
records.text: No, Miss Yinlin. My body is fully functional.
records.zh: 嗯，我的身体没有异常。

records.text: Giving someone a lecture? Are you sure you're Zani?
records.zh: 居然会认真开导她，你真的是赞妮吗？

records.text: Zani swiftly subdues the two would-be escapees.
records.zh: 赞妮迅速制服了想要逃跑的两人。

records.text: You order some late night snacks at Trattoria Margherita and looks for a place to rest.
records.zh: 你在玛格烈特餐馆吃了点夜宵，随后找了个地方休息。

records.text: I remember doing landscape paintings with Zhezhi.
records.zh: 我记得我和折枝画过风景画委托。

records.text: I met a painter called Zhezhi during the Moon-Chasing Festival. We had a blast at the festival.
records.zh: 我在追月节上认识的折枝。大家一起热热闹闹过节时，也邀请了她一起，所以我们见过。

records.text: Hey, Zhezhi! Long time no see! You need more pigments already?
records.zh: 哎呀折枝，好久不见啊！你的颜料这么快又用完了吗？

records.text: Zhezhi seems to be struggling to tell what she couldn't express earlier, but eventually stays silent.
records.zh: 折枝欲言又止，似乎想说出刚才没来得及说出口的话。

records.text: (Once Zhezhi has the paintbrush in her hand, she begins to speak calmly.)
records.zh: （果然，折枝一旦拿起画笔就放松下来了。）

records.text: Zhezhi stands stunned before the painting. Words hover on her lips, yet remain unspoken.
records.zh: 折枝被面前的画震惊到了，似乎欲言又止。

records.text: Ms. Zhezhi, the hearing is about to start. If you would, please join us.
records.zh: 折枝，论辩时间差不多要到了，准备好了的话就进去吧。

records.text: Zhezhi seems a bit upset and unwilling to continue this topic.
records.zh: 折枝的情绪似乎变得有些低落，看起来她并不愿意继续这个话题。

records.text: I was entrusted to investigate a certain "Arcane Artist" in the Tiger's Maw.
records.zh: 那天，我接到了一个关于奇画师传闻的委托，于是按照要求去虎口矿场调查情况。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_2_角色_折枝线_2_1
records.text: Three days earlier, Gupan had entrusted you with investigating the "Arcane Artist" in the Tiger's Maw. You then decide to track down witnesses and begin gathering information.
records.zh: 时间回到三天前，到达矿场的你找到委托人顾盼，在她口中得知了奇画师的传闻。答应帮她调查这个传闻的真相后，你拿着顾盼提供的目击者名单，打算先找这些人问问情况。

records.text: Most of these paintings were sent to the Whining Aix's Mire.
records.zh: 这些画大多运到了怨鸟泽。

records.text: Mingyan accepts a scroll of painting from Zhezhi, staring at it for a long time after opening it.
records.zh: 明砚接过折枝递来的画卷，打开之后，盯着那幅画看了许久。

records.text: Yeah, normally, Camellya doesn't seem to care about anything.
records.zh: 是啊！平常的椿，看起来对什么事都不太在乎。

records.text: With Camellya on this mission with you, you should be safer.
records.zh: 这次任务有椿在，行动风险应该也会更小一些。

records.text: Got separated from Camellya… I should check out the surroundings.
records.zh: 和椿也失散了……先看看周围情况吧。

records.text: Did Camellya seal her memories because of my choice?
records.zh: 选择……椿是因为过去我的某个选择，封住了自己的记忆？

records.text: Camellya is still inside that Stellar Matrix.
records.zh: 椿还在那枚星图内部的模拟空间中。

records.text: Camellya disappeared… So, does that gate lead to a new juncture?
records.zh: 椿消失了……那扇门就是通向新节点的枢纽？

records.text: And Camellya, you are not "mine". You belong to yourself.
records.zh: 没有人是完全属于另一个体的。

records.text: You will be switched to Camellya's perspective.
records.zh: 即将切换至椿视角

records.text: My name is Xinyi. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
records.zh: 叫我辛夷便好。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_2_6
records.text: You and Changli enter a hidden chamber. Xinyi greets you. She is an old acquaintance of Changli's and once held a prominent position in City Hall before retiring to Hongzhen. She asks you to follow her.
records.zh: 你们进入了密室，辛夷现身迎接。她似乎与长离是旧相识，曾在边庭身居要职，现已退居虹镇。她愿和你们移步详谈。

records.text: Just give me a call if you need anything at Mt. Firmament.
records.zh: 以后在乘霄山有啥用得着的地方，尽管找我。

records.text: I believe you are here for Magistrate Jinhsi?
records.zh: 两位此番前来，是为了令尹吧。

records.text: Lady Xinyi, I need to know where the Sentinel was last seen.
records.zh: 辛夷大人，我需要知道乱流爆发前岁主的位置。

records.text: I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.
records.zh: ——帮我看顾好各位。

records.text: Thank you, Lady Xinyi. Please leave it to us.
records.zh: 辛夷大人放心。

records.text: ...{Male=He;Female=She} must be the esteemed guest from Jinzhou Lady Xinyi mentioned.
records.zh: ……{TA}是刚才辛夷大人说的那位从今州来的客人。

records.text: Madam Magistrate traveled to Mt. Firmament alone.
records.zh: 令尹并无指派陪同。

records.text: I need to go to Mt. Firmament to meet with the Sentinel.
records.zh: 我想去乘霄山见岁主。

records.text: Currently, she's likely at the ferry terminal in Whining Aix's Mire. I'll reach out to her.
records.zh: 眼下……她大概在怨鸟泽附近的渡口，稍后我会传讯于她。

records.text: 漂泊者, Mt. Firmament is a dangerous place. Please take care.
records.zh: 漂泊者，您也是。乘霄山一行还需多加保重。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_11_3
records.text: In City Hall, Sanhua reveals that the Magistrate ventured to Mt. Firmament days ago, concerned for the Sentinel's safety. You express your intent to follow and Sanhua offers to contact a guide for the treacherous journey. She arranges a meeting with the Wayfinder at Whining Aix's Mire.
records.zh: 在边庭，散华表示令尹已独自前往乘霄山确认岁主安危，数日杳无音讯。你打算前往乘霄山，得知进山之路难寻，需有“引路人”相伴。散华愿意帮忙传讯于“引路人”，你们将在怨鸟泽附近渡口相见。

records.text: When we captured Scar, he claimed that the Fractsidus has imprisoned our Sentinel.
records.zh: 我们设局擒获伤痕时，他曾扬言残星会已将岁主囚禁。

records.text: All the government workers there helped care for and teach her at some point, including Lady Xinyi.
records.zh: 所以不仅仅是辛夷大人，供职于边庭的各个仕宦，都或多或少照护、教导过她。

records.text: I assume this is the Truthseeker's Pass Xinyi mentioned.
records.zh: 这里应该就是辛夷说的叩天关了吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_1_1
records.text: And Baizhi discovered more after analyzing your spectrums.
records.zh: 而进一步佐证这些可能的，是白芷解析你和小家伙频谱后的发现。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_1_1
records.text: She found a new power source within you, similar to the Crownless but even stronger. This power comes from the Tacet Discord you defeated in Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 你的体内多出一股与无冠者同源、却比它更为强大的力量——是你们在北落野打败的那个残象。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_1_1
records.text: Okay, now that's... pretty much it. Baizhi was going to explain it to you herself, but she has to go check on a newly appeared Sonoro Sphere in Zhaozhou...
records.zh: 那……差不多就是这样？原本，该是白芷亲自和你们说明的，但诏州那边突现蜃境，她不得不过去一趟，所以就由我代劳了。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_1_1
records.text: So... Is this how it first showed up when you guys were in the Norfall Barrens?
records.zh: 所以，先前在北落野它也是……呃，这样“钻”出来的？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_2_1
records.text: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.
records.zh: 既然忌炎将军和白芷都给出了判断，那肯定不会有假。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_2_1
records.text: This small, rare Echo has no memory of its origins or the events in the Norfall Barrens. Intrigued by the concept of names, it asks you to bestow one upon it, having forgotten its own.
records.zh: “小家伙”似乎是某种瑝珑少见的特殊声骸，但它不记得自己在哪里被你吸收，也想不起北落野之前的事。失忆的它对厉害声骸的“名号”产生了兴趣，希望大家正式给它取个名字。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_4_1
records.text: Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?
records.zh: 岁主能知晓未来，一切都会按照祂所预知的轨迹发展，记得之前你也算是遵循岁主和令尹的嘱托前往北落野的吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_岩壁遗迹_8_1
records.text: A destined fight between Jinhsi and the Sentinel...
records.zh: 今汐和岁主必有一战。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_岩壁遗迹_11_1
records.text: Today it's Mt. Firmament, but tomorrow it could be all of Jinzhou.
records.zh: 到那时，乘霄山如今的惨况，便是来日今州城的写照。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_岩壁遗迹_11_1
records.text: Have you thought about the consequences, Jinhsi?
records.zh: 可今汐，我希望你仔细考虑这样做的后果。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_岩壁遗迹_11_1
records.text: Yes, it could be any of these scenarios. Lady Xinyi is already on the case. We should get an answer soon.
records.zh: 你说的这些，都有可能。辛夷大人正在为此事奔波，相信很快我们就能得到答复。

records.text: Hmm... Mt. Firmament. Our Wayfinder should have plenty information to share.
records.zh: 关于乘霄山……那位"引路人"应该知道不少信息。

records.text: Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
records.zh: 今汐将在叩天关的发现、以及自己的猜测与决定告知辛夷。

records.text: Lady Xinyi... I was born with my life, my everything connected to our Sentinel.
records.zh: 辛夷大人，自我诞生之时，我就与岁主命蒂相连。

records.text: Xinyi places the Cipher Key onto the Keyforge.
records.zh: 辛夷携心核来到控制机枢近旁，并将心核置于机枢之上。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_3_5
records.text: You and Jinhsi return to Hongzhen, and with Xinyi's help, unlock the Mianloong Chamber. You discover that the Fractsidus has used a Court of Savantae creation to generate a special force field that prevents Jué from drawing energy from the chamber, effectively trapping it.
records.zh: 你与今汐回到虹镇，在辛夷协助下开启了眠龙庭。原来残星会借助稷廷造物架设了特殊力场，使岁主「角」无法通过眠龙庭补充能量，进而困住了祂……

records.text: A Fractsidus Artificer frozen in time by the Sentinel. They must belong to the death squad Xinyi mentioned.
records.zh: 被岁主的力量凝滞了时间的残星会造匠，这应该就是辛夷说的那批死卒。

records.text: A Fractsidus Artificer gravely injured by Mianloong Chamber's defense mechanism. They must belong to the death squad Xinyi mentioned.
records.zh: 遭到眠龙庭防御机关重创的残星会造匠，这应该就是辛夷说的那批死卒。

records.text: Jinhsi has stayed on Mt. Firmament for too long.
records.zh: 今汐她，确实在乘霄山内耽搁得太久了。

records.text: You're here because I invited you. Sanhua was instructed to disclose my whereabouts if you ever went to City Hall and asked about Jinhsi.
records.zh: 实不相瞒，此前我曾嘱咐散华，若是你来边庭询问今汐的去向，如实告知便可。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_眠龙庭_1_7
records.text: It was the endless kindness of you, Changli, Xinyi, and everyone in Jinzhou that gave me the courage to push on.
records.zh: 我想，我之所以能走到今日，从来不是靠我一人。是长离老师、辛夷大人、你，还有今州的所有人，你们的善意，给了我勇气。

records.text: Why hasn't this brilliant invention spread beyond Mt. Firmament?
records.zh: 这样神妙的机巧，怎么在乘霄山外就见不到半点影子？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_8_2
records.text: The flow of time has returned to normal. Mt. Firmament thrives once more, and you journey to Hongzhen to meet with Changli and Xinyi. All is not what it seems, however. The Fractsidus is planning its next move...
records.zh: 时流危机解除，乘霄山一派欣欣向荣的景象，你与长离、辛夷在虹镇会合。而在一旁的暗处，残星会的阴谋仍未休止……

records.text: If you're curious, just head southeast. Mt. Firmament is on the east side of Whining Aix's Mire, and you can see it from a distance.
records.zh: 你要好奇得紧，就往东南走，乘霄山在怨鸟泽东面的海上，远远就能瞧得见。

records.text: I had a flashback about seeing their Sentinel... Perhaps that happened on Mt. Firmament...
records.zh: 记忆中我见过岁主……地点也许就在乘霄山……

records.text: Changli, does that mean you're in danger too?
records.zh: 那长离你岂不是随时可能……

records.text: Did you hear about the fog over the waters around Mt. Firmament?
records.zh: 听人说乘霄山附近那片海上的雾……

records.text: It seems the Fractsidus had infiltrated Mt. Firmament even before the disaster struck.
records.zh: 看起来，至少在时间乱流爆发前，残星会已经入侵了乘霄山。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_通用文本_24_1
records.text: I bet Fenrico never imagined these pipelines would end up making our lives easier.
records.zh: 芬莱克大概也没想到，这些四通八达的管道会为我们提供便利。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_通用文本_30_1
records.text: Fenrico wanted to keep this place under wraps. There may be more to it than meets the eye.
records.zh: 芬莱克不想让人知道这里的存在，那这或许还藏着些我们不知道的东西。

records.text: Looks like these pages are from an Acolyte's memoir. She used to serve at the Titular Repository in Avinoleum.
records.zh: 看起来，这些书页来自一位教士所撰写的回忆录，她当时在阿维纽林的扉页书馆工作。

records.text: Avinoleum... That was the name of the old Seminary in Ragunna, wasn't it? Once a place of great renown.
records.zh: 阿维纽林……这是拉古那曾经那座辉煌的神学院的名字。

records.text: ...Why is it here? From the Somnoire to Chronorift Metropolis... how many times have you encountered it already?
records.zh: ……它怎么会出现在这里？心之集域、时隙废都……这已经是你第几次见到它了？

records.text: Margherita's signature combo, featuring Pizza Tropicale, Nuvola Pasta, Shell Burgers, and ice cream. It is an unmissable treat for any visitor to Ragunna.
records.zh: 玛格烈特餐馆的招牌套餐，由热海皇梨披萨、肉酱烩面、贝壳汉堡和冰激凌组成，是前来拉古那游览的游客不可错过的美食。

records.chapter: 剧情_黎乔利群岛_人文生态对话和冒泡_3_1
records.text: Ah... I know you! Heard about you from Mr. Fulmine some time ago.
records.zh: 唔……我记得您！之前我在斐林先生那边听说过您。

records.chapter: 剧情_黎乔利群岛_人文生态对话和冒泡_3_1
records.text: Can you imagine… what kind of men would have the strength to leave such scars on a creature like that?
records.zh: 只是以人的力量就能在这样的生物身上留下痕迹……该是什么样的一群人啊……

records.chapter: 剧情_黎乔利群岛_人文生态对话和冒泡_3_1
records.text: Didn't think I'd find you out here in the Riccioli Islands, though. Came for a bit of a break?
records.zh: 没想到您也来黎乔利群岛旅行了？

records.chapter: 剧情_黎乔利群岛_人文生态对话和冒泡_3_1
records.text: There are secrets buried here, ones even the ruins of Ragunna City have no record of. Secrets about the Sentinel and that Cetus the Tidebreaker…
records.zh: 这里似乎埋藏着拉古那城都没有记载的秘密，有关于岁主的，还有关于溯海之鲸的……

records.chapter: 剧情_黎乔利群岛_人文生态对话和冒泡_1_1
records.text: You think that's it? Now, don't go getting all scared on me... This ship... it's a ghost ship!
records.zh: 还没完！我说出来你可别害怕啊——这艘船，是一艘鬼船！

records.text: Didn't someone fetch a doctor from Ragunna City or something?
records.zh: 不是有人去拉古那城请大夫了吗？

records.text: Wonderful, then I've got a good place for you. Riccioli Islands, north of Ragunna. It's right where the currents of the Stormy Sea meet, drawing in swarms of fish.
records.zh: 如果你想要试试的话，我倒是有个好去处，拉古那北边的那片黎乔利群岛，正好是风暴海寒暖洋流交汇的地方，鱼群都集中在那里了。

records.text: It's a Remnant Creature that dwells in the depths of Riccioli. It may even be the same kind as Lorelei, who we met in the Nimbus Sanctum.
records.zh: 它应该是一种生活在黎乔利海渊，也就是群岛海底的回音生物，也可以说和我们之前在氤柔水境遇到的罗蕾莱是相同的生物。

records.text: Time to put our experience in the Nimbus Sanctum to good use. I'm certain we can make it work.
records.zh: 在氤柔水境我们已经有过这样的经验了，这次一定没问题。

records.text: You arrive near the Riccioli Islands on the fisherman's Gondola...
records.zh: 渔民的贡多拉载着你穿越海洋，抵达了黎乔利群岛附近……

records.text: There are four of 'em across Riccioli Islands. As long as their lights are on, the Tidebreaker will answer our pleas as gently as ever.
records.zh: 像这样的灯塔在黎乔利群岛一共有四座，只要灯亮着，溯海之鲸就能回应我们的祈求，温和如初。

records.text: W-what? I've only ever read about Riccioli Islands' fishing trade in the Order's library before, but I've never actually fished on the sea...
records.zh: 诶！？可是我也只是在修会的书上读到过黎乔利群岛的捕鱼产业，从来没有出过海啊……

records.text: People would see that knights who uphold justice and righteousness are still active, in Whisperwind Haven and even in other places in Rinascita, not lost to time.
records.zh: 人们会知道，践行正义与公正的骑士并未消失，他们仍然活跃在拂风水畔，乃至黎那汐塔的其他地方……

records.text: But think of the knight who ventured deep into Whisperwind Haven and faced the Giant alone. He must have encountered something far worse.
records.zh: 但传闻中在水畔深处直面巨人的那位骑士，面临的肯定是更艰难的境况吧……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_11_1
records.text: And Ms. Margherita is so fast! I'm out of breath just trying to keep up.
records.zh: 玛格烈特女士的动作真的好快，光是跟上她的节奏我就已经竭尽全力了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_6_1
records.text: Lately, Ms. Margherita has been sharing all sorts of cooking tips with me.
records.zh: 说起来，最近我从玛格烈特女士那学到了很多做菜的心得呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_1_1
records.text: Really? Margherita makes the best food! My mum used to bring me here all the time.
records.zh: 真的？“玛格烈特”的菜品是远近闻名的地道美味，以前母亲经常带我来这里。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_1_1
records.text: I... I heard they were hiring, so I thought I'd take a peek. But Ms. Margherita seems really busy, and I didn't want to be a bother.
records.zh: 那个……我听说这边在招人，所以想来看看。但玛格烈特女士看起来很忙的样子，我不太好去打扰她。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_3_1
records.text: To capture true Egla flavor, I got up early and went to the Gondola Market to buy wild mushrooms from Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 为了还原埃格拉小镇的风味，我可是特意起早，在水市上买了产自拂风水畔的野生蘑菇。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_3_2
records.text: I did! Today was supposed to be Margherita Pizza, but...
records.zh: 做了的，今天学着做了「玛格烈特披萨」，但是……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_每日_虹镇地推大使_2_1
records.text: Mt. Firmament rocks...? Are they different from the ones in Jinzhou?
records.zh: 乘霄山的石头……？和今州的石头不一样吗？

records.text: It might have worked in the old days, but now Desorock Highland is so close to the front line that the people are no longer allowed to go up there.
records.zh: 要是以前说不定行得通，可是现在荒石高地离前线这么近，已经不让百姓上去了，我也没办法。

records.text: Oh, sorry about that. Haven't introduced myself yet. My name's Alannah, I'm with the Product Development Team at the Pioneer Association.
records.zh: 啊啊——不好意思，我还没自我介绍，我叫阿兰娜，隶属于先行公约的产品制作团队！

records.text: (Upon hearing your voice, Alannah turns her back and lowers her voice.)
records.zh: （听到你的声音后，阿兰娜转过身，并放低了音量）

records.text:
By the young man's invitation, the three of you begin sunbathing with Slowy.
After getting plenty of sunshine, you see Alannah in deep thought. She then says goodbye and returns to Jinzhou on her own.
records.zh:
在男生的建议下，你们三人跟慢慢一起晒了会儿太阳。
晒完太阳后，阿兰娜似乎若有所思。她跟你告别后，独自走回了城里。

records.text: After some hard work, Alannah manages to send a shipment of Jinzhou-styled Echo plushies to Ragunna.
records.zh: 经过一番准备，阿兰娜将数个今州特色声骸抱枕发往了拉古那。

records.text: You see, Rinascita is comprised mostly of islands out at sea, with Ragunna City on one of the isles.
records.zh: 是的！那拉古那城所在的黎那汐塔，是一个被海洋环绕的岛屿地区。

records.text: Yuanwu has his own boxing gym and is secretly the proprietor of the Liuxian Teahouse. A good guess.
records.zh: 渊武不仅开着拳馆，还是六羡茶行的幕后所有者，的确很有实力。

records.text: Later, by adding a few edits here and there, Alannah finishes compiling a printout called Mahe's Spicy Secret.
records.zh: 没过多久，阿兰娜添油加醋地整理好了一本名叫《马家秘辛》的资料……

records.text: I have just received it from the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. Freshly picked, still rich with fragrance.
records.zh: 是昭明商会派人送来的，都是刚采摘的好茶，香气浓郁。

records.text: Let us meet again at the Western Fang Peaks tomorrow. The next section of the piece awaits.
records.zh: 明日在方擎西峰相见吧，我会将下一段琴曲教给你。

records.text: A gateway opens. Desorock Highland. The Somnoire shows up. A collection of dreams...
records.zh: 荒石高地上，出现了大门，集域的梦境，将侵入现实。

records.text: Spanning a natural barrier and reaching straight into Bjartr Woods, the bridge raised concerns in the Solisylum when first proposed.
records.zh: 这座跨越天然屏障、直达浮光林的大桥在计划初期引起了引日殿的担忧。

records.text: Rain, Helios's light, and the Starward Riseway piercing the clouds.
records.zh: 雨、赫利俄斯的光芒、高耸入云的联运椎骨。

records.text: Back when I was in Bjartr Woods, the Roya children didn't quite understand the way I spoke.
records.zh: 我还在浮光林的时候，罗伊族的孩童不理解我的言语。

records.text: Not true! Cosmos, Cloudy, and the white cat were also part of our team...
records.zh: 有安可勇士，黑咩勇士，白咩勇士，白猫勇士，漂泊者……

records.text: I suspect you experienced something similar upon awakening in the Gorges of Spirits.
records.zh: 你在云陵谷醒来时，应当也是如此？

records.text: Not in that way, of course. I heard you took down that beast at Norfall Barrens. The wilds have been quieter since then, which means more opportunities for folks like us.
records.zh: 如今，正是蛟龙帮发展的黄金时期，我们正在广纳贤才。

records.text: Haha, because I'm Lumi, Luminary of Logistics!
records.zh: 我也觉得，毕竟我可是——噔噔噔噔，灯灯组长！

records.text: Again, thanks a bunch for your help! If you ever swing by my hometown, Yuezhou, I'll treat you to some local delicacies!
records.zh: 这次的事情真的非常感谢你！要是你有机会到我老家越州去的话，我肯定用村里的特产好好招待你！

records.text: After bowing deeply, Lumi grabs a delivery crate and rushes out of the station.
records.zh: 灯灯深深地鞠了一躬表示感谢，然后才火急火燎地拿上快递箱，离开了物流站点。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_13_1
records.text:
After Tianhu and his subordinates depart, Lumi expresses her heartfelt gratitude. You ask if she remembers what happened in the Somnoire, and as expected, she has forgotten everything upon waking...

Now, you are the only person in Solaris who still remembers this adventure.
records.zh:
天胡和小弟离开后，灯灯对你表达了感谢。你问灯灯是否知道心之集域中发生的事，结果果然如白猫所说，脱离了梦境的灯灯已经忘掉了这一切……
如今，索拉里斯只有你还记得这场冒险。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_18_1
records.text: (Is that... Lumi? The Tacet Discords are after her!)
records.zh: ……灯灯？她好像在被残象追赶。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_8_1
records.text: In the dream, you come across Lumi, but it appears she can't hear you.
records.zh: 在梦中你遇到了灯灯，但她似乎听不见你说话。

records.text: Three days ago, the delivery van reached Waving Battlefield near Whining Aix's Mire!
records.zh: 话说在三天前，载着咱们那货的车驶入了怨鸟泽旁边的觉林峡！

records.text: Journeying from the New Federation to Jinzhou, it braved countless trials to arrive at its destination, but alas...
records.zh: 从新联邦到今州，一路多少艰难险阻！总算平安到了这地界，却没想到……

records.text: He mentioned seeing weird things in Whining Aix's Mire, kinda like the stuff happening over in Tacet Fields.
records.zh: 前几天，他说在怨鸟泽看到了奇怪的景象，感觉就像踏进了无音区一样……

records.text: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.
records.zh: 不知道是不是巧合……从怨鸟泽回来后，我这几天都没有再做过梦了。

records.text: I was planning to search Whining Aix's Mire again, but now...
records.zh: 本来我想自己再去怨鸟泽找一次货物，但现在组员突然出现了意外……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_1_4
records.text: You engage in conversation with the Lollo member, named Lumi, who reveals that strange events have been occurring in the Whining Aix's Mire, where her team member lost the package. She asks for your help in recovering it, and to investigate the anomalies, you agree to assist her.
records.zh: 在与物流员交谈后，你知道了她的名字叫做灯灯。灯灯告知你最近怨鸟泽的情况有些异常，自己的组员正是在那里弄丢了货物。在一番交谈后，灯灯询问你能否帮忙找回这件货物。你为了调查这一系列异常现象，决定帮灯灯这个忙。

records.text: Hiya! I'm Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain. I head up the delivery team.
records.zh: 而我呢，名字叫作……噔噔噔噔，叫灯灯！是物流小组的组长。

records.text: His package got lost in Whining Aix's Mire. Speaking of that place, something strange is going on there lately, so be careful when you're there, hmm?
records.zh: 但是最近，这旁边的怨鸟泽好像有些异常的情况……漂泊者，你要是经过那附近也要小心哇。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_17
records.text: People may eventually forget them, but Somnoire won't!
records.zh: 但留存在心之集域中的梦依然有它的意义！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_17
records.text: Those gateways that appeared by the Whining Aix's Mire... It's all because of you.
records.zh: 除了怨鸟泽，现在其他地方也都出现了心之集域的大门……这些，都是你入侵现实带来的。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_13_1
records.text: Ugh, I keep getting sidetracked. Focus, Lumi! Think about what you're gonna do next.
records.zh: 不纠结了，还是想想组员们的事情吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_16_1
records.text: You're here, Lumi! I've been looking for you!
records.zh: 灯灯组长，终于找到你了！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_2_2
records.text: After aiding Lumi in resolving her issues, you discover that the white cat can now speak. It explains that gateways have emerged across various regions, and it has lost its control over the Somnoire. It requests you to help reclaim its clearance.
records.zh: 在你帮助灯灯解开了心结，脱离噩梦之后，之前逃出心之集域的白猫也能开口说话了。据它所说，大门出现在了各大地区，而它失去了在心之集域内的控制权限，需要你进入门中的梦境里，帮助其夺回权限。

records.text: Somnoire breaks into world. My authority... lost.
records.zh: 心之集域，侵入现实，我的权限，失去了喵。

records.text: You saw Illusia, not real Lumi. She is safe, don't worry...
records.zh: 车里灯灯，梦境虚像，不是真人，不用担心……

records.text: (Lumi hasn't had any dreams since visiting Whining Aix's Mire.)
records.zh: 灯灯之前提到，她来过这附近后，就没有再做过梦了。

records.text: (If this has been going on for a while, Lumi might not be the only one trapped here.)
records.zh: 如果异变已经持续了一段时间，恐怕被困住的不会只有灯灯一个人。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_吟霖_1_1
records.text: Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.
records.zh: 吟霖，有一个紧急任务必须马上去做。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_吟霖_4_1
records.text: You are no Public Security agent, Yinlin. Your foolishness has ruined everything.
records.zh: 吟霖，你再也没法光明正大地回到治安署了，而这一切都是你咎由自取！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_吟霖_4_1
records.text: You are no Patroller, Yinlin. You never will be.
records.zh: 吟霖，你不是巡尉，你永远都不会是。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_26
records.text: Sad little adventurer Cosmos was so moved by these words.
records.zh: 于是，本来很伤心的冒险家黑咩现在非常感动。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_26
records.text: With his brave heart, Cosmos decided to fight the Big Bad Demon and save the Magical Kingdom with Encore!
records.zh: 陪她一起挑战大坏魔王，守护魔法王国，这就是冒险家的精神！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_4
records.text: If you're not Cosmos's friend, I'll just go join the Big Bad Demon and cause trouble!
records.zh: 你们都不是黑咩的好朋友，我要加入大坏魔王，和他一起搞破坏！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_5
records.text: But they were not afraid! Ha, ha! Princess Cloudy and Adventurer Cosmos used all their skills to support Warrior Encore.
records.zh: 呵！呵！我们才不会害怕！白咩公主与黑咩冒险家各自施展绝技，想方设法地帮助勇士安可。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_28
records.text: On the big battle day, Adventurer Cosmos led the super-duper awesome team to dodge traps and face the Big Bad Demon.
records.zh: 决战当天，在冒险家黑咩的带领下，超级大大大军团绕过了大坏魔王的陷阱，来到了他面前。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_16
records.text: It isn't. It's due to Somnoire's innate design.
records.zh: 让它不稳定的，不是我，而是它的规则本身。

records.text: Then she met you, Traveler Cosmos, Prince Cloudy, and many more new friends.
records.zh: 她先是遇到了漂泊者，又遇到了旅行家黑咩，再遇到了王子白咩，然后遇到了好多好多伙伴。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_12_1
records.text: Master Zhezhi, have you made any plans for your next painting?
records.zh: 折枝大师，不知道您对下一卷画画什么可有想法？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_12_1
records.text: Of course. Take your time, Master Zhezhi. Let me know when you've decided.
records.zh: 好好，折枝大师，您慢慢画不着急，我等着你的消息！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_14_1
records.text: Zhezhi, you're a true master! Would a master present a client with a half-finished piece?
records.zh: 不是……折枝大师，您要清楚自己的身份。您可是大师啊，当然要用最成熟的作品示人！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_14_1
records.text: With all due respect, Master Zhezhi, not everyone will buy whatever you paint.
records.zh: 不是我刻意贬低您，但现状就是，您不是那种画什么都有人买的画家。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_14_1
records.text: Okay, Master Zhezhi! About the painting I mentioned last time...
records.zh: 您手头的画，不知道情况如何了？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_4_5
records.text: (Zhezhi musters her courage and continues to work on the unfinished draft.)
records.zh: （你攥紧手中的画笔，鼓起勇气，铺开了未完成的草稿）

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_5_1
records.text: Don't be so stubborn, Zhezhi! A painting that doesn't sell well is meaningless!
records.zh: 折枝大师，你真是执迷不悟！卖不出好价的画，没有任何意义！

records.text: They then posed as Jing's parents and lay in wait until Xinyi figured it out.
records.zh: 等辛夷察觉到异常时，两名残星会成员已经偷梁换柱，假扮成了阿径的父母在乘霄山生活。

records.text: Of course, Xinyi was prepared for this. She used the opportunity to expose them in the act and capture them.
records.zh: 辛夷这才行动，将目的败露的二人，连同当时渗入虹镇的残星会小队一网打尽。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_1_15
records.text: In the Whining Aix's Mire, you encounter a white cat that escaped the Somnoire by train. It asks you to enter a mysterious gateway...
records.zh: 在怨鸟泽，你遇见了乘坐列车逃出心之集域的白猫。它拜托你进入门中……

records.chapter: 剧情_2.7幸存者活动引导任务_1_1
records.text: You can find me in Ragunna City and I'll brief you on the details in person when you have the time.
records.zh: 我们目前就在拉古那城内，有空最好能够见面详谈一下。

records.text: Sounds like something Cristoforo would be into.
records.zh: 这话听上去有点像克里斯托弗的风格。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.6黎那汐塔塔防活动引导任务_1_1
records.text: But due to the high risks that often come with the tasks, many Bloom Bearers gave their lives while performing their duties, just like... Niya and Hoda did in the previous Port City of Guixu incident.
records.zh: 但这些任务无比危险。有许多执花都在履行职责时不幸牺牲，就像……在之前归墟港市事件中牺牲的妮娅和霍德一样。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.6黎那汐塔塔防活动引导任务_3_1
records.text: Awaiting further data input. Please stand by, Valentina.
records.zh: 正在等待数据返回。请稍等，瓦莲京娜。

records.chapter: 剧情_春节活动引导任务第一天_1_3
records.text: Huanglong's holographic tech has come a long way.
records.zh: 瑝珑的影像技术真是突飞猛进。

records.chapter: 剧情_春节活动引导任务第一天_1_7
records.text: Judging by that look on your face, you've dug up a clue, haven't you, Lumi?
records.zh: 灯灯，看你的样子，是不是打听出了什么？

records.chapter: 剧情_春节活动引导任务第三天_1_3
records.text: Ah, that was just a tale I spun for Lumi. Geisel was just an ordinary boy. But very easy to love, I must say.
records.zh: 哈哈，那是我对灯灯的胡言乱语罢了，盖泽尔是个再普通不过的孩子。虽然普通，但很可爱呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_春节活动引导任务第三天_1_3
records.text: Ah, it seems Lumi has told you quite a bit. Well, let me tell you what happened before all that.
records.zh: 啊，看来灯灯已经对您说了很多。那么，就让我说说更早的事吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_无尽宴会引导任务第一天_IRIS_2_1
records.text: Oh, no need to worry. I wouldn't waste processing power on an emotion like regret. Anyway, check your Terminal, Lumi seems to have sent you an important message.
records.zh: 啊呀，倒也不必担心，我可不会在这种情绪上浪费算力。好啦，快查看一下校内终端吧，灯灯似乎给你发了条重要的消息哦。

records.text: Heard you've never lost in a game of Lone Star. Impressive.
records.zh: 听说你玩孤星的晚宴从来没输过。真厉害啊。

records.text: Lumi said she'd come see us often. If only this place would fade away a little slower.
records.zh: 灯灯说，她会常常来看我们的，如果这里消失得慢一点就好了。

records.text: ...Is that a poem from Huanglong? That's kinda cool.
records.zh: 这是瑝珑的古诗吗？有意思……

records.chapter: 剧情_找bug活动_华胥研究院_1_1
records.text: At first, we were going to base the design on the real-life Black Shores archipelago. Made sense, lots of overlap with the lore.
records.zh: 一开始，我们打算参考现实中的黑海岸群岛进行设计，毕竟黑海岸和原作中的描述有很类似的地方。

records.text: Actually, this reminds me of the Reinfish from the Riccioli Islands. I heard they float upright in the water like this to catch passing prey.
records.zh: 不过这倒有点像黎乔利群岛那边地震皇带的生态习性，我听说它们一般会这么竖立在海中，来捕食路过的鱼儿。

records.text: It has a short flowering season, making it unsuitable for Penjing. So we usually don't sell them here. But Verina happened to drop by a few days ago and gave me a few.
records.zh: 怨鸟泽的鸢尾花花期很短，并不适合做成盆景，所以店里并没有卖。但是前两天，维里奈有给店里送来两朵。

records.text: It originates from Whining Aix's Mire and its flower language is fragile, untold affections. Romantic, isn't it?
records.zh: 这种花原产自怨鸟泽，花语是破碎而隐晦的爱哦，很浪漫吧。

records.text: It's called Jinzhou Stew, General Jiyan's favorite food of all time.
records.zh: 偷偷告诉你，这道今州烩，可是忌炎将军最爱的菜肴。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_仿声骸会梦到电子羊么_2_1
records.text: Cosmos dashes through the gate at an astonishing speed.
records.zh: 黑咩玩偶以令人瞠目结舌的速度逃进了门里。

records.text: It uses data from all over Solaris-3, to simulate Crisis Trials that put the combat capabilities of its participants to the test under extreme conditions.
records.zh: 它可以根据索拉里斯各地数据和过往案例模拟出一些「危机情景」，从而检验挑战者在严苛条件下的实战能力。

records.text: Like the TD outbreaks along the Jinzhou borders, or the mist swallowing up Penitent's End in Ragunna...
records.zh: 比如今州的边境出现了残象潮，拉古那的那座墓岛被海雾淹没……

records.text: A pizza oven... You mean all of Trattoria Margherita's pizzas are made inside of this Echo?
records.zh: 居然是披萨炉……难道玛格烈特餐厅的披萨都是它烤出来的？

records.text: A peculiar canine Echo that frequent the streets of Ragunna City. Often used by people as a storage box...
records.zh: 出没于拉古那城的奇特犬型声骸，经常被人们拿来装东西……

records.text: After all, Chisa is practically a legend among us students from Ashinohara.
records.zh: 在我们这些从苇原来拉海洛读书的学生里，她可是不折不扣的传奇名人哦。

records.text: "Beep. Thank you for choosing Lollo Logistics—We Promise, We Deliver! For further assistance, press 1. To access the Beyond the Waves campaign, press 2. If you wish to speak to a representative, please contact business manager Maji."
records.zh: 「滴，服务已结束——呜呜物流，使命必达！如有其他需要请按1，打开踏潮探历页面请按2，转人工请联系业务负责人马计……」

records.text: It's me! Your old pal Maji from Lollo Logistics! You helped me out a bunch in the past, remember? What a surprise to run into you here!
records.zh: 我是你的老朋友马计啊，呜呜物流的，以前一直找您帮忙做业务的那个！没想到会在这遇见你啊！

records.text: "Transferring your call to Manager Maji. Please hold… While you wait, enjoy this brief commercial break: Lollo Logistics shipping service is now fully upgraded! Place your order today and enjoy exclusive discounts!"
records.zh: 「即将为您转接负责人马计的通讯终端，请稍后……等待转接期间，请您欣赏优美的商业广告：呜呜物流闪送服务全面升级，现在订购更可以享受满减优惠！」

records.text: Hehe, with today's sales under the watchful eye of yours truly, Maji, we've got nothing to worry about! Right, 漂泊者?
records.zh: 嘿嘿，今日的呜呜业绩也将由我马计守候……你说对吧，漂泊者？

records.text: Hey, it's me! Your old friend Maji! Lollo Logistics, remember? You helped me with work in Jinzhou and Rinascita!
records.zh: 怎么回事……我是你的老朋友马计啊！呜呜物流的那个，在今州和黎那汐塔都有找您帮忙做业务的那个啊！

records.text: "Victory at the Norfall Barrens, return of Mt. Firmament, and a successful Moon-Chasing Festival... One remarkable event after the other, Jinzhou is slowly presenting its unique brilliance across Solaris!"
records.zh: 「北落野大捷，乘霄山回归，追月节圆满举办……随着一系列令人瞩目的事件，今州正将独特的魅力展现给整个索拉里斯！」

records.text: "From the victory in the Norfall Barrens to the return of Mt. Firmament, and the successful Moon-Chasing Festival, Jinzhou's unique brilliance is shining bright across Solaris, one remarkable event after another!"
records.zh: 「北落野大捷，乘霄山回归，追月节圆满举办……随着一系列令人瞩目的事件，今州正将独特的魅力展现给整个索拉里斯！」

records.text: Beep. Thank you for choosing Lollo Logistics—We Promise, We Deliver! For further assistance, press 1. To access the Beyond the Waves campaign, press 2. If you wish to speak to a representative, please contact business manager Maji.
records.zh: 「滴，服务已结束——呜呜物流，使命必达！如有其他需要请按1，打开踏潮探历页面请按2，转人工请联系业务负责人马计……」

records.text: Oh, that's a sweet one! Lingyang, you're truly a master of lucky greeting couplets!
records.zh: 完美！不愧是吉祥话大王啊，凌阳！

records.text: Looks like 漂泊者 has the upper hand. Now, you go first, Lingyang.
records.zh: 看来漂泊者稳占上风了。那么，下一题还是由你来出吧，凌阳。

records.text: It doesn't seem to rhyme with Lingyang's line...
records.zh: 对得好像……不太工整。

records.text: In no time, Ganxue locates the puppets Yinlin needs and brings them to you.
records.zh: 甘雪很快找到了吟霖所需要的人偶，并将它们交给了吟霖。

records.text: Ha, no way. We just got here. Hurry up, greet our boss, Uncle Li!
records.zh: 呵……呵呵，黎哥您说的哪里话。我们也是刚到。快，叫黎叔！

records.text: Uncle Li is about to speak when the roars of Tacet Discords interrupt him.
records.zh: 就在此时，不远处传来了残象的吼声。

records.text: Interesting… From what I know, Uncle Li isn't a bad person. If he was actually hiding his true nature this whole time, I have to give him some credit for fooling me.
records.zh: 有趣……以我对黎叔的了解，他并不是个坏人。难道……他的伪装技术会比我还好吗？

records.text: Uncle Li knows life ain't easy for a man with a past like mine. Used to run with the Savage Beasts, know how to hunt, so he hired me and my crew to fetch meat for him.
records.zh: 黎哥知道我金盆洗手不容易，又知道我以前在 野兽帮干过，知道怎么狩猎，所以才雇我带兄弟们打猎的。

records.text: Uncle Li, heading back to the stall already? Let us handle the boxes. We'll get 'em close to the venue, but the rest...
records.zh: 黎叔，你要回宵月会的摊位吗？我们帮你抬箱子吧。不过我们只能送你到会场附近，剩下的路……

records.text: I'll spill everything! It was all Uncle Li's idea!
records.zh: ……我交代，我坦白！都是黎哥让我们做的！

records.text: Wait! Zhezhi, don't tell me you plan on finishing all that by yourself?
records.zh: ——等等，折枝。这些你全都要画吗？

records.text: Zhezhi never misses deadlines, but I don't want her to overwork herself.
records.zh: 我倒不担心她画不完……只是担心她太拼命，身体说不定会垮的。

records.text: When you're finished, please bring them back to me and I'll pass them on to Zhezhi.
records.zh: 拍完之后，由我来把照片交给折枝就好。

records.text: That's a relief. Thank you, Zhezhi will be so happy to have those photos!
records.zh: 哈，太好了……折枝一定会很开心的。

records.text: Your theory makes sense—Uncle Li is known for his exquisite taste, and the items he bought just happened to attract attention from greedy Tacet Discords like Spearback.
records.zh: 嗯……是个不错的切入点。大家都知道黎叔是个著名的美食家，而他购买的货物偏偏又能吸引箭簇熊这种残象。

records.text: Jiyan? Did something happen on the front lines?
records.zh: 忌炎？难道是边关出问题了？

records.text: Jiyan never seems to stop working. He keeps skipping meals once he gets busy.
records.zh: 每次大伙休假的时候，忌炎总是不休息，他一忙起来就又会忘了吃饭。

records.text: Hey, no sneakin' bites! Well, maybe a nibble, but leave some for Jiyan, okay?
records.zh: 喂，你可不许偷吃啊！算了，你可以偷偷吃一点，别都吃光了就行。

records.text: Yumyum Haven. Uncle Li made it fresh! Madam Magistrate said it's good too!
records.zh: 这个嘛？我在团圆铺买的，黎叔新做的，可好吃了！令尹大人刚才都说好吃呢！

records.text: This is merely our personal preference. It may be helpful to get others' input as well, Uncle Li.
records.zh: 这只是我们的个人口味，要不黎叔再多问问别人？

records.text: Thank you, Uncle Li. If you need any assistance, please let me know. I'll be sure to help.
records.zh: 谢谢黎叔。如果您有需要帮忙的地方，请随时告诉我，我一定会来的。

records.text: Hehe, Uncle Li is having people taste-test some pastries. I happened to be passing by and decided to stop in.
records.zh: 黎叔在请人帮忙试试点心的味道，我正好路过，就过来看看。

records.text: Actually, I came to see if I could help with something, but Uncle Li told me that…
records.zh: 原本我是想来问问，宵月会上有没有需要帮忙的地方，没想到黎叔却说……

records.text: Is that the divination lot you wanted Jianxin to decipher?
records.zh: 所以，你想让鉴心解开的卦签……

records.text: Great! I'll be sure to pay you a hefty sum! Best of luck, Jianxin, 漂泊者!
records.zh: 那太好了。找到之后，我必有重谢！祝你们顺利，鉴心，漂泊者！

records.text: You and Jianxin open the casket. However, except for some herbs wrapped in silk pouches, there is only a yellowed piece of paper.
records.zh: 你和鉴心打开了木匣，但里面除了放了一些用锦囊包裹的药材外，只有一张泛黄的纸条。

records.text: Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall" we can probably cross out large stores from our list.
records.zh: 等等，鉴心。既然卦辞中说的是逐利之亭，那想必指的不是大型的商铺。

records.text: You and Jianxin open the wooden casket. Inside there is an ordinary looking black porcelain bowl.
records.zh: 你和鉴心打开了木匣，里面放着一个看起来平平无奇的黑色瓷碗。

records.text: Anyway, thank you, 漂泊者, Jianxin. Thank you for helping me find this bowl.
records.zh: 不管怎么说，谢谢你们，漂泊者，还有鉴心。谢谢你们帮我找到了这个瓷碗。

records.text: Thank you so much. I'll pass them on to Zhezhi once she's back!
records.zh: 非常感谢，等折枝回来，我就把照片交给她！

records.text: "Sanhua has eight hundred matters to handle simultaneously," she wrote… That's impossible. Not even the Academy's computers could do that.
records.zh: “同时有八百件事等着散华去处理”，哪怕是研究院开发的终端，也不可能同时处理这么多工作吧……

records.text: Hi, Sanhua. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?
records.zh: 散华？你也是来逛宵月会的吗？

records.text: There's a special lotus seed called Twin Lotus Seed, found near lakes in the Whining Aix's Mire.
records.zh: 是一种名为“双生莲实”的特殊莲实，它们一般生长在怨鸟泽深处，有残象活动的危险湖泊。

records.text: Welcome, 漂泊者 and Lady Sanhua! What can I get for you?
records.zh: ——欢迎光临！是漂泊者和散华大人啊。二位想来点什么啊？

records.text: But these are said to only grow in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire, where many monsters live...
records.zh: 但……但这东西，据说只有怨鸟泽深处的残象栖息地才有。

records.text: ...On second thought, with 漂泊者 and Lady Sanhua, getting those seeds would be a breeze. Can't wait for your Plumpcake!
records.zh: 不，如果是漂泊者和散华大人的话，弄到这些莲实应该还是没问题的。就让我期待一下吧。

records.text: Soon, Sanhua effortlessly recreates the Plumpcake with her incredible talents.
records.zh: 片刻之后，散华以行云流水的刀法和出神入化的技巧完美还原了每一个制作团圆饼的步骤。

records.text: Sanhua boxes up the fresh Plumpcakes, then hands a box to you.
records.zh: 散华把烤好的团圆饼分成了两份，并递给漂泊者一份。

records.text: You're that "Cosmos" from before, aren't you?
records.zh: 上次的“黑咩”也是你吧？

records.text: And then... I was able to manifest in Solaris-3 and talk to you.
records.zh: 而我……我则经由这样的方式来到索拉里斯和你交流。

records.text: Changli walks over to the stall and casually spins the wheel.
records.zh: 长离走到摊位前，随意地摇动了转盘。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_4_肉鸽_起点房角色剧情_1_3
records.text: It's Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain.
records.zh: 是噔噔噔——灯灯组长！

records.text: That's reassuring. Please do keep exploring the Somnoire.
records.zh: 嗯，请继续向梦境的深处前进吧。

records.text: Nevertheless, a true man never sheds tears over his career! Pull yourself together, Maji!
records.zh: 真男人怎么能为了生计落泪？振作起来，马计！

records.text: Bakie joyfully swallows your ingredients, turning them into a delicious dish. You split the dish into three portions, sharing with Margherita and Bakie.
records.zh:
焙焙欢快地吞下你给的食材，烘烤出了一道美味料理。
你将料理分成三份，和玛格烈特、焙焙一起分享。

records.text: Remember us? We're the Plushie Squad from Penitent's End, the ones you and Roccia brought back to the Troupe of Fools.
records.zh: 还记得我们吗？我们是之前在悲叹墓岛上，被你和洛可可带回愚人剧团的布偶小队。

records.chapter: 剧情_V2_2呜呜物流引导和后续任务_7_1
records.text: Well, about Bakethoven, while it is a pity that the Averardo Vault declined its application...
records.zh: 关于昨天那位声骸「焙多分」，虽然很遗憾，埃弗拉德金库最终拒绝了它的申请……

records.chapter: 剧情_V2_2呜呜物流引导和后续任务_4_3
records.text: Sounds like Maji is in trouble... I'd better go lend a hand.
records.zh: 马计似乎遇到了什么麻烦……过去看看吧。

records.text: After some hard work, you and Maji used the data recorded by "Lollo Navigator" to help the couriers verify their goods. In the end, all the couriers gave you a thumbs-up.
records.zh:
经历了一段时间，你和马计利用「呜呜导航」记录的数据帮助物流员们重新确认了货物的信息……
物流员们纷纷向你们竖起了大拇指……

records.text: I don't remember Maji ever mentioning them...
records.zh: 我记得马计没有提到过它们……

records.text: Just as Maji is about to explain the details to you, the applet on the "Lollo Navigator" starts chiming…
records.zh: 正当马计想向你详细解说时，「呜呜导航」小程序响动了起来……

records.text: I remember Maji taught me how to transmit data. Let's see here...
records.zh: 我记得马计教给我传输信息的步骤是……

records.chapter: 剧情_春节活动角色邀约_吟霖_1_1
records.text: Besides, like I said, I'm not here on assignment. I'm simply "Yinlin," on vacation.
records.zh: 而且，我刚才说过了，我此行并不是为了任务而来。其实，我只是以“吟霖”的身份，来这里休假的。

records.chapter: 剧情_春节活动角色邀约_琳奈_1_1
records.text: They've even got New Federation specialties here! Been ages since I last had those…
records.zh: 而且，还把派对办得这么棒……这里竟然还有新联邦的特色菜，我已经好久没吃到了！

records.text: The Crownless… was that your first strong enemy in Huanglong?
records.zh: 无冠者……漂泊者在瑝珑遇到的第一个强敌吗？

records.text: What are you talking about? In all of Solaris, you're the most dependable one. Only I, Maji, could find someone as reliable as you.
records.zh: 这是什么话，放眼整个索拉里斯，只有你最靠谱，也只有我马计，才能找到你这么靠谱的关系。

records.text: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!
records.zh: 呜呜物流的全新篇章，马计时代，沸腾期待！

records.text: Then I suggest asking Lumi to deliver you back to the HQ. Maybe she'll go soft on you.
records.zh: 我会推荐灯灯做这件事的，也许她会对你温柔一些。

records.text: For my salary, and for the happiness of my old friend. I, Maji, will do anything!
records.zh: 只要能领到工资，只要能让老朋友享受到舒心的服务，马计我义不容辞！

records.text: The Tacet Field in the Port City of Guixu is expanding, and the nearby Xiehua Village has been included in the emergency evacuation area. The Ministry of Development and the Patrollers are already very busy.
records.zh: 归墟港市的无音区有扩张的趋势，邻近的撷华庄被纳入了应急疏散区，天工和巡尉已经忙得不可开交了。

records.text: Merchants willing to go to Xiehua Village are few already because of the short distance to the Port City of Guixu. Now with the trouble in the Tacet Field...
records.zh: 撷华庄临近归墟港市，本来愿意去那儿的货商就少，再加上这无音区一闹……

records.text: The navigation system shows that Guanxian is in Dim Forest. I was about to go and find him, that's why I changed into this outfit.
records.zh: 定位显示，管羡还在无光之森的林区附近，我刚换上衣服准备去找他。

records.text: 漂泊者, the situation is urgent. I heard that you can use the Resonance Beacon to reach Dim Forest faster. I must ask you for help.
records.zh: 漂泊者，事态紧急。听说你能借助信标更快地到达无光之森，我只能拜托你了。

records.text: After dispersing the group of Hoochiefs, you and Maji bring the frightened freshman courier back to Jinzhou.
records.zh: 驱散了戏猿群后，你和马计一同将惊魂未定的新人物流员带回了今州。

records.text: Maji remains silent for a while before calming down.
records.zh: 马计沉默了良久，才平复了心绪。

records.text: Next to Maji, an expensive-looking magazine titled How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite catches your attention...
records.zh: 【马计的身边，一本名为《物联网黑话指南》的精装杂志引起了你的注意——】

records.text: Oh, I almost forgot to introduce myself. I'm the new manager of the Lollo Logistics Station, Maji. By the way, I also go by Ma... M-Maggie! Sounds pretty cool and international, right?
records.zh: 忘记自我介绍了！我是今州物流站的新任管理员，我叫马计，你也可以叫我的花名——呣……不对……咩……Maggie！

records.text: Yes, I am Maji, staff number 2404150. I have worked at the Jinzhou Lollo Logistics Station for three years.
records.zh: 是，我是物流管理员马计，工号2404150，工龄3年，任职于呜呜今州物流站。

records.text: You tell Maji about the event, leaving him speechless for a moment.
records.zh: 你将方才的遭遇告诉了马计，马计一时无语。

records.text:
Order #1: 5 cups, 0 code.
Order #2: 30 cups, 1 code.
Order #3: 22 cups, 1 code.
Order #4: 1 cup, 1 code.
Order #5: 10 cups, 2 codes...

With 68 cups of boba in your stomach, you and Maji call it quits earlier than you expected.
records.zh:
第一单，5杯，兑换码0张；
第二单，30杯，兑换码1张；
第三单，22杯，兑换码1张；
第四单，1杯，兑换码1张；
第五单，10杯，兑换码2张……

68杯糖水下肚，你和马计提前结束了战斗。

records.text: "I was robbed by a group of Exiles in Wuming Bay, and they threatened to destroy all my stuff if I dared to call the Patrollers. Please, help me!"
records.zh: “路过无明湾时被流放者打劫了，还被威胁‘敢告诉巡尉就把你的勘探器材给扬喽’。这一次，请帮我把失去的夺回来！”

records.text: Alright, enough with the fancy words... Ahem. I hereby declared that "Maji's Lollo Entrepreneur Pilot Business Projects" will end today.
records.zh: 算了算了，不和你贫了。本人马计，宣布「马计的呜呜创业企划」今日正式收官。

records.text: A few days have passed. Today, the Incubator project's final decisions will be revealed. You meet Maji at the Lollo Logistics Station.
records.zh:
几日后，创业企划发布了结果。
你在今州的呜呜物流站见到了马计。

records.text: Maji inspects the codebase and contacts the buyers who canceled the orders.
records.zh: 马计查验了系统代码，并逐个联系了撤销订单的委托人。

records.text: A new order! An automatic courier truck went missing in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire. I'll send you the coordinates.
records.zh: 来活儿了漂师傅！有一辆自动物流车在怨鸟泽深处失联了，我把定位发你。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_拂光搁浅的旧讯2_4_1
records.text: We still need more clues. Let's head to the Silent Crag to meet the next victim. He's supposed to be inspecting survey equipment there.
records.zh: 线索还不够，我们去找下一位受害人吧，他正在寂静断崖检测野外探测设备，我们约在那碰头。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_拂光搁浅的旧讯_25_1
records.text: If those terms are acceptable, prepare 15,000 Shell Credits. Meet this same time tomorrow at the Dimmr Deep.
records.zh: 没问题就准备15000贝币，明天这个时间，恒黯之原见。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_拂光搁浅的旧讯2_2_1
records.text: Anyway! First victim should be near the Sealed Fissure. Let's go.
records.zh: 第一个受害人应该在封存地附近，我们出发吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_拂光搁浅的旧讯_9_1
records.text: To answer your question, we met at the Sealed Fissure, not far from here. It was a girl. She looked like a Roya student. Very pale, with a distinct carving on her arm. That's all I can tell you.
records.zh: 你刚才的问题……交易地点就在封存地，离这不远，样貌……是一位脸色苍白的罗伊族女学生，手臂上有刻痕，我只记得这些。

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_2_1
records.text: I've had enough of thillers. How about turning it into a revenge comedy? Picture a knight lost in a forest called Revenge...
records.zh: 悬疑类做腻了啊，不如做成复仇喜剧吧，做一个迷失在名为复仇的森林中的骑士……

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_7_1
records.text: Twenty years ago, it was only through the Enlightened One, Lord Fenrico, that Ragunna was able to survive the Dark Tide.
records.zh: 二十年前的黑潮，正是因为有了神启者芬莱克大人，拉古那才能幸存。

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_7_1
records.text: Devout believers will be protected by Imperator, as Lord Fenrico is the embodiment of the Sentinel's will!
records.zh: 虔诚的信仰者会被英白拉多大人庇佑，芬莱克大人就是岁主意志的延伸！

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_7_1
records.text: Whatever your obsessions or desires may be, as long as you confess to the Sentinel, Lord Fenrico will bring a response!
records.zh: 无论大家有怎样的偏执或心愿，只要肯向岁主告解，芬莱克大人都将带来回应！

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_9_1
records.text: In the third year, I joined The Order. It was through Lord Fenrico's guidance that I was able to understand the Sentinel's benevolence.
records.zh: 第三年起，我加入了修会。正是有了芬莱克大人的点化，我才能够感悟岁主的仁慈。

records.text: They've got Lupa. Honestly, I can't imagine how they'd ever lose.
records.zh: 他们队可是有露帕选手，根本想不到怎么输好吧。

records.text: I told you, go all in on Lupa and you'll cash in big! Lupa the Dupa. She's the best!
records.zh: 早和你说了，买露帕，赚大钱！露帕选手，角斗场里永远的神！

records.text: Hey, brother, do you know how to join Lupa's fan club?
records.zh: 老哥，你有没有什么露帕选手的粉丝俱乐部的加入方式啊？

records.text: I mean, no one would've guessed we'd run into Lupa in the qualifiers...
records.zh: 毕竟谁能想到，我们会在预选赛上遇到露帕选手呢……

records.text: Well, a loss is a loss. Are we that far removed from the greats? What is it that makes Lupa so strong?
records.zh: 输得百口莫辩，这就是我们与天才之间的差距么……露帕选手，到底是因为什么，才能变得那么强啊。

records.text: Relax. We didn't lose to just some ordinary noob. Lupa is heading for the bigger stages. She'll become the strongest Gladiator there is.
records.zh: 放心吧。我们并没有输给什么随处可见的普通人。露帕选手会走向更大的舞台，她将成为最强的角斗士。

records.text: Don't stress over it. There's only one Lupa in all of Septimont. Losing to her is just something you have to accept.
records.zh: 别想太多了，整个七丘也只有那么一位露帕啊，输给她，也是没办法的事。

records.text: I wish they'd build a fancy place like this back in Huanglong.
records.zh: 如果能在瑝珑也盖这样一个高档会所就好了。

records.text:
A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks. 
 
They say to record all your ideas—you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp. 
 
But of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?
records.zh:
釉瑚随身携带的小册子，记录着她的打油诗的灵感痕迹与好诗精选。
书到用时方恨少，点子也一样！正所谓台上一分钟，台下十年功……为了将那些经她鉴定的古物用有趣的方式记下来，也为了能在恰到好处的时候摇头晃脑吟诗一首，日常的积累是必不可少的。
当然，这就是釉瑚不足为外人道的秘密了。

records.text:
An ice mask conjured by Youhu's Forte. The design differs from the original, but the sly grin on the mask mirrors Youhu's own when she's scheming up some mischief. 
 
Youhu often toys with this mask in her spare time, keeping it as a reminder of how she was nearly deceived when appraising the original antique early in her career. 
 
Beyond serving as a cautionary symbol, it's also the perfect prop for giving people a good scare or pulling a fast one on those who catch her interest.
records.zh:
一枚由共鸣能力化出的冰制青铜面具，样式和当初经釉瑚手的正品有所区别，正露出和釉瑚想鬼点子时相似的笑容。
釉瑚时常将它拿在手中把玩欣赏，这是她入行之后险些打眼的一件古物，给那时的小釉瑚留下了极为深刻的印象。
除了提醒自己干活时谨慎判断外，有时候她也会忽然将它遮在脸前，用以吓唬和捉弄那些感兴趣的对象。

records.text:
A jade ring once cracked, now repaired by Youhu with her cryogenic Forte.
 
Once lost in the chaos of a fire, this family heirloom has finally found its way back to Youhu after an arduous search spanning miles. She still dreams of the old days—the gentle breeze from her mother's fan, the sound of her father brewing tea. When she wakes, she often finds the Ruyi ring clutched in her hand.
 
Ruyi, a symbol of peace and happiness, is believed to grant one's wishes. To Youhu, it's more than just an antique.
records.zh:
曾一度碎裂过的如意环，如今已经被釉瑚的凝冰能力重新修复。
这枚传家宝在火光和混乱中与她失散，她远渡万里，才终于重新将它寻回。后来，釉瑚有时做梦，会梦到母亲给她摇扇子的风声，以及父亲给茶壶添水的声音。醒来后，才察觉到自己握着如意环睡着了。
如意，如意，圆满如意，顺遂平安。

records.text:
Ever since Lupa's parents severed ties with her, their faces began to blur from her memory.

What lingers is the way they used to reminisce about their days on Capitoline Hill, far from the small village she called home. They had once borne the name Silva, until they were cast out, shamed by defeat in the arena. From then on, their lives were marked by regret, hardship, and finger-pointing. 

And yet, when they heard Lupa had won her first match, they still went to the blacksmith and had this medal forged, a gift to commemorate her victory.
records.zh:
如今露帕对父母的记忆已经非常模糊，彼此间的联系也早已因为他们的断绝而失去。
她只记得他们时常在故乡的小村庄里谈论卡庇托山城……他们属于西尔瓦家的旁支，早在多年前就因为赛场失利而被迫离开那座美丽的都城。他们经常发愁，为了如今的落魄而叹气，为了生计而奔波，经常吵架，经常互相指责。
但即便如此，他们也曾在露帕第一次赢下比赛时，拜托铁匠打造了一枚小小的徽章，以祝贺她的胜利。

records.chapter: 嘉贝莉娜档案_珍贵之物
