records.text:
The "first bullet" condensed from Galbrena's own blood. Her gift to you.
 
During her travels in the Lawless Zone of the New Federation, Galbrena encountered a secret association and learned a brutal technique known as the Blood Pact. Its practitioners were either fugitives with no path back, or those like her, already bound by darkness. Each had chosen the Way of the Hunter for their own reasons, seeking only to deliver a single, deadly strike at the most unforeseen moment. Galbrena mastered the art quickly. Her results were more extraordinary than most—her blood had long since burned like fire. She was already well accustomed to walking this path.
 
Every hunter who swore the Blood Pact carried such a bullet, known as the "First Blood Pact." An old saying among them was, "The bullet bears your name." It was a mark of resolve to hunt their prey to the bitter end. Yet in the Lawless Zone, where allies could turn to enemies in an instant, genuine bonds of trust became precious. From this was born the Rite of Covenant. Though Galbrena herself never performed it, she still remembers its weight and meaning.
 
When a hunter offers their First Blood Pact to another, they carve the recipient's name upon it. The simplest, yet most binding and ancient contract: to become {Male=his;Female=her} bullet. To never betray. To never flee. Not until the blood runs dry and the fire burns to ash.
records.zh:
嘉贝莉娜利用血液凝聚而成的“第一颗子弹”，如今她已将其赠送予你。

在旧日新联邦的“无法之地”游历时，她于一处秘密结社，习得了这项名为“血誓”的“残忍技艺”。学习者或是走投无路的亡命之徒，或是与她相同的沾染黑暗之人。出于各种缘由，他们选择了这样一条“猎人之道”，只求在对抗邪恶的仇敌时，能够以最意想不到的方式发出最致命的一击。嘉贝莉娜学习得很快，成果也更为显著——她的血液早已化作烈火，她也早已熟稔于这条道路。
而作出血誓的猎人们，都会拥有这样一颗子弹，它也被称作“最初的血誓”。在他们之间，还有一句俗语广为流传：“子弹上刻着你的名字”，象征着他们至死追杀猎物的决心。只是，在那时的无法之地，昔日盟友化作仇敌不过瞬息，而这些离群索居者，通常更为珍视同道之人，为此，他们曾发明了一种“誓盟仪式”……嘉贝莉娜未曾缔结盟约，却仍旧记得那仪式与意义。
当一位猎人将“最初的血誓”赠予出去时，也会在其上刻下受赠者的名字——这即是那最为简易，却永不磨灭的古老盟约：她将化作{TA}的子弹，永不背叛，永不弃逃，直至鲜血干涸，烈火燃烬。

records.text: Calcharo's nameplate from his childhood. It has lost its original color due to rust, all that remains visible are the rusty carvings of a dog. The markings appear to have been crudely drawn by a child.
records.zh:
卡卡罗从儿时保留至今的铭牌，锈蚀的痕迹早已令其失去了原有的色彩，只能隐约看出其上刻有的恶犬形象。
笔迹稚嫩，似是孩童所刻。

records.text:
For Calcharo, it's a life-saving treasure. 
It's rough, but it's good for the stomach. 
In the case of extreme hunger, no matter what flavor you eat, it will feel like a heavenly delicacy. 
Pungent, braised, spicy... According to him, the canned rations produced in Huanglong are a bit tastier than the ones from other regions.
records.zh:
对于卡卡罗而言，这可是能够救命的宝贝。
虽然粗糙，但胜在果腹。
在极度饥饿的情况下，无论吃到何种风味，都会感觉是天赐的美味。
辛香、红烧、麻辣……卡卡罗还是觉得，瑝珑生产的罐头，要比其他地区生产的都要好吃一些。

records.text:
A short sword that Calcharo has carried since childhood. 
It was there when he first rose to fame as the vicious Underdog. 
Unfortunately, it was broken in an unknown encounter. 
Calcharo doesn't like to talk about the battle, but sometimes you can catch him touching the broken blade as a way to remember those who died and a time that has passed.
records.zh:
与卡卡罗一同出生入死，携带至今的短刀。
曾与卡卡罗一齐被冠以了“恶犬”的威名。 
遗憾的是，拥有如此盛名的獠牙， 
最终却折断于一场不为人知的交锋里。 
那场战斗的细节，卡卡罗想必不愿轻易提及，只是偶尔能看见他轻柔抚拭着断裂的獠牙，好像在祭奠某位消逝的故人，又好像在祭奠某段消逝的过去。

records.text: Dried fish made from Tetra. The fish is usually brought to Yuanwu Boxing Gym by Lingyang, as a thank-you to Mimi for "sparring" with him. When Mimi can't finish her fish, Yuanwu dries it out for future use.
records.zh: 由群彩制成的小鱼干。群彩几乎都是凌阳带来的，作为找小咪“切磋”的报酬。渊武会收起小咪吃不完的群彩，制成方便保存的小鱼干。

records.text:
The secret of Leihuangquan lies in the good control of power and balancing combat with mindful self-care. The deadlier the strike, the greater the devotion to health.
That's why Yuanwu always carries a flask with him during his daily activities. Some say it contains his secret potion for staying fit, but in reality, it's usually just ordinary hot water.
records.zh:
雷煌拳讲究收放自如，力量循环之道。挥拳时有多刚猛，平日的保养就得有多悉心。
所以，拳馆的渊武老板经常随身携带着一个保温杯。
据说，这里面装着不可言说的养身秘诀……其实大多数时候，就是平平无奇的热水啦。

records.text:
Many have wondered whether the Master Exorcist's tinted sunglasses hold any special powers—blocking disturbances, perhaps? Or identifying demons and deities?

When Buling finally bought this stylish pair in a bustling store, she just wanted another shiny accessory to brighten her look. Still, somewhere deep down, she might have desired such speculations. After all, it's the fanciful meanings people project onto an object that make it worth more than its price.
records.zh:
人们经常猜测“驱鬼大师”这副特殊颜色的墨镜有什么神奇的功能，是能隔绝外界干扰？还是能分辨神鬼？
当她在琳琅满目的商店里挑挑选选，最终买下这件潮流靓丽的装饰品时，除了是因为她喜欢身上亮闪闪的感觉，所期望的或许也包括人们的那些想象。毕竟，有时人们的想象早已超越了物品本身的价值。

records.text:
On her first few trips down the mountain, Buling used to stuff her talismans into her pockets, only to pull them out all wrinkled when it came time to fight. Sometimes they even scattered across the ground, leaving her scrambling in a panic to gather them up during a fight.

To save herself from further embarrassment, she repurposed a charming little casket she found, refitting it to hold an entire stack of talismans and adding a few convenient extras: navigation, feng shui reading, and fortune-telling. As for what the casket originally carried, well… probably bubble gum.
records.zh:
刚下山游历时，卜灵总是把符箓皱皱巴巴叠起来放在衣兜里，紧急情况想拿出来使用，却总是手忙脚乱撒得一地都是，经常在敌人面前狼狈捡拾。
为了不让自己继续丢面子，她在一个称手的容器上进行了一些改造，让它既能分辨四方，判断风水与吉凶，还可以存储大量符箓，方便抽出取用。至于这个容器一开始是什么，似乎是……泡泡糖盒子。

records.text: As Buling grew older and her Forte matured, the noises in her ears grew sharper, impossible to ignore. Beyond the temple's walls, she couldn't keep chanting to hold them back the way she could in quiet practice. The relentless clamor gnawed at her mind. Then one day, dazed and aching after dragging someone out of a swarm of Tacet Discords, that person gently placed a Huaxu Academy's invention on her head. In that instant, her world fell completely silent.
records.zh: 耳朵听到的杂音随着她的年龄增长与共鸣能力的成熟越来越清晰。出门在外，她无法和在道馆中静心修行时一样，时时刻刻念咒保持耳边清净。那些杂乱的声音不断扰乱她的精神，在痛苦而恍惚的状态下从残象群中救下一人后，那人将自己在研究院的成果戴在了她的头上。那一刻，整个世界都安静了下来。

records.text:
Upon meeting the Second Seal, Suoming asked him to forge her a mechanical weapon. The Second Seal first proposed twin blades or a sword, arguing that shaping it as a standard weapon first would allow ten thousand variations to flower from its form. But Suoming simply replied: "An umbrella would be best." The Second Seal mused in silence, and at last understood. Against the Evil Miasma that came howling with wind and rain, Huating needed an umbrella to shield its people from the storm.

Thus was born the mechanical umbrella that would one day be known as Nine Shadows. Capable of shifting at will into weapons both long and short, it breaks apart into a rain of fine hidden darts to strike distant foes, or unfolds into an impenetrable shield against ferocious assaults. Its hundred mechanisms and thousand transformations stand ready to answer every hardship.
records.zh:
与二契相识后，锁暝请他打造一件机关兵器。二契起初提议双刀、剑等。先以武器为形，再于其上衍化万般变化，锁暝却只答“伞便是最好”。二契沉思片刻，终是会意。面对卷来狂风骤雨的「恶瘴」，华亭当有一伞，为众人遮风蔽雨。
于是，一柄日后被唤作「九方故影」的机关伞应运而生。它可随心化作长短兵器，亦能分解为细小暗器远袭敌手，或展开为坚盾抵御攻势，由此百机，千变，应万难。

records.text:
A bamboo flask Qiuyuan often carries, crafted from black bamboo native to Chongzhou. Its natural fragrance has long faded, replaced by the lingering scent of the medicinal decoction it always contains.

When Qiuyuan once teetered on the brink of death, a doctor from Chongzhou saved him with a potent regimen. While he recovered, his Forte did not, though it can be temporarily restored to full strength with the decoction in this flask. Yet even this power serves only as an embellishment to the already refined swordplay he takes pride in.
records.zh:
仇远随身携带的竹筒，由重州特有的黑竹制作，不过似乎是因为常年装着药液的缘由，已经闻不到原本应有的竹香，只有浓重的药香。
那位重州的郎中下猛药将他从阎王手里勾回，他也因此落下共鸣力微弱的病根，必须服用这种特殊的药液才能全然使出自己的力量，只不过对他来说，那力量也不过是他引以为傲的剑技的添头罢了。

records.text:
A token of Mingting's Internal Security Agency that Qiuyuan always carries. It should have been confiscated along with his uniform after he left the service, yet someone within Mingting ensured he kept it.

"…I hereby entrust this to you. Let all officials of every state know: whoever bears this token carries my presence."
records.zh:
仇远平日佩戴的明庭镇抚司信物，按理他早就应该褪下这身公服，信物也应被没收。只是似乎因为有人在明庭暗中帮了他一把，最终让他留下了这一切。
“……我将剑交到你们手中，百官各州，凡见此物，如同见我。”

records.text:
He came to know the world through his ears, not his eyes.

The weary sighs of his parents, the whispers of wind coming from Chongzhou's hollow bamboos, the clash of blades, the drop of his master's blood, the furious cries of his foes...

And then, in Mingting, he heard light, but also the shadows lurking beneath it. He heard the greedy begging for mercy. He heard schemes snarled with lies. He heard resentment and hope spoken in another kind of voice.

He cannot see, yet he hears all things clearly and inevitably. They are already there before the sounds ever reach him, as natural as iron becoming a sword, jade slumbering within stone, or music waiting in the heart of a bamboo flute.
records.zh:
他对于这个世界的第一印象，不是眼看的，而是听到的。
他听到父母的无奈，听到重州山林中无数毛竹的空洞，听到刀和剑，听到师父的血，听到仇人的怒号。
后来，他听到光亮，听到明庭里数不清的明争暗斗，听到贪官墨吏的告饶，听到一场阴谋，听到另一种仇恨和希望。
他看不到，但他一切都听得清楚。因为有许多声音，在他听到时，它就已经在那里了。如同剑生于铁，玉生于石，音生于竹。

records.text: Verina cherishes her Pioneer Association expedition goggles, remnants of a journey and warm memories like Starflower. Now useless for danger detection, they hold sentimental value to her.
records.zh: 在先行公约时，探险队配发的护目镜，可以监测周围环境是否危险，现在已经不能使用了，但维里奈一直好好收藏。因为这代表着一段生活，一段旅途，一段星星花一样的温暖回忆。

records.text:
"The weight of Jinzhou is far beyond what a model can carry, but you can feel the weight of guarding Jinzhou up close by purchasing a Guardian Wall model." 
The Ministry of Development partnered with a toy company to create this model, rumored to be a limited first edition obtained personally by Taoqi from a revered toy mogul.
records.zh:
“今州之重，远非模型可以承载，但您却可以通过购买守护壁模型，来近距离感受守护今州的重量。”
天工和玩具公司联合推出的文创产品，据说这是桃祈从某玩具大亨的手里直接拿到的初版。

records.text: The data module for Terminal loading contains Taoqi's observations and thoughts on Jinzhou, from her childhood musings to her current decisions to protect the city. Every detail has been meticulously documented in this small but powerful device. Perhaps one day, it will alter the fate of Jinzhou.
records.zh: 用于终端加载的数据模组，其中存放着桃祈对今州的所有观察和思考。从幼时在脑海中浮现的一个个不成熟的点子，到决定守护这一城人民后，深思熟虑无数次才落到笔端的一个个决策，桃祈将一切都记录在这个小小的数据模组上。也许未来有一天，这个不起眼的模组会改变整个今州。

records.text: Taoqi always longs to catch a nice, peaceful nap during her free time. The soft and plush Peachy Turtle becomes her haven, a paradise that washes away all fatigue accumulated from work.  "If I could live a slow-paced life just like the Peachy Turtle, and still be a reliable support for everyone, that would be perfect."
records.zh:
闲余时间能美美地睡上一觉是桃祈平日里反复念叨的愿望。
软绵绵的桃桃龟成了包容她一切的乐园与天堂。
“如果能像桃桃龟一样慢悠悠地生活，而又能成为大家安心的依靠就好了。”

records.chapter: 釉瑚档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
The waveform graph for Resonator Youhu shows a non-periodic rectangular pulse fluctuation for once, with sustained peak values during specific time intervals before a gradual decrease. These waveforms currently display clear sinusoidal fluctuations. Both the upper and lower peak values are low.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Youhu's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking.

Regular physical check-ups are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.
records.zh:
受试样本波形检验呈现单次非周期性矩形脉冲波动，峰值维持一定时间，后续平稳下降，当前规律性正弦形波动，上下峰值较低，波形清晰。
诊断结果：当前超频临界值较高，稳定性较高，超频风险较小。
无过往超频史。
建议按时进行定期检查，暂无需心理辅导。

records.chapter: 釉瑚档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment RA1013-G]

Resonator Youhu's Awakening occurred three years prior, with early manifestations observed during childhood. The Awakening was accompanied by symptoms of hypothermia induced by prolonged exposure to low-temperature environments.

Youhu's Tacet Mark is located on her upper left arm. Snowflake patterns have been observed on the forearms. Temperature readings indicate these patterns are below 0°C. The texture remains largely unchanged, though a slight presence of micro-crystalline particles has been detected upon tactile examination.

Youhu demonstrates the ability to replicate antiques using ice, achieved through resonation with the frequencies of said objects. However, detailed data collection has been hindered by the subject's unpredictable and uncooperative nature.

Youhu's Resonance Spectrum closely aligns with that of the Ruyi Ring, indicating strong Syntony reactions. 

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a steep rise in its middle section. Therefore, Youhu is classified as a Mutant Resonator.
records.zh:

通过与古物频率共鸣，可凝冰造物，复刻古物的造型，因对象思维跳脱，配合度欠佳，具体数值尚无定论。

records.chapter: 绯雪档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text: Hailing from Ashinohara, the Miko of Flaming Sakura now remains in Lahai-Roi as the last and only member of the Special Response Force.
records.zh: 来自苇原的灼樱巫女，现今以特别对策组唯一成员的身份在拉海洛停留。

records.chapter: 绯雪档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
The subject's Rabelle's Waveform diagram exhibits an elliptical oscillation pattern with a stable Time Domain representation. No abnormal fluctuations were observed. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters. 
 
Current Overclocking threshold is exceptionally high, and subject stability remains robust. There is no risk of Overclocking, and the subject has no prior history of Overclocking. However, a course of psychological intervention is recommended.
 
"This miko... How should I put this..."
"Ashinohara textbooks never show her face, but they're clear about one thing. She is the strongest living warrior in all of Ashinohara."
"And yet, with all that combat, her readings stay perfectly stable. Something about that just doesn't sit right..."
"I get your concern, but the data is clear. There's not a single irregularity."
"...Then what about those shadows? Like parallel-universe versions of herself from some movie?"
"Hardly. It must be the Suzu's power. Just as the Ashinohara records describe, it allows her to 'draw upon the future' to a certain extent."
records.zh:
受试样本拉贝尔波形检测图呈椭圆形波动，时域表示稳定，未见任何异常波动倾向。检测结果判断为正常阶段。
当前超频临界值极高，稳定性高，绝无超频风险，无过往超频史。
但仍需一定心理干预。

“这位巫女大人……怎么说呢……”
“虽然苇原的课本上没把样貌画上去，但明白地写着呢，苇原当世最强嘛。”
“在高频次战斗的前提下，还能保持稳定，总觉得不太对劲……”
“我懂你的疑虑，但测试数据一丁点儿问题都没有。”
“……那些影子算什么？电影里拍的那种平行世界的自己？”
“怎么可能，应该是那「铃」的力量，就像苇原记录的那样，能在一定程度上预取未来。”

records.chapter: 绯雪档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
[Spacetrek Collective: Classified Archive]

Interview Dossier: Hiyuki

Due to multifaceted considerations, we have foregone a truly comprehensive evaluation of the representative from Ashinohara—the Miko of Flaming Sakura.
The majority of the intelligence gathered herein is based on her personal testimony. In the recorder's professional estimation, corroborated through subsequent cross-referencing, she appears to harbor no intention of concealing any information regarding her background.
"After all, information regarding the 'Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura' can be found in just about any Ashinohara elementary school textbook..."
 
According to Hiyuki's own account, the source of her Forte is the "Suzu," a Legacy Talisman worn on her right wrist.
Hiyuki describes the Suzu as follows: It grants the bearer the ability to perceive and utilize "future possibilities" of oneself, though it does not allow for direct communication with these "shadows of future possibility."
The freezing power she often wields in combat also stems from the "Suzu."
"Verified via official Ashinohara reports: The Legacy Talismans are five relics left behind by the Sentinels, distributed among the internal factions of Ashinohara for safekeeping."
"Among them, the Suzu is described as granting its bearer the power to 'draw upon the future.'"
 
Consequently, it is determined that the fundamental source of her exceptional combat prowess remains her own inherent skill.
However, the "futures" available for her to draw upon are not infinite. Out of concern for her physiological lifespan, aggressive deployment of her abilities is strongly advised against.
"Investigation confirms that every Miko of Flaming Sakura has shared a singular cause of death: vanishing from the battlefield without a trace following excessive use of the Suzu."
records.zh:
「调自深空联合：保密档案」
「访谈报告记录：绯雪」
出于多方考量，我们并未对苇原的代表，即灼樱巫女，进行真正深入的完整测试。
大部分情报都由她本人自述，从记录者本人的经验，及多方查证后来看，她无意隐藏关于自身的任何情报。
“毕竟关于这位「永世灼樱巫女」的情报，随便一本苇原小学教材上都翻得到……”

据她本人所说，其特殊能力的共鸣源，是她佩戴在右手手腕处，被称为“颂物”的「铃」。
绯雪本人对「铃」的描述为：能够通过它看到未来自身的可能性，并加以利用，但无法做到与“未来可能性的影子”沟通。
她通常战斗中所使用的冰结能力，也是从「铃」中取得的一部分。
“据苇原官方报告核实，颂物是岁主留下的五种物品，分别交由苇原内部势力保管。”
“其中，关于「铃」的描述为‘预取未来’。”

因此，判断其卓绝战斗能力的根本来源，仍然是她自身。
但供她预取的未来总有尽头，出于对她自身寿命的考虑，仍不建议过于激进地使用能力。
“据查证，历代灼樱巫女的死因都只有一条，在战斗中过于激进地使用「铃」而凭空在战场上消失。”

records.chapter: 穗穗档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text: Born into a noble family of Mingting, she is the brilliant young director of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. Wielding a water fan, she weaves business deals into a grand tapestry of trade. records.chapter: 莫特斐档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告

records.chapter: 卡卡罗档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2300-G]

The Time of Awakening for Resonator Calcharo remains unclear. According to Calcharo's report, he endured extended periods in hostile environments and faced numerous life-threatening situations. As a result, his Forte naturally awakened as a means of self-protection.

Resonator Calcharo's Tacet Mark is located on his forehead. When Calcharo activates his Forte, a golden core manifests on his chest. Concurrently, various parts of his body display characteristics of Tacet Discords, entangled with shadow-like thorns.

Notably, Calcharo's body possesses a significantly higher amount of bioelectrical energy compared to the average human. He demonstrates exceptional awareness of and control over electric currents and magnetic forces.

The exact cause of Resonator Calcharo's Awakening cannot be identified at the moment, as his Spectrum Pattern does not show similarity to any known samples.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a gradual rise. Resonator Calcharo is thereby classified as a Natural Resonator.

“有一种已知事物的频率波动区间，是与他的频谱检验图最为接近的。我们都漏掉了，或者说，是我们根本不敢想象这种可能。”

records.chapter: 仇远档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
Miscellaneous Records of Mingting's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs: Correspondence Collection

…In my recent observations over the past few days, it appears less that he refuses to employ his Forte and more that he consciously restrains himself from using it. Regarding the nature of the ability itself, he remains decidedly reserved. Only from the Academy's report may one glean a few particulars:

Test subject waveform analysis presents an elliptical oscillation. Time-domain readings are stable, with no anomalous patterns observed.
Resonant Criticality: High. Stability is high with no risk of Overclocking. 
No prior history of Overclocking. Psychological intervention is deemed unnecessary.
Note: The subject admits to repeated offenses involving violent breaches of the law, though his demeanor was notably composed. It is recommended that these claims should be verified by the Ministry of Justice and local authorities in Chongzhou.

…Yet, in my own assessment, this man harbors no murderous intent. His composure is unwavering, his demeanor steady. His swordsmanship is among the finest, and few in all of Mingting could rival him. He could have been a remarkable asset to the Internal Security Agency. That such an individual is listed in the Justice Commission's dossiers as a perpetrator of unlawful violence is difficult to believe. I have already communicated with the Ministry of Rites, outlining the advantages and implications of recruiting said individual. Should you wish to employ this man, I expect no obstacle shall arise on that account.

Dongyuan's annotation: Naturally, the steadier the better. But judging from this report... isn't this lad a little too devoid of emotion?
records.zh:
「明庭谛天鉴监正杂录——书信编」
……数日以来，以弟观之，与其说他不使用共鸣能力，不如说他始终刻意制压自己不去使用它。而关于这能力本身，他自己三缄其口，只能从研究院的报告中略窥一二：
受试人员波形检测呈现椭圆形波动，时域表示稳定，未见异常波形。
当前超频临界值极高，稳定性高，无超频风险。
无过往超频史，无需心理辅导……
备注：受试人员自述曾多有犯案，以武犯禁，而语气极为平静，建议刑部并重州地方查明。
……然而我看此人似无杀意，镇浮沉静，而其剑术之高超，遍观明庭，少有敌手，可为镇抚司栋梁。竟有三法司案卷所载以武犯禁情事，实难置信。弟已秉呈礼部，陈明利害，东园兄若用此人， 想必于礼部处并无大碍。
——东园注：超频这种事，自然是越稳定越好，不过这报告看着，是不是有点太波澜不惊了……

records.chapter: 仇远档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
records.text:
Miscellaneous Records of Mingting's Minister of Sentinel Affairs: Correspondence Collection

My dear friend Dongyuan,

A few days prior, the Internal Security Agency forwarded documents from the Justice Commission and the Huaxu Academy to the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. Without delay, I instructed the Chongzhou official to assist in the matter and thoroughly examine the local Resonator register. It has now been confirmed that the individual in question has no connection with the Sentinel or the Threnodian of Chongzhou.

According to the Ministry's records, this individual has been a Resonator for over fifteen years. Described as one who "sees the world through bamboos and hides his blade within them," he is blind yet wields a remarkable ability known as Mindsight. Through this power, he perceives his surroundings through a "bamboo forest" in his mind, enabling him to discern opponents' intentions and vulnerabilities. He can even manifest the Mindsight into tangible illusions. This is not a person to be underestimated.

Moreover, his swordsmanship appears to stem chiefly from personal skill rather than his Resonance Ability. Observations indicate that he consistently restrains the use of his Resonance power. He claims that the bamboo flask he carries contains a concoction—prepared by a wandering healer in Chongzhou—that stimulates his Mindsight and Forte, and is used only when necessary. This matter may be forwarded to the Academy for further analysis.

As for the detailed test data, please await the Academy's formal report...

Dongyuan's annotation: Simply ensure this is recorded clearly. We follow the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs's judgment… My my, Lin still writes with his characteristic formality.
records.zh:
「明庭谛天鉴监正杂录——书信编」
东园兄台钧鉴，前日镇抚司转三法司并华胥研究院行文谛天鉴，弟便立刻责成重州州监协办，清点重州共鸣者名录，现已查明此人和重州岁主鸣式并无关联。
据谛天鉴查，此人共鸣史距今十五年有余，即所谓“成竹于胸，裁竹为锋”，虽双眼不能视物，却有“心镜”，能透过心中具象化的“竹林”感知到外界的事物，勘破对手的心境和破绽，甚至能将“心镜”外化成虚景，不容小觑。
另外，他的剑术似乎更源自于他自身的技艺而非来自于共鸣能力，能很明显地感觉到，他无时无刻不在克制着自己的共鸣能力。据他自己说，那随身的竹壶中装着一种能够催动他“心镜”和共鸣力的药液，据说是重州一位江湖郎中所配，只在必要时才会饮用。关于此事，兄可另行转交研究院解析其成分。
至于此人详细的测试数据，兄可静候研究院报告……
——东园注：正式报告登记明白就好，一切都以谛天鉴的意思为准……哎，老林他还是这么说话文绉绉的。

records.text:
Speaking of how Lingyang came to join the Liondance Troupe, we have to go back to that "ordinary" day when a Liondance performance at the Jinzhou Theater had just concluded. As the staff were busy tidying up the stage props, a strange-looking youth dropped from the roof. To be more precise, it wasn't a mere "drop"; it was more like a "crash".

As it turned out, this was a carefully orchestrated accident. Lingyang had planned to approach the Liondance Troupe in advance. However, what he hadn't accounted for was the fact that rooftops, especially after a bout of rain, proved to be much slipperier than tree branches.

Back then, Lingyang, who hadn't fully mastered human language yet, didn't even possess a name. He was simply referred to as the "little guy" by the members of the Liondance Troupe for a long time.

Despite Lingyang's best efforts, he could not communicate with the troupe's staff. So, he resorted to a clumsy liondance performance using a head found elsewhere. 

Whenever the troupe members reminisced about this moment, they chuckled and commented that it seemed more like Lingyang was showing off his claws and teeth rather than performing a traditional liondance. 

While his intentions were understood, his unusual appearance sparked heated discussions among the troupe.

In the end, it was the oldest members, Mr. Wufang and Mr. Qixing, addressed as "Masters" even by the current leaders of the Liondance Troupe, who decided to take Lingyang in.

Lingyang has tried many times to inquire about the reasons for taking him in, but all he gets are vague responses:

"Haha, maybe it's because your ears and tail resemble those of the legendary auspicious lions."

Occasionally, during the master's nap, Lingyang overhears some sleep talk, "'Big Lion'... I did it... My promise..."

Under the guidance of this master, Lingyang has embarked on a formal journey of learning: delving into lion dancing, calligraphy, and learning how to interact with human beings.

To help Lingyang control the brutal force within his body, he was taught a set of ancient steps from Huanglong, believed to regulate energy flow and serve as the foundation for lion dancing. With diligent practice, Lingyang officially earned the title of "Lion Head."

In Jinzhou, the term "Lion Head" carries multiple meanings. For ordinary people, it can refer to the "liondance head" used in the performance, or the lead performer. While for the Liondancers, it refers to a shared dream — the aspiration to become the "head of lions" through diligent practice and perfected lion dancing skills.

"I was born with this strength and honed my hunting skills in the wild. However, liondancing is more than just pure strength—posture, steps, rhythm, coordination with teammates... It's not something that can be learned overnight. My master emphasizes how lion dancing means a lot to the Jinzhou people, and I can't help but worry that I might not be meeting their expectations. To live up to the title 'Lion Head', I know I've got to put in more work."

According to his masters, Lingyang isn't just talented. More importantly, he possesses an insatiable desire for progress.

With each new move mastered and every practice session lasting until the sky was cloaked in stars, Lingyang stood atop the Plum Blossom Pole in the Central Plains. He gazed at his reflection in the water, as if contemplating or challenging his limits. Amidst falling petals, the young Lion Head danced passionately on the poles, creating a unique spectacle in the region.
records.zh:
说到凌阳与瑞狮团的缘分，还要追溯到那一天——某日，今州剧院的狮子舞表演结束，工作人员趁着夜色收拾道具时，一个模样奇怪的少年从房顶上掉了下来……比“掉”更准确的，应该是“砸”。
这是一场预谋好的意外。预谋的部分在于凌阳本就决心和瑞狮团打交道，意外之处是他没意识到下雨后的人类屋顶要比树木光滑太多。
于是，对人类语言尚不精通的凌阳……嗯，那时候的凌阳还没有名字，在很长一段时间里，他都在被瑞狮团的成员们以“小家伙”相称。
总之，对人类语言尚不精通的“小家伙”，在发现与众人沟通无果后，不知从哪搬来一个狮头，在众人面前，笨拙地开始了他不知从何处学来的狮舞。
每当后来瑞狮团成员们回忆起那场表演，大家都不约而同地摸了摸后脑勺：“与其说那是狮子舞，倒不如说用‘张牙舞爪’来形容才对……”
幸好凌阳想要留下来的意图还是传达了出来，但他那副奇怪的模样，也是让瑞狮团的成员们对此展开了一番激烈的探讨。
最后拍板，决定收留凌阳的，是瑞狮团资历最为古老的一位先生，现今瑞狮会馆“五方”和“七星”两位执掌先生都得尊称一声“师父”的存在。
凌阳曾不止一次尝试询问过师父收留自己的原因，但得到的都是些模棱两可的回答：
“哈哈，可能是因为，你的耳朵和尾巴，和传说中的‘瑞狮’很像吧。“
偶尔，凌阳也会在师父午憩时，从他的口中听到一些喃喃的梦呓：”‘大狮子’……对你的承诺……我兑现了……”
在这位师父的引导下，凌阳正式开始了自己的修行之路：舞狮，习字，以及，如何与人打交道。
为了帮助凌阳控制体内那股横冲直撞的野蛮力量，师父也将一套从瑝珑古时流传下来的古老步伐传授给了凌阳，据说其有着辅助调节人体能量运转的神奇功效。而这套步伐，也正是狮子舞的基本功之一。入门之后，凌阳正式成为了一名“狮首”。
在今州，“狮首”一词有着许多重含义。对于普通人而言，“狮首”一词既可指代舞狮时所用的“狮头”，亦可用于称谓台上扮演“狮首”之人。而对于舞狮之人而言，这一词则指向了所有舞狮之人的共通理想——勤修苦练，精益求精，直待某日技盖天下，名扬四海，成为真正的“万狮之首”。
“我的力量是与生俱来的，在野外也磨练出了不少狩猎技巧。可原来舞狮需要的不仅仅是力气，身形、步伐、节奏、与队友的配合……这可不是一朝一夕就能学成的。师傅总是说，狮舞对于今州人而言意义重大，我也担心会让观众们的期待落空，为了不辱‘狮首’的名号，必须要更加努力才行。”
在师父眼中，凌阳是富有灵性的，但更重要的，是他那永不止息的进步欲。
动作一学是循环往复，练习一始便披星戴月。
中曲台地的梅花桩上，凌阳时常会望着水中的倒影，似在思考，又似是在和自己较劲。
桃华簌簌而落，年少的狮首在桩阵上踏花而行，热烈起舞。这也成为了中曲台地中一番别样的风景。

records.text:
One cannot mention Central Plains without bringing up the Liondance Troupe's annual winter training.

During the winter off-season, the Liondance Troupe gathers in Taoyuan Vale for intensive training at their grounds. This preparation is vital for their upcoming performance at the "New Year Parade," a highly significant event in Jinzhou that symbolizes bidding farewell to the old year and welcoming the new. Despite the off-season, the troupe is hard at work refining characters, honing skills, crafting props, and rehearsing new performances. Leisure is not an option during this crucial time. On the other hand, since they are leaving city for the wilderness, Lingyang gets the chance to embrace his nature.

Even in the winter chill, Lingyang's inherent liveliness keeps him active, much like the fierce beasts inhabiting the nearby mountains. 

As snow blankets the world, these creatures eagerly hunt for their prey. Whenever Lingyang heard their growls and distant cries for help, he'd rush into the woods during breaks to deal with the threats. He employed a savage and brutal approach against attacking beasts, tearing them apart with lightning speed.

The rescued were grateful, yet their demeanor showed fear.

Lingyang couldn't help but wonder:

"Are they still afraid of those beasts? Or... Are they worried I might end up tearing them apart too?"

Confronted with people's fear again and again, Lingyang started realizing his differences from humans: his claws and teeth, wielded in the heat of combat, bore a striking resemblance to the very beasts he fought.

Can people really accept this part of him?

Perhaps... He needed to find a more acceptable way to help others, out of kindness at least?

Soon, a rumor began circulating in Jinzhou: every winter, a strange creature with a lion head appears to those who cry out for help in the Central Plains.

As people discovered that this mysterious being meant no harm, fear turned into fascination, and the creature became known as a guardian deity, watching over travelers during the cold months.

Well, these are tales for another time. Anyway, Lingyang must now prioritize his master's mood.

Lately, when he's supposed to be at rehearsal, Lingyang is often missing from the gym. The master's angry voice echoes through the valley, startling birds from their rest as he bellows for his wayward student:

"Lingyang? Lingyang! Where has that brat gone off to now?!"
records.zh:
说到中曲台地，就不得不提及瑞狮团每年冬季所必须经历的修行了。
每年冬季是瑞狮团的休演季，瑞狮团会集体前往中曲台地，来到位于桃源乡的演武场闭关修习，为新年的“巡岁”做准备：“狮首”自今州大剧院的舞台处出发，走街串巷，吐福旺场——此举即为“巡岁”。意为与过去一年告别，迎接新年的到来，是今州每年最为盛大的活动之一。
因此，即使是休演季，瑞狮团的各位也并不像一般人想象中那样轻松。他们都需要利用好这段时间打磨心性，精进技艺，制作道具，排演新的剧目……不过，既然离开了城市，到了野外，那就是凌阳的天地了。
天性中的活泼让凌阳即使在冬天也一样闲不下来——山野中的凶怪猛兽亦是如此。每逢雪雾弥漫，蛰伏的野兽便又开始蠢蠢欲动。
异兽的低吼，孱弱的呼救……即便相隔甚远，但只要被凌阳敏锐的耳朵听到，他就一定不会坐视不管。凌阳会瞅准师兄弟们分神或是排练休息的空隙，闪身入林寻找目标，最后从高高的山崖之上一跃而下，用最野蛮、最原始的捕猎手段，风雷般利落地将敌人撕碎。
被救下的路人虽会礼貌地感谢凌阳，但他们脸上显现的，往往是迟迟褪却不去的惊恐。
“是因为刚刚从战斗中脱身，留有后怕……还是，在恐惧我控制不了自己的力量，将他们也一同撕碎？”
在经历了许多次这样的事情之后，凌阳开始意识到并反思自己与人类的不同：当自己的利齿展露，利爪狠狠地刺进敌人心脏，自己和那些野兽又有何区别？
人类……真的能接受自己的这一面吗？
或许，即使是出于善意，自己也应该使用一些更容易让人类接受的方式？
……于是，不知何时，今州城中逐渐兴起了一则怪谈：每年冬季，只要在中曲台地一带大声呼救，就会目睹到一只头戴狮头的奇怪生物，自山林之中全速向你奔来的诡异场面。
在确认了这头“怪物”对人类并无恶意之后，人们也由起初的害怕，逐渐转为了好奇……直到最后，将其视作了冬季过路旅人的守护山神。
不过这些都是后话了。比起这个，或许凌阳应该先关注一下师父他老人家的情绪：每当到了需要凌阳一同排练的时候，演武场中，已经不止一次查无此人了。
一旦到了这时，师父的怒吼就会传响在空谷之中，惊起一片林鸟，有如雄狮咆哮，力压群兽：
“凌阳——！这小子，又跑到哪儿偷懒去了？”

records.text:
On the busiest street in Jinzhou, a small appraisal stall occasionally appears, adding a touch more excitement to the bustling scene.
 
The stall owner is a lively girl Youhu who confidently considers herself a seasoned appraiser. She claims that with just a light touch, she can discern the history behind any antique. Her early career saw just one slip-up—misjudging an ancient Ding. She later purchased it from the client, repaired it with her cryogenic powers, and now keeps it close as a reminder to stay sharp.
 
Despite her playful self-promotion and carefree antics, people don't mind trusting her, especially since her appraisal fees are modest—just the cost of a meal and a sprinkle of compliments.
 
"This folding screen predates Jinzhou, a rare treasure perfectly preserved! You can even call it a witness to Jinzhou's rise and fall!"
 
"The glaze here? Smooth as jade, soft as silk. It's not ancient, but the craftsmanship is definitely worth the price!"
 
Her insights, whether on artistry or historical value, hit the mark every time, earning her the trust of her clients. 
 
Adding to the charm of her appraisals is a unique flair—call it a show, if you will.
 
While others might inspect antiques with magnifying glasses, Youhu examines each piece with lively gestures, reciting witty poems as if she's performing some ancient, mysterious ritual. 
 
Initially, people worried she might accidentally damage their valuables, but after seeing her skills, they've come to embrace her eccentric ways. Perhaps true masters just have their... well, quirks.
records.zh:
今州城里最繁华的街头，偶尔会支起一个鉴宝小摊，让这条长街再增添几分热闹。
摊主名叫釉瑚，按她自己的描述，她已是资深的鉴宝大师，那些被岁月淘洗过的器物，她只消轻轻那么一摩挲，便能窥得磨痕之间流淌的岁月。
据她说，除了刚入行时曾经看错了一尊鼎外，鉴宝一道，她几乎再没出过岔子。而那尊鼎也被她从委托人那里买下，用凝冰之力补好，一直带在身边引以为戒。
这番自吹自擂，加上她吊儿郎当的举止，总有几分江湖骗子的意味，但大家觉得，信她一回也未尝不可，毕竟她的鉴宝费堪称良心。
只需付出一顿饭的钱，并在话语间夹杂几句客套与奉承，便可以呈上手中的器物，让这位釉瑚大师帮你掌掌眼。
“这扇古屏，可是今州建立前的工艺，见证了今州潮起潮落，想不到能保存如此完好，可谓瑰宝啊！”
“釉光温润，如玉如脂，虽然年头不久，但此等工艺，还是值得珍藏的！”
从制作工艺到历史价值，她说得头头是道，大家对她也愈发信服。
何况，鉴宝的过程，还附赠一场妙趣横生的……表演？
别的鉴宝师，都是细细端详，她却不同，一边将古物里里外外看个遍，一边还在手舞足蹈，嘴里念着她胡诌的打油诗，像极了跳大神这类神秘仪式。
起先，大家还怕自己的宝物在她手中有什么闪失，见她未曾失手，才放下心来任她胡闹。或许大师就是会有些怪癖……吧？

records.text:
Youhu always carries a scroll-like box filled with miniature replicas of antiques she's appraised, each crafted with her Forte. These replicas aren't just souvenirs, but handy tools to fend off Tacet Discords. In the summer, they can double as coolers. Just pop some fruit in with an iced replica, and voilà—a chilled snack!
 
Inside the box is also a booklet where she writes limericks about every antique she encounters:
 
"A guy from the Ministry of Development asked me to find that missing enameled porcelain from Huanglong. Noted!"
 
"That merchant definitely got the celadon tripod incense burner through shady means! I hinted he should return it, but who knows if he'll listen. Better keep an eye on him."
 
"That carpenter at the city gate is chopping wood with a centuries-old knife! The audacity! What a disgrace! I'll... let it slide this time. Just need to tell him the knife's true worth later."
 
These interesting notes help keep her memories fresh.
 
Take that merchant with the incense burner. After weeks of strange events and sleepless nights, he recalled the street appraiser's warning:
 
"Haiya, that incense burner's from a bad place! Your luck won't hold up against it—misfortune's coming your way!"
 
She had said it with such flair, like a storyteller spinning a tall tale. The merchant hadn't taken her seriously at first, but his recent misfortunes made him reconsider.

One night, after the fifteenth eerie shadow flitted outside his window with its bone-chilling shriek, he rushed to return the stolen burner.
 
Had he dared to look up, he might have seen another scene unfolding: 

The Patrollers had spotted a suspicious figure on the rooftops and moved in to question them.

Youhu, dressed in a makeshift disguise, saw the guards approaching and fled, stumbling a few times along the way.
 
Even as she ran, she managed to jot down in her booklet: "Celadon tripod incense burner, returned to its rightful place."
records.zh:
釉瑚随身带着一个小匣子，内藏她用共鸣能力制作的袖珍古物仿品，它们既是她对于鉴定过的好东西的留念，也是她抵御残象的道具，乃至于她夏日解暑的帮手——水果藏在冰古董里，凉凉的，可好吃。
匣中另有一本小册子，用一首首胡诌的打油诗，记录她邂逅的每一件古物。
“天工的人托我帮忙寻找瑝珑失踪的珐琅彩缠枝瓷，这个记起来。”
“商人手里拿的青釉三足香炉，一看就是靠邪门歪道得来的，我暗示他尽快归还，也不知道听进去没有，还是继续管管这桩事吧，记起来记起来！”
“城门口的张木匠，居然拿着几百年的古刀劈柴，不敬，大大的不敬，我要记……算了，我大人有大量，改天先给他好好宣扬下那把刀的价值吧！”
编成诗句写进小册子里，也便是记在心上了。
比如那个手持青釉三足香炉的商人，这两个月屡遭诡谲之事，夜不能寐时，他终于想起当初有个街头鉴宝师提点过自己——
“咿呀咿呀，这香炉来路不正，你的命格压不住污秽，必遭祸殃呀！”
那个鉴宝师说得眉飞色舞，活脱脱一个江湖骗子，他本没有把话放在心上。但这段时间的遭遇，让他不敢怠慢这位大师的说辞。
这一晚，自家屋檐第十五次飘过幽深的黑影，还伴随着惊悚的尖啸，他终于忍受不住煎熬，连夜将盗来的香炉归还原处。
当然，如果那晚他胆敢往屋檐多张望几下，或许能看到另外一场闹剧：
今巡尉发现了一人在屋檐上装神弄鬼，安全起见，他们上前准备盘问这个“黑影”。
釉瑚被假扮黑影的衣服包得严严实实，见今巡尉朝自己走来，赶紧包裹着这身衣服拔腿就跑，期间还被磕绊了几下。
但她一边跑，一边还不忘在小册子上添一笔：青釉三足香炉，已物归原主。

records.text:
Youhu was born in a bustling port town known for its antique trade, where her parents were both esteemed appraisers. 
 
On her first birthday, her parents, following local customs, surrounded her with objects representing various trades. It was said that the first item the child touched would predict their future interests and career path.
 
But that day, little Youhu ignored pens, swords, and cooking utensils, crawling straight to her mother to latch onto the family's precious heirloom—a genuine antique Ruyi ring—and refused to let go.
 
Growing up surrounded by antiques, Youhu's love for them blossomed. She was fascinated by everything about them, soaking up the driest, most obscure appraisal facts with a twinkle in her eye. But what she loved most was listening to the stories her parents told about the antiques.
 
The deep chimes of the ancient bell echoed with memories of distant times when people knelt in devotion before golden statues praying for their family's wellbeing. 
 
The stone carvings depicted bold youths drawing their bows, warding off Tacet Discords to protect the people.
 
Youhu's lively nature shone through as she immersed herself in the world of antiques, the Tacet Mark on her arm glowing faintly to illuminate her eyes.
 
In every antique, she saw a little piece of history and a glimpse into the remnants of a civilization. This magic still holds her spellbound today.

Chenpi, Youhu's master, often praised her talent. "To be honest, your knowledge of antiques lacks structure. But don't worry, I'll teach you everything you need to know."
 
"What's truly valuable is your respect for the history in these antiques and your keen perception. In other words, you're a natural appraiser."
 
And Youhu would flash a cheeky grin, "Pfft, my parents already said I was born for this."
records.zh:
釉瑚出生在一个古物交易繁忙的港口，她的爸妈都是当地的鉴宝师。
周岁那天，爸妈按照家乡的习俗，在釉瑚身边摆满象征各行各业的器物，据说孩子第一个触摸到的物品，预示着孩子的志趣和未来从事的行当。
那天，釉瑚对笔墨、刀剑、炊具统统视而不见，径直爬向妈妈，伸手握住妈妈佩在腰间的如意环，不肯松开。
那是他们家的传家宝，一件货真价实的古物。
后来，釉瑚在古物堆里长大，她也确实展露出对古物的热忱，与古物有关的事情，她都兴致盎然，哪怕是枯燥晦涩的鉴宝知识，也能听上一整天。当然她最喜欢的，还是听爸妈讲古物背后的故事——
洪钟里回响的，是遥远岁月里的身影，对金色人像虔诚叩拜，祈祷阖家平安。
石雕上镌刻的，是英姿勃发的少年郎，把弓箭拉成满月，剿除残象护佑苍生。
生性活泼的她，屏除所有杂念，沉浸在古物的世界里，手臂泛起微光，声痕若隐若现，把她的眼眸照得很亮很亮。
吉光片羽里，皆是光阴之沉淀，文明之余晖，直至今日，她依然觉得这是古物的魅力所在。


“说实话，你的鉴宝知识完全不成体系，也难怪，毕竟在该学习的年纪……没关系，我都会教给你的。”
“难能可贵的是，你懂得尊重古物的历史底蕴，对此的感知也很敏锐。换言之，你是有鉴宝天赋的。”
师父陈皮多次夸赞釉瑚的天赋。
“嘁，还用你说，爸妈早就说过，我与古物有缘”。

records.text:
The so-called renowned appraisers are always squabbling over the value of antiques.
 
First, they downplay an antique's value, snapping it up for a pittance, only to turn around and hype it up to sell for a fortune. Craftsmanship? History? Mere afterthoughts in their pricing games.
 
However, Youhu has a different approach. For her, the worth of an antique isn't measured solely in currency, but something more unique.
 
Genuine appreciation is the first factor. Youhu enjoys facilitating deals where buyers are deeply respectful of the antiques and sellers entrust their cherished items to someone who truly appreciates them. As the antique changes hands, its frequency is mirrored in the hearts of both parties.
 
Another factor would be conscience. When Youhu was seven, raiders ransacked the town looking for riches. To them, antiques were just another form of loot.
 
The wealthy merchants and local appraisers panicked, abandoning their treasures as they escaped.
 
The raiders, ignorant about the true worth of these antiques, justified their plundering by saying the people here didn't deserve their treasures anyway, and such items might as well be taken somewhere they would be appreciated.
 
But not everyone fled. Some stood their ground, facing the raiders with steely resolve. They knew the true value of these antiques and defended them to the bitter end.
 
And that brings us to the final factor. The courage to sacrifice.
 
Now, it is Youhu's turn to make a sacrifice. Whether it is her talent, her knowledge, or the lengths she will go to recover them, she is determined to return every lost antique back to its rightful owner.
 
In the past, those who couldn't see the value in these relics trampled all over them. But today, Youhu's mission is to return each lost antique to where it truly belongs.
records.zh:
那些被港口奉为座上宾的鉴宝大师，总在讨论古物的定价。
他们先贬低古物的价值，用最低的价格购入；再极力吹捧，好卖出最高的价格。制作工艺与历史沉淀，都只是价格的添头。
但釉瑚的定价体系里，能够支付古物价值的并不只有货币。为她构造出这个体系的种种事物，也迥然不同。
比如，真实流动的情感。
釉瑚喜欢促成心意相通的交易，买家对古物未敢有一丝怠慢，卖家如遇知己，将珍视的藏品托付给对方。古物与货币在双方手中流动，而古物回响的频率，则同时沉淀在两个人心中。
比如，被献祭的良知。
釉瑚七岁那年，掠宝者入侵港口。他们为掠夺财富而来，古物，只是一种财富。
无论是曾斥巨资购入古物的富商，还是港口的鉴宝师，大多毫不犹豫地抛下“身外之物”逃难去了。
掠宝者不了解古物的一切，却依然振振有词：反正这片羸弱的土地无法保护自己的珍宝，还不如由他们送到更懂欣赏的地方去。
比如，付出自己的一切。
也有人选择了留在被暴乱侵蚀的港口，他们深知古物的价值，毅然直面掠宝者的屠刀，为守护身后的古物，伫立到最后一刻。
如今，轮到釉瑚为古物付出一些什么了，可以是自己与生俱来的鉴宝天赋，是自己日积月累的知识，是自己跋山涉险的追讨。
曾经，那些不懂欣赏与珍视的人，践踏了古物的价值。而她要做的，便是让那些飘零四海的古物，一件一件，回到原本的土地上。

records.text:
Over the course of examining countless antiques, Youhu has developed a habit of replicating her favorites with her cryogenic powers. 
 
She once made an ice chime. It didn't quite match the original's melody, but the crisp sound of shattering ice was delightful in its own way. She also crafted an ice Ruyi, swinging it with such gusto that she nearly smashed the nearby ice cauldron and mask!
 
People often ask about her most treasured antique. Youhu always hesitates, her eyes fixed on the Ruyi ring before her. This is her family's heirloom—once shattered, but now pieced together with ice.
 
Her mother had told her that the Ruyi ring symbolized completeness and good fortune. Youhu was mesmerized by the clear and translucent jade. But when raiders came, she could only watch as the ring and other treasures were pillaged and shipped away.
 
Three years later, she found those plundered items displayed as trophies in a museum. Despite an exhaustive search, the Ruyi ring was nowhere to be found.
 
It wasn't until she stumbled into a dusty storage room that she found the ring's shattered fragments, along with a tag that read "Low value, not for display." What she valued most was dismissed by those who didn't understand its true worth.
 
Heartbroken yet determined, Youhu clutched the fragments and trudged through knee-deep snow, her tears freezing as they fell. Driven by a sudden thought, she ignored the biting cold, crouched down, and used her Forte to piece the ring back together from the ice before losing consciousness.
 
When she awoke, her hands were etched with delicate snowflake patterns. The next thing she saw was a perfect, gleaming ice Ruyi ring lying beside her, as if it had been waiting for her all along.
records.zh:
釉瑚阅宝无数，遇到自己喜爱的古物，她便照着样式，凝冰造物，供自己把玩。
她造出一排冰编钟，敲敲打打，虽未能还原编钟的韵律，但冰块碎裂的声音倒也清脆悦耳；她又凝出一柄如意，乱挥一通，差点劈裂了一旁的冰大鼎和冰面具。
大家不免好奇，釉瑚最为喜爱的，又是哪件古物？釉瑚总是一愣，目光停留在身前的如意环。
确切地说，那是几块玉石的碎片，在断裂处凝水成冰，重新连接为如意环的形状。
妈妈曾告诉釉瑚，这是她们家族的传家宝，意为圆满如意。玉石剔透，辉光流转，釉瑚看直了眼。
但在那场掠夺中，釉瑚只能眼睁睁看着如意环与其他古物一起，装箱登船，飘零异国。
三年后，她终于找到了那些被掠夺的古物，它们被粉饰为掠夺者的藏品，陈列在场馆中。
但釉瑚搜寻了好多天，都未能找到那枚如意环。
直到她进入蒙尘的仓库，在凌乱的杂物里，她看到了如意环的碎片，还有一个【价值较低，不予展出】的鉴定标签。釉瑚最为珍视的古物，在一些人眼中，甚至不配得到妥善的保管。
原来古物落在不懂得珍惜的人手中，会是这样的下场。釉瑚捧着如意环的碎片，失魂落魄地走在及膝的积雪中，眼泪夺眶而出。眼泪落在碎片上，凝结成冰块。
她似乎想到了什么，不顾自己骤降的体温，蹲进雪中，如意环的往事在脑海里翻飞，频率从手中溢出，凝为冰霜，化为如意环的形状。
等她从昏迷中醒来，双手已被冻结出无法融化的冰花，手臂横陈着上一道声痕。
声痕尽头，一枚冰晶凝结而成的如意环正静静相伴。

records.text:
The first time Hiyuki heard the truth of her own past, it spilled from Gyokuro's drunken lips. Hiyuki's mouth tightened. Without a word, she poured herself a glass of the bitter liquor.
 
"Hiyuki... My dear Hiyuki..." 
"You can't do this. You can't be the damn Miko of Flaming Sakura... Your life was never meant to be like this!"
 
Hiyuki's eyes narrowed. If the people of Ashinohara saw their usually dignified and poised Miko of Flaming Sakura acting like this behind closed doors... 
 
The second hand ticked. The minute hand followed. At last, the hour hand lurched forward. By Ashinohara time, this very moment marked Hiyuki's transition into adulthood. She sighed and downed the drink in one burning gulp.
 
"You managed. You think I cannot?"
 
The liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame. So this was what they called the "drink of adulthood." Its taste, she decided, was hardly worth the wait. Hiyuki stood and draped a blanket over Gyokuro's muttering form. She lingered in the corner for a long moment. At last, she stepped forward, tucked the edges tight, and closed the door softly behind her.
 
The next morning, Gyokuro's fury toward the steward tasked with the Legacy Talisman's succession rang out loud enough to be heard two streets away.
 
The Suzu's power lay in "drawing upon the future." In simple terms, it meant every use exacted a toll from the bearer's remaining lifespan. In the worst case, it meant a successor who inherited the bell today might vanish into nothingness in their very first battle against a Threnodian. Because the price was so high, successors were usually chosen early. Hiyuki had stayed at Gyokuro's side for more than a decade. Even if Gyokuro refused to name her... who else could possibly be chosen?
 
The steward, unable to handle Gyokuro's temper, could only offer a strained, placating smile. "Even if not Hiyuki, surely you must name someone, Lady Miko."
 
Gyokuro fell silent for a few breaths. She sighed, cleared her throat, and prepared to resume her tirade.
 
It was Hiyuki who finally opened the door, ending the farce.
 
"For years, I have journeyed with you through Ashinohara. I know what each duty demands." 
"I have mastered every art a miko must know. The weaving of charms, the ceremonial dances—all from teachers of your own choosing."
"Only I can ensure the name of the Flaming Sakura remains untarnished, Gyokuro... No. Lady Miko."
 
Gyokuro's brow furrowed. She waved a hand dismissively. 

"You've learned it all, have you? Then don't you realize the Suzu will be the death of you?"
"I was an orphan you took in. My family lies buried beneath the snow from that Threnodian attack. I have no attachments left."
 
The room fell suffocatingly quiet. The only sound was the raspy, obsessive scrape of Gyokuro's thumb as she rubbed the bell on her wrist. She tried to speak, but in the end, no words came.
records.zh:
从醉倒的玉露口中第一次听到自己的身世时，绯雪抿了抿嘴，为自己也倒上半杯。
“绯雪……我的好绯雪呀！”
“你做不了这个……你不能做什么狗屁灼樱巫女……你的人生不该是这样！”
绯雪眯起眼，如果让大家看到平日里威风凛凛的灼樱巫女大人，私下里竟是这副模样……
秒针向前，分针渐进，时针终于肯向前挪动。
按照苇原的算法，从这一刻起，就算迈入成年了。
她叹了口气，将面前的半杯一饮而尽。
“你做得，我就做不得了？”
辛辣入喉，再向下，揉入略显单薄的身体。
嗯，所谓长作大人后才能喝的东西，滋味也不过如此。
绯雪站起身，拖出一床被子来，盖在哼哼唧唧的玉露身上，抵在角落里窝了一阵，又回头紧了紧被角才关门离去。

第二日，玉露对着颂物继承管理人的发怒的骂声隔两条街都听得到。
「铃」的能力本质是预取未来，简单地讲，使用者的寿命会随着力量的取用逐渐减少，再说得过分些，兴许今天刚刚接过「铃」的使用者，会在下一场对鸣式的战斗中身亡。
因此，继承者的选定通常被提前的极早，即便玉露一直不肯选定绯雪为正式继任者，但跟随玉露前后生活十几年……除了绯雪外，还能是谁？
玉露的性子没人压得住，管理人只能讪笑着应和，哎呀……就算不是绯雪，您也总得指一位出来不是？
玉露沉默了数秒，叹了口气，清了清嗓子，总之，先把他们骂回去吧。

终归是绯雪推门开口，结束了这场闹剧。
“十几年来我跟着你走遍了苇原，各处该注意的，我都清楚。”
“苇原巫女百般武艺我都学会了，织造术法、仪典舞道，更是你亲自找的老师。”
“玉露姐……灼樱巫女大人，唯有我，不会玷污灼樱的名讳。”
玉露皱紧了眉头，扬了扬手。
“你都学会了，那你难道不知道，这「铃」会要了你的命？”
“我本就是被你捡回来的孤儿，家人都在那场鸣式灾袭中被埋在雪里了，无牵无挂。”
房间里静得令人喘不过气，只余下玉露摩挲手腕铃铛的沙哑声。
她张了张口，终是没能发出声来。

records.text:
The days following Hiyuki's succession were inevitably frantic. Where once she had simply walked in Gyokuro's shadow, she now found the weight of every duty resting on her own shoulders.
 
Ashinohara had long suffered under the Threnodian's shadow, forcing the land to weave its very survival around the mikos. As the bearer of the Suzu, Hiyuki's status was as uniquely sacred as it was heavy, and her jurisdiction covered the entirety of Ashinohara. She became a nomad of necessity, racing between different places to assist the local mikos and turn the tides of battle.
 
Yet a miko was as much a living symbol as a blade. Wherever people would gather, a miko must appear to remind them why they fought. The Miko of Flaming Sakura was no exception. Hiyuki carried both burdens well. Perhaps it was because she had learned each duty at Gyokuro's side since childhood, combat and ceremony alike had long since become second nature. The only thing missing was Gyokuro's specific Flaming Sakura swordsmanship. Gyokuro had stubbornly refused to pass down the forms, even going so far as to distance herself from Hiyuki.
 
"Fine. If you will not teach me, I will learn in secret. One day, I will master it. One day."
 
But that day never came.

"The Suzu allows the bearer to draw upon the future, and a successor who inherits the Suzu today might vanish into nothingness during their very first battle with a Threnodian..."
 
Hiyuki couldn't remember the words the steward whispered when placing the Suzu in her hands. She couldn't remember the clumsy way she tied it to her wrist, mimicking a gesture she had seen so many times. She couldn't recall the weather that day, or the face of the person who handed her the small wooden box containing Gyokuro's legacy.
 
By the time the world rushed back into focus, she was sitting alone in the hollowed halls of the seat of Flaming Sakura, clutching the wish slip that had been inside the box.
 
Blood froze in her chest. A creeping frost left her fingertips numb. Inch by inch, Hiyuki dragged herself to that familiar corner of the room and curled up. She had crumpled the wish slip earlier. Now she smoothed it flat. 
 
"...I see."
"...I accept your wish."
"...There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura."
records.zh:
接过灼樱巫女继承者的责任后，绯雪的日子不可避免地繁忙起来。往日只需跟在玉露身后看着，如今许多事务必须亲自上手才行。
苇原受鸣式侵袭已久，以巫女为核心构建起了自身的防御体系，其中，灼樱作为颂物「铃」的持有者，地位更为特殊，责任也更为沉重，划分上，整个苇原都是灼樱巫女的守备范围。因此，灼樱巫女必须频繁往返于苇原各地，四处作战，分担各地巫女的压力。
另一方面，巫女也是苇原人的精神寄托，要在各类活动中频繁露面，给予苇原坚持与鸣式抗争的信心，灼樱巫女，自然不可缺席。
绯雪处理得很好，兴许是年幼时便跟随灼樱巫女左右，战斗也好，仪典也罢，她早已习惯了这些。
只是，玉露仍不肯传给她灼樱的刀法，甚至平日里也刻意地与绯雪拉开了些距离。
也好，你不肯教，那我便偷偷学吧，总有一天能学会的，总有一天。

没有那一天了。
「铃」的能力本质是预取未来，兴许今天刚刚接过「铃」的使用者，会在下一场对鸣式的战斗中身亡。

绯雪已不记得管理人在将「铃」交给自己时口中念叨的是什么，也不记得是如何将它学着熟悉的样子绑在手腕上，她不记得那一天的天气，不记得是谁递给她那个代表玉露的小盒子……等她反应过来时，已捧着盒子里那张愿签，呆坐在空荡的灼樱本部里了。
血液仿佛在心脏处凝固，指尖有些麻痹了。
绯雪一点一点地移动，抵在熟悉的角落里窝了一阵。
那枚愿签被揉皱了，又展开。

“……嗯。”
“……你的愿望，我收下了。”
“……不会再有下一个灼樱巫女。”

records.text:
"Lady Hiyuki, you have served as the Miko of Flaming Sakura for a century now. If we are to renew the contract..."
"It is of no consequence."
"Then, as per our previous arrangement... for how many years shall we set the renewal?"
"Fill it as you wish."
"I did not expect you to be quite so like the previous Miko... Ahem. Very well. As you wish, Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura."
 
The steward bowed and withdrew, closing the door with practiced reverence. Hiyuki noted that the staff accompanying him had changed three times over the decades. She shook her head, eyes narrowing as they fell upon the envelope on her desk. After a pause, she reached instead for a teacup that had long since gone cold.
 
"Just like the previous Miko... am I?"
 
How long had it actually been since she took up the title? 
Long enough that "Hiyuki" was now a fixed entry in Ashinohara's history books. 
Was it a long time? 
Not long enough.
 
True to the fortune lot she had inherited that year, Hiyuki had used her own strength to prove a silent vow: There will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura. Gradually, the voices urging her to select a successor had faded. The Office of Legacy Talismans now treated its visits to the shrine as a mere formality. Even the steward, she suspected, believed a successor unnecessary. To them, Hiyuki had become the title itself.
 
Yet Hiyuki often heard a voice. It wasn't the grating, persistent lure of the Fractsidus. It was a peaceful murmur stating facts plainly in her ear.
 
"Hiyuki, you have held on for so long. But your enemy, the Threnodian, has a far longer lifespan. It will wait until you die, until every miko, and every successor of every miko, has passed into memory."
"Does this path of resistance truly have an end?"
 
Cold tea is always the most bitter. The over-steeped acridity clung to her tongue, making each breath feel heavy. Hiyuki tapped a finger against the envelope on the desk. Instantly, a layer of frost raced across its surface. With one more light touch, the unopened Fractsidus seal shattered into crystalline dust.
 
Hiyuki rose and called out to the child who had volunteered to help clean the shrine, reminding her to stay vigilant and watch for intruders while she was away. Her lips curled into a smile as she ruffled the girl's hair and pressed a protective charm into her small palm.
 
"Lady Miko, where are you going to help this time?"
"Honami. I will be back soon. Keep this charm with you during this time, all right?"
 
Hiyuki waved goodbye to the little girl. As she turned to leave, the bell on her wrist caught the light, shining as brilliantly as ever.
records.zh:
“绯雪大人，您担任灼樱巫女已有百年，如果再次立约……”
“无妨。”
“那，便依照之前的约定，再许多少年呢？”
“随你填吧。”
“没想到您会和上任巫女一样……咳，好吧，如您所愿，「永世灼樱巫女」大人。”
管理人恭敬地关上门，与他一起来的工作人员似乎已换了三次。
绯雪摇摇头，眯起眼打量着桌上的信封，顿了顿，转而伸向已冷掉的茶杯。
和上任巫女一样……吗？

接过灼樱巫女之名，到底已过了多久？
久到苇原的课本上已有了绯雪的名字。
长吗？
还不够长。
如同那年那日承接下的愿签，绯雪用自身的能力证明着，不会再有下一个灼樱巫女。渐渐地，催促选定继任者的声音越来越少，颂物管理处也只把拜访灼樱当作例行公事，恐怕连管理人自己都觉得无需选定继承者，绯雪已是巫女一职的代名词了。

但绯雪时常会听到一种声音，那声音并不如残星会的劝诱那样恼人，它只是平和、安静地在她耳边陈述着。
绯雪，你已经坚持了足够久的时间——但眼前的敌人，鸣式，祂有着更为漫长的时间，直到你死去，直到每一位巫女的每一位继承者都死去。
与鸣式抗争的这条道路，真的有尽头吗？

冷掉的茶水最苦，那股熟透的苦涩味道绕在舌尖，让每一次呼吸都带着令人不快的沉闷。
绯雪的指尖轻叩在信封上，那信封便迅速地结上一层冰霜，再微微一点，其上的残星会标记便随未打开的蜡封化作冰屑碎裂。

绯雪起身，叮嘱门外自愿来打扫的孩子，在她离开时要多加注意，小心外人摸进来。
她又露出笑容来，揉了揉那孩子的脑袋，将一枚平安符放在小小的手心。
“巫女大人，您这次是要去哪儿帮忙呀？”
“穗波，我很快回来，这几天，记得把这符带在身边。”

绯雪与身后的小姑娘挥手作别，腕上的铃铛仍旧光彩照人。

records.text:
The people of Ashinohara had long grown accustomed to the distortions wrought by the Threnodian. Survival was a matter of routine: seek shelter, wait for the local miko to deploy, and if the situation spiraled, wait for the recovery teams and the Miko of Flaming Sakura to arrive.
 
To Hiyuki, this felt like just another fight among thousands. She cut through the monsters with practiced efficiency, checking the integrity of the barrier as she always did. As the civilians emerged from the shelters, parents pointed her out to their children with reverent relief. "Look, that's Lady Miko of Flaming Sakura."
 
Hiyuki offered a slight nod in response. She stepped over a fallen "No Entry" sign and turned back toward the barrier to finish her sweep.
 
Focus. Strike. Sheathe... Hm?
 
The blade passed through the air as it always did. Yet something was different. Subtle, but unmistakable.
 
Hiyuki reexamined the entire barrier. Everything appeared intact, yet a lingering, visceral wrongness clung to her fingertips. She released her hilt. Flexed her wrist. Pressed her fingers together—
 
A single drop of iridescent black mire welled from her skin. It pooled in the creases of her palm before dripping to the ground, spreading silently beneath her feet. 

Hiyuki drew her blade. Frost snapped into existence around her. First, contain it. Evacuate the civilians. Then find a way to—
 
She turned, but the cry died in her throat. There was nothing before her. It was as if the air itself vanished. For one frozen moment, Hiyuki could not breathe.
 
Honami was gone.

Aside from the shattered sign at her feet and a trace of mud creeping up the hem of her dress, there was nothing left.
 
Hiyuki reached out, but her hand recoiled on its own. She gasped for breath, but there was no oxygen. It was as if the atmosphere itself had been erased from existence. She raised her blade to strike, but found no enemy to sever. Only a faint, residual frequency remained, proof that the Threnodian had acted, for a fraction of a second, with power never before recorded.
 
According to Ashinohara's records, Honami had been pulled into another dimension at that moment. Even after a desperate appeal to the Spacetrek Collective for their most advanced tracking technology, not a single trace could be found.
 
When the others finally led Hiyuki away, she was still mindlessly rubbing the bell on her wrist, her mind trapped in that moment of shock.

Was this silent disaster her fault?
Of course it was her fault. As the Miko of Flaming Sakura, she had failed to protect Honami.
And of course, it was not her fault. Against the power of a Threnodian, a single person didn't matter—even one who could draw a million futures to safeguard the present.
 
Hiyuki returned to the Flaming Sakura. She took the protective charm from the child at the gate, forcing a ghost of a smile. Then she walked slowly to her room and pushed open the door. There, sitting quietly on her desk, was the envelope she had destroyed.
 
"Hiyuki, oh Hiyuki... Does this path truly have an end?"
records.zh:
苇原的人们早已惯常于鸣式引发的怪异，无非是躲避到安全处，负责本区域的巫女自会出动，事态再大些，也不过是等待救援队与灼樱巫女到场。
至于绯雪，原本也认为这只是千百次鸣式侵袭中的一次，她利落地解决怪物，依照往常的习惯检查结界的情况。
躲藏在安全屋中的民众走出，父母拉起孩子的手指向绯雪，看，那边那位就是灼樱巫女大人哦？

绯雪轻轻点头回应，迈步避开倒下的、标识着禁止通行的路牌，又转身回到结界中。
只需像往常一样，凝神、挥刀、收刀……嗯？
刀刃划过的手感，似乎有微妙的区别？

绯雪将整个结界都检查了一遍，好像没什么不对，但那股异样的手感仍粘滞在指腹，她放开刀柄，活动着手腕，指尖轻抿……
一滴泛彩的黑色泥泞悄然从指尖生出，涌向指缝间漏下，悄然自脚下漫开。
绯雪抽刀出鞘，霜寒瞬间凝结——先控制住它，让民众撤离，再想办法——绯雪转过身，却发不出声音。
如同从未存在过一般，好像连同此处的空气也消失，呼吸也被迫静止了一瞬。

穗波，消失了。
除开脚下那块碎裂的禁止通行与悄然爬上裙摆的泥泞，不再有任何存在的痕迹。

向前伸出手，手指又自顾自地退缩回来。
急促地想要呼吸，却又捕捉不到氧气。
手中的刀刃想要挥出，却找不到可以斩断的敌人。
唯有残留的频率痕迹证明着，鸣式曾以从未被观测过的烈度活动过一瞬。

依据苇原的观测记录表明，那一瞬，穗波似乎被拉入了另一个空间。
后续，即便向深空联合提出援助申请，期望借由最新的技术，也没能查出一丝踪迹。

当其他人将绯雪带离原地时，绯雪下意识地摩挲着手腕处的铃铛，仍未来得及从那一瞬的惊诧中走出。
这场无声的灾难，是绯雪的责任吗？
当然是，作为灼樱巫女，她没能救下穗波。
当然不是，在鸣式面前，单薄一人，即便能预取百万种未来于此刻，又算得上什么？

绯雪返回灼樱，从门外的孩子手中接过还愿的平安符，挤出一抹笑容来。
慢步向前，疲惫地推开房门，桌上悄然放着那封理应被碎裂的信件。

绯雪啊绯雪，这条路，真的有尽头吗？

records.text:
Hiyuki didn't linger on the Fractsidus's many offers. No sane person would collaborate with those who viewed human lives as mere expendable fuel.
 
Instead, she traveled across Ashinohara, leaving behind white paper birds infused with her own frequency. She instructed the local mikos that her mind was linked to these messengers, and should any insurmountable incident occur, she would be there the moment they crushed the bird.
 
The path of resistance against the Threnodians... it had to have an end. It had to.
 
It was then that Hiyuki heard word that the Spacetrek Collective was grappling with a critical lack of safety provisions for its expeditions. She saw an opportunity and proposed a "trade." She would ensure the safety of their exploration efforts, and in exchange, the Collective would forge her a blade using the pinnacle of Solaris technology. A weapon sharp enough to cleave through a Threnodian.
 
Hiyuki joined the Spacetrek Collective as part of the Special Response Force. The unit had once been large, but casualties mounted as Aleph-1 grew more active. So Hiyuki submitted a request, proposing that henceforth, she alone would handle Threnodian containment and ensure the safety of those conducting surveys.
 
When she first arrived here, the Collective was little more than a plot of foundation in the dirt. She watched as Lahai-Roi was built, step by step, and began to grasp the true measure of human potential. The facility's construction was a miracle, perhaps the greatest engineering feat in the history of Solaris. Yet it came not from gods, nor from any single hero. It was built, brick by brick, by people across all Solaris who dared to dream.
 
"Lucilla."
"Hmm?"

Lucilla casually pulled a bottle of fine liquor from beneath the desk, a specialty from Ashinohara. A student hoping to pass their finals had left it at one of Hiyuki's frequent haunts, tucked under a neat note asking for the miko's blessing.
 
Hiyuki sighed, set out two glasses, and pushed one toward the restless Lucilla.
 
"The Spacetrek Collective... it was built to explore the stars beyond Solaris, was it not?"
"That's the idea."
"How fares the progress?"
"Ugh..." Lucilla drained her drink in one go. "Still a long way off. Research is hitting walls everywhere, and the higher-ups keep breathing down our necks with impossible demands."
 
Hiyuki rubbed the bell on her wrist, her eyes downcast. 

"Have any of you ever wondered... where the end of this path is?"
 
Lucilla toyed with her empty glass, then gently clinked it against Hiyuki's.
 
"There is no end, Hiyuki. Just like what you're trying to do... No end."
"But we have to keep moving forward anyway."
"Not to reach a finish line, but to take one more step alongside the people standing next to us."
 
Hiyuki remained silent for a long time. Finally, she gave a soft nod and raised her glass, drinking deeply. The liquor scorched her throat and settled like lead in her slight frame.
 
The bell on her wrist chimed—a solitary sound, but the Miko of Flaming Sakura would take her next step regardless.
records.zh:
绯雪并未与残星会多做纠缠，没有人会想与那群把人当作耗材的家伙们合作的。
她主动前往苇原各地，留下了刻有自己频率的白鸟，交代各地的巫女，自己与这些白鸟心思相连，如若真有无法处理的意外发生时，则碾碎白鸟，自己会及时返回。

与鸣式抗争的道路，总该有尽头……必须有终点。

绯雪听闻了深空联合相关的事，深空联合此时正苦于探索工作缺少安全保障，绯雪便主动提出了“交易”——她来主导保障探索工作的安全，而深空联合，则需要以当今索拉里斯最高的科研水准，为她准备一把刀，一把锋利到足以斩落鸣式的刀。
她以特别对策组的身份申请加入了深空联合，这个小组曾有过不少人，但随着阿列夫一的活跃，伤亡比逐渐增高。绯雪递交了申请，往后，将由她一人独自负责鸣式对策工作，保护探测人员的安全。

初到时，深空联合还只有一处地基，她眼看着拉海洛一步步被完善建立起来，逐渐意识到人类本身的力量——深空联合的建立堪称索拉里斯史上的基建奇迹，而这份奇迹，并非由神赐福，并非借由任何单独一人的伟力，而是由整个索拉里斯怀揣着理想与抱负的人们一砖一瓦地搭建起来。

“洛瑟菈。”
“嗯？”
洛瑟菈自然地从桌下翻出一瓶佳酿来，这是来自苇原的特产，某位想要求保佑期末考过关的苇原学生特意放在绯雪曾出现过的地方，下面还压着一张工整的字条，写着些求巫女大人保佑的话。
绯雪叹了口气，转身拿出两个杯子，推到左顾右盼的洛瑟菈面前。

“深空联合……是为了探索索拉里斯外的星空而建立的，对吧？”
“啊，对。”
“你们现在的进度如何了？”
“唉……”
洛瑟菈拿起杯子一饮而尽，叹了口气。
“还差得远了，各处的研究都有瓶颈，上头还总下些难捱的需求。”
绯雪摩挲着手腕处的铃铛，垂下眼来。
“那你们有没有想过，这条路何时才是尽头？”

洛瑟菈掂了掂空杯，碰了碰绯雪的杯子。
“没有尽头，绯雪，就像你想做到的事一样，没有尽头。”
“但，我们总要向前走。”
“不是为了走到尽头，而是为了与身旁的人共同再迈出一步。”

绯雪沉默了一阵，轻轻点头，也拿起杯子任由辛辣入喉，再向下，揉入略显单薄的身体。
手腕处的铃铛作响，孤身前行的灼樱巫女，也必将迈出她的一步吧。

records.text:
Spring days lingered, slow and sweet. In courtyards across Mingting, flowers were in magnificent bloom.
 
Suisui sat slumped over her desk, a brush clutched in her hand and a smudge of ocher paint on her cheek. After painting intently for hours, she stood up to admire her masterpiece—a cluster of overlapping blues, greens, and deep reds. It was hard to tell what it was, but it radiated a cozy warmth. Content with her work, Suisui snatched the paper and dashed outside, her skirts stirring the air and sending blank sheets rustling behind her.
 
"Yangyang! Yangyang—"
 
In a flash, the paper was in Yangyang's hands. Suisui braced against the qin table, searching her sister's face. "Can you tell what it is?" 
Yangyang studied it, her fingertip tapping a golden smudge on the right, then a white one on the left. "It's... two little birds nestled together." 
Suisui's eyes lit up, and she smacked the table. "Exactly! They're birds! I knew those adults were blind! They kept saying they were baby chicks!"
"No, they aren't." Yangyang put the drawing down and tilted her head. "A baby chick's tail droops. These are perked up."
"That's right!" Suisui wanted nothing more than to scoop her sister up and spin her around. "You're the only one who understands my art!"
Yangyang accepted the praise with only a soft curve of her lips. She pointed to the golden cluster on the right. "Is this one you, Sister?"
 "Mm-hmm! The one on the right is me, and the one on the left is you." Suisui leaned closer, using the tail end of her paintbrush to point at the snowy bird. "See? It's dainty. Just like you."
 
That was how the springs of their childhood slipped by. Outside, clusters of pink and white blossoms hung heavy over green leaves. Whenever a breeze swept through, petals would drift onto the qin table, the girls' sketches, and their hair. Soft sunlight bathed the courtyard in a golden hue. Birds chirped beneath the eaves, blending with the drifting notes of Yangyang's qin. Suisui would lounge across her desk, or settle on the veranda, raising her drawings to the sun to watch the colors softly bloom across the paper...
 
Days moved so slowly back then. The shadows beneath the eaves crept inch by inch, carrying whole afternoons away. And then, before one could even notice, many springs had already passed.
records.zh:
春日迟迟，明庭的院子里，花开得正盛。
穗穗趴在书案前，手里攥着画笔，腮帮子上还蹭了一抹赭石色。她画了好一会儿，终于直起身来，端详着自己这幅大作——纸上一团一团的色块，青的、蓝的、赭的，交错在一起，说不清画了什么，反正看着暖融融的。穗穗满意地点点头，拎起画纸就往外跑，裙角带起一阵风，吹得纸张翻动，簌簌作响。

“秧秧！秧秧——”

那张薄薄的画纸转瞬就到了秧秧手里。穗穗两手撑着琴案，盯着妹妹的脸："你看出来是什么了吗？"
秧秧看了一会儿，指尖碰了碰右边那团金色的东西，又碰了碰左边那团白色的：“应该是……两只凑在一起的小鸟。”
穗穗眼睛亮了，一掌拍在案上：“对嘛！就是鸟！我就说那些大人眼神不好，他们偏说是鸡仔！”
“不是鸡仔。”秧秧把画纸放平，歪着头看了看，“小鸡的尾巴是耷下去的，这个翘着呢。”
“对吧对吧！”穗穗恨不得把妹妹举起来转一圈，“就你看得懂！”
秧秧被夸了也不怎么得意，只是嘴角弯了弯，伸手指了指右团那只淡金色的：“这只是姐姐？”
“嗯！右边是我，左边是你。”穗穗凑过来，拿画笔杆子指着左边那只雪白的鸟，“你看，小小的，就跟你一样。”

那些年的春天就是这样过的。窗外是满架新开的花，粉白相间，密密匝匝地压低了绿叶，风一过便簌簌落几片花瓣，沾在琴案上、画纸上、姐妹俩的发梢上。日光柔软地铺下来，把院子里的一切都镀上一层薄薄的蜜色，鸟雀在檐下跳来跳去，叫声轻快又明亮，和着琴声悠扬地飘来。穗穗就在这样的光景里趴在案上躲懒，或是干脆坐在廊下，把画纸举得高高的，对着阳光看那些色彩晕开的样子……
那时候日子真是慢啊。檐下的光影一寸一寸地挪，挪着挪着，一个下午就如此过去——再到回神时，便已挥别数十个春日了。

records.text:
When autumn arrived in Mingting, the wind swept withered yellow leaves against the latticed window before tearing them away, like someone slowly turning the pages of an old book.
 
Yangyang was leaving for Jinzhou to become an Outrider. The decision had been made half a month ago. Though the family left it unsaid, everyone kept endlessly busy, as if trying to outrun her departure. Inside the room, Suisui was helping her sister pack. The camphorwood chest had been open all day, the dried mugwort at the bottom releasing a bitter, clean scent. She shook out Yangyang's clothes one by one, folding them with care. Outside, a lone insect chirped in fits and starts, reluctant to surrender to the autumn.
 
The sunlight carrying the camphorwood's fragrance fell gently across Suisui's hand. Looking up, her gaze rested on the central pillar of the hall. Row upon row of notches were carved into the wood, stretching from knee-height to her ear. The lowest two belonged to Yangyang at ages seven and nine, marked lightly by their father in fear of hurting his daughter. Suisui remembered Yangyang could barely stand straight back then, having to steady herself against the pillar. Yet even as a toddler, she had been exceptionally sweet, filling Suisui's heart with a silent pride: Yes, this is my little sister.
 
Further up was Suisui's own notch from when she was fourteen, a year she had thrown a tantrum insisting on leaving home to study medicine elsewhere. Her father hadn't refused outright; he simply made her stand before this pillar for the better part of a day. Staring at the stacked markings, she had watched herself grow, inch by inch. Somehow, she realized her growth felt so fast, and yet so slow. She may have grown taller, but she still had much to learn.
 
Near the top, Yangyang's notches grew closer together. The one from last winter, carved by Yangyang herself, was barely half a finger shorter than Suisui's. By the spring of this year, they stood at the exact same height.

A scattering of birdsong drifted in from the courtyard. Suisui pushed the door open, the autumn sun striking her face with a fleeting warmth. Beneath the eaves, a blue-backed bird leaped from a branch, its wings stirring a rustle of yellow leaves.
 
Yangyang was crossing the yard from the other end. Pausing at the steps, she saw her older sister under the veranda and walked over. Suisui offered her a soft smile.
"When do you set off?"
"Tomorrow morning."
Suisui let out a quiet "Oh." She wanted to say more, but the words dissolved on her tongue. Instead, she reached out and gently adjusted the collar of Yangyang's cloak. Yangyang stood perfectly still, waiting. Only when Suisui pulled her hands away did Yangyang speak in a low voice: "I will come back."
Suisui smiled. "Go on, then. The winds are harsh in Jinzhou. Take care of yourself."
Yangyang nodded. Hearing their parents call her name, she turned to join them. She walked slowly, her back held straight, already adopting the bearing of an Outrider.
 
Once more, Suisui was left alone. The blue-backed bird returned to its branch, chirping with its head tilted high. Withered leaves blanketed the steps. She bent down to pick one up, wondering which book she should press it into, before realizing it didn't really matter.
 
After all, autumn always passes.
 
Suisui rose to her feet. From beyond the courtyard walls, the distant neighing of a horse drifted in, like an echo carried from Jinzhou. She knew it was impossible, yet she stood listening for a long time before turning back to the room.
 
The camphorwood chest was still open, waiting for her to close it.
records.zh:
秋来明庭，风卷着枯黄落叶贴上窗棂，又被揭走，像有人慢慢翻着一本旧书。
秧秧要走了，去今州，做踏白。这事定下来已有半月，家里人嘴上不说，却各自忙着，像有什么活计是赶在她走前必须做完的。
穗穗在屋里帮妹妹收拾行囊，樟木箱开了大半日，箱底铺着去年晒过的艾草，闻着仍有一股清苦。她把秧秧的衣裳一件件抖开，又依次叠紧，窗外有虫还在叫，断断续续，像是不甘心入秋。

掺着樟木气息的秋阳，温和地落在她手背上。她抬眼，看见堂屋那根承重柱。
柱上一道道横刻，从膝盖那么高，一直爬到她耳侧。最低的两道是秧秧的，七岁，九岁，是父亲蹲下来替她比划的，刀痕很浅，怕伤了孩子。穗穗记得那年的秧秧还站不太稳，要扶着柱子，幼小的孩子却分外乖巧，自己看了心中都隐隐生出骄傲之意——这是我的妹妹。
再往上，就是自己的那道了，落于十四岁那年。那年她曾闹着要出门闯荡，要随人去别处学医，父亲没说不许，只让她在这柱子前站了半日：柱上的刻痕一道压着一道，她盯着看，看自己一寸一寸往上长……穗穗有些茫然地想，自己的成长速度似是很快，又似是很慢。个头窜了不少，但论及处世经验，又好像还多的是要学的。
属于秧秧的刻痕越往上越密。去年腊月那道，是秧秧自己刻的，比自己只矮半指。今年开春以后，她便基本和自己一样高了。

院外零星传来几声鸟叫，穗穗推门出去，秋阳撞在脸上，裹着几分暖意。檐下那只蓝背的雀正从枝桠间跃起，翅膀扑扇两下，惊得几片黄叶簌簌而落。秧秧正从院子另一头过来，她在阶前停了停，看见姐姐站在廊下，便走过来。穗穗也冲她笑了笑。
“什么时候动身？”
“明早。”
穗穗“哦”了一声。她想再说点别的，话到舌尖又咽了回去。她伸手替秧秧拢了拢披风的领子，秧秧没动，等姐姐手收回去，秧秧才低声说了句：“我会回来的。”
穗穗笑了一下：“去吧。今州风大，照顾好自己。”
秧秧应了，刚巧父母喊她，她便往那边过去。她走得不快，腰板挺得很直，像已经在习惯做一个踏白。
于是廊下又只剩穗穗一个人。那只蓝背的小鸟不知什么时候回来了，再次站在那枝桠上，仰着头叫了两声。叶子落了一阶又一阶，她弯腰捡起，想着该把它夹进哪一本书里，又觉得夹进哪里都一样。
毕竟秋天总是要过去的。

穗穗起身，听见院墙外遥遥传来马的嘶鸣，像是今州方向传来的回音——她知道不可能，但还是听了半晌，才终于转身回房。
樟木箱还开着，等她回去合上。

records.text:
Nightfall descended upon the Land of Xuanfang, the twilight sinking inch by inch across the horizon. Suisui walked along the thoroughfare, her steps clicking softly against teal stone slabs. The sky's amber afterglow bathed the street where lanterns yet to be lit swayed gently in the breeze. Shops were closing for the night. Vendors carried wooden shutter boards back and forth, their casual chatter drifting into the evening air. Suisui moved through the shifting play of light and shadow, her silhouette stretching long across the ground.
 
The Waking Moon Festival was drawing near. Stacks of colorful silk lined the storefronts as shophands counted the bolts being carried inside. A group of children dashed past her, only to freeze at the street corner. They stared wide-eyed at a row of steaming mechanical cauldrons, swallowing hard before finally tearing themselves away with reluctant backward glances.
 
Suisui stopped by the stall and observed for a while. The vendor was selling "Brocade Pearl Meatballs"—glistening, tender orbs garnished with green onions, lined up neatly in bamboo steamers.
 
"One steamer of Brocade Pearl Meatballs, please."
The vendor looked up, saw the young woman before him with her smiling eyes, and beamed in response. Taking the steamer, Suisui paid her tab, then slid a few extra Shell Credits across the counter.
"For those children who just ran past. Please give each one a serving," she said, her voice light as she turned to leave. "No need to tell them who it's from."
The vendor blinked in surprise, but by the time he looked up, her figure had already vanished into the crowd.
 
As darkness set in, lanterns across teahouses and taverns flickered to life, spilling warm, golden light onto the pavement. Suisui stepped through the glowing patches, her hands full with the bag of warm meatballs. When the wind blew a stray lock of hair across her face, she didn't even have a spare hand to brush it away.
 
It suddenly occurred to her that she had left her water fan behind. She chuckled, unbothered. There were few occasions that truly required her to wield it anyway. The real storm had already been weathered during the Siege of Xuanfang Hold. Everything had settled now, peaceful enough that she had the luxury to stroll the streets and watch people spend a perfectly commonplace evening.
 
With that thought, her pace unconsciously quickened.
 
Just past the narrow alley and over a small bridge lay her destination. Her sister was there, and so was that person. She wondered if they had already lit the lanterns, and whether they would enjoy this dish. She had walked through the spring and summer of Mingting, where her young self ran through bustling crowds with her hair flying in the wind, her heart captivated by the vibrant tapestry of the world. She had walked through the autumn and winter of Mengzhou, rowing into misty mornings to negotiate trade, and sitting alone on snowy nights to read family letters over and over by the hearth.
 
And now, those seasons had led her to this very evening. Beneath her feet were the roads of Xuanfang. In her hands was a treat for the people she held dear. Suisui shifted the bag to her other hand and quickened her pace. The wind rushed down the long street, sending her sleeves billowing against the hazy scatter of lantern light. She squinted into the glow, but she didn't slow down.
 
The bridge was just ahead.
records.zh:
入夜时分的玄方地界，暮色正从天际一寸一寸沉下去。
穗穗走在城中长街上，鞋底踏过青石板，步子不紧不慢。天边的余晖还没散尽，将整条街都镀染上淡淡的橘色，檐角挂着的灯笼还未点亮，只在风里轻轻晃着。铺子陆续开始收摊，人们进进出出，搬着门板，偶尔传来几句闲话，散在暮风里，听不真切。穗穗从那些光影里穿过去，身影被拉得很长很长。

快到要举办朝月会的时节了。街边铺子门前堆着几十匹彩绸，伙计搬进搬出，老板娘靠在门框上点数，嘴里念着数字，眉梢带笑。几个孩子从穗穗身边跑过去，路过拐角处那几只正热腾腾冒着香味的机关炉鼎时，又纷纷驻足，眼睛发亮地咽了半天的口水，这才终于恋恋不舍地走了。
穗穗支着下巴，打量了一会儿。店家摆的是个卖“锦霞珠”的摊，那油亮软糯、喷香扑鼻的肉丸缀着碧色葱花，齐齐整整列在蒸笼中，看着就叫人食指大动。穗穗伸手点了点。
“烦请来一笼锦霞珠。”
店家抬头，瞧见面前站着个年轻姑娘，笑眼盈盈的，便也笑着应了声。穗穗接过装好的锦霞珠，付过钱，又多递了一份贝币过去。
“方才跑过去的那几个孩子，一人给装一个吧。”她拎起袋子，声音轻盈地飘回来，“不用说谁买的。”
店家愣了愣。那钱留在摊面上，身影已经消失在了人群中。

暮色沉下去，茶楼酒肆的灯陆续亮起来，暖黄的光从窗格子里漏出来铺在地上。穗穗踩着那些光走，手里拎着那袋热气腾腾的肉丸，风将耳边碎发吹到脸上也没腾出手去拢。
想起今天出门急，水扇忘带在身上了。她笑了一声，倒不在意，能让她动扇子的时候本来就不多，真正要紧的风浪早在守城战那几天翻过去了。眼下的日子寻常得很，寻常到她有空在街上闲逛，有空停下来看人们是怎样度过一个再普通不过的黄昏。
脚步不知不觉快了。
穿过前头那条窄巷，再过一座小桥就到了。妹妹在那里，那个人也在那里。她不知道那头此刻是不是已经点起了灯，不知道{Male=他们;Female=她们}能不能吃得惯这道菜？
她曾走过明庭的春夏，水面波光粼粼，美不胜收，小小的穗穗奔跑在喧嚷人群中，任风扬起她的长发，满心满眼只有那生动、鲜活直叫人不舍移开目光的烟火万象；亦走过梦州的秋冬，于湖上起雾的早晨泛舟去谈生意，于落雪的傍晚独坐窗下，炉火噼啪响着，手里攥着迢迢而来的家书，看了一遍又一遍，直到墨迹被热气氲开。
如今又走到了这个傍晚。脚下是玄方地界的路，手里有给惦记的人带的东西。穗穗把袋子换了只手拎，步子越来越快，风从长街那头灌过来吹得袖摆翻飞，街面上是朦胧错落的灯影，她眯了眯眼，没慢下来。
桥就在前面了。

records.text:
Chixia's ancestors were migrants to Jinzhou from the Central Plains, with their later generations settling in the city ever since. The family is well-known for their deep passion and expertise in the world of spices.

As the sun painted the Jinzhou skyline with its morning light, the first sign of activity would always come from Panhua's Kitchen, where plumes of smoke billow from its chimney.

"Mornin', Mrs. Panhua. A bowl of handmade noodles, please. Extra numb and spicy." A loud and clear voice overshadowed the rising hustle and bustle of the city outside the kitchen, immediately capturing the attention of several children nearby, their eyes lighting up with admiration.

"Miss Chixia, when are we having today's Overdash lessons?" one of the children asked eagerly.

"Your students look more psyched than you are," Panhua teased as she served Chixia and the children their breakfast.

"What's the hurry, I'm not even warmed up yet! Plus, ya can't work on an empty stomach," Chixia replied between mouthfuls of spicy noodles.

For her, an energetic day begins with a spicy tingle to the taste buds.

Chixia relished each bite of spicy chili peppers, washing them down with steaming soup. Her body glowed with warmth as the food settled in her stomach.

With the last slurp of noodles, Chixia wiped her mouth in satisfaction.

"Now I'm all fired up!"
records.zh:
炽霞的祖辈是从中曲台地迁来今州的，这一支亲系在今州留下不少旁支。
他们的特点是口味喜辣，极善吃辣。
每当今州的天蒙蒙亮，最先恢复烟火气的当属攀花饭馆的早餐摊。
“早啊攀花姨，和往常一样，来碗手打小面，加麻加辣的。”
一声嘹亮的吆喝盖过了店外城市复苏的喧嚣，跟在这声吆喝声后，几双亮晶晶的眼睛也冒了出来。
“炽霞姐姐，今天的飞檐课堂什么时候开始呀？”
“你徒弟真是比你还闲不住。”
攀花揶揄了两声，给炽霞和孩子们各自端上了热腾腾的早餐。
“急什么嘛，还没开始热身呢。先吃早饭，吃饱了才有力气嘛！”
炽霞一边热情地回应着孩子们，一边把一碗热辣鲜香的麻辣小面滑下肚。
活力满满的一天，由舌蕾上跳动的麻辣开始。
辣椒的酥麻热烈由唇齿咀嚼，顺着食管滑进胃里。再喝上一口热腾腾的面汤，整个身子由内而外散发着暖意。
吸溜完最后一根面条，炽霞满足地抹了抹嘴：
“这下，就准备好了！”

records.text:
Master Xuanmiao had been looking for a certain person.

Young Changli accompanied her aged mentor across the landscapes of Huanglong. Though he was initially reluctant to mentor another student, the revered elder dedicated himself to passing on every ounce of wisdom to her in their limited time together.

Master Xuanmiao was a devoted Weiqi player. During breaks on their weary journey, they would settle by the roadside to engage in intense matches. He utilized these moments not just for play but also as teaching opportunities for Changli, imparting wisdom on strategic thinking and power dynamics within each move. Sometimes, he would analyze an unfinished game of Weiqi with her, but he always seemed somewhat dissatisfied with her responses. 

It was during these times that he would mention an old friend of his, hinting at a quest to reconnect with this individual through Changli's tutelage. Despite Changli's curiosity about this mysterious person's identity and location, her mentor would simply shake his head and tell her, "The time has not yet come."

On the day he felt his final moments approaching, he entrusted Changli with his Weiqi game record and his cherished journal. With solemnity, he told his devoted disciple, "In this unfinished game, you shall find the ultimate truth." 

And so, carrying on the legacy of Master Xuanmiao, Changli embarked on her path ahead.

"...A celestial being descended, wielding the limitless might of the universe, embracing the inaugural Echo within..."
"...The enigmatic figure with eyes of gold amidst swirling clouds and waning lights."
"...Steadfastly by the side of Sentinel Jué, in a bond of intimate camaraderie."

Following the notes in her late mentor's journal, she continued her search, uncovering traces of that enigmatic figure in various unexpected places. At times, it was the captivating tales spun by seasoned storytellers; elsewhere, it was mere slivers gleaned from ancient archives. Like a silent guardian, this person acted as a sturdy anchor in turbulent seas, leading humanity through the wreckage of past calamities towards a hopeful horizon. The subtle imprints they left behind wove an almost imperceptible yet unyielding thread that bridged vast stretches of time and history far surpassing the ordinary span of mortal lives.

She had been told that the signs of that person's arrival would be impossible to miss. That said person had the power to truly change the world. However, her vision of a peaceful and prosperous world required more than mere hopeful anticipation of a savior. Understanding that achieving her dreams necessitated acquiring substantial power and influence, she embarked on a journey through diverse lands, immersing herself in wisdom, and persisting through every challenge without faltering to meet the expectations placed upon her.

Upon assuming the esteemed role of Secretary-General, she at last gained entry into the revered Grand Libraries. Within the vast expanse of knowledge stored within their walls, she uncovered a pivotal revelation: a clue leading her to Jinzhou, a border city in Huanglong.

From then on, everything unfolded precisely as Sentinel Jué predicted. The person she had been searching for emerged in Jinzhou and protected the city from a reviving Threnodian. The once nebulous being from ancient records and myths now solidified into a clear and distinct presence within her mind.

On the day of their foretold encounter, she returned to Jinzhou from Mingting, the capital city of Huanglong. She witnessed the esteemed guest of Jinzhou waiting at the ferry port in the rain, looking uncertain.

Following the prophecies of Jué, she had faith that their paths would converge at the right moment. 
And that awaited moment was upon her. 

Concealing a whirlwind of emotions behind her gaze, she advanced towards them with measured steps. Using her paper umbrella adorned with a spirit bird motif, she gently angled it to provide cover from the rain, as their eyes locked in a wordless exchange. The sole audible presence was the hushed melody of raindrops tapping against her umbrella.

She smiled and softly asked, "Are you trapped here by the rain?"
records.zh:
师父似乎一直在追随一个人。
年幼的长离跟着年迈的师父在瑝珑中游历，德高望重的老者本已不打算再授徒讲学，但既已收下了这小徒弟，便要尽心在最后的时间里将全部学识倾囊相授。
老人喜爱弈棋，在赶路疲乏的时候，师徒便席地而坐，摆出棋盘对弈。师父大多时间与长离下指导棋，在棋中教导她如何筹策万类，度权量能，但偶尔也会与她复盘一局未完的棋局，每每进行到中盘，师父却不甚满意。
到这时，他总会提起那个与他对弈的旧友，长离明白那人便是师父一直在追随的人，师父收她为徒，也是为了寻找这个人。但若是闻及那人姓甚名谁、现在何处，师父却总是摇摇头。
“时机未到。”
在预感到自己大限将至的那一日，老人将随身携带的棋谱与手记交给了长离，也将遗志传给了自己的徒儿。
“一切因果，皆在棋中。”
于是徒弟接过了师父的遗志，继续前行。
“……斯天人降世，乾坤指掌，纳骸于身。”
“……见金瞳异人于云霞明灭之间。”
“……与角并肩而立，亲密无间。”
她顺着师父留下的手记，一点点向前追寻，发现许多地方都存在着那个人的影子，有时是说书人口中精彩纷呈的故事，有时是史书典籍中只言片语的记载——那个存在如同坚定的基石与灯塔，在数度风雨飘摇的文明中将人们引向更好的未来。
那个人在世界上留下的痕迹，如同一缕难以察觉却坚韧绵长的丝线，将比普通人的寿命漫长得多的岁月与历史一一串联。
“那个特殊之人的出现，势必伴随着足以令你注意到的征兆。那个人，是真正有能力改变这个世界的人。”
而若想达成盛世太平的夙愿，却不能仅靠遥远的幻影，她必须站在足够高足够远的地方，才能有足够强的力量亲手触碰她追寻的未来，完成一路走来所有人托付于她的祈盼与约定，于是她游学四国，雪案萤窗，即使路途遥远艰险，也未曾放弃分毫。
官拜长史之后，她终于获得权限，如愿踏入瑝览类书，在浩如烟海的记载中，她找到了最为关键的信息。
信息所指向的，正是瑝珑的边陲重地，今州。

一切都如同岁主预言那般，贵客造访今州，破局止战，护得今州安宁——曾经只在典籍与传说中出现的模糊背影，如今终于有了确切的形态。
正式相见的那天，她从明庭匆匆赶回今州，见那位贵客正站在渡口，似乎在雨中踌躇。
——只要那位贵客按照角所言前行，我们总会相见。
如今，时机已到。
于是她隐去眼中如潮的情绪，一步一步走向那个人身边。
绘着灵鸟纹样的纸伞轻斜，二人四目相对，天地间只余细雨敲击伞面的声响。
她露出微笑，轻声开口。
“——你是被雨困在了这里吗？”

records.text:
Scorching. That was Lupa's earliest memory of the small village where she was born.

Summers stretched on endlessly, the heat so intense that even the lake seemed to boil. But the children of Septimont hardly cared. Far away, in the city atop Capitoline Hill, the Great Agon was about to begin. The village had rarely produced a Gladiator skilled enough to enter the match, but the excitement still pulsed through the air. Even the children couldn't resist picking up weapons and staging their mock battles in celebration.
