Lupa was called home halfway through one of those kids' Agons.

Stepping through the door, she was greeted by the same old conversation. Her parents asked if she would be willing to move to Capitoline Hill. She said yes. They asked if she would be willing to become a Gladiator since she showed signs of being a Resonator. And again, she said yes. These questions had been repeated many times, and her answers stayed the same. Yet each time, her parents seemed relieved, as if they feared she might someday refuse, even though she never had.

Then the usual arguments began. Should they try to mend ties with the House of Silva, who had once turned their backs on them in their darkest hour? Or should they start over somewhere new? Whenever they spoke of that glittering city on the hill, and the House they once served, their voices would take on a tone—one caught between yearning for acceptance and fearing for rejection, just like when they spoke to Lupa about her future.

Lupa sat for a while, listening. When it became clear her parents had drifted into their own quarrels again, forgetting she was even there, she quietly got up, stepped outside, and made her way back to her arena. The stifling heat inside her body seemed to cling, heavy and wet, growing larger as it loomed over her. It burned in her veins, a restless, humid anger that only grew hotter. It drove her forward, made her run faster, strike harder, and lunge at her opponent with everything she had.

And it was then that she heard the gasps from the crowd.

Lupa looked down and saw flames spilling from her limbs, fierce and untamed, curling to engulf her whole.
records.zh:
燥热，是露帕对自己出生的那座小村庄最初的记忆。
夏季漫长，就连湖水都被蒸得滚烫，但七丘的孩子们并不太顾及这些。遥远的卡庇托山城中，大角斗赛即将开始。尽管这座村庄几乎从未诞生能够入围的选手，但那种热闹的气氛还是使人们蠢蠢欲动，以至于孩子们也拿起了武器，加入了对这场热闹赛事的模拟。
露帕是在和孩子们比赛的中途被喊回家的。
她走进家门，又是一场和往常无甚区别的对谈。父母问她愿不愿意去卡庇托山城生活，她说好。父母又问她愿不愿意成为角斗选手，因为她极可能成为共鸣者，她也说好。这样的问题已经重复了很多次，露帕每次都这么回答。于是她的血亲似乎终于安下心来，他们总担心被自己的女儿拒绝，尽管露帕从未表露出这样的意愿。
接着他们又开始争吵起来，为该不该回去向曾对他们的窘境置之不理的西尔瓦家示好，还是另寻他路从头开始。说到那座美丽的城市，那个他们曾依附的家族，他们的声音呈现出一种既想得到认同，又害怕被拒绝的调子——就和他们问露帕意愿时一样。
露帕又在椅子上坐着等了一会儿，看他们似乎已经沉浸在了争论中，没有再和她说话的意愿，便重新转身走出门去，准备回到她的赛场。躯体中的燥热像一片潮湿的阴云，在她狭窄的家中生长得庞大，笼罩在露帕头顶。潮湿躁动的热意与古怪的愤怒在她的血管中流淌，变得越发滚烫，它驱使着露帕不断在村庄小小的赛场上奔跑，并再次猛地挥枪进攻。
也就是在这一刻，她听到了周围人们的惊呼声。
露帕低下头，看到火从她的四肢百骸中漫出，熊熊燃烧，将她笼罩。

records.text:
By the time Lupa returned to the training room, the teammate she had partnered with for the past few months was already gone.

She stood there for a moment, dazed, before moving forward through the unlit room. Her Forte had gifted her with many things: fire, a sharpened sense of smell, and the ability to see in the dark. Without hesitation, Lupa made her way to a chair and sat down, settling quietly into the darkness.

"Well," she thought, "the Domina or manager will send someone new soon."

This farce was finally over.

They had found the mole, the one leaking the team secrets, the source of the rumors. Julia wasn't one for mercy. Therefore, that former teammate who sold them out would likely be barred from setting foot on any arena of Capitoline Hill for a very long time.

Over the years, as Lupa's fame grew, her teammates had come and gone. Some couldn't keep up with the way she fought. Others were dismissed simply because Julia didn't like them. A few, like her former teammate, had come with ill intent from the very start. And then there were those who... simply couldn't stand how the crowd's cheers always found her, leaving them forgotten in her shadow.

Lupa had tried to say something about it, but she quickly learned that even the act of "trying to say something" could cut like blades.

Maybe it was because she had never truly been in their shoes. After all, she had never tasted failure. Or maybe it was that unspoken "You'll never know what it feels like," and the fact that, when the dust settled, she was always the one who came out ahead.

Eventually, Lupa learned to stay silent.

After sitting there a while longer, she got up and walked over to the cabinet where the match recordings were kept. From the shelves, she pulled out one particular recording she had watched many times before. Perhaps it was a kind of self-consolation, clinging to the idea that even those without talent could still find joy in the arena, even though the Gladiator in that recording didn't last long and disappeared from the arena all too suddenly.

The light from Breen the Screen cast flickering shadows across Lupa's face, leaving deep, hollowed patches of darkness behind.
records.zh:
等露帕回到训练室的时候，刚刚搭档了数个月的队友已经离开了。
她愣了一会儿，才继续在没有开灯的室内向前走。共鸣能力为她带来了不少馈赠，譬如火，譬如灵敏的嗅觉，譬如夜视能力。露帕径直走到椅子附近坐下，就这样安静地坐在在空无一人的黑暗中。
好吧，她想，下一个应该很快会被经理和家主安排过来。
闹剧结束了。
他们找到了是谁在泄露队内的消息，也找到了那些谣言的源头，尤利娅女士不是个心性仁慈的人，她那位把消息卖给外人的队友恐怕很长时间都没法踏入卡庇托山城的赛场了。
这些年来，随着露帕的名声与日俱增，她的队友一直在被更换。有些是因为跟不上她成长的速度和打法，有些是尤利娅女士不喜欢，也有这种本就怀着恶意来的，还有一些……似乎只是无法忍耐在她身边被观众审视，因为那些目光只落在她身上，而不照耀别人。
露帕也曾为此尝试说些什么，但她很快发现，“说些什么”本身也会刺伤别人。
或许因为她并没有真的处在他们的境况中，她总是能获得胜利，或许因为“你怎么会懂”，而她总是事实上得到好处的那个。
久而久之，露帕也学会沉默。
又坐了一会儿，她径直走到储存录像的柜子里，从里面掏出一份看过很多次的赛事录像。露帕看它有些自我说服的念头在，为了寻求一些哪怕不具天赋也能享受竞技乐趣的可能性，尽管录像上的人也没有在赛场上一直坚持下去，而是骤然消失了。
转播布莱恩投出的光在她脸上闪动，留下一片深深的阴影。

records.text:
There were no stars at Startorch Academy.

Back then, the Sky Projection Array could only manage the most basic precipitation patterns, and the Spacetrek Collective, still in its early exploratory stage, had no spare resources to adorn the unfamiliar underground world with starlight.
 
But Mornye hadn't realized that the "stars" her mentor spoke of were the ones above the frostlands.
 
It happened during an expedition to the frostlands. Normally, no one would have thought to invite Mornye on such a mission, so when her mentor extended a hand toward her, she did not refuse.
 
She boarded the Starward Riseway bound for the world above. To her surprise, she was treated no differently from the rest of the team. She sat quietly in the humming vehicle, analyzing in real time the data collected by its roaring machinery. Occasionally, when the transport could go no further or when there was simply something worth seeing, her mentor would lift her onto {Male=his;Female=her} back and carry her through the snow.
 
Wind swept across the plains, cold flakes tearing at warm cheeks. The distance blurred into white, yet something vast and new seemed to unfold before her. At the end of the expedition, they arrived at the wreckage of an old machine. Sitting atop the ruins, they looked up at a sky thick with stars.
 
"Do you like the stars?"

Her mentor's voice broke the quiet. Mornye followed {Male=his;Female=her} gaze, looking up at those fragments that had traveled from light-years away.
 
"Seeing the stars makes us curious. They make us ask what else is out there." 
"I think... One day, you'll all prove that the blockage in the sky isn't the end. There will come a day humanity reaches the stars." 

Ah. So that was it.

The first thing she realized was that she and everyone else were equally small.
She, her father, her mother, her classmates back home, and this person next to her. Beneath the boundless night, they were nothing more than dust drifting on a single planet.
 
Then came the memories she had forced herself to bury.
The pain of falling the first time she tried to climb the railing.
The cry she choked back when her mother left home. 
The secretive glances in her old school, the way silently made for her passage.
The unsettling calm she felt when she once imagined ending everything herself.

And then, a restless yearning surged.
 
It was unlike anything she had ever felt, a fierce tide rising so violently it felt like a defiance of something vast and incomprehensible. A cold spark ignited in her silenced chest, tearing apart the quiet she had built to survive her narrow world.
 
Then the starlight leaned toward her.
 
Tears spilled. Heartbeat thundered. She reached out toward the person beside her, toward the distant light stretching into infinity.
 
"I… want to reach that future, too."
records.zh:
星炬学院没有星星。彼时的大气拟造阵列还只具备最基础的降水功能，还在探索阶段的深空联合也尚无余力对这片陌生的地下世界进行装点。
但莫宁没有想到，那位前辈所说的星星，是冰原之上的世界。
那是一次前往冰原之上的科考。平日没有人会邀请莫宁参加这样的行动，因此在{TA}向自己伸出手时，她反而没有拒绝。
于是她坐上了通往冰原之上的联运椎骨。意外的，大多数时间她都和其他科考队员没什么不同，安坐在交通工具中，一路计算着那些轰鸣的庞大机械收集得来的数据。偶尔，当他们的交通工具无法通行——或者只是单纯的有什么值得一看的景色时，那位前辈会背着她，走在风雪之中。
雪原中的风夹杂着冰片擦过滚烫的面颊。远方的面貌在雪风中模糊不清，但似乎有崭新的世界在她面前豁然展开。
考察的最后，他们抵达了一片机械的残骸，坐在废墟之上，仰望漫天星辰。
“你喜欢星星吗？”
那个人这样说着。莫宁跟随{TA}抬起头，望向那些自光年外而来的碎片。
“正因为能看到星星，人类才会对天空之外的世界产生好奇。
“我想，你们会证明，这看似永恒的隔绝并非终点。人们终有一日能以自己的意志，迈向星辰大海”
——啊，原来如此。
她首先意识到的，是他人与自己是同等渺小的存在。她，父亲，母亲，故乡的同学，还有{TA}。在浩瀚无垠的群星下，都只是这颗星球里一颗微不足道的尘埃。
紧接着，她回想起那些被自己刻意压制的痛苦。她想起第一次翻越护栏时坠地的疼痛，想起母亲离开家时被她咽下的哭喊，想起故乡的学校里孩子们秘而不宣的眼神，被让出的过道，想起她想象自己结束一切时那令人不安的平静。
最后，不甘翻涌而来。
那是一种前所未有的情绪，它是如此强烈地席卷了她，以至于像是对某种伟大存在的宣战。一簇冰冷的星火在她沉寂的胸腔点燃，带着灼痛的引力，将她因守于狭小世界而维持的平静撕毁殆尽。
然后，星光倾斜而来。
带着泪水，带着心脏的轰鸣，她像身边人一般伸出手，伸向那无穷远处的星光。
——“我也想……抵达那样的未来。”

records.text:
The marketplace was always lively in the afternoons, stalls of every kind lining the streets. An old candy maker slowly stirred a pot of syrup, golden strands trailing from his ladle in fine, gleaming arcs. Steam billowed from the bun shop nearby, carrying the rich smell of meat and chili far down the road. In an open square, a mechanical stage had drawn a crowd: a troupe of Autopuppets tumbled and danced to the beat of the drums, earning burst after burst of applause from the onlookers.

Jingran stopped by a fabric shop to pick out a bolt of moon-white cloth for Yanshu, then bought Nian a mechanical jade rabbit that could hop about on its own. As he paid, the shopkeeper smiled and complimented his taste. But Jingran wasn't nearly so confident. Picking gifts for his Shifu's old lady and his little sister had always proven far more troublesome than venturing into any Mirage Realm. Not long ago, he'd brought Nian a mechanical pellet drum, two round-faced lucky children painted on either side. Spin it, and the little figures would bob their heads and unfurl a tiny scroll that read "Good Fortune and Prosperity." Jingran had thought the thing was a stroke of genius. Nian, however, crossed her arms as he showed her how it worked, then heaved a world-weary sigh. "Bubba, I'm really too old for this."

The pellet drum ended up back in Jingran's hands. That evening, he fiddled with it late into the night, quietly wondering what on earth was wrong with it. That question still haunts him.

With that memory still fresh, he bought the jade rabbit without a second thought. Nian will definitely like this one. Before leaving, he made one last stop at a pastry shop for a Little Snowy Moon—layers of snow-white cake stacked neatly into the shape of a full moon, as if sculpted from fresh-fallen snow. The shopkeeper smiled and asked if they were for his family. Jingran didn't answer. He simply took the paper-wrapped parcel and ambled off toward the river.

It was the day Qiuyuan left Mengzhou.

A strong wind swept across the water at the dock, setting the flecks of gold dancing on the surface. The passenger ship had nearly finished casting off.

Jingran spotted him from a distance, a lone figure in black standing beside the ship, robes snapping sharply in the wind. As always, he carried the unmistakable air of a man best left undisturbed. Jingran found his thoughts drifting back to stories from years ago.

Whenever his master had one drink too many, he would bring up a certain young swordsman. A once-in-a-generation talent, he'd claim. The praise had stoked Jingran's curiosity for years. Now he had finally met the man in the flesh. Unfortunately, he still hadn't had the chance to test himself against that sword the man's holding.

Qiuyuan noticed him too, and dipped his head in greeting.

Jingran waved and strolled over. Stopping at the railing, he glanced out at the river before drawling, "Got everything packed away?"

Qiuyuan knew he meant the modular part recovered from Muyu. He nodded. But before he could answer, Jingran raised a hand.

"Save it."

"I couldn't care less about the old dramas and squabbles of Mingting. What I need to know, I already know. What I don't, I've no interest in knowing. So spare me the explanation."

Another gust swept across the water, scattering the reflections into rippling fragments.

"That said," Jingran went on, turning to him with a raised brow, "I did help you get what you came for. I'm putting that one on your tab."

Qiuyuan tilted his head slightly, those deep gray eyes as unreadable as ever.

"What do you want?"

"Haven't decided yet."

Jingran grinned.

"When I think of something, I'll come collect."

Silence settled between them for a moment.

At last, Qiuyuan nodded.

"Very well."

Satisfied, Jingran pushed the paper-wrapped parcel he'd been carrying into the other man's arms.

"Here. A parting gift."

The river wind tugged at their sleeves. In the distance, the boatman began calling passengers aboard, and the dock grew busier. Qiuyuan tucked the parcel away and turned toward the ship. After a few steps, he stopped.

"Jingran."

"Hm?"

"Offer a stick of incense to your Shifu for me."

Jingran went still. Then, after a moment, he smiled.

"Sure."

The ferry pulled slowly away. Water lapped against the hull, sending rings of ripples spreading across the river. Little by little the vessel drifted into the evening mist, until it melted into the dusk. Jingran stayed where he was, watching until the silhouettes of man and ship had vanished into the gilded horizon.

The wind stirred the reeds along the riverbank.

At that very moment, he remembered another evening, many years ago. His Shifu had been sitting outside the courtyard gate, shelling peanuts as he talked about that young swordsman. Every time the story reached a good part, the old man would laugh and clap him on the shoulder.

"You're not half bad yourself, brat. Give it a few more years, and I'll take you to Chongzhou to cross blades with him in person."

Back then, Jingran had had little idea what Chongzhou was really like. He'd simply taken his Shifu at his word and gazed off toward the horizon beyond Mengzhou. Dusk had been spilling over the mountain ridges from the far side. Birds crossed the sky overhead, beating their wings toward lands farther still.

Jingran lowered his head and chuckled softly. Then he turned and started for home.

The sun had already sunk behind the mountains, leaving only a thin ribbon of molten gold along the horizon.

One by one, lanterns lit up the length of the street, their warm glow stretching on and on down the limestone road.

And by that light, Jingran found the road that led home.
records.zh:
午后的街市向来热闹。街边支着各式摊棚，卖糖人的老人正慢悠悠熬着糖浆，金黄糖丝在勺尖拉出细亮的弧光，包子铺前热气腾腾，混着辣椒与肉香飘出老远，空地上搭着机关戏台，几个素偶踩着鼓点翻腾跳跃，引得人们一阵阵喝彩。
景燃先去绸缎铺替烟舒挑了匹月白细布，又给阿念买了只会自己蹦跶的机关玉兔。付钱时老板笑眯眯地夸他眼光不错，景燃却没什么底气——给师娘和师妹挑东西向来比下蜃境麻烦得多。前阵子他给阿念带个机关拨浪鼓回去，鼓面上画着两个圆滚滚的小福娃，一转起来便会摇头晃脑，手上拉开一张写着“吉祥如意”的纸卷。景燃觉得挺有意思，然阿念抱着手臂看了半天，十分老成地叹了口气：“阿兄，我已经不是玩这个的年纪了。”
那拨浪鼓最后落到了景燃自己手里。他悻悻地坐在灯下玩了半夜，心想这不挺好玩的嘛……至今也没想明白问题出在哪儿。
想到这里，景燃顺手把那只机关玉兔买了下来。这个阿念肯定得喜欢了。
临走前，他又绕去糕点铺，买了一份满轮映雪——雪白的糖糕层层叠叠，像新雪堆出来的一轮圆月，老板笑着问他是不是给家里人带的，景燃没答，只拎着纸包晃悠悠往河边去了。

今日仇远离开梦州。
渡口风大，江面碎金浮动，停泊的客船已经解开了大半缆绳。景燃远远便看见那道身影立在船边，一袭黑衣被江风吹得猎猎作响，依旧是那副生人勿近的模样。景燃想起很多年前，师父喝高了酒，总爱提起这么个人，说是难能一见的奇才，惹得他那时候天天惦记着，如今倒是见着了，可惜没机会见一见他怀中剑的本事。
仇远显然也注意到了他，转身微微颔首。
景燃摆摆手走过去，在栏杆边站定，先往江里看了一眼，才懒洋洋开口：“东西收好了？”
仇远知道他说的是从木禺那儿得来的活字块，点了点头，正要开口，景燃却先一步抬手打断：“打住。”
“——你们明庭那些陈芝麻烂谷子的是是非非，我没兴趣听。该知道的我知道，不该知道的我也不想知道，无需讲与我听。”
江风吹过河面，卷起细碎波光。
“不过这回，我帮你拿到了想要的东西。”景燃偏过头，冲他扬了扬眉，“这人情我可记着呢。”
仇远微微偏过头，那双深灰的眼中不起波澜。
“你想要什么？”
“现在没想好。”景燃笑了，“等哪天想起来了，再找你讨。”
仇远静了片刻，最终点头：“好。”
景燃这才满意，顺手将一直提着的纸包塞进他怀里：“送别礼，收好了。”

江风自河面吹来，卷起两人的衣摆。远处船家已经开始催人登船，渡口渐渐热闹起来，仇远收起纸包，转身朝渡船走去。走出几步后，他忽然停下。
“景燃。”
“嗯？”
“替我向你师父上炷香。”
景燃微微一怔。片刻后，他笑着应了一声：“行。”

渡船缓缓离岸。江水拍打船舷，荡开层层涟漪，船影顺流而去，渐渐融入暮色与江雾之间。景燃站在岸边，看着那道背影一点点远去，直到最后船身隐没在水天相接的昏黄里。
晚风掠过河面，吹得岸边芦苇轻轻摇曳。
他忽然想起很多年前，师父坐在院门口边剥花生边与他说起那个擅剑的年轻人，说到兴起处便笑着拍自己的肩，说你小子也不差，等再长大些，就带你去重州亲自跟他比划两招——那时候的景燃对遥远的重州没什么概念，他只是顺着师父的话抬起头，望向梦州的天边，暮色正从山脊另一头漫过来，飞鸟掠过长空，朝着更遥远的地方振翅。
景燃低头笑了笑，转身往回走去。
此时夕阳已沉入群山之后，天边只余下一线流金。长街两侧的灯笼次第亮起，暖黄灯火沿着青石路一路蜿蜒出去，他顺着那灯火，望见归家的路。

records.text:
Calcharo "the Vicious" was once one of the Exiles in the New Federation's Lawless Zone. He has long mastered all kinds of insidious strategies to survive. Nowadays, he has grown even more ruthless for his mercenary: Poisoning, assassination, bribery, kidnapping, bombs... He'd do whatever he found necessary to get the job done. Rumors of Calcharo's impossible feats circulated endlessly. Some spoke of him staying in the desert for 7 days without water for a planned ambush, others of him donning bombs all over his body during a past negotiation. There were even whispers of him hiring killers to fake his assassination in a scheme to garner trust.

While potentially exaggerated, the rumors were not entirely unfathomable to those who knew Calcharo personally. However, the stories became even more outlandish as time passed... 

"He single-handedly stopped a truck at 12; when he turned 15, his Forte made the whole New Federation shudder in fear. He even fought the entire country's cops at 18 and left unscathed..." 

"His chest is home to the dead spirits, and his forehead bears curses of the gods. Beneath his feet strikes thunder, and out of his eyes shoots flames. His rage will never be quenched until heaven burns down..." 

"He has been to hell and back, time and time again... He will always come as a lightning, a phantom, and reclaim everything he deserves..." 

The latest rumors about Calcharo have become one of the go-to topics among the mercenary members when off-duty.

But the man himself seems unfazed... He's either desensitized already or scheming to capitalize on the rumors.

In the Lawless Zone, friends can become enemies in an instant—as common as changing air currents. Change is constant, even in the most unexpected places. What once seemed harmful can instantly become a useful tool. It all depends on how we choose to use it.

Rumors sow prejudices. Prejudices grow into misconceptions. Misconceptions produce misjudgments.

And in a cut-throat game, misjudgment of enemy strength is always a bane.
records.zh:
“恶犬”卡卡罗，曾是“无法地带”流放者的一员，为了生存，早已练就了极为阴险的战斗技巧，如今为维护佣兵团口碑，投毒、收买、绑架人质、预埋炸弹……更是各种手段无所不用其极。坊间一直流传着关于卡卡罗的凶狠传闻，诸如能在炎热的沙漠中埋伏七天七夜滴水不喝，在身上绑满定时炸弹前去谈判，为骗取信任雇佣杀手刺杀自己……
种种传说虽含有夸大成分，却并非无根之谈，熟悉卡卡罗的人都不会怀疑——这些确实都是他能够做出来的事情。
然而，这类传说却随着时间的推移又产生了愈演愈烈的趋势……
“12岁时他能够单手截停运输车，15岁时他的异能令整个新联邦为之颤抖，18岁时一人对抗新联邦全部警力，最后全身而退……”
“他的胸口寄宿着鬼魂，额头上是神明降下的诅咒。他的双脚踏出闪电，他的双眼燃着火焰，誓要将怒火燃向高天……”
“历尽死亡，几度重生……无论多少次，他都会如幽灵般归来，夺回他的一切……”
关于卡卡罗今天又被造了什么谣的话题，已经成为了团员们每天茶余饭后必备的闲谈甜点。
至于卡卡罗本人，则显得尤为淡然……要么是早已见怪不怪，要么，就是在盘算着如何利用这些谣言。
在无法之地，让朋友成为敌人，或是令敌人成为朋友，就像风改变它的流向那样简单……更何况是其他事物呢？
一切事物都可以转化，有利或不利，从不绝对。二者的区别，只在于如何使用。
谣言带来偏见，偏见带来误解，误解带来错判。
而错判对手的实力，永远是博弈的大忌。

records.text:
Calcharo started from scratch but made his reputation in only a few short years. His success stemmed from two factors: One, he was willing to take on dangerous but lucrative jobs others didn't dare to tackle. Two, he had a flexible moral code that allowed him to work with all types of people.
 
He took the cash, he did the job. He promised, he delivered.
 
From armed protection to disposal of hazardous materials, he always got the job done flawlessly. But if his clients reneged on their end, they were in for a lifetime of being hunted by Calcharo.
 
Such "impartiality" earned him fear and acquiescence from other powers in the area.
 
Calcharo sees business as a mere exchange of values, where no job is too immoral, and no secrets are kept. Every transaction is fair game.
 
Nevertheless, value is not always weighed in terms of money. When faced with desperate, impoverished people begging for help, Calcharo would charge a symbolic fee of one Shell Credit in his own name. The grateful beneficiaries were unaware that this gift became their binding contract with Calcharo, and favors are never easy to repay.

Never accept a deal that brings no benefits. That's Calcharo's core principle.

This approach allowed Calcharo to cultivate many eyes and ears among the common folk, creating a formidable intelligence network that spans all walks of life.

Venal, merciless, and vengeful—these are just some of the words others used to describe Calcharo. Yet even his critics admit that his network has prevented much unnecessary bloodshed. No one can be sure if a lady selling street food in an alley is one of Calcharo's informants. Any bully aiming to harm the common people must consider that before acting.
records.zh:
白手起家的卡卡罗，之所以能在短短几年之内打出名声，一方面源于卡卡罗总是敢于接取那些出生入死，一般人完成不了的高价委托，另一方面，则源于他那与任何人都可以达成合作的模糊道德观。
拿钱办事，天经地义。契约既定，使命必达。
武装押运，涉险夺人，无音区清理……又或是其他隐秘的业务，只要拿到酬金，卡卡罗便一定会将事情办妥。
若是雇主失信，那就需要做好被卡卡罗追杀到天涯海角的准备。
如此“公正信誉”，自然是为卡卡罗换来了各方势力的忌惮与默许。
没有什么不道德的委托，没有什么不可告人的买卖，一切只是“价值交换”，这便是卡卡罗所认为的交易的本质。
只是很多时候，价值，并不总以金钱来衡量。
在面对那些付不起高额酬劳的底层民众时，卡卡罗往往只会以个人的名义，象征性地收取一枚贝币。
在受惠者感恩戴义之时，殊不知这份礼物，早已成为了卡卡罗与他们所签订的契约……人情，可是最难以还清的债务。
绝不接受没有利益的委托，永远是卡卡罗的第一原则。
凭借这一理念，卡卡罗将不少市井小民都收归为了眼线，积累起强大的情报与人脉关系网，渗透进了各个境域。
唯利是图，心狠手辣，睚眦必报。这即是外界对于卡卡罗的评价。
但外界也不得不承认，卡卡罗以其手段所建立的秩序，的确避免了许多不必要的厮杀——毕竟谁也不知道，那个巷子里卖小吃的阿姨是否是卡卡罗的线人。
任何欺软怕硬的家伙，在想对这些平民百姓出手时，也都要因为这一点而先退让三分。

records.text:
Many Exiles were blocked from finding legitimate work in the New Federation, facing endless discrimination and prejudice.

They resorted to building camps in the country's outskirts, and the place where they gathered became the "Lawless Zone". 

To better survive, Exiles in the Lawless Zone formed various gangs. 

Back then, a gang named the "Underdogs" quickly rose to fame. 

The first members of the Underdogs were just a bunch of children around the age of 12. As children, they were bullied and ousted, until one fearless boy united them. He observed those who were bullied and invited them to join. With strategic planning and unwavering bravery, the Underdogs gained notoriety among rival gangs.

In this gang, there was no hierarchy or politics—only a primal need for survival and freedom.

However, the members died one after another: murdered by rivaling gangs, betrayed by those they trusted, or trapped by deceitful patrons.

Time showed them no mercy in the Lawless Zone. It was every man for himself.

In the end, the leader boy decided to take fate into his own hands once again, risking it all in a daring gamble for power.

...

Years later, the New Federation waged war against "the Underdogs," the last gang in the Lawless Zone. In a sudden twist, a new mercenary group known as "Ghost Hounds" annexed the "Underdogs" overnight and put an end to the chaos. 

Only then did people discover that the mercenary group's leader shared a name with the former head boy of the "Underdogs." 

He had returned in a horrific figure, almost like a ghost. He was surrounded by shadowy thorns, and accompanied by fearsome phantoms. 

This time, he would reach the top of the ladder, and finish what he once failed to accomplish due to naivety, sympathy, and indecisiveness. 

But despite all the time that had passed, he couldn't shake off the memory of that one afternoon. The sun was shining down on them as they established the Underdog in a desolate dump site. 

It was a rare moment of tenderness in his life.
records.zh:
在过去的新联邦，歧视与偏见，曾是流放者们寻求合法工作的最大阻碍。
位于新联邦外围的流放者聚集地，也曾因此被称作“无法地带”。
帮派，则是无法地带的流放者们独特的生存方式。
在那个帮派横行的年代，曾有一支“恶狗帮”名噪一时。
恶狗帮最初的成员，是一批不过12岁左右的少年。
为首的少年不甘于其他帮派的压迫，暗中跟随所有被欺辱过的孩子，向他们发出邀请。
少年展现出惊人的手段与魄力，令恶狗帮在几年内迅速崛起。
帮派内没有等级，没有压迫，有的，只是少年们对生存与自由的渴望。
可成员们最终却接连死于其他帮派的窥视觊觎，死于合作者的阴谋暗算，死于金主的归顺变节。
时代并没有善待他们。在无法地带，相互背叛就是宿命，不向上攀登，便只能任人宰割。
醒悟的少年，向命运发起了一场赌博。
……
许久之后，新联邦对无法地带最后的帮派“恶狗帮”展开大规模清剿行动，引发了惨烈的战争。
于时，一支秘密组建，名为“幽灵猎犬”的佣兵团，在一夜之间便将“恶狗帮”吞并，终结了这场混乱。
浩劫过后，人们才注意到，该佣兵团首领的名字，竟与恶狗帮曾经的首领如出一辙。
荆棘环绕，幻影加身。
他以一种宛如幽灵般可怖的形象，再次回到了这里。
这一次，他会站在顶点，完成那些因自己的天真、恻隐、游移而未能完成的事情。
只是……多年以后，他仍会想起，在垃圾场中，他与同伴成立“恶狗帮”的那个午后——那却是他生命中为数不多的温存。

records.text:
"Always count your ammo, check your weapons, wear your protective gears, and make sure your Terminals are online..."

Though fully aware of the inherent danger in their profession, Calcharo still finds himself going over safety reminders before missions, or silently observing his team as they take on quests or report back. It's a fatherly instinct he can't shake, always worrying about their well-being despite the inevitable bloodshed.

To ensure their safety, Calcharo made a set of rules:

"Team formation is free, but members must be informed and not coerced."

"Job details must be kept secret to external parties." 

"Observe local laws and regulations." 

"Betrayal is forbidden, punishable by execution." 

...

Behind the rules lies Calcharo's deep care for his group.

Calcharo has always known that the abyss looks back. Staying in this kill-or-be-killed business is never the best solution.

Therefore, Calcharo decided to keep a low profile and start looking for legal business ventures.

However, his caution drew threats as some new rivals attempted to replace Ghost Hounds. In an act of provocation, they severely injured a Ghost Hound recruit, breaking one of the "unstated rules" of the underworld.

The group thought they had gotten away with their actions against Calcharo, but the following day they were wiped out from the surface of the planet. The incident was dismissed as an accidental fire. No one spoke out, though everyone knew the truth.

Barking dogs do not bite, but if you cross the sleeping dog's line, it will be too late to run when it wakes and shows its teeth.
records.zh:
“出发前一定要清点弹药，检查武器损耗，确认防护装备穿戴整齐，小队行动必须确保彼此终端连接正常……“
尽管像雇佣兵这种刀尖舔血，九死一生的工作免不了伤亡，团员们也早有觉悟，但卡卡罗还是会在成员出战时，事无巨细不厌其烦地进行叮嘱，在成员交接任务时默默在背后注视一切，对自家人总是有操不完的心……像是一位天生的操劳命苦当家。
为此，卡卡罗曾为佣兵团定下十余条守则：
“成员享有自由组队的权利，但必须提前告知风险，不得以任何方式强迫其他成员……”
“委托内容对外必须保密……”
“成员必须遵守各城邦基本法律规定……”
“严禁任何形式的出卖与背叛行为，违者，死罪。”
……
缜密的条文之下，尽是卡卡罗的一片苦心。
卡卡罗始终明白，行走于黑暗边缘，必会被黑暗浸染。卖命生意，终不是长久之计。
为此，卡卡罗选择了低调行事，开始为佣兵团招揽各类合法生意，寻求更多的机会与可能。
长久的收敛为佣兵团招来了外部的觊觎，其中不乏一些妄图取而代之的新兴势力，他们曾无视“规矩”，将一名佣兵团新人打至重伤作为挑衅。
就在对方认为卡卡罗选择了忍气吞声之时，在一个夜晚，这支势力，于爆燃的火光中，彻底从这颗星球的历史上消失了。
这一事件在后来被包装成了一起“意外火灾“，相关机构均保持了沉默——尽管他们全部心知肚明。
狂吠的野狗往往不会咬人，而一旦触碰到了那头沉睡恶犬的底线，待他醒来，展露獠牙时再想逃跑……早已为时过晚。

records.text:
Yuanwu maintains a simple daily routine. Every day in the early morning, he opens up his gym and proceeds to clean the pieces of training equipment one by one. Then he boils a pot of tea and greets customers while savoring it.

For those seeking to learn martial arts, Yuanwu assesses their physique and current condition before suggesting a suitable style. The intensity of training can be tailored to individual preferences, whether for physical fitness or making a name in the martial arts world. Every customer is heard attentively, with Yuanwu patiently crafting a personalized practice plan for their goals. Even those who enter without a clear purpose are welcomed with warm hospitality and offered guidance in exploring their interests.

As soon as a client steps through the gym's front door, Yuanwu's kind eyes immediately meet theirs. 

"Leave your worries behind and lift your spirits in our gym. Let's start with some easy punches to unwind."

From just a few moves and punches, Yuanwu can tell the guest's current physical condition and recommend a suitable training plan.

"Your posture is slouched, and your walk lacks stability... The lower back muscles appear strained. Try this set of moves: three slow punches followed by one fast. This should provide relief."

After practicing as per his instructions, the customer should feel a significant sense of relaxation, both mentally and physically. Before leaving, Yuanwu would say goodbye with just the right amount of genuine concern, almost like an old friend.

"Feeling better now? That's good. And don't forget to ease up on those usual tense days. Take this pack of tea with you, it'll help you unwind."

Among the numerous boxing gyms of various sizes in Jinzhou, only Yuanwu's gym enjoys such sustained popularity.
records.zh:
渊武的日程很简单，每天上午拉开店铺门，挨个擦亮悬挂着的练习用拳具。然后煮上一壶茶，边饮边招呼客人。
有兴趣学拳的人，渊武会根据他们的身体素质和当前状况推荐适合练习的拳法。练到何种境界就全看个人意愿了，只求强身健体也好，想要打出名堂也罢，渊武会静静地听着顾客们的诉求，然后制定出合适的练习方案。就算不知道自己具体有什么诉求，只是懵懵懂懂走进来，想看一眼凑个热闹的客人，渊武也能招待周到。

从进门开始，渊武那深邃的目光就会温和地落到客人身上。
“既然来了拳馆，就把眉头舒展开，忘掉那些烦心事吧。打上一两套拳放松放松，或许能让你开心些。”
只要比划几下，他就能看出客人当前的身体状况，并推荐合适的方案。
“体态不正，下盘不稳……唔，腰肌看着有些劳损。可以试试这套拳路，三静一动。”
按他说的练上两套，身体和心情总有一个能放松不少。临出门前，他也会像老朋友一样，送上恰到好处的关心。
“嗯？轻松了不少？那就好，平时也记得不要太过紧绷。带上这包茶吧，喝了能让你放松些。”

今州城里大大小小的武馆不少，唯独渊武拳馆的生意一直这么好。

records.text:
It is said that Yuanwu Boxing Gym's owner is willing to help his customers with any kind of trouble, even those not related to working out.

One day, Mahe, a customer usually focused and devoted during workouts, was suddenly off his game. Yuanwu picked up on that and asked him if something was wrong. Mahe's demeanor was somber as he led Yuanwu to the gym's locker, where he pulled out a delicate dinner plate from his belongings.

The plate had a circle of small red flowers on the edge. Yuanwu recognized it as an enamel craft from overseas. The flowers were perfect, except for a small missing piece of the gold rim. The entire plate appeared incomplete without it.

It was a gift Mahe prepared for Panhua. A few years ago, when Panhua Restaurant opened, Mahe promised that he would find the world's most beautiful dinner plate to serve the world's most flavorful meals. Even though the two of them later parted ways due to differences in ideals, Mahe still remembered his promise.

He stuck to his ideals, but couldn't let go of his affection for her.

For years, he searched for the perfect dinner plate, one that wasn't too flashy or tacky. Finally, his eyes landed on this simple yet elegant piece - white with red flowers. It was just right.

The plate was expensive, and he had a hard time securing the funds to buy it. His anxiety mounted as he debated whether to give the gift. Would it be appropriate? Should he send it anyway? During his hesitation, a section of the filigree gold rim that adorned the plates went inexplicably missing. He asked all the vendors in Jinzhou, but they either weren't familiar with imported porcelain or didn't dare to attempt fixing such valuable items. Mahe was left in a predicament.

Having listened to Mahe's situation, Yuanwu gently picked up the dinner plate, telling Mahe to come pick it up a week later.

When Mahe came back, the flowers were perfectly arranged in a circle, with no signs of repair.

In return, Yuanwu only asked Mahe to bring him and the repaired plate to Panhua Restaurant for a meal.

Served on the beautiful plate adorned with enameled flowers, the spicy, fragrant dishes looked even more enticing. Panhua's smile looked peculiarly charming that day, and the usually reticent Mahe managed to put a smile on his face too. It was truly an enjoyable dinner.

No matter how popular the gym was as a business, to charge so little for work like this seemed like a bad bargain to many.

Yuanwu, however, simply shrugged it off with a smile, as if money was the least important thing to him.
records.zh:
据说只要成为了渊武拳馆的常客，就连锻炼之外的事情，只要渊武老板能解决的，都会帮忙解决。
一次，锻炼时总是板板正正的马和频繁漏招，发力方式也和平时有所不同。渊武问他是否遇到了什么烦心事，马和沉着脸，思索再三，垂头丧气地带渊武来到拳馆的寄存柜，从自己的包裹中翻出一个精巧的餐盘。

餐盘四周绘制着一圈红艳艳的小花，色泽鲜丽，光彩夺目，渊武一眼认出这是海外的珐琅彩工艺。美中不足的是小花上的掐丝金边少了一段，整个盘子缺了这处，看起来就不再圆满。
这是马和给攀花准备的礼物。几年前攀花饭馆开张时，马和就说过，要找一个世上最好看的餐盘来盛这世上最香的饭菜。即使后来两人因理念不合而分道扬镳，马和还是记得自己当初的承诺。
他坚持自己的道路，却也放不下对她的情谊。
这些年他一直在寻找好看的餐盘，有的太艳，有的太俗。直到这个白底红花、艳而不俗的餐盘闯进他的眼帘。
餐盘昂贵，他好不容易凑钱买齐，又辗转反侧，不知道如今的自己该不该送出手。在他犹豫的这些时日里，餐盘上装饰着的掐丝金边莫名其妙少了一段。他问遍了今州城里的商贩，要么不熟悉舶来品，要么嫌餐盘太贵不敢修，实在不知道该怎么办才好。

渊武听罢，轻轻拿起餐盘，说一周后来取。
一周后，小花圆圆满满簇成一团，甚至看不出修补的痕迹。
而渊武要求的报酬，仅仅是让马和带上餐盘，和他一起去找攀花吃上一顿。
麻辣鲜香的菜肴配上红花簇拥的盘子，确实相得益彰，鲜艳诱人。攀花的笑容愈发明丽，寡言少语的马和脸上也有了笑意，这顿饭吃得很是畅快。

就算拳馆再怎么生意兴隆，收这么点报酬办这么一桩事，怎么看都是亏本生意。
渊武却只是笑笑，仿佛钱财对于他来说，是最不重要的事。

records.text:
Located on the frontier, Jinzhou boasts a robust martial arts culture, featuring numerous gyms of varying sizes. In this relatively tranquil era, the once stringent and harsh customs governing duels gradually waned, making way for more "amicable" consultations and exchanges between gyms.

Where people gather, politics inevitably follows. Despite the activities being cloaked under the banner of exchanges, behind the scenes, individuals engaged in secret competitions, employing every means to emerge victorious. After all, this provides a rare opportunity for publicity. A simple statement from the winner about their affiliated gym brings about a surge in attention and lucrative business contracts.

As the event gains more influence, an increasing number of gyms decide to participate. Surprisingly, even Yuanwu, known for his indifference to fame and fortune, threw his hat into the ring.

Yuanwu's gym was already a flourishing and enviable business. His participation immediately stirred up trouble among some vested interests, with the most perturbed being the previous top-ranker, Wenxi. Wenxi, a businessman, treated both his gym and participation in the event as mere publicity tools for his weapon workshop, emphasizing commercial benefits. Notably, his top rank was purchased, not earned.

Understanding Yuanwu's capabilities and recognizing that his gym was not overly corporate, Wenxi personally visited and extended a tempting offer to buy out Yuanwu. However, Yuanwu rejected the proposal without a second thought.

Unfazed, Wenxi resorted to paying substantial sums to some of Yuanwu's regulars to divulge every detail of Yuanwu's boxing techniques. He then went on to bribe the referees and staff overseeing the finals, ensuring they turned a blind eye to the tampering he did with the fighters' suits.

On the day of the finals, a surprising surge of thunder filled the air, only to dissipate in an instant. Between the flash and the sudden calm, both suits were struck open. The scorching thunder precisely hit the costumes, avoiding unprotected skin; a little further, and the fighters' joints would have been burned. The exposed inner workings of the broken suits revealed all the clandestine schemes, causing an uproar among the spectators and thus leading to the suspension of the match.

Following an investigation, the horrifying thunder during the match was attributed to accidents caused by the concealed devices within the suits. Simultaneously, Wenxi's weapon workshop, responsible for manufacturing such devices, came under scrutiny.

Before long, the workshop mysteriously vanished, fading into oblivion along with the rigged fighting events.

After the storm had settled, Yuanwu Boxing Gym returned to its usual lively state, a small haven bustling with patrons. For the sharp-eyed customers, a subtle difference might be observed–a few familiar faces were absent from the crowd coming in and out of the premises.
records.zh:
今州地处边塞，城中好武之风盛行，大大小小的武馆开了不少。在如今这个相对和平的年代，曾经严格残酷的打擂机制渐渐淘汰，演化成武馆间“友好”的磋商交流。
有人的地方就有江湖，虽说是以交流为名，却有人暗自较劲，动用一切手段，试图在比赛中拔得头筹。毕竟这可是个不可多得的展示机会，只要将自家武馆推上首位，收获关注，各种生意合约不就源源不断地来了？

就这样，打擂活动越办越大，参加的武馆越来越多。今年这届，就连一向淡泊名利的渊武老板都报名参加了。
渊武拳馆本就生意兴隆惹人眼红，渊武这么一参加，很快就有些人坐不住了。最坐不住的当属上届榜首玟玺。玟玺是个商人，无论是开设拳馆还是参加打擂，都只是为了给自家武器厂搏一些知名度，获取商业效益。榜首之位自然也是买来的。

玟玺知道渊武的实力，也知道渊武拳馆并不算大。于是早早就亲自登门拜访，开出诱人的价码，企图买通渊武。
渊武自然是一口回绝。玟玺一计不成又生一计，花重金买通数位场内人员，将渊武的出招路数和力度了解了个十成十，又买通决赛当天的裁判和场务，在各自使用的拳具里做了手脚。

决赛当天，雷光瞬间暴涨，又在瞬间熄灭。一闪一灭之间，两幅拳具各被击破，雷击的焦灼精准停留在快要触碰到皮肤的位置，再往前一点就会灼伤关节。破碎的拳具吐出暗藏玄机的内里，一切小算盘都暴露在雷光之下。全场哗然，比赛中止。
经过调查，擂台上那骇人的雷光被定义为拳具中机关引发的意外，而制造这种机关的玟玺武器厂也受到了调查。
没过多久，玟玺武器厂就和不公正的打擂比赛一起，默默消失在了时代的尘埃中。

风波过后，渊武拳馆还是一如往常，地方不大，门客熙攘。如果说有什么不同，眼尖的熟客会发现，店里进进出出的人群中，少了几张熟面孔。

records.text:
The standout feature that sets Yuanwu Boxing Gym apart from others is the emphasis on comfort.

Under Boss Yuanwu's guidance, practitioners go through their routines, ending each session by wiping away the sweat and indulging in a pot of tea. The comfort! Whether practicing the nimble Xianfengquan, the powerful Leihuangquan, or the flexible Sanfuquan, Yuanwu has paired each style of boxing with a specific tea boasting complementary benefits. Practitioners, sipping the hot brew after their workouts, relax their muscles, invigorate circulation, and dispel fatigue.

Yuanwu personally tested these tea formulas before handing them over to the neighboring teahouse, which thrives with a booming business. Requests for tea bookings are usually made months in advance, and while occasional delays occur, they never affect Yuanwu's orders to be delivered as scheduled. Speculations arise about Yuanwu not being the ordinary, idle gym boss he appears to be, but rather a big shot overseeing multiple enterprises. Could this highly sought-after tea be just another facet of his business?

When confronted with inquiries, Yuanwu merely smiles and hands over a cup of tea, saying, "Stop chasing shadows. Have some tea and refresh. Sweat more, conjecture less." After a practice session and a cup of tea, with the nose filled with the fresh aroma, doubts and anxieties disperse with the droplets of sweat. Questions about Yuanwu's wealth and how he accumulates it become irrelevant. A profound sense of relaxation envelops the whole body, momentarily dispelling worldly plots and pursuits.

In this world, most things demand pace and balance. When tired, take a break and enjoy some tea. It's a moment to pause, refresh, and then continue.
records.zh:
渊武拳馆和别家最大的不同，就是练着舒坦。

按照渊武老板的指导，痛痛快快打上几场拳，末了擦一把汗，饮上一壶茶，别提有多舒坦了。
练灵巧的羡风拳，就喝墨菊茶提精神；练刚猛的雷煌拳，就喝凌霄茶补气力；练柔顺的三馥拳，就喝杜若茶养气血……渊武为不同拳路搭配了不同茶方，精心烹煮后趁热喝下，能放松因锻炼而酸胀的肌肉，舒经活络，抒气排瘀。

这些茶方都是由渊武亲自试出，再交由隔壁茶楼调制茶包，按期配送。说来也怪，隔壁茶楼生意兴旺，要订茶通常得提前数月预约，有时还会延期配送，可从来没有误过渊武的单。不仅不误，渊武还能随时下单，随时提货。难道真如传闻那般，渊武表面上是个喝茶撸猫晒太阳的普通老板，其实是个手握多家企业的大人物？那一壶难求的茶楼，也不过是他众多产业中的一处？

有好奇之人上门询问，渊武只是笑着递上一杯三清茶：“别想那些有的没的了，喝了提提神，多出汗，少发梦。”
一套拳，一杯茶，清新的香气浸润鼻腔，那些疑惑和焦虑都随着滴落的汗珠一起烟消云散了。至于渊武到底有没有钱，那些钱又是怎么赚来的，似乎没那么重要了。一股由内而外的放松感笼罩全身，得以让人暂时忘却那些世俗的算计与追赶。

这世上之物，多半都有张有弛，有急有缓。要是累了，就停下来喝一壶茶，好好休息够了再继续。

records.text:
Yuanwu Boxing Gym was once renowned as the gym for Leihuangquan successors. The gym boasted countless honors, and each of its masters achieved fame across Huanglong.

Leihuangquan's reputation rests on its aggressive style, but such intensity often comes at a cost. Unfortunately, the last three masters met rather unfortunate fates, with the most recent one experiencing a particularly tragic downfall. Rumor has it that he, in the heat of competition, punched through the boxing equipment, violating the rules and leading to his expulsion. Seeking solace from the blow to his career, he embarked on a ship tour, only to encounter a fatal thunderstorm. Coincidentally, he possessed a skill for manipulating thunder, and in a twist of cruel irony, he succumbed to the very force he once controlled. It seems that karma refuses to let anyone go.

As the property agent finished his introduction of the gym's history, he paused to gauge the middle-aged man's reaction. "This property isn't really auspicious. Do you still want to buy?" The man simply smiled and nodded, undeterred.

"Well, I've said everything I have to," the agent sighed, cautioning, "If you still want to buy it, go on, but just don't turn it into a martial arts gym again. It's unlucky."

Yuanwu pushed open the creaky wooden door, allowing sunlight to spill into the space. Dormant dust danced in the hard-earned sunlight's warmth, settling on familiar yet weathered furnishings—the worn wooden stakes, the boxing ring with a worn floor, the quiet display case, and dusty medals of honor.

Yuanwu delicately wiped down these objects from the past, along with memories obscured by dust. The wooden stakes bore the marks of his late fellow apprentices' intense practice. The medals in the display case were hard-earned victories, and as for the floor, it was indeed broken by himself.

Back in the match, he knew no fear and no restraint. A single punch shattered the delicate balance maintained by masters over the years, breaking the floor and throwing him into the storm of reality. The storm, which was also called reality, tore apart the young martial artist who knew nothing but fight. Perhaps, as the rumors suggested, he was truly buried at the bottom of the sea.

As the gym reopened under new ownership, a middle-aged owner with a warm smile welcomed customers coming and going. "Welcome to Yuanwu Boxing Gym."
records.zh:
渊武所在的拳馆曾是名盛一时的雷煌拳馆。
该拳馆曾经赢下无数荣誉，历代师傅也都是名贯瑝珑的武学名家。
雷煌拳速来以刚猛闻名，只可惜刚极易折，最近三代师傅都没能落个好下场。
特别是最后那代，据说在台上跟人比武时一拳打穿拳具，坏了规矩被赶出门。人生失意的他乘船出游却遇上雷暴，最终葬身鱼腹。说来也巧，最后那代师傅善使雷法，最终也为雷电所吞噬，一切都是因果宿命，可悲可叹呐。
中介说完这些，看向眼前这个慈眉善目的中年人：“这屋子可不算吉利，你真要买？”
中年人微笑着点了点头。
“好吧，该说的我可都说了啊。”中介叹了口气，“要买就买吧，可别再开拳馆了，不吉利。”

渊武推开那扇吱嘎作响的木门，阳光照进屋内，沉寂已久的灰尘被门风带起，漂浮在来之不易的温暖阳光中。
屋内陈设变化不大，摩擦得有点秃噜的木桩，地板破损的擂台，静静伫立一旁的展柜，展柜里的荣誉奖章落满了灰尘。
渊武仔细擦拭着这些旧物件，连同尘封的回忆一起。
木桩是师兄弟们练功时打秃噜的，展柜中的奖章是师傅们赢回来的，至于那地板，确实是自己打坏的。
彼时的他不知畏惧，不知收敛，那一拳打穿了拳具，打坏了地板，打碎了师傅苦心维持多年的微妙平衡，也将自己打进了风暴中央。名为现实的风暴将那个空有一身力气的青年拳师撕得粉碎，或许他真如传闻那般葬身鱼腹了吧。

拳馆重新开张了，笑容亲和的中年老板站在门口，招呼着来往的客人：
“欢迎来到渊武拳馆。”

records.text:
When Jinhsi became the Jinzhou Magistrate, she was young and inexperienced. The people of Jinzhou placed their trust in her decisions, but she knew it was not her alone, but also her role as the Sentinel's Resonator, that earned their faith.

Taking on this great responsibility, Jinhsi felt determined to guide Jinzhou towards a better future, despite her initial challenges. She also understood that trust had to be earned through hard work and dedication.

Despite the skepticism she encountered, Jinhsi was more troubled by the weariness etched on the faces of the people—a weariness born of life's hardships and a lack of hope.

She realized that beyond addressing tangible issues like material shortages and external threats, her true challenge was to restore the hope and confidence of the people of Jinzhou, who had been worn down by life.

In such times, what the people needed most was a reliable source of hope, regardless of who provided it.

During a reconstruction event, the young magistrate performed a "miracle" known as "Sentinel Granting Wishes." The remote village had been plagued by weather anomalies for years. Even though the Tacet Discords had stopped, villagers still suffered from extreme cold and gloom.

Jinhsi asked the villagers to voice their wishes. At first, silence hung heavy until a sneeze broke the silence. A timid voice then followed, "It's so cold… I wish it was a bit warmer here."

Standing amidst the crowd, Jinhsi held a Loong Scale, closed her eyes, and nodded, "I will convey your wish to the Sentinel."

Right after her words fell, loong horns sprouted from her head, and a Sentinel-like light pierced the dark clouds and the snow on the ground—just in an instant, the ice thawed, and the land once again sprang to life.

Witnessing this spectacle, the crowd exclaimed, "The Sentinel... the Sentinel has shown itself!" People observed the loong-shaped light in awe, with hope rekindling in their eyes.

News of the young magistrate's wish-granting ability spread rapidly in Jinzhou. Wishing became a popular custom, with people submitting their desires to her at City Hall. She meticulously examined each one and devised effective strategies to fulfill them.

"Dear Magistrate, I'm worried about Tacet Discords infiltrating our city."—Taoqi, director of the Defense Division, was then tasked with fortifying the city defense walls.

"Dear Magistrate, I pray for my father's safe return and an end to the war."—Jinhsi prioritized research on Tacetite weaponry and material engineering, pushing for new weapons against Discords and faster upgrades for defense.

"Dear Magistrate, the Exiles have been spotted in the city. I'm scared."—Jinhsi expanded Patrol Stations, added Patrollers in the city, and assigned more Midnight Rangers to guard outside.

Within three years, the city defense walls were renewed, new weapons were created, and Tacet Discords were repelled. Jinzhou finally ushered in peace and prosperity.

As time passed, people came to realize that the so-called "Sentinel Granting Wishes" was just a white lie from the young magistrate.

However, they also discovered her true dedication to addressing their problems and concerns, always being on the spot at lightning speed.

The lights in City Hall never went out, even on holidays. Jinhsi worked tirelessly until midnight, developing feasible plans to fulfill people's wishes. 

And eventually, they came to understand that she possessed an incredible power - without a Loong Scale, she could summon a dazzling light that could pierce through ice and turn the tide of time.

...

Today, making wishes has become a habit for Jinzhou people, an unspoken agreement between them and their young magistrate.

"Dear Magistrate, I hope you can take some time to relax and come watch our latest show." This was the last wish of the year.

Smiling, Jinhsi closed the file in her hands, leaned against the window in her office, and listened to the melodious singing from Jinzhou Theater, where the new Hero Play, Loong Maiden and Wishes, was being performed.
records.zh:
今汐刚被选为令尹时年纪尚幼、资历尚浅，人们信任的多半是岁主的选择，是岁主共鸣者的身份，而不是今汐本身。
作为一名合格的令尹，即使开局不利，也得用尽全力将今州引领至更好的未来。况且，信任是要靠自己的能力去争取的，今汐很清楚这点。
比起眼中的怀疑，今汐更在意城民们脸上的疲态——那是一种被生活的苦痛反复碾压，丧失了希望的疲态。
今汐知道，比起物资匮乏、内忧外患的环境，更难的是让被生活摧残得早已丧失气力的人们恢复期盼明天的勇气和信心。
在这种情况下，人们需要一个可以信任的精神寄托，而这个寄托是不是目前的自己，并不重要。

于是，在一次灾后重建中，少女令尹上演了一场“岁主与愿”的“神迹”。这处村庄地势偏远，残象潮虽已退却，连年的频率紊乱却导致了持续异常，乌云压城，雪凝不化。
少女令尹请村民说出自己的愿望。刚开始无人回应，直到一声喷嚏打破寂静，紧接着，一个小小的声音怯生生地哼唧道：“好冷……要是天气没有这么冷就好了。”
今汐站在人群中央，手捧龙鳞，闭目颔首：“我会向岁主传达你的愿望。”
霎时，她的头上生出龙角，一道形似岁主的光芒划破黑压压的乌云，击穿地上的积雪——霎时间，冰消雪融，寒去春来。
众人惊叹：“岁主……岁主显灵了！”龙形天光倒映在人们的眼中，重新点燃了希望的光芒。

一传十、十传百，许愿的习俗逐渐风靡今州。
大大小小的愿望在边庭附近聚集，传进少女令尹的耳中。
她从这些细碎的愿望中找出关键的信息，制定对应的策略。
“担心残象溜进城里。”——任命桃祈为天工防事科事务长，带头升级边防城墙。
“希望战争早点结束，爸爸早点回家。”——将黑石武器科和工学材料科并列为重点研究科，一边应对进化的残象开发新型武器，一边升级防护材料，边攻边守，齐头并进。
“城里混进了流寇，害怕。”——增设巡宁所，增加巡尉数量，夜归攘外，巡尉安内。
不出三年，边防城墙焕然一新，新型武器横空出世，残象潮败退至百里之外，城中政通人和，物埠民丰。

人们逐渐发现，所谓“岁主与愿”，只是少女令尹开的一个善意的玩笑。
毕竟，无论今州境内发生什么事情，令尹都会第一时间赶到现场，亲自了解状况，解决民众们的难题。
毕竟，边庭办公室的灯光永不熄灭，即便是节假日的深夜，令尹也一边聆听着大家的愿望，一边奋笔疾书。
毕竟，即使令尹的手中并没有龙鳞，也一样可以唤来破冰的天光，一样可以使时间流转，寒尽春来。
……
时至今日，许愿已经成为了人们的习惯，成为了人们与令尹之间心照不宣的默契。
“希望令尹别那么忙，有空休息休息，和大家一起看看戏。”这是今年最后一个愿望。
今汐笑了笑，合上手中的文件，侧身靠在边庭的窗户上，闭眼倾听起今州剧院那边传来的，新戏《龙女与愿》的婉转唱腔。

records.chapter: 奥古斯塔档案_角色故事
records.text:
"Who is he?"
 
"Are you kidding? That's Ephor Magno! There's not a soul in Septimont who doesn't know him."
 
"Ephor..."
 
In the shadow of a street corner, Augusta took the last bite of her dry bread, her eyes fixed on the tall figure speaking in the square. He looked to be in his thirties. His features were chiseled like marble, yet softened by a warm, open smile. As his speech rose to its peak, he spread his arms wide. The crowd erupted in thunderous applause.
 
An undefeated champion of the public Agons. A once-in-a-generation Gladiator prodigy. He had slain seven Corrosauruses in the Sanguis Plateaus and returned alive, bathed in dragon's blood. They called him the "Dragon Slayer." At that time, tales of his deeds echoed throughout Septimont.
 
He listened to the people. Never turned away a plea. He ruled without greed. An Ephor chosen by the will of the masses. Many believed he would rise as the prophesied Hero of Heroes of their era. 
 
To Augusta, that title had always felt distant and unreachable. But for the first time, she saw someone who might truly ascend to it.
 
A fire lit in her chest. Those feats she once thought exaggerated, those soul-stirring legends... Someone in her own lifetime had actually lived them. That meant her dream wasn't just a fantasy. It could be within her reach.
 
But slowly, that fire began to cool. She studied the man's face, her gaze lingering on that impeccably beautiful smile—
 
"Why couldn't someone that strong... save Fabianum?"
 
Not long after, Augusta stood face-to-face with that same man, those questions still heavy in her heart.
 
"Congratulations, young one. You've earned Arsinosa's blessing. You shall be crowned the new Champion."
 
On the medal platform, Augusta faced Magno as he prepared to pin the medal to her chest. But behind the smile he strained to maintain, she saw eyes dulled by weariness.
 
The hero she once imagined no longer stood there. Nor did the fire. The warrior once hailed as the Dragon Slayer was gone.
 
Augusta accepted the honor in silence. Then, just before stepping away, she whispered, low enough that only he could hear—
 
"Were those legends about you... ever true?"
 
He answered with the same silent smile.
 
Sometime later, a nameless Gladiator appeared in the underground pits. He wore a helm that concealed his face, and armor black as obsidian. He fought like a man with nothing to lose. Sought out only the strongest. No flourish. No dignity. He didn't fight for honor. He fought like he was hunting death.
 
"The Nameless" racked up wins at a terrifying pace, soon drawing Augusta's attention. Though she was already crowned Champion, she accepted his challenge.
 
The moment their blades met, she knew. Helm or not, it couldn't hide those same clouded, exhausted eyes.
 
She didn't know why a revered Ephor, a hero with nothing left to prove, would descend to the shadows to fight in a bloodstained cage. But in that moment, none of it mattered. All that mattered was the strong opponent before her and how to defeat him.
 
Steel clashed, again and again. Neither yielded an inch. To break the standoff, the Nameless's sword sparked with electricity. Arcs of crimson lightning danced along the blade. Lightning forged into a weapon. His ultimate strike, one meant to end it all.
 
And in that blinding flash, Augusta saw it. The legend. The warrior of the Sanguis Plateaus, lightning in hand, ripping through stormclouds and despair to bring hope to those behind him.
 
Her Tacet Mark flared on the back of her hand. She could never summon lightning like his. Her Forte was a whisper compared to his roar. But even so—
 
That faint flicker of resistance bent the lightning, just slightly.
 
And in that breath of an opening, Augusta struck with everything she had. One final swing.
 
After that day, the Nameless vanished from the pits. To the world, it was just another of Augusta's many victories. No one realized that a legend had quietly ended.
 
Some time later, on an otherwise ordinary day, Augusta received a letter. A handwritten invitation from the Ephor's Palace.
records.zh:
“他是谁？”
“别开玩笑了，那可是马格诺总督！哪有七丘人不认识他的？”
“总督……”
街角的阴影下，奥古斯塔咬下最后一口干面包，遥遥望向那个正在广场上发表宣讲的高大身影。那人约莫三十岁出头的年纪，他的面容硬朗，如同雕像般线条分明，却带着温和开朗的笑意。宣讲至高潮时，他敞开双臂，民众欢呼的热浪一阵高过一阵。
公开角斗赛未尝一败的绝对王者，不世出的天才角斗士。曾在桑古伊斯狩原斩杀七只蚀脊龙，浴“龙血”而生还，而被冠以「灭龙」的称谓——彼时，七丘还流行着这样的传说。
那是一个不会拒绝民众愿望的倾听者，一个没有私欲的执行者，他是七丘众望所归的总督，同时也是当今世代最符合「英雄王」预言的人选。
曾被奥古斯塔只当成一个遥不可及的愿望而憧憬着的「英雄王」，这是她第一次发现，现实中居然有如此接近那张王座的存在。
奥古斯塔的心中燃起一阵烈火。那些看起来不可思议的事迹，那些振奋人心的传说，在她所诞生的时代里，仍有人能亲身完成——这意味着她的梦想不是一个虚假的白日梦，而是切实能够达成的目标。
可随即，她的思绪渐渐冷却下来，她注视着那个男人的面庞，凝视着那副没有破绽与瑕疵的笑容——
“为什么连这样的人……也没能救下法比亚纳……”

很快，奥古斯塔带着这些困惑与思考，站到了那个男人的面前。
“恭喜你，获得亚狮诺索认可的年轻人。你将加冕为新的「冠军」。”
授勋台上，奥古斯塔站在马格诺面前，在等待马格诺为她佩戴勋章的期间，她透过那张努力保持笑容的面孔，看到了一双疲惫而浑浊的眼睛。
那与她想象中的英雄相去甚远，那名被誉为「灭龙」的勇士，瞳孔中的心火已经归于沉寂。
奥古斯塔安静地接受了马格诺的授勋，直到最后，她才以唯有马格诺能听见的声音低语——
“那些关于你的传说，到底是真的吗？”
回应她的仍是沉默的笑容。

一段时间过后，地下角斗赛上出现了一个没有名字的角斗士。他戴着遮掩面庞的兜鍪，身披漆黑的甲胄，他如同求死般只挑战最强大的对手，他战斗的方式无所不用其极，毫无节制与尊严可言，仿佛他身处的不是追求荣誉的角斗场，而是只言生死的狩猎之地。
「无名」的胜场迅速累积，很快引起了奥古斯塔的注意。哪怕已经加冕为「冠军」，奥古斯塔仍接受了「无名」的挑战。
然而就在剑戟相交的一瞬间，奥古斯塔便认出了「无名」的真实身份。厚重的面甲可以掩饰容貌，但没能藏住那对疲惫而浑浊的眼睛。
奥古斯塔并不明白，为何那位高高在上的总督，那个早已不需要胜利与荣誉去证明自己的英雄，不惜隐藏身份也要来到地下，参加这种阴暗角落中的铁笼之斗。但奥古斯塔此刻抛去了这些疑问，她所想的唯有如何战胜眼前这名强大的对手。
两柄剑刃仿佛在永无止境地相互碰撞，为了打破这一僵局，「无名」手上的剑开始有电光弹跳，奔走的电弧化作绯红的霓裳，缠绕于「无名」的剑身。雷霆化作利刃，这是他倾注一切的必胜一击。
雷光炸裂的那一瞬间，奥古斯塔仿佛看到了传说的影子，她似乎看到一名勇者立于桑古伊斯狩原，高举利剑，苍红的雷霆贯穿阴云，为他身后的战士们带来胜利的希望。
可紧接着，奥古斯塔手背上的声痕也刺眼地亮起，她当然无法像「无名」那样制造出璀璨的雷霆，她的共鸣能力比起对方而言可谓微不足道。
但就是这看似微不足道的阻力，偏转了一丝雷霆的方向。
奥古斯塔抓住了这一转瞬即逝的胜机，她竭尽全力，挥出最后一剑。
那一天过后，「无名」的身影在地下角斗场彻底消失，人们只知道这是奥古斯塔的又一场胜利，却无人知晓传说已经悄然更迭。

不久后，一个寻常日子里，奥古斯塔收到了一封亲笔信，那是来自总督宫的邀请。

records.text:
Compared to the quiet temple on the mountain, the world beyond felt vast and unruly, alive with a thousand voices. Without her master's sheltering, Buling's first days away from home were uneasy and frustrating. Had she not rescued that Huaxu Academy researcher from Mengzhou, who repaid her with a prototype headset that muffled intrusive sensations, she might have suffered from those ceaseless whispers far longer.

She drifted through crowded streets, learning the rhythms of modern city life step by step. Her master's words on flexibility became her compass: times change, and so must the sect. Talismans and tools should evolve with the world. Every so often, she sent her master some exorcist gadgets she bought or improved upon: a microwave alchemy furnace, an exorcism bell with a built-in alarm clock, or a fly-whisk that glowed neon at night. Her proudest creation was a voice-controlled peachwood sword, able to swerve midair at a single command, far more convenient than the old sword-riding techniques.

Her master's patience eventually wore thin. One day, a letter arrived with just two bold words written in clean calligraphy: "UTTER NONSENSE." But when Buling finally returned to the temple, she found him waiting there—wearing that very sword on his back.

Her journey stretched on, a winding road of self-cultivation. She crossed most of Huanglong, stood on the Black Shores, and ventured into the New Federation. She marveled at Mengzhou's endless waters, braved Chongzhou's jagged peaks, walked through rule-based nations, and wandered lawless lands where only the strong survived.

Much later, in Rinascita, she received an assignment through the Tethys system: assist a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores who, like her, had traveled far. From the start, she sensed {Male=his;Female=her} identity was more complicated than the records suggested, as {Male=his;Female=her} fate lines were tangled beyond divination. Their paths crossed again and again: in Septimont City with both bright and dark sides, in hunting grounds haunted by the Dark Tide, and in the ruins of destroyed Honami City. None of those places could be called peaceful.

Buling thought of herself as a free spirit, roaming wherever whim led her. That Rover was different—no carefree traveler, but someone forever running from one storm to the next. And still, for reasons she could not name, she wanted to see that person smile, as if {Male=he;Female=she}, too, could take a moment to enjoy the journey. The quiet gathering at Shashou Cafe was one of those rare, unburdened moments.

Where would their journeys converge next? Buling's hand hovered over her divination set, then she let it fall. When the time is right, their fates will meet again. And when they do, she will be there to offer {Male=him;Female=her} a steady hand, just as she always has.
records.zh:
与山上道馆的清净天地相比，山外的世界宽广、冗杂、喧嚣。失去了师长的荫庇，卜灵在下山初期度过了一段烦闷的时光。若不是偶然救起那位梦州华胥研究院的研究员，获赠一副新式耳机型感知屏蔽仪，她恐怕还要因纷扰不休的絮语困扰许久。
年轻的方士行走在热闹的街市，感受着、学习着当下最新潮的城市生活。师父教导的变通之道，成了她的行事准则之一。时移世易，如今的道门应该引入当下的新潮文化，各式法宝也应当紧跟时代。她时不时会给九峰道长寄去一些她购买或是改良的新玩意，比如微波式炼丹炉、带闹钟功能的驱魂铃、晚上会闪霓虹光的拂尘。其中她最满意的是一把内嵌了声控装置的飞行桃木剑，会根据使用者的指令在空中改变方向，这可比什么御剑术省力多了。
不堪其扰的老道寄来了一封亲笔信，里面只有刚劲的笔锋写的几个大字——“瞎胡闹”。待到卜灵某天回到道馆，她却发现师父身后就背着这把徒弟送的桃木剑。
这是一段漫长的旅途，也是一次漫长的修行。渐渐地，卜灵游遍了大半个瑝珑，去过黑海岸，到过新联邦。她曾欣赏烟波浩渺的梦州水景，也曾感受山峦险塞的重州风光。她曾到过秩序井然的文明之邦，也曾来过弱肉强食的无法之地。
后来，卜灵云游至黎那汐塔，期间接到了泰缇斯系统的传令，协助一位与她一样游历至此的黑海岸执花。卜灵早已察觉，{TA}的身份绝没有资料里写的那样简单，毕竟自己可算不清{TA}的气运。接下来的时光，他们曾多次发生交集。光影伴生的七丘城，黑潮将临的狩原，劫后荒废的穗波市……这么一说，倒都是些不太平的地方。
卜灵四海云游，自认逍遥。{TA}却难称得上是一名游客，总是从一个危机奔赴下一个危机。不知为何，卜灵也想看看那个人露出像自己一样享受旅途的表情。在列车长咖啡厅的聚会，便是这样的轻松时刻。
接下来，他们的脚步又会在什么地方交汇呢？卜灵本想卜卦一算，随即打消了念头。
该重逢的时候自然会重逢。届时，自己想必会像过去的每一次一样，助{TA}一手。

records.text:
The rain stung Suoming's eyes. Wiping the drops away with her shoulder, she cleared her vision for one last look at her parents' faces worn past recognition by the Evil Miasma. She gripped a spade nearly as tall as herself and laid the final clod of earth upon the grave. Across the mound, the girl who would become the First Seal lowered her own spade. Raised by Suoming's parents, she had long considered them her own family.

"So... what do we do now?"

Suoming looked into the distance, raising a hand toward Huating. Its massive gates were sealed tight against the black curtain of rain.

"They shut us out to be bait for the Evil Miasma... but I will bring everyone home."

Beyond the walls, the land had long been forsaken. Alongside the constant threat of the Evil Miasma, bands of ruthless outlaws ran rampant. Suoming walked every village outside Huating, bearing witness to orphans left adrift, families driven out, and survivors who had lost everything. The people beyond the walls needed order, and Suoming needed the supplies and strongholds to keep them alive. She scattered the bandits, stood against the Evil Miasma, and shielded the villages. Year by year, people gathered at her side until a true sanctuary took shape. 

Suoming was ready.

When the Evil Miasma finally pressed down upon the city once more, Huating's garrison retreated behind their walls as always, intent not on saving, but only on keeping the desperate out.

Suoming advanced alone to face the Tacet Discords surging from the Evil Miasma. Meanwhile, the First Seal brought the Thousandweight Pin to the city gates. As its heavy gears turned, the mechanism pried the massive gates open, and the waiting crowd surged inside. By the time Suoming cut down the final Tacet Discord and stepped through the entrance, the guards were clutching their weapons in terror. They fruitlessly ordered the crowd back, frantically demanding the gates be shut, as if sealing out the world would keep calamity at bay.

Suoming's gaze passed over the anxious crowd, over the sprawling rooftops, and rested on the grand manor towering above the city center. Resplendent amid the storm-tossed ruins, it was the residence of Huating's Chief of Records.

Suoming nodded quietly to herself. The path she had spent years planning had finally taken its first step.
records.zh:
雨水刺得锁暝眼睛发酸，她用肩膀擦去眼角的雨滴，让视野清晰些，好能最后再看一次父母的面容，即便那已经是受「恶瘴」侵蚀，面目模糊的模样。随后，她握紧那柄几乎与自己等高的铁铲，将最后一抔泥土轻轻覆下。坟墓另一侧，后来成为一契的少女也放下铁铲，她自幼受锁暝父母照顾，早已将这一家视作至亲。
“这之后……我们怎么办？”
锁暝望向远方，抬手指着漆黑雨幕中城门紧闭的华亭，“他们关上门，要我们成为吸引「恶瘴」的饵料……我要，带大家回去。”
只是，华亭城外早已是被弃之不顾的土地，除「恶瘴」威胁外，还有贼人恶霸四起，拉帮结派。锁暝走遍华亭城外一座座村落，见到那些流离失所的孤儿、被恶霸驱逐的百姓、因「恶瘴」失去一切的幸存者……城外百姓需要新的秩序，而锁暝也需要能够维系众人生计的物资与据点。于是她驱散贼寇，迎击「恶瘴」护住村落。岁月流转，越来越多的人聚集于她身旁，华亭城外，也有了一片属于他们的立足之地，锁暝也做好了万全准备……
终于有一日，「恶瘴」再度压境，华亭守军一如往昔，尽数退守城内躲避威胁。他们的职责从来不是救人，而是守住城门，不让任何人闯入。
锁暝独自迎向伴随「恶瘴」而来的残象，与此同时，一契带着托人制作的「千钧顶」来到城门前，伴随着机关转动，千钧顶缓缓撑开厚重的城门。下一刻，等候已久的人群涌入华亭城。当锁暝斩尽最后一头残象，踏入城门时，士兵紧握兵刃，与众人对峙，神色惊惶中催促百姓关紧城门，就好像只要隔绝城外，名为「恶瘴」的灾祸便不会降临。
锁暝的目光越过惶惶不安的人群，越过鳞次栉比的屋舍，最终落在城中央那座高踞其上的宅邸。那是华亭主簿的府邸，在风雨飘摇的城中依旧富丽堂皇，格外刺眼。
锁暝微微颔首，她筹谋多年的道路，直到此时，方才迈出第一步。

records.text:
Suoming knew taking Huating by force and striking down its Chief of Records would be easy. But the city's power play ran deep and tangled. Eliminating the chief would not bring true peace, nor would it win the trust of the people. To destroy his hold, she had to dismantle the pillars supporting his authority.

The first was the city's most arrogant swordsman. Hired at great expense by the Chief of Records, his formidable Forte allowed his blade to slice through iron like mud. Relying on that reputation, he gathered a gang of his own. Many who despised the Chief of Records still trembled before his steel.

When Suoming tracked him to a tavern, his men snickered as they let the petite young woman upstairs: "What does a kid know about drinking?"

Moments later, the second-story window shattered. A single sword hurtled downward, embedding itself in the street below. The gang fell dead silent as they recalled a rumor from the West Gate: the leader who had broken into Huating was a short girl with red hair.

Sobered instantly, the swordsman picked himself up and clashed with Suoming for dozens of rounds before collapsing in exhaustion. Suoming looked down at him. "With skill like yours, why serve evil? Come with me, and we'll wipe out the Evil Miasma."

The swordsman would go on to become the Third Seal. He later admitted that Suoming's grand ambitions had meant little to him at first. What won him over was her willingness to wield absolute power without ever bullying the weak, and the shame that realization stirred in him.

With the chief's blade dealt with, Suoming turned her sights toward the city's other power—its wealthiest merchant clan. For generations, they had amassed inexhaustible fortunes in gold, jade, and brocade. Suoming intended to request their financial support, but upon her visit, she met only the clan’s young lady. The girl asked hesitant questions about the outside world, hiding a secret too heavy to speak aloud.

The First Seal sensed something amiss and advised caution. But when the clan head openly boasted that the Evil Miasma was an opportunity to hoard goods and inflate prices rather than fight, Suoming realized words were pointless. That night, she slipped into the estate and brought the young lady out, learning the truth from her own lips.

The young lady possessed a Forte that could replicate any object, which is in fact, the true secret behind her family's vast fortune. In return, they had kept her imprisoned in the inner halls year after year, forcing her to copy every treasure brought before her. Once the Evil Miasma isolated the city, she became the clan's source of endless treasures. However, years of captivity and constant depletion of her Forte had left her spirit withered.

Suoming told her plainly: "I can free you, but beyond freedom, I have nothing to give." The young lady followed without a second thought.

Years later, whenever the Fourth Seal combed Suoming's long hair, Suoming would often sigh: "I should have simply freed you from that mansion and left it at that. I never should have dragged you into this war."

The Fourth Seal would only shake her head, gather up Suoming's red hair, and hum a quiet verse of her own making. It's her gentle way of giving thanks.
records.zh:
锁暝清楚，闯入华亭后直取主簿固然不难，可城中势力盘根错节，主簿一死，华亭未必就此安定，如此行事她也难以服众，于是锁暝将目标转为了那些支撑主簿权势的人。
第一个，是城中飞扬跋扈的刀客，此人刀术精湛，共鸣能力强悍，让挥出的斩击削铁如泥，受主簿重金招揽后，又借其声势招聚党羽，城中诸多对主簿不满者，也忌惮于他的刀刃。
锁暝寻到他时，他正于酒楼纵酒寻欢，其随从见来者不过一个身材娇小的姑娘，便放她上楼，还忍不住笑道：“小孩儿也懂喝酒？”
未过片刻，酒楼窗棂轰然碎裂，那刀客已被锁暝自二楼掷出，重重摔在长街之上，慕强而来党羽们一时噤声，这才想起几日前西城门外的传闻——率众闯入华亭的，正是一位个子不高的红发少女。
酒意散尽，刀客翻身而起，与锁暝鏖战数十回合，最终力竭落败，锁暝质问他“有此一身武艺，何必为恶人驱使？跟我走，铲灭「恶瘴」。”
成为三契后，他承认当时并不在意锁暝有什么志向，只是折服于她恃强却不凌弱的姿态，令他自惭形秽。
解决了主簿的刀剑，锁暝又将目光投向另一股势力，那是华亭首屈一指的豪商世家。世代经营金玉锦绣，即便货品并非世间奇珍，却胜在取之不竭，由此富甲一方。锁暝本欲借其财力，却在拜访时遇见了家族的小姐，少女寥寥数语，皆是宅邸之外的风景；欲言又止之间，藏着难以出口的隐情。
一契察觉异样，劝锁暝暂且静观。可当家主笑言「恶瘴」围城未尝不是天赐良机，正好借此囤积居奇，不必急着与「恶瘴」决战时，锁暝已不愿再多言，当夜，她潜入宅邸，将那位少女带了出来，从她口中了解到真相。
少女拥有仿造物件的异能，家族凭此聚敛无数财富，也因此将她终年囚于深宅。每有珍宝运来，便命她一件件仿造；「恶瘴」封城后，再无人能够窥见这一切，她便愈发成了永不停歇的聚宝盆，漫长的囚禁与无休止地榨取共鸣力，早已令她心神枯槁，锁暝对她说，“我能带你离开，可除了自由，我什么都给不了你。”而少女的回应则是义无反顾。
后来，每当四契替锁暝梳起长发时，锁暝常常叹息，“若当初只是带你离开宅邸就好了，不该再让你卷入这一切。”四契则是摇摇头，挽起她的红发，低声念着她新写的诗句，婉转地传达谢意。

records.text:
"How many years has it been since you came to me for the Thousandweight Pin? You kept your word. You brought our people back to Huating and tore down that accursed regime. When the gates opened and the crowds flooded in, the city didn't collapse into chaos. It took on new life. Every bit of it was bought with you and your followers."

"Huating hangs on your every word now. People placed faith in your strength. If you raised a single hand, the whole city could march out and wipe the Evil Miasma away forever."

"But the people behind these walls haven't seen the true calamity. They've never watched black rain drown the soil and wither the earth. They've never seen a loved one eroded past recognition. We have. When I built that pin for you, my only goal was to bring the stranded home. As for defeating the Evil Miasma... I never thought it possible. So don't try to talk me into this again. I won't waste what little strength I have left on a futile cause. And I suggest you... stop chasing it, too."

Suoming looked down at the cup of clear local white tea before her. At the bottom, the emblem of the Ministry of Development rippled faintly in the brew.

"Huating today isn't my doing alone. The Sixth Seal reads people well and is eloquent beyond measure. It was she who walked the streets, maneuvering deftly among the city's competing factions to earn the people's trust for me. Without her, Huating might never have believed."

"As for the Evil Miasma... there is a physician who, too, has witnessed firsthand the Blight Rain that gnaws bone and the Miasmic Thunder that devours men. Had she surrendered to grief, she would never have probed the nature of the Evil Miasma, nor found a way to combat it. The Fifth Seal has designed a mask capable of resisting the erosion. It awaits only a master craftsman to forge it. Once complete, the Fourth Seal can replicate as many as we require. With those, we will finally be equipped to step into the Blight Rain. But that alone is not enough. I need you to forge a weapon..."

The old man leaned in, waiting for her to continue.

"I will claim its power. In battle, I will weaken the Evil Miasma. Even if I can seize only a wisp of Blight Rain or a thread of Miasmic Thunder, I will seal it within the weapon. My body may have its limits, but I will master its power and find a way to conquer it."

"Then... what kind of weapon do you envision? A sword? A broadblade? With internal mechanisms, it could—"

"An umbrella would be best."

"An umbrella...?" He turned toward the window, gazing into the distance. "I see. Against the Blight Rain that fills the heavens, there is indeed no finer shield than an umbrella to shelter Huating from the storm."

He turned back to Suoming.

"Very well... by your own ranking, where do I stand now? Am I the Seventh Seal?"

Suoming finally raised her teacup, a rare smile gracing her lips.

"I have been holding that place for you all along, Second Seal."
records.zh:
“自你请我打造「千钧顶」那日起，已经过去多少年了？你兑现了当初的承诺，带着城外的人回到了华亭，也灭了那罪恶滔天的主簿。城外人涌入后，华亭没有陷入混乱，反倒渐渐有了新的气象，这一切，都是你和那群追随者挣来的。
“如今的华亭相信你的每一句话，相信你手中的力量，仿佛只要你振臂一呼，众人便能随你出城，将「恶瘴」彻底扫尽。
“可城中的人没有见过真正的「恶瘴」，他们不曾见过黑雨覆地、草木尽枯，不曾见过至亲被它侵蚀，面目全非。可你我，都见过。当年答应替你打造「千钧顶」，我只是想把城外的人带回家。至于击败「恶瘴」……我从未信过。所以，不必再劝我了。我不会再为此倾尽余力，也劝你……莫再执着于此了。”
锁暝看着眼前那杯透明无色的华亭白茶，杯底的天工部徽记微微荡漾。
“如今的华亭，并非我一人所成。六契善察人心，亦善言辞。是她奔走于街巷之间，周旋于城中诸势，替我赢得了百姓的信任。若无她，华亭未必愿意相信我。
“至于「恶瘴」……有一位医者如你所说，亲眼见过凄雨蚀骨、瘴雷噬人。若她沉溺于悲痛，便不会穷究「恶瘴」为何物，更不会寻到与之相抗的办法。五契设想了一种能抵御「恶瘴」侵蚀的面罩，只待工匠将其铸成，且只要控制数量，四契能仿造多个性能完备的面罩。如此，我们便有了踏入凄雨的资格，当然，这还不够，我要你打造一把武器……”
老者聚精会神，等着锁暝开口。
“我要夺取它的力量，我会在交战中不断削弱「恶瘴」，哪怕只能夺来一丝凄雨、一缕瘴雷，也要将它们锁入武器之中。即便能夺取的频率有极限，但我会驾驭它的力量，并找到击败它的方法。”
“那么……你想要一件怎样的兵器？迅刀？长刃？若辅以机关，应当——”
“伞便是最好。”
“伞……？”他望向窗外，“原来如此，面对那漫天凄雨，确是没什么比一柄能为华亭遮风蔽雨的伞更好。”
他收回目光，重新望向锁暝。
“既如此……按你的规矩，如今我该排第几？七契？”
锁暝终于端起茶盏，露出难得的微笑。
“这个位置，我一直替你留着，二契。”

records.text:
Not long after the Eighth Seal joined the Covenant, the Vermillion Locks were finally complete. Suoming intended to use them to borrow the other nine Seals' abilities against the Evil Miasma. Yet, having never attempted such a feat, even her calm expression hid a trace of hesitation. For a brief moment, she pondered who should step forward first.

It was the Seventh Seal who volunteered. As a soldier of the Ministry of War, he insisted it was only right that he take the lead.

When Suoming had originally ousted Huating's Chief of Records, the Ministry of War was freed from its shackles. Most of its soldiers eagerly pledged their support, save for the Seventh Seal, who stubbornly refused to yield. To him, no matter how heinous the chief's crimes, he remained Huating's legitimate authority. Suoming, a mere commoner, had no right to replace him. In those early days, the Seventh Seal opposed her at every turn.

It was only when Suoming escorted him beyond Huating's walls to witness the villages buried beneath the Blight Rain that his resolve shattered. Standing silent among the ruins, he asked her with reddened eyes: "Could Huating truly be spared such tragedy from now on?"

The answer needed no words. From that day forward, the Seventh Seal remained the same steadfast, rule-abiding soldier. He shouldered every burden while insisting that, regardless of Suoming's standing, she was still a citizen of Huating, and it was his duty to protect her.

Accepting his goodwill, Suoming set about sealing a fragment of his frequency into her lock. Moments later, a wisp of mist materialized in her palm—faint, but unmistakably the Seventh Seal's Forte. Simultaneously, the umbrella resting beside her violently shuddered. With a deafening roar, a bolt of crimson-black thunder burst from the umbrella, shattering the courtyard wall.

As the others stood in stunned silence, the Eighth Seal approached the rubble, inspecting the Miasmic Thunder still crackling among the debris.

"Have you ever wielded two powers at once before?" she asked after a quiet pause.

Suoming shook her head.

"A fraction of your mind is constantly spent suppressing the Evil Miasma sealed within your umbrella. Borrowing the Seventh Seal's power alongside it likely triggered the instability."

The Eighth Seal had been brought into the fold by the Seventh Seal. Suoming remembered their first meeting, when the Eighth Seal had bypassed formalities to ask for an exhaustive account of every battle she had fought against the Evil Miasma over the years. They spoke for an entire day, emerging only as dusk faded into night. Afterward, Suoming announced to the others that their plan was complete.

According to the Eighth Seal's design, one would have to venture directly into the swirling black clouds alongside Suoming. The moment Suoming bound the entity, this ally would drive a dagger charged with the Eighth Seal's Forte into its core, forcing it out of the cloud's protection and into an open battle with them all.

Yet every Seal already bore a vital role, and none could be spared for such a perilous gambit.

They needed someone else. One last person...
records.zh:
八契加入禁锁十契后不久，玄朱锁终于铸成，锁暝想以此借用禁锁十契的共鸣能力，以应对「恶瘴」。可这种用法，她此前从未尝试过，纵然神色如常，心中终究有几分踌躇，一时竟不知该向谁先开这个头。而七契自告奋勇，说他身为军策府一员，自是要敢为人先。
当年锁暝铲除华亭主簿后，军策府终于摆脱桎梏，府中上下皆愿在履行原有职责的同时，协助锁暝。唯独七契始终不肯低头。他固执地认为，主簿纵然罪孽深重，也终究是名正言顺的华亭执掌者，锁暝不过一介平民，不该取而代之。那段时日，他几乎处处与锁暝作对。直到锁暝带他走出华亭，看到城外村落埋没于凄雨之下，断壁残垣间，七契久久伫立，终是红了眼眶。他问锁暝，能否让华亭城不再遭此劫难？
答案不言而喻，自那以后，他仍是那个事事循规蹈矩的七契，总把责任揽在自己肩上，也总说无论锁暝今日身居何位，终究都是华亭百姓，他会尽力保护诸位。锁暝自然不会拒绝他的好意，旋即动手将七契的些许频率封入锁中。下一刻，一团水雾自她掌心缓缓凝聚，虽然微弱，但正是七契的异能。而此时锁暝放置在一旁的伞忽然震颤，伴随着轰鸣，一道赤黑色雷霆骤然从伞中迸发，将院墙轰然击碎。
众人惊诧中，八契踱步至断墙前，望着碎石间仍在跳动的瘴雷，沉默片刻后开口。
“你从前……可曾同时驾驭过两种力量？”锁暝摇头，“你的心神始终分出一部分，镇压着伞中封存的「恶瘴」。如今再借七契之力，或许正是因此生变。”
八契是由七契引荐而来的，锁暝还记得初次相见时，她单刀直入，让锁暝将这些年来与「恶瘴」交锋的每一场战斗，从头到尾细细说来。一谈便是一整日，直至暮色将尽，两人才推门而出。锁暝告诉众人，击败「恶瘴」的计策已成，在八契的计划中，必须有人随锁暝一同闯入「恶瘴」缠绕周身的黑云，在锁暝牵制它的瞬间，将灌注八契共鸣能力的匕首刺入其体内，逼它脱离浓云的保护，与众人决战。
可禁锁十契各司其职，无人能担此任，仍需再寻一人，最后一人……

records.text:
"And that is how I came to know the Eighth Seal." Suoming let out a quiet breath, relaxing into the back of her chair. "As for the last one... the Ninth Seal..."

She paused, taking a moment before continuing. "Our meeting was rather ordinary. That day, I was walking down the street alone when I spotted a piece of... floating rice cake."

At that, the Sentinel gave a slight nod. Suoming guessed It might be smiling.

"She was starving, and using her Forte to stay invisible, she was stealing food from the street vendors. So I stood there and waited. When she drifted past me, I stuck out my foot and tripped her. Ninth tumbled to the ground, her invisibility breaking. She turned around to curse me, but stopped dead in her tracks."

"You frightened her."

"Yes." Suoming nodded gently. "My expression must have been terrible, because I knew she was the one—the Ninth Seal. I would have her draw close to the Evil Miasma to strike the killing blow, and then... she would be discovered and killed on the spot."

"And you told her all of this."

"I did." Suoming reached out, her fingers brushing the Vermillion Locks at her side. "But what good did it do? Ninth loved to trail behind me, calling me 'Sister Suoming' at every turn. Whatever I said, she simply nodded along. She even styled her hair to match mine. Within days, she had stopped fearing me entirely. No matter how I reasoned with her, no matter what I told her, she only smiled... afraid of nothing."

Suoming's voice grew softer, fading into silence with a quiet sigh. The Sentinel knew she needed no comfort. Even this grief, she wished to carve deep into her heart. It required no empty words, only a path forward.

"Suoming, I appreciate everything you have done for Huating. But I have nothing left to reward you with. I must even ask you to keep fighting for Mengzhou."

"It's fine." Suoming lifted her head, the gloom vanishing from her eyes. "Tell me what you need of me. Tell me how to ensure the Evil Miasma never threatens Mengzhou again."

"...Very well. Take out the Vermillion Locks. I have one final duty to entrust to you."
records.zh:
“如此，便是我与八契相识的经过。”锁暝舒了一口气，身子放松了力气，靠在椅背上，“至于最后的九契……”
她停顿片刻后开口，“我们的相遇，倒是寻常。那日我独自走在街上，只瞧见一块会飘的……粘糕。”
话音刚落，「岁主」微微颔首，锁暝猜祂或许是在笑，“她饿坏了，仗着能隐去身形，在街边偷东西吃。我便站在那里，等她从身旁经过时，伸脚绊了她一下，九儿摔在地上，现了形，转过身像是要骂我两句，但欲言又止。”
“你吓着她了。”
“是啊。”锁暝轻轻点头，“那一刻，我的表情很是可怕吧？因为我想着就是她了，第九契，我要她靠近「恶瘴」施与致命一击，接着……她就会被「恶瘴」发现，殒命当场。”
“你把这些，都告诉她了。”
“都告诉了。”锁暝伸手抚过身边的玄朱锁，“可又有什么用？九儿总喜欢跟在我身后，一口一个‘锁暝姐姐’地叫着。无论我说什么，她都会点头答应。连头发，也要梳得与我一样。不过几日工夫，她便再也不怕我了，无论我怎么劝、怎么说，她都只是笑……什么都不怕。”
锁暝声音越来越轻，逐渐变为沉默和叹息，「岁主」知晓她不需安慰，连这份悲伤她都想牢牢刻在心中。祂无需多言，只要为锁暝指明前路便好。
“锁暝，谢谢你为华亭做的一切，但我已没有什么能够嘉奖你的，甚至，还要请你继续为了梦州而战。”
“这样便够了。”锁暝抬起头，脸上再无先前的阴郁，“告诉我，你需要我做什么，该如何才能让「恶瘴」，永远不再出现在梦州。”
“……好，把玄朱锁取出来吧，我要将最后的嘱托交于你。”

records.text:
Shortly after Jiyan's appointment as the Midnight Ranger's general, an unexpected Tacet Discord Outbreak occurred. It was during this battle that he suspected the Threnodian's resurrection.

As the weary soldiers recovered from a fierce battle on the frontline, they were greeted by an ominous sight: shadow ravens circling above and swarms of Tacet Discords charging towards their position at the Norfall Barrens and Desorock Highland pass. 

The outnumbered army knew that failure to defend this stronghold could spell doom for the entire Huanglong.

Even seasoned veterans had never faced a crisis as urgent as this one. Amidst the chaos, Jiyan alone remained composed.

"All of you. Prepare to fight."

"Absurd! If we lose now, it's truly over. We can still retreat and protect the city!"

"Choose now: stand with courage, seize our chance. Or run and face defeat. For centuries, the Midnight Rangers have held this pass without retreat. Or do you prefer to go down in history as cowards?"

The veterans left, their emotions ranging from disappointment to rage.

Jiyan's resolve remained unshaken. He carefully studied real-time images from monitoring devices and noticed a connection between the Tacet Discords and the shadow ravens above. Quickly summoning the other commanders in the military, Jiyan devised a plan and led their coordinated army to face the enemy head-on. With precision, they used Sound Emulators set in a narrow valley to emit the shadow raven's frequency. As he expected, the Tacet Discords were drawn towards the sound, allowing for their easy capture.

Meanwhile, the Midnight Rangers stationed at Norfall Barrens were instructed to join hands with their comrades in the Desorock Highland, and carry out a pincer attack on the Tacet Discords. In the midst of a sandstorm, Jiyan bravely fought off hordes of enemies, paving the way for his fellow soldiers with unmatched strength.

The Tacet Mark on Jiyan's nape was flickering, a sign of Forte overexertion, but he pressed on. His Qingloong flew high in the sky like a proud banner of resolution, never once faltering to the ground.
records.zh:
忌炎初任将军之时，关外遭遇了一场规模空前的残象潮，正是从那场战役中，他推测“鸣式”有了异动的迹象。
彼时，前线刚结束一场鏖战，还未从疲乏伤病中缓过来。便见远处赤流涌动，隐鸦盘旋于天际，蚁群般的残象直直逼近北落野与荒石高地的交界关口，敌众我寡，趁虚入侵。
全军皆知，此地若破，后方防线岌岌可危。一众老将虽身经百战，却也从未面临过如此困局，唯有忌炎镇定如常。
“全军迎战。”
“不可！要是败了，就真无挽回余地了。我们身后可是今州！用断尾之计舍弃整个关口还有机会！”
“战，仍有胜算。不战，便是彻头彻尾输了。夜归镇戍关口几百余年，从未有过贪生怕死不战自降的记录。诸位，是想'青史留名'吗？“
老将或是摇头叹息，或是愤然离席。
忌炎并未因此动摇，而是冷静地分析监测设备传回来的实时画面，他发现这批残象的行动逻辑与空中盘旋的隐鸦群有相似之处。于是，立刻召集军中其他将领排兵布阵，率兵亲征。
位于山谷中部的音波仪根据指示开始发出类隐鸦频率，果然如忌炎所料，这些残象对隐鸦的频率有特殊偏好，全部循着声源方向行进。如此一来，残象完全被吸引到逼仄的山谷之中。
与此同时，驻扎于北落野营地的夜归也收到信号，与荒石高地的夜归兵分两路以钳形攻势包围残象。
青色的背影在黄沙之中游动，所谓一人可抵万军并非虚言，他坚定地走在最前方为众人开道。
后脊的声痕不断闪烁，这是异能使用过度的信号，但青龙从始至终如夜归的旌旗悬于战场之上，从未坠落。

records.text:
"Music itself holds no emotion. It's the heart that grants it meaning. So, dear listener, tell me. What feelings did my piece evoke in you?"
 
In Egla Town, countless people may meet and part with every passing moment. As a wandering bard, Ciaccona had always been an observer of stories, witnessing their beginnings, progression, and endings...
 
Until one morning, when she glimpsed an outlander from afar in the morning light, she knew that a new melody was about to sound.
 
That was Ciaccona's first conversation with you. But to her, it may not have been the first time the two of you met.
 
Under the night sky ablaze with fireworks, she witnessed the masked outlander claim the Laurel, outshining the stars and sparks amid the crowd's cheers.
 
What defines a hero praised in legends? Is it strength? Courage? Kindness? Or justice...?
 
Those qualities all converged on the radiant silhouette standing before her.
 
"If given the opportunity, I'd like to write a poem for you, Laureate."
 
The gentle breeze of Whisperwind Haven silently rides along the tides, passing over windmills and chimneys, then sweeping across the wilderness until it reaches a red-haired girl with antlers. She plays her lute among dancing birds, and the lingering wind soon carries her song to distant places.
 
"In her world, poetry and music each hold equal sway..."
 
As the girl with antlers watches you and Carlotta emerge from the wind, something tells her she too might soon be swept into a story.
 
Bards have always remained in the shadows as observers of another's legend. But stepping out from the pages, Ciaccona finds herself drawn into a story. There is both excitement and a hint of unease.
 
This time. For herself, she shall sing.
records.zh:
“音律本没有情绪，是人的心赋予了它们的意义，这位听众，你觉得刚才的曲子中，有什么样的感情呢？”
也许埃格拉镇每时每刻都有不同的人在相遇、离别，作为吟游诗人的夏空一直以来旁观着故事的开始、经过、结束……
直至她透过晨光瞥见了那远道而来的异乡之人，一段新的旋律即将奏响。
这是夏空与你的第一次交谈，但对她来说，见面……也许并不是第一次。
绚丽烟火的夜空下，她曾目睹着那位异乡之人戴着假面摘得「桂冠」，在众人的欢呼声中比天上的星辰、烟花更为绚烂。
故事里称颂的英雄究竟是什么样子？力量、勇气、善良、公正……
而这些品质此刻都聚拢在眼前这道带有温度的廓影。
“桂冠，如果有机会的话，我也想为你写一首诗 ”
拂风水畔的风是温柔的，它拨开水浪，无声地渡过水岸，从风车和炊烟的头顶吹过，沿着旷野一直向前，直至遇见一个红发的鹿角女孩，她手中弹奏着琉特琴，飞鸟为她而舞，而停留的风将她的歌声带去各处。
“在她的世界里，诗和音乐占了一半……”
鹿角少女看向你和珂莱塔从风中走来，她察觉到了或许自己也将被卷入某个故事当中。
吟游诗人永远站在篝火的阴影处记录英雄传奇，可当自己走出书页停驻在故事中时，有兴奋，也有些不安。
她，这次将为自己而歌。

records.chapter: 卡提希娅档案_角色故事
records.text:
This quest continued for some time.

In those unnoticed moments, the girl visited every field in Whisperwind Haven. Mischievous and free-spirited by nature, she even stole sips of sacramental wine under the watch of guards, danced away on high platforms, and turned a solemn ceremony into complete madness. Even the Order's prison walls became her personal canvas.

"She's really the most rambunctious girl in the countryside," people would say. "A serious fate isn't one she's meant for, and no wall, no matter how strong, could ever keep her from spreading her wings."

Yet to everyone's surprise, she was chosen by the Divinity.

Why her? Some questioned. She was only the daughter of an official, a peasant girl lacking discipline! Not a drop of noble blood ran in her veins. How would she ever come to understand the hierarchies of the world?

"She is the one!" others exclaimed. "She listens to our sorrows and replaces them with joy! If anyone is worthy of Divinity's crown, it is her."

But what would the one bearing the name Fleurdelys think of all this? Before the ceremony to receive her holy name, in a dull and stuffy hall, she performed her final dance as Cartethyia.

Was she confused by Divinity's whispers? Fearful of an uncertain future? Confident that she could wield the sacred sword?

She simply kept the name "Cartethyia" hidden deep within her heart. Farewell, grain fields swaying in the breeze, and the Tumbleyaks roaming so free. In a world so vast, someone must take up the sword. Someone must bind themselves in thorns. Someone must accept the weight of responsibilities. Someone—

Must become Fleurdelys, the guardian of Rinascita.
records.zh:
这场巡礼持续了很长一段时间。
在那些不被注意的时间里，这位少女已经走过了拂风水畔的每一块田野。她生性顽皮自由，甚至偷喝下圣酒，在高台上舞蹈，将那场严肃的祭典变为一场彻头彻尾的闹剧，就连修会的禁闭室都变成她的涂鸦墙。
人们说：这真是乡间最顽皮的女孩，任何严肃的命运都和她无关，再坚固的门墙都束缚不住她欢腾的翅膀。
但她却偏偏获得了神明的垂青。
为什么会是她？有人曾质疑过。她只是个巡礼官的女儿，最不服管教的乡野丫头！她身上不流淌一丝贵族的血液，更别说要让她理解尊卑！
就应该是她！有人曾感叹过。她倾听过每一个人的难过，带给每一个人欢笑！如果有谁能获得那神明的冠冕，就应该是这个女孩。
但名为芙露德莉斯之人该作何想法？在那场领受圣名的典礼之前的舞会上，在那过于沉闷潮湿的空气中，少女跳起她作为卡提希娅的最后一支舞。
对那神明的低语感到疑惑吗？对那看不清的未来感到恐惧吗？对那能握紧宝剑的自我感到欣慰吗？
她只是将「卡提希娅」藏在心底。再见啦，那些自由的被微风吹起的麦浪，那自由自在翻滚的风滚牦。天地如此广大，总有人要接过宝剑，有人要自缚荆棘，有人要领受责任，有人——
要成为守护黎那汐塔的「芙露德莉斯」。

records.chapter: 卡提希娅档案_角色故事
records.text:
