records.text: Nowadays, they even consider Trattoria Margherita a place for traditional local food, just like Burrata Bakery... Honestly, do these outsiders even understand?
records.zh: 说起来，如今玛格烈特餐厅和布拉塔烘焙坊都被算作传统菜了……真是的，这群异乡人到底懂不懂呀。

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_8_1
records.text: The history of our town begins with the first settlers in Rinascita. Later, The Order united the people during the Dark Tide and established a city-state. Over time, Ragunna City became the cultural and life center of the region.
records.zh: 这里的历史可以追溯到最初人们来到黎那汐塔定居的时代，后来修会在黑潮中团结起人们，建立了城邦，拉古那城才渐渐成为了文化和生活的中心。

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_10_1
records.text: Stay away from the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 不要靠近拂风水畔深处，那里很危险。

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_10_1
records.text: I'm stationed here to ensure no one strays into the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 是的，我守在这里防止有人误入水畔深处。

records.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_2_3
records.text: He's taken a two-month leave to visit Ragunna City. If business slows down a bit, I can manage the inn by myself.
records.zh: 他向我请了两个月的假，打算去拉古那看看。如果生意清淡点，我一个人也忙得过来。

records.text: Come to think of it… Platya's hometown is actually Honami City, isn't it?
records.zh: 说起来，我记得，桔梗的家乡……其实就是穗波市吧？

records.text: …I recently learned an old Huanglong saying from Encore: "The closer to home, the more timid you are."
records.zh: ……我最近和安可学了一句瑝珑的古话，叫“近乡情更怯”。

records.text: That's probably what Platya felt like when she saw her hometown in a Sonoro… Maybe a nice meal will help cheer her up.
records.zh: 桔梗面对这个索诺拉中的穗波，心情大概也会这么复杂吧。改天请她好好吃一顿。

records.text: …Still, I have a feeling Miss Camellya will come out on top.
records.zh: ……不过，我觉得还是椿小姐会赢啊。

records.text: Kuku, by my calculations, Chisa's combat skills are more than enough to impress Miss Camellya!
records.zh: 库库，根据我的计算，千咲的战斗力一定能让椿小姐满意的。

records.text: Years of labor, years of exploitation. And now, my agent has the audacity to ask me for overtime? I'll make sure they know...
records.zh: 我被工作囚禁了那么多年，又被无良的家主剥削至今。而现在，经纪人竟敢再让我加班。我会让他们知道……

records.text: After all these years, I'm finally about to live my dream! I'll buy a boat at Riccioli Islands and live out my days as a fisherman!
records.zh: 我忍受了这么多年，终于能过上我所希望的生活了！我要去黎乔利群岛，买条船当个自由自在的渔夫！

records.text: Do you mean Peaks of Prestige? No need for concern. It so far remains under our oversight.
records.zh: 你说荣耀之丘吗？不必担心，一切尚在总督宫的控制之中。

records.text: I'm Mayou, Maji's brother. He told me all about you. Said you helped him launch a bunch of Lollo apps...
records.zh: 我叫马游，是马计的弟弟。我从他那里听说了很多关于你的事，他告诉我，你帮他研发了一大堆呜呜系列的应用……

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_5_1
records.text: Top eight? You're supposed to be playing none other than the genius Gladiator, Contender Lupa!
records.zh: 八强？你负责扮演的可是那位天才角斗士露帕选手！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_5_1
records.text: Miss Lupa would never say something like that!
records.zh: 露帕小姐是不会说出这种话的！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_5_3
records.text: The one who can quiet every child in Ragunna City—
records.zh: 能让整个拉古那城的小孩停止啼哭的——

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_1_2
records.text: What a convoluted name. How does a New Federation company even end up registered in Septimont? Is it one of those shell companies?
records.zh: 这名字还挺复杂的，你说一新联邦的公司怎么注册到七丘来了？难不成是传说中的空壳公司？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_4_4
records.text: That rainy night, you carried me in your arms and carved a way through the TD Outbreak in the Sanguis Plateaus. To this day, people still talk about how the Odle Family stole an orphan right back from death's grip.
records.zh: 那年的雨夜，您抱着我在桑古伊斯狩原的残象潮中奔驰，所有人都记得，奥德家族曾经从死亡的手中夺回了一个遗孤。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_4_5
records.text: Ah, Priestess Iuno... it seems fate was never mine to rewrite.
records.zh: 啊……尤诺大人，到头来，我还是没能改变她的结局么？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_8_2
records.text: So, do you prefer the Septimont or Huanglong styles?
records.zh: 不知道你是更喜欢七丘的还是更喜欢瑝珑的风格呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_1_4
records.text: Don't worry... Once I've earned enough credits, I'll head back to Huanglong and take all of you to Mingting. That way, my little sis can go to school there.
records.zh: 放心吧……等我赚够了钱，就回瑝珑，到时候给你们搬到明庭去，让小妹去那的学校念书。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_2_2
records.text: Have you heard? Maji just got promoted again.
records.zh: 你听说了么，马计最近又升职了。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_3_1
records.text: The Scratchy's exhibition match is about to start. Switch the channel! Or we'll miss the opening show!
records.zh: 磕磕撞撞队的表演赛就要开始了，换台啊！再不切过去就要错过开幕演出了！

records.chapter: 剧情_黎那汐塔基础功能NPC_4_5
records.text: Ding! Margherita's Victory Feast, served up with flair!
records.zh: 叮！玛格烈特冠军全餐出炉啾！

records.chapter: 剧情_黎那汐塔基础功能NPC_4_1
records.text: Welcome to Margherita's! Your pizza will be hot and fresh in no time!
records.zh: 欢迎光临玛格烈特家庭餐厅，披萨马上就出炉了啾！

records.chapter: 剧情_黎那汐塔基础功能NPC_1_1
records.text: Pleasure to meet you! I am Fulmine, the head of the Wutherium Film Studio. We are the visual production division of the Pioneer Association.
records.zh: 很高兴认识您！我是拉古那城先行公约旗下“潮汐影像工作室”的主理人，斐林。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_4_支线_彩蛋NPC对话+包装_3_2
records.text: You tell Fulmine what happened at the Plushie Village in Septimont.
records.zh: 你将发生在七丘布偶村的事情和斐林讲述了一下。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_4_支线_彩蛋NPC对话+包装_3_2
records.text: After Fulmine hangs up, Tubpup looks at you, eyes filled with anticipation.
records.zh: 斐林挂断电话后，浴缸犬看着你，露出了期待的眼神。

records.text: Just thinking about the news I saw last night. Something about that champion Gladiator everyone's talking about... Her name's Lupa, right? She looks quite the warrior!
records.zh: 妈妈在想昨天晚上看的新闻报道哦。这次的热门夺冠选手……名字叫做露帕吗？看上去还挺强的！

records.text: Mom, who was the champion twenty years ago? Was she as great as Lupa?
records.zh: 妈妈，二十年前的优胜者是谁啊？她和露帕姐姐谁更厉害啊？

records.text: Again with the story twenty years ago... As far as I'm concerned, there's no one cooler or stronger than Lupa. When I grow up, I want to buy some of your gear, old timer, then go ask Lupa to be my mentor!
records.zh: 大叔，你怎么又开始讲二十年前的事情了……反正在我心里，露帕姐姐最帅最强。我的梦想就是长大之后从大叔你这买装备，然后去找露帕姐姐拜师学角斗技巧！

records.text: Lupa's team won. No surprises there. Still, I'm proud of you, Beasts Beneath! May applause greet you!
records.zh: 最后果然是露帕{Male=他们;Female=她们}夺冠了啊……以呼嚎向你们致意，我的兽之心队！

records.text: Oh? Not calling yourself a longtime Lupa fan, are you now?
records.zh: 怎么了，这次不改口说自己是露帕的粉丝了？

records.text: Please. After today, we're all Lupa fans! Some people already watched the replays of her finals match a dozens times.
records.zh: 哪有，我们这里不遍地都是她的粉丝？已经有人反复看了十几遍决赛回放了。

records.text: You got this, Lupa! No matter how you do in the finals, I'll always support you!
records.zh: 露帕选手加油啊！无论冠军赛表现如何，我都永远支持你！

records.text: With her capabilities, the win's in the bag for sure! I want to get stronger too... Wish I could be in the same training room with Lupa...
records.zh: 她实力那么强，夺冠肯定没问题的！我也想变强，真希望露帕选手训练的时候可以带我一个啊……

records.text: See? I told you all Lupa was going to win the championship!
records.zh: 哼哼~我就知道露帕选手肯定会夺冠的！

records.text: I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple.
records.zh: 看来是我误会了……露帕的强大毋庸置疑。

records.text: You're a quick learner! Won't be long before you can start heading out to the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 你的成绩进步很快。估计再过不久，就能被派往桑古伊斯狩原执行任务了。

records.text: When's our next Sanguis Plateaus mission, Captain?
records.zh: 队长，我们下次什么时候去桑古伊斯狩原啊？

records.text: Captain Drusus, when will we be assigned field missions? I've done pretty much everything there is to do around the Citadel. I think it's about time we get to see some action. I've always had an interest in recon missions in the Sanguis Plateaus...
records.zh: 德鲁苏斯长官，什么时候能给我们分配到要塞外执勤的任务啊？要塞内的工作我都熟悉了，也该去外面看看了吧……我觉得桑古伊斯狩原的侦查任务就挺不错的。

records.text: Yeah. You think that Gladiator can go up against Lupa, old timer?
records.zh: 是啊是啊。大叔，你说的那个角斗士有露帕姐姐那么强吗？

records.text: That's right. I'm a Lupa superfan! I've watched replays of every single one of her matches at least a million times now!
records.zh: 是啊，我可是露帕选手的超级粉丝。她的每一场比赛我都看了几十遍了哦！

records.text: What's there to be fishy about? It's pure Lupa roflstomp! Besides, Lupa's not the cheating type!
records.zh: 能有什么猫腻？就是单纯实力碾压罢了！露帕不可能是打假赛的那种人！

records.text: Hey! Aren't you one of Lupa's teammates? I didn't recognize you last time. Congrats on winning the championship!
records.zh: 啊！你不就是露帕选手的队友吗？上次没认出你来，恭喜你们夺得冠军！

records.text: Can you help me tell Lupa that I'm sorry for accusing her of cheating earlier?
records.zh: 能帮我向露帕选手道个歉吗？之前我不该怀疑她打假赛的。

records.text: I know you've probably already gone over this in your manual, but there are things I still need to remind you again before you head out to the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 虽然你可能之前已经从手册上学习了，但在前往桑古伊斯狩原执行任务前，我还是有几件事想再三叮嘱下。

records.text: Let me guess, you're chomping at the bit thinking about getting out on the Sanguis Plateaus and proving yourself hunting TDs that you're not even interested in any other missions, am I right?
records.zh: 你这家伙满脑子都想着去桑古伊斯狩原狩猎残象证明自己，别的任务都无心执行了吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_12
records.text: You wouldn't want to end your glorious career in disgrace, would you? The young rise quickly, old friend.
records.zh: 您这光辉的职业生涯，也不想落个身败名裂的结局吧……拳怕少壮啊，前辈。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_12
records.text: Hehe. I may have a way to keep the boy's career... quiet. For a few years, at least.
records.zh: 呵呵，前辈，我这里倒是有一个方法，可以让这小子的职业生涯安静几年……

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_20
records.text: We need fighters like Lupa. Eyes locked on the enemy's throat, always calculating the kill. That's someone who wins, or dies trying.
records.zh: 你要找的是露帕那种永远紧盯着对手双眼和喉咙的人，因为我们不需要失败者，要么赢，要么滚。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_22
records.text: Yes, these are the worst by far, madam... Only a handful barely made the cut, and Lupa still crushed them five to zero.
records.zh: 诶，今年真是有史以来最差的一届了……就这么几个人已经是还算勉强的了，没想到一见到露帕就被打了个五比零。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_5
records.text: It depends... But I'd go for Lupa if you ask me.
records.zh: 这个要分情况……不过要我说，目前应该是露帕选手吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_5
records.text: Lupa is the real deal, no doubt. But if the Ephor ever entered the ring? All bets are off.
records.zh: 的确应该是露帕选手，但总督要是下场的话就不一定了……

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_6
records.text: Aha! So even you think Lupa is the strongest out there! I knew it!
records.zh: 果然，哥哥们也认为露帕选手是现在最强的角斗士呀！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_6
records.text: Ha! I knew Lupa was unbeatable! No one can take down our champion!
records.zh: 耶！果然露帕选手才是最强的！我们露帕选手是不可战胜的！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_7
records.text: All the lads think Lupa is the strongest Gladiator around. But I think her partner also deserves more credit.
records.zh: 哥哥们认为露帕选手是现在最强的角斗士……但我觉得她那位搭档也同样优秀啊。

records.text: If Paragon Qingxiao hadn't been there, I shudder to think what might have happened.
records.zh: 若不是有清宵司骑助阵，后果可就难说了。

records.text: You know, the new Watcher Yangyang was truly something else out there on the battlefield.
records.zh: 说起来，秧秧骑使在战场上真是太可靠了啊。

records.text: Her and Watcher Liangyu together? Devastating. It's just a pity that... Ah.
records.zh: 椋羽骑使和她的配合也非常默契，只可惜……哎。

records.text: I did. And we all heard Paragon Qingxiao's voice too.
records.zh: 看到了。大家不是还听到清宵司骑的声音了吗？

records.text: Grandfather, I saw the great Lady Qingxiao again.
records.zh: 爷爷，我又看到清宵姐姐了。

records.text: Hah! Your imagination's outpaced the truth again, boy. As if you'd run into Paragon Qingxiao.
records.zh: 去去，吹牛不打草稿，清宵司骑哪是你能老看见的。

records.text: I've told you about her. Daoist Master Jiufeng's favorite disciple? She has a history with Qingxiao the Perfected.
records.zh: 就是那位九峰道长的爱徒啊，我跟你讲过的。她和清宵真人有一段渊源。

records.text: I've seen Paragon Qingxiao twice just recently. That's got to be a lucky omen.
records.zh: 最近我见到了足足两次清宵司骑，绝对会走好运的。

records.text: Lady Hsin, surely You will show Yourself soon as well!
records.zh: 心月狐大人，您想必很快也会现身了吧！

records.text: Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar, recommended by Transcendents themselves!
records.zh: 梦州醋鲙，仙子推荐！

records.text: Hello there. I remember you were dining with Paragon Qingxiao earlier.
records.zh: 你好啊，我记得之前清宵司骑是和你在同一桌吃饭的。

records.text: Our reinforcements sent to Xuanfang Hold have reported in.
records.zh: 咱们派去玄方城的支援部队有消息了。

records.text: During the Fortress and Gorges War, the Midnight Rangers' forebears held the line at the Gorges of Spirits against the Tacet Discord hordes.
records.zh: 云渊之役时，夜归的先辈们可就在云陵谷抵挡残象潮了。

records.text: Sent a copy to Qingxiao too. She seemed pretty happy after seeing it.
records.zh: 我也给清宵发了一份哦，她收到后似乎心情很好。

records.text: Wait... Is that Qingxiao the Transcendent I'm seeing?
records.zh: 咦，刚才……我是看到了清宵仙子吗？

records.text: Besides us, did the Gorges of Spirits get hit by the TD Outbreak too?
records.zh: 之前的那波残象潮，除了我们这，还去了云陵谷？

records.text: True. As long as the Gorges of Spirits are still in a mess, the Threnodian's gonna keep sending TDs our way.
records.zh: 确实，只要云陵谷的问题没解决，鸣式就能不断派残象过来。

records.text: Oh, I've got my own problem... I'm scared of heights. My legs are shaking already.
records.zh: 我倒和你情况不一样……我恐高，现在腿都有点软。

records.text: Of course. If the Rafter Kite hadn't brought Paragon Qingxiao at the time, us kids would've been swept away in the flood.
records.zh: 当然了。当年要不是梁鸢叫来了清宵真人，我们这几个小孩可都要被山洪冲走喽。

records.text: They were soldiers stationed at Jinmen Pass. After the front line fell back to the Gorges of Spirits, they fought to their last breath.
records.zh: 他们本是驻扎在今门关的边军，在战线退至云陵谷后，奋战到了最后一刻。

records.text: Paragon Qingxiao, 漂泊者, I wish you both a safe journey.
records.zh: 清宵真人，漂泊者，祝你们一路平安啊。

records.text: As things stand, even Lady Hsin's residence may not be called safe. Do take the utmost care.
records.zh: 如今形势特殊，心大人的行宫也难说安全无虞，请务必多加小心。

records.text: Don't worry. We have Ms. Yangyang and all the soldiers keeping watch. We'll be fine.
records.zh: 嗯，放心去吧。外面有秧秧姑娘和众多的将士们在，我们不会有事的。

records.text: Hello! This is account manager Maji. How can I help you today?
records.zh: 您好，我是客户经理马计。请问有什么需要咨询的？

records.text: You give Galbrena a quick rundown about what happened in Honami.
records.zh: 你简单地和嘉贝莉娜聊了聊近期在穗波市发生的事。

records.text: I am waiting. Fish in Mengzhou are far craftier than those in Jinzhou.
records.zh: 我在等待。梦州的鱼看来比今州的更为狡猾机敏。

records.text: Okay, let's not stick around too long. I don't know why, but the Sanguis Plateaus give me the creeps…
records.zh: 嗯，还是早点回去吧。不知道为什么，我总觉得桑古伊斯狩原那边阴森森的……

records.text: The Sanguis Plateaus... The travel guide says we're not allowed to go, right?
records.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原……按照旅游手册上所说的，我们是不被允许前往吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_2_11
records.text: The Sanguis Plateaus is very dangerous now. We shouldn't rush in without being fully prepared.
records.zh: 现在的桑古伊斯狩原十分危险，没有做好万全的准备，绝不能贸然踏入。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_1_3
records.text: ...Okay, I've noted your feedback. You can take a break, and I'll submit the Sanguis Plateaus report for you.
records.zh: ……好的，你反馈的情况我都记下了。先在这里休息会儿吧，桑古伊斯狩原的报告我会替你上交的。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_1_5
records.text: You're a new guest, right? Although you look pretty strong, I still don't think you should go to the Sanguis Plateaus unprepared.
records.zh: 您是刚来这附近的客人吧？虽然看您身手不凡，但我还是不建议您贸然前往桑古伊斯狩原。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_1_5
records.text: We will head to the Sanguis Plateaus again to hunt soon. If the situation improves, the next time we meet will be when we're on the hunt.
records.zh: 不久后，我们就会再次前往桑古伊斯狩原行猎。如果情况有所好转的话，下次见面就是一同行猎的时候了。

records.text: Oh, and one more thing: watch that tower. You humans love building dangerous toys, meow.
records.zh: 千万要小心，那座高高矗立的塔喵。人类总喜欢造这种危险的东西喵。

records.text: That's… really scary. But somehow… I feel like it wasn't just a dream.
records.zh: ……那确实有点可怕。奇怪，为什么我感觉……这不像是梦呢？

records.text: Maybe I've just been too scared to accept that those happy moments were real.
records.zh: 其实……是我自己不敢承认那些沉眠在记忆里的幸福瞬间吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_穗波市和黑海岸群岛_1_6
records.text: That's enough. If Valentina finds out you tried something so reckless again, you'll be writing reports.
records.zh: 够了，让瓦莲京娜女士知道你这么莽撞，就等着写检查吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_穗波市和黑海岸群岛_2_1
records.text: That blue figure just now… Was that Shorekeeper?
records.zh: 刚才的那个蓝色身影是……守岸人女士？

records.text: Ah, you're the young {Male=man;Female=lady} who was with Watcher Yangyang. Please give her my regards.
records.zh: 啊，你是和秧秧骑使在一起的那位年轻人，请替我向她问个好吧。

records.text: I thought I wasn't going to make it through the last incident, and had Yangyang send a letter home for me.
records.zh: 我曾以为自己活不过之前的那场变故了，托秧秧骑使给家里人寄过信。

records.text: Hmm? You're the hero who fought alongside Watcher Yangyang during the defense of the Hold.
records.zh: 咦，你是那位在守城战里和秧秧骑使并肩作战的英雄？

records.text: As for Miss Suisui, I heard she arranged for the Commerce Guild to send a big shipment of emergency supplies to the Hold. The Ministry of Development also received a hefty stock of raw materials, too.
records.zh: 至于穗穗女士，我听说她安排商会给玄方城运来了一大批应急物资，天工部也补充了不少原材料。

records.text: I ran into Paragon Qingxiao on a job. When she stepped off her flying sword, I thought something was wrong, but she just stopped to ask me for directions.
records.zh: 我在出外勤时见到了清宵司骑，她从飞剑上下来时，我还以为出了什么事，原来只是找我问路啊。

records.text: Watcher Yangyang being reassigned to Xuanfang Hold has been one of the few pieces of good news these days. Folks all wanted to thank her in person.
records.zh: 秧秧骑使调任玄方城的事算是这些天为数不多的好消息，有不少人想去当面答谢她。

records.text: Quite the personality, doesn't she? The other day, I saw Master Leitao calling her over for dinner.
records.zh: 很有个性对吧？前几天，我还见到累陶师傅去喊她一起吃饭呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_2_1
records.text: Speaking of which, I've never been to the Sanguis Plateaus myself…
records.zh: 说起来我还从来没有去过桑古伊斯狩原……

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_1
records.text: I watched the Final where you and Lupa fought side by side. That was a remarkable victory.
records.zh: 我观看了您和露帕选手的决赛，不得不说，赢得漂亮。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_1
records.text: Contender Lupa is a force to be reckoned with, but your prowess is unquestionable as well.
records.zh: 露帕选手的实力固然出众，但您的实力也不容小觑。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_1
records.text: Speaking of which, I hear you're accompanying Her Excellency to the Sanguis Plateaus for the hunt?
records.zh: 说起来，我有听闻您要和总督大人一起参与桑古伊斯狩原的行猎？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_2_13
records.text: Augusta! You are our eternal Hero of the Heroes!
records.zh: 奥古斯塔，您才是我们永远的王！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_3
records.text: If the Sanguis Plateaus were to fall, the Blightcloud would sweep in, unstoppable. It would devour all of Septimont in an instant, and the City of Glory would be lost to history.
records.zh: 倘若桑古伊斯狩原失守，黑潮云的翻涌便无人可以阻止。它很有可能在顷刻间倾覆七丘，毁灭我们的荣耀之都。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_5
records.text: It's true that Ephor Augusta has had her share of accomplishments... but many still doubt her ability to lead all of Septimont.
records.zh: 诚然奥古斯塔总督在某些方面表现出色，但想要治理七丘，仅凭目前的表现尚不足以说服众人。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_6
records.text: Augusta, Hero of the Heroes. I didn't expect her to truly prove herself.
records.zh: 英雄王奥古斯塔啊……没想到她真的证明了自己。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_6
records.text: I believe under Ephor Augusta's rule, more will come to see her as she truly is.
records.zh: 相信随着总督的治理，越来越多的人会认同她。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_7
records.text: Normally, it takes three to four weeks to schedule an audience with Her Excellency. However, given the urgency of the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus, that rule doesn't apply to you.
records.zh: 通常与总督会面需要提前三至四周进行预约，但鉴于您所需交涉的是有关狩原的要事，可以不受这条条例的影响。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_9
records.text: But I doubt any of that will trouble you. With you and Contender Lupa on the field, I can't imagine anyone standing in your way.
records.zh: ……不过这些对于您来说应该都不是问题吧？我相信以您和露帕选手的实力，可以赢下任何的角斗比赛。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_每日_归期未有期_续_7_1
records.text: All those lights across Xuanfang Hold... They were stunning.
records.zh: 玄方城的万家灯火……很美。

records.chapter: 剧情_贡多拉共乘_奥古斯塔_1_4
records.text: The Sanguis Plateaus, border to the abyss... countless unsung heroes have fallen in these hunting grounds. May the fragrance of Asphodels bring peace to their souls, and may the wings of Gryphons guide them home to the Vale of Glory.
records.zh: 毗邻狭渊的桑古伊斯狩原……太多无名的英雄倒在了这片荒凉的猎场，愿往世花的幽香抚慰他们的英魂，愿鹰鹫的羽翼引领他们归返荣耀之间。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_支线_历程记忆手册_燎原觅影_8_1
records.text: It wasn't until eight years ago that his frequency started appearing around the Sanguis Plateaus again. That's when people began to remember the name “Timid Acis.”
records.zh: 直到八年前，父亲的频率出现在狩原四处徘徊，“胆小的阿喀斯”的名号才逐渐被人想起。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_支线_历程记忆手册_燎原觅影_1_3
records.text: It likely has something to do with the Sanguis Plateaus itself.
records.zh: 他的“灵魂”会出现徘徊，多半和桑古伊斯狩原本身有关。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_2
records.text: I recall the dusk when I took Rosalie to Avinoleum. The golden light of the setting sun bathed the main tower's dome.
records.zh: 我想起……带罗萨莉去看「阿维纽林」的那个傍晚，黄昏的淡金色铺满了主塔的穹顶。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_2
records.text: This is indeed Avinoleum. These towers, these columns... They still shine with the brilliance of days gone by.
records.zh: 是的……啊，这确实是「阿维纽林」。这些塔楼和廊柱……它们仍像从前那样辉煌……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_1_1
records.text: The tower... It seems to have risen to where Avinoleum is.
records.zh: 留在地上的塔……隐约升上了「阿维纽林」所在的高天……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_1
records.text: But when I reached the part about Avinoleum, I realized I could barely remember what it looked like.
records.zh: 但当我提笔写起「阿维纽林」，我却发觉它在记忆里的样子变得有些模糊了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_1
records.text: This was drawn back when Avinoleum was still on the ground. It marks the renowned places of that time.
records.zh: 这份路线图是在「阿维纽林」仍在地面时绘制的，标注的都是当时知名的地点。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_1
records.text: Once, Avinoleum was a marvel admired across all of Rinascita. But now, it's nothing more than an expanse of shadows, hanging in the sky.
records.zh: 曾经让整个黎那汐塔震撼的「阿维纽林」，现在只是天空中一片难以辨识的阴翳。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_1_2
records.text: When you were in Avinoleum, did you encounter... No, please forget it. Good luck on your journey.
records.zh: 你是否在「阿维纽林」遇到过……不，没什么。祝你一路顺风。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_3_1
records.text: A place blessed by the Sentinel, where divine glory converges—the Avinoleum Theological Seminary.
records.zh: 岁主赐福的殿堂，有着拉古那所有的光辉与神迹的地方，阿维纽林神学院。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_3_2
records.text: Ragunna City is always full of cheer and joy at such times, but I never expected to see the same festive spirit at the seminary.
records.zh: 这个时间的拉古那城总是张灯结彩，但我没想到……神学院里也是一样。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_4_支线_历程记忆手册_战陵追痕_6_1
records.text: Septimont City, Capitoline Hill, Gryphon's Fortress. This place goes by many names, just as it embodies the many qualities of the Septimontians.
records.zh: 七丘城、卡庇托山城或是鹫巢石城，它有很多名字，就像它代表了七丘人所拥有的诸多特质。

records.text: Drawing on the mechanics of the Thorncrown Rises and the Remnant Energy within Nimbus Sanctum, I have recreated powerful frequencies from various dimensions.
records.zh: 我集合了大量的智慧，利用三重冠塔的原理，以云海内的回音能量为基础，在此处复现了各时空中足够强大的频率。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_今州一日奇谈_6_2
records.text: The combination of bitter medicine and delightful ingredients creates a unique taste on your tongue. You notice the same intricate expression mirrored on the faces of the other two.
records.zh: 药剂的清涩混合着食材的鲜香，一阵奇异的味道从你的唇齿间划过，你打量着另外两人，在她们脸上看到同样一言难尽的神情。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_今州一日奇谈_3_1
records.text: Hello there, how can I help...? Oh, Ms. Chixia?
records.zh: 你好，有什么要买的……咦？炽霞姐？

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_今州一日奇谈_4_1
records.text: ...Aw, please don’t call me Xiaofang! It’s Chixia!
records.zh: ……不是小芳啦，是炽霞，是小霞！

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
records.text: You remind me of Xinyi the first time I saw her.
records.zh: 因为我看到你，就想起从前第一次看到辛夷的时候。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
records.text: When I handed over the position to Xinyi, I gave this scale to her as well.
records.zh: 在刚刚把掌事之位交给辛夷的时候，我把这鳞片也交给了她。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
records.text: I'm the one who had witnessed Hongzhen grow into what it is today before I handed it over to Xinyi.
records.zh: 我是看着虹镇长大，然后亲手把它交到辛夷手上的人。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
records.text: Back then, I thought Hongzhen needed Xinyi more than me, just like Jinhsi did Jué.
records.zh: 当年的我觉得，就像角需要今汐一般，虹镇比起我，更需要辛夷。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_支线_大世界_烬潮之梦_1_1
records.text: 漂泊者, I've just sensed a Dreamscape Node being restored in the Sanguis Plateaus. And no surprise, it was your doing.
records.zh: 漂泊者，我刚刚感受到桑古伊斯狩原的梦境节点被修复了，果然是你出手了啊。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_支线_大世界_烬潮之梦_2_1
records.text: Ah, yes. I've discovered something interesting within the final Node of the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 对了，在桑古伊斯狩原最后的梦境节点中，我发现了一个有趣的东西。

records.text: It seems Melody and I should venture beyond Ragunna City and explore the wider world.
records.zh: 看来，我和麦乐帝也应该从拉古那城出去，多在外面的世界走走才是。

records.text: Why not expand your business in Ragunna City?
records.zh: 怎么不去拉古那城发展？

records.text: I've heard from the elders in town that at the end of Whisperwind Haven lies a mystical island, surrounded by a circular forest encasing a mirror-like lake.
records.zh: 说起来，我听镇里的老人讲过，拂风水畔的尽头有一座梦幻般的岛屿，圆环状的森林包围着一处镜湖。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_26_1
records.text: Oops, my bad. I should call you Chixia, Patroller Chixia.
records.zh: 呵呵呵，怪我怪我，瞧我这记性。是炽霞，炽霞巡尉。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_47_1
records.text: You’re gonna be the hero of Huanglong, Ma Xiaofang.
records.zh: 以后就是瑝珑的大英雄马小芳了。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_47_1
records.text: You’re gonna be the hero of Huanglong, Chixia.
records.zh: 以后就是瑝珑的大英雄炽霞了。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_47_1
records.text: If the art of appraising treasure piques your interest, it may be worthwhile to seek guidance from a young girl known as "Master Youhu" if you cross paths with her in the future.
records.zh: 或许，若小友有缘遇到那自称“釉瑚大师”的姑娘，大可向她求教一二。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_47_1
records.text: Ugh, speaking of that, I haven’t seen Youhu for a while now. Hopefully she didn’t get into trouble again…
records.zh: 啧，怎么感觉许久没瞧见那丫头了，别是又惹了什么乱子。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_47_1
records.text: Haha, well... I’m afraid you should ask Patroller Chixia herself.
records.zh: 呵呵呵，这个……你得问问我们的炽霞巡尉了。

records.text: And just like that, we can enjoy some momentary peace in the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 这样一来，桑古伊斯狩原就能平静一阵子了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_1_1
records.text: (What is this feeling... is it... the Somnoire?)
records.zh: （怎么回事……这种感觉是……心之集域？）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_1_1
records.text: There are things best discussed face-to-face. Could you come to Ragunna City if you have the time? I need a favor from you, meow...
records.zh: 有些事情可能需要当面才能说清楚，有时间的话，能来一下拉古那城么？我有些事想拜托你喵……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_2_1
records.text: However, in the Fagaceae Peninsula and the Penitent's End, the Dreamscape Nodes appear to be veiled by an unknown force.
records.zh: 不过在槲生半岛和悲叹墓岛，梦境网络的节点似乎都被某种莫名的力量遮蔽了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_2_1
records.text: It's truly a headache, meow. Penitent's End is completely shrouded in a thick, eerie fog, and some of the nodes in Thessaleo Fells are shielded by a strange energy.
records.zh: 真是头疼喵，墓岛目前全域都被某种幽邃的雾气所笼罩，而槲生半岛的部分节点则被一些特殊力量覆盖了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_2_1
records.text: Originally, I couldn't leave the Whining Aix's Mire or collect dreams from other regions due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus.
records.zh: 原本由于管理员权限和集域中枢的限制，我很难离开怨鸟泽，也无法收集其他区域人们的梦境。

records.text: Sorry to trouble you. My name is Luojing, and I oversee the seal on a certain mechanism within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
records.zh: 冒昧联系您，我是落京，负责监测梦枢天罗的一处机关封印。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_50_1
records.text: Is that so? It leads to the Somnoire, a place where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge.
records.zh: 是吗？这扇门中的空间叫做心之集域，它贮存了索拉里斯上的所有幻想。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_中曲台地支线_50_1
records.text: You know about the Somnoire? It's where all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 are stored.
records.zh: 你有印象？心之集域贮存了索拉里斯上的所有幻想。

records.chapter: 剧情_肉鸽_新手引导副本_6_2
records.text: The Somnoire has grown increasingly chaotic and dangerous.
records.zh: 从不知何时起，心之集域开始变得越来越混乱。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局外对话事件_5_1
records.text: "It went down exactly the way I thought it would. Knew Fenrico was up to no-good right from the start!"
records.zh: “这电影我猜得果然没错，芬莱克这家伙……哼，我一眼就看出他不是好人！”

records.text: (She knows Platya and I are tracking her. She knew I was coming today.)
records.zh: （她知道我和桔梗的行踪，也知道我今天要来。）

records.text: It's about a miko from my hometown. I don't know if you've heard, but Ashinohara's defense against the Threnodian was built around mikos.
records.zh: 是关于我故乡的一位巫女，不知道你有没有听说过，苇原抵抗鸣式的防线是以巫女为核心构建的。

records.text: I've already set a timeline with Hiyuki. This next trip is the last one the Collective is authorizing.
records.zh: 我和绯雪约定了时间，最近就是深空联合容许她进行的最后一次探查。

records.text: Hi 漂泊者, this is Platya. How have things been?
records.zh: 漂泊者，我是桔梗，最近还好吗？

records.text: You watch "Leon the Unprofessional" with Platya...
records.zh: 你和桔梗一同观看了《这个杀手有点儿冷》……

records.text: But I did find one journal. The daily habits recorded in it match someone from Ashinohara. It's highly likely our Lady Miko wrote it herself.
records.zh: 不过我注意到了一封日志，里面记载的生活习惯与穗波人十分相像，而且极有可能就是巫女大人写下的。

records.text: You discover the instruments of the Poets Society, and Ciaccona decides to use it to recreate the past.
records.zh: 你们找到了诗社人的乐器，夏空决定利用它复现过去。

records.text: Where is this place? A study? Ciaccona are we... Ciaccona?
records.zh: 这里是？看上去像一个书房，夏空，我们是不是……夏空？

records.text: We must have gotten separated. Ciaccona did say even a slight misstep could draw us into other melodies. Am I...
records.zh: 走散了……夏空说过，步伐稍有偏差就会触发其他旋律，难道是……

records.text: Won't you dine with me? Ms. Margherita asked me to sample her newest pizza, but my goodness, these portions...
records.zh: 不介意的话，能和我拼桌吗？玛格烈特小姐请我来试吃新款披萨，不过这分量，一个人恐怕……

records.text: Just call me Ciaccona! We don't need to overcomplicate things.
records.zh: 叫我夏空就好！没必要那么复杂啦。

records.text: You and Ciaccona realize that these criminals are in fact members of the Golden Anthem.
records.zh: 你和夏空明白了，也许他们口中的罪人就是「黄金之歌」的成员。

records.text: Their assumptions were challenged, so they traveled to the knight's encampment at Whisperwind Haven to verify the truth for themselves.
records.zh: 遭到质问的诗社成员似乎决定前往骑士驻扎的营地，亲眼见证真相，地点就在拂风水畔。

records.text: If the Order's choir is pointing us to Whisperwind Haven, then that's where we'll find more clues. Let's go.
records.zh: 既然唱诗班的记录指向了拂风水畔，或许在那儿我们能找到线索，我们走吧。

records.text: Chorister Raisa leaves to rehearse with the other children. After she leaves, Ciaccona starts asking you questions about what you saw in the melody.
records.zh: 莱莎带着唱诗班的孩子继续开始排练，夏空向你询问起旋律的故事。

records.text: Ciaccona plays her instrument. The wind stirs, and the melody of the Poets Society fills the air.
records.zh: 夏空随心演奏着乐曲，你触摸着风，感受到了诗社过去的旋律……

records.text: We'll go back to Margherita's. It's where our story began... and it's where it must end.
records.zh: 我们回玛格烈特餐厅去，这个故事始于那里……也必须终于那里。

records.text: Is this form of the Sentinel the same as the one you saw at Avinoleum, 漂泊者?
records.zh: 漂泊者，这和你在「阿维纽林」见到的岁主一样吗？

records.text: Cristoforo approaches and greets you, mentioning a recent article from Ragunna that offers an unusual take on the "Golden Anthem" legend.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗向你们主动打起招呼。他告诉你们拉古那最近有篇文章，对于「黄金之歌」的传闻作出了异样的解读。

records.text: Well, hello, hello! If it isn't 漂泊者 and Ciaccona!
records.zh: 你们好啊，是漂泊者和夏空啾！

records.text: Oh, Miss Ciaccona is a regular around here, you know. I've even asked her to perform a few times. Helps bring in the crowds!
records.zh: 夏空小姐是餐厅的熟客了啾，之前我还邀请过她担任驻唱乐师，为餐厅招揽客人。

records.text: Actually, I've come to ask a favor of you today, Ms. Margherita. I'm sure you've heard the rumors circulating lately...
records.zh: 今天来，我们是有事想要让你帮忙，你应该知道最近热议的那则传闻。

records.text: Margherita agrees to your request and begins to gather an impressive crowd...
records.zh: 玛格烈特接受了你们的请求，替你们召集了不少人……

records.text: You and Ciaccona take your place on an impromptu "stage," the curtain poised to rise.
records.zh: 现如今你们正站在“舞台”上，大幕还未拉开。

records.text: As you finish your interpretation, the crowd in the restaurant grows restless, many surrounding you with questions. While you and Ciaccona are separated in the crowd, and Cristoforo appears next to Ciaccona, telling a story about a caged bird, as if hinting at something deeper.
records.zh: 解读结束后，餐厅下的观众开始热议起来，不少人围着你们询问，你和夏空被人群分开，克里斯托弗出现在夏空周围，讲述了一个笼中之鸟的故事，似乎在隐喻着什么。

records.text: We should also share these findings with Ciaccona. As a poet, her insights would be much appreciated.
records.zh: 我们也把现在的线索告诉夏空吧，她也是诗人，说不定有新的想法。

records.text: Ms. Ciaccona... Hmm, she was squirreling off towards the harbor earlier. I thought that's where you were meeting, so I didn't say a word.
records.zh: 夏空小姐……我记得她朝港口的方向走去了，我还以为你们约定好了要在那里见面，就没拦住她。

records.text: Thank you for letting us know, Ms. Margherita.
records.zh: 谢谢你，玛格烈特小姐。

records.text: You search around but find no sign of Ciaccona.
records.zh: 你们四处看了一下，却没有发现夏空的踪影。

records.text: Oh, the parallels... so striking. Just like the day the Poets Society boarded their Sail. You, Ciaccona Toccata, blaspheming against the Sentinel.
records.zh: 唉，像啊，真像啊，诗社那时登上朝圣船也像现在这样，夏空·托卡塔……渎神重罪。

records.text: Is this Ciaccona's sheet music? She was here.
records.zh: 这是夏空的乐谱？她来过这里。

records.text: Ciaccona mentioned she always writes down her melodies on manuscript paper. Could this be...?
records.zh: 夏空说过她将所有的旋律都记录在乐谱上，这上面会不会有……

records.text: Earlier before, Ciaccona walked to the harbor...
records.zh: 此前，夏空走到港口时……

records.text: Cristoforo's words echo in Ciaccona's mind. As she walks toward the harbor, memories of the Poets Society and her own past resurface. She now understands what Cristoforo meant—if the truth is revealed, the past tragedies may be doomed to repeat themselves.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗的话在夏空脑海里回响，她走到港口时想起了过去诗社和她自己身上发生的故事。她理解了克里斯托弗的言外之意，如果公布真相，也许过去的悲剧将会再次发生。

records.text: The girl in the Poets Society's study must have been Ciaccona when she was little...
records.zh: 待在诗社书房的女孩应该就是小时候的夏空……

records.text: Let me tell you... the story of the "Golden Anthem" doesn't just belong to the Poets Society. It also belongs to me, Ciaccona Toccata...
records.zh: 就由我来告诉你吧，《黄金之歌》的故事不仅仅属于诗社，也属于夏空·托卡塔……

records.text: I am yesterday's child of ignorance, the actor now on stage, and the banished sinner of tomorrow... Ciaccona Toccata.
records.zh: 我是过去无知的孩子，是现在登台的演员，是未来流放的罪人……夏空·托卡塔。

records.text: Ciaccona Toccata, in the name of Imperator and Primus Fenrico, you are hereby under arrest. You will face the full weight of the law at the Order Penitentiary.
records.zh: 夏空·托卡塔，以英白拉多和芬莱克主座的名义，你将被押入忏悔院，受到律法的制裁。

records.text: Ciaccona joins you in returning to Ragunna City, where, as planned, you will make your final revelation. However, your actions have drawn the attention of the Order, and the Acolytes are closing in on you.
records.zh: 夏空与你一同回到拉古那城，按照昨日你们的预告，你们将在此地发表最终解读，揭开真相。与此同时，你们的行动也招来了修会的关注，教士们正在一步步靠近你们。

records.text: Sweeping through Whisperwind Haven and towards Ragunna's high walls.
records.zh: 掠过水畔吹向拉古那的高墙

records.text: I've heard whispers of your presence at Whisperwind Haven around that time. Whenever you were asked, you claimed to be seeking inspiration.
records.zh: 有人说那段时间你也出现在拂风水畔附近，每当有人问起，你的说辞都是在寻求灵感。

records.text: You sought to revive the blasphemous Poets Society, spreading their legacy to stoke the fires of prejudice. And through my aid, summon Daemons to sow fear across Ragunna City...
records.zh: 您想起那犯下渎神罪过的诗社，故意传播他们的遗作，加深大家对他们的偏见，借我之手，在拉古那城中引出所谓的「亡灵」，制造恐慌……

records.text: At the Cathedral of Mercury, Cristoforo reveals Fenrico's plan. In the confrontation, Fenrico suspect that Crisroforo was the one who secretly guided the Poets Society all those years ago.
records.zh: 水星天大教堂内，克里斯托弗道出了芬莱克的计划，两人对峙中，芬莱克开始怀疑克里斯托弗就是过去故意指引诗社的人。

records.text: And yet... why do you seem so restless, Lord Fenrico? This is hardly the character I expected from you.
records.zh: 不过，您为什么这么急躁呢？芬莱克大人，这可一点也不像是您的性格。

records.text: She who resembles Topaz should still be near Whisperwind Haven at this hour.
records.zh: 那个像“托帕石”的她，这个时间，一定还在拂风水畔附近。

records.text: I know right? We should suggest to Ms. Margherita that she add new signage: "Sing with civility, it starts with us!"
records.zh: 对吧，你也这样认为，也许该建议玛格烈特小姐在公告牌加上一句“文明高歌，从你我做起！”

records.text: When I was a child, whenever I passed by Ciaccona's house, I'd always hear music drifting from the courtyard. Lively, spirited and so full of emotion...
records.zh: 嗯，小时候我路过夏空家，总会听见庭院内传来乐声，灵动、跳跃，充满着情绪变化……

records.text: Back then Ciaccona's family conducted the Order's choir.
records.zh: 就是在那时，我认识了夏空，他们家一直担任着唱诗班的指挥。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V2.3_夏空线副本内_2_3
records.text: As you wander through the Realm of Melodies, you lose track of Ciaccona and find yourself in a study, where a young girl is singing.
records.zh: 你与夏空在旋律的世界走散，你走进了一个书房，看见了一个小女孩在房间高歌。

records.text: Do you feel it? The breeze from Whisperwind Haven. You can even catch the faint scent of wet grass.
records.zh: 感受到了吗？水畔吹过来的风，鼻子偶尔还能闻到潮湿的草地味道。

records.text: By the way, I met a man at Margherita's who claims to be a playwright. You should watch out for him!
records.zh: 对了，我在餐厅遇见了一位自称街巷剧作家的男人，你一定要小心他！

records.text: The Daemons reappear. After defeating them, Ciaccona draws closer, hoping to use her Forte to uncover the story hidden in the frequencies.
records.zh: 亡灵再次出现，你们击败亡灵后。夏空靠近它们，打算利用自己的共鸣能力复现频率中蕴藏的故事。

records.text: We need to split up. With your tenacity and Ciaccona's expertise, we will uncover the truth.
records.zh: 我们分头行动吧，我相信夏空的鉴赏力和漂泊者的行动力，你们一定能找出真相。

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_1_17
records.text: I'm Valentina, the remote commander of the emergency response team. This is a combat unit sent by the Black Shores to deal with the Waveworn phenomenon.
records.zh: 应急处置小组是黑海岸派往各国进行支援、应对海蚀现象的共鸣者武装小组。我是远程指挥负责人，瓦莲京娜。

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_1_18
records.text: Valentina is communicating with the dispatched members of the emergency response team.
records.zh: 瓦莲京娜正在和外派到其他地区的应急处置小组通讯。

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_18
records.text: Oh no, I promised my daughter I'd bring her souvenirs from the New Federation! I told her I'm working there.
records.zh: 糟了，我和女儿说我在新联邦工作，还答应了她要带特产回去。

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_18
records.text: Didn't you tell your family you were posted in Huanglong?
records.zh: 你不也和你的家里人说，你被外派到瑝珑工作了嘛。

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_20
records.text: That's the ancient wisdom of Huanglong for you…
records.zh: 瑝珑文化博大精深啊……

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_24
records.text: "Cosmos told me that saving the world is as difficult as beating the Big Bad Demon. It's never easy to be a warrior."
records.zh: “黑咩说，拯救世界就像是打败大魔王，勇士的道路不会是一帆风顺的。”

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_26
records.text: Speaking of which, bioenergy has been in use in some regions for a while. Take the New Federation, for instance—
records.zh: 不过植物能源的应用早有先例，以新联邦为例——

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_2
records.text: Confirm with the Eye of Asteria if the Reverberation samples from the New Federation have been compiled.
records.zh: 问询阿斯特莉亚之眼，新联邦悲鸣区的残响样本是否完成了编译？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_2_4
records.text: Qiuyuan fights alone, driving back Tidespawn in the streets and rescuing an Acolyte in the middle of evacuating civilians. Carlotta and the others soon arrive to help, guiding the civilians to seek sanctuary at the Cathedral of Mercury and Averardo Vault. Because Qiuyuan is not from Rinascita, the Dark Tide does not harm him. Instead, it allows him to sense you in pursuit of Galbrena, far away in Avinoleum...
records.zh: 仇远以一人之力击退了商店街前的黑潮造物，救下疏散民众的修会教士。此时珂莱塔等人也支援过来，将民众向水星天教堂以及更远的埃弗拉德金库撤离。由于仇远不是黎那汐塔人，那黑潮似乎对他没什么危害，反而能让他透过黑潮，感知到你正在阿维纽林追逐嘉贝莉娜……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_2_1
records.text: His name is Qiuyuan. He appeared in Ragunna City, originally in search of Fenrico, Primus of the Order of the Deep. But before long, the city was struck by the Dark Tide and its spawn. By then, you had already departed for Avinoleum to seek Cartethyia's aid concerning the Civilization Capsule...
records.zh: 名叫“仇远”的瑝珑人出现在拉古那城中，他原本似乎是来寻找隐海修会的主座芬莱克，突然间拉古那城突然出现遮天蔽日的黑潮和黑潮造物，而就在这不久之前，你为了黑匣子的事奔赴阿维纽林向卡提希娅寻求帮助……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_2_1
records.text: You wish to confess to our Primus? Alas, Lord Fenrico is currently away on a journey to spread the Sentinel's teachings.
records.zh: 您是想要跟他亲自告解吗？真不巧，最近芬莱克大人外出宣讲福音了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: There's no record of you in Mingting's archives.
records.zh: 明庭的卷宗里，没有关于你的记录。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: You serve under Lord Liang... Qiuyuan, if memory serves?
records.zh: 你是那个梁先生手底下的……仇远。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: You said you met with Mingting's officials. That means you had an audience not just with Grandmaster Liang, but with the Grand Marshal, too.
records.zh: 你若是亲自拜访过明庭要员，除了梁大人之外，那你应该也见过明庭军策府的本兵大人。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: She asked me to execute a Fractsidus Overseer named Scar in Rinascita, and help 漂泊者 in the process.
records.zh: 她委托我来黎那汐塔诛杀一个叫做伤痕的残星会会监，也托我来此地帮助漂泊者。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: That may be referring to Primus Fenrico and the "First Relic" he holds.
records.zh: 也许，是说主座芬莱克和掌握在他手中的拉古那“始源圣器”。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: I had the privilege of meeting many distinguished officials in Mingting. The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs once introduced me to your Internal Security Agency's workings.
records.zh: 我曾经亲自去明庭见到了许多明庭要员，专司岁主事务的谛天鉴特意向我介绍了你们镇抚司。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: Fenrico should still be in the experiment site he secretly built.
records.zh: 芬莱克如今应该在他秘密修建的试验场中。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: It lies beneath the waters to the southwest of Thessaleo Fells. I'm afraid you'll need to pinpoint the precise location yourself.
records.zh: 狄萨莱海脊西南海域，具体位置，恐怕只能你自己寻找了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: And why is that? Are you not a Mingting official?
records.zh: 为什么？你不是明庭官方的人吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: Mingting... is not the place you once visited.
records.zh: 明庭……应该已经不是你曾经以为的模样了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
records.text: Qiuyuan arrives in Avinoleum. By then, Cartethyia has already been killed by Galbrena, and you have left in pursuit. Only Cantarella remains. She recognizes Qiuyuan as a former high official of Mingting. He tells her someone in Mingting has sent him to aid you, and through his Mindsight ability, he perceives the Mark of the Dark Tide clinging to you...
records.zh: 仇远抵达阿维纽林。只是等他赶到时，卡提希娅已被嘉贝莉娜所杀，你也追赶嘉贝莉娜离开了阿维纽林，只有留守的坎特蕾拉。坎特蕾拉认出仇远曾在明庭身居要职，仇远表示是明庭有人要他来帮助你，他又依照自己的“心镜”觉察到你已经与黑潮有了联系……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_3
records.text: Looks like Fenrico is still controlling this place.
records.zh: 看来，芬莱克仍然控制着这里。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
records.text: A wanted criminal of Mingting, and yet the Ministry of War sent you all the way to Rinascita to hunt down Scar in secret.
records.zh: 倒是你，身为明庭重犯，却带着军策府的命令私下来黎那汐塔追杀「伤痕」。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
records.text: Who would've thought... Mingting places such importance on him.
records.zh: 没想到，明庭竟然把他看得这么重。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
records.text: If you know that, it means you still have eyes and ears in Mingting.
records.zh: 你知道这件事就说明，明庭里还有你的人。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
records.text: Speaking of which, Scar should be in Septimont now.
records.zh: 不过这个时候伤痕应该在七丘吧。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
records.text: Following Cantarella's clues, Qiuyuan finds Fenrico at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, only to be blocked by an illusion of an Acolyte, a Fractsidus member in disguise. Qiuyuan instantly recognizes "him" as the one who killed his Grandmaster. Yet he also knows this figure is only a projection, not the true "killer." The man declares he will not stop Qiuyuan and steps aside, saying only by letting him pass will Fenrico's destiny be fulfilled...
records.zh: 按照坎特蕾拉提供的线索，仇远找到了身处隐海试验场的芬莱克，只是此时由一位神秘的残星会成员幻化而成的教士挡在他面前。仇远认出“他”是杀害自己恩人的凶手，也知道“他”的真身不在此处。“他”表示无意阻拦仇远，让出了前往芬莱克身边的道路，因为那正是完成芬莱克自己命运的方式……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
records.text: What a shame you couldn't end "him" in Mingting… and now, you still can't.
records.zh: 可惜，过去在明庭你没能杀了“他”，现如今也不可能。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_7_1
records.text: The First Relic draws on Qiuyuan's Mindsight to manifest the Cathedral of Mercury. There, the lingering consciousness of Fenrico confesses his ideals and intentions. To allow Qiuyuan to take the Relic and deliver it to you, Fenrico must finally accept his own death and find release. Perhaps it was fate that brought them to this moment, for Qiuyuan too is burdened by a regret over a past choice involving the Threnodian...
records.zh: 始源圣器藉由仇远的“心镜”构筑出了水星天教堂，而其中残存的芬莱克的意识向仇远和盘托出了自己的理念和意志。为了让仇远取走始源圣器交给你，芬莱克必须完成最后的“解脱”。也许是冥冥之中的命运使然，仇远心中也残存着有关鸣式的执念……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_8_2
records.text: Qiuyuan once faced a difficult choice. Ordered by the Mingting Censorate to kill Geshu Lin, Qiuyuan hesitated, seeing that the man had not yet fallen to darkness. He saw the raging fire churning in the man's heart, but just as his own teacher once cautioned him, he urged Geshu Lin to wield his power with restraint. In defying the Censorate's command, he spared Geshu Lin's life.
records.zh: 心中怀有疑虑的仇远没有按照命令诛杀当时还未堕入阴翳之中的哥舒临，但他仍然察觉到了哥舒临内心中翻腾的火焰。如同过去自己的师父叮嘱自己一般，仇远告诫哥舒临谨慎使用自己的力量。他最终违逆了明庭兰台御史的命令，放过了哥舒临，就此离去。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_7_2
records.text: History shall remember me... as Fenrico the First.
records.zh: 后人也将称我为……芬莱克……一世。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_7_2
records.text: So ends the path of Fenrico the First, of the Order of the Deep.
records.zh: 这就是，隐海修会芬莱克一世的末路。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
records.text: Perhaps it's the lantern. It holds the last flickers of Fenrico's will. It could have revealed a glimpse of what happened in the Fabricatorium.
records.zh: 也许，那盏提灯里保存着芬莱克的意识吧，所以你才能通过芬莱克的意识看到当时试验场发生了什么。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
records.text: There's more to him than they want us to see. And more buried between Jinzhou and Mingting than they'll ever admit.
records.zh: 在他身上，还有今州和瑝珑明庭之间，肯定还有不为人知的谜团。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
records.text: The order to hunt down Scar in Rinascita came straight from Mingting. Even Jinhsi was left in the dark.
records.zh: 甚至他来黎那汐塔追杀伤痕的命令都直接来自明庭，连今汐都不知道……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
records.text: Whatever he's carrying... could shake Mingting to its core.
records.zh: 他身上……恐怕藏着牵动明庭的秘密。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
records.text: Through Ciaccona's Forte, you glimpse Qiuyuan's journey across Rinascita. But since the battle in Septimont, you haven't seen him again, nor do you know where to find him to offer your thanks.
records.zh: 通过夏空的能力，你看到了有关于仇远在黎那汐塔各地的经历。只是在七丘大战之后，你再也没有见过仇远，不知该在何处找到他向他道谢……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
records.text: Not to mention, he made quick work of Scar, the Fractsidus Overseer.
records.zh: 也轻而易举地击退了名为伤痕的残星会会监。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_2
records.text: Ms. Zani and I have been assessing the damage to Averardo Vault and the Cathedral of Mercury.
records.zh: 赞妮小姐和我正在清查埃弗拉德金库和水星天教堂的损失情况。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_2
records.text: Have you seen Qiuyuan? The one from Huanglong.
records.zh: 有看到那位叫做仇远的瑝珑人吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_2
records.text: Hard to miss someone from Huanglong in the crowd.
records.zh: 因为是瑝珑人，所以显得很特别。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_3
records.text: About that Huanglong warrior who aided in Septimont's frontline defense...
records.zh: 那位独守了七丘防线的瑝珑人……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_4
records.text: Scar and the other Fractsidus operatives got away...
records.zh: 伤痕和残星会他们还是逃跑了……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_4
records.text: You should save your gratitude for her when you visit Mingting someday. She takes great interest in you.
records.zh: 要谢的话，等你将来去了明庭，亲自向本兵大人道谢吧。她似乎对你很有兴趣。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_4
records.text: Mingting... I've only been to Jinzhou so far.
records.zh: 明庭……我还只见过今州风貌。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_4
records.text: You know Jiyan. You fought in Norfall Barrens. You must also know what really happened in Jinzhou three years ago.
records.zh: 你认识忌炎，打过北落野那场仗，也知道今州三年前到底发生了什么。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_4
records.text: In the end, you find Qiuyuan just before he boards a merchant ship bound for Mengzhou. He tells you he came to Rinascita to aid you at someone's request, and Scar was merely a side matter. The two of you are but strangers whose paths happened to cross. But the world is wide, the road is long. Perhaps one day, in Huanglong, your paths will cross again.
records.zh: 最终，你在即将驶向瑝珑梦州的商船前找到了仇远。仇远向你说明，他受人之请来黎那汐塔帮助你，至于伤痕不过是顺带的事。如今你们如同萍水相逢的过客，而江湖路远，也许将来你在瑝珑的旅程，还会再次遇到他。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦枢天罗_火匣POI生态_3_1
records.text: That's Lady Hsin's touch, isn't it? She's made this place grander than before.
records.zh: 那当然是因为心月狐大人妙手生花，把这儿变得格外雄伟了。

records.text: You recount to Aalto the events that led to your arrival here.
records.zh: 和秋水详细讲述了刚才的事……

records.text: Ahem... Anyway, let's not get carried away. We should head to the Greenhouse. The abnormal frequency you collected needs to be uploaded to the Tethys System as soon as possible in order to avoid another Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 不过现在，我们一起去花房吧。你拿到的东西需要尽快回收到泰缇斯系统，从而解决归墟港市的问题。

records.text: You hand the antique Youhu gave you over to Aalto.
records.zh: 将釉瑚转交给自己的古物给了秋水查看……

records.text: Huh, didn't expect to see it outside Mt. Firmament…
records.zh: 这东西居然从乘霄山流出来了……

records.text: Looks like it was also used to record abnormal frequencies in the Port City of Guixu…
records.zh: 没想到它恰巧还在归墟港市承担了转录异常频率的功能……

records.text: You tell Aalto about the person you met on the beach…
records.zh: 和秋水讲述了刚才在海滩上遇到的人……

records.text: A person in light blue… Could it be the Shorekeeper?
records.zh: 淡蓝色的身影……守岸人吗？

records.text: Someone must have teleported us away from the Port City of Guixu when things went south.
records.zh: 看来我们刚才在归墟港市遭到突发情况的时候，有什么人把我们从那个地方分别传送走了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_5_17
records.text: Even Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, has never heard of the name Hoda. Right after your discussion, another quake shakes the Black Shores, echoing the disaster in the Port City of Guixu. To safeguard the Tethys System, Monica instructs you to inspect the Modulation Device in the Greenhouse.
records.zh: 就算是人事主管的莫妮卡，也没有听说过这位“霍德”。然而恰巧就在此时，黑海岸再一次发生了与归墟港市相仿的地震，为了确保泰缇斯系统安然无虞，莫妮卡请求你去花房确认调律装置的安全。

records.text: You tell Monica what happened in the Port City of Guixu…
records.zh: 和莫妮卡讲述了归墟港市的事……

records.text: Yes, we received word from Jinzhou's City Hall about their actions. We also alerted them to the Tethys System's likely warning of a potential Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 嗯，今州官方已经向我们发来照会了，而我们也同时通知了他们，泰缇斯系统可能会继续针对归墟港市发布悲鸣预警。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_5_12
records.text: You meet Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, and discover that the Tethys System has been experiencing instability. You then brief her on the recent events in the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 见到了库默尼所说的黑海岸人事主管莫妮卡，得知泰缇斯系统目前仍然处于不稳定运行状态，并向她讲述了归墟港市的事。

records.text: The Midnight Rangers are preparing to secure the Port City of Guixu, and…
records.zh: 夜归军也正筹备向归墟港市集中并戒严那里，而且……

records.text: You hand over the card Youhu gave you to the peculiar robot.
records.zh: 将釉瑚给自己的卡片交给了面前奇特的机器人……

records.text: This a new rookie? You've got skills if you snagged that abnormal frequency from Port City of Guixu. Better not underestimate you.
records.zh: 哦吼，是新人吗？居然能拿回归墟港市的异常频率，看来不容小觑嘛。

records.text: KU-Money is right. Just in case, the Tethys System is very likely to send out a warning to Jinzhou about an imminent Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 库默尼提醒了我，保险起见，泰缇斯系统可能会向今州发布归墟港市的悲鸣预警。

records.text: What's going on, Aalto? I never see you this serious.
records.zh: 不过，怎么你今天突然这么严肃了？有点不太像你……

records.text: What's worse, along with the data, we received some terrible news. The Bloom Bearers we sent to the Port City of Guixu… We lost them all.
records.zh: 漂泊者从归墟港市带来的不只是这份数据，还有其他消息……我们派去归墟港市的人，牺牲了。

records.text: But it seems Aalto took the liberty of naming it the "Money Tree."
records.zh: 不过似乎被秋水“擅自”命名为“发财树”。

records.text: Hmm... Aalto didn't plant a flower but a tree. A money tree, I remember…
records.zh: 唔……他种的好像是一棵树来着……发财树……

records.text: But more importantly, she died in the Lament that destroyed the Port City of Guixu a few hundred years ago.
records.zh: 而且最重要的是，她在几百年前那场毁灭了归墟港市的悲鸣中，已经牺牲了。

records.text: You tell the Shorekeeper what happened in the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 和守岸人讲述了归墟港市的事……

records.text: The departed, whom you saw in the Port City of Guixu, caused those abnormal frequencies. Only you can mend those errors.
records.zh: 那些逝者，就是你在归墟港市见到那些异常频率的成因，也只有你能修复那些错误。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_6_15
records.text: The Shorekeeper explains that during your absence, she and the Tethys System had taken over the running of the Black Shores. She confirms that it was indeed she who saved you, Yangyang, and Youhu in the Port City of Guixu. To address the threats posed by Hoda and the looming crisis in both the Black Shores and the Port City of Guixu, the Shorekeeper requests that you venture underground, to where the starry sky awaits...
records.zh: 守岸人告诉你，在过去的一段时间里，她和泰缇斯系统替代你承担着黑海岸管理者的职能，也说明的确是她在归墟港市救下了你、秧秧和釉瑚。而为了解决“霍德”和萦绕在黑海岸与归墟港市两地的阴霾，她请求你深入地底，前往黑海岸地下的星空……

records.text: Valentina is in communication with the emergency response members deployed to other regions.
records.zh: 瓦莲京娜正在和外派到其他地区的应急处置小组通讯。

records.text: So I'm betting they're from the Port City of Guixu!
records.zh: 没错！据我推测，很可能是归墟港市的古董！

records.text: I still have this Blake Bloom that Aalto gave me.
records.zh: 我还有之前秋水给我的黑花。

records.text: This is Youhu from Jinzhou. Like Mr. Chenpi, she's an expert in antiques.
records.zh: 对了，这位是今州城里的釉瑚，和陈皮先生一样，也是古玩方面的专家。

records.text: The battle in Norfall Barrens is over, and the Black Shores should be withdrawing... but they've asked the Midnight Rangers to monitor the area around the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 北落野的战斗告一段落后，今州的黑海岸成员就陆续撤回了。不过前几天，他们向夜归申报，要在归墟港市开展环境监测。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_1
records.text: Yangyang has sent word that a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores is currently in the Port City of Guixu and may have important information about your identity. Upon your arrival in the city, you happen to run into Chenpi's apprentice, Youhu…
records.zh: 你收到秧秧的消息，据她说归墟港市现今正能找到来自于黑海岸的执花，以此进一步找到关于你的身世谜团。恰巧，在你抵达归墟港市后，遇到了陈皮的“徒弟”——釉瑚……

records.text: You've met KU-Money, then. He is the robot administering the Black Shores Archipelago.
records.zh: 你已经见过库默尼了啊。他是黑海岸地上群岛的机器人管理者。

records.text: I hear there is a Jinzhou scholar by the name of Verina who is well versed in botany.
records.zh: 据说今州有个叫维里奈的学者，在植物学上颇有造诣。

records.text: The abnormal frequency you encountered in the Port City of Guixu is part of it—or rather, it is the Necrostar itself.
records.zh: 你在归墟港市遇到的那个异常频率，就是它的一部分，或者说……就是它自己。

records.text: I admit... I am surprised to see the Shorekeeper here.
records.zh: ……我没想到守岸人会出现。

records.text: The Port City of Guixu was decimated by the Lament. If this frequency goes unchecked, it could trigger another catastrophe...
records.zh: 归墟港市正因悲鸣而毁灭，如果放任它在这里的话，很可能会引起新一轮悲鸣……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_8
records.text: In the Port City of Guixu, you meet Niya, a Bloom Bearer who quickly recognizes you. She warns of an abnormal frequency detected in Guixu that must be urgently brought back to the Black Shores. If left unresolved, it might trigger another Lament…
records.zh: 在归墟港市遇到了一位自称妮娅的执花，她立刻认出了你并表示目前的归墟港市存在着一段异常频率需要带回黑海岸，如果放任下去，也许会造成新一轮悲鸣……

records.text: Oh!? So… y-you're the one Aalto invited earlier?
records.zh: 嗯！？你……你是那个秋水邀请过的人吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸地下主线玩法_3_2
records.text: But for the Shorekeeper, and everyone here...
records.zh: 还有大家，还有守岸人……

records.text: Gravity caused the destruction of Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 归墟港市因为引力而毁灭。

records.text: Does the Necrostar have any connection to the Port City of Guixu?
records.zh: 这黑洞和归墟港市有什么关系吗？

records.text: This Necrostar is the black hole that destroyed the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 在那场悲鸣中，有许多人来不及撤离而被悲鸣的重力操控，落入了那颗黑洞。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_9_15
records.text: The Shorekeeper can sense the underlying emotions feeding into deceit, pity, and other behavior, but struggles to fully understand them. She reveals that the data you recovered is related to the Lament from the Port City of Guixu, and the Tethys System is using the Lament itself to fight against it...
records.zh: 守岸人能够感知到欺骗、悲悯种种行为背后的情感，却又难以全部理解。她告诉你归墟港市悲鸣数据其实就是你刚刚带回来的那份，泰缇斯系统正在利用悲鸣本身来对抗悲鸣……

records.text: I—No, the Shorekeeper has been waiting for you endlessly!
records.zh: 我……不对！守岸人等了你很久了！

records.text: Perhaps checking on the Shorekeeper is the more pressing matter.
records.zh: 也许应该直接去查看守岸人的状况。

records.text: Loading backup data from the Necrostar. Simulating the Port City of Guixu...
records.zh: 加载当前噬亡星备份数据，归墟港市……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_3_黑海岸地下_归墟港市副本_1_1
records.text: The Port City of Guixu... It once embodied the metropolitan dream.
records.zh: 归墟港市……也曾如此辉煌。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸地下_归墟港市副本_2_4
records.text: Ahead lies the onset of the Port City of Guixu's destruction. According to the Shorekeeper, despite deploying every available Black Shores member to prevent the disaster, many innocent lives were lost to the Necrostar, including Hoda, the field medic.
records.zh: 再往前，你们要面临的就是归墟港市毁灭的开端。据守岸人所说，那时候黑海岸和你派出了所有能动用的执花和客卿，然而还是有许多无辜的人消逝在了黑洞之中，身为战地医生的霍德也不例外。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_3_黑海岸地下_归墟港市副本_2_4
records.text: You dispatched all available personnel to assist Huanglong in evacuation.
records.zh: 尽管你已经把当时黑海岸所有能动用的客卿和执花都派了出去，最大限度协助瑝珑疏散归墟港市。

records.text: Even the Shorekeeper herself is used as a pawn.
records.zh: 就连守岸人也只是执行泰缇斯系统指令的工具。

records.text: Wait, where's the Shorekeeper? Wasn't she with you?
records.zh: 诶？守岸人呢？她不是跟你一起去的吗？

records.text: No matter what, we have to save the Shorekeeper.
records.zh: 无论如何，都要救回守岸人。

records.text: Watch over the Black Shores, watch over the Shorekeeper...
records.zh: 保佑黑海岸，保佑守岸人……

records.text: Now, imagine that drop of ink is the Shorekeeper.
records.zh: 想象一下，这滴墨水，就是守岸人。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_3_黑海岸地下_错乱空间副本_5_1
records.text: The Shorekeeper is now the core computational unit.
records.zh: 守岸人已经被更新为泰缇斯系统的编码核心。

records.text: Formatted. The Shorekeeper will be the new computational unit.
records.zh: 格式化后的守岸人将作为本机新的核心。

records.text: Port City of Guixu must hold secrets waiting to be discovered.
records.zh: 归墟港市一定还有我们尚未知晓的秘密……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_13
records.text: Youhu reveals that the clue Hoda mentioned is an artifact from Mt. Firmament, discovered by her and Master Chenpi. Now, it seems connected with the Black Shores. The frequency tied to Hoda is hidden within this artifact, and it seems linked to the deaths of the Bloom Bearers. Reporting this matter to Niya and the Black Shores is now a matter of urgency.
records.zh: 釉瑚告诉你，“霍德”指向于她的线索其实就是她和师傅陈皮发现的乘霄山遗物，现在看来也许正和黑海岸有关。那段代表“霍德”的频率最终寄宿在了釉瑚交给你的乘霄山遗物上，而现如今已经涉及到了执花们的阵亡，必须尽快将情况告知妮娅和黑海岸。

records.text: Solving this issue is beyond our capabilities. Besides, they also mentioned Rover and the fall of the Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 这绝不是我们能轻易解决的事，刚才的声音还提到了漂泊者和归墟港市的毁灭。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_2
records.text: Upon arriving at the coordinates provided by Niya, you find the bodies of several Black Shores members who have died under mysterious circumstances. There, you encounter a mysterious Bloom Bearer named Hoda, who claims to know about your past but cannot divulge the details. Before disappearing, Hoda directs you to Youhu for further clues...
records.zh: 当你们抵达异常频率的精确坐标后，却发现了许多死于不明原因的黑海岸成员的遗体，以及一个自称为“霍德”的神秘执花，她似乎知道与你过去有关的事，却又无法和盘托出。而在“霍德”消失前，将线索指向了顺路前来的釉瑚……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_4_2
records.text: You ask Sanhua about Jinzhou, Jinhsi, and the tokens.
records.zh: 你从散华处有了解到了一些有关今州、今汐还有与信物相关的事情。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_1_12
records.text: You tell Chixia and Yangyang about your conversation with Sanhua.
records.zh: 简单地向炽霞、秧秧说明了会面的谈话内容。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_1_12
records.text: Oh right, Baizhi's still waiting for us at the Academy!
records.zh: 也是，白芷还在研究院等着呢！

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_5
records.text: Oh right, Baizhi's still waiting for us at the Academy!
records.zh: 对哦！白芷还在研究院等着呢！

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_5_1
records.text: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...
records.zh: 白芷，这话有点令人误解了……

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_5_1
records.text: The anomalies at the Gorges of Spirits, the resurgence of that Tacet Field, and the many Waveworn Phenomena occurrences... I should report them in time.
records.zh: 云陵谷异变，无音区复苏，海蚀现象频发，这些异常情况信息，也需要有人及时同步上报。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_3_5
records.text: For some reason, you can tell Sanhua doesn't want to continue this topic.
records.zh: 不知道为何，你能感受到散华并不想继续这个话题。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_3_6
records.text: Sanhua upgrades your Terminal. You now have permission to travel to any region of Jinzhou without hindrance.
records.zh: 散华接着为你升级了终端，并给予了可以确保你畅行无阻的权限。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_3
records.text: I got to see... Lady Sanhua! She even looked back at me!
records.zh: 我可是见到了——散华大人呢！散华大人看了我一眼！

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_3
records.text: And I even got Lady Sanhua's verbal assurance... That I wasn't the guest the Magistrate was waiting for!
records.zh: 而且散华大人可是亲口——确认了我不是那位客人！

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_3
records.text: I was able to witness Lady Sanhua in the flesh and be rejected by her in person!
records.zh: 我可是亲眼见到了散华大人并被她亲口拒绝了的啊！

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_1_7
records.text: The few that made it inside said it only took "one freezing look from Lady Sanhua", and they were compelled to leave.
records.zh: 但前去的人似乎都说是“被散华大人看了一眼，就像被定住了”。然后就被一句话劝返了。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_3_2
records.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. I apologize for the delay. My name is Sanhua, the bodyguard of Madam Magistrate.
records.zh: 抱歉让您久候，初次见面，我是令尹近卫，散华。

records.text: Is there any chance that Baizhi down there is bait?
records.zh: 有没有可能底下的白芷是个诱饵。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_序章_1_12
records.text: Upon leaving the Gorges of Spirits, you encounter a newly-formed Tacet Field. In its center stands a woman named Baizhi, who appears to be engaged in an investigation. You decide to glide down there to meet her.
records.zh: 你们走出了云陵谷，却遭遇了突然生成的无音区。而在无音区中央，名叫白芷的女孩正在探查着什么，此地不宜久留，你们决定乘坐滑翔伞尽快与白芷汇合。

records.text: Jinzhou sits between the Desorock Highland and the Norfall Barrens. It's a border city and a fortress. It's very crucial to the safety of Huanglong.
records.zh: 今州面靠荒石高地与北落野，是座关城，也是要塞，被称为瑝珑的咽喉之地。

records.text: Now you're talking a little like Baizhi, Rover.
records.zh: 漂泊者这一点倒是和白芷有些相似。

records.text: Baizhi didn't tell us you'd have these aftereffects when you wake up.
records.zh: 白芷可没说醒了之后会有这种后遗症啊。

records.text: You can call me Chixia... And, she's Yangyang!
records.zh: 我的名字是炽霞……嗯，她是秧秧！

records.text: We are in the Gorges of Spirits. It's on the outskirts of Jinzhou, Huanglong.
records.zh: 这里是云陵谷，瑝珑属下今州城的边地野外。

records.text: Rover, is that you? You're still up at this hour?
records.zh: 漂泊者，是你啊？这么晚了居然还没睡吗。

records.text: Not sure, but if you're free, you could check out the Tiger's Maw.
records.zh: 我也不好说，或许你有空的话可以亲自去虎口山脉那边看看。

records.text: Hey, you're the Rover, right? Got important business here?
records.zh: 嗯？你是那个漂泊者吧，来研究院有要事吗？

records.text: Man, every time I read Mr. Mortefi's research, I learn something new...
records.zh: 莫特斐前辈的研究报告真是每次看都会有新的发现……

records.text: Did you see Mr. Mortefi shut down that guy making all those crazy demands?
records.zh: 那你肯定看到莫特斐前辈把那个提出无理要求的家伙驳得一句话都回不了吧。

records.text: Only Mr. Mortefi has the guts to challenge them openly, it's pretty cool!
records.zh: 不过也就只有莫特斐前辈敢这么公开和他们叫板了，真是太帅了！

records.text: Some folks might not get Mr. Mortefi, seeing him as only short-tempered, but there are plenty who secretly admire him.
records.zh: 虽然其他人可能并不理解莫特斐前辈，会觉得他脾气很差，但其实也有很多人背地里佩服他的。

records.text: Hey, did you hear? Because of the Crownless, the Gorges of Spirits is becoming a center of attention.
records.zh: 你知道吗？因为无冠者的缘故，云陵谷那地方开始火起来了。

records.text: Talking about the Disruptor Cannon in the Norfall Barrens?
records.zh: 你们是说北落野的裂解炮吗？

records.text: So, Rover, did you really cross paths with that Fractsidus Overseer in Qichi Village?
records.zh: 漂泊者，你在祈池村里遇到过那个残星会的会监，是真的吗？

records.text: The war in the Norfall Barrens has finally ended.
records.zh: 北落野那边的战事终于告一段落了。

records.text: The Retroact Rain was already scary enough as an illusion... but then actual "ghosts" appeared!
records.zh: 原本只是幻觉的溯洄雨就已经够吓人了……居然还有实体的“幽灵”产生。

records.text: I heard Fractsidus members were part of this Threnodian revival too. Rover, any insights?
records.zh: 我还听说这次鸣式复苏也有残星会的人参与，漂泊者知道些什么吗？

records.text: In the end, Miss Baizhi, as the discoverer, has the final say.
records.zh: 虽然也确实是这样，最后还是得由发现者白芷小姐来决定。

records.text: By the way, did you know? Miss Baizhi actually came up with the term "Crownless." What a pity.
records.zh: 对了，漂泊者听说过吗？其实“无冠者”这名字是白芷小姐取的，可惜了。

records.text: Don't you think the name is a bit... uninspired? Miss Baizhi is a genius at everything, except naming Tacet Discords.
records.zh: 你不觉得这名字也太简单了吗，唉~白芷小姐做什么都很天才，就是给残象取名字太随便了。

records.text: My favorite is "Savage God of Torn Wings." What do you think, Rover?
records.zh: 例如我最喜欢这个“残酷断翼之战神”，漂泊者你觉得呢？

records.text: Hang on, you're not planning to snitch to Mr. Mortefi, right...?
records.zh: 等等，漂泊者你不会去找莫特斐前辈告状吧……

records.text: Just so you know, that's the 17th most brutal line from Mr. Mortefi, as per our rankings on the Huaxu Hive.
records.zh: 顺带一提，这是今涯论坛上，莫特斐前辈骂人语录攻击性排名第17的例句。

records.text: Should I join Mr. Mortefi's project? ...Koko, would you support my decision?
records.zh: 如果加入莫特斐的项目，会怎么样呢……蔻蔻，你会支持哥哥吗？

records.text: He's probably the most respected researcher here, just behind our Principal Investigator, Mr. Xiangli Yao.
records.zh: 除了相里要首席之外，莫特斐前辈可以说是现在研究院里名望最高的人之一。

records.text: Mortefi's been trying to outdo him in research, but it's not easy. Xiangli is just... built different.
records.zh: 莫特斐一直想追赶上首席，但这很难。首席，是特别的。

records.text: Ah, you must be the Rover. What can I do for you?
records.zh: 啊，漂泊者，你有事找我吗？

records.text: Yesterday, Mr. Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
records.zh: 昨天，莫特斐邀请我加入他的一个项目。

records.text: I don't want to pass up this chance. It's more than just a project. Being able to working alongside Mr. Mortefi is an honor itself.
records.zh: 不仅是项目，能与莫特斐前辈合作，这本身也是一种荣幸。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
records.text: Access Pass is required if you're heading to the Norfall Barrens. That place is now off-limits.
records.zh: 再往外走就出城了。除非有通行权限，现在北落野方向，不允许通行了。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
records.text: Besides, General Jiyan is currently there at the Norfall Barrens base. Dangerous as it is, he will keep an eye on every soldier, including the one you're looking for.
records.zh: 况且，忌炎将军就带着兵在北落野，战场危险是危险，有忌炎将军在，他会看好每一个兵的。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
records.text: Greetings. I'm Jianxin. Could you please do me a favor?
records.zh: 两位少侠，小道鉴心，有一事相求。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
records.text: At the city gate, you encounter Jianxin, a Taoist who is being denied passage. After learning she is searching for a missing person, you use your authority to help her leave the city.
records.zh: 你们在城门口遇见了想要出城寻人但因没有权限被阻拦的小道士鉴心，你决定使用权限带她一起出城。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_23
records.text: Jianxin explains why she wants to leave the city. She tells you about the person she is looking for.
records.zh: 鉴心向我们讲述了出城的缘由和所寻之人情况。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_23
records.text: So you're looking for the relative of a veteran, and you believe he's in the Midnight Rangers camp in Desorock Highland?
records.zh: 也就是说，小道长想前往荒石高地的夜归营地，寻找退役军士的亲人？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_23
records.text: ...According to what I've gathered, Mr. Zongye's grandson is very likely in the Desorock Highland.
records.zh: ……通过搜集的信息，得出宗业爷爷的孙儿极有可能在荒石高地。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_23
records.text: Jianxin explains she is searching for a boy named Zhiyuan. He vanished after leaving the city, and his grandfather tasked her to find him. Sadly, she has no information about the tokens you are investigating.
records.zh: 鉴心向你们讲述了出城的缘由和所寻之人情况，原来是一位退役军士名叫致远的孙儿出城后没了消息，她受老人之托前去寻找。你也向她询问了有关线索的情况，很可惜她并不知晓。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_6
records.text: If you really can't find any job in the city, come to Liuxian Teahouse and ask for Jianxin. I'll gladly help you search for jobs and work alongside you.
records.zh: 若是入城后确实找不着活计，可以到六羡茶馆寻小道，小道名鉴心，可以同诸位一起找活，做活。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_7_2
records.text: And you said it was flowing in a certain direction. The nearest places are the Gorges of Spirits and the Norfall Barrens...
records.zh: 最近的方向是云陵谷和北落野……

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_7_2
records.text: The Etheric Sea and Resonance Cords in your dreams are real, possibly leading to the Gorges of Spirits and Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 天空海和声弦是存在的，而在漂泊者的描述里，声弦落下的地界，确确实实是云陵谷和北落野。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_7_2
records.text: That girl might be the key to recovering your memories. Madam Magistrate's information aside, it seems to me your dream points toward the Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 或许找到那个少女，是找回漂泊者记忆的关键，除去今令尹提供的信息，梦境的指向之一，是北落野。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_2
records.text: Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge and Jianxin asked him about Zhiyuan.
records.zh: 秧秧向其出示了夜归凭证，鉴心向其打听了所寻之人。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
records.text: According to Baizhi, the leaf showed residual fluctuations of Tacet Discords.
records.zh: 之前白芷说过，树叶有残象频率波动。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
records.text: And that is... Qichi Village, in the Central Plains.
records.zh: ……那是，中曲台地，祈池村。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
records.text: Inspired by Yangyang's words, you close your eyes and tap into your intuition, pinpointing the last token's location: Qichi Village in the Central Plains.
records.zh: 你从秧秧的话中得到启发，闭眼感受，果然察觉到了最后一件信物所指何处——中曲台地，祈池村。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
records.text: Jianxin asked the quartermaster about Zhiyuan's whereabouts.
records.zh: 鉴心向军需官询问了情况。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
records.text: Excuse me. I'm an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. This is Rover, and this is Master Jianxin who came here to look for someone.
records.zh: 叨扰了，我是夜归军属下踏白成员，这是漂泊者和来寻人的鉴心小道长。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
records.text: The quartermaster reveals Zhiyuan's likely whereabouts. Jianxin leaves to continue her search for Zhiyuan. You show the quartermaster the mangosteen, which he mistakes for a grenade. After the misunderstanding is resolved, he tells you about the dire situation in the Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 你们从军需官这里了解到了致远的所在，鉴心去寻致远时，你们也趁机向军需官询问有关莽吉柿的线索，军需官错将莽吉柿看成了榴弹，向你们讲述了北落野前线战事的紧张。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
records.text: (Tell him about the person Jianxin's looking for.)
records.zh: （说明找人的事。）

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
records.text: Master Jianxin, do you want to go look for Zhiyuan first?
records.zh: 鉴心小道长要不要先去寻人？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
records.text: Jinzhou is the gateway to Huanglong, and the Desorock Highland is the gateway to Jinzhou. A single breach could have dire consequences. Our defense must hold at all costs.
records.zh: 今州是瑝珑的关口，荒石高地则是今州的第二道关口。若是这里的关口有失守的风险，可就远远不止是今州的事了。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
records.text: The Streams from the Norfall Barrens feel more suffocating than ever.
records.zh: 从北落野传来的流息，比以往所有时候，都更加压抑，令人窒息。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
records.text: It felt as if I was seeing through the eyes of a Tacet Discord. I think... I saw what was happening in the Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 我的视野似乎变成了残象的视角，看见了北落野的情景……

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_25
records.text: Master Jianxin, have you found the person you're looking for?
records.zh: 鉴心小道长可寻到所要寻之人？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_25
records.text: Reuniting with Jianxin, you learn she has successfully found Zhiyuan and convinced him to return to Jinzhou. This journey has been enlightening for her, and she looks forward to seeing you and Yangyang again.
records.zh: 你们与鉴心汇合，她已经找到致远并劝他回了今州城，这次出行令她有了诸多体悟，她也期待与你和秧秧能有缘再会。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_19
records.text: Us running into Master Jianxin was a one-off incident. If the mangosteen indicates something about war, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
records.zh: 遇到鉴心小道长应当是意外，如果莽吉柿指向的是战争，今令尹想要说的究竟是什么呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_11
records.text: Crank that thing another five degrees, and not even Xiangli Yao will be able to save it.
records.zh: 你掰动的角度再多个5度，就算是相里要那家伙旋转跳跃立刻出现也很难救回这个机关盒。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_11
records.text: Yes. The large data repositories located in Huanglong's major cities.
records.zh: 「类书」，可以理解为数据库，「瑝览类书」一般指的是瑝珑特有的大型数据库中枢。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_8_10
records.text: Baizhi, what happened just now? The connection was suddenly cut off...
records.zh: 白芷，刚刚那是……什么情况？我们和漂泊者的联系突然就断开了。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_6
records.text: Oh, you are... a Rover? The sample report is from Baizhi herself!
records.zh: 咦，你是……漂泊者？白芷带回来的样本报告来源本人！

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_22
records.text: The Battle of Gorge of Spirits was the catalyst to found Jinzhou. Tacet Discords were born in the Norfall Barrens and their invasion route was originally traceable. However, the emergence of the Crownless changed that route.
records.zh: 而云陵谷一役正是建州的契机，残象潮的进犯与路线本是有迹可循的，从北落野生成，而无冠者的出现，改变了残象潮原本的行进路径。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: Here you are. The data we collected in the Gorges of Spirits has been submitted for analysis, and we'll have the results today. I have the equipment for your physical examinations ready, too.
records.zh: 你们来了。有关云陵谷的采样数据信息已经递交分析了，今天内会有结论。体检的仪器也准备妥当了。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: Tacetite... That's the field Mortefi specializes in, isn't it?
records.zh: 安全科，我似乎刚听到莫特斐就是……

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: Yes, Mortefi is the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry's head within the Department of Safety.
records.zh: 莫特斐确实是安全科黑石武器开发专项的负责人。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: Mortefi takes the sundial and gently weighs it in his hand.
records.zh: 莫特斐接过日晷，轻轻地掂了一下。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: Mr. Mortefi, I heard you weren't raised in Huanglong?
records.zh: 莫特斐先生不是瑝珑人吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: No. I'm from the New Federation. You mean this sugar pearl might be unique to Huanglong?
records.zh: 的确，我是新联邦人。你是想说，只有瑝珑才有这种糖丸？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_20
records.text: You show Baizhi the tokens and tell her about what happened.
records.zh: 取出信物，并将面见令尹的情况作了一番说明。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_3
records.text: Over there must be Mr. Mortefi from the Department of Safety. Baizhi once mentioned him before...
records.zh: 那边那位，就是安全科的莫特斐先生吧，听白芷提起过他……

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
records.text: Oh dear! Thank the heavens you saved it in time, Jianxin!
records.zh: 哎呦幸好幸好，谢谢你啦鉴心。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
records.text: *Chuckle* Oh, it's you Jianxin, you silly girl.
records.zh: 呵呵……鉴心，小丫头，是你啊。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
records.text: Jianxin, disciple in training. We've met before.
records.zh: 小道鉴心，见过诸位。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
records.text: *Chuckle* Where are my manners. I am Yuanwu. It's a pleasure to meet you.
records.zh: 光顾着说话了，倒忘了自我介绍了，在下渊武。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_25
records.text: The Gorges of Spirits Battle sparked Jinzhou's founding.
records.zh: 建州的契机是云陵谷一役……

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_23
records.text: Mr. Mortefi, is it the person you were talking to earlier? ...Mr. Xiangli Yao, I think?
records.zh: 是刚才和您通讯的那位吗？……相里要？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
records.text: Should I join Mortefi's project or not? ...Koko, will you support my decision?
records.zh: 如果加入莫特斐的项目，会怎么样呢……蔻蔻，你会支持哥哥吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
records.text: I'd say Mr. Mortefi is the most respected researcher at the Academy now, second only to our Principal Investigator, Mr. Xiangli Yao.
records.zh: 除了相里要首席之外，莫特斐前辈可以说是现在研究院里名望最高的人之一。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
records.text: Mr. Mortefi even treats us to afternoon teas. He really looks out for us.
records.zh: 那天下午他还请我们喝了下午茶。说他是部分科室的再生父母也不为过。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
records.text: What do you mean by "second only to Xiangli Yao"?
records.zh: 为什么要“除了相里要之外”？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
records.text: Yesterday, Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
records.zh: 昨天，莫特斐邀请我加入他的一个项目。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_9
records.text: Rover... Mr. Mortefi's expression seems to have softened, don't you think?
records.zh: 漂泊者，你有没有感觉，莫特斐先生现在的表情变得柔和了……？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_9
records.text: It looks like Mr. Mortefi needs some more time. Maybe we should give him some space to concentrate?
records.zh: 看来莫特斐先生还需要一些时间，在这里旁听着会不会不太好？

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_18
records.text: Hehe, actually, the words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
records.zh: 嘿嘿，其实鉴心道长的话启发了我，她以前帮助别人的那些事情，我觉得这些我也可以做嘛。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_18
records.text: The words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
records.zh: 鉴心道长的话启发了我，她以前帮助别人的那些事情，我觉得这些我也可以做嘛。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_18
records.text: So why shouldn't I go back to a place that suits me better? That way, I might be able to help more people, just like Master Jianxin, and also gain more recognition.
records.zh: 那我干嘛不回到更适合我的地方去呢？那样说不定能和鉴心道长一样，帮到更多的人，也能获得更多的认可。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_38
records.text: Scar reveals the moral of the tale he has spun for you. He believes himself to be the rule-breaking black lamb. It is clear where his allegiances lie, and you decide you have heard enough...
records.zh: 伤痕将故事的真相和盘托出，作为始作俑者他却自称是打破规则的“黑羊”，已经没有必要再聊下去了，这样的恶徒必须得到制裁。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_24
records.text: They belonged to this one Overseer I'm talking about. They call him... Scar.
records.zh: 正是出自残星会会监之一，伤痕。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_24
records.text: From cards discovered at the scene, Yangyang deduces that the tragedy is likely the work of the Fractsidus, an extremist group obsessed with merging humans and Tacet Discords. The cards belong to Scar, one of the organization's Overseers.
records.zh: 秧秧从现场发现的几张卡牌判断这里的惨案很可能是残星会——一个热衷将人与残象融合的极端组织的手笔。而这几张卡牌正来自他们的会监，伤痕之手。

records.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_6_1
records.text: If you need to hear it from me, then... Yes, I am Scar.
records.zh: 如果你需要我再自我介绍一遍……是的，我是伤痕。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_6_1
records.text: The mysterious man, whose name is Scar, doesn't attack you. He invites you to investigate the village with your own eyes to uncover the truths beneath the surface.
records.zh: 你眼前这个名叫伤痕的男人并没有发起攻击，相反，他似乎想要招揽你，并且看起来非常有把握。他邀请你继续调查这个村子，用你自己的眼睛去发掘惨案背后的真相。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_4
records.text: You demand the truth, but Scar refuses. Clearly, revealing it to you directly holds no thrills for him.
records.zh: 你想让伤痕直接告诉你关于村子的真相，但他明显觉得这样实在太无趣了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_5
