records.text:
Reported by Goose Book
Since the beginning of TD Outbreak (130-155 years), there has been a dramatic increase in the mist in the deep pit located at the bottom of Tiger's Maw, and the Institute has detected a large number of active Wuthering Waves sub-signals at this location, and has dispatched an exploration team to the pit to investigate on a number of occasions, however, personnel have been severely compromised, and the data has been lost, and it has not been possible to actually advance the progress of the investigations.
The purpose of this exploration is to continue the investigation of the mists and to rescue the trapped personnel. The personnel involved were:
Midnight Rangers Pioneer Brigade Specialized Team (111162)
Institute Address Exploration Team
......
Analysis of survey results regarding the Unknown Mists:
This exploration collected samples of the Mist in the tunnel connecting Tiger's Maw Mine and the Misty Deep Pit, and analyzed them in a field test using the [Simple Spectrometer] carried by the team. Based on the results of this test, we hypothesized that the Mist appears to be a biological component with a composition similar to the scale powder on the wings of Lepidoptera insects, exhibiting non-toxic, low-temperature properties.
We judge that the danger of the mists comes mainly from its low-temperature characteristics:
① The condensation of water vapor caused by low temperature will greatly obstruct the field of vision, causing investigators to lose their judgment of direction in the misty area.
② Low temperature will directly affect the health of the investigators, long-term low temperature leads to reduced physical vitality, unable to respond to the danger in time.
However, this investigation has not yet identified the positive body of the unusual sound coming from within the misty area. Considering that the unknown sound may cause panic among the people in the vicinity and affect the operation of the mine, it is recommended that the information be blocked.


The following is a list of recently missing persons:
Chamon
Bracegirdle
Leyun
Chonin
..................
(Relatives of the above individuals appear to have been experiencing varying degrees of hallucinations recently. They are calling for them to enter the deep pit of mist at the bottom of the mine, which is suspected to be related to the mutation of the mist. As the Misty Pit is sealed off and cannot be investigated further, it is recommended that all operators be informed to avoid the mist and temporarily stop mining in the area around the Misty Pit.)
records.zh:
报告人：雁书
自兽潮（130年-155年）开始，位于虎口山脉底层的深坑内迷雾剧增，研究院在该位置探测到大量鸣潮子活跃信号，已数次派遣勘探队前往深坑调查，然而人员折损严重，数据遗失，无法实际推动调查的进度。
本次勘探的目的一为继续调查迷雾，二为营救被困人员。参与人员为：
夜归先锋大队特种小队（111162）
研究院地址勘探组
……
关于未知迷雾的调查结果分析：
本次勘探收集了，连通虎口矿场和迷雾深坑的甬道内的迷雾样本，并使用队内携带的【简易测谱仪】对其进行了实地测试分析。根据本次测试的结果，我们推测迷雾似乎是一种生物成分，其成分类似于鳞翅目昆虫翅膀上的鳞粉，呈现出无毒、低温的特性。
我们判断迷雾的危险性，主要来自于其低温特性：
①	低温导致的水汽凝结，会极大的阻碍视野，导致调查人员在迷雾区内失去对方向的判断。
②	低温会直接影响调查人员的健康状态，长期低温导致身体活力降低，无法及时应对危险。
然而此次调查尚未查明，迷雾内传来的异常声音的正体，考虑到未知声音可能导致附近人员恐慌，影响到矿场的作业，建议对该情报进行封锁。


以下为近期失踪人员的名单：
茶蒙
括圃
勒允
诵宁
………………
（以上人员的亲属，近期似乎都有不同程度的幻听。幻听内容为失踪人员呼唤他们进入矿场底层的迷雾深坑，怀疑与迷雾的变异有关。因迷雾深坑为封锁状态，无法进一步对其进行调查，建议通告全体作业人员避开迷雾，暂时停止迷雾深坑附近的区域的开采工作。）

The ancient tree "Loong's Gaze", is located in the northern parts of Loong's Gaze Outskirts, Central Plains. Based on records found inside "Plants of Jinzhou", the Loong's Gaze is estimated to be between 1400 and 1500 years old, having withstood the test of the Lament and continues to stand tall. Its twisting roots are like a python wrapped around a loong banner, its branches as though piercing claws, both showing the tree's unrestrained nature.
This unshakable ancient tree has long since become an icon of the land, as people seek to it as a beacon of hope. As long as the Loong's Gaze stands, the day of the Central Plains' rebirth will sure to come. 

Reminder: Please do not carve on the bark or branches of the tree. We all share an equal responsibility to safekeep the ancient tree's well-being.

鸣式战争初期，面对无冠者的残象大军，瑝珑军队与祈池村民齐心协力，在此奋力抵抗，取得了可贵的胜利。岿然不动的古树如同大地的坐标，成为人们内心的依靠。只要龙望还在，中曲台地就有再次重生的一天。
新历147年，祈池村的居民们在今州的帮助下进行了古树复壮，并正式定名“龙望”。 

*温馨提示：请勿在树干、树枝上刻字。爱护古木，人人有责。

~The Comfort Inn~
Weekly Readings 100th Special Extra Edition

*Weekly Fresh* Bounds of Gathering
Qichi Village's first Flower Tossing Festival came to a successful conclusion. Unlike previous years, to commemorate the completion of the village to the north, Qichi Village invited a number of nearby villagers to participate as a way of thanking everyone for their support.
Flower Tossing is a custom of the villagers of Qichi Village in the past. In March, freshly folded flower branches and petals are thrown into the Yuhua Lake pool to let the water feel the vitality of the early spring, and to pray that the joy of the new life will be transmitted to the hearts of the people and that they will not be trapped by the destruction of the Lament.
There is also a small pond near our inn, so if you are interested, you can throw a handful of flower petals into it when you take a walk after dinner. Although it is not as large as the Yuhua Lake in Qichi Village, the prayers and joys are certainly shared.


*Toilet reading
"Why is Tiger's Maw nothing like a tiger's mouth?"
"Because a long, long time ago, a goat got lost in the mountains ......"

Scientists analyze Tacetite composition and find it's all Resonator's wish.

Chirpuff was traveling down the river when he came across a Feathered Heron feeding and exclaimed, "Chirpuff!!!"

(This page is older than the others, and appears to have been thumbed through many times)


*Special Postscript* A Final Farewell
Without realizing it, Concentration has accompanied you travelers for two years and two months, and Concentration has successfully reached its 100th issue. At the end of this Concentration issue, we would like to say goodbye to all of you.
The LamentSonata-style war has revolutionized Central Plains, and various sudden disasters have made it difficult for us to resist. At this rate, ComfortSonata will not be able to live up to its name and give travelers a truly safe and comfortable living experience.
But our farewell will not be as sudden as that of the Lament. We will continue to operate for another month, and when the handover is complete, the building will be retained and taken over by Jinzhou. As for what will become of it, stay tuned!
records.zh:
~安适心旅店~
每周读物 第100期 特别加量版

*每周新鲜* 千缘相会
祈池村第一届抛花节顺利结束。与往年不同，为了纪念北面村庄完工，祈池村邀请了不少附近的村民参加，以此感谢大家的支援。
抛花是祈池村村民过去的习俗，在三月往雨华池池中抛入新折的花枝或是花瓣，让池水感受初春的生机，祈愿这新生的喜悦能够传递到人的心中，不再受困于悲鸣的毁灭。
另外，我们旅店附近也有一个小池塘，如果客人有兴趣，饭后散步时也可以试试往里面抛一捧花瓣哦。虽然大小不如祈池村的雨华池，但这种祈望和喜悦一定是共通的。


*一刻开心* 厕所读物
“为什么虎口山脉一点都不像虎口呢？”
“因为很久很久以前，有一只羊在山里迷了路……”

科学家分析黑石成分，发现都是共鸣者的愿望。

啾啾河豚沿河而下，遇到了正在捕食的羽鹭，大声叫道：“啾啾！！”

（这一页比其他页面更老旧，似乎是被翻阅过很多次）


*特别后记* 最后的告别
不知不觉见，安适心已经陪伴各位旅客走过两年零两个月的时间，安适心新情也顺利走到了100期。在这充满纪念意义的一期最后，我们要跟大家说一声再见。
悲鸣和鸣式战争已经彻底改变了中曲台地，各种突发灾害让我们难以抵抗。这样下去，安适心也无法对得起招牌的名字，给旅客一个真正安全舒适的居住体验。
不过安适心的告别，不会像悲鸣一样突然哦。我们还会坚持再运营一个月，完成交接后，建筑也会保留，由今州接手。至于会变成什么，各位敬请期待喽！

Today, the captain had another discussion with me. He hoped that, as a technical backbone, I could provide a decisive opinion on whether the exploration work could still be completed as scheduled. Both he and I, and even everyone else, understand the importance of excavating the second long-distance transportation route. This route, starting from Jinzhou, passes through the Gorges of Spirits to connect the remaining areas in Huanglong. It is important for Jinzhou to have closer and more convenient interactions with other territories in Huanglong. To put it bluntly, in case there are issues with one transportation route in the future, we can still rely on the other, avoiding falling into a desperate situation.

Recent monitoring indicates the potential emergence of Tacet Fields around the Gorges of Spirits at any time, but we can't stop now as we have already come this far. If we stop now, all our hard-earned achievements will be in vain. However, if we don't stop, we may risk the lives of our team members.

43) The minimum unit of action is a group of two people, and a decibel meter must be carried in operations.

records.text:
The ancient tree "Loong's Gaze", is located in the northern parts of Loong's Gaze Outskirts, Central Plains. Based on records found inside "Plants of Jinzhou", the Loong's Gaze is estimated to be between 1400 and 1500 years old, having withstood the test of the Lament and continues to stand tall. Its twisting roots are like a python wrapped around a loong banner, its branches as though piercing claws, both showing the tree's unrestrained nature. This unshakable ancient tree has long since become an icon of the land, as people seek to it as a beacon of hope. As long as the Loong's Gaze stands, the day of the Central Plains' rebirth will sure to come.

*Reminder: Please do not carve on the bark or branches of the tree. We all share an equal responsibility to safe keep the ancient tree's well-being.
records.zh:
古树「龙望」，位于中曲台地龙望郊北部。据《今州植物考》记载，龙望的树龄推测在1400-1500年间，历经悲鸣仍屹立不倒。其根曲折，如蟒绕龙幡；虬枝似利爪，尽显恣意。岿然不动的古树如同大地的坐标，成为人们内心的依靠。只要龙望还在，中曲台地就有再次重生的一天。

*温馨提示：请勿在树干、树枝上刻字。爱护古木，人人有责。

records.text:
~ Qingyan Courier Station ~
Station Monthly Read, Issue No.80, Standard Edition

*Event Guide* Bounds of Gathering
The very first Flower Tossing Festival in Xiehua Village ended in a success. Unlike previous years, we invited many of our friends from the army to participate and celebrate the victories of their battles on the front lines, as a way of saying thanks for their hard work.
Flower Tossing is a local custom of the residents of the Central Plains. In March, residents throw freshly-picked flowering branches or petals into running water, as a way of embracing the vitality of early spring within the pools of water. They pray that the joys of new life can flow into people's hearts, no longer confined by sorrows left by the destruction of the Lament.
In addition, there is a small pond near our station. All visiting guests who are interested can feel free to throw a handful of petals into the pond during a stroll after dinner time. It may not be as big as the Yuhua Lake of Qiqi Village in the past, but the hopes and joys are the same.


~ Qingyan Courier Station ~
Station Monthly Read, Issue No.100, Special Commemorative Edition

*Special Postscript* Final Farewell
Who would have thought, the Qingyan Courier Station has accompanied travelers of all walks for another two years, and our monthly read has now reached its 100th issue. At the end of this commemorative issue, we would like to bid farewell to each and all of you.
The Lament has completely changed the Central Plains. Frequent outbreaks of disasters have made management of the station more and more difficult. Under these circumstances, I regret to say that the Qingyan Courier Station can no longer live up to its name and provide guests with a truly safe and comfortable living experience.
However, Qingyan's farewell will not be as unexpected as the appearance of a Tacet Field! We will soon be holding a charity sale of all the items inside the station. The proceeds from the sale will be used to help everyone rebuild their homes.

I hope you'll all look forward to it.  I hope that we can meet again in Jinzhou in the not-so-distant future.
records.zh:
~清晏驿馆~
驿站月刊  第80期  常规刊

*活动指南* 千缘相会
撷华庄第一届抛花节顺利结束。与往年不同，为了恭贺前线战事告捷，今年我们邀请了不少军将朋友们一同参加，以此感谢大家的守望相助。
抛花是中曲台地的住民习俗，在三月往流水中抛入新折的花枝或是花瓣，让池水感受初春的生机，祈愿这新生的喜悦能够传递到人的心中，不再受困于悲鸣的毁灭。
另外，我们驿馆的附近也有一个小池塘哦，如果客人有兴趣，饭后散步时也可以试试往里面抛一捧花瓣哦。虽然大小不如昔日祈池村的雨华池，但这种祈望和喜悦一定是共通的~


~清晏驿馆~
驿站月刊  第100期  特别纪念刊

*特别后记* 最后的告别
不知不觉，清晏驿馆又陪伴了各位旅客走过两年的时间，驿站月刊也顺利走到了100期。在这充满纪念意义的一期最后，我们要跟大家说一声再见。
悲鸣已经彻底改变了中曲台地，各种突发灾害使得驿站的运营举步维艰。这样下去，清晏驿馆也无法对得起招牌的名字，给旅客一个真正安全舒适的居住体验。
不过清晏的告别，不会像无音区的出现那般突然哦！不日后，我们将对驿馆内的物件进行义卖，义卖所得的收入将用来帮助大家重建家园，敬请期待。

希望在不远的将来，我们能在今州再会。

records.text:
Date: [--02]
The C.V. laboratory is located in an abandoned site within Whining Aix's Mire. The main structure was built using a special material developed by C.V., which prevented severe weathering and corrosion. As a result, the building remained relatively intact. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the base level of the site for an artificial Tacet Field.
A few mechanical instrument abandoned by C.V. are left at the experiment environment. Outside the environment, a low-frequency lighting system was installed at a regulated distance and angle, ensuring permanent illumination of the experiment area.
The experimental environment center is composed of multiple bundled cables that secure a spherical metal device. The cables transmit the input and output data from within the metal device. Surrounding the spherical device are frequency detection instruments of the same specifications. These instruments are typically controlled by dials. When the dial is rotated clockwise, the electrical energy will drive the composite metal frame to rotate in a high angular speed clockwise around the central device for synchronizd frequency detection.
records.zh:
日期：[--16]
搬到怨鸟泽的遗址后，工作比以前更累了，不过一切都是值得的。
海森教授在会议上公布试验结果成功的那一刻，我现在都还记忆犹新，他告诉着我们：“我老了，趁我还有些时间，还想做些正确的事。
而你们还年轻，还有无限的未来，我相信你们每一个人，无论天才与否，都想把自己的名字留在时间与历史的丰碑中，而不是碌碌无为地从这扇单门走出去，在此，我恳请大家帮助我，也是帮助大家自己，履行这份研究的职责，直至最后一刻。”
是啊，如果这次研究能够成功，我们这些本该无名的普通人也许也能跟着海森教授的名字一同出现在历史的教科书上。
我们当中有来自各地研究院被遗弃、落选的失败者，也有靠自主学习的民间科学爱好者，甚至还有一些曾做出危险行为而被禁止研究的学者，但是来到这里后，没有人会去追究你的过往，是海森教授给了我们重新来过的机会。虽然现在我们只能躲藏起来，但研究完成的那一天，我们一定能够重新站到阳光的下面。
海森教授是一位天才，很少会给我们讲他过去的故事，只是听他说过自己并不是出身于大型研究院，但工作的地方也是天才云集，做着有趣的研究。每次谈到那段时光的时候，海森教授看上去总是很开心，但好像也有遗憾。诶，来到这里的大家，或许都有自己的遗憾吧。

records.text:
April 8
The doctor recommended Fuling receive palliative care at home. Fuling smiled and explained that it wasn't about losing hope, but rather a chance to finally visit the magical destinations we've always talked about exploring together... I understand her illness is serious, but as long as it brings her happiness, I'll support her wholeheartedly. And me? Well, I'm not one to give up without a fight.

April 15
Fuling asked me to map out our journey, and she took on the task of delving into success stories of her illness, pinpointing potential treatment spots. A few of the locations she picked were incredibly isolated. I was worried she wouldn't make it to those places. However, she brushed off my concerns with a carefree assurance, claiming she was perfectly capable and full of vigor.
Not wanting to dampen her spirits, I agreed and promised to take good care of her.

May 1
The famous doctor we visited in Mingting said she couldn’t do anything about Fuling's rare symptoms.
It's okay; we have other options. There must be a way to cure her.

May 30
Despite everything we've tried, we haven't found a treatment that can fully cure Fuling. Her condition has worsened, and the illness has made it difficult for her to travel long distances. To cheer her up, I rented a hologram projector from the Pioneer Association for her. She enjoyed the projected scenery, but I couldn’t ignore the yearning and sorrow in her eyes. She concealed them well, but I sensed them, and it pained my heart.

June 13
Fuling, in her gentle way, had requested snapshots of the landscapes I stumbled upon during my travels. She believed that by seeing these images, she could somehow accompany me on my journey. Despite her well-meaning gesture to console me, her absence left a void that tainted even the most breathtaking views with melancholy.

June 15
Encountered a Tacet Field on my path today, diverting me onto a detour that led me to a hidden lake nestled deep within the forest. 
The sight before me was beyond words—the wind carried petals from the trees, creating a mesmerizing dance of colors in the sky. My camera failed to capture the fleeting magic of that moment. Enthralled by the enchanting view, I momentarily lost touch with reality. 
Yet, as quickly as joy enveloped me, sorrow and fear washed over, realizing that such beauty held no meaning without her presence beside me. 
It felt like fate as I journeyed in search of a cure for Fuling, passing through places we had once dreamt of exploring together. Some spots were meant to surprise her during our planned adventures. 
If only Fuling were here, her artistic touch would breathe life into these places once more; even the most desolate ruins would flourish under her paintbrush.
...If only she were here with me.

June 16
I encountered a strange man in red today. His pretentious attitude put me on edge. Despite my unease, he shared a weird story with me, almost as if it was intentional.
He knew I was seeking a cure for Fuling and claimed to have a way to save her. However, he only revealed half the truth and insisted on me doing him a favor before sharing more details. Honestly, I'm not sure if I should trust him.

June 17
My next destination is Jinzhou, the home of a painter Fuling admired. She is so excited about this. I haven't seen her like this in a long time.
I've discovered the true identity of that man in red. Apparently, he belongs to a dangerous organization that I shouldn't meddle with, but...

June 20
The information shared by that man and his organization was beyond anything I could have imagined. The truth behind that tale, the Sentinel's power to manipulate time, the secret realm in Mt. Firmament... if they are all real, then Fuling can be cured.
According to the deal I made with them, I need to use my identity as an adventurer to find a certain object hidden in the mountain, and this object, as they promised, is the key to saving Fuling's life. They seemed unusually obsessed with it, but their intentions were none of my concern. All I need to do is keep Fuling alive, and for that, I'll pay any price.
I must give it a try.
records.zh:
4月8日
医师建议伏翎出院修养，姑息治疗。
伏翎笑着说这并不是放弃，她还有很多想去的地方，想和我继续去探索那些我们曾经一起约定去看的奇景。
……我明白她其实并没有抱什么期望，但只要她能开心，我愿意实现她的任何心愿。
况且，我还没有放弃。

4月15日
伏翎说我们可以分工合作，她来调查这个病存在的治愈案例和有可能找到特效药的地方，我来规划行程。伏翎查到的地方有一些在很偏远的州城，我担心她的身体吃不消，但她很坚持，说自己还能跑能跳。
我会照顾好她，我不想让她失望。

5月1日
我们拜访了明庭的那位名医，但她也表示对这种罕见病症束手无策。
没关系，我们去下一个地方，一定还有希望。

5月30日
到现在还是没有找到真正有效的治疗方法，她的身体状况越来越差，已经不能走太远的路了。我从先行公约借来了投影设备，她很喜欢。
我仍然忘不了她看着那些虚拟风景的时候眼中的向往和难过，即使她掩饰得很好。

6月13日
伏翎说，希望我记录下沿途的风景发给她，因为这样就是和我一起旅行了。我知道她是在用自己的方式安慰我，但我自己早都已经无心去看那些风景。

6月15日
必经之路上形成了无音区，我只能绕远避开，却因此在树林深处发现了一片非常美丽的湖泊。
那是难以用言语形容的景色，风吹落树上的花瓣，带来一场缤纷的雨，就连手中的相机都无法承载那样绚烂的色彩，在那一瞬间，我忘掉了现实中的一切，完全沉浸在奇景带来的震撼里。
但震撼之后是巨大的恐惧和悲伤，现在根本就不是在意这些的时候，我的身边没有她。
或许是巧合，在这几次寻药的过程中，我总是能路过很多我曾经计划想要探险的地方，有些甚至连伏翎也不知道，那些景色是我想要留给她的惊喜。
如果是伏翎，一定能完完整整地画出那些地方最美丽的样子，只要经由她手，哪怕是灰败寂寥的废墟，都能绽放出更富生机的色彩。
……如果她也能在这里，该多好。

6月16日
遇到了一个可疑的红衣人，装腔作势的样子让人有些不适，他对我讲了一个奇怪的传说，意有所指。
他知道我们的事情，甚至还说知道让伏翎活下去的方法，他告诉的信息似乎真假参半，还说只有我答应他们的条件才会告诉我更多事情，我不知道该不该相信他。

6月17日
下一个目的地是今州，伏翎说那里有她非常崇敬的画师，一直表现得很兴奋，很久没看到她这么高兴的样子了。
我查到了那个红衣人的身份，显而易见，我不应该和那个组织有任何牵扯，但是……

6月20日
毫无疑问，红衣人告诉我的事情超越了我的想象，那个传说的真相，还有岁主的操控时间的能力……若真如他们所言，乘霄山中存在那样的地方，那就代表着我们还有第二次机会。
他们想委托我这个身份单纯的探险家进山找一个东西，并且向我保证这个东西就是能够拯救伏翎的关键，他们似乎对这件事有着异乎寻常的狂热，不过我不在乎他们的目的是什么，只要能让伏翎活下去，我愿意付出任何代价。
我要试一试。

records.text:
My Dearest Wuli,

How are you? I wonder if you're still continuing our adventure as you read these words.

You've visited several places on our list of future adventures. I intentionally picked them under the guise of seeking treatment for my illness, as you may have noticed. I wish I could go with you, Wuli… I don't have many days left, but I trust you'll find and enjoy the wonders we once dreamed of sharing.

We've traveled through diverse lands, witnessing lives rebuilding from devastation, and immortalizing extraordinary moments for a wider audience to savor. In this world scarred by the Lament, beauty and hope persist, sprouting anew from the depths of despair. This is our quest, and I hope you will carry this essence with you as your journey unfolds.

Our adventures have always been shared with companions. We met, journeyed together for a time, and eventually diverged onto separate paths. Perhaps we will reunite on our next escapade, or perhaps destiny will guide us on divergent routes indefinitely. The bravery to explore and forge ahead will forever reside within us.

This truth holds for our past journey and for the ones ahead for you.

The day will inevitably come when we must bid each other farewell, just as it will when our paths cross once more. So, my love, please, continue your journey... and carry our joint aspirations into the future.

With all my love,
Fuling
records.zh:
当你看到这则留言的时候，是否还在继续我们的旅程呢？
抱歉……或许你已经察觉到了，那些我以寻药为由调查到的位置里，有很多是曾经我们有计划探险的地方。我希望你寻找和看到的，一直是那些让我们魂牵梦萦的风景。毕竟……我自己的身体状况，我再清楚不过了。
我希望梧黎能回想起刚开始踏上旅程的心情，还有我们的愿望。我们曾经一起去过很多地方，记录过许多在毁灭中新生的事物，我们想让更多人看到那些奇景，这个星球在悲鸣中变得满目疮痍，但正因如此那些新生之物才如此美丽。
记得我们总是能在旅程中遇到很多很好的朋友，我们会在同行一段时间后分别，或许还能够在下一趟旅程中与他们相遇，也或许那就是我们的最后一次见面，但我们从来没有因为离别而失去继续向前探险的勇气，不是吗？
那么这一次，也是一样的。
我们终会离别，但也终会重逢，请你不要停下脚步……继续将我们共同的愿望带向未来吧。

records.text:
Arriving at Cliffside Harbor, start your journey with a visit to the Farrow Bridge Ruins, a silent testament to the divide forged by faith between Septimont and Ragunna. Continue along the Hero’s Way, an ancient path once trodden by Gladiators on pilgrimage to the legendary Colosseum Olymdos. Frequencies of their emotions still linger along the route, guiding travelers toward the majestic city on top of Capitoline Hill, where the awe-inspiring Gryphon’s Fortress stands.
...
Begin your day with a visit to Colosseum Olymdos to witness a live gladiatorial match (check the event schedule in advance and pick your favorite showdown). Explore the public rest areas of top Gladiators for a glimpse behind the scenes. Next, make your way to the Vale of Glory, where stone-carved weapons commemorate the legendary heroes and Gladiators of Septimont, whose names still echo through the ages.
...
Hop on the Cable Car and glide down to the bustling Caracalla Market, where you can sip the signature blends at Solis, browse arms and armor at the Silver Helmet Store, and pick up unique mementos at the Pygmalion Workshop. Cap off your journey with a relaxing soak at the Thermes Baths, where warm waters soothe away the weariness of your adventure.
...
This guide is for reference only. Feel free to plan your day according to your own pace. The best itinerary is always the one that suits you. May your time in Septimont be unforgettable!
records.zh:
从崖港登陆，可以顺路先去观览屹立百年的法罗断桥遗迹，了解七丘与拉古那因信仰而断裂的过往。
继续前行途径英灵古道，感受古代朝觐奥利多斯大竞技场的角斗士留下的情绪频率，并在它们的指引下到达卡庇托山城，感受宏伟气派的“鹫巢石城”景观。
……
角斗士文化体验一日游可先前往奥利多斯大竞技场观看角斗士比赛（可以提前了解角斗士比赛日程，挑选自己喜欢的场次进行观赛），并参观部分明星选手的休息室开放区，然后去往荣耀之间，历代七丘英雄、传奇角斗士生前惯用的武器铸为石雕屹立于此，向后人传颂着不朽的英名。
……
乘坐日曜缆车索道可前往卡拉卡拉集市，在热闹的氛围中体验「烈日」酒馆的独家特调，观赏「巧手与银盔」杂货铺中的武器与盔甲。皮格马利翁工坊内拥有多样化纪念品供大家购买，最后可去往瑟姆斯浴场，在温热的浴池中放松下来，洗去奔波的疲惫。
……
以上指南仅供参考，您可根据个人时间自行安排，适合您的才是最好的，祝您在七丘拥有美好的时光！

records.text:
A group is gathered around a plant in what appears to be a Pioneer Association office. You recognize Verina among them.
In the background, a lone figure works facing away from the camera. Is that Lucilla?
records.zh:
这似乎是先行公约的一间办公室？照片中的几人正围着一株植物合影，你在照片中还发现了维里奈。
后方的办公桌前，有一个人背对相机依然在工作，那是洛瑟菈吗？

records.text:
Tucked away in the tempestuous Stormy Sea lies an archipelago known for its lavish Tacetite deposits and as a refuge for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, the Black Shores has fostered strong partnerships with nations across Solaris-3.

The archipelago cannot be accessed from any known lands. Only those recognized by the Black Shores or who have received an invitation and guidance can navigate their way to this hidden place.

Members of the Black Shores who operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands, are known as "Consultants." Those stationed at the headquarters are referred to as "Bloom Bearers." Apart from these fundamental duties, the Black Shores also accommodates a plethora of other specialized roles.

Though the Black Shores openly shares its advanced technologies with its partners, even its own members remain unaware of the true origins of these innovations.
records.zh:
隐藏在索拉里斯风暴海上的黑石群岛，据说聚集着全世界各行各业的精英人才，因其致力于对抗悲鸣而与索拉里斯的大多数国家均有广泛而深度的合作。
黑海岸无法从风暴洋上的任何一处陆地出发并抵达，只有被黑海岸认可或是受到邀请和指引的人，才有可能抵达这里。
一般而言，那些常年在外工作在各地奔走的黑海岸成员被称之为「客卿」，在黑海岸本岛总部工作的成员则称之为「执花」，而除了这两个基本职别之外，黑海岸还有许多专门性更强的特殊职别。
时至今日，黑海岸掌握的技术虽然开放给各地的合作伙伴使用，但或许连黑海岸的成员们自己也并不知道，自己掌握的技术究竟来自何方。

records.text:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament. Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study and observe them. Malfunctioning matrices, however, are collected and isolated in designated areas to prevent data overflow.
The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.
records.zh:
一种依照泰缇斯运算规范而诞生的打包形式，是泰缇斯系统下数据压缩的结果。每个星图蕴含的数据都足够重现一场完整的悲鸣灾难，因此可以在特定情况下“进入”星图之中。对星图的解算和模拟，构成了泰缇斯系统的底层运行逻辑之一。
正确运行的星图会被释放到黑海岸地下的地中星河中供给成员观测，错误运行的星图会被收集在特定区域内，防止出现数据溢出。
根据黑海岸历史上第一个定义星图的成员给出的方案，对星图的观测基本和索拉里斯的天文学标准近似。

records.text:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.

At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator."
records.zh:
调律即调节频率，在索拉里斯，频率是事物的第一判断标准，对频率的调节，也即对事物本质的探究。
黑海岸通过对星图的调律，实现对悲鸣本质的溯源和解析。
在黑海岸历史上，只有过一个人被称之为「调律者」。

records.text:
The Nimbus Sanctum is the only Sonoro Sphere that exists in the physical world, where mist and clouds are formed by concentrated Remnant Energy.

The sea of clouds that envelop the Sanctum is believed to be the lingering aftermath of the first Dark Tide. As the mist rose, it gradually submerged the former headquarters of the Order of the Deep, the Seminary of the Forgotten, forcing them to relocate to the Cathedral of Mercury in Ragunna City.

Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. Many pilgrims, drawn by this tale, journey here in search of inner peace.
records.zh:
氤柔水境是唯一一片存在于现实世界的索诺拉。这里的云雾实际上由高浓度的回音能量构成。
氤柔水境中的「云海」据说是第一次黑潮留下的残迹。云海逐渐上涨，淹没了被称为「旧神学院」的隐海修会中枢机构，修会因此迁移至拉古那城的水星天教堂。
在拉古那的传说中，氤柔水境的中心有一片宁静如镜面的水域，它可以净化人们内心的恶念，将它们化为云海的一部分。一些相信此传说的信徒踏上了朝圣之旅，希望能以此得到心灵的平静。

records.text:
The Remnant Creature dwelling within Nimbus Sanctum. Legend holds that it was Lorelei's power that restrained the violent sea of clouds, sparing Ragunna from flooding.

Lorelei has the ability to cleanse the dark frequencies within the clouds, but she is not immune to their corrosive influence. As they accumulate to a breaking point, Lorelei will eventually become the Queen of the Night, unleashing her wrath upon all life that comes near.
records.zh:
居住在氤柔水境的回音生物。传说中，正是罗蕾莱的力量约束了狂暴的云海，使得拉古那城免遭被淹没的厄运。
罗蕾莱具有净化云海中负面情绪的能力，但她本身也会受到这些恶念的影响。当这些恶念累积到临界点时，罗蕾莱便会成为「夜之女皇」，将怒火倾泻到任何附近的一切生物身上。

records.text:
The Fools who survived the dragon's assault—whom the Order refers to as the "pilgrims"—drifted on the warm currents, eventually finding refuge in a vast cavern on Penitent's End.

There, the Fools formed a troupe, determined to one day expose the truth hidden by the Order and return to their home. To achieve this, the troupe wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.

For years, they have awaited the return of the Carnevale, hoping to expose the Order's secrets through their performance, claim the Laurel, and earn the chance to commune with the Sentinel.
records.zh:
在古龙的袭击之下幸存的愚人——也就是修会所谓的朝圣者们，随着环绕悲叹墓岛的暖流漂泊至一处巨大的溶洞。
愚人们以此为据点，组建了剧团，希望有朝一日能够揭露修会所隐瞒的真相，重返故乡。
为此，愚人剧团撰写了诸多剧目，并“戴着镣铐起舞”，于列岛巡回演出。
多年来，他们一直期望着拉古那重新举办狂欢节，在那时凭借自己编写的剧目揭露真相，夺得桂冠，并取得聆听岁主神谕的机会。

records.text:
[Today's Drink Specials]
Vent-a-Nite: Made with aged liquor as the base, infused with refreshing herbal extracts. One sip will send a cool rush from head to toe, like stepping into a ventilation shaft after an ice-cold shower!
Recommendation: ☆☆☆☆

Dragon's Breath Octane: Featuring Pavo Plum juice swiped from the docks and a spoonful of real fossil fuel, this fiery mix is for the boldest drinkers! Dare your friends to survive the burning journey from throat to stomach. First one to take a sip of water picks up the tab!
Recommendation: ☆☆☆

Biohoard: A concoction made from pickled fish and corned meat juices. Tastes just as bad as it smells. I don't know how anyone could enjoy this, but it was made on request from an anonymous letter... Anyway, makes for a good prank on your friends!
Recommendation: ☆
To the anonymous requester: Your drink is ready. Please pay for it soon, or I'll tell Talos and she'll find out who sent this letter.

Golden Hour Special: A special blend of Tumbleyak butter and Nectarwine. A perfect fusion of the rustic charm of Whisperwind Haven and the sophisticated taste of the Montelli Quarters. Some might find it lacking a bold kick, but trust me, the creamy bubbles and velvety texture will win you over.
Recommendation: ☆☆☆☆☆
records.zh:
【今日饮料推荐】
通风井之夜：以陈酿作为基底，加入沁人心脾的草本植物提取物，一口就能让你从头凉到脚底，就像洗完冰水澡之后去通风井里吹风一样！
推荐指数：☆☆☆☆
燃油龙息：添加从码头货物中盗取的雀翎果汁，以及一勺真正的燃油，极致超绝辣度，硬核老饕的心头好！和朋友一起来挑战从食管灼烧到胃部的感觉吧，谁先喝水谁付钱！
推荐指数：☆☆☆
生化奇藏：用腌鱼和腌肉坛子里的汁液配置的饮料，闻起来和尝起来都一样糟糕。我也不知道为什么有人喜欢喝这个，但根据一封匿名信中提出的需求还是制作出来了……总之，很适合用来整蛊你的朋友！
推荐指数：☆，请寄信者尽快来买走所有已经配置好的成品，不然我就把这事告诉塔洛斯老大，她会查出来那封信是谁寄的。
金色时光特饮：用风滚牦奶油加蜜露果酒精心调制的特饮，拂风水畔风情的田园风味与莫塔里区高雅品味的完美结合体。也许有人会觉得这饮料不够有劲，但请相信我，你们一定会被它绵密的气泡和柔滑的口感所征服的。
推荐指数：☆☆☆☆☆

records.text:
Day 15.

Some have begun to question the worth of this endeavor, and the very honor we strive to uphold for Fisalia. Such whispers should have no place here.

We have crossed the ridges of Thessaleo Fells, weathered storms, and dared currents to reach this place, losing a ship on the way. Now, it's time to claim our rewards. The "relic" that has been kept from our family by the Order lies somewhere within these forsaken ruins, and treasures glimpsed only in dreams seem at last within our grasp.

Dario will stay behind. His legs were pierced by a TD and he can no longer walk. We've left him with enough provisions.

The rest of the knights will press on, toward the ruins in the southwest.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.
records.zh:
第15天。 

有人开始质疑这次远行的意义，想给翡萨烈的荣耀蒙上阴翳。这样的声音不该存在。

自狄萨莱海脊长途跋涉，穿越风暴和湍流，我们付出了一艘船的代价才抵达这里。现在正是勇敢探索的时候。这些年修会刻意向家族隐瞒的“圣物“，就隐藏在这些让人生厌的废墟里。那些只会在梦里出现的宝藏，从未像现在这样触手可及。

达利会留在相对安全的遗迹里，他的双腿被残象洞穿，已经不能再行走了。

我们留下了必要的饮水和食粮，余下骑士会向西南方向的遗迹前行。

愿一切行于公义的道途。

records.text:
Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. Korlacchi. The holy name... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...
records.zh:
入冬了，就在这里暂时歇歇脚吧，趁这段时间也可以磨练磨练剑技。
说起来今天遇见了几位过路的骑士，他们似乎也是被骑士传说吸引而来，打算以拂风水畔为起点向更远处进发。
他们的盔甲上都印有家族的骑士纹章，很容易便能辨认出他们的身份，以家族之名，我将……
抱歉，吉安娜，我欺骗了你，科拉基之名……根本不存在。因为大雪的原因，我并没有赶上招揽家族骑士的宴会。
那个名字，不过是从书架上一本骑士小说里摘出的名字……我没有成为被认可的骑士……
对不起……

records.text:

Welcome to Averardo Vault! We hope you have a wonderful and unforgettable time here.
 
The main areas of the Underground Depository are as follows:
 
1. Precious Metals and Artworks Depository
This section primarily stores valuable metals and rare artworks. Some of the items are displayed to the public on a rotating basis. Below is a partial list of recommended exhibits for this month:

Stern's Ceramic Jar
The beloved ceramic jar of the famous comedian Arthur Stern! After receiving the Laurel, he retired from the stage to focus on the art of pottery. This jar is one of twelve masterpieces he personally painted.
Recommendation Rating: Five Stars!

"Deepening Stars"
The painting of an anonymous artist, depicting the starlight reflected from beneath the abyss. Critics have debated the theme of this piece for years, making it a highly controversial and discussed piece.
Recommendation Rating: Three Stars!
 
2. Echo Depository (Currently Closed)
This section primarily houses Echoes.
Important: The Echo Depository is no longer open to visitors.
 
3. [Data Deleted]
records.zh:
主题：埃弗拉德金库游览指南（地下藏区部分）
欢迎来到埃弗拉德金库，希望您能在这里度过一段美好而难忘的时光。
地下藏区的主要区域如下：
1.贵金属与艺术品藏区
该藏区主要存放贵重金属及稀有的艺术品。部分藏品会不定期进行对外展示。以下是本月推荐展品名单（部分）：
斯特恩的陶罐
著名喜剧演员亚瑟·斯特恩最钟爱的陶罐！他在荣膺桂冠后退出了舞台，专心研究陶罐艺术。该陶罐为他亲手绘制的十二个杰作之一。
推荐等级：五星！
画作《深瞑星》
无名作家的作品，主题为深渊之下所映射的星光。评论家曾对此画作的主题争论了长达数年，极具话题性的作品。
推荐等级：三星！
2.声骸藏区（已关闭）
该藏区主要存放声骸藏品。
重要：声骸藏区不再对游客开放。
3.【数据删除】

records.text:
Titular Repository Memoir - Part I
"(This appears to be a personal memoir written by the now-retired Acolyte Julia. Most pages have been lost.)
 
That day, I recognized a familiar figure by the shelves in the Titular Repository. As I'd done in my youth, I tapped his shoulder. Andrea turned, recognized me, and murmured, "Teacher." He looked just as I remembered from our last meeting, yet years had slipped by unnoticed. He had come all this way just to see me. We found a quiet corner to talk.
 
Andrea spoke of his time as a traveling Acolyte, carrying the Sentinel's blessings beyond Ragunna to Riccioli, Septimont, Lilyland... through lands rich and poor, faithful and faithless. His journey must have been arduous yet extraordinary. The new wrinkles and scars on his face told me he was no longer that headstrong young man driven only by passion. His faith and ideals had forged him into a weathered knight.
 
But then, he began to confess. Not about duty, but about his daughter. It was the confession of a father, burdened with guilt toward a daughter he had failed. That kind of regret shouldn't have belonged to an Acolyte, so I did not offer the Sentinel's absolution in Their stead. The same devotion still shimmered in his eyes, and I knew he would continue traveling. Still a devout Acolyte. Still an absent father.
 
So I told him I was writing this memoir. I want to record my experiences here in Avinoleum, and in this very library. Most of them are trivial, yet each is a vivid reflection of the era I live in. These forgotten corners of history deserve to be remembered. The Sentinel teaches us to illuminate the world for others, and it's also important not to forget to light the way for those closest to us.
 
Titular Repository Memoir - Part II

"…
 
On an otherwise ordinary closing day, I was carrying a stack of old books across the platform outside the library when I was drawn, almost involuntarily, into a crowd of onlookers. A duel held every gaze. As the Sword of Virtue touched Cadanto's breastplate, the match between Blessed Maiden and Echo came to an end.
 
Cadanto knelt humbly in defeat. The crowd, who had been holding their breath, erupted into thunderous applause. At that moment, an Acolyte led a young girl through the excited crowd. Dressed in commoner's clothes, the girl clutched a large bouquet of blooming Firecracker Jewelweeds. The bundle was almost taller than she was.
 
A gift for the Blessed Maiden, I assumed. Ever since she began her studies in Avinoleum, devotees had begun to make long journeys just to catch a glimpse of the girl blessed by the Sentinel. But this girl merely nodded toward the Blessed Maiden before turning toward Cadanto. 
 
To everyone's surprise, the girl presented the bouquet to him. After some explanation from the Acolyte, we learned that Cadanto had recently saved a family from Tacet Discords near Avinoleum's outskirts. The towering Echo knight remained half-kneeling and silent. He didn't seem to understand why a human would offer him flowers, or perhaps he felt unworthy of such thanks?
 
"So this is what you've been doing in my absence…" The Blessed Maiden smiled warmly. "Cadanto, accept the flowers. You've earned them." 
 
Still silent, the knight laid down his greatsword and carefully received the bouquet. The little girl immediately leaned forward and embraced him, pressing her face against his cold armor. As always, Cadanto wordlessly bore both her tearful thanks and joyful sobs. 
 
Cadanto… as many have said, is the Blessed Maiden's loyal servant and shield. But he is also a blade that protects the people."
 
Titular Repository Memoir - Part III

"…
 
Retirement drew closer with each passing day, and time flowed quietly within the library. I thought there would be no more ripples.
 
"Excuse me... I'd like to read this book. Do I need to register here?"
 
Accompanying the timid voice before me was a biography, its cover bearing the portrait of the Blessed Maiden. I looked up from the desk and saw a small girl with pale violet curls. There was a mole just beneath one of her eyes. Tiny and delicate. Her skin was so pale that it was nearly translucent like someone who hadn't seen sunlight in a very long time.
 
"You're free to read anything here. Just remember to put the books away when you're done," I said as gently as I could, worried the solemn atmosphere of the library might frighten her away.
 
She was clearly not an Avinoleum student, yet she began appearing regularly in the library in the days that followed. She wandered between the circular shelves, always quietly absorbed in whatever book she picked up. Sometimes she asked me to help her find specific texts. Some were dense theological books, while others were thick volumes on the ocean or pharmacology—not quite the usual interests for someone her age. We grew acquainted. I learned that she'd been brought to Avinoleum by her relatives. They had their own matters to attend to and left her to wander freely in this comparatively safe library.
 
Her departure was as sudden as her arrival. That afternoon, as if answering some unseen summons, she closed the book in her hands and slid it back onto the shelf. I remember it. It was a study of the traditions of the Blessed Maiden in Ragunna. In the slanting dusk light, a long shadow stretched across the floor. Her guardian, presumably.
 
"Thank you for looking after me these past few days." She stood in front of me, doing her best to smile. "Cantarella... I'm Cantarella Fisalia."
 
That surname explained a great many things. Her belated introduction. The sorrow hidden in her words. The flicker of bitterness as she looked toward the door. I rose and took her hand. At the very least, I didn't want her to feel alone on the walk back to the threshold."
records.zh:
扉页书馆回忆录·其一
（似乎是由已退休的茱莉亚教士所撰写的个人回忆录，大部分书页已散佚）
 
那天，一个有些熟悉的身影正站在扉页书馆的书架前，我和年轻时一样拍了拍他的肩膀。安德烈亚转身认出了我，低声说了一句老师。记忆里的他还是上次离开时的模样，一转眼已经过了好多年。他是专程来见我的。于是，我们换了个不会打扰别人的地方叙旧。
 
安德烈亚讲起了他作为驻外教士到各地旅行的事。离开拉古那的他带着岁主的福音去过许多地方，黎乔利、七丘、莉莉兰德……无论信仰充盈还是匮乏，无论富饶还是贫穷，他都一一见证。这段旅程一定非常辛苦，也非常精彩吧。从他脸颊多出来的皱纹和伤痕里可以看出来，他已经不是当年那个空有一腔热血的年轻人了。信仰和理想将他淬炼得宛如一位饱经风霜的骑士。
 
但接下来男人却开始向我告解，内容无关信仰，也无关理想，只有一个不称职的父亲对女儿所怀有的歉疚。那本不该是一位教士该有的遗憾，所以我没有代岁主宽恕他。那些宏大的象征仍然在他的眼睛里闪烁，接下来的他肯定仍会在各地巡游，继续扮演那个不称职的父亲，扮演那位无私的圣职者。
 
于是，我向他提起自己正在撰写这本回忆录的事。我会记录下在阿维纽林，在这座书馆中遇到过的那些事。它们大多无足轻重，却都是我所在的时代一个个鲜活的事例。需要有人铭记这些历史的角落。岁主教导我们成为照亮世间的灯塔，但并没有让我们忘记照亮身边的人。
 
扉页书馆回忆录·其二
……
 
在那个普通的闭馆日，我捧着旧书路过书馆外的平台，便不由自主地汇入了旁观的人群。那是一场谁都无法移开目光的剑技比拼。随着人权剑触及卡迪安特的胸甲，圣女与她的声骸的对决落下了帷幕。
 
卡迪安特谦恭地半跪下来，宣告自己的落败。屏住呼吸的人们这才爆发出热烈的喝彩。这时，一位教士领着一个绿发的女孩经过了我。平民打扮的她紧紧地抱着一大捧盛开的礼花蒴，那几乎高过了她的头顶。
 
大概是准备献给圣女的花束吧，我想。自圣女在阿维纽林进修以来，常有信徒不顾路途遥远来到这里，只为能够见到这位蒙受神恩的少女。但她却只是向圣女点点头，捧着花束走向了另一个方向——卡迪安特的所在。
 
出人意料地，女孩将花端到了卡迪安特面前。经过教士的说明我们才得知，不久前正是卡迪安特在阿维纽林外围解救了被残象袭击的一家人。高大的声骸骑士仍然维持着半跪的姿势，保持沉默。它似乎并不理解眼前的人类将花送给他的含义，又或者……它觉得自己不适合接受这样的答谢？
 
“原来在我不在的时候做了这样的事啊……”圣女露出了明朗的笑容，“卡迪安特，你就接下这些花吧。你有足够的资格。”
 
骑士仍然沉默，但它放下了手中的巨剑，伸出双手接过了面前的花束。小女孩顺势抱了上来，紧贴着骑士冰冷的甲胄。骑士一如既往地，沉默地用身体承接女孩感谢的话语和激动的泪水。
 
卡迪安特……它确实如许多人所说，是圣女的侍从与坚盾，但它也是守护人们的锋刃。
 
扉页书馆回忆录·其三
 
……
 
退休的日子越来越近，书馆里的时光静静流逝，我本以为不会再有波澜。
 
“您好……我想看这本书。是要在这里登记吗?”
 
伴随着怯生生的话语来到我面前的，是一本封面印着圣女肖像的人物传记。我从桌案上抬起头，看到了一个有着淡紫色卷发的小女孩。她眼角下方有颗痣，身材瘦小，皮肤白得几乎透明，就像……常年不见阳光。
 
“在书馆内你大可以自由借阅，但要记得放回原位喔。”我用尽量柔和的语气说，生怕将这位与书馆的严肃氛围格格不入的女孩吓走。
 
女孩显然并不是阿维纽林的学生，但接下来一段时间，她常常出现在书馆里。她在环形的书架间行走，拿上一本书就会安静读上半天。偶尔她会拜托我去找一些特定的书籍，有些是艰深的神学著作，有些则是关于海洋与药剂的大部头——都不太像是她这个年纪该有的趣味。帮忙的次数多了，我们渐渐熟络起来。我逐渐得知，原来她是被亲属带到阿维纽林来的，大人们显然还有大人的事要谈，她就被放养在环境相对安定的书馆里了。
 
女孩的离开和她的到访一样突然。那天下午，她好像有所感召一般地放下了手中的书，将它塞回了原位。那本书是研究拉古那的圣女传统的，我有印象。薄暮的日光在书馆的门口投下了狭长的人影，大概是她的家长来了。
 
“感谢您这段时间的照顾。”她来到我的面前，努力露出笑容，“坎特蕾拉……我是坎特蕾拉·翡萨烈。”
 
翡萨烈这个姓氏足够解释许多东西。比如女孩迟到的自我介绍，话语里隐含的伤感，她望向门口时脸上闪过的忧郁。我站起身，拉过她的手。至少，我不想让她在走向门口的这段路上感到孤独。

Bloom Bearer Field Report No. 10826 
Authored by: Ariosto
 
Attention Rinascita-based Bloom Bearers: Please follow the advice below in the interest of your safe being. Failure to do so may result in unpleasant repercussions.
 
1. Rinascita has no center of politics, instead a collection of city-states governs the region. The southern coastal city of Ragunna is the recommended port of entry for Black Shores Bloom Bearers. The "Stormy Sea" between Black Shores and Rinascita is treacherous, exercise extreme caution. Stay on the approved navigation route. If found to be deviating, correct course at once.
 
2. Strange aquatic TDs inhabit the Stormy Sea. Our current understanding of them is limited as they appear incapable of coherent thought. Do not interact, approach, or touch them. Take evasive action at once should one move towards your vessel.
 
3. Ragunna, a city-state by the sea, is the city with the strongest link to the Sentinel. This connection is maintained by the Order of the Deep, an organization claiming to act as the Sentinel's representative. The citizens of Ragunna equate Sentinel Imperator to "god," and have erected numerous statues in Their image. Bow and lower your gaze when in the presence of such statues. Do not stare at any one statue for over 30 seconds. 
 
4. Ragunna has one cardinal rule regarding pizza: it does not, and will never, tolerate crownapple topping. Do NOT in any circumstance, add crownapple or gemberry to any pizza served at a Ragunnesi restaurant. This rule must—and I repeat—must be adhered to.
 
Comments
Comment 1: I knew sending you to investigate the Somnoire was a mistake! If I read another useless do's and don'ts listicle you'll be re-writing the whole thing. And say goodbye to your performance bonus!
Posted by: Mistman
Comment 2: Living by the sea… Do the Ragunnesi eat rice from a coral bowl?
Posted by: SheepGoBaah
 
Everything I've shared above is based on firsthand experience—gathered by shedding blood, sweat, and tears!
 
In all seriousness. Other than its Common Echoes, the city of Ragunna is also renowned for its "faith" centered around the Sentinel, reinforced via mythologies created by The Order of the Deep to justify the post-lament state of affairs. Personally, I find their mythologies not entirely baseless, as the worldviews espoused are similar to that of the Tethys System.
 
The first inhabitants of Rinascita were refugees displaced by the Lament and Waveworn disasters. Guided by the Sentinel to settle in Rinascita, these refugees were of vastly different backgrounds, cultures, and ideologies. Ragunna's religious and political systems were likely structured around a unifying mono-faith to increase civil cohesion. I encourage Bloom Bearers to approach Ragunna's many rituals and customs with a critical but open mind.

I was born in Rinascita, but after years with the Black Shores, upon my return, the change was far greater than I had anticipated. Most notably, the Order now holds absolute authority in Ragunna. I advise all Bloom Bearers to maintain cordial relations with the Order, respect their rules, and avoid confrontation. Given the Order's current stance towards the Black Shores, Bloom Bearers must exercise utmost discretion while in Ragunna,
 
To help Bloom Bearers earn the trust of Order members, I've compiled a few useful examples of how to phrase sentences so they resemble clauses from their Codex. Let me demonstrate:
-Oh, mighty lord in black, the founder and ruler of the Black Shores! May I one day be worthy of your talents and devote myself fully to your service!
-Greedy KU-Money, reflect upon the error of your ways before the lord's altar and seek redemption.
-Praise to Shorekeeper, Guardian of the Black Shores! Your starlight scatters the darkness and banishes all evil. With your light to guide us, we are delivered to salvation!
 
Comments
 Comment 1: Even if you said that, I do not accept a delay in the report.
 Posted by: Shorekeeper

《黑海岸执花外勤报告_NO.10826》——报告人：阿里奥斯托

各位前往黎那汐塔的执花请注意，在黎那汐塔，尤其是在拉古那执行任务时，请各位务必遵守以下规则，以确保你们的安全，否则后果自负。

1.黎那汐塔并不存在一个传统意义上的政治中心，它更像是一种基于地域形成的文化集合体。现阶段黎那汐塔以城邦分治的政治制度为主。黑海岸的诸位执花，若想前去黎那汐塔，黎那汐塔的南部港口城市「拉古那」是必经的一站。黑海岸与黎那汐塔之间的海域被称作「风暴海」，浪潮汹涌，风暴肆虐。请记住，从黑海岸前往拉古那的安全航路只有一条。如果偏航，请立即返航。

2.黎那汐塔的海域中存在着千奇百怪的水生残象。然而目前，我们人类对海洋的认知还不到十分之一，因此，无论你在风暴海中遇到何种存在，都不要感到惊慌，保持冷静。但请注意，无论如何，既然它们身为残象，自然是无法讲出与人类一般，连贯且完整的语句的。请不要与海中的鱼影说话，不要靠近，更不要触摸——尤其是在它发现并开始迅速接近你的时候。如果发现，请尽快逃离。

3.拉古那是一座海上城邦，也是黎那汐塔中，与岁主联系最紧密的城市——将岁主作为神祇信仰，号称“岁主代言人”的「隐海修会」便位于此处。岁主英白拉多，对拉古那人而言，是字面意义上，完全等同于“神明”的存在。人们因感念祂的功绩在城中铸造了数座岁主像。如遇岁主像，请颔首低眉，保持谦卑与恭敬，切勿注视岁主像超过30秒。

4.拉古那的披萨里没有热海皇梨，热海皇梨披萨不是披萨。千万不要在拉古那的餐厅，擅自往披萨中添加热海皇梨或者龙衔果。这点非常重要！重申，这点非常重要！

*一则批注：早知道就不该派你小子去调查什么心之集域！再给我整什么规则怪谈，这份报告就准备重写吧！绩效奖金也别想拿了！——批注人：雾一样的男子
*另一则批注：生活在海上……那拉古那人会喜欢吃珊瑚钙饭吗？——批注人：咩能说什么

以上都是本人亲身经历，字字泣血！
言归正传，如前文所述，除公共声骸外，拉古那城更是以其“信仰”闻名于世。围绕着岁主，隐海修会建立了一套对应的神话体系，用以解释悲鸣后的当今世界，辅导治理城邦的大小事务。但在我看来，修会的信仰并非愚信，隐海修会的神话体系，的确有不少地方，与泰缇斯所建立的世界观模型有着共通之处。
黎那汐塔最初的建造者是一群因悲鸣、海蚀灾害背井离乡的流亡者，他们在岁主的指引下登上了黎那汐塔，在此建立了家园。流亡者们的出身、文化、理念千差万别，也许，拉古那的宗教与政治制度，是基于某种，将信仰作为锚点，团结彼此，快速为文明筑基的需要。有关拉古那的种种礼仪习俗，诸位执花请辩证看待。

我虽出生于黎那汐塔，但已在黑海岸任职多年，与家乡阔别已久。尽管我已对故乡可能出现的变革有所准备，但其变化之大，还是远远超出了我的预期。尤其是隐海修会……但鉴于隐海修会在拉古那城邦的绝对地位，我依然建议后来的同事们，对修会尽量保持友善，尊重当地教义，避免与他们产生直接冲突。
同时，碍于隐海修会对黑海岸表现出的态度，诸位执花在拉古那执行任务时，也需尽可能保持隐秘。
后来的执花们，请记住如下句式，其皆由本人自修会圣典习得，有助于诸位与修会尽快熟络，取得他们的信任。我将在此做出示范。接下来，学习会很有用。

“啊！伟大的黑衣之主，黑海岸的创始人与管理者！我期待能拥有与您一样的才能与天赋，我将尽我所能侍奉您！”
“那利欲熏心的库默尼！谋算工资者，理应在公正神明的殿前进行自省！”
“赞美守岸人！黑色海岸的守护者！无限宇宙星光闪耀，万千邪恶消遁无形！因您的光芒指引我们向上，我等必将得到救赎！”

*一则批注：……即使这样，报告也是不能延期的。——批注人：守岸人

Perhaps the greatest misfortune one can face is falling in love with a Resonator.
On a train bound for Lilyland, a weary traveler fleeing his past in Ragunna stumbles into a designer chasing inspiration. Following that fateful encounter, he resolves to write her one letter every single day until the day he dies.
A century later, the designer steps onto Ragunna's soil, his letters pressed to her heart...
records.zh: 普通人最大的不幸，或许就是爱上一个共鸣者。在一辆通往莉莉兰德的列车上，想要逃避现实的拉古那男人，遇上了寻找灵感的设计师女士。他决定每天向他爱慕的女士写一封信，直到他去世的那一天。百年后，设计师带着这些信，踏上了拉古那的土地……

records.text:
Dear Rover,

How are you finding your time at Startorch Academy? I find myself wondering how long the sunlight I basked in today will take to reach you.

Lately... I have been having the same dream. In it, I am alone in the Gorges of Spirits, running and running... And just when it seems I am about to find something, something always pulls me back to reality.

Does that sound like I am complaining? Forgive me. Once in a while, I hope you will not mind if I write like this.

Oh, yes. Some time ago, my older sister said she wanted to come visit me in Jinzhou. It's been years since we last saw each other. I wonder what she is like now, but knowing her, I think she must still be the same sister I remember. I would like to introduce you two someday. I'm sure you would become very good friends.  

I assume by the time you receive this letter, Chixia and I will be on an assignment together. Things have been a little unsettled in Jinzhou lately, but do not worry. Just as you have sharpened your blade through so many stories and trials, I would like to think I have grown too, since the day we first met.

So next time, let me be the one to share my "adventures" with you, Rover.

Sincerely,
Yangyang

P.S. I've also included some seasonal snacks for Abby. Do share them with your friends at Lahai-Roi. I hope they are to everyone's liking.
records.zh:
漂泊者：
       不知你在星炬学院过得还好么？今天所照拂我的阳光，要隔多久才能到你那儿去呢？
       最近……我偶尔会做一个梦。梦见自己独自一人身处云陵谷，不断地跑着跑着……每当我像是要找到什么的时候，却总会被什么推回到现实中去。
       这段话……像是在发牢骚吗？抱歉，偶尔，也让我写一点吧。
       对了，前段时间，姐姐说要来今州看我。我们之间已经几年没见了，不知道姐姐现在成了什么样，不过我想，按姐姐的性格，应该还是我记忆中的模样吧。如果能介绍你们认识就好了，你们肯定能成为很好的朋友。
       等你收到这封信的时候，我应该就要协助炽霞出任务了。最近今州有些不安宁，但不必担心，就像你已经用了那么多的故事去磨砺自己的剑一样，我想，自我们初见以来，我应该也有所成长。
       所以，等到下次，就由我给你讲述我这次的“冒险”吧，漂泊者。
       秧秧。 

       也给阿布带了些应时的点心，和拉海洛的朋友们一起吃吧，希望能合大家的口味。

records.text:
Southern Yuan Hills
Minor rogue Autopuppet and Tacet Discord activity detected.  All personnel from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have withdrawn into Xuanfang Hold. No one left behind...

Conclusion: Medium Threat 
The southern mountain gate connects to the Dreaming Cavern, which leads into Jinzhou. With Mengzhou City Hall still silent, we need to assess whether crossing the gate to request reinforcements from Jinzhou is feasible.

Western Fang Peaks
Large-scale rogue Autopuppet presence confirmed. The status of the production lines inside the Skyworks is completely unknown. All Ministry of Development Artisans have been evacuated...

Conclusion: Extreme Threat 
Unclear whether the rogue Autopuppets will use the production lines to self-replicate. Requires immediate investigation.

Eastern Xuan Peaks
Minor rogue Autopuppet and Tacet Discord activity. Additionally, the composition of the Disorienting Fog around Fogveil Pagoda has changed. It now disrupts human senses and appears to be spreading outward... 

Conclusion: High Threat 
All personnel are strictly prohibited from approaching Fogveil Pagoda or its surrounding areas. We must organize the immediate evacuation of the neighboring Xianling Village to Xuanfang Hold. 

...
records.zh:
落渊南丘——少量异常机傀、残象出没，外事府人员均已撤回玄方城内，未发现有人员滞留……
结论：危险度中，南方山门与梦窟相连，穿越梦窟后便是今州地界，由于梦州边庭现仍未回应，需要评估穿越山门，向今州求援的可能性。

方擎西峰——大量异常机傀聚集，已完全无法掌握悬天构中机傀生产线的现状，现已安排所有天工匠人已撤回……
结论：危险度极高，未知异常机傀是否会通过生产线自行生产，需尽快查清。

玄幽东岳——少量异常机傀、残象出没，此外，雾隐阁及其周围地带的隐息雾成分发生变化，现会对人的感官造成干扰，并有向外扩散的迹象……
结论：危险度高，禁止任何人员靠近雾隐阁及周围地带，避免进入隐息雾散布区域。尽快组织人员协助衔翎村村民撤回玄方城。
……

records.text:
Fuling,
I'm off to Huaxu Academy for your medicine. You looked so peaceful asleep this morning, so I couldn't bear to wake you. Please have a good breakfast when you're up. You're still recovering and can't afford to skip meals.
Xuanfang Hold has so many pavilions, towers, and little courtyards to explore. When I get back, we'll go sketching together.
—Wuli
records.zh:
伏翎，我先到华胥院去取药了，早上看你睡得很熟，我就没叫你，起来后要记得好好吃早饭，你身子虚，营养一定不能落下。
这玄方城里四处都是亭台楼阁，还有许多别致的庭院，等我回来后，我陪你一起去写生。

——梧黎

records.text:
To the Revered Sentinel,

I am deeply moved and honored to have received your invitation and to be favored by your recognition.

As merchants, our calling is to gather the strength of the masses to build communities and unite the hearts of many to foster thriving markets. If we might follow in the footsteps of the wise and virtuous to help alleviate the burdens of the realm, it would be the utmost aspiration, and indeed, the greatest privilege, of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.

Please accept this humble reply. May you preserve your precious health. 

With highest regards,

Suisui
Zhaoming Commerce Guild
records.zh:
承蒙岁主垂青，赐帖相召，感慨万千。
从商之人，聚众力而成城，联万心而为市。若能附诸贤之骥尾，分天下忧患，此昭明之愿也，亦之幸也。
先此奉复，伏惟珍重。

昭明商会，穗穗敬上。

records.text:
...

The beacon fires of the Fortress and Gorges War at last burned low, and peace was restored across the realms.

Mingting issued a proclamation, calling upon the full might of Huanglong to raise a new fortified city south of the Central Plains and naming it Jinzhou. Thenceforth, the lands east of the Mountains of Spirits and south of the Norfall Barrens fell under Jinzhou's jurisdiction.

The first Magistrate of Jinzhou decreed that the city would bear no emblem of its own. Instead, it would share the insignia of Huanglong, in remembrance of the bond forged in aid with the one capital and five cities.

...
records.zh:
……
云渊之役烽烟渐息，宇内重归安宁。
明庭颁诏，命集瑝珑之力，于中曲台地以南另筑关城，定名今州城。此后，云陵山脉以东、北落野以南，皆为今州州域。
初任今令尹为感念一庭五州襄助，遂令今州不另设徽记，径与瑝珑同徽，以铭倾力相援、共守河山之谊。
……

records.text: The Riccioli Islands, a territory of Rinascita, uses Shell Credits as well. However, fishermen and sailors there have their own unique currency for sea trade.
records.zh: 黎乔利群岛仍然归属于黎那汐塔，也流通贝币，但渔民和水手们自有一套通行于海上的交易方法。

records.text: It's a tradition to trade using precious corals in the Riccioli Islands—though, not all corals are conveniently washed ashore by the waves.
records.zh: 用珍贵的珊瑚换点什么自然也是这里的传统，不过，不是所有珊瑚都是被海浪拍到岸边的。

records.text: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.
records.zh: 黎乔利群岛特产的滨海亚麻，非常常见的粗加工材料。

records.text: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.
records.zh: 黎乔利群岛特产的棕榈原木，非常常见的粗加工材料。

records.text: Maintenance log for Court of Savantae's No. I suppressor, documenting the research findings of the SR-461 team from the Court of Savantae during their time in Whining Aix's Mire.
records.zh: 稷廷一号抑制装置点的检维日志，记录了稷廷461号小组组员在怨鸟泽期间的研究内容。

records.text: Maintenance log for Court of Savantae's No. II suppressor, documenting the research findings of the SR-461 team from the Court of Savantae during their time in Whining Aix's Mire.
records.zh: 稷廷二号抑制装置点的检维日志，记录了稷廷461号小组组员在怨鸟泽期间的研究内容。

records.text: Metal Debris discovered in the Riccioli Islands. Despite erosion from the sea, it is still suitable as a roughing material.
records.zh: 黎乔利群岛找到的金属块，虽然已经被海水锈蚀，但仍然可以当做粗加工材料。

records.text: A scripture fragment found on the seabed of the Riccioli Islands, documenting what is unrecorded in the Codex of the Order of the Deep. Those fragmentary words seem to respond to the very call of the ocean.
records.zh: 在黎乔利群岛海底发现的断章，记录着隐海修会正典中全无记载的经文。只言片语的残片，仿佛响应着大海的呼唤。

records.text: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.
records.zh: 伤痕的手中带有黑羊标记的卡牌，其上附着的烈焰仿佛永远不会熄灭。而那股烈焰将与伤痕永不止息的破坏欲望一道永远燃烧。

records.text:
A plant native to Whining Aix's Mire. It symbolizes broken or concealed affection.
Affected by the continuous thundercloud weather of this place, this variant has a significantly shortened flowering period compared to its original species. A true pity, indeed.
records.zh:
怨鸟泽的原生植物，其花语是破碎而隐晦的爱。
受当地持续的雷云气象影响，此种鸢尾花相比原种花期大大缩短，更是令人唏嘘不已。

records.text:
A fluorescent berry growing in caves.
Before miners get down the mine in the Tiger's Maw, their family will tuck a lanternberry into their pocket, hoping its glow will lead them safely home in the midst of darkness.
records.zh:
灯笼果于岩洞中生长，结出的果实能在黑暗中散发荧光。
虎口山脉的矿工下矿前，家属会在他们衣袋里装上一枚灯笼果，以盼灯笼果帮他们照亮回家的路。

records.text:
Once the symbol of the Port City of Guixu, it nearly went extinct when Incinero Petals were rampant.
However, at the outskirts of the city ruins, Belle Poppy was found to bloom still at its home, having endured the disaster.
records.zh:
妙弋花曾是归墟港市的象征，在焚焰花肆虐时近乎绝迹。
但在城市废墟的外缘，人们发现仍有妙弋花顽强地绽放于故乡。

records.text:
A special fungus associated with ancient trees. Its medicinal and curative properties have been recorded in numerous medical classics of Jinzhou.
An ancient specimen is preserved in the Academy, a living relic tracing back to the era when the towering Central Banyan in the Dim Forest was not so majestic.
records.zh:
与古木伴生的特殊菌类，在今州的各种医典中都有记载其药性和疗效。
华胥研究院里保存着一株云芝标本，其历史获悉可以追溯到无光之森的中央巨榕还未长成的时候。

records.text:
A flower blooming on the high shores.
Legend has it that the Wintry Bell does not really wither. When the ancient bells born by the giant Turtoise in Gorges of Spirits resonate, they will rise again from the ice and snow.
records.zh:
盛开在高岸的清冷之花。
传说中，傲寒钟不会真正地枯萎。当云陵谷巨鼍驮负的古钟轰鸣之时，它们便会从冰天雪地中复苏。

records.text: A translucent specialty mineral found in the Tiger's Maw Mine. Both the crystal produce and raw status of this mineral has a translucent azure shine. As a material, it has excellent toughness and stability.
records.zh: 半透明的特色矿物，大多分布于虎口山脉的矿洞中。该种矿物的产出晶体和野外形态均为不纯粹的蓝色。作为矿石，其硬度与稳定性上佳。

records.text:
A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.
The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.
records.zh:
长期浸淬于氤柔水境中的矿物，矿体呈现为变幻莫测的珠光釉质，是传导回音能量的天然介质。
关于云母釉岩的形成原因，学界尚未达成共识：一说云海能量经年累月的冲刷，改变了矿物内质的排列结构，使其发生了质地变化；另一说为云海渗入地质的裂隙后，经板块的挤压后形成。

records.text:
A rare flower found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to glow like moonlight in the dark.
"O warriors, should shadow steal the moon, look down, and the Sliverglow Bloom still shines beneath your feet."
records.zh:
只在狩原生长的奇特花种，夜晚会散发出酷似月华的光亮。
“战士啊，如果阴霾将月光阻隔，不妨低头见月吧。”

records.text:
A rare bloom found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to thrive where warriors have shed their blood.
When Gladiators die a glorious death in Septimont's wild hunts, their companions often place a Luminous Calendula at their graves as a solemn tribute to their courage and sacrifice.
records.zh:
只在狩原生长的奇特花种，传说只在勇士用热血浇灌的大地上盛开。
来到七丘狩猎的角斗士们，若英勇战死，则会由同伴摘一朵辉光金盏放在墓前以寄哀思。

records.text: A far‑from‑home species that, when mature, bears bell‑shaped crimson fruits. In Ashinohara, these fruits are often consecrated to the divine. Should a soft chime ring out during prayer, know that the divine has heard your plea.
records.zh: 背井离乡的种子，成熟时会结出赤红色，如铃铛一般的果实。苇原人习惯用这些果实作为祭品进献神明，如果祈愿时铃铛轻响，说明神明听到了你的呼唤。

records.text: Originally a common tree of Mengzhou, it was corrupted by the Evil Miasma's Miasmic Thunder and reduced to a charred, blackened stump, upon which red lightning can still be seen pulsing along its surface. Though the Huaxu Academy and the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs have confirmed it poses no immediate danger, its contamination by the Evil Miasma has made it a scar upon the land, and few dare approach. Whether it is the remains of the Evil Miasma or the breeding ground of a new calamity has yet to be determined.
records.zh: 原为梦州常见树木，受「恶瘴」瘴雷侵染后，化作焦黑的瘴痕残株，能窥见红色闪电在树木上跃动。虽经华胥研究院与谛天鉴研究，确认其暂无危害，却因沾染「恶瘴」而被视作大地疮痕，鲜有人靠近。至于它究竟是「恶瘴」遗骸，还是新灾厄的温床，至今仍未有定论。

records.text: The special supply chest obtained from Shilang in the Tiger's Maw.
records.zh: 从虎口山脉的石琅处获得的特殊补给箱。

records.text: Bio samples collected by the Black Shores' Bloombearers during their fieldwork, which were later transplanted, preserved, and archived in the Bank of Life at Tethys' Deep. When necessary, specimens stored within may be used as supplies and freely accessed by personnel in need.
records.zh: 黑海岸的各个执花外出调查采样时获得的生态样本，交由泰缇斯之底的金枝地进行移栽、封箱与收容。必要时，材料舱内的收容物可作为补给，供人员自由调用。

records.text: These resources come from all over Solaris-3, delivered on time by Lollo Logistics for customers. When traveling in dangerous areas, mutual support is indispensable for safe travel.
records.zh: 这些资源来自索拉里斯的各地，由呜呜物流为客户准时送达。 在危险地区游历时，他人的支援是必不可少的助力。

records.text: Out of hatred for humans, the Hoochiefs in the Dim Forest will use tree cages to imprison passers-by. They use the hides of other creatures in the forest to crudely imitate humans and draw maps to remind the locations of the tree cages.
records.zh: 无光之森的捣蛋猿出于对人类的仇恨，会使用树笼禁闭路人。它们使用森林中其他生物的兽皮，比较粗糙地学着人类的样子画出地图提醒树笼的位置。

records.text: A special-shaped key that can open the secret passage in the Dim Forest. It belongs to the zookeeper before the Lament.
records.zh: 能够开启无光之森秘密通道的特殊形状的钥匙，是悲鸣前动物园管理人员的所有物。

records.text: A data card obtained from the Dim Forest camp, old and rusty. Perhaps, it can be used to open the nearby iron cage.
records.zh: 从无光之森营地中获得的数据卡，样式陈旧，有些许锈蚀。也许能打开附近的铁笼。

records.text:
According to legend, the Thorncrown Rises, located in Thessaleo Fells, holds the lost glory of the Fisalia family. 
Through the painter's delicate brushstrokes, one can sense her upset and confusion.
records.zh:
传说中，伫立于狄萨莱海脊的三重冠塔埋藏着翡萨烈家族最初的荣誉。
能从作画者细腻的笔触里感受到不安和迷惑。

records.text: A photograph with blood stained on its back. Marks are made on the photo, indicating somewhere in the Whining Aix's Mire. Treasures might be found there.
records.zh: 一张背面沾满了血迹的实拍照片，照片上面做了标记，似乎是在怨鸟泽地区的某个地方，或许在那里能够找到些什么宝藏。

records.text: A photograph with scratches spread on its back. Marks are made on the photo, indicating somewhere in the Tiger's Maw. Treasures might be found there.
records.zh: 一张背面布满划痕的实拍照片，照片上面做了标记，似乎是在虎口山脉地区的某个地方，或许在那里能够找到些什么宝藏。

records.text: A photograph as good as brand new, with marks on it pointing to somewhere in the Dim Forest. Perhaps it's a map to treasures.
records.zh: 一张光洁如新的实拍照片，照片上面做了标记，似乎是在无光之森地区的某个地方，或许在那里能够找到些什么宝藏。

records.text: picture with Camellya looking at the moon at location B
records.zh: 存在异常，如有疑问请联系官方客服

records.text: photo with Camellya at location C looking at the sea
records.zh: 存在异常，如有疑问请联系官方客服

records.text: You and Jiyan are preparing for the race, and the careful photographer has captured an interesting scene.
records.zh: 你与忌炎正在进行赛前准备，细心的摄影师捕捉到了有趣的画面。

records.text: Developed by Huaxu Academy, this chip can release vortex flow and facilitate researches surrounding the Whining Aix's Mire.
records.zh: 该芯片由华胥研究院研发，装载后可协助使用者处理龙卷形的沼泽漩涡，在怨鸟泽沼泽水域附近探索。

records.text:
A play written by the mysterious playwright Cristoforo, telling the story of Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden of the Order of the Deep.
The script, however, is unfinished, leaving the story hanging just before the Maiden's martyrdom.
records.zh:
由神秘剧作家克里斯托弗所撰写的剧本。剧中讲述了隐海修会的旧日圣女“芙露德莉斯”的相关事迹。
目前还处于未完成的阶段，故事只进行到圣女殉道前的一幕便戛然而止。
可阅读。

records.text:
A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
You can zoom in to view the photo.
records.zh:
一张由斐林拍摄的照片，记录了你与伙伴们一同谢幕时的情景。
可放大查看。

records.text: A chip found in the Dim Forest. Seems to be the survey record of a botanist.
records.zh: 在无光之森发现的芯片，似乎是某位植物学家的考察记录。

records.text: A data chip picked up in the Port City of Guixu. Seems to be a battlefield record of a warrior.
records.zh: 在归墟港市拾取的数据芯片，似乎是某位战士的战地记录。

records.text: An item which Xuanqing refers to as the "Feeling Capsule," seemingly affiliated with Hsin the Moon Fox. Its frequency is linked with a certain location within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. When placed in the Inner Threshold, one can view the memories stored within.
records.zh: 被璇情称为「情匣」的物件，似乎与心月狐有关。频率与梦枢天罗中的某处相互连通，放入心钥井后，可以查看储存其中的记忆。

records.text: In handing it to you, Suoming seems to carry a deeper meaning.
records.zh: 将它交给你的锁暝，似乎别有用意。

records.text: Incomplete sheet music, part of the core melody regulating the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
records.zh: 一段不完整的乐谱,是控制隐海试验场正常运转的核心乐曲的一部分。

records.text: A manuscript from the Golden Anthem Poets Society preserving their poems and musical compositions, transcribed by Cristoforo.
records.zh: 「黄金之歌」诗社遗作的一份手抄稿，由克里斯托弗手抄，上面记录着诗篇与乐谱的内容。

records.text: "The culture and spirit of Jinzhou all included in this book, begins with the battle in the Gorges of Spirits."
records.zh: “以云陵为序，以今州为始，今州人文、瑝珑风骨，皆在此书中。”

records.text: Torn pages found in Averardo Vault. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于埃弗拉德金库拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in Egla Town. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于埃格拉小镇拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in Penitent's End. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于悲叹墓岛拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in Thessaleo Fells. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于狄萨莱海脊拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in the Hallowed Reach. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于赞悼圣迹拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in the Fagaceae Peninsula. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于槲生半岛拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in Ragunna City. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于拉古那城拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in Nimbus Sanctum. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于氤柔水境拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: Torn pages found in Avinoleum. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
records.zh: 于阿维纽林拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

records.text: A dish of tender tofu served in chili sauce. The appetizing spiciness of it makes Chili Sauce Tofu a widely popular dish even among the nobles of the New Federation.
records.zh: 盖有满满一层红油的水豆腐，色泽赤红、鲜香可口。油辣豆腐流传甚广，连新联邦的贵族们都对其赞不绝口。

records.text: Pasta made with Mastic Nuvola, known for its strong, inviting fragrance. It is said that the fragrance attracts the singing wraiths from the Nimbus Sanctum. People often venture out at dawn to gather fresh Mastic Nuvola, hoping to catch the melody it holds within.
records.zh: 加入云凝乳香的烩面，香气扑鼻。据说云凝乳香散发的香气能够吸引树海中全心歌唱的妖精，人们踩着晨曦去采集未坠入云海中的云凝乳香，是为了听凝固在其中的自然的乐音。

records.text: Calcharo has a fondness for Huanglong's Food Ration Bar. He believes it efficiently satisfies basic energy needs in the wild and has a unique taste. To cater to some of the younger merc's preferences, Calcharo has enhanced the bar by adding dried fruits, sugar beans, and various seasonings, creating a variety of flavors.
records.zh:
卡卡罗一直对瑝珑的戍边粮情有独钟，认为其已经能够满足野外的基本果腹需求，口感也别具特色。
但为了照顾到一些佣兵团内小朋友的口味，卡卡罗在此基础上又进行了改良，在其中添加了果干，糖豆等调剂，设计了多种口味。

records.text: The Sanqing tea from Yuanwu Boxing Gym has healing properties, aiding the spleen, lungs, and alleviating worries. A cup after a boxing session boosts blood flow and circulation while soothing the mind. The perfect combination of exercise and tea brings a sense of inner peace, momentarily freeing one from mundane concerns and desires.
records.zh:
渊武拳馆特供的三清茶，清脾，清肺，清烦恼。
练完拳后来上一杯，可以活血化瘀，修生养气。
一套拳，一杯茶，一股由内而外的放松感笼罩全身，得以让人暂时忘却那些世俗的算计与追赶。

records.text:
Long, silky noodles absorb the rich, spicy broth. Chopped scallions adorn generous slices of meat. One bite can make you sweat, even in winter's chill.
In the remote, rustic village of Yuezhou, this dish is Lumi's fondest memory of home. 
Despite her travels after joining Lollo Logistics, tasting a variety of cuisines, Lumi still believes that the steaming bowl of noodles from her hometown is the true definition of happiness.
records.zh:
柔滑细长的圆粉，在浓郁的辣汤中浸足了味道。葱花点缀着厚实的肉片，一口下去，冬日也能让人大汗淋漓。
在越州那个与世隔绝的淳朴村落中，辣肉粉是灯灯对于家乡味道最深厚的记忆。
即便如今在呜呜物流工作的旅途中远离家乡，吃遍了各色美味，但灯灯仍旧觉得家里灶台上的那热腾腾的一碗，就是幸福的代名词。

records.text: Stir fry the shredded fish with seasoning, place it on top of the simmered thick broth, and then pour hot oil over the dish, creating a sizzling sound that brings out sweet and savory flavors. This rich soup is by far Buling's favorite hometown dish.
records.zh: 煸炒的底料与鱼丝，放在调味焖煮至汤汁浓稠的高汤面上，热油浇下去"滋啦"一声后的香气与咸鲜微甜的美味，是卜灵心中永远排名第一的家乡美食。

records.text: Gently simmer the rice over low heat, adding a few delicate flower petals for flavor. As it begins to lightly boil, this simple yet sweet dish becomes a favorite snack for Taoqi when relaxing at home. With each slow sip, it seems to wash away the accumulated fatigue of the day, leaving a refreshing feeling in its wake.
records.zh:
温火小煮粳米，加入少许花瓣，等待小沸即可。
因烹饪简单而味道香甜，成了桃祈宅家时钟爱的清新小食。
缓缓喝上一口，似乎能驱散不少积累已久的倦意。

records.text: Maintaining a healthy body is crucial. The combination of gold and silver lotus seeds in this recipe provides warmth, nourishment, and a calming effect on both the body and mind. It was the first medicinal meal Jianxin learned during her mountain retreat and remains one of her go-to recipes for overall health and well-being.
records.zh: 固本强身，养生为本。并蒂金银与莲子两种食材搭配在一起，有益气温补、安神醒目之效。这是鉴心在山上修行时最早学会的食补方子，也是她最常做的药膳之一。

records.text:
When Qiuyuan and his comrades were still in service, their missions often required them to travel fast and eat light, with little chance to enjoy a good meal. Even when they lodged at village inns, they still had to cook their own food out of an abundance of caution. Originally from Chongzhou, Qiuyuan had learned a few basic recipes at a young age. One of his dishes was fragrant, spicy, and mouthwatering, perfect for an empty stomach when paired with rice. Simple, yet satisfying. 
"Eat well, live well."
records.zh:
过去当差时，仇远和他的弟兄们日夜兼程，风餐露宿，没什么机会吃顿好饭，即便是到了外地的馆子住下，也要因为防备而亲自下厨做饭。而出身于重州的仇远早年间也恰恰懂得几个小菜，鲜香麻辣，最是解馋下饭，讲究的就是畅快。
“好好吃饭，好好活着。”

records.text:
Changli's favorite dish, which is made with extra chili.
The vibrant redness hints at its intense flavor, which seems to leap out of the bowl. Served alongside rice and a cup of osmanthus syrup, amidst the bustling ambiance of Capital Mingting, it provides a heavenly culinary experience.
While few in Mingting, apart from Changli, venture to taste this delicacy, it's a cherished household favorite among families in Hongzhen. Accompanied by wine, it adds an extra layer of warmth to the dining experience.
records.zh:
长离喜爱的菜肴，比寻常做法加了更多辣椒。
赤红的色泽令辣度肉眼可见，灼辣与鲜香仿佛要化作实体从碗中振翅而出，配一碗米饭与一盅桂花酿，佐以瑝都明庭的长街盛景，酣畅淋漓，实乃人间绝妙。
在明庭时，这道佳肴除了长离外鲜少有食客尝试，而在虹镇，这是家家户户都会的家常菜，亲朋满座一堂，觥筹交错间，这道菜便也有了另一番温暖滋味。

records.text:
Snacks kept by Youhu in her ice cauldron, always cool to the touch. 
It’s difficult for Youhu to find food and accommodations while she travels around Solaris hunting for antiquities. These tasty cakes are what keep her from starving at times like these.
Youhu likes to put fruits in the cauldron too. As a result, the moist crusts of the cakes always gives off the faint fragrance of the seasonal fruits.
records.zh:
釉瑚存放在匣中冰鼎的零嘴，无论何时拿出都带着丝丝凉意。
追寻古物在索拉里斯各地旅行时，时常会有找不到食宿的时刻，小饼就成了她果腹的绝顶美味。
因为釉瑚喜爱往冰鼎中同时镇些水果，饼皮带着湿润的气息，隐隐有股果香，四时不同。

records.text:
Red bean pudding that can be easily made at home, a simple homemade dessert. After Hiyuki tweaked the recipe, it now comes in a more convenient package.
Hiyuki doesn't have much of a sweet tooth, but once she became the miko, she quietly visited a dessert shop to learn how to make red bean puddings. 
The children of Ashinohara came to call it the "good luck pudding." However the story grew, the sweetness itself stayed simple. Almost plain.
Just as she hoped.
records.zh:
在家中也可以轻松制作的红豆布丁，最朴素的家常甜点之一。经由绯雪的改良，变为更方便携带的袋装形制。
绯雪对甜食并无过分的偏好，但在她接任巫女职位后，悄悄去一家甜品店请教了红豆布丁的做法。
即便在苇原的孩子间被传成“能够带来福气”的布丁，但不论外界如何流传，它都只有一份朴素到有些寡淡的甜。
就像她所期盼的那样。

records.text:
When Suoming first arrived at Xuanfang Hold, she came across a dish flavored with tea broth called "Memories of Autumn," which awakened memories of the white tea from home. It was Tangning who later told her that this dish originally used no tea at all, but due to the lack of its true ingredients locally, it was a traveling soul yearning for the taste who used tea as a substitute, thus giving it its present form.
Suoming then procured Huating white tea and personally remade the dish. The tea's fresh aroma gave it a delicate flavor, and from then on it frequently graced her table. Those under her command secretly lamented that her homesickness was difficult to dispel, which accounted for her singular fondness for the flavor. Yet to her, it was merely a preference for that fresh and clear taste, and perhaps, without intention, this dish had also retained within it the flavor of her homeland.
records.zh:
锁暝初到玄方城时，偶然尝到一道名为「客途秋忆」以茶汤入味的菜肴，这令她忆起故乡白茶。又从棠宁那得知，此菜本非以茶入馔，只是此地寻不到原本的食材，但思念这口味道的游子借茶寄思，方有今日模样。
锁暝听后取来华亭白茶，亲手改制此菜。茶香清鲜，滋味淡雅，自此便常见于她案前。属下见状，暗中哀叹她乡思难遣，才独钟此味。然而，于她而言，不过是偏爱那一口清鲜，只是无意间，这道菜似乎也将故乡的滋味一并留在其中。

records.text: A recipe that details how to make Huanglong Omelette.
records.zh: 详尽记录着蛋饼制作方法的食谱。

records.text: A recipe that details how to make Steak Margherita.
records.zh: 详尽记录着玛格烈特牛排制作方法的食谱。

records.text: Following the direction of the pointer, you travel on the land of Solaris-3, these journeys will never be forgotten.
records.zh: 沿着指针的方向，你游历在索拉里斯的大地上，这些历程永远不会被遗忘。

records.text: Huanglong Agriculture Bank... Oh, what a fascinating answer...
records.zh: 瑝珑农业银行……噢，多么奇特的回答……

records.text: Yes, the Echoes here in this section of the depository! They've all got that spooky look on their faces. What are they even for anyway? They're nothing like the ones in Ragunna City.
records.zh: 就是这片藏区里的声骸啊！一个个都长得阴森森的，也不知道有什么用，和拉古那城里的那些完全不一样。

records.text: Welcome to Averardo Vault. Is there something I can help you with?
records.zh: 欢迎光临埃弗拉德金库，请问您需要办理什么业务？

records.text: Alright. Thank you for choosing Averardo Vault's Echo storage services.
records.zh: 好的。感谢您选择埃弗拉德金库的声骸存储服务。

records.text: The underground is divided into three main areas: The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository, the Echo Depository, and the Talent Depository. Whether you're storing valuables or showcasing creativity, Averardo Vault is here to help you make the most of them with unmatched service.
records.zh: 下层共设有三个主要分区：贵金属与艺术品藏区、声骸藏区与人才藏区。无论资产还是才能，埃弗拉德金库都将最大程度为您保存它们的价值。

records.text: Under the same gentle moonlight as nights past, you share the tale of your journey with Jinhsi.
records.zh: 你在和过去别无二致的月色下，与今汐谈起一路的旅程。

records.text: Of course. I left Jinzhou in such a rush last time that we didn't have the time to catch up. Jinhsi... how have you been lately?
records.zh: 当然可以。说起来，上次回今州走得太急，还没来得及问……今汐，你最近还好吗？

records.text: Since waking up, Master Changli and the Sentinel have been guiding me in my daily duties.
records.zh: 在我苏醒后的日常事务，长离老师和岁主也对我多有点拨。

records.text: But it worked out perfectly, didn't it? Though you really need to keep yourself safe, Jinhsi.
records.zh: 但挺有效的，不是吗？就是别再把自己弄伤了，今汐。

records.text: Yangyang told me about your journey after leaving Jinzhou, and how you always managed to turn the tide. But I know so few of the details...
records.zh: 离开今州后你的去向，虽然我曾听秧秧谈起，知道你总能转危为安，具体经历却并不清楚。

records.text: You sound like you actually enjoyed it, Jingran.
records.zh: 你看起来倒是乐在其中啊，景燃。

records.text: Leaning in next to Jingran, you lose yourself in the wild tale of his recent plunge into the Mirage Realms.
records.zh: 你和景燃站在一起，开始听他讲起最近入蜃境时的诸多奇闻异事。

records.text: You've faced your fair share of high-stakes adventures, but none of them carry quite the same eerie, twisted horror that leaks from Jingran's storytelling.
records.zh: 虽然你也经历过许多奇妙的冒险，但那毕竟都是在光下，与这些鬼气森森的阴凉故事还是不太一样。

records.text: Once we're done here, let's first head back to Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 等找到了，我们就先回浮光林一趟。

records.text: Once we're done here, let's first head back to Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 如果找到了，我们就先回浮光林一趟。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_无人分享的星空_9_1
records.text: I heard from the crew at the Starward Riseway that the blizzards and Void Storms out in the frostlands have been terrible lately...
records.zh: 我听联运椎骨那里的人说，最近冰原上的暴风雪一直很大……还有磁暴……

records.text: That's a dish from my home. Back when I was visiting the Jinzhou Campus of Huaxu Academy, I had some with Principal Investigator Xiangli Yao!
records.zh: 这是我老家的美食，当初我在今州华胥研究院参观的时候，和那位首席研究员相里要一起吃过呢！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_11_1
records.text: Jingran takes the object from your hand, studies it carefully, frowns.
records.zh: 景燃把你手里的东西接了过去，仔细查看了一番，皱了皱眉。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_13_1
records.text: Jingran hands you a piece of metalwork. It looks just like the one you found earlier by Jiang Laowu's place, as if…
records.zh: 景燃递给你一块金属制的东西。这东西和你之前在姜老五那里找到的很像，似乎……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_13_1
records.text: Jingran's eyelids flutter. It takes him a few tries to force them open.
records.zh: 景燃的眼皮微微颤抖，他睁了好几次，才勉强睁开眼睛。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_15_1
records.text: Strange... Jingran's Forte is gone from the camera...
records.zh: 奇怪……相机里景燃的共鸣力消失了……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_16_1
records.text: Then to keep him from dragging you down, help us out. Let's get Jingran to a doctor together.
records.zh: 那为了让他别连累你，你也帮个忙，我们一起把景燃送到医师那里去吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_17_1
records.text: You get Jingran to Huaxu Academy. The doctor wheels him off for checks. Smokey's hiding in the lamp, and you get the feeling it's not happy.
records.zh: 你将景燃送到了华胥研究院后，医师将他送去做检查。小灰躲在灯里，你感觉它好像不太高兴。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_19_1
records.text: Come to think of it, Jingran calls you something different every time. What's your real name?
records.zh: 说起来，景燃每次喊你的名字都不一样，你的本名是什么？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_21_1
records.text: That thing just now... Is that what will cure Jingran?
records.zh: 刚才那东西，就是用来救治景燃的？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_23_1
records.text: When you two return to the sleeping Jingran, the lynx spirit slips into the Life Lamp. The pale blue flame flickers, beat by beat, then burns bright.
records.zh: 回到睡着的景燃身边后，山猫妖钻入那盏命灯之中，幽蓝的火一下一下地闪烁，而后变得明亮起来。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_23_1
records.text: Jingran slots the coin into the compass disc. The pointer starts to turn slowly, until it settles on a direction.
records.zh: 景燃把那枚铜钱嵌在了指针圆盘上，指针开始晃晃悠悠地转了起来，指向了某处。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_23_1
records.text: After the room flickers between dim and bright a few times, Jingran wakes up.
records.zh: 满室昏暗与明亮的交替后，景燃醒了过来。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_33_1
records.text: Jingran pockets the dagger. He chooses not to use it.
records.zh: 景燃把那柄匕首收起来，并没有用它。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_5_1
records.text: Pale blue flame flickers to life. You watch Jingran's fingers brush lightly across the camera's casing.
records.zh: 幽蓝的火焰燃烧着，你看到景燃的手在相机的外壳上轻轻一抹。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_8_1
records.text: (Now that Jingran's got the merchant distracted, I should go check it out.)
records.zh: （趁着景燃吸引了那个商人的注意力，去看看吧。）

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族女补充生态_1_1
records.text: Agreed. Only after visiting Riccioli Islands can one truly feel the world's vibrancy.
records.zh: 同意。只有去过了黎乔利，才算是感受过世界的鲜活。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族女补充生态_1_1
records.text: Then there's Lilyland Fashion Week, and the heart-pounding battles of Septimont...
records.zh: 还有莉莉兰德的时装周，还有七丘角斗的热血沸腾……

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_13
records.text: The well was once blessed by the Sentinel. Back when Ragunna City was founded, people used to get their fresh water from it. There are also legends that say the well is bottomless, which connects to the depths of the ocean...
records.zh: 圣井曾得岁主赐福，在拉古那城刚建立之时，人们通过它得以饮用淡水。还有传说说，圣井深不见底，其根源直通大海渊底……

records.text: Yeah! Sometimes when I'm riding through the Nimbus Sanctum, I can hear this beautiful song coming from the water.
records.zh: 也许吧……穿过云海时，那些歌声便随着氤氲的云雾不断蔓延，好像云雾才是声音传递的介质。

records.text: But here's the thing: after the train leaves the Nimbus Sanctum, the song will just disappear, leaving only static noise in the recorder.
records.zh: 只是不知为何，列车驶离云海之后，录音设备中的歌声总会神秘地“蒸发”，只留下了嘈杂的底噪。

records.text: I've been wondering lately... could it be that the Lorelei in Nimbus Sanctum doesn't want that song to be shared with more people?
records.zh: 难道是歌声的主人……并不希望自己的歌声被带走吗？

records.text: You've probably seen those Echo trains gliding through the Nimbus Sanctum, right? They're responsible for delivering treasures for the Montelli family's bank and vault.
records.zh: 你一定看到过在云海中穿梭的那些声骸列车吧，它们往来于银行和金库，负责运送藏品。

records.text: Not exactly! I just pray that I get to record the song when we are in Nimbus Sanctum during this trip.
records.zh: 哀伤、怅然若失、难以形容……好像被情绪的洪流裹挟，找不到出口……

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_14
records.text: I want to remind you that recent Tacet Discord activities outside Ragunna City have increased. If you plan to venture into the wild to collect Echoes, please be careful.
records.zh: 我想提醒您，最近拉古那城外的残象活动变得活跃了，您如果要前往野外收集声骸，务必小心。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_14
records.text: The function of the Servitude Hall is to regularly purge the Tacet Discords around Ragunna City, maintain the surrounding safety, and expand the frequency reserves within the Genesis Nexus Data Bank.
records.zh: 驱役所的职能，便是定期对拉古那城周边的残象进行清剿，维护周边安全，扩充起源信标数据坞内的频率储备。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_15
records.text: Recently, the Tacet Discord activity outside Ragunna City has become more active. If you plan to venture into the wild to collect Echoes, please be careful.
records.zh: 最近拉古那城外的残象活动变得活跃了，您如果要前往野外收集声骸，务必小心。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_16
records.text: If you're planning to travel to Nimbus Sanctum soon, it's safer to set sail during the day.
