records.zh: 对了，如果您最近要前往氤柔水境，还是尽量选择白日出航，相对安全一些。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_16
records.text: Scholars want more frequency samples for analysis. And with the sea of clouds... things have been unsteady, so the Servitude Hall has extended "operations" to Nimbus Sanctum.
records.zh: 学者们希望有更多的频率样本可供解析。再加上云海那边……有些不太平静，驱役所的“业务”便扩展到了氤柔水境。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_16
records.text: While undertaking tasks in Nimbus Sanctum, we often have to ascend and descend through the cloud tunnels of the sea of clouds. That sense of weightlessness is not a pleasant experience.
records.zh: 嗯……在氤柔水境执行任务时，我们经常要在云海的云洞中直上直下，那种失重感，可不是什么好的体验。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_18
records.text: Fae Ignis... it's supposed to only appear around Penitent's End, yet lately, sightings report them gathering at the Hallowed Reach.
records.zh: 幽翎火……本该是只在悲叹墓岛区域活动的残象，最近却有人目睹他们，成规模地出现在了赞悼圣迹。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_18
records.text: Perhaps... something secretive is happening in Penitent's End... I worry that this anomaly might impact all Common Echoes, even threatening the safety of the people.
records.zh: 或许，在悲叹墓岛上，有些隐秘的事情正在发生……我在担心，这种异常，可能会影响到所有的公共声骸，甚至影响到民众的安危。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_20
records.text: At his strong insistence, the Servitude Hall reported the matter to the higher-ups of the Order and proposed organizing a field investigation of the Penitent's End.
records.zh: 在他的强烈要求下，驱役所将此事上报给了修会高层，并提出组织一次对悲叹墓岛的实地勘察。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_20
records.text: Who knows, Tulio went alone to Penitent's End one night... and never returned...
records.zh: 谁知道，图里奥竟然在一个夜晚，一个人，独自前去了悲叹墓岛……再也没有回来……

records.text: But after the Dark Tide twenty years ago, Fenrico became the Primus, and established the Order Penitentiary for investigating heresy. The Order Tribunal's influence has been gradually diluted...
records.zh: 但二十年前的黑潮过后，芬莱克主座继位，又增设了忏悔院这一用以侦察和审判异端的机构。赦免院的权力也逐渐被削弱……

records.text: Primus Fenrico established the Order Penitentiary as a response to the societal instabilities at the time.
records.zh: 芬莱克主座增设忏悔院，也是出于当时维稳的需要。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_2
records.text: Go ahead, eat up. Let's see if you can grow into even more vibrant colors.
records.zh: 吃吧，吃吧。让我看看你能否绽放出更诡丽的颜色。

records.text: The people of Ragunna City live alongside the water, resting upon it as they sleep, yet often needing to confront the threat of the tides.
records.zh: 拉古那城的人们与水同居，枕水而眠，又时常需要面对海潮的威胁。

records.text: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.
records.zh: 我的任务还没结束。我会在黎那汐塔境内，继续调查有关岁主的史实。如果有新的情报，我会联络你的。

records.text: Mr. Aalto was right. Bloom Bearers attract other Bloom Bearers!
records.zh: 秋水师父说得没错。执花与执花之间，果然是会相互吸引的！

records.text: People in high positions care the most about saving faces. Show them attitudes, you only get a taste of your own medicine.
records.zh: 位高权重之人最是看重面子。你不给他好脸色，他也不会给你好果子吃。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_2
records.text: Alice, when will Phoebe bring the Echoes back here?
records.zh: 阿莉切姐姐，菲比姐姐什么时候才能带着声骸回到这里？

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_2
records.text: Yeah! Every time Phoebe comes here, she tells us new stories.
records.zh: 是啊！菲比姐姐每次来这里都会给我们讲新的故事。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_2
records.text: Our elders always say the other side is dangerous, full of bad people. But the new stories Phoebe brings back are always exciting!
records.zh: 长辈们总说对岸很危险，那里全是坏人。可是，菲比姐姐从外面带来的新故事总是很有趣。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_7
records.text: Ever since the current Primus, Fenrico, took over the Order, many plays have been banned. All performances must be approved, or else you risk being arrested.
records.zh: 自从那位蓝衣「芬莱克」入主修会，不少剧目都被列为了禁忌。所有演出都要经过修会的批准，否则就可能引来抓捕。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_1
records.text: You're exactly the kind of person destined to make a mark in the vibrant Montelli Quarter.
records.zh: 要在这繁华无两的莫塔里区博得一席之地，非得是您这样的人不可。

records.text: If this keeps up, Averardo Vault will turn into an Averardo General Store.
records.zh: 哎，再这么下去，埃弗拉德金库就要成埃弗拉德杂货铺了。

records.text: The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament, from New Federation—what kind of art is just a rusty tin can?
records.zh: 《悲鸣前的最后一罐空气》，新联邦——哪儿有艺术作品是一个生锈的铁皮罐子啊！

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_10
records.text: I'm headed to Whisperwind Haven to help the Order distribute supplies to poor villagers, which is why this one is with me.
records.zh: 我正要去拂风水畔帮助修会的兄弟向贫苦的村民们分发物资，也因此它便跟在我身边。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_10
records.text: They also bear Imperator's blessings, as indicated by the halo above their heads, which is a mark of the Order.
records.zh: 它们也一并蒙受着英白拉多的祝福，那头顶的光环，就是修会的明证。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_5
records.text: ...I see. Thank you for your contribution to the Order, Mr. Fulmine.
records.zh: ……可以。感谢您为修会的贡献，斐林先生。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_5
records.text: This is Fulmine from the Pioneer Association. You may have heard of me.
records.zh: 我是先行公约的斐林，您应该听说过我。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_7
records.text: The avant-gardes of the New Federation haven't turned out anything exciting recently. I've a hunch we're not getting our money back.
records.zh: 新联邦的源流先锋派最近没什么动向啊，总觉得投资不一定收得回本。

records.text: Whoa! Welcome! Welcome! Ragunna has an endless array of culinary delights! We have Margherita Steak, Nectarwine, Pizza Classica, and Nuvola Pasta...
records.zh: 哦！欢迎！欢迎！拉古那的美食数不胜数！玛格烈特牛排、蜜露果酒、传统窑炉披萨、云凝肉酱烩面……

records.text: Go ahead and dig in! If you can make it to the Riccioli Islands, you'll be in for a real treat.
records.zh: 吃吧，吃吧，你们要是真去黎乔利群岛，可是享福了。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_3
records.text: Have you heard? Averardo Vault has suddenly tightened its security.
records.zh: 听说了吗？最近埃弗拉德金库突然戒严了。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_3
records.text: Precious Echo? What Echo is precious enough to be in Averardo Vault?
records.zh: 什么声骸这么珍重？还要收藏进埃弗拉德？

records.text: And I was wondering why Ragunna City reeks of money and snobs these days.
records.zh: 那就不奇怪了，我还在纳闷，怎么这拉古那城里，净是一股不甚优雅的铜臭味道。

records.text: Ms. Margherita won't step in as long as they don't disrupt other guests from enjoying their meals.
records.zh: 玛格烈特小姐也不会想管的……吵归吵，只要不打扰到其他客人的食欲和心情就行了。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_2_2
records.text: "Eyes of illusion reflected underwater, coveting Avinoleum above..."
records.zh: “水下倒映的虚妄目光，觊觎天上的阿维纽林……”

records.text: Two decaf Margheritas, a courtesy from Ms. Zani.
records.zh: ……两杯玛格烈特低因浓缩，赞妮小姐请的。

records.text: The clean and vibrant color palette is emblematic of the creator. All proceeds from the auction will be donated to the Order of the Deep.
records.zh: 用色朴素，明媚，如同藏品的作者那般。拍卖所得将全部捐赠给隐海修会。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_12
records.text: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
records.zh: 你在拉古那城看到过像戏里那样，动不动就打架，还公开做违法买卖的家伙吗？

records.text: Damn! You scared me! I thought I had run into my boss again.
records.zh: 啊！吓我一跳，我还以为又偶遇上司了呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_10
records.text: Maggie...? Oh, oh! You mean my colleague, Maji!
records.zh: Maggie……？哦哦哦，您说的是我的同僚马计！

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_2_5
records.text: I bet it's part of Averardo Vault's collection.
records.zh: 我猜是埃弗拉德金库的馆藏。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_7
records.text: The route between Ragunna and the Riccioli Islands has been less than peaceful recently.
records.zh: 拉古那和黎乔利群岛之间的航线最近不是很太平。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_居民区生态_1_1
records.text: I heard that this year's Carnevale is being organized entirely by the Montellis.
records.zh: 听说今年的狂欢节是莫塔里家一手操办。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_11
records.text: —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
records.zh: ——您就会立刻开除我，冻结我所有的账户，把我送去埃弗拉德金库的地下工作。

records.text: These Announcements Bishop Fenrico To Drop on Carnevale Will BLOW YOUR MIND—Learn How it Will Affect Your Wallet.
records.zh: 《震惊！芬莱克主座将在狂欢节上宣布这几件事，事关您的钱袋子！》

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_4
records.text: ...Lady Cantarella put on quite a "banquet" for those working under the Montelli family.
records.zh: ……坎特蕾拉大人好好地「宴请」了那群为莫塔里办事的家伙。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_居民区生态_1_3
records.text: Eccentric Roccia the First Mate, free-spirited Captain Brant...
records.zh: 沉稳可靠的洛可可大副，奔放自由的布兰特船长……

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_2_2
records.text: Don't worry about me. Go play with Sister Phoebe and the little echoes.
records.zh: 不用担心我，快去找菲比姐姐和小声骸们一起玩吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_2_3
records.text: Oh, right! Sister Phoebe gave me a little gift, and said she hid it in the garden!
records.zh: 啊对了！菲比姐姐送了我一件小礼物，好像就藏在了花园里！

records.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_2_3
records.text: Maybe I'll even spot Little Sea Anemone and Sister Phoebe!
records.zh: 说不定还能看到小海葵和菲比姐姐！

records.text: I was just asking Mr. Fulmine about you a few days ago, and now we're meeting at the carnival!
records.zh: 前几天我还在向斐林先生打听您的去向呢，没想到在狂欢节上遇到你了！

records.text: Following the clues, you reached the Avinoleum Theological Seminary, hanging inverted in the sky, and there you rescued Cartethyia, vessel of the Threnodian, and Resonator of Imperator.
records.zh: 你追寻线索抵达了倒悬于天空中的阿维纽林神学院，并在此救下了鸣式的容器，也是英白拉多的共鸣者，卡提希娅。

records.text: In search of the Threnodian's Gem, you came to the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Along the way, you learned of the promise you once made to Phrolova, and the knot it had become in her heart. In the end Fenrico met his end, the Gem fell back into the Fractsidus's hands, and Phrolova sank into the deep, vanishing without a trace.
records.zh: 为了寻找鸣式宝石，你来到了隐海修会的海底试验场，过程中，你得知了弗洛洛与你曾经的约定和如今的心结。最终芬莱克身死，鸣式宝石也被残星会回收，而弗洛洛沉入深海，不见踪影。

records.text: Afterward, at the invitation of Septimont's Ephor Augusta, you traveled with her to the Sanguis Plateaus, where you watched her prove, through her deeds, what it means to be a true sovereign.
records.zh: 之后，你接受七丘总督奥古斯塔的邀请一起来到狩原，见证了她用行动诠释何为王者。

records.text: To commemorate you and Lynae going toe-to-toe with that Voidworm, our baristas leveled up their latte art. Now we can do custom mini portraits of you two on your drinks.
records.zh: 为了纪念你和琳奈同学与虚诞虫作战的英勇表现，社团咖啡师特意提升了拉花技术，现在可以定制琳奈同学和你的迷你头像拉花哦。

records.text: But my brother said this is the Academy's specialty, recommended by Professor Mornye, the amazing woman who launched Helios. He packed a ton for me to take back.
records.zh: 但哥哥说这是那个很厉害的、发射赫利俄斯的莫宁教授推荐的学院特色食物，给我装了很多带回去。

records.text: Yes. They say a New Federation professor thought it had commercial value...
records.zh: 是的，说一个新联邦的教授认为可能有经济价值……

records.text: Lehton, did you ever bring up skipping ahead a year with Chisa? Seems like she's settling in pretty well. Plenty of students want to be her friend.
records.zh: 莱赫托，你对千咲同学提过跳级的事情吗？感觉她已经慢慢适应学校的生活了，有不少学生想和她交朋友。

records.text: That's still a long way off... We'll have to see what Chisa wants for herself when the time comes.
records.zh: 那么远的事情……到时肯定要看千咲同学自己的意愿。

records.text: Me? If Chisa could be my reading partner... then yeah, I'll join, too!
records.zh: 我……能和千咲同学一起读书的话，当然要参加了！

records.text: Yup, you saw her too, right? Chisa doesn't follow the crowd. She does her own thing with style.
records.zh: 对，你也看到了吧！千咲同学逆着人潮战斗的身影，帅气又坚定。

records.text: Chisa likes detective stories too, right? The fan club could invite her to join.
records.zh: 千咲同学不是也喜欢本格推理嘛，邀请她加入同好会怎么样。

records.text: Oh, good call! If Chisa wants in, the club leader will definitely approve it. What about you, Arisa?
records.zh: 好主意，如果千咲同学想加入，会长一定会同意！亚里沙你呢？

records.text: How did you know...? Is it because you're from Ashinohara too, Professor?
records.zh: 怎么发现的……是因为老师也是苇原人吗？

records.text: A Drive Replica... You mean the one Professor Mornye and the others developed after the New Solar Ceremony?
records.zh: 拟制炉芯……是莫宁老师他们在换日计划后开发的那个？

records.text: Stories, in the end, are naught but things carried from one mouth to another.
records.zh: 所谓的故事，自始至终就是人们口口相传的事物。

records.text: Anya, I heard they're closing down Rabelle College... If you go back to the New Federation now, will your credits transfer over?
records.zh: 安雅乔，听说拉贝尔学部要解散了……现在你回新联邦还能拿回原本的学位吗？

records.text: Could it be... that Professor Mornye's "Drive Replica" gave the Exostrider a new ability? A way to sense anything connected to it?
records.zh: 会不会……是莫宁教授他们的“拟制炉芯”让隧者获得了新的能力，使得隧者能够感知到与祂相关的一切？

records.text: You *New Federation curse*... I just held your FUNERAL yesterday!
records.zh: 你*新联邦粗口*，我昨天刚给你办完葬礼！

records.text: Shh, keep your voice down. It's just what I heard. Something about the New Federation redoing the budget...
records.zh: 小点声，小点声……我这也是道听途说的，好像说是新联邦那边重新审计了预算……

records.text: That said, you should already be familiar with the Dimmr Plains region and the survey teams working there.
records.zh: 话是这么说，但您应该已经对黯原地区和勘探队相当熟悉了。

records.text: How are we supposed to pull off this Dimmr Plains survey? Floating islands are gonna be a nightmare to map...
records.zh: 这黯原测绘计划可怎么弄啊……浮岛地貌也太麻烦了……

records.text: You didn't record it? *New Federation curse*, Miles! Don't tell me you ripped out my dashcam again without asking!
records.zh: 没录下来？*新联邦粗口*，你真该死啊！你又擅自拆我行车记录仪是吧！

records.text: I put in for a transfer. Dimmr Plains survey team.
records.zh: 我申请调去黯原参加勘探队了。

records.text: The Dimmr Plains... I'd like to see where they sealed the Threnodian too.
records.zh: 黯原啊……我也想去看看封印鸣式的地方。

records.text: The Exostrider is gone... and yet the waters of the Luminous River run on.
records.zh: 隧者已经离去，但流光河的水却依旧流动着……

records.text: The Exostrider is gone, but the Luminous River is just as it was yesterday... still murmuring on.
records.zh: 隧者已经离去，但流光河的水却一如昨日……仍旧潺潺流动着。

records.text: But when the Luminous River runs downstream, it carries Soliskin blessings. When it runs upstream, it nourishes the living green.
records.zh: 但流光河的水到了下游会承载日灵，到了上游，又恩泽了植被。

records.text: Did you get to see Lady Sigrika at the Academy?!
records.zh: 你在学校见到西格莉卡大人了吗！

records.text: We owe the finished Drive Replica to Professor Mornye. Her early analysis was what laid the path.
records.zh: 幸亏莫宁教授提前解析了大量数据，拟制炉芯才顺利完成。

records.text: Playing message... 漂泊者, Luuk Herssen reminds you to please see him for your follow-up appointment.
records.zh: 触发留言……漂泊者，陆·赫斯医生提醒您按时复查。

records.text: Oh, and thanks to you, we've been granted the chance to perform in Ragunna City.
records.zh: 对了，托你的福，现在我们已经可以在拉古那城里演出了。

records.text: When night falls, the curtain will rise at Margherita's Restaurant.
records.zh: 当夜幕降临的时候，演出将在玛格烈特餐厅拉开序幕。

records.text: Should it be "Battier and the Golden Harpoon," "Tina the Soprano Navigator," "Brant the Maverick Captain," or "Pero the Peculiar Box"?
records.zh: 《金鱼叉巴蒂尔》《驭水玫瑰蒂娜》《不羁船长布兰特》，还是《怪奇百宝箱佩洛》？

records.text: Better still, "Roccia the Legendary First Mate."
records.zh: 不如演《传奇大副洛可可》。

records.text: The show begins this evening at Margherita's Restaurant.
records.zh: 晚上，在玛格烈特餐厅开演。

records.text: A great rendition of "Starry is the Night" plays out. From among the crowd, you watch the Troupe set Margherita's Restaurant aglow with starlight.
records.zh: 一场足够精彩的《今夜星光灿烂》。这次你作为观众，看着愚人剧团的大家将星光洒满玛格烈特。

records.text: A marvelous rendition of "Starry is the Night" plays out. Together, you paint every corner of Margherita's Restaurant in starlight.
records.zh: 一场异常精彩的《今夜星光灿烂》！你和大家一起将星光洒满了整个玛格烈特餐厅。

records.text: And now, it's come true. Starlight and laughter fill… Well, at least they fill Margherita's for now.
records.zh: 现在实现啦，星光和欢笑洒满了……呃，至少洒满了玛格烈特。

records.text: The response last time was so good that Margherita's has become one of our regular stages.
records.zh: 之前的演出获得了很好的反响，玛格烈特餐厅成为了剧团常驻演出点之一。

records.text: Rinascita has always been on our list. Fuling talked about painting the sunset in Ragunna City and visiting the Salotto Open Air Gallery.
records.zh: 以前，我们就想来黎那汐塔看看，伏翎还说过，要画下拉古那城的日落，还想去萨尔洛托露天画廊看看。

records.text: Some notes on them are really interesting. Fuling even marked them.
records.zh: 这上面的备注很有意思，伏翎还特地标记出来了。

records.text: Oh, sorry, you're right. Mr. Fulmine also taught me that "It's the glimmer of each and every soul that forges the glories in history."
records.zh: 抱歉抱歉，您说得对。斐林前辈也教过我，“历史之所以璀璨，是因为每个灵魂都在闪光。”

records.text: Mr. Fulmine and I have been grabbing as many Caskets as we can, but it's still not enough to power the painting fully. That's why we need your help.
records.zh: 过去一段时间，我和斐林前辈已经把我们能找到的声匣都收集了过来，但距离让声骸画完全恢复还有一定距离，所以才想要请您帮忙。

records.text: Oh, he's heading out with the expedition team to the frostlands soon, isn't he? How about knitting him a nice, thick scarf?
records.zh: 啊，他不是要跟科考队去冰原考察一段时间吗，给他织一条围巾怎么样？

records.text: Maybe I should apply for permission to search the Dimmr Plains...?
records.zh: 是不是得申请去黯原找找看呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_4_洛瑟菈线_生态冒泡_1_1
records.text: President Lucilla has been looking so drained lately. I truly wish she'd take a proper rest.
records.zh: 洛瑟菈校长最近越来越憔悴了，真希望她能好好休息下。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_4_洛瑟菈线_生态冒泡_4_1
records.text: This is bad. This is REAL bad. Director Aalto walked out without even eating the cup noodles!
records.zh: 坏了坏了，秋水领导没吃杯面就走了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_4_洛瑟菈线_生态冒泡_5_1
records.text: Could you please not? We'd be doing President Lucilla a much bigger favor just by staying out of the way!
records.zh: 能别胡闹吗，咱们不给洛瑟菈校长添乱就好了！

records.text: The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
records.zh:
「悲鸣」是在索拉里斯一切灾变态势的统称。
人们牢记一切产生变化的时间，那是从第一声悲鸣开始，而「悲鸣」从未结束。
浪潮不止，悲鸣永不停歇。

records.text: The land is engulfed in flames, while the Necrostar swallows the sky. The black hole at the pinnacle of the Port City of Guixu marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation... Or perhaps, merely a lie.
records.zh: 火焰烧毁大地，暗星吞噬天空。归墟港市最高处的黑洞，是毁灭的开端，也是毁灭的终局，同样，也隐藏着救赎的钥匙……亦或是，一个谎言。

records.text:
On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future.
The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end.
Yet, the guardian of this final destination, like yourself, is but a remnant of that very future.
records.zh:
泰缇斯系统最深处虚拟海岸，记录并代表着遥远未来的黑海岸的终点。
浪潮将失乡的旅者推至终点，自此以后，不再有漂泊。
然而，守护着终点的人，和你一样，都是来自于终点的孑遗。

records.text:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.
records.zh:
黎那汐塔城邦之一拉古那的都城，一座无比繁荣的港口城市。整座城市坐落在海上，城区之间由水道相互联通。民众普遍信奉岁主，将公共声骸视为岁主的赐福，甚至传达岁主意志的使者。
除了广为人知的虔信外，拉古那人还以对艺术的狂热追求而著称。精美绝伦的雕塑和画作在城内随处可见，街头也经常可以看到即兴戏剧上演。

records.text: At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.
records.zh: 拂风水畔的尽头有一处岛屿，树林与遗迹构成了庞大的迷宫，簇拥着中央的湖泊。这里是无数骑士传闻所提及的终点。时至今日，仍有往昔的幻影在林迹中徘徊……

records.text: The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.
records.zh: 此地常年不散的「云海」实际上是由高浓度的回音能量构成。在拉古那的传说中，氤柔水境的中心有一片宁静如镜面的水域，它可以净化人们内心的恶念，将其化为云海的一部分。氤氲的水雾中有时会传来一阵摄人心魄的歌声……

records.text: The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.
records.zh: 嶙峋险峻的山脉似乎永远被长夜笼罩，呈现出深海一般的神秘幽暗。这片区域是拉古那最为古老的家族——翡萨烈家族的旧时领地，鲜有外人敢踏足。

records.text: The Fool's Troupe travels across all of Rinascita, but their base sits in a vast cavern on Penitent's End. Their creed is freedom, their treasure is laughter, and their gift to every city they visit is a new tale.
records.zh: 于黎那汐塔四处巡演的「愚人剧团」，以悲叹墓岛中的一处巨大溶洞为据点。他们崇尚自由，掠夺欢笑，为每一个城市带去欢声和故事。

records.text:
Averardo Bank utilizes an Echo train system to move clients' collections and staff to and from Averardo Vault.
Once the Echo trains reach the underground station of Averardo Vault, the collections within will undergo a second sorting process before being moved to specialized storage facilities.
records.zh:
埃弗拉德银行接收了储户的藏品之后，会利用声骸列车将藏品和工作人员运送至埃弗拉德金库的地下站台。
地下站台会将藏品进行二次分拣，并将其运往不同的藏馆。

records.text:
Beneath the shadowed trench, an empty yet defiant gaze hungrily covets the legacy of the heavens.
Once a sacred land, only a faint shadow of Avinoleum's glory remains. Those destined to fall still live, while those meant to survive lie buried, transformed into divine oracles no one hears. Their lips remain sealed, and Their ears are bound by words They never spoke.
records.zh:
海沟之下，虚妄的目光正觊觎着天渊的遗产。
昔日筑于地上的圣地，已然沦为阿维纽林的幽影——应当陨落的却从未降落，不该殉道的却葬于高阁，化作不被聆听的天音与神启。祂的口从未开过，祂的耳仍囿于非祂所言之言。
records.title: Beohr Waters

records.text: The capital city of Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states. Perched atop Capitoline Hill, it boasts towering stone structures that form the grand "Gryphon's Fortress." After fleeing the threat of the Dark Tide, the bold and battle-loving Septimontians have devoted their lives to chasing the heights of glory. With travelers from distant seas, they gather in this City of Glory built upon the legends of heroes.
records.zh: 黎那汐塔城邦之一七丘的都城。坐落于卡庇托山上的城市由无数庞大的石质建筑构成，形成了宏伟气派的“鹫巢石城”景观。在避开低地黑潮的威胁后，豪放尚武的七丘人在力量至上的思想下不断向着山顶攀登，并与远渡重洋、自各地而来的旅者们一起，聚集在这座英雄史诗所铸就的荣光之都中。
records.title: Capitoline Hill City

records.text:
The core area in the Fabricatorium of the Deep for developing Common Echoes. Endless arrays of Echo Brooders line the space, cradling Echoes awaiting rebirth.
As the foundation of the Common Echo system, this site commands heavy investment of security and research resources by the Order.
records.zh:
隐海试验场中培育、生产公共声骸的核心区域。大量培育舱聚集在此，孵育着还未新生的声骸。
作为公共声骸系统的基石，修会在这里投入了大量的守备力量与研究人员。

records.text:
The central tower of the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where the Lost Beyond is created.
As the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, the tower regulates the activities in all other areas within the facility. Deep in the tower keeps the lantern of the first Primus, the first gift bestowed upon the Order by Sentinel Imperator.
records.zh:
隐海试验场的中心高塔，也是失亡彼岸建立、诞生的地方。
作为整个试验场的控制中枢，调律着试验场的各个区域。而在塔的更深处，则存放着初代主座的提灯，那也是岁主英白拉多给予隐海修会的第一份礼物。

records.text: A natural pass of solid bedrock, marked by jagged cliffs and towering stone pillars. As the gateway to the Sanguis Plateaus, it has stood witness for generations as Gladiators embarked on their sacred hunt, all under the silent watch of the stone colossus of Atilius, the Hero of Heroes.
records.zh: 由坚硬磐石所构建的天然隘口，石柱横亘，陡峭嶙峋。作为进入桑古伊斯狩原内部的主要通道，代代七丘人在英雄王阿提留斯石像的见证下，由此踏上狩猎的征途。

records.text: The highest peak in the Sanguis Plateaus, named for both its unique summit and the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. To Gladiators, it is sacred ground. Legend says that each Hero of Heroes faced their final trial there, and only then would they conquer fate and be cloaked in glory.
records.zh: 位于桑古伊斯狩原最高处的山峰，因其独特的峰峦结构和三位英雄王造访的典故因此得名，被角斗士们视为心中的圣地。据传说，每一位英雄王都将在此完成最后的磨砺，此后，他们必将战胜命运，满载荣光。

records.text: Named after the colossal Exostrider greatsword that holds up the underground dome, its dark waters feel like a gateway to another world. As one of the few regions shielded from Void Storms, it became the foundation for the Spacetrek Collective's Starward Riseway, a lift that scales the greatsword's spine to link this subterranean oasis with the Roya Frostlands.
records.zh: 因湖中托起地底穹顶的隧者兵装巨剑而得名，湖水幽暗，仿佛通往异世的门扉。作为少数能规避虚质磁暴的安全区，深空联合凭依剑脊建起，建造了贯通地底绿洲与罗伊冰原的运输动脉「联运椎骨」。

records.text: A terrifying creature born from the Threnodian's influence, found primarily in the hinterland of Lahai-Roi known as the "Mawburrow Desert." Its source of power and its fatal weakness are the Voidmatter Regulators on its head. Wherever it passes, life is extinguished, leaving only the void in its wake.
records.zh: 鸣式力量影响下诞生的可怖生物，主要活跃于拉海洛腹地，名为「隐喙深腹」的山谷。其头部的虚质反应炉既是动力源，也是要害所在。凡为它所踞之处，万物寂然，唯余虚无。

records.text: Located within the research base zone, the Icebreak Port is the only regular access point into the Roya Frostlands. Upon arrival, personnel and supplies may be transferred via the Starward Riseway to the underground haven of Lahai-Roi, or routed deeper into the frostlands through the inter-outpost roads.
records.zh: 位于科考基地区域内的不冻港，是外界人员和物资进入罗伊冰原的唯一常规途径。登陆港口后，人员与物资可经由「联运椎骨」转运至地下绿洲拉海洛，也可通过各科考站点间的道路前往冰原其他区域。

records.text: Once a forest-thick fjordland in the frigid zone, this region was home to the nomadic Roya. Then came Lahai-Roi's first recorded Lament that triggered a geomagnetic pole shift. The land was transformed into the new polar extremity of Solaris, buried beneath endless snow and ice. The violent shift also dragged near-orbit satellites and space stations from the sky. Their wreckage still litters the frostlands to this day.
records.zh: 原为一片寒带峡湾，地表分布着广袤的森林，罗伊人在此游牧栖居。拉海洛记载的第1次悲鸣引起地磁极变化，此地成为新的索拉里斯之极，被一望无际的冰雪覆盖。磁极变化引发索拉里斯地外的近地卫星与空间站坠落，至今仍可在冰原地表发现大量残骸。

records.text:
Formally known as the Spacetrek Collective: Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, this facility is a joint project between the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya people. Built around the Exostrider's greatsword embedded in the ice, it serves as a vital logistics hub.
Here, researchers work to salvage pre-Lament data from fallen satellites and space stations, run non-invasive diagnostics on the Exostrider to monitor its restoration, and survey the ecosystem to revive the long-frozen flora and fauna of the ancient world.
records.zh: 全称「深空联合：极地科考站」，是深空联合与罗伊人协作，围绕冰原地表的隧者巨剑建造的科考工程，同时也是重要的物资集散枢纽。其主要科考项目包括搜索卫星及空间站残骸，回收悲鸣前观测数据；监测隧者修复状态，对机体进行非破坏性探测与试验，收集原始数据并采样；进行生物多样性勘测，复苏被封冻的动植物等。

records.text:
During the second Lament recorded in Lahai-Roi, the Exostrider, a colossal mech from an unknown civilization, emerged through the Stridergate. It fought a fierce battle against the Threnodian to seal the catastrophe from the other side, a clash that shattered the very bedrock of the frostlands.
As the Roya faced annihilation, the Exostrider channeled its remaining power and drove the greatsword deep into the earth to brace the collapsing land. Its Reactor Drive transformed into a subterranean sun, casting warmth into the depths. Its scattered fragments reassembled into the Exoswarm that mimic the local lifeforms, guiding the Roya toward a new homeland. Since then, the Exostrider fell dormant upon the surface, awaiting the day of its awakening.
records.zh: 在拉海洛记载的第2次悲鸣发生时，来自未知文明的巨型机兵——隧者穿越隧门而来。祂与鸣式鏖战，竭力将灾厄隔绝门后。撼天动地的战斗使冰原倾塌，在罗伊人面临浩劫的时刻，隧者调度残存的能量，以巨剑为脊，支撑起摇摇欲坠的拉海洛；以炉芯为太阳，向地下洒落温暖的辉光；以机体残片模仿、聚合、重组为隧群，牵引罗伊人走向新的家园。而后祂于地面休眠，等待复苏之日到来。

records.text: A way station in the Land of Xuanfang's Southern Yuan Hills. Every shipment, commodity, and traveler entering the territory must first submit to inspection by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
records.zh: 位于玄方地界南侧的落渊南丘的驿站。所有入城的物资、商品以及人员都要在此接受「外事府」的审查。

records.text: A pagoda of mechanisms in the Land of Xuanfang's Eastern Xuan Peaks. Its complex structure spills a ceaseless Disorienting Fog made up of frequencies that confound Tacet Discords, luring them into traps from which there is no escape.
records.zh: 建于玄方地界东侧，玄幽东岳上的机关楼阁。结构复杂，且不断散发名为隐息雾的烟障，雾中含有令残象感官混乱的频率，借此将残象吸引并困在此处。

records.text:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
The Thousandfold Foundry within it produces Autopuppets for Xuanfang ceaselessly, while the Myriad Snare disposes of powerful Tacet Discords too terrible for Censure Courts to hold.
records.zh:
位于玄方地界西侧，方擎西峰中的机关工厂。
此中的流水线「千形坊」为玄方地界源源不断地生产着机傀，而其深处的「万囮牢」则专用于绞杀咎庭难以处理的强大残象。

records.text: Those who are ignorant hinder progress, while the innocent suffer from the challenges imposed upon them. The embers of a fire, sparked by memories of a distant night and fueled by present circumstances, ignite the pain of Scar's past and the rebirth of new ideas, ultimately leading to the downfall of the old world order.
records.zh: 无知者打破一切向前的发展，无罪者背负被赋予的责难。余烬乘风而起，让一场大火从多年前的夜晚燃烧至今，将伤痕的苦痛与思想的重生引向旧世秩序的毁灭。

records.text: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
records.zh: 拉古那城中用以瞻仰岁主雕像的神圣建筑，包含上下两层，被统称为“水星天教堂”，亦是隐海修会之所在。

records.text: The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
records.zh: 由莫塔里家族主控，收藏有大量珍贵声骸与艺术品的金库。天堑环绕，睥睨云海。

records.text: A vast valley stretching between the Starward Riseway and the Etching Plains. Its name, translated from Royan itself, refers to the jagged square cliffs and stone spires that jut from the valley like the serrated teeth of a giant, forever studded into a scar upon the earth.
records.zh: 位于联运椎骨与蚀刻平原间的巨大谷地。其名直译自罗伊语，意指谷中参差耸立的方形峭壁与石阵，宛若巨人遗落的齿列，永恒嵌于大地伤痕之中。

records.text: Officially Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute, it stands as part of the same borderless research initiative—the Spacetrek Collective—as Startorch Academy. Its mission is to extract and apply advanced technologies. Linked directly to the Starward Riseway, the Institute rests above the greatsword's tip like a guarding Stargram, watching over Lahai-Roi from above.
records.zh: 全称「深空联合：研究院」，与星炬学院同属无国界科研共同体「深空联合」，专注前沿研究与技术的提取与转化。它与交通枢纽「联运椎骨」相接，高悬于巨剑顶端，形如守护的星环，俯瞰拉海洛的大地。

records.text: A basin located between the Western Fang Peaks and the Eastern Xuan Peaks, where the ruins of Yuan Fortress still remain. Once destroyed by war, the Fortress has long since faded from memory. Yet amid erosion and moss, the outline of its former grandeur can still be discerned.
records.zh: 位于方擎西峰与玄幽东岳之间的低谷地带，亦是昔日渊城的旧迹所在。这座毁于战火的城池渐渐被世人淡忘，风沙与苔痕之间，仍能依稀窥见昔年渊城的轮廓。

records.text:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh:
位于玄方地界西侧、方擎西峰深处的庞大机关工厂。
此地由负责制造机傀的流水线工坊「千形坊」，以及专用于镇压、绞杀强大残象的「万囮牢」共同构成，悬天构昼夜运转不息，为玄方城提供源源不断的增援与助力。

records.text: A suspended City of Mechanisms under Mengzhou's jurisdiction, built to hold the hordes of Tacet Discords diverted from the Norfall Barrens outbreak. Its intricate construction reroutes and traps incoming hordes through a vast array of mechanisms. Its form shifts at will, deploying Autopuppets to rotate defenses and purge or suppress the Tacet Discords held within.
records.zh:
隶属于梦州的悬空机关城，关押了北落野残象潮中分流的大量残象。
此城构造精密，其运作原理，乃借机关之术，将涌入关内的残象潮予以分割、围困。亦会变换结构，并启动机傀换防，对封存之残象进行清理与压制。

records.text: Meanwhile, on the other side of Xuanfang Hold...
records.zh: 与此同时，玄方城的另一侧……

records.text: Formed from Tacetite and hidden in the Stormy Sea, this archipelago is a sanctuary for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, it has fostered extensive partnerships across Solaris-3. While its advanced technologies are shared with the outside world, their origins remain a mystery, even to its members.
records.zh: 隐藏于风暴海上的黑石群岛，聚集着全世界各行各业的精英人才，致力于对抗悲鸣，广泛参与国际合作。其所掌握的技术虽对外开放，但来源却成谜，甚至连成员自身亦未必知晓自己掌握的技术究竟来自何方。

records.text:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator."
records.zh:
调律即调节频率，在索拉里斯，频率是事物的第一判断标准，对频率的调节，也即对事物本质的探究。
黑海岸通过对星图的调律，实现对悲鸣本质的溯源和解析。在黑海岸历史上，只有过一个人被称之为「调律者」。

records.text: That's how I feel now. Life at the Academy is peaceful. The students can be a handful sometimes, but I'd never change their vibrant spirits. To be able to share a casual conversation with you like this... I couldn't feel more at home.
records.zh: 像现在这样——学院的日子很平静，学生们偶尔闹腾却始终活泼有生命力。能这样站着和你随意聊聊天，本身就已经让我觉得很放松了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_1_拉海洛主线_下半_14_2
records.text: A scorched report from a Fractsidus Overseer, meant to be sent to "Eris" in the New Federation.
records.zh: 一份被火焰灼烧的残损报告，来自某个残星会会监，原本会发往给新联邦的「厄里斯」。

records.text: A Fractsidus Overseer's report on its way to the New Federation?
records.zh: 残星会会监发到新联邦的报告……？

records.text: The recipient is "Eris" in the New Federation.
records.zh: 这份报告要送予的对象，是新联邦的「厄里斯」。

records.text: Luuk Herssen gathered this dirt from the "place where he rests."
records.zh: 陆·赫斯从“沉眠之地”取来的一抔冻土。

records.text: Three: Cristoforo, Phrolova, and Scar. Plus the Grand Architect you mentioned.
records.zh: 三名，克里斯托弗、弗洛洛、伤痕。还有你说的会长。

records.text: Ah, those names do ring a bell. Phrolova is codenamed Hecate. Cristoforo? Arachnos. Intriguing, isn't it? The flair they have for their own branding.
records.zh: 噢，我对这几个名字有印象。弗洛洛的真实代号是赫卡忒，克里斯托弗则是阿拉克农……你瞧，很好玩儿吧，他们的代称还挺花哨呢。

records.text: Zashiki-warashi won't require much of your attention. This Overseer primarily operates in Ashinohara, a region that's been largely destroyed by the Lament.
records.zh: 「座敷童子」，这个会监不用太关注，其活动的地域主要在苇原，而苇原已经被悲鸣毁灭大半了。

records.text: Ashinohara... I've heard of it somewhere before.
records.zh: 苇原……似乎在哪里听过。

records.text: The girl we had in the infirmary for a while, Chisa, I remember? The city that trapped her, Honami, is part of Ashinohara.
records.zh: 之前在医务室养过一段时间伤的孩子，我记得是叫千咲？她曾在的穗波市就属于苇原。

records.text: Lahai-Roi was just a minor setback! I'm still useful! I still have work in the New Federation, I still—
records.zh: 拉海洛……只是个小失误！我还有用，我还有新联邦的活儿，我还——

records.text: After that incident, the Academy detected cracks on the Threnodian seal in the depths of Bjartr Woods. The damage seemed... intentional.
records.zh: 那件事之后，学院检测出浮光林深处的封印曾一度出现裂隙，那痕迹……看起来是人为的。

records.text: The Court of Savantae was active in Mengzhou?
records.zh: 梦州有稷廷的存在？

records.text: As for the New Federation, you'll likely end up there eventually if you plan to counter the Fractsidus's operations in the future.
records.zh: 至于新联邦……如果你未来准备干涉残星会的行动，迟早也会去吧。

records.text: Will they even let us stay in Capitoline Hill after this? I'm scared of what comes next—
records.zh: 我们还能留在卡庇托山城吗？我害怕之后——

records.text: Who's it you're looking for? This here is the first stop for ferries heading to Capitoline Hill. Maybe we've seen them before.
records.zh: 你要找谁？这里是渡口去卡庇托山城区的第一站，也许我们之前有看到过。

records.text: Your clothes aren't from around here. You from the New Federation?
records.zh: 不常见的打扮啊……从新联邦来的？

records.text: Look, 漂泊者. Once we cross the Hero's Way, we'll get to the Capitoline Hill district.
records.zh: 瞧，漂泊者，穿过英灵古道，我们快抵达卡庇托山城区了。

records.text: Scar, your nameless ally, and you... The Fractsidus seems to revel in the company of those with twisted obsessions.
records.zh: 你也好，伤痕也好，还有这位不知名字的残星会成员……这种所谓的偏爱还真是泛滥啊。

records.text: How much do you know about it? This is our second time meeting, Buling. That can't be a coincidence.
records.zh: 关于这种异常，你知道多少？卜灵，你第二次找上我，这次不再是“偶遇”了吧。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_4_七丘主线_上2_4_1
records.text:
As you consider the connection between Lupa and the strange happenings in Septimont, Buling appears once more. 

She tells you that she also senses the oddities around but cannot find a way to break the deadlock. She hands you a copper mirror. As you examine it, the scene shifts to reveal a conversation that occurred two decades ago during the Great Agon. Two Septimontians discuss a shadowy underground bet involving Gladiator Mya.
records.zh:
在你思考着露帕与七丘的异常之间的关系时，卜灵再次悄然出现。
她告诉你，她也隐约感到了周围的异常，但并不能找到破局之法。于是她将一面奇妙的铜镜给了你，而在你用铜镜映照之处，出现了二十年前举办冠军赛时的情境——有两个七丘人，正在谈论和角斗士蜜芽有关的暗庄赌局。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_4_七丘主线_上2_5_9
records.text:
You and Lupa emerge victorious, but the strange events you just experienced go unnoticed by the crowds.

Meanwhile, in an unknown place, Cartethyia steps into the same arena, her sword aimed at the playwright Cristoforo.

You and Cartethyia stand together, unknowingly united in the light and shadow of glory, fighting side by side in a battle that no one is aware of. The story is far from over.
records.zh:
你和露帕获得了胜利，但刚才你所经历的一切异常，除你之外似乎都无人得见。
而在你所不可知的另一侧，卡提希娅踏上与你同在一处的竞技场，剑指剧作家克里斯托弗。
你与卡提希娅处在荣耀的光与暗中，以无人知晓的方式并肩而战。故事，尚未走到结局。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_4_七丘主线_上1_4_5
records.text:
You encounter a young Taoist girl named Buling, who claims to be from Mengzhou.

She seems to have sought you out deliberately, but after a few cryptic exchanges, she vanishes without a trace.
records.zh:
一位自称是梦州方士的少女卜灵忽然出现在你身侧。
她似乎是特意来接触你的，却又在说了些古怪难明的话后悄然消失了。

records.text: Me? I'm a traveling Taoist from Mengzhou. Just call me Buling.
records.zh: 我嘛？只是一个来旅游的梦州方士，老板叫我卜灵就好。

records.text: Heard about you from an old friend. You know Jianxin? Pretty sure you met her in Jinzhou. She trained with the same master before me.
records.zh: 听一位故人讲过啦~鉴心，就是你在今州遇到过的那个姑娘，也是我的师姐！

records.text: Lupa, does Domina Julia believe in the Sentinel?
records.zh: 露帕，那位尤利娅女士信仰「岁主」吗？

records.text: After a long, bumpy ride from Chongzhou, I've lost count of how many times that damn ship's turned...
records.zh: 自重州一路颠簸到此，我都记不清自己船转了多少趟……

records.text: (Before meeting Buling, when I touched the Echo in that village, I felt... a layered, indistinct frequency.)
records.zh: （遇到卜灵前，我在那个村落中触碰声骸时，曾感到一种“层层叠叠、模糊不清的异样频率”。）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_4_七丘主线_放水后日谈_4_1
records.text: Alright, Cartethyia... I'll... I'll try my best...
records.zh: 呵呵……哈哈哈！好啊，卡提希娅，我会……咳，像你说的那样，尽量撑住……咳咳！

records.text: To treat Septimont like a plaything... unforgivable!
records.zh: 把七丘当做手里的玩具，随意涂抹……不可原谅！

records.text: The Threnodian's frequency is gone. Well done, Lupa.
records.zh: 我感觉到鸣式的频率消失了。你做得很好，露帕。

records.text: (Surely they must be Phrolova and... Scar. But how is Scar in Rinascita?)
records.zh: （听起来，似乎是弗洛洛和……伤痕。为什么伤痕会出现在黎那汐塔？）

records.text: We traveled together for a time and discovered the architects of the destruction—the Fractsidus playwright Cristoforo and the Threnodian.
records.zh: 我和她同行了一段时间，找到了引发异常的元凶——残星会的剧作家克里斯托弗和鸣式。

records.text: May applause greet you. Lupa from House Silva.
records.zh: 以呼嚎向你致意，西尔瓦家的露帕。

records.text: You're assistance is much appreciated, Contender Lupa!
records.zh: 感谢你的帮助，露帕选手！

records.text: The Academy will look after you. Or you can go back to live in Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 之后学院的人会照顾你，如果你想，也可以回浮光林生活。

records.text: If it's leaving the campus, it's probably going to the frostlands. Right, we'll need to take the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: 如果要往校外走，大概会去罗伊冰原……噢，那我们得去一趟联运椎骨。

records.text: I'm Aemeath. The Academy's star. A Synchronist. A savior.
records.zh: 我是爱弥斯。我是……学院明星，适格者，救世主。

records.text: When I was a kid, I once hid in the Starward Riseway and made it to the frostlands all by myself.
records.zh: 小时候我曾偷偷藏进联运椎骨，自己一个人去过冰原呢。

records.text: Our next stop is the Starward Riseway. Are you ready?
records.zh: 接下来就要去联运椎骨那边了，准备好出发了吗？

records.text: Aemeath, you think Cassettes might be a breakthrough?
records.zh: 爱弥斯，你是觉得磁带是个突破口？

records.text: So I ran away from Bjartr Woods by myself. I hid in the Starward Riseway and made my way to the frostlands.
records.zh: 于是我独自从浮光林跑了出来，躲藏在联运椎骨中，一路来到了冰原。

records.text: Since I woke in the Gorges of Spirits, I've met many people from my past. They've helped me recover pieces of myself. It's a good thing.
records.zh: 自云陵谷苏醒开始的这段旅途，我遇到的故人都让我更了解自己，这没什么不好的。

records.text: Here is a peace offering. I've granted you full clearance: passes for the Starward Riseway, archive access, and use of Academy weaponry and equipment.
records.zh: 作为赔礼，我已经为你开通了所有行动会需要的权限：无论是往返联运椎骨，还是访问内部资料库，以及学院兵装的取用。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_1_寻找勇气的日灵玩法_8_1
records.text: "Okay, well... I need to find a way to get stronger. Once I get back to Bjartr Woods, I'll seek guidance from the Giant Soliskin!"
records.zh: “嗯……我要想办法变强。等回了浮光林，我先找巨日灵请教一下！”

records.chapter: 剧情_3_1_寻找勇气的日灵玩法_8_1
records.text: "Alright, I'll head back to Bjartr Woods now. Bye!"
records.zh: “那我就先回浮光林了，再见啦！”

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_10_1
records.text: It has! Based on the data we pulled, Suhsin's influence has been completely neutralized!
records.zh: 对！从收回的频率数据来看，溯心留下的影响已经消去！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
records.text: 漂泊者! You really kept your word! So you and Lady Hsin already dealt with Suhsin?
records.zh: 漂泊者！你果真说到做到！溯心已经被你和心大人解决了？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
records.text: That's not quite right. It isn't truly back to its "original state." Before, the Fox Shadow would either aid us on its own, or after we'd asked Lady Hsin for help.
records.zh: 你这话不太严谨，现在可不是所谓“最初的状态”，以前狐影要么是主动协助，要么是我们向心大人求助后祂才出手。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
records.text: But now that Lady Hsin is no longer within the Simulacrum Nexus, we can only reach it through the Shadow Binder. That's a world of difference.
records.zh: 如今心大人不在梦枢天罗，我们只能通过「缚影璇玑」呼唤狐影，这可和以往大不同。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
records.text: True... And the Shadow Binder only mends the parts of the Fox Shadow that Suhsin corrupted. It's going to need some serious modifications from here on.
records.zh: 的确……「缚影璇玑」是针对狐影中溯心侵占的部分进行干涉，现在可需要大幅改进了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
records.text: But at its core, the Fox Shadow is a creation of Fractal Proliferation. And Suhsin's power likely shares the same origin as Lady Hsin's. So perhaps all we need to do is adjust—
records.zh: 不过，狐影本质还是分形权能的产物，且溯心的权能和心大人应该是同源的，或许只要改变其中——

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
records.text: (I'd been worried the Fox Shadow might turn on them once Hsin was gone. Looks like I can finally put that fear to rest.)
records.zh: （原本还担忧心离开这里后，狐影是否对他们不利，看来可以放心了。）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_14_1
records.text: That's right. They're projections from Lady Hsin's memory data. I was completely baffled the first time I met them.
records.zh: 对，他们都是心大人用记忆数据投射出的存在，第一次看见他们的时候，我还有些疑惑呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_14_1
records.text: But after Lady Hsin explained it, I understood. She believes the people of Mengzhou are part of its civilization too. That's why She did it.
records.zh: 听心大人解释后才明白，祂认为梦州人也是文明的一部分，所以才这么做。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_14_1
records.text: Haha, I can't speak for the other Sentinels. But if it's Lady Hsin's Civilization Capsule, then this is exactly how it should be.
records.zh: 哈哈，其它「岁主」我无法断言，但心大人的文明之匣，就应该是如此。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_15_1
records.text: All these "phantoms"... Can Lady Hsin really sustain every one of them?
records.zh: 这些“幻影”是……心大人能维持住吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_16_1
records.text: I have. They're Hsin's memory projections, so it makes sense.
records.zh: 嗯，既然他们都是心的记忆投影，有这种情况也在情理之中。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_16_1
records.text: Exactly. But that means it costs Lady Hsin extra computational power to reunite people who could never otherwise have met, just to give them a chance to make up for their regrets.
records.zh: 对，但心大人还会额外消耗算力，让那些原本不可能相见的人重逢，弥补他们的遗憾。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_16_1
records.text: That sounds just like Hsin. She can't bear to see people suffer. Is there some problem with that?
records.zh: 这确实是心会尽力去做的事，祂最不忍见人们悲伤的模样，有什么问题吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_17_1
records.text: Look at this! My hands are trembling. The level of detail in Lady Hsin's simulation is really that precise.
records.zh: 你看，我的手在颤抖，心大人对知觉的模拟竟能深入到这种地步。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_18_1
records.text: Ugh, every time it comes to this, I always wonder why Lady Hsin even bothered to simulate a feeling like this. Rest, sleep, hunger… it's all just noise. It only gets in the way.
records.zh: 唉，每次这种时候我都要说，心大人何必为我们模拟这些感觉，我们要休息、要睡觉、甚至还会肚子饿，这些都只会妨碍我。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: 漂泊者, thank you for your help. With Suhsin gone, the remolding has picked up pace. It won't be long now.
records.zh: 漂泊者，多谢你相助，溯心不在后，重塑进度加快许多，很快就能完成了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: Hsin will gather every Celestial's frequency into a Prism of Fate and sustain your existence with Her own computational power. And once the people of Solaris grow strong enough to reach a level of power comparable to a Sentinel's, She'll grant you new bodies.
records.zh: 心会将所有天人的频率收进宿镜，以自己的算力维持你们的存在。等索拉里斯人靠自己拥有比肩「岁主」的能力时，祂会赋予你们新的躯体。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: I accepted my fate the day I swore my oath. But I never expected that the one I'd find hardest to let go of... would be Lady Hsin.
records.zh: 虽然在立誓的那天就做好了准备，但没想到此刻心中的不舍，竟更多是对心大人。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: Haha, I suppose it would. You know Lady Hsin better than most. I imagine you understand exactly what I'm feeling right now.
records.zh: 哈哈，的确，比我们更了解心大人的你，很能理解我此刻的想法吧！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: Lady Hsin, though... She'd come right up to us, praise our work, and gush about Her favorite stalls at the Waking Moon Festival. And when someone was lost to the anomalies... She'd cover her face and weep for them.
records.zh: 可心大人会来到我们身边，夸赞我们的成果，还会兴高采烈地诉说祂在朝月会上最喜欢的摊位，也会在有人卷入异象消亡时……掩面而泣。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: My resolve has never once faltered. Still, I count it as the fortune of three lifetimes—that the Sentinel I gave my oath to was Hsin the Moon Fox.
records.zh: 尽管我的决心从未动摇过，可还是要感叹，我所献身的「岁主」是心月狐，可谓三生有幸。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
records.text: If that's the case, you should have a little more faith. Do you think Hsin would let the people who stood by Her for a century to remold the Civilization Capsule just fade away?
records.zh: 既然如此，你更该相信，心怎会舍得让相伴百年、共塑文明之匣的你们就此消亡？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_22_1
records.text: Lately, Lady Hsin has been acting much more as She did back then...
records.zh: 最近的心大人，倒是更像那个时候的样子了……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_24_1
records.text: But... your wound might leave a scar. And you've already got a big old scar on your thigh. I'm so sorry...
records.zh: 不过……创口可能会留下伤疤了，你大腿上都已经有个很吓人的旧疤，抱歉……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_24_1
records.text: Maybe. Anyway, that old scar has its story, and so does this new one. This one's proof of a healer coming into her own. So please, don't dwell on it.
records.zh: 或许吧，不过旧疤有它的故事，新伤也有——它见证了一位医师能够独当一面，所以你别放在心上。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_2_1
records.text: Come on, it can't be that hard. You met Lady Hsin at the Waking Moon Festival. What else could you be but happy?
records.zh: 哪有这么复杂，在朝月会上见到心月狐大人，除了开心还能有别的？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_2_1
records.text: She gave this little smile, and those gold-red eyes swept over the crowd. It was over in a heartbeat, but it felt like She looked at each one of us for an eternity...
records.zh: 祂微微一笑，金红的目光缓缓掠过众人。只是短短一瞬，却像在每个人身上都停留了许久……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_31_1
records.text: Sorry to trouble you. You're from outside the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, aren't you? Have you ever heard of the Myriad Snare?
records.zh: 抱歉打扰你了，你是从梦枢天罗之外来的吧？我想问问你知道万囮牢吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_31_1
records.text: He was meant to come here with us. But he chose to stay behind at the Myriad Snare to protect his homeland, the Western Fang Peaks.
records.zh: 他本也该来到这里，却为了守护故乡方擎西峰，自愿留在了万囮牢。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_33_1
records.text: But then again, why did Lady Hsin preserve our senses, our living forms, and all our emotions? When I think of that, I can't help but feel I've failed to live up to what She wanted for us.
records.zh: 可心大人保留我们的知觉、活着时的模样、还有万般情绪是为了什么呢？一想到这里，我便不禁自省是否辜负了祂的心意。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_33_1
records.text: Exactly. Hsin wants you to live as fully, even as you remold the Civilization Capsule. If you all keep throwing yourselves into such reckless acts, it would trouble Her deeply.
records.zh: 那的确，心希望你们重塑文明之匣的同时，也要和过去一样好好生活，如果都做出那么吓人的举动，那心可要急坏了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_33_1
records.text: Heh... Hearing you say that, I can almost picture the look on Lady Hsin's face right now.
records.zh: 呵呵，听你这么说，似乎能想象心大人的表情了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_34_1
records.text: Flying lanterns as far as the eye can see across the Heart of Flames today. This must be the most unforgettable Waking Moon Festival in Lady Hsin's memory.
records.zh: 今日烬心域灯火满天，想必那是心大人印象最深的一次朝月会吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_37_1
records.text: Do you think Lady Hsin can actually take on the form of a young girl?
records.zh: 你说心大人……果真能变成少女的模样吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_37_1
records.text: Here we go again! I told you it was just your eyes playing tricks. Still rambling about "Lady Hsin in her maiden form"?
records.zh: 还说呢！说了是你眼花，还一口一个“少女模样的心大人”。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_38_1
records.text: 漂泊者... No, Lady Hsin's Arbiter. I've finally met you!
records.zh: 漂泊者……不，心大人的御者，终于见到你了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_39_1
records.text: Take the situation right now. Were it Hsin alone, it would've been impossibly difficult to remold the Civilization Capsule, and Mengzhou would be left with scars that could never heal.
records.zh: 好比现在，如果只有心自己，文明之匣难以重塑，梦州也会留下无法挽回的伤痛。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_12_1
records.text: 漂泊者! Look! The Fox Shadow is completely different from before! So I take it you and Lady Hsin have already dealt with Suhsin?
records.zh: 漂泊者！你看，狐影和之前大不一样了！溯心已经被你和心大人解决了？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_3_1
records.text: Still no sign of Her this year. Could it be... Lady Hsin won't ever come again?
records.zh: 今年还是没见到祂，难道……心月狐大人不会再来了？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_4_1
records.text: Granny! I gave the Gilded Ball to Lady Hsin! And She smiled back at me!
records.zh: 奶奶！我把玲珑球交给心月狐大人啦！祂还对我笑了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
records.text: Of course she did. Lady Hsin would never miss the heart behind it.
records.zh: 当然啦。玥儿的心意，心月狐大人一定收到了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
records.text: The uncles and aunties in the village look after me like their own. And I met Lady Hsin! Remember the Gilded Ball you gave me? I got to give it to Her, just like you asked!
records.zh: 村里的伯伯、阿姨都很照顾我，还见到了心月狐大人。奶奶交给我的玲珑球，我也送到了祂手里！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
records.text: I had the best time! Granny, you won't believe what happened! At first, Lady Hsin wasn't really Lady Hsin. Oh no, how do I explain this...
records.zh: 开心！奶奶，你听了一定会吓一跳！心月狐大人一开始……不是心月狐大人。哎呀，这要怎么说呀……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
records.text: Mm! Lady Hsin came with me to buy sugar paintings. Then we solved word riddles, took a boat ride, and watched the Loong dance! The performance was amazing!
records.zh: 嗯！心月狐大人陪我买了糖画，猜了字谜，后来又一起坐了小船，还看了舞龙呢，可威风啦！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
records.text: And at the end, we set off fireworks. They were huge! Lady Hsin flew up into the sky, and bursts spread out behind Her, all bright and sparkly... It was so, so beautiful.
records.zh: 最后还放了好大好大的烟花！心月狐大人飞到天上，烟花就在祂身后，一闪一闪的……特别漂亮。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
records.text: Exactly. Oh, if your granny knew that you met Lady Hsin, and you delivered that Gilded Ball on her behalf... She'd be so proud.
records.zh: 对，若你奶奶知道，你真的见到了心月狐大人，还替她送出了玲珑球……一定很高兴。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
records.text: I did. Lady Hsin will surely be glad to read it too. I just hope I get to see Her this year.
records.zh: 是呀，心月狐大人看了一定会开心，希望今年能见到祂。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
records.text: Oh? We must've gone to the Festival at the same time. I met Lady Hsin, too.
records.zh: 哦？看来去年我们参加的是同一场朝月会呢，我也见到祂了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
records.text: But Granny always said I had to hand the Gilded Ball to Lady Hsin myself. So I went.
records.zh: 可是奶奶说，要我把玲珑球亲手交给心月狐大人，我就去了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_8_1
records.text: If even the artifacts Lady Hsin made are failing, then Her condition must be...
records.zh: 如果连心大人亲设的物件都效果欠佳，那祂的状态恐怕……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_9_1
records.text: Here's how it is. Long ago, Lady Hsin used Her power of Fractal Proliferation to create the Nexus Fox Shadow. She entrusted it to watch over the entire Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, and lend us aid whenever we called.
records.zh: 嗯……是这样的，当初心大人用自身分形权能，塑造了天罗狐影，祂让狐影代替自己俯瞰梦枢天罗全境，随时为我们伸出援手。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_9_1
records.text: So, if the authority sustaining the Fox Shadow is starting to falter, then Lady Hsin... I'm sorry. That's all we can say.
records.zh: 所以，若连维系狐影的权能都开始动摇，那心大人……抱歉，我们只能说到这了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_9_1
records.text: Got it. Don't worry, Hsin and I will solve it together.
records.zh: 好，放心吧，我会和心一起解决这件事。

records.text: Do something with your invincible scissors, Chisa.
records.zh: 对它使出你无敌的剪刀吧，千咲。

records.text: (I remember now. Galbrena once told me about them.)
records.zh: （想起来了，嘉贝莉娜……曾和我提起过这样的磁带。）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_1_2
records.text: Some time later, you return to the Black Shores to visit Chisa. Valentina tells you that the connection between Honami's Sonoro and the real world is stabilizing. Chisa has completed her treatment and shows no serious lingering Overclocking symptoms. However, she recently went back to Honami alone for reasons unknown. Her guide, KU-Shosho, might know more.
records.zh: 一段时间后，你回到黑海岸探望千咲，在瓦莲京娜处得知穗波市的索诺拉和现实的连接已经变得稳定。千咲在近期结束了封闭治疗，身上没留下显著的超频后遗症。但让人意外的是，千咲在不久前独自前往了穗波市，具体原因不明。或许，这些天负责指引千咲的泰缇斯终端了解一些情况……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_4
records.text: Not long after, Shorekeeper arrives. It turns out Chisa already met her while recovering in the Black Shores. Later, Buling arrives and lightens the mood. Although Chisa has heard of her from you, this is their first meeting. Namipon then leads Buling inside.
records.zh: 一段时间后，你们在咖啡厅门口迎接了守岸人。原来千咲在黑海岸休养时，就已经和守岸人认识了。稍晚到场的卜灵活跃了现场的气氛，尽管千咲听你提起过卜灵，但这次是她们第一次见面。波仔带着卜灵先一步进了咖啡厅。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_5
records.text: Buling tells you that Honami feels quiet, likely because many of the "people" who once lived there have already faded away.
records.zh: 卜灵表示现在的穗波市很安静，大概是因为许多生活在这里的“人”都已经消散了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_26
records.text: The radio suddenly picks up a signal from outside the Sonoro. On a talk show hosted by the Pioneer Association, special guest Aalto recounts an incident he dealt with in Lilyland, where someone attempted to resell the Troupe of Fools' tour tickets at outrageous prices...
records.zh: 收音机似乎收到了索诺拉之外的信号。先约电台的访谈节目上，特邀嘉宾秋水谈起了他在莉莉兰德解决的一起事件。当时，有人企图高价倒卖愚人剧团巡演的门票……

records.text: Glad to have you. Mr. Aalto, why don't you start us off with the Lilyland incident?
records.zh: 秋水先生，请讲讲您在莉莉兰德解决的那起事件吧。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_30
records.text: From Shorekeeper, you learn that no other guests are expected. Of everyone invited, only Shorekeeper, Encore, and Buling were able to come. Encore turned down the invite, choosing instead to finish the homework assigned by the Tethys System. Her newfound dedication to studying might be because Chisa tutored her in math during her time spent in the Haven of Sprouts...
records.zh: 你在守岸人处得知接下来大概没有其他客人了。原来你给的邀请名单上，今天还留在黑海岸的只有守岸人、安可和卜灵。安可不知为何拒绝了派对的邀请，决心要完成泰缇斯系统布置的作业。究其原因，或许是因为千咲在新枝地休养时曾给安可辅导过数学习题……

records.text: From the guest list you provided, only Encore, Buling, and myself were free to come. The others are either away or currently on assignment.
records.zh: 你给的邀请名单上，今天留在黑海岸的只有安可、卜灵还有我。其他人或是外出，或是执行任务去了。

records.text: "Safety risk, moderate. Further surveillance is needed." That'll do as the report for Valentina for now.
records.zh: 安全风险适中，留待进一步观察——先这么回复瓦莲京娜吧。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_4_6
records.text: Near the rift, Platya finds the radio Chisa had taken outside the cafe earlier. It's now emitting heavy static. Namipon, seeming to recall something, asks you to adjust the receiver.
records.zh: 不知为何，桔梗在裂隙周围捡到了早上千咲拿到咖啡厅外的收音机。现在收音机正发出嘈杂不清的声音，波仔似乎想到了什么，拜托你调节一下它的接收频率。

records.text: ...It really has been a long time since I've been home. How are they doing? I wonder what Mingting is like now.
records.zh: ……说起来，确实很久没回去了，不知道父亲母亲，还有明庭现在是什么样子。

records.text: I visited them recently. They're in wonderful form, as spry as ever. I heard they're even planning a little trip to Chongzhou next month.
records.zh: 我前段时间顺道回去看望过了，他们精力可好啦，听说下个月还要去重州旅游呢。

records.text: Suisui, no matter what, I'll always be your little sister. That's the one thing that will never change.
records.zh: 不管怎样，我是姐姐的妹妹。这件事，无论如何也不会改变的。

records.text: Hurry up! Come on! Yangyang, Baizhi! We're almost at the Gorges of Spirits!
records.zh: 快快快，秧秧，白芷，我们就要到云陵谷啦！

records.text: Chixia, Baizhi, the Streams... They just brought back a new message...
records.zh: ……炽霞，白芷，流息里……好像有新的讯息……

records.text: The figure draws Yangyang into a Sonoro Sphere that recreates the landscape of the Gorges of Spirits. There, the figure reveals that Yangyang meeting you carried an indelible significance, and her that her path as the Votary of the Voice is about to begin. When Yangyang asks about the figure's identity, it simply replies that it is merely the echo of a passing breeze before dissolving.
records.zh: 光影将秧秧带到了一处索诺拉内，此处复现的，是曾经云陵谷的光景。光影告诉秧秧，她与你的相遇有着不可磨灭的重大意义，并提醒秧秧，她作为祀声之人的旅途也即将开始。秧秧询问光影的身份，光影回答她，自己只是一道风残留的声音，随后便消散而去了。

records.text: Our tech is standard across the world. Even if you went to Mingting, the results would still be the same.
records.zh: 华胥研究院的技术各地互通，即便到明庭去，应该也只能得出一样的结果。

records.text: Huff... Huff... 漂泊者! I have a delivery for you! It's from Huanglong!
records.zh: 呼……呼……漂泊者！有你的快件！瑝珑来的！

records.text: Please forgive Sanhua. I truly did not share my whereabouts with her.
records.zh: ……还请谅解散华的所为，我确实没有告诉她我到底去了哪里。

records.text: Madam Sanhua, I do believe it's been two whole hours. Will you be taking me to see the Magistrate or not?
records.zh: 散华侍卫，我已在这坐了足足有两个时辰，是否可带我去见今令尹了？

records.text: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.
records.zh: ……放心吧，炽霞，我会带秧秧回来的。

records.text: 漂泊者, Sanhua told me about your situation. I take it you'll be heading to Xuanfang Hold soon?
records.zh: 漂泊者，散华侍卫和我说了你的事，你接下来，应该是要出发去玄方城吧。

records.text: To reach Xuanfang from Jinzhou, we'll need to cross through the Dreaming Cavern, north of the Gorges of Spirits. Since you've never been, I'll lead the way.
records.zh: 自今州取道至玄方地界，需要穿过云陵谷以北的梦窟。你应该还没去过，就让我带路吧。

records.text: Yeah... we haven't run into any of those Autopuppets Xiangli Yao mentioned yet.
records.zh: 嗯……暂时也没遇到相里要所说的「机傀」。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_拉海洛今州_53_6
records.text: You and Suisui arrive at Shaftpost Yard in the Southern Yuan Hills and find the area completely unguarded. To be safe, Suisui gives you a locator paired with her own.
records.zh: 你与穗穗抵达了位于落渊南丘的井栈，发现此处已经空无一人。为了以防万一，穗穗将一枚一式两份的发讯器交予你。

records.text:
Dear Rover,

How are you finding your time at Startorch Academy? I find myself wondering how long the sunlight I basked in today will take to reach you.

Lately... I have been having the same dream. In it, I am alone in the Gorges of Spirits, running and running... And just when it seems I am about to find something, something always pulls me back to reality.

Does that sound like I am complaining? Forgive me. Once in a while, I hope you will not mind if I write like this.

Oh, yes. Some time ago, my older sister said she wanted to come visit me in Jinzhou. It's been years since we last saw each other. I wonder what she is like now, but knowing her, I think she must still be the same sister I remember. I would like to introduce you two someday. I'm sure you would become very good friends.  

I assume by the time you receive this letter, Chixia and I will be on an assignment together. Things have been a little unsettled in Jinzhou lately, but do not worry. Just as you have sharpened your blade through so many stories and trials, I would like to think I have grown too, since the day we first met.

So next time, let me be the one to share my "adventures" with you, Rover.

Sincerely,
Yangyang

P.S. I've also included some seasonal snacks for Abby. Do share them with your friends at Lahai-Roi. I hope they are to everyone's liking.
records.zh:
漂泊者：
       不知你在星炬学院过得还好么？今天所照拂我的阳光，要隔多久才能到你那儿去呢？
       最近……我偶尔会做一个梦。梦见自己独自一人身处云陵谷，不断地跑着跑着……每当我像是要找到什么的时候，却总会被什么推回到现实中去。
       这段话……像是在发牢骚吗？抱歉，偶尔，也让我写一点吧。
       对了，前段时间，姐姐说要来今州看我。我们之间已经几年没见了，不知道姐姐现在成了什么样，不过我想，按姐姐的性格，应该还是我记忆中的模样吧。如果能介绍你们认识就好了，你们肯定能成为很好的朋友。
       等你收到这封信的时候，我应该就要协助炽霞出任务了。最近今州有些不安宁，但不必担心，就像你已经用了那么多的故事去磨砺自己的剑一样，我想，自我们初见以来，我应该也有所成长。
       所以，等到下次，就由我给你讲述我这次的“冒险”吧，漂泊者。
秧秧

       也给阿布带了些应时的点心，和拉海洛的朋友们一起吃吧，希望能合大家的口味。

records.text: (These must be the "rogue Autopuppets" Chixia's report mentioned...)
records.zh: （这应该就是炽霞她们提到的「异常机傀」……）

records.text: Could it be—you're the one from the Battle of Norfall Barrens? The one who fought alongside General Jiyan and drove back the Threnodian Ovathrax... 漂泊者?
records.zh: 莫非——你就是之前那场北落野之役里，和忌炎将军一起，击退鸣式无相燹主的那个……漂泊者？

records.text: Yes. My name is Liangyu, and I serve under Mengzhou's Ministry of War, as part of the Xuan Triad. But now, I'm the only one left...
records.zh: ……我叫椋羽，梦州玄方城军策府下属后玄三骑——话是这么说，如今后玄三骑，也只剩我一个……

records.text: I sent a few scouts to search the Eastern Xuan Peaks area, but we failed to locate her trail.
records.zh: 那之后，我也派了几个斥候在玄幽东岳附近搜查过，但没发现她的踪迹……

records.text: (Now that she mentions it, Suisui did give me... one of her letters?)
records.zh: （说起来，穗穗之前给我的……一封……信？）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_拉海洛今州_53_13
records.text: Guided by the Rafter Kite, you manage to escape the fog but lose contact with Suisui. Nearby, you encounter Liangyu, a Xuanfang Warden. She explains that rogue Autopuppets and escaped Tacet Discords are now threatening the land, but that she had traveled with Yangyang days prior and the letter Suisui found was indeed written by Yangyang.
records.zh: 你在梁鸢的带领下成功走出了迷雾，却在途中与穗穗失散。此时，一名名叫椋羽的定玄卫正在井栈附近徘徊，经过与她的交流，你得知了玄方地界此刻正在经历的危机——机傀叛乱，残象外逃。好消息是，几天之前，秧秧曾与椋羽同行过一段时间，而穗穗此前发现的信件，似乎正是秧秧所写。

records.text: (Locator readings are normal. Suisui's safe for now...)
records.zh: （定位器上的指数正常，说明穗穗现在还平安无事……）

records.text: We have to get word back... to Xuanfang Hold...
records.zh: 我们得……把消息……带到玄方城——

records.text: Watcher Liangyu! Someone's fighting the Autopuppets over there!
records.zh: 椋羽骑使——那边有人在和机傀交战——！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_28
records.text: After exchanging information with Liangyu, Yangyang volunteers to help the Xuanfang Wardens evacuate the villagers to safety.
records.zh: 在与椋羽简短交换情报之后，秧秧主动请求协助定玄卫们，带领村民撤离到安全的地方。

records.text: ...Name's Liangyu. I'm a Xuan Watcher under the Ministry of War, stationed at Xuanfang Hold. This is Xianling Village, at the foot of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Most folks here are locals.
records.zh: ……我叫椋羽，玄方城军策府所属后玄骑使。这里是衔翎村，背靠玄幽东岳，在这里住下的几乎都是玄方地界本地人。

records.text: Jinzhou hasn't been informed... Mengzhou won't answer... What is all this...? Tch—!
records.zh: 今州还不知情……梦州那边又没回应……这一切到底……啧——！

records.text: Liangyu gives Yangyang a brief account of events.
records.zh: 椋羽简单地向秧秧讲述了事件的经过。

records.text: Xiaoyi, pack your things. We're going to Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 小翼，收拾收拾东西，我们要到玄方城去了。

records.text: (Come to think of it, it was this little thing that led Liangyu and the Wardens to my aid before.)
records.zh: （说起来……之前它也引了椋羽他们来帮我……）

records.text: He... he's been missing ever since Liangyu came back...
records.zh: 他……从椋羽回来后就不见了……

records.text: (But that moment in the Gorges of Spirits, the first time we met, is a reality we share that no number of dreams could ever erase.)
records.zh: （然而，那场在云陵谷的邂逅，我们最初的相遇，是无论再多的梦也无法抹去的，属于我们的现实。）

records.text: A leader cannot afford to show weakness before the ranks. Liangyu is too proud for that. She will only bury it inside.
records.zh: 领兵之人，不可在将士面前露怯。椋羽性格要强，恐怕只会把这些心绪咽进肚里。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_5
records.text: A Xuanfang Warden named Yanlang confides that Liangyu recently lost two comrades to Autopuppet ambushes. Out of concern, he asks Yangyang to keep an eye on Liangyu.
records.zh: 在与定玄卫颜朗的交谈中，秧秧得知椋羽的两名战友皆在不久前死于机傀的袭击中，颜朗出于对晚辈的关心，希望秧秧能够对她施以关照。

records.text: Liangyu said you're an Outrider from Jinzhou? I should have guessed. The front lines against Tacet Discords do not breed ordinary soldiers. Only the finest make it there.
records.zh: 听椋羽说，你是从今州来的踏白？不愧是抗击残象潮的第一线，一兵一卒都堪称精锐。

records.text: But now the Autopuppets have turned on us, the Paragon is trapped in a Censure Court, and of the Triad, only Liangyu remains... Even if we retreat to the Hold, we still will not be able to stop what's coming.
records.zh: 但现在，机傀倒戈，镇玄司骑被困在咎庭，后玄三骑也只剩下椋羽一人……说实话，即便退守玄方城，我们也根本拦不住机傀和残象的攻势。

records.text: If you are willing, comrade, do us one favor. Look after Liangyu.
records.zh: 这位袍泽，如果你愿意，还请替我们关照一下椋羽的情况。

records.text: (His sister must've been in Liangyu's unit...)
records.zh: （他的姐姐……应该就是椋羽的队友……）

records.text: You... you were the one speaking with Liangyu earlier.
records.zh: 您是……刚才与椋羽说话的那位……

records.text: Yes. I am Qiankun, the village chief. I have watched over Liangyu since she was just a child.
records.zh: 嗯……老拙是衔翎村的村长，椋羽那孩子算是老拙看着长大的。

records.text: Forgive me, Grandmother. But my mind is made. My husband never came home. A Xuanling brought word that he was slain by Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits...
records.zh: 对不住，阿婆。可我已经决定好了。囡囡她爹没能回来，玄翎告诉我，他是在云陵谷被残象所害……

records.text: Once this war is over, I... will return to Mengzhou for you.
records.zh: 等打完这场仗，我……再去梦州接你们。

records.text: Would you do an old man a favor? Take this sword and pass it to Liangyu. Let the Wardens carry it back to the Hold.
records.zh: 不知姑娘可否帮老拙一个忙，取下这把剑，将它交予椋羽，让定玄卫们把剑带到玄方城？

records.text: (The Chief was right... I should go talk to Liangyu.)
records.zh: （按村长先生说的，去找椋羽聊聊吧。）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_26
records.text: Yangyang presents the blade to Liangyu and relays the chief's wish. Overwhelmed by anxiety, Liangyu refuses to take it, so Yangyang decides to keep it for now. Seeing how disheartened Liangyu is by the loss of her comrades, Yangyang steps in to comfort her.
records.zh: 秧秧带着长剑找到了椋羽，并告诉了她村长的意愿。由于椋羽因焦虑拒绝了保管剑的请求，秧秧便决定代为保管。见此时的椋羽正因战友的死伤处于失落之中，秧秧决定同她谈一谈……

records.text: Was that how you all felt, too? During the Battle of Norfall Barrens?
records.zh: ……在那场北落野之役里，你们也是这么想的吗？

records.text: But Liangyu, we're soldiers. We have our duties. This is no time to indulge ourselves.
records.zh: 但是椋羽，我们是军人，我们有职责在身，不能在这种时候任性。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_26
records.text: Yangyang comforts Liangyu with a few gentle words and sings a song she heard from Liangyu earlier to ease the tense, suffocating atmosphere hanging over the village.
records.zh: 秧秧用简短的话语稳定了椋羽的情绪，并唱起了她先前从椋羽口中听到的歌谣。村子内原本紧张压抑的氛围被秧秧的歌声冲淡了不少。

records.text: Watcher Liangyu, a Skywatch Ring has detected Autopuppets moving this way. They will reach Xianling Village in about two hours.
records.zh: 椋羽骑使，「巡霄环」监测到有机傀正往这里行进，预计再有两个小时就会抵达衔翎村。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_2_22
records.text: When Xuanfang Warden Mingyu reports incoming Autopuppet movements, Yangyang volunteers to scout the Eastern Xuan Peaks to map a safe retreat route in place of their missing scouts.
records.zh: 定玄卫明煜向椋羽汇报机傀的动向，秧秧主动请缨，代替许久未归的斥候前往玄幽东岳探查安全的撤退路线。

records.text: The Eastern Xuan Peaks are treacherous, and the Disorienting Fog hangs thick through much of it. Be careful.
records.zh: 玄幽东岳地势险峻，而且还散布着大量隐息雾，路上多加小心。

records.text: (That must be the garrison camp Liangyu mentioned.)
records.zh: （应该就是椋羽提到的营地吧。）

records.text: So Watcher Liangyu sent you to map a route. Good! We've been waiting a long time.
records.zh: 原来如此……椋羽骑使派你来测绘路线，太好了，终于等到了。

records.text: No time to lose. We must send word to Liangyu immediately.
records.zh: ……事不宜迟，我们现在就立刻通知椋羽骑使。

records.text: In Xianling Village, I met Liangyu. She is young, yet she already holds the title of Xuan Watcher. She told me of the chaos that has swept across Xuanfang. Her squadmates were slaughtered in a Censure Court.
records.zh: ……在衔翎村，我认识了椋羽，她年纪很轻，但已经是玄方城的「后玄骑使」。是她告诉我玄方地界近日的异变，而她的同伴此前牺牲在了咎庭中……

records.text: Watcher Liangyu! The Hold is answering our signal!
records.zh: 椋羽骑使！城内有回应了！

records.text: Liangyu, one of us has to stay behind to hold them off...
records.zh: 椋羽小妹，看样子，我们中得有人留下来断后啊……

records.text: Liangyu, you are our captain now. Don't lose sight of that.
records.zh: 椋羽，现在你是这里的指挥官，别忘了你肩上的职责。

records.text: Heh... Now you sound... just like... little Liangyu.
records.zh: 呵呵……你怎么跟……椋羽小妹……说一样的话……

records.text: Zhuojun Atelier... Liangyu mentioned them... a Mengzhou organization devoted to the mechanist arts.
records.zh: 琢钧堂……椋羽提到过……那是梦州的机关术组织……

records.text: This is no time to return to the Hold. I must get to the Western Fang Peaks, now. I must not dally.
records.zh: 不不不，现在不是回城的时候。我得到方擎西峰一趟，时间紧迫，可等不得了。

records.text: The Western Fang Peaks houses the Skyworks, Xuanfang's largest Autopuppet production plant and Tacet Discord disposal facility. If that place falls, rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords will spill into every corner of Xuanfang. The consequences are unthinkable.
records.zh: 方擎西峰，坐落着玄方地界最大的机傀生产工厂，以及残象的销毁炉——悬天构。一旦那里沦陷，异常机傀和残象一并涌入玄方地界各处，后果不堪设想。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_2_19
records.text: A voice pulls Yangyang out of the Sonoro Sphere. Before her stands Muyu, an Artisan from the Ministry of Development, who claims that clues to the Autopuppet rebellion lie in the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks. Sensing something amiss but needing answers, Yangyang decides to head into the Skyworks with him.
records.zh: 秧秧被一道问候声从索诺拉拉回现实，一名自称木禺的天工匠人出现在了她面前。他表示，方擎西峰的悬天构中，或许藏有机傀暴乱的线索。秧秧虽有些许异样的预感，但她还是决定暂时与木禺同行，一起前往悬天构一探究竟。

records.text: But the ruins of Yuan Fortress lie between the Eastern and Western Fang Peaks. How do you plan to get there?
records.zh: 但是，玄幽东岳与方擎西峰之间隔着废弃的渊城，你打算怎么前往那里？

records.text: There's an old passage through the ruins that connects to the Western Fang Peaks. Rarely used now, but I know of it.
records.zh: 虽然极少使用，但我知道一条自渊城取道至方擎西峰的旧路。

records.text: Something's not right, Chixia. Ready your weapon.
records.zh: 炽霞，有些不对劲，拿出武器。

records.text: (Abby's completely lost in a fantasy world now...)
records.zh: （已经完全沉浸在幻想里了……）

records.text: All eyes are watching Ashinohara now. In Lucilla's words, it is a "complicated and troublesome adult world." And the appearance of the Miko of Flaming Sakura would only complicate things further.
records.zh: 现在各方都在注意着苇原的情况，用洛瑟菈的说法是“比较复杂、麻烦的大人世界”，灼樱巫女的出现只会让事情变得更复杂。

records.text: The Fractsidus. The Threnodian... Perhaps even something rooted within Ashinohara itself. I will have to see with my own eyes to know.
records.zh: 残星会、鸣式……也有可能是苇原内部的问题……得亲眼看看才知道了。

records.text: Nothing of value. Lucilla made inquiries on my behalf. There have been discoveries of peculiar frequency traces where Ashinohara's center once lay. Investigations are ongoing.
records.zh: 没什么有价值的消息，洛瑟菈帮我打听过，苇原曾经的中心上倒是有一些奇怪的频率残留，各方也都在查。

records.text: Well, it all started back at the Gorges of Spirits...
records.zh: 这还要从云陵谷开始说起……

records.text: Huanglong, the New Federation, even the frontiers of civilization I myself have never set foot in...
records.zh: 瑝珑、新联邦，或者是那些连我都不曾抵达的文明边界。

records.text: Don't beat yourself up, Zhezhi. You've already been a big help.
records.zh: 别自责，折枝，你已经帮了很大的忙了。

records.text: That means... you'll end up in the New Federation sooner or later, right?
records.zh: 那……以后，某一天，你肯定也会去新联邦吧？

records.text: I'm... I'm alright. Liangyu, the civilians... did everyone make it back to the city?
records.zh: 嗯……嗯……我没事，椋羽，大家都平安撤回城里了吗？

records.text: Liangyu contacts the nearby Xuanfang Wardens. After arranging for the civilians to be escorted to safety, you prepare to head toward Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 椋羽联系上了在附近驻扎的定玄卫，众人安排完护送平民的事宜后，准备前往玄方城。

records.text: The frequency trace ends northwest of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Either it's heading somewhere a Skywatch Ring cannot monitor, or...
records.zh: 频率的踪迹到玄幽东岳西北方位就断掉了……可能是到了「巡霄环」监视不到的地方，也可能……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_梦州主线_中_1_1
records.text: Tracking Yangyang's frequency, you trace her movements over the past few days in Xuanfang. Following the clues from her letter, you head to the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks for more answers. Liangyu joins you, determined to find out why the Autopuppets went rogue.
records.zh: 通过追踪秧秧的频率，你了解了这几日秧秧在玄方地界的行迹。根据秧秧在信上留下的线索，你决定前往位于方擎西峰的悬天构一探究竟。而椋羽为了查明机傀暴乱的真相，也选择和你同行。

records.text: A factory in the Western Fang Peaks. It is where Xuanfang Hold produces its Autopuppets and "disposes" of Tacet Discords.
records.zh: 那里是位于方擎西峰的工厂，玄方城生产机傀，以及「销毁」残象的地方。

records.text: ...Miss Suisui, you are claiming you entered into a direct deal with Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox?
records.zh: ……穗穗小姐，你是说，你与岁主心月狐有一个交易？

records.text: Miss Suisui, you're wondering if that Prism of Fate can be used to find Yangyang, aren't you?
records.zh: 穗穗小姐，你是在想，那枚「宿镜」是否能用来寻找秧秧，对吧？

records.text: (I suspect it is the same one I attended back in Mengzhou.)
records.zh: （恐怕，是当初在梦州，我参加过的那场……）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_穗穗线_玩法副本_1_3_19
records.text: Hsin the Moon Fox projects a reality-based deduction of the current world crisis to make Suisui understand Her concerns.
records.zh: 心月狐借由索诺拉复现的场景，希望穗穗理解祂如今的处境，并展开了一场基于现实的推演……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_梦州主线_中_12_1
records.text: Suisui secures the Sentinel's token and leaves the pagoda. Sensing a sudden anomaly erupting from the Western Fang Peaks, she asks Dumpling to deliver the token directly to your hands.
records.zh: 成功取得岁主信物的穗穗离开了雾隐阁。与此同时，她察觉到了自方擎西峰传来的异象。为此，她拜托水饺，将岁主信物送到你的手上。

records.text: Could it be the woman we encountered in Jinzhou? Scar's companion?
records.zh: 难道，是之前在今州出现的，那个伤痕的同伴？

records.text: Let's find Liangyu and the Warden Commander. Maybe they can help us make sense of these leads.
records.zh: 带着这些线索去找椋羽和定玄卫长吧，说不定他们听了之后，能有一些新的头绪。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_决战_4_1_1
records.text: You, Yangyang, and Suisui exchange the intel you have gathered. Piecing the clues together, Suisui believes that Zhuojun Atelier, a prominent Automata Mechanics organization based in Mengzhou, is heavily implicated. To gather more evidence, you seek out the Warden Commander and Liangyu.
records.zh: 你与秧秧、穗穗各自交换了取得的信息。结合已有的情报，穗穗认为扎根于梦州的机关术组织——琢钧堂有着重大嫌疑，为了取得更多的线索，你们决定去寻找定玄卫长与椋羽。

records.text: Don't say that, Suisui. It's over now. You've carried that burden alone for far too long.
records.zh: 别这么说，姐姐。都过去了，你肯定也一个人承担了很多压力。

records.text: ...You three must be the ones Liangyu spoke of. In these desperate hours, your willingness to stand with us is a comfort beyond words. I, Qiuhong, owe you a debt!
records.zh: ……三位想必就是椋羽提到的协助者了。如今玄方城战情窘迫，三位的义举无异于雪中送炭，秋鸿感激不尽！

records.text: Commander Qiuhong, there are things we need to discuss with you and Liangyu.
records.zh: 秋鸿卫长，我们有些事想与您和椋羽商议。

records.text: I discovered the connection in a dossier collected by the Commanders who came before me. Everyone knows when the Threnodian stirred at Norfall Barrens and Tacet Discords swelled beyond control, Sentinel Hsin looked ahead. She chose to build this Hold.
records.zh: 这也是我闲暇时查阅历代定玄卫长留下的卷宗时看到的。当年，在北落野的鸣式复苏，残象潮愈演愈烈之际，岁主心未雨绸缪，决定修建玄方——这是众人皆知的事实。

records.text: I remember Xiangli Yao telling me that a group from the Court of Savantae once came to Mengzhou...
records.zh: 我记得相里要和我说过……曾经有一群稷廷的人来到了梦州……

records.text: Xuanfang Hold... It's like... we're in the past again.
records.zh: 这里是玄方城……似乎……我们又回到了过去。

records.text: I brought back the blade you entrusted to Liangyu. There was... some trouble along the way, but I managed to keep it safe.
records.zh: 对了，您让椋羽保管的这柄剑……虽然途中经过了一些波折，不过我完好地带回来了。

records.text: (She's the one I saw in those memories. She and Liangyu... Could it be...)
records.zh: （她……就是之前在记忆里看到的那位……难道说……她是椋羽的……）

records.text: Oh? I did not expect to be recognized so far from Mengzhou.
records.zh: 欸……没想到出了梦州，居然还有人认识我啊。

records.text: Others might have seen only an ordinary painter, but I saw the colors within him. He walked away from a chance to study at the Mingting Institute of Art, all to stay in the hometown he loved so dearly.
records.zh: 我的丈夫，在别人看来没什么特别的，一个落魄画家而已。但我知道，他曾有去明庭画院的机会，只是舍不得这片育他长大的家乡。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_决战_4_4_2
records.text: Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see the memories of Lingfang, Liangyu's ancestor from two hundred years ago. Her husband had been killed by Tacet Discords, and she was about to march onto the battlefield. Before departing, she sang the familiar song once more as a thank-you to Yangyang for comforting her.
records.zh: 在索诺拉中，你与秧秧见到了椋羽两百年前的祖先——铃坊。铃坊的丈夫被残象所杀，而她此刻也即将要踏上战场。临行之际，为感谢秧秧对她的宽慰，铃坊再度唱起了那首熟悉的歌谣……

records.text: Liangyu? Liang... Yu... Hmm. A beautiful name, but it is not mine.
records.zh: 椋羽？椋……羽……真不错，念起来很好听。可惜，我不叫这个名字。

records.text: You mentioned earlier that the Sentinel of Mengzhou is missing?
records.zh: 之前你说，梦州的岁主如今失联了？

records.text: We should let Baizhi and the others know we're safe.
records.zh: 得向白芷他们报个平安。

records.text: Yes, I want to know how Chixia's recovery is going.
records.zh: 嗯，我也想知道炽霞恢复得怎么样了。

records.text: Liangyu has the makings of a leader, but she pushed herself to the brink of Overclocking to defend the Hold. She's currently at Huaxu Academy receiving treatment.
records.zh: 椋羽虽然已经可堪大任，但她在守城时拼死顽战，一度陷入超频，现在还在华胥研究院接受治疗。

records.text: 漂泊者, let's find somewhere quiet to call Baizhi.
records.zh: 漂泊者，我们找个地方给白芷打个通讯吧。

records.text: My voicemail is... wait. Ninety-nine missed calls?! Baizhi, Zhezhi, Taoqi, Suisui, Jianxin... even Magistrate Jinhsi called!
records.zh: 我确认一下留言箱，九十九个未接来电……！？白芷、折枝、桃祈、姐姐、鉴心，还有今令尹……！？

records.text: You're one to talk, Baizhi! Weren't you just—Mmph!
records.zh: 你还说我白芷！你不也——唔——

records.text: Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, has gone missing.
records.zh: 梦州的岁主心月狐，如今似乎下落不明。

records.text: I want to visit Liangyu at Huaxu Academy first. If you have things to do, 漂泊者, we can meet at the Ministry afterwards.
records.zh: 我想顺道去华胥研究院看望一下椋羽，如果漂泊者还有别的事，我们之后在军策府会合吧。

records.text: Hehe. I had planned to wait until Changli returned from Mingting, but I found myself growing a bit restless.
records.zh: 呵呵，本来想等长离老师从明庭回来后再联络你们，但我还是有点等不及。

records.text: Yangyang, would you be willing to serve as a Xuan Watcher during this time? I believe Liangyu would be happy to hear it.
records.zh: 秧秧，可否请你在这段时间，出任后玄骑使一职？我想，椋羽应该也很乐意听到这个消息。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_梦州主线_中_1_5
records.text: As you pursue Muyu, you rescue Uncle Dong, who was kidnapped and brought to Xuanfang. He tells you and Liangyu that all the missing citizens from Jinzhou have been imprisoned in the Skyworks by unidentified thugs.
records.zh: 在深入悬天构的途中，你解救下了被绑架至玄方地界的董叔。从董叔的口中，你与椋羽得知，今州此前失踪的人，都是被身份不明的歹徒囚禁在了悬天构中。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_15_1
records.text: It's a multinational project. It's inevitable some New Federation methodologies get in the mix.
records.zh: 这可是多国联合的项目，有一些新联邦来的技术也不奇怪。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_35_1
records.text: I do. I'm not a Startorch student anymore. Rules are rules, and I should return to the New Federation.
records.zh: 我知道，我已经不是星炬学院的学生，按照规定，应该遣返回新联邦。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_深空联合主线_上半_2_2_3
records.text: Yep. They connect Lahai-Roi to the surface frostlands. But with all these Void Storms, surface trips—except for the supply runs—are on hold. Every train turns back here once it reaches the Institute.
records.zh: 嗯，这就是连通拉海洛和地上冰原的列车，最近虚质磁暴频繁，除了必要的补给班次，前往地上的列车全都暂时停运了，所有车在抵达研究院之后就会回返。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_深空联合主线_上半_2_2_7
records.text: See that? That's the lift to the surface. We call it the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: 那个啊，就是通往地上的运载电梯——联运椎骨。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_深空联合主线_上半_2_1_30
records.text: Massive cultivation tanks house many ancient plant species you've never seen on the surface. Life was once scarce in these underground caverns, until the Reactor Drive ignited here. In its relentless pursuit of progress, the Spacetrek Collective did not forget to retrieve the dormant seeds that slept beneath the Roya Frostlands.
records.zh: 巨大的培养仓中种植着许多你在地表未曾见过的古老植物，地下空洞中曾鲜有生命，直至炉芯于此点亮，深空联合在求索前行的过程中，也仍不忘拾起罗伊冰原之下沉睡的种子。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_24_1
records.text: One last thing, Miss Lynae. You're from the New Federation, right?
