records.zh: 对了，琳奈同学是来自新联邦吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_18_1
records.text: Professor Warren knows I'm from the New Federation, but not exactly which part.
records.zh: 魏尔伦教授说过我来自新联邦，但他不知道我来自新联邦的哪里。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_18_1
records.text: It's called the Lawless Zone. Let's just say... you'd see blood spilled every three days, on average. That's where I grew up.
records.zh: 那里被称为“无法地带”，无法的程度大概在……平均每活三天就要见一次血吧，我就是在那种地方长大的。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_18_1
records.text:
Lynae finally reveals her true identity: she is a former government-hired mercenary from the New Federation's "Lawless Zone." During a mission, she found an admission letter in one of the dead's belongings. Seeing a chance to escape her old life, she took on the dead girl's name and identity to enroll in Startorch Academy.
What she didn't expect was that the dead girl, the real "Lynae," had been a Fractsidus plant, sent to infiltrate the Academy. Wanting to stay in the place she's come to call home, she asks to work with you to uncover the truth and thwart the Fractsidus's plans.
She then takes out the device that caused Hyvatia's malfunction and prepares to investigate its origin in the Department of Engineering.
records.zh:
琳奈向你坦白了她的身份：她来自新联邦，曾是一个生活在“无法地带”，受政府雇佣的佣兵。在执行某次任务时，琳奈意外获得现场死者的录取通知书，她将它视作逃离组织的机会，顶替死去“琳奈”的身份，来到了星炬学院。
但让她没有想到的是，那位被她顶替身份的“琳奈”是残星会准备安插在学院中的内应，为了留在这个已经让她产生归属感的学院，她主动向你提出合作，与你联手追查事情的真相，阻止残星会的阴谋。
琳奈拿出了那个令海维夏失控的仪器，打算先去工学部调查线索。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_25_1
records.text: (Brief Luuk Herssen on your investigation and suspicions.)
records.zh: （向陆·赫斯说明了调查的过程和推论）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_26_1
records.text: ...Whichever "Lynae" I am, I don't belong here.
records.zh: ……但无论是哪个“琳奈”，都终究不属于这里。

records.text: A few days ago, I was shepherding mature Soliskin to Bjartr Woods when I met Foreseer Yngvar.
records.zh: ……前几天，我护送即将成熟的日灵前往浮光林，偶然间遇到了伊摩尔祭司。

records.text: Something isn't right. We seem to have a situation in Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 情况有些不对，浮光林里好像出事了。

records.text: But the Soliskin... many have already entered Bjartr Woods!
records.zh: 日灵……有许多日灵都已经进入浮光林了！

records.text: What is it that brings you here? With the Void Storm's fury upon us, it is no time to enter Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 二位怎么来了？浮光林内出现了虚质磁暴，现在不是进入的时候。

records.text: "Should a visitor from beyond Lahai-Roi protect Bjartr Woods from destruction, an invitation to Solisylum they will receive."
records.zh: “若有来自拉海洛之外的来访者，使浮光林免于毁灭之灾，便邀他进入引日殿。”

records.text: You witnessed the Void Storm in Bjartr Woods, yes?
records.zh: 您已经在浮光林中，见证了那场虚质磁暴了吧。

records.text: Then I'd finally escape from this frozen wasteland and go start a new life in the New Federation!
records.zh: ——就能送我离开这片封闭的苦寒之地，去新联邦开启新的生活！

records.text: So their plan wasn't just to disrupt the Heliogyre by unleashing the Void Storm in Bjartr Woods. They also planned to...
records.zh: 也就是说，他们向浮光林中投放虚质磁暴的真正目的远不止破坏日轮，还有……

records.text: That is a serious accusation, Professor Mornye.
records.zh: 这可是非常严重的指控，莫宁教授。

records.text: The Solisylum's people usually abide in the village bordering Bjartr Woods, called Haldarheim.
records.zh: 引日殿的相关者，平时都会居住在浮光林外，名为「赫尔琉斯」的村落中。

records.text: There's the other visitor in Bjartr Woods now, correct? Some crippled scientist.
records.zh: 浮光林还有一位来访者，对吧？是一位双腿不便的科学家。

records.text: That depends on Lucy... This is her Somnoire, after all.
records.zh: 这就取决于露西了……毕竟这里是她的心之集域。

records.text: Back in our world, David's already dead. And so are you, Rebecca... You both died that night. Adam Smasher killed you.
records.zh: 现实中的大卫已经死了。你也一样，丽贝卡，你们都在那个夜晚死在了亚当·重锤的手里。

records.text: Listen, Lucy... David and I are gone. Nothing's changin' that.
records.zh: 听好了，露西，我和大卫的死亡是无法改变的事实。

records.text: Lucy, I can't promise that you won't have nightmares again...
records.zh: 露西，我不能保证你今后是否还会陷入梦魇……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_3_5
records.text: As the Nightmare Tacet Discord fades, David and Rebecca's frequencies begin to disperse, too. Lucy embraces them both one last time as sunlight breaks through the sky.
records.zh: 随着梦魇残象的消失，大卫和丽贝卡的频率也逐渐开始消散。露西和二人拥抱道别，温柔注视着天空洒下的阳光。

records.text: Because I'll wipe Rebecca's record that way, duh... So second place is the goal.
records.zh: 那样的话，师傅的记录就会被消除了……所以，第二名就好。

records.text: Got no idea why... If David and Rebecca hadn't been there, I'd be...
records.zh: 我不知道……如果当时没有大卫和丽贝卡，我恐怕已经……

records.text: I know that, meow! Why do you think I didn't say this in front of Lucy or Rebecca?
records.zh: 这点我当然知道啦喵！所以我才没有当着露西和丽贝卡的面说这件事。

records.text: Lucy. We're tyin' up some loose ends here. Try to stay outta your hair.
records.zh: 露西。因为一些事我们要在这里停留。不会给你们添麻烦的。

records.text: 'Member that shard Rebecca found? Don't think it was random. It's tied to David, I'm sure of it.
records.zh: 还记得丽贝卡找到的频段吗？我认为它的出现并非偶然，和大卫一定存在着某种关联。

records.text: During the examination, I noted Lucy's psychological state isn't stable.
records.zh: 在先前的检查中，我注意到露西的精神状态并不稳定。

records.text: They have a connection to the Somnoire, don't they?
records.zh: 她们和心之集域有所关联，是吧？

records.text: I'll check with Rebecca first... Hm? Where'd she run off to?
records.zh: 先问问丽贝卡……嗯？她人去哪了？

records.text: I'll track her down. Luuk, keep an eye on Lucy for me.
records.zh: 我去找她吧。陆，这段时间露西就麻烦你照看了。

records.text: Of course. While you're at it, could you give Rebecca this Terminal?
records.zh: 好的。如果你去找丽贝卡，那刚好可以帮我把数据终端带给她。

records.text: Anyway, Lucy's been in there forever. What's the holdup?
records.zh: 说起来，露西这家伙都进去这么久了，怎么还没有消息？

records.text: This is Luuk Herssen. One of the Academy's doctors.
records.zh: 介绍下。这位是赫斯医生，星炬学院的校医。

records.text: Got a feeling that even when we find Rebecca, she's not going for that check-up.
records.zh: 总感觉就算找到丽贝卡，她也不愿意去接受检查。

records.text: I'm actually not very good at gaming. I lost every round until Rebecca showed up and gave me a hand.
records.zh: 我其实不是很擅长玩这个，玩了好几次都输了，后来是丽贝卡出现帮了我一把。

records.text: Yep! Let me introduce you. This is 漂泊者, and that's Rebecca.
records.zh: 是呀，我和你介绍！这位是漂泊者，那边那位是丽贝卡。

records.text: I just got a message from Lucy. She needs more time digging through the archives. Says to wait.
records.zh: 刚才露西发来消息。她让我们再等等，说自己还需要一些时间查阅资料。

records.text: I saw this symbol in Lucy's memories too. What does it mean?
records.zh: 我在露西的记忆中也看到过这个图案。它有什么含义吗？

records.text: I was about to contact you... It's about the Somnoire.
records.zh: 我刚好要找你……是关于心之集域的事。

records.text: Lucy, do you have the frequency band's shard with you?
records.zh: 露西，那块捡到的频段在你身上吗？

records.text: I'll explain. This shard Lucy recovered is part of what my colleague and I call a Dream Band.
records.zh: 我来解释一下喵。露西捡到的这个碎片，我和小黑称呼它为幻梦频段。

records.text: I do not know this "David," but from what I can tell, he is the embodiment of Lucy's happiness.
records.zh: 虽然我不认识你们所说的大卫，但根据现状来看他多半就是露西梦境的具象化。

records.text: The Nightmare Tacet Discord and the Dream Band were born in Lucy's dream. They are figments of her imagination.
records.zh: 幻梦频段和梦魇残象都是由露西梦境诞生的产物，是如同幻想一般的存在。

records.text: Oh, meow... This is more complicated than I thought. Lucy, you haven't told her the truth?
records.zh: 呜喵，事情看来比我想得更加复杂啊。露西，你还没有告诉丽贝卡真相吗？

records.text: While the Gatekeeper and I were researching solutions, Lucy contacted me...
records.zh: 在我和白色守门人研究解决方案的时候，露西小姐刚巧发来通讯……

records.text: Lucy... listen... Do not resist... Everything will be easier.
records.zh: 露西……只要……你放弃反抗……一切都会变得轻松。

records.text: Now let's discuss getting Lucy back home, meow.
records.zh: 我们来聊聊露西回去的事情吧喵。

records.text: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.
records.zh: 我们无法解析你的能力，但能通过研究还原出露西小姐她们武器的频率，将其作用在我们的武器上。

records.text: Both Lucy and Rebecca's weapons are capable of this. Rebecca's firearm, in particular, demonstrates remarkable efficacy against Nightmare Tacet Discords.
records.zh: 露西小姐和丽贝卡小姐的武器都可以做到这点。尤其是丽贝卡小姐的武器，对梦魇残象的伤害格外显著。

records.text: It will take a while to study your weapon, Ms. Rebecca. Do you have something to do in the meantime?
records.zh: 武器的研究还需要一段时间。丽贝卡小姐，你接下来有什么安排吗？

records.text: You can stop callin' me "Ms. Rebecca." Ain't my vibe, like, at all. Just Rebecca's fine.
records.zh: 加个称呼什么的也太见外了，直接叫我丽贝卡就好。

records.text: ...I see. Then what do you plan to do now, Rebecca?
records.zh: ……好。丽贝卡，你接下来有什么打算吗？

records.text: I should be on my way now. See you next time, Coach Rebecca!
records.zh: 那我先走一步去探望学姐了。丽贝卡老师，下次见！

records.text: I'm not a cat! I'm the Ivory Gatekeeper of the Somnoire!
records.zh: 我不是猫，是心之集域的白色守门人啦！

records.text: C'mon, I'm sure Rebecca's already got a plan, right?
records.zh: 这种事情丽贝卡应该早就考虑过了，对吧？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_2_12
records.text: Beyond the door lies the home David and Lucy once shared. Lucy looks at the familiar objects and begins to reminisce.
records.zh: 门扉后所连接的，是过去大卫和露西共同生活过的家。露西看着眼前这些熟悉的物件，开始回忆过去。

records.text: At the foot of Arasaka Tower that day... He killed Rebecca. Then he killed David.
records.zh: 那天的荒坂塔下，他亲手杀死了丽贝卡和大卫。

records.text: In the end, he did—I lived. But he and Rebecca... they died that night.
records.zh: 最后我活了下来，而他和丽贝卡却一起死在了那个夜晚。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_2_16
records.text: On the rooftop, Lucy watches the city lights below and slowly opens up about her past with David.
records.zh: 天台上，露西看着眼前的夜景，缓缓阐述她与大卫的过去。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_2_6
records.text: Lucy fights with everything she has, but is unable to defeat Smasher and collapses.
records.zh: 露西殊死抵抗，但最终还是不敌梦魇亚当·重锤，脱力倒下。

records.text: If not for you, David and Rebecca would have survived that night.
records.zh: 如果没有你，大卫和丽贝卡也不会死在那一晚。

records.text: Hello, hello! And please, just Aalto is fine. No need for that "honored sir" stuff...
records.zh: 您好您好，叫我秋水就行！我算不上什么“大人”哈……

records.text: Cup Noodles? Uh, thanks. And hey, just call me Aalto...
records.zh: 杯面？谢谢谢谢，不用加“长官”，叫秋水就行……

records.text: I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.
records.zh: 不过叫投资方，其实主要就是新联邦，实话说他们做出这种事我一点都不吃惊。

records.text: As you can see, Mr. Aalto, this is our signature "Sleep Learning Program."
records.zh: 秋水审查官，这是本校特色的“睡梦学习法”。

records.text: Shall we sit in for a bit, Mr. Aalto? Before we tour the student projects?
records.zh: 秋水审查官，不如我们在参观学生项目前稍微旁听一下？

records.text: Anyway, the New Federation and the majority of the board want to pull the plug immediately and draft a new teaching plan from scratch.
records.zh: 以新联邦为首的大部分董事要求立刻暂停适格者当前的教学计划，讨论新的草案。

records.text: So, whaddya say, Auditor Aalto? How about you order ten as a starter pack!
records.zh: 怎么样，秋水审查官，我们先定个十辆！

records.text: Chief Aalto! It was you, wasn't it?! You're the sponsor!
records.zh: 秋水长官，一定是您赞助的我们吧！

records.text: So, Mr. Aalto, shall we move on to the evening's special viewing?
records.zh: 秋水审查官，我们这就出发进行今晚的特别参观吧？

records.text: Sorry, Professor, Mr. Aalto... and Club Leader Lenie. I lost control. I'm... I'm really sorry...
records.zh: 对不起老师、秋水审查官，对不起莱妮社长，我失误了，我……对不起……

records.text: Change of plans. The New Federation caught wind she was rallying support and moved the review up.
records.zh: 新联邦发现洛瑟菈校长在联系支持者，于是将审查会提前了。

records.text: Fishing for intel. That Mr. Aalto must've put you up to it, right?
records.zh: 套我的话呀，秋水审查官肯定拜托你了吧？

records.text: Not a problem. For project funding approvals, we can follow the New Federation model.
records.zh: 没问题，项目的资金审批流程，我们可以沿用贵方在新联邦的模式。

records.text: Congratulations! I'm certain she'll make an immense contribution to the New Federation one day.
records.zh: 恭喜您，她日后一定能为新联邦做出巨大贡献。

records.text: Your plan... Are you just following the New Federation's playbook?
records.zh: 你的计划，就是按部就班地执行新联邦的计划吗？

records.text: Thank you. I promise, I'd never let the New Federation lay a single finger on my students. But...
records.zh: 谢谢，我绝不会让新联邦染指我的学生，只是……

records.text: Is that Sundermere? Are we back before the Starward Riseway was even built?
records.zh: 那边是坠剑湖吗？这是联运椎骨都尚未建成的时期？

records.text: Fifteen months later, this very component became the final piece for the construction of the Starward Riseway, the bridge between Lahai-Roi's earth and the sky.
records.zh: 而在十五个月后，这枚机械元件成为了如今联运椎骨的最后一块拼图，联通了拉海洛的天与地。

records.text: A group is gathered around a plant in what appears to be a Pioneer Association office. You recognize Verina among them. A small note in the bottom right corner of the photo reads: Milestone achieved.
records.zh: 照片右下角写着：阶段性成果留影。这似乎是先行公约的一间办公室？照片中的几人正围着一株植物合影，你在照片中还发现了维里奈。

records.text: Find a suitable place. You know what to do... And keep your wits about you, Rover. Don't get yourself lost in a memory.
records.zh: 寻找合适的地方，你知道该怎么用……不要被记忆迷惑了，漂泊者。

records.text: Oh, it's a favorite among the Goldrunners in the New Federation. Packs a punch. Heh, sometimes a little too much of a punch.
records.zh: 这在新联邦的淘金客之间很流行，优点是劲大，缺点是劲太大~

records.text: I didn't know you worked with Verina before. She helped me out back in Jinzhou.
records.zh: 原来你还跟维里奈合作过，我之前在今州的时候，她帮过我。

records.text: Dr. Luuk is waiting for the auditor at the Starward Riseway as we speak. They'll be here any minute.
records.zh: 陆医生已经去联运椎骨接那位黑海岸审查官了，估计很快就到。

records.text: You receive a WavesLine message from Lucilla.
records.zh: 你收到一条来自洛瑟菈的飞讯。

records.text: The vote was jointly conducted by each department's committee and the New Federation Special Investigation Panel.
records.zh: 本次结果由学院各学部委员会及新联邦特别调查团共同投票产生。

records.text: It's just the two of us now. No need for all the formality, Hiyuki.
records.zh: 这里没有其他人了，在我面前就不用这么拘谨了，绯雪。

records.text: Sigrika, the Divinator just released another riddle.
records.zh: 西格莉卡，占卜师发布了新的谜题。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_2_拉海洛主线_上半_暗面4_5_1
records.text: She's lost in a nightmare now. I have to wake her up.
records.zh: 她已经陷入噩梦了，必须喊醒她。

records.text: User login… Sigrika… Switching to Riddle Channel!
records.zh: 用户登录……西格莉卡……切换到猜谜频道！

records.text: The elders of our tribe would hide runes all over Bjartr Woods, each one leading to the next.
records.zh: 小时候，长老们在浮光林里布置很多隐藏的符文标记。这些符文互有指向。通过一个符文，就可以知道下一个符文的位置。

records.text: You know, when I played that rune-finding game in Bjartr Woods, I was always the first one out.
records.zh: 以前玩符文游戏的时候，我总是第一个走出浮光林。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_2_拉海洛主线_上半_暗面3_22_1
records.text: Long ago, the children of Bjartr Woods played an interesting game.
records.zh: 很久以前，浮光林的孩子们玩了一场游戏

records.text: Denia... I told you a long time ago, didn't I?
records.zh: 达妮娅……其实我早就告诉过你了，不是吗？

records.text: Hey... can you imagine her face if we told her the white bird is just Hiyuki's ability?
records.zh: 你说，如果告诉她那只白鸟其实只是绯雪的能力，她会露出什么表情？

records.text: Hiyuki is just doing her job. And she's kinder than she looks.
records.zh: 绯雪只是在履行自己的职责。而且，她是个很温柔的人。

records.text: Then I... I'll leave Professor Mornye a message...
records.zh: 那我……我现在就联系下莫宁老师——

records.text: The New Federation is pressing charges over the Stridergate incident and the residual frequency on the Dimmr Plains. They want Denia handed over immediately.
records.zh: 新联邦正因隧门事件和黯原残留的频率发起指控，要求我们立刻将达妮娅送过去。

records.text: 漂泊者, Denia has left the Academy and is heading towards the Dimmr Plains.
records.zh: 漂泊者，达妮娅目前已经离开了星炬学院，正在前往黯原区。

records.text: A cabinet filled with various medicines, predominantly from the New Federation, including nutritional agents, antibiotics, suppressants, and other drugs...
records.zh: 装满了各种药品的柜子，大多数药物来自新联邦，包含营养剂，抗生素，抑制剂等各种药物……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_5_2
records.text: All good, Roccia? Some new friends have joined us.
records.zh: 洛可可，还好吗？有新朋友来啦。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_7_1
records.text: Hmm... Wha... Huh? We docked already? Where is Brant and the crew?
records.zh: 唔……呼哈……嗯……？已经上岸了吗？布兰特他们呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_7_1
records.text: Pardon my intrusion. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a modest playwright visiting Ragunna in search of inspiration for my latest work.
records.zh: 抱歉，请允许我自我介绍——我叫克里斯托弗，只是一个不入流的剧作者，此番来到拉古那，是为给新作取材。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_7_1
records.text:
You finally arrive at the docks of Ragunna. The troupe bids you farewell, promising to make their grand entrance during the opening of the Carnevale.
As you and Abby search for a way into the city, you witness deacons from the Order sending "the Fools" on a pilgrimage. A mysterious playwright named Cristoforo notices your confusion and begins to explain the origins of this practice.
records.zh:
你们终于抵达了拉古那城的接驳码头，游行剧团将你在此放下，与你告别。待到狂欢节开幕，他们将伴随着最浩大的欢呼声入城。
你与阿布在码头寻找着入城之路，偶然目睹了修会的执行者们遣送“愚人”前去朝圣的场景。
一位神秘的剧作家“克里斯托弗”看到了你内心的困惑，向你解释了“朝圣”的来历……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_10_1
records.text: Once again, "we" will rove Solaris-3 and walk among the people.
records.zh: 索拉里斯，进入了这个世界，身处在这个世界。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_11_1
records.text: I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.
records.zh: 那么……我会联系秋水，为你准备前往黎那汐塔的船只。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_地牢_1_6
records.text: You don't offer the petals to change his mind. But maybe he'll understand what the gesture means—the celebration was never about any one person. It's for everyone who joined the hunt, Avidius included.
records.zh: 你没打算就此说服他，但你想他会明白你的意思——庆典本就不是为了某个人，而是为了同行的每一位，阿维狄亚自然也在其中。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_地牢_1_6
records.text: You let Avidius's words hang in the air. You have no answer to give, not yet. But at the mention of the celebration, you remember the petals Bruno gave you to hand out.
records.zh: 沉默淹没了阿维狄亚逐渐低沉的诘问，你给不出回答，但提及庆典，你几乎是下意识想到布里奥交给你的、你还未分发完的那些花瓣……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_地牢_1_5
records.text: (For Avidius here, Iuno has also never existed. Whatever she did in the past is now my doing. That's why he thinks I'm behind all this.)
records.zh: （对阿维狄亚来说，尤诺同样是没出现过的存在，所以她做过的事情变成了我做的，他这才以为是我。）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_1_23
records.text: Although I hate to admit it, Avidius was right... Since you still remember Iuno and thus hold onto that last connection between her and the world, you've essentially "anchored" her.
records.zh: 虽然我很不想承认，但阿维狄亚是对的……因为你还记得尤诺，保持了她和世界最后的联系，一定程度上「锚定」了她。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_1_23
records.text: For instance, I saw Avidius making a commotion not long ago.
records.zh: 比如不久之前，我看见了阿维狄亚在地下喧嚷的画面。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_混沌之间_4_10
records.text: Ugh... Cough, cough... Priestess Iuno, thank you...
records.zh: 呃……咳咳……谕女尤诺，谢谢……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_2_6
records.text: Apparently, that Avidius locked up below overheard the Priestesses talking about some prophecy and escaped, just like that.
records.zh: 原本一直被收押在下面的阿维狄亚，听经过的谕女们说起看见的预言什么的，突然就激动起来，不管不顾地离开了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_2_6
records.text: No, that's not it. Avidius wasn't being locked up. He chose to stay here. If he wanted to leave, Lillibet wouldn't worry about him.
records.zh: 没有吧，哪有什么收押啊，阿维狄亚是自己要待在这的，他想走就走好了，用不着婆婆操这个心。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_12_1
records.text: Yes, only one person has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
records.zh: 如今唯一一位成功觐见了岁主的信徒——也就是现在修会的「主座」，蓝衣「芬莱克」大人。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_3_1
records.text: Yes. The nearest one is Trattoria Margherita. I personally recommend Pizza Tropicale. Would you like to dine there?
records.zh: 当然，离这里最近的是「玛格烈特家庭餐馆」，我个人十分推荐那家店的「热海皇梨披萨」，我可以带您前往。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_8_4
records.text: Cristoforo gives a courteous nod and takes his leave.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗向你颔首致意，随后离开。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_16_1
records.text: How about Steak Margherita and Nuvola Pasta? Both excellent choices!
records.zh: 那当然是玛格烈特特制——「玛格烈特牛排」和「云凝肉酱烩面」！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_16_1
records.text:
You’re taken to Trattoria Margherita, the most popular restaurant in Ragunna.
Zani tells you to order whatever you like, as the Montelli family’s covering the bill.
records.zh:
欢迎来到，拉古那最有名气的玛格烈特家庭餐厅！
来看看吃什么吧，不要客气——开支都会记在莫塔里家族的账上。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_15_1
records.text: Now, try the Nectarwine from Egla Town. It's aged in oak barrels from the Fagaceae Peninsula, known as the "Harvest Spirit" or "Gocce di Divino" for its exceptional flavor.
records.zh: ——请尝尝吧，埃格拉小镇出品，槲生半岛小橡木桶发酵熟成，被誉为「丰收之心，神之水滴」的「蜜露果酒」。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_19_2
records.text: We should have heeded Primus Fenrico's words…
records.zh: 我们本应该听从芬莱克大人的指示……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
records.text: Mr. Fulmine's Forte is Celluloid Chronicle. He can convert events into film, recording all that happens within a span of time.
records.zh: 斐林先生的共鸣能力是「胶片记录」，能够将事件直接转化为特殊的胶片，记录下一段时间内发生的所有事情。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
records.text: Don't be hard on yourself, Mr. Fulmine. You've been a tremendous help. At least we're not flying blind anymore. But 漂泊者, we need a new plan.
records.zh: 已经很了不起了，斐林先生，至少我们不用像无头呼咻咻那样漫无目的地乱撞，让我们再想想有没有什么别的线索……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
records.text: No, I'm here for something else. This is Mr. Fulmine from the Pioneer Association.
records.zh: 今天是为了别的事……这是先行公约的斐林先生。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
records.text: Oh, hello! You've brought a new friend! Pleasure to meet you. I'm Fulmine, head of the Wutherium Film Studio under the Pioneer Association in Ragunna. How should I address you?
records.zh: 哎呀，您带来了新朋友……您好，我是拉古那城先行公约旗下“潮汐影像工作室”的主理人，斐林。该怎么称呼您？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
records.text: We're here to ask a favor. We're investigating a Vitreum Dancer who caused a scene around Trattoria Margherita.
records.zh: 这次找你，是想请你帮个忙……我们正在调查一个「刀伶声骸」的去向，不久前它在玛格烈特家庭餐馆附近引起了骚动。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
records.text:
Fulmine from the Pioneer Association has a unique skill: he can turn his memories into special film reels, and assisted by the Echo, C-MOSS, he can project those memories for others to see.

In one of Fulmine's memories, you see someone dressed in Montelli attire, wearing a mask and lurking suspiciously behind the Vitreum Dancer. Since the Carnevale hasn't started yet, it's odd for someone to already be masked up—as if they're deliberately hiding their identity.

With this clue, you decide to head to Masked Reverie, a mask shop, in search of leads…
records.zh:
先行公约的斐林先生可以将自己的记忆转化为特殊胶片，在声骸“西莫斯先生”的帮助下，他可以将这些记忆复现出来，供他人观看。
在斐林的记忆中，你们看到了一位莫塔里家族打扮的人员，戴着面具，在刀伶声骸的身后鬼鬼祟祟地做着什么——明明狂欢节未到却戴着面具，就像是在故意掩饰自己的身份一样。
顺着这条线索，你们决定前往“梦中人”面具店，打探一下这款面具的来历……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_21_1
records.text: You elaborate on the mask design you saw in Fulmine's memory to Nyarla.
records.zh: 向奈亚拉详细描述了在斐林的回忆中看到的面具样式。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_22_1
records.text: Greetings, Sir Antonio. I'm Zani from the Averardo Bank.
records.zh: 安东尼奥先生，您好，我是「埃弗拉德银行」的赞妮。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_26_1
records.text: He looks like the man we saw in Mr. Fulmine's memory. Isn't that Gilberto?
records.zh: 和照片里的人很相似，难道是吉尔贝？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_27_1
records.text: This is our Primus, Fenrico, the Enlightened One.
records.zh: 这位，便是我们的「神启者」，芬莱克主座。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_35_32
records.text: This must be Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep, just as Priest Alessio described.
records.zh: 这位应当就是阿莱克斯司铎口中，隐海修会如今的主座，芬莱克。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_11_1
records.text: Ah! Hello, I'm Phoebe! Nice to meet you, too.
records.zh: ……啊，嗯！我叫菲比，你好呀。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
records.text: Cristoforo leaves in a hurry. It looks like he's on his way to warn the nearby villagers and Echoes.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗匆匆忙忙地离开了，看来是打算去警告附近的村民和声骸。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
records.text: It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?
records.zh: 好像是菲比！她怎么会出现在这呢？还和那些声骸在一起？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
records.text:
Upon reaching the area where Echoes have gone missing, you're attacked by out-of-control Echoes. After quelling them, you notice that they seem to be manipulated, just like the Vitreum Dancers in Ragunna. 
Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face—Acolyte Phoebe.
records.zh:
你们在声骸失踪的地点受到了失控的声骸的攻击。
将威胁清除后，你们察觉到，这些声骸的表现与城内失控刀伶的表现几乎一致，它们都像是受到了某种控制。
与克里斯托弗道别后，你们继续调查，又遇见了一位熟悉的故人——菲比教士。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
records.text: You tell Cristoforo and Zani what you found out.
records.zh: 你向克里斯托弗和赞妮说了自己的发现。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
records.text: Actually, there was a similar incident with hostile Echoes in Ragunna City recently.
records.zh: 咳，其实，就在不久前，拉古那城也发生了类似的声骸失控事件。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_73_1
records.text: Everyone move! Follow the Averardo Vault Emergency Response Plan!
records.zh: 所有人，按照《埃弗拉德金库突发事件应急预案》行动！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_13_1
records.text: I thought you were at Ragunna City. Didn't expect to meet you here. Oh, uhh... Sorry, I don't think we've met.
records.zh: 你不是应该在拉古那城吗？怎么会突然跑到拂风水畔来？还有这位……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_13_1
records.text: Greetings, madam. My name is Zani. Averardo Bank.
records.zh: 尊敬的教士小姐，我叫赞妮。在埃弗拉德银行工作。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_13_1
records.text: We're investigating the Echo incident from the Carnevale rehearsal at Whisperwind Haven, as requested by the Montelli family. One of our clues led us here.
records.zh: 我们来拂风水畔，是应莫塔里家族的请求，调查狂欢节预演上声骸失控的事件。其中一条线索……恰好指向这里。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_17_1
records.text: According to the Codex, Lorelei is a powerful Remnant creature residing in the Atrium of Reflections at the center of the Nimbus Sanctum.
records.zh: 根据圣典记载，罗蕾莱是一个强大的回音生物。她居住在氤柔水境中央的云中庭院里。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_17_1
records.text:
Despite his defeat, Gilberto continues to preach a dark prophecy: Lorelei will command the sea of clouds to engulf Ragunna, sparing only the faithful. Meanwhile, an anomaly at the Nimbus Sanctum suggests Lorelei might also be influenced by a Lycoris. 
Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive. You head to the sea of clouds alone.
records.zh:
击败吉尔贝后，他仍在肆无忌惮地宣扬着邪异的预言：罗蕾莱将令云海吞没拉古那城，届时只有真信者才能获得新生。
此时氤柔水境中央的云海异象突起，恐怕他口中的「罗蕾莱」已经受到了彼岸花的影响。
赞妮与菲比将留在此处看守吉尔贝，等待莫塔里家族人士的接手。你与她们暂时分别，先行前往云海。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_23_1
records.text: Truth be told, I need to catch the final train in the Nimbus Sanctum today. However, this lone Gondola is all the harbor offers.
records.zh: 事实上，我有急事要去云海中的列车站点，赶今天的最后一班车。但港口里只有这一艘船了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_24_1
records.text: Perhaps it's merely my fancy. Regardless, her melody will guide us through fog and storm to the heart of the Nimbus Sanctum.
records.zh: 也许是我的错觉吧。总而言之，跟随着那个歌声，我们就能穿越迷雾和雷暴，抵达云海深处。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_2_1
records.text:
To your surprise, the Order's "confessional" turns out to be a freight elevator. 
After leaving it behind, you arrive at Whisperwind Haven and meet Zani. Together, you set off to trace Gilberto.
records.zh:
没想到，修会的忏悔室竟然是一间用以运送货物的电梯。 
从电梯出来后，你抵达了拂风水畔，在附近与赞妮汇合，继续寻找吉尔贝的去向。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_26_1
records.text:
You arrive at the Echo train station and wait for its arrival. 
During the wait, the noble lady shares her thoughts on Ragunna City, the Montelli and Fisalia families... and you.
records.zh:
你们顺利抵达了声骸列车的站点。
在等候列车到来的间隙里，这位贵族小姐向你简单分享了自己的看法：关于拉古那城，关于莫塔里与翡萨烈两大家族，以及，关于……你。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_32_1
records.text: The Blessed Maiden? We met a playwright named Cristoforo earlier. He shared some stories about her.
records.zh: ……圣女？之前我们遇到过一个叫克里斯托弗的剧作家，他给我们讲了一些关于圣女的故事。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_35_1
records.text: That flower... looks like the petals we found in Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 那朵花……和之前在拂风水畔找到的花瓣很像。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_35_1
records.text: The oathbreakers, hiding behind their Masks of Madness… They tainted the Nimbus Sanctum with corrupted blooms, drowning me in rage and sorrow. Endless nightmares became my prison.
records.zh: 那些戴着癫狂面具的背誓者……他们用充满恶意的花污染了云海的频率，让我陷入了愤怒与悲哀……用无休止的噩梦困住了我。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_35_1
records.text: Had you not freed me from my nightmare, I would never be able to fulfill the Sentinel's task… The tides of the Nimbus Sanctum would have engulfed the whole of Ragunna, just as they once claimed the sacred temple now lying in ruins beneath you.
records.zh: 如果不是你们从噩梦中将我解放，我将无法继续履行岁主留下的使命……云海掀起的浪潮将吞没整个拉古那，如同它吞没你们脚下那圣殿的残骸。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_36_1
records.text: There happens to be an auction at Averardo Vault today. The top members of the family will be there.
records.zh: 今天正好是「埃弗拉德金库」会举办拍卖会的日子。家族的上层人物都会到场。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_41_1
records.text: Averardo Vault is just up ahead. It seems this is where we part ways, Noah.
records.zh: 前面就是「埃弗拉德金库」了。诺亚，看来我们得在这里分别了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_42_1
records.text: Welcome to Averardo Vault. Do you have an appointment?
records.zh: 埃弗拉德金库欢迎您的到来。请问二位有预约吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_42_1
records.text: Ah, this invitation… My apologies. Welcome to Averardo Vault. How may we assist you today?
records.zh: 这份邀请函是……啊，失礼了，欢迎您。请问二位有什么需要办理的业务吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_43_1
records.text: Despite our feud, no one in Ragunna can refuse the services of Averardo Vault.
records.zh: 虽然我们和他们不太对付，但在拉古那，埃弗拉德金库所提供的服务是不可替代的。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_44_1
records.text: Here we are. Welcome to Averardo Vault—the Montellis' heart and glory.
records.zh: 我们就要到了。欢迎来到埃弗拉德金库，莫塔里家族的心脏与骄傲。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_主线_金库上层副本_6_3
records.text: Lady Carlotta, we… we're just following orders.
records.zh: 珂莱塔小姐，我们……也只是奉命行事而已。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_6_1
records.text: Welcome to Whisperwind Haven—known for its iconic windmills and flower fields. Legend has it, this was once the home of the Blessed Maiden.
records.zh: 这里是「拂风水畔」——以标志性的风车和花田著称，据说这里曾是圣女的故乡。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_57_1
records.text: Of course, if Lord Fenrico is the true "Enlightened One."
records.zh: 是啊，如果芬莱克阁下真的是“神启者”的话。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_7_1
records.text: You've likely noticed the abundance of Echoes here in Whisperwind Haven. One might say it's more their village than ours.
records.zh: 想必二位也看到了，拂风水畔有很多声骸。可以说，这里与其说是人类的村落，不如说是声骸的村落。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_7_1
records.text: Mr. Cristoforo, do you know where those Echoes were last seen before they disappeared?
records.zh: 克里斯托弗先生，你知道那些声骸失踪的具体位置吗？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_7_1
records.text:
You run into Cristoforo, the mysterious playwright, again. He's on a journey for inspiration to finish his script about the Blessed Maiden, "Fleurdelys." 
As for Gilberto, he tells you that a Fisalia member has been frequenting Whisperwind Haven, and Echoes have been mysteriously vanishing. 
Suspecting a connection, you follow the Echoes to investigate further.
records.zh:
你再一次与神秘的剧作家克里斯托弗相遇。他正在此处采风，撰写一出有关拉古那的旧日圣女「芙露德莉斯」的剧本。
提及吉尔贝，克里斯托弗表示，最近确有一位翡萨烈家族的成员常来附近闲逛，而拂风水畔最近常有声骸失踪，二者之间或有关联。
在声骸小队的带领下，你们决定去声骸失踪的地点看看。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_7_1
records.text: Ahh, no need for the formalities. Allow me to re-introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a humble playwright grappling with modern trends. Delighted to meet you.
records.zh: 哈，这就免了。让我再做一次自我介绍吧。我叫克里斯托弗，是一名不入流的剧作者。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_21
records.text: Roccia makes quick work of repairing the Cloudcaster.
records.zh: 洛可可飞快地将造云机修复好……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_1_2
records.text: The Remnant Clouds from the sea of clouds drew hordes of Tacet Discords here. Now, their whispers fill the air, turning this once holy place of pilgrimage into the "Penitent's End."
records.zh: 加上从云海蔓延而来的「回音云」，无数残象被频率吸引至此，占据了岛屿，悲恸凄厉的絮语日夜不休。昔日神圣的巡礼地，也成为了如今的「悲叹墓岛」。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_1_2
records.text: Uh... Hello, I'm Roccia. We've met before on Brant's ship. I was... in this box.
records.zh: 唔……你好。我叫洛可可……我们之前应该在花船上见过一面。我是那个……箱子。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_16
records.text: What say you, Brant? Do you like this stage design? It could be used for this year's Carnevale!
records.zh: 嘿！布兰特小子，你看，这个演出效果怎么样？今年的狂欢节，你们要不要参考一下啊？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_2_5
records.text:
As you journey through the mist, you spot a "Pilgrim's Sail," the ship you saw when you first arrived in the city. Roccia explains that all Pilgrim's Sails eventually end up here, carried by the undercurrents to this island—Penitent's End, a place both destination and grave for every Pilgrim's Sail.
The ship appears abandoned. Its passengers must have ventured deeper into the island. With the mist still thick and danger lingering around, you decide to head toward a nearby lighthouse, hoping to find any scattered survivors along the way.
records.zh:
穿越海雾，你见到了曾在你入城之时出航的“朝圣船”。洛可可解释道，由于这座岛屿下隐藏的暗流，所有朝圣船无一例外最终都会抵达这里——这片名为「悲叹墓岛」的危险岛屿，正是所有朝圣船的终点与坟墓。
朝圣船上空无一人，船上的人们可能已经往岛屿深处走去。如今海雾尚未彻底消散，危险还未解除，你们决定向不远处的灯塔前进，沿途寻找失散的人们。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_2_7
records.text: Is this the place Carlotta said everything ends?
records.zh: 这就是珂莱塔所说的「坟墓」？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_64_15
records.text: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.
records.zh: 我的任务还没结束。我会在黎那汐塔境内，继续调查有关岁主的史实……就先从拂风水畔入手吧。期望我们有缘再会了！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_64_15
records.text: Mr. Aalto was right. Bloom Bearers attract other Bloom Bearers!
records.zh: 秋水师父说的没错。执花与执花之间，果然是会相互吸引的！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_3_4
records.text: Brant, you handle the Tacet Discords. I've got the dragon.
records.zh: 布兰特，身手灵活，去处理其他残象。这里交给洛可可。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_3
records.text: The troupe's base is, surprisingly, hidden in a cavern beneath Penitent's End. The thick mist provides a natural cover, but it remains a perilous environment. Brant and Roccia tell you how to find Bardolino, the former Laureate, and then set off to handle the lingering impact of the mist. They'll meet you again once their tasks are done.
records.zh:
游行剧团的据点竟然建立在悲叹墓岛下方的海窟之内。虽然海雾为他们的藏身提供了天然屏障，但其本身带来的威胁不容小觑。
布兰特与洛可可把老桂冠“巴多里奥”的位置指示给你后，表示需要先去处理下之前海雾造成的影响，待会儿与你汇合。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_3
records.text: They say the most dangerous places are the safest. Penitent's End has always been forsaken, and now, cloaked in the sea of mist, even the Order's envoys wouldn't dare set foot here. It's the perfect refuge for us.
records.zh: 最危险的地方就是最安全的地方。墓岛本就人迹罕至，再加上海雾这道天然屏障，就连修会的使节都不敢前来。可以说是完美的藏身处了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_4
records.text: Brant is a natural. As for me, I'm more comfortable managing these kinds of tasks.
records.zh: 布兰特的性格，总是能感染他人。相比之下，我的性子还是更适合做这些整备工作。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_5
records.text: Welcome back, Brant! I... I heard a lot of voices coming from the mist. It's scary...
records.zh: 布兰特哥哥，你回来了……刚才的海雾里面，有好多人的声音，好恐怖……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_10
records.text: The mist might be coming from the Remnant Clouds in the Nimbus Sanctum. Lorelei has the power to purify and control them, but the Fractsidus interfered…
records.zh: 海雾的根源，很可能来自于氤柔水境的「回音云」。庭院的主人「罗蕾莱」本具有净化与控制它的能力，但却被残星会干扰……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_11
records.text: Exactly. I'll handle the stage lighting, Brant will narrate, and the rest will take on the role of the audience.
records.zh: 嗯。那么，洛可可会担任舞台的灯光师，布兰特担任旁白，其他成员则扮演互动的观众。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_31_1
records.text: Fl… No, I'm Cartethyia… Yes, that's right. Cartethyia.
records.zh: 芙……不。卡提希娅……嗯，我的名字是卡提希娅。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_56_1
records.text:
Not far away, Phrolova watches your every move. Beside her stands another Overseer, Cristoforo the "Playwright."
It seems his script is only starting to unfold...
records.zh:
不远处，残星会的会监弗洛洛仍在观察着你的行动。在她身侧站立的，正是残星会的另一位会监——「剧作家」克里斯托弗。
这位剧作家的「剧本」，似乎也才刚刚展开……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_56_1
records.text: Cristoforo, if you don't want to spoil the next act, I might have to give your carefully crafted plot a little nudge.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗，如果你不愿将故事的下一幕透露给我，我就只能对你所撰写的剧情，进行一些小小的推动了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_57_1
records.text: I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.
records.zh: 地址已经发送到你的终端上了。布兰特与洛可可也在，我们在这等你。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_2_3
records.text: Following the Golden Phantom, you and Roccia narrowly escape the Dragon of Dirge's ambush in the mist...
records.zh: 你与洛可可跟随“金色的虚影”，顺利躲过了埋伏在海雾中的古龙……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_44_1
records.text: Once again, Phrolova conjures a deadly swarm of Tacet Discords...
records.zh: 弗洛洛再度召唤出残象，组成杀阵……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_47_1
records.text: You and Carlotta are surrounded by TDs, but Roccia arrives in time, diving headfirst into the fight to aid you.
records.zh: 你与珂莱塔陷入残象的包围，洛可可及时出现，将自己掷入战场……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_38_1
records.text:
With C-MOSS's wish granted, Fulmine arrives to thank you for your kindness. Phoebe, however, is bound by her duties to the Order. She needs to maintain order at the festival and can't join you for the rest of the Carnevale. 
You can see the excitement and joy in her eyes, though. With her blessings for you in mind, you decide to help keep the Carnevale safe.
records.zh:
西莫斯先生的心愿得以实现，闻讯赶来的斐林对你们表示了感谢。
作为修会的成员，菲比还有职责在身，需要在此地维持秩序，不能与你一同参加狂欢节。
你能看出菲比对此次狂欢节的期待与喜悦，带上她的祝福，守护好这场狂欢节吧。

records.text: I'd rather know I'm a villain than remain a wanderer, lost in a world without understanding.
records.zh: 我宁可最后成为清醒的恶人，也不要做什么都不知道的徘徊者。

records.text: Ah... seems like I won't get a chance to apologize to Cantarella.
records.zh: 啊……好像没机会给坎特蕾拉道歉。

records.text: After Fleurdelys's conception, Cantarella became my safeguard.
records.zh: 而在芙露德莉斯诞生后，她便是一道保险。

records.text: Such was my intention... yet Cantarella chose another way.
records.zh: 我原本是这么想的……但，坎特蕾拉做出了另一个选择。

records.text: (Describe to Cantarella what was portrayed on the stained glass.)
records.zh: （给坎特蕾拉描述彩窗画。）

records.text: (Cantarella said she was Overclocking when she tried resonating with Tyrvine.)
records.zh: （坎特蕾拉刚才提到了在超频状态下尝试与「提尔芬」中的力量共鸣。）

records.text: You tell Cantarella about the conversation you had with Cartethyia.
records.zh: 你向坎特蕾拉讲述了你和卡提希娅的交流内容。

records.text: Before it became a Sonoro Sphere, it was a seminary known as the Avinoleum. The Martyred Maiden once pursued her studies there.
records.zh: 那里成为索诺拉前，曾是一座名为「阿维纽林」的神学院，也是那位圣女曾进修的地方。

records.text: After most of my leads fell short, a friend at Mingting in Huanglong introduced me to the stories they were telling of you.
records.zh: 吃了不少闭门羹后，才在瑝珑明庭的一位朋友那里听说了你的消息。

records.text: The second Dark Tide... It occurred right here, at the Avinoleum. The largest seminary ever built by the Order.
records.zh: 第二次黑潮……它曾经的发生地点就是这里——「阿维纽林」，修会修建过的最大的神学院。

records.text: Salutations, 漂泊者. My name is Ciaccona, a wandering bard. I'm glad to have met you.
records.zh: 漂泊者你好，我的名字叫夏空，是一个流浪的吟游诗人，很高兴见到你。

records.text: Standing next to the abandoned house Ciaccona mentioned, you feel the faint breeze of the sea.
records.zh: 站在夏空提到的荒屋旁，你感受到了淡淡的海风气息。

records.text: You look distracted. Still thinking about what Cantarella said about fearing answers?
records.zh: 你看起来心不在焉，还在意坎特蕾拉之前在地面说的话？

records.text: Well, Imperator called you "the Lost," and Primus Fenrico claims you are the Resonator for Leviathan, the Threnodian.
records.zh: 「英白拉多」称你为迷途者，但现任主座芬莱克又告诉我，你是鸣式——「利维亚坦」的共鸣者。

records.text: I should go back for Cantarella. Will you wait here for us?
records.zh: 我去接坎特蕾拉过来，可以稍微等我一下吗？

records.text: Cartethyia and I will take point again tomorrow.
records.zh: 明天还是我和卡提希娅一起行动。

records.text: A play about you written by Cristoforo the playwright.
records.zh: 一个名叫克里斯托弗的剧作家为你写的剧本。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_29
records.text: "I" just want you to finish Cristoforo's plan first.
records.zh: “我”只是想让你帮助克里斯托弗完成他的计划后，再来实现这一切而已。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_30
records.text: Phrolova, when this piece is truly complete, I'll come back.
records.zh: 弗洛洛，等这首乐曲真正完成时，我一定会再来。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_30
records.text: Phrolova, keep living… We long to be by your side…
records.zh: 弗洛洛，活下去……我们多么想和你一起活下去……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_33
records.text: Fenrico tied the music piece to the security system.
records.zh: 芬莱克把能源安全系统和曲谱绑在了一起。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_3_1
records.text: After a short deliberation, Phrolova hands you all the music pieces.
records.zh: 弗洛洛思考后，将手里的所有曲谱交给了你。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_36
records.text: From what the Order's pursuers said, Fenrico will have his men guarding it.
records.zh: 按照之前修会追兵所说，芬莱克应该带人正守在那里。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_朝拜圣所_1_14
records.text: Imperator's statue is gone… Is this Fenrico's ambition?
records.zh: 没有了英白拉多的雕像……这是芬莱克的野心吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_朝拜圣所_7_1
records.text: ("Unity is the sole deliverance from the Divine Ordeal." That's why Fenrico fought to keep Ragunna from falling into discord.)
records.zh: （「联结」是度过「天难」的唯一道路……这是芬莱克强行阻止拉古那人之间产生分裂的真正原因？）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_朝拜圣所_7_1
records.text: (That recording I found earlier also mentioned Fenrico giving conflicting orders to the Acolytes at times.)
records.zh: （之前发现的那份录音有提到，芬莱克在对教士下达命令时也出现过命令完全不同的情况。）

records.text: (Could this be the Lost Beyond Phrolova mentioned?)
records.zh: （难道这里是弗洛洛所说的失亡彼岸？）

records.text: Phrolova, I brought you some pastries! Have 'em on the road.
records.zh: 弗洛洛姐姐，我给你带了好吃的，你可以在路上吃！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_2
records.text: Cristoforo hands the script he holds to "you."
records.zh: 克里斯托弗将手里的剧本交给了“你”。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_2
records.text: In a flashback through Phrolova's perspective, you experience her conversation with Cristoforo back in Septimont and realize why she handed you the script: Cartethyia's intervention had made their plans to overwrite reality almost impossible. To maintain control of the Threnodian's power, they made a last-minute adjustment, shifting their focus to this underwater location ahead of schedule. Giving you the script was a way to leverage your power to progress the story until the power could be separated from Mya and returned to their grasp.
records.zh: 你以弗洛洛的视角发现了她与克里斯托弗曾在七丘的对话，了解了当时弗洛洛将剧本交给你的背后真正原因：卡提希娅的介入让他们在七丘想要让剧本覆写现实的计划成功率降到了最低点，为了保证鸣式的力量始终掌握在他们手中，他们临时调整了计划重点，将目光早早投向了海底，把剧本交给你，是利用你的力量去推动故事进展，直到鸣式残力从蜜芽体内剥离，回到他们手中。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_3
records.text: Fenrico hands "you" a guest list for the Carnevale.
records.zh: 芬莱克将一份狂欢节宾客名单递给了“你”。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_4
records.text: In Phrolova's third flashback, you see her and Scar in Jinzhou, standing before a hatching Ovathrax. Her presence in Norfall Barrens was mostly for personal reasons. Despite the Grand Architect's orders, she cared little about Jinzhou or you. She was more there for the countless Reverberations of the dead scattered across the battlefields. Experimenting with merging Reverberations and Tacet Discords there could offer valuable insights for the ultimate success of the Lost Beyond.
records.zh: 你以弗洛洛的视角发现了她与伤痕曾在今州的对话，了解了当时她出现在北落野背后的个人原因：执行会长命令的她对今州和你都没有过多上心，她更在乎的，是战场上充斥着大量人们死后的残响。在这里尝试残响与残象躯壳的融合，或许能为失亡彼岸最终的成功提供些不错的参考价值。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_4
records.text: {Male=He's;Female=She's} in the Gorges of Spirits. Care to witness it firsthand?
records.zh: {TA}现在就在云陵谷，你要去看看吗？

records.text: (Fabricatorium of the Deep... It belongs to the Order.)
records.zh: （隐海试验场……修会的地方。）

records.text: Fenrico, stop! The Threnodian is using you! You are the Harbinger of the Dark Tide!
records.zh: 芬莱克！别进去！鸣式在蛊惑你，你是黑潮的代行者！

records.text: (Fenrico spoke of a... Paradise. What does it mean?)
records.zh: （芬莱克刚才提到的……天国……是什么？）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_主塔_1_13
records.text: In his last moments of consciousness, Fenrico reminds you that the Threnodian's residual energy isn't the real problem. Rinascita's woes lie in the "Journeying Paradise." He hopes you can prevent this impending calamity and save Rinascita. With this new information, you cease your search for the Threnodian's residual energy and instead plan to return to Septimont for further investigation. As you take one last look at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, wondering what to do with it, a Lycoris suddenly catches your eye.
records.zh: 芬莱克用虚弱的意识最后提醒你，鸣式残力不是最重要的，黎那汐塔真正的灾难源泉在「巡游天国」之中，他希望你能阻止这场灾难降临，拯救黎那汐塔。你得到了新的线索后，不再强追鸣式残力，而是打算下一步回七丘继续探查。你最后看向这座海底的试验场，正在思索该如何处理这里时，突然看到了残留在此的彼岸花。

records.text: If what Fenrico said is true, the Order should make the right choice here.
records.zh: 如果芬莱克说的都是真的，在这件事上修会应该能做出正确的选择。

records.text: Sure. I'm heading to Septimont to follow the clues Fenrico left behind.
records.zh: 好，那我先按照芬莱克留下的线索去七丘看看。

records.text: (Tell her about the Fabricatorium of the Deep.)
records.zh: （告知隐海试验场的存在。）

records.text: Spare me the commentary. Fenrico wants the Gem, and I intend to stop him. That's all that matters. Now, lead the way.
records.zh: 不用故意强调我和他们的对立，既然芬莱克也想要宝石，我就不可能不阻止他。继续带路。

records.text: We must return to the tower before Fenrico finds it.
records.zh: 要在芬莱克得手前回高塔中去。

records.text: The area before us is vital to the Order. Fenrico wouldn't leave it lightly guarded.
records.zh: 前面的核心区域被修会视为珍宝，芬莱克为它留下多少道防守都不为过。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_声骸培养场_1_19
records.text: (It hurts... Phrolova... I don't want to be here...)
records.zh: （好痛……弗洛洛……我不要在这里……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_声骸培养场_1_9
records.text: Are you alright, Phrolova? You look a bit pale...
records.zh: 弗洛洛姐姐，你还好吗？脸色看起来有点差……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_声骸培养场_1_12
records.text: Primus, Phrolova has reached the final stage.
records.zh: 主座，弗洛洛已经进行到最后一步了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_声骸培养场_1_12
records.text: (This feels a lot like what Cantarella described before.)
records.zh: （这种状况……和坎特蕾拉之前提到过的很像。）

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_能源场上层_1_9
records.text: You discover a piece of sheet music. Phrolova explains that this music is the core of the Fabricatorium of the Deep. The area can only be restored by returning it to the Orchestration Altar and fixing the melodies. When you speculate she composed it, she admits it was part of her collaboration with Fenrico. You both then agree to bring the sheet music back to the Altar.
records.zh: 你们发现了遗落的曲谱，弗洛洛告诉你，乐曲是控制隐海试验场正常运转的核心，只有将它放回调律台将旋律调整回去，区域内才能恢复正常。你猜测这曲子是她创作的，她承认这是她与芬莱克合作的一部分后，你们打算将乐谱拿到调律台前将乐曲复原。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_能源场上层_1_9
records.text: So all this chaos was caused by Fenrico disrupting the composition?
records.zh: 你的意思是我们见到的失控，都是芬莱克把这首曲子打乱造成的。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_6
records.text: Fenrico likely hid the two music sheets separately to stall us.
records.zh: 芬莱克有可能将两段曲谱分开存放来拖住我们。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_6
records.text: Heh… Now I'm even more certain. Fenrico wanted us separated.
records.zh: 呵……你的反应让我更加确定，芬莱克一定会将我们分开，并将两段曲谱分开藏放。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_14
records.text: And if Fenrico's recording is real, who exactly was she trying to save when she created the Lost Beyond?
records.zh: 如果芬莱克的录音没有作假，那么弗洛洛创造失亡彼岸又是为了承载谁的意识？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_七丘主线_下半间章_1_1
records.text: Abby, what do you think Imperator wants me to find? If Cartethyia's right, the last clues should be somewhere on the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 阿布，你说英白拉多留给我的……会是什么呢？按照卡提希娅的说法，剩余的信息应该就遗留在七丘的桑古伊斯狩原。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_七丘主线_下半间章_1_1
records.text: I remember Lupa said there's this weird Blightcloud hanging over the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 我记得之前露帕说，桑古伊斯狩原的天上有一片怎么飘都飘不走的「黑潮云」。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: Hmph. I'm not blind to your tricks, Avidius. Do you really think 漂泊者 would take sides? With you?
records.zh: 嘁，别以为我不清楚你在打什么算盘，真以为漂泊者会站在你们那边？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: Even ones with decent Resonance powers like Avidius, she eats for breakfast.
records.zh: 像阿维狄亚那样共鸣力还算拿得出手的人，早就不知道打败多少个了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: Though... Avidius makes me rather uncomfortable. It's got nothing to do with his stance, it's... more of a hunch. Something about him feels... unnatural.
records.zh: 只是……那个阿维狄亚，总让我觉得不太舒服。不是立场上的，是……直觉。他有一种……不太真实的感觉……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_23_1
records.text: The elderly Priestess does not respond. Her gaze is fixed on the blazing flames, her mind seemingly far away, lost in another realm.
records.zh: 这位年长的女性没有回答你的疑问，她的双眸注视着炽热的焰光，灵魂似乎不在此处。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_赤林台地_3_1
records.text: Avidius, take a response team and get that Anchor Obelisk functioning.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，带上应急行动人员修复锚定界石。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_赤林台地_4_1
records.text: Avidius's team should be almost done, Augusta. I'll head over to join them.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔，阿维狄亚那边处理得差不多了。我去接应他。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
records.text:
You're invited to the Ephor's Palace to meet Septimont's Ephor, Augusta. After an exchange of swords, she shares a brief history of Septimont's hunting traditions and formally invites you to join the hunt for the Dark Tide and its creations in the Sanguis Plateaus.

You accept and share information about the Sentinel's Relic and the Journeying Paradise. Upon hearing this, Augusta suggests that the Earthrend Wedge in the hunting grounds may be where the Relic is hidden. Before parting, she tells you that a storm rising in the skies southeast of Septimont will mark the beginning of the hunt.
records.zh: 你应邀来到总督宫，如约见到了在此等候的七丘总督奥古斯塔。二人以剑交心后，奥古斯塔向你简述了七丘的狩猎历史，并正式邀你一同前往桑古伊斯狩原，追猎黑潮及其造物。你欣然应允，随后与奥古斯塔交换了有关岁主旧物及巡游天国的情报。闻言，奥古斯塔表示，位于狩原深处的彻地之楔或许正是岁主旧物的所在。临别前，奥古斯塔同你约定，当七丘城的东南方高天卷起风暴，即是你们启程之时。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
records.text: It's no exaggeration to say that the blood of Gladiators still burns in every inch of the crimson Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 毫不夸张地说，角斗士们沸腾的热血几乎灼烧着桑古伊斯狩原每一寸猩红的土地——

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
records.text: You've surely noticed the lingering Blightcloud that hovers over the Sanguis Plateaus. Since the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita, that place has become a breeding ground for its horrors.
records.zh: 你或许知道，桑古伊斯狩原的高空，盘桓着一片永恒不散的黑潮云。自黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发始，狩原就不幸沦为滋生黑潮造物的温床。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
records.text: Go to the Earthrend Wedge. It's where the Sentinel Imperator first descended upon the Sanguis Plateaus and is the "epicenter" of every hunt to this day.
records.zh: ……去彻地之楔看看吧，那是岁主英白拉多在桑古伊斯狩原的降临地，也是历来狩猎的“核心”所在。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_赤林台地_26_1
records.text: Makes for a fun challenge, don't you agree, Avidius?
records.zh: 但这才是有趣的挑战，不是吗？阿维狄亚。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_29_1
records.text: With all Anchor Stones in place, the hunting party tracks Tyrannos to Asphodel Barrens, a historical battlefield scarred by brutal conflicts between Gladiators and Dark Tide creations. Augusta, embracing her rivalry with fellow would-be Hero of Heroes Avidius, proposes they hunt the Corrosaurus together. The stakes are set for their eventual duel.
records.zh: 完成全部定向锚的架设后，一行人等追踪「暴君」来到往世花平野——这片荒野曾见证过无数角斗士与黑潮造物的生死交锋。面对同为“准王”候选的阿维狄亚，奥古斯塔选择直面挑战，主动邀其联手完成对蚀脊龙「暴君」的最终狩猎，以此作为两人正面对决的开端。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_29_1
records.text: This is a matter between Augusta and Avidius. We shall not intervene for the time being.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔和角斗士之间的事，暂时还不需要我们插手。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_29_1
records.text: Avidius, descendant of the Hero of Heroes, Atilius. Decorated for the four crossings of Manes Deep.
records.zh: 英雄王阿提留斯的后裔，因四度穿越玛涅斯之底而授勋的阿维狄亚。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_8_1
records.text: Seeing a storm form in the distance, you head for Tempest Cliffs, the agreed-upon meeting point. Along the way, you encounter the Gladiator Avidius, who's also bound for the hunt. He suggests traveling together.
records.zh: 到了约定之日，你按计划动身去往事先与奥古斯塔商定好的会合地点，风潮崖。途中，你偶遇同样要去参加狩猎的贵族角斗士阿维狄亚，在简短交谈后，他向你发出了同行的邀请。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_36_1
records.text: Before this hunt, Augusta and I investigated such Dark Tide irregularities at the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 在这次狩猎开始前，我和奥古斯塔提前调查了桑古伊斯狩原，确认了这次涨潮的不寻常。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
records.text: You contact Consultant Buling of the Black Shores. She reports that the Tethys System has detected the False Sovereign rapidly consuming nearby frequencies and growing stronger. Left unchecked, it could threaten the Earthrend Wedge and trigger a catastrophic collapse. To stop the Dark Tide's spread and intercept the Sovereign, you, Augusta, and the Gladiators set out for Murmurstown, the most frequency-rich area in the hunting grounds.
records.zh: 鉴于当前紧迫的局势，众人在临时营地的主营帐中与黑海岸客卿卜灵取得了联系。对方透露，泰缇斯系统已观测到伪作的神王正以一种令人不安的趋势吞噬频率、汲取力量，若任其继续壮大，势必将对彻地之楔构成严重威胁，甚至引发无可挽回的灾厄。为了遏止黑潮蔓延，你、奥古斯塔与众角斗士决议前往桑古伊斯狩原内频率最为集中的区域——呓语镇，追踪神王动向，并设法加以阻截。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
records.text: That's right. Her name is Buling. An interesting young lady. Left quite an impression on me.
records.zh: 没错，名字叫卜灵。有趣的小姑娘，我印象很深。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
records.text: Looks like it's east of the Sanguis Plateaus. Yeah, that place has lots of dark energy. Bet many tough people died there.
records.zh: ……好像是桑古伊斯狩原的东边，唔……那地界阴气不散，怕是之前出过大事，折过不少厉害人物呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
records.text: You recall what Iuno once shared with you—the plan she and Augusta devised to hunt down the Sovereign. Though that plan has since failed, you relay the details to Buling, backed by Augusta's permit.
records.zh: 你回想起尤诺曾向你透露，她与奥古斯塔原先暗中筹划过一项狩猎神王的计划。尽管那一计策终告失败，你仍依奥古斯塔的意思将其转告给了卜灵。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_40_1
records.text: Avidius, ready the Anchor Stones. We must set up a defense line around Murmurstown.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，准备好定向锚，我们需要在呓语镇筑起防线。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_1_1
records.text: Once consumed by the Dark Tide, the ruins of Murmurstown still bear its scars. In the face of such destruction, the hunting party knows this hunt cannot fail. Avidius offers to lead a team to place Anchor Stones around the town's perimeter, sealing off any escape routes. Meanwhile, you and Augusta will enter the ruins and track the Sovereign's presence.
records.zh: 一行人等按计划抵达呓语镇。在目睹了这座曾遭黑潮侵蚀、如今化为废墟的小镇后，你们深知这场狩猎不容有失。经简短商议，阿维狄亚决定和众角斗士留守外围，架设定向锚，以封锁神王可能的退路。而深入镇内，追踪隐匿形态的神王踪迹的任务，则由你与奥古斯塔承担。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_呓语镇_2_1
records.text: To speed up the search for the False Sovereign, you and Augusta split up. When you contact Buling for help, she explains that the Sovereign has absorbed Murmurstown's chaotic frequencies to mask its own, making it impossible for the Tethys System to locate it. To fix this, you and Abby set out to find a sample of pure Dark Tide frequency.
records.zh: 为了尽快找到伪作的神王，你与奥古斯塔选择分开行动。搜寻途中，你尝试联络卜灵，对方回应称，神王目前已吞噬融合了一部分呓语镇内繁杂紊乱的频率，这一情况导致现有的黑潮样本难以协助泰缇斯系统实现对神王的精准定位。若能设法找到纯净的黑潮频率并将其提供给黑海岸，确认神王的确切坐标将不再是难题。于是，你和阿布打算一同探索小镇，着手寻找相关线索。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_呓语镇_2_1
records.text: Hey Buling, can you help me track down the Sovereign?
records.zh: 卜灵，你那边能定位到神王的具体位置吗？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_9_1
records.text: Under Avidius's escort, you arrive at Tempest Cliffs. Once the hunting party is assembled, Augusta gives the order to begin the campaign.
records.zh: 在阿维狄亚的引领下，你顺利抵达风潮崖。见众人集结完毕，奥古斯塔当即下令，狩猎队伍随之启程。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_2_1
records.text: It was once called Fabianum—the town of Gladiators, visited by Fabius, the Hero of Heroes. But the Dark Tide claimed it in the end, leaving behind a scar Septimont will never forget.
records.zh: 确切地说，是被黑潮的阴影纠缠的角斗士小镇，英雄王法比乌昔日的造访地……七丘永恒的伤口——法比亚纳。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_43_1
records.text: But Fabianum never found its Hero of Heroes... Ever since then, the name was lost, replaced by Murmurstown, a scar that Septimont refuses to face...
records.zh: 可惜我的故乡没有盼来英雄王……在那之后不久，法比亚纳就成了七丘人羞于启齿的呓语镇……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_43_1
records.text: (Tell Augusta about the Unyielding Gladiator's Spirit.)
records.zh: （告知不屈角斗士“英灵”的情报。）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_13_1
records.text: If anyone can sniff out the truth, it's Abby. But just to be sure, I'll send the data to Buling once we're out of here.
records.zh: 阿布的鼻子不会有错，但以防万一，等离开「索诺拉」之后，我会把记录下来的数据传回给卜灵。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_13_1
records.text: More Phantoms appear inside Oak Hollow. Young Augusta rushes to Angel's side, believing the Whispers may have granted her the power to fend off the Dark Tide. But something is wrong. Just before her Phantom vanishes into a swirling vortex of pure Dark Tide frequency, Angel cries out, urging Augusta to flee. Stunned, you and Augusta collect the frequency and prepare to send it to Buling for analysis at the Black Shores.
records.zh: 橡树洞内，“虚影”重现：年少的奥古斯塔匆忙赶来，想要确认安吉尔的安危，然而树洞内却早已不见黑潮的踪影。奥古斯塔本以为安吉尔获得了传说中英雄王的力量击退了黑潮，可对方的状况却有些异常。在安吉尔用残存的理智呼喊奥古斯塔离开的瞬间，“虚影”消失了，而先前安吉尔所在的位置，缓缓浮现出一团来自纯净黑潮频率的回响。惊愕之余，你和奥古斯塔准备先将纯净黑潮频率的数据回传给卜灵，等待后续泰缇斯系统的分析结果。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_14_1
records.text: After leaving the Sonoro, you return to Murmurstown and send the pure Dark Tide frequency to Buling.
records.zh: 你们离开「索诺拉」返回到了呓语镇，并将收集到的纯净黑潮频率回传给了卜灵。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_15_1
records.text: Such devotion. Forgive me, but you seem to forget your place, Avidius.
records.zh: 如此尽心……阿维狄亚，恕我直言，你可能还不了解自己的处境。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_15_1
records.text: Wake up, Avidius. Isn't Murmurstown the very place where your glory began? That, Avidius, is your true arena.
records.zh: 清醒一些吧阿维狄亚，呓语镇难道不正是玛涅斯之底的所在、你大放异彩的竞技场吗？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_18_1
records.text:
The Sovereign's power grows exponentially after absorbing the pure Dark Tide frequencies sealed within Oak Hollow and the surrounding frequencies of deceased souls in Murmurstown. It now seeks to uproot the Earthrend Wedge and unleash the full force of the Dark Tide being suppressed beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Rinascita teeters on the brink of catastrophe.

However, Buling identifies a weakness in the Sovereign. Iuno proposes a plan to use the Anchor Stones to disrupt its internal frequency and reclaim control of the Wedge. To buy time for the plan to work, Iuno offers to put her own existence on the line by using her Forte to keep the Sovereign exposed. 

As the final battle approaches, she tells you that your "unknowable fate" might be the key to overcoming the crisis. She implores that you stand with Augusta until the very end.
records.zh:
在被尘封于橡树洞中的纯净黑潮频率的加持下，伪作的神王完成了瞬间的成长，它一举融合了呓语镇内大量亡故生灵的频率，并试图调集全部力量，控制、拔除彻地之楔，释放所有被压制于桑古伊斯狩原之下的黑潮。黎那汐塔危在旦夕。
面对绝境，卜灵结合卜算与泰缇斯系统提供的数据，分析出神王的弱点隐藏于其身形之内，黎那汐塔尚有一线生机。听闻这一线索，尤诺表示或可借助定向锚的力场，从神王的体内瓦解其形态，趁神王频率不稳之际夺回彻地之楔的控制权。为了确保计划能够顺利推进，尤诺不顾自身安危，决心再次消耗共鸣力维持神王显化，为你与奥古斯塔争取将定向锚送入神王内部的机会。
决战将至，临别之际，尤诺提及也许你那“不可知的命运”正是扭转危机的关键。她请求你，无论如何都要坚定地信任奥古斯塔，与她并肩战斗到最后一刻。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_20_1
records.text: The Anchor Stone Avidius and the others set there could come in handy.
records.zh: 之前阿维狄亚他们架设的定向锚，应该能用得上。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_21_1
records.text: Buling mentioned even something small could have a great influence. The smaller, the more unnoticed.
records.zh: 卜灵提起过，即便是微不足道的力道，也足够能达成我们的目标。既然如此……动手的时候，藏得越深越好。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_83_1
records.text: Meanwhile, in Murmurstown, Cristoforo finds the Holmleaf Medal lost by Avidius. The Playwright's work is not yet finished...
records.zh: 与此同时，在呓语镇中，克里斯托弗拾起阿维狄亚遗落的槲叶勋章。他的创作，似乎仍未画下句点……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_14_1
records.text: The Hunter's Den. The busiest Gladiator encampment across the Sanguis Plateaus. Nearly every hunter passes through here on their way to the hunting grounds.
records.zh: 狩猎者营地，桑古伊斯狩原最为繁忙的角斗士驻地，几乎每一位猎人都需经由此地前往猎场。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_14_1
records.text: Avidius was correct. It is a Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚说得没错，那是诞生自黑潮的残象。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_14_1
records.text: Only the Earthrend Wedge that bears Sentinel Imperator's power can sever the link between the Dark Tide and the Threnodian, burying the calamity deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 只有拥有岁主英白拉多力量的彻地之楔，可以切断黑潮与鸣式之间的那根脐带，将灾厄死死钉在桑古伊斯狩原的深渊之下。

records.text: The villagers said the copper coins on it have ties to Mengzhou's Nethermancers.
records.zh: 我们向其他村民打听过，这上面的铜钱与梦州的「寻幽客」有关。

records.text: It is Hsin's residence, and the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 那是「心」的行宫，也是玄方城的控制中枢所在。

records.text: His full name is Jingran. Sandao and I raised him. He followed at Sandao's heels, learned what he could, and became a Nethermancer himself.
records.zh: 全名叫景燃。他算是我和三刀抚养大的，跟着三刀有样学样，成了一名寻幽客。

records.text: (This is... the same music I heard after saying goodbye to Suisui.)
records.zh: （这是……在送穗穗走后听到过的琴声？）

records.text: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.
records.zh: 今州第一时间回应了我们的求援，但北落野近期出现了鸣式的异动，牵制住了夜归的主力。

records.text: Where is Suisui now? She hasn't left yet, has she?
records.zh: 穗穗现在在什么地方？她还没出发吧？

records.text: Suisui... are you sure you won't stay a few more days?
records.zh: 姐姐……真的不再多留几天吗？

records.text: So you're going back to Mengzhou to try to find answers.
records.zh: 你认为，这一切在梦州城，或许可以查出些什么。

records.text: Relax, darling. I am esteemed Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. The eldest daughter in a family of musicians. And... Yangyang's big sister!
records.zh: 放心吧，我可是堂堂「昭明商会」的理事长，声乐世家的大小姐，以及……秧秧的姐姐~

records.text: I trust you, Suisui. But if anything happens that you can't handle alone, you need to contact us.
records.zh: 穗穗，我相信你，但如果你遇到了什么解决不了的麻烦，一定要联系我们。

records.text: I only just heard you're heading back to Mengzhou.
records.zh: 我才刚知道，你要回梦州了。

records.text: It's very sudden, that's all. Has something pressing come up in Mengzhou?
records.zh: 突然回梦州城，是有什么要紧事吗？

records.text: Ovathrax, Retroact Rain, and the Gorges of Spirits... They're talking about the battle that occurred years ago.
records.zh: 无相燹主、溯洄雨、云陵谷……他们说的是那场发生在很久以前的战役。

records.text: I heard two moons appeared in the sky above the Gorges of Spirits. And the rain was going up, not down.
records.zh: 听说云陵谷那一带出现了两个月亮，雨水还倒着往天上飞。

records.text: The Cloud Shuttles and Autopuppets weren't bothered by that strange rain. After they cleared the Tacet Discords in Xuanfang, they went on to the Gorges of Spirits and destroyed the source of the outbreak.
records.zh: 不过云梭和机傀可不怕这种古怪的雨，解决完玄方地界的麻烦后，就到云陵谷把残象潮的源头打散了。

records.text: Yes. The war is over. Mingting's decree has been proclaimed. Huanglong is soon to have its sixth city.
records.zh: 是呀，仗打完了，明庭诏书也下来了，马上要有瑝珑的第六个州了。

records.text: This is the City of Mechanisms built with the aid of Mengzhou's Sentinel, right?
records.zh: 这里是梦州岁主所协助建造的机关城，对吗？

records.text: In a single day and night, from Yuan Fortress to the Gorges of Spirits, the Threnodian of War's vanguard was reduced to nothing.
records.zh: 只消一昼夜，从渊城到云陵谷，战争鸣式的先锋军便彻底化为乌有。

records.text: Now, our Shuttles provide reinforcement across all of Huanglong. One fleet has already left for the Norfall Barrens, to protect the newly founded Jinzhou City.
records.zh: 现在，云梭甚至可以支援瑝珑的其他区域。已有一批云梭前往了北落野，为新建的今州城保驾护航。

records.text: A pleasure. Welcome to Xuanfang Hold—or rather, to the Cloud Shuttle.
records.zh: 初次见面，欢迎来到我们的玄方城，或者说，云梭。

records.text: A Xuanfang Hold with no Sentinel, but a Transcendent who preaches mechanist arts...
records.zh: 这座玄方城没有岁主，却有一位传授机关术的仙人……

records.text: Liangyu passes along a message from Granny Yanshu: Jingran is back. You decide to go see him.
records.zh: 椋羽给你带来了烟舒婆婆的话，你得知景燃回来了。你决定去见见他。

records.text: (I still have Jingran's Qingfu pendant. It's time to return it.)
records.zh: （我身上还带着景燃的青蚨挂饰，是时候去还给他了。）

records.text: Jingran, I think it's time... to give you this back.
records.zh: 景燃，这个挂饰……也该物归原主了。

records.text: Hey, remember that Bladepuppet incident in Mengzhou... what, ten, fifteen years back?
records.zh: 说起来，你还记得十多年前，在梦州城的那次刃偶事故嘛？

records.text: Ah... Lady Suoming. What brings you to Xuanfang?
records.zh: 原来……是锁暝女士。你怎么来了玄方地界？

records.text: So, you are the Jinzhou Patroller seconded to Mengzhou?
records.zh: 你就是那名借调梦州的今巡尉？

records.text: So... this Xuanfang Hold isn't as perfect as it seems.
records.zh: 这座空中的玄方城……并没有看上去那么美好。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_39_1
records.text: Qingxiao confides that, as far as she can recall, most of the Artisans aboard this Shuttle are among those who perished when Yuan Fortress self-destructed. Back then, the last Artisans and soldiers holding the Fortress had no choice but to detonate it to prevent the Tacet Discords from reaching Mengzhou. Qingxiao had been in the Gorges of Spirits supporting local forces at the time, and by the time she returned to Xuanfang, Yuan Fortress was already in ruins, and with it, those who had made their final stand there.
records.zh: 清宵向你坦言，云梭上大部分的工匠在她的印象里，都是当年随着渊城自毁而逝去的人。当年最后留守渊城的工匠和军人不得已只能亲自炸毁城池来阻止残象进入梦州。当时，清宵在云陵谷支援当地守军，等她赶回玄方地界，渊城已化作了一片废墟。

records.text: No. I was... with the defending troops in the Gorges of Spirits.
records.zh: 不，当时……我在云陵谷支援当地的守军。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_45_1
records.text: Conditions around Xuanfang Hold continue to worsen: more Censure Courts have gone dark, and Tacet Discord hordes are closing in. As Yangyang rallies the vanguard troops before battle in her new role as Xuan Watcher, Liangyu returns, recovered and ready to fight alongside her. Together with the soldiers, they prepare to meet the oncoming hordes.
records.zh: 玄方城周边的情况正在恶化，更多的咎庭停摆了，残象潮在逼近玄方城。秧秧以后玄骑使的身份给担任先锋的将士们做了战前动员。此时椋羽伤愈归来，准备与秧秧并肩作战。她们与将士们即将迎战来袭的残象潮。

records.text: 漂泊者, Paragon Qingxiao... It's been so long...
records.zh: 漂泊者……清宵司骑……这么久了……

records.text: Please, Qingxiao. You both have to keep going.
records.zh: 清宵，拜托你们了，请继续前进吧。

records.text: ...Xuanfang Hold and its people will survive.
records.zh: ……玄方城所有人都会活下来。

records.text: Up at last? Suisui's already on her way to Mengzhou City, and Yangyang's out on routine patrol.
records.zh: 你醒了？穗穗刚启程去梦州城，秧秧去参加例行巡逻了。

records.text: This is the path Suisui described. But I'm not seeing any of the Disorienting Fog she mentioned.
records.zh: 这确实是穗穗曾走过的路线。但她曾提到过的隐息雾，这一路上似乎没有出现。

records.text: Promise me, Qingxiao. No more carrying everything alone.
records.zh: 清宵，答应我，以后别再一个人硬撑了。

records.text: (The cabin has been affected by the fog. Qingxiao...)
records.zh: （这舱室似乎受到了雾气的影响……清宵……）

records.text: That day, the Xuanling Bird told you the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress were burning. Where did you go?
records.zh: 那一天，玄翎雀告诉你云陵谷和渊城都陷入了战火，你下山去了哪？

records.text: You are back at the Gorges of Spirits... The battlefield that haunts you. Your fear. Your regret.
records.zh: 你又回到了云陵谷……你记忆深处的战场，你的恐惧，你的遗憾。

records.text: We lost the Central Plains... They came too fast...
records.zh: 中曲台地失守了，这次的残象潮……来得太突然……

records.text: From Yuan Fortress, to the Gorges of Spirits, to the Land of Xuanfang... No matter how hard I try, my sword cannot save everyone.
records.zh: 渊城、云陵谷、玄方城……无论怎么努力，我的剑始终救不下所有人。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_6_心魔幻境_37_1
records.text: As Qingxiao wakes, you finally meet within her inner landscape. She has come to understand the path she will walk from here on. She tells you of the Fortress and Gorges War two hundred years ago, and how the two of you once crossed paths at the Gorges of Spirits. Even when aid offers no guarantee of a good end, you will both still follow your hearts and do all you can. In this shared calling to protect, neither of you stands alone. Fellow guardians at heart, you lay yourselves bare to one another, and Qingxiao sets aside her reserve and claims you as her disciple.
records.zh: 随着清宵醒来，你们终于在心湖中相见。清宵已悟出了她今后要走的道。她道出了两百年前的云渊之役，你们曾在云陵谷相遇的事。即使出手不一定会有好结果，你们也始终会遵从本心，尽力而为。在这条守护的道路上你们并不孤单。同为守护者的你们彼此交心，清宵决定坦荡一些，认你做她的徒弟。

records.text: ...From now on, please just call me Qingxiao.
records.zh: ……之后，请直接叫我清宵吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_地境接舷战_80_1
records.text: Simulating... Xuanfang Hold... Reconstructing... Future possibilities converged...
records.zh: 推演……玄方……重塑……可能性已收束……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_地境接舷战_82_1
records.text: Jingran, we'll fly up there on swords. What about you?
records.zh: 景燃，我们会御剑穿过去，你呢？

records.text: The wound was fatal. It must have been the strike Jingran landed earlier.
records.zh: 身上的创口是致命伤，应该就是景燃留下来的。

records.text: In short... Xuanfang Hold has weathered the storm.
records.zh: 简而言之……玄方城算是安然地度过了此次危难。

records.text: (Suisui seems to want to discuss something. I'd better head to the Ministry of War and find Yangyang first.)
records.zh: （穗穗似乎有事要联络我们，先去军策府和秧秧会合吧。）

records.text: Alright, alright. Enough flattery, you two. Let's talk business. I'm speaking as Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild now.
records.zh: 好啦好啦，你们就不要互相捧对方了。接下来——我该以「昭明商会」理事的身份来谈正事了。

records.text: My training hall is at the summit of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Are you available?
records.zh: 我的道馆在东岳的山峰上。你可有空？

records.text: Hmm, Suisui did mention an informant who met her outside Fogveil Pagoda before—
records.zh: 之前，穗穗提到过一位和她在雾隐阁外接头的线人——

records.text: By order of General Jiyan, our unit has arrived to provide reinforcements.
records.zh: 我部奉忌炎将军命令，特来驰援。

records.text: We'd like to know what this pendant means in Mengzhou.
records.zh: 我们想知道这件挂饰，在梦州有什么来历。

records.text: Well, she is the master of the Xuanyuan School in the Eastern Xuan Peaks. The only Perfected One in all of Xuanfang. She has watched over this land for centuries.
records.zh: 当然有，她可是玄幽东岳上那个玄元门的门主，玄方地界唯一的「真人」，庇护这里数百年了。

records.text: It took Suoming too. Do you know where she is now?
records.zh: 还有被祂抓走的锁暝，你知道现在她在哪里么？

records.text: The future of Mengzhou and Jinzhou rests on this.
records.zh: 梦州与今州日后的时局皆系于此。

records.text: You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.
records.zh: 你就是棠宁吧？锁暝州监在等你。

records.text: But you're the one who's been protecting Xuanfang Hold...
records.zh: 但，一直以来守护玄方城的人是你……

records.text: Liangyu told me you went into the Sanctum with that Ministry of Sentinel Affairs Intendant... Are you all right?
records.zh: 听椋羽说，你已经和谛天鉴的那位州监进入了神宫……一切还好吗？

records.text: Has Hsin reclaimed more of Her authority? Or... did Suoming do something?
records.zh: 或许是心收回了更多权限，还是锁暝做了什么……

records.text: Yes! Intendant Suoming, may all be well in Hsin's keeping.
records.zh: 嗯！锁暝州监，祝您心驭万全。

records.text: Sister Suoming, did Huating become a better place after we killed off the "Evil Miasma"?
records.zh: 锁暝姐姐，「恶瘴」死后，华亭变好了吗？

records.text: Look, Sister Suoming! Doesn't that look like the mechanism teapot the Lord Second Seal made?
records.zh: 锁暝姐姐你看，这像不像二老爷自己做的机关茶壶？

records.text: Sister Suoming, these Autopuppets... Did the Sentinel abandon them here?
records.zh: 锁暝姐姐，这些机傀……「岁主」大人不管它们了？

records.text: Your timely aid is much appreciated, Intendant Suoming. I have heard much of you.
records.zh: 感谢相助，锁暝州监，久仰。

records.text: And you are just like us, Intendant Suoming. That we do know.
records.zh: 锁暝州监，我们知道，您也是如此。

records.text: Hehe. And that's why I came back, Sister Suoming.
records.zh: 嘿嘿，所以我又回来啦，锁暝姐姐。

records.text: That isn't a bad thing. You needn't dwell on the past anyway, Sister Suoming.
records.zh: 那也挺好的，锁暝姐姐不需要停在过去嘛。

records.text: I've been waiting for you, little Suoming. Did you enjoy the journey?
records.zh: 锁暝妹妹，可算等到你了，这一路，玩得开心吗？

records.text: Our cause began in Huating. We refused to bow to a "greater good" that treated lives as expendable.
records.zh: 我等自华亭而起，本就是不服大局为先，视小我如草芥。

records.text: The "Evil Miasma" was a blight, but it pales before the sins of Huating's rulers who fed their own people to it.
records.zh: 「恶瘴」区区邪祟，可比华亭主簿将民众推向城外，饲于其口？

records.text: This is Her at the very start of Xuanfang Hold's construction.
records.zh: 刚开始建造玄方城的祂。

records.text: You do realize that the faster Xuanfang Hold is completed... the sooner you—
records.zh: 你们应该知道，玄方城的进度越是提前，你们……

records.text: Xuanfang Hold's defense formations... Are they being hacked?
records.zh: 这是玄方城的防御阵列……被控制了？

records.text: Using the Civilization Capsule to hasten Xuanfang Hold's completion...
records.zh: 用文明之匣催生玄方城完工……

records.text: ...Since the shift change two nights ago, Ovathrax launched a surprise raid at Desorock Highland, pushing straight toward the Clouded Cliffs.
records.zh: ……自前日后夜时，无相燹主趁机傀换防的间隙，于荒石高地处发动突袭，一路袭往夜明坡。

records.text: How is our communication with Mingting? Any news?
records.zh: 向明庭发出的联络如何了，有消息了吗？

records.text: The situation at the Gorges of Spirits is no better. We have to rely on these Autopuppets...
records.zh: 云陵谷那边的情况应该也不乐观，只能靠机傀了……

records.text: A message came from the Central Plains. Only two words—
records.zh: 中曲台地的兵士们发来传信，信中只有两个字——

records.text: She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
records.zh: 她说……她是梦州谛天鉴的州监。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_7_梦枢天罗_5_2
records.text:
You come upon a family in the middle of an argument. Wanhong, an old man, refuses to leave the Land of Xuanfang, the only home he has ever known. His daughter Qingchen, however, is convinced the Hold is heading for another disaster and insists on moving the family out.
 
As father and daughter stand at an impasse, Qingxiao receives word from Liangyu: a woman claiming to be an Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs tried to force her way into the Sanctum and was stopped by the Wardens.

You decide to head to the Sanctum and find out what's happening.
records.zh:
你们遇到了正在争执的一家人，老人挽鸿不愿离开生活了一生的玄方地界，而他的女儿青沉则担忧玄方城又生变故，打算举家搬离，就在父女僵持间，清宵接到了椋羽的通讯——一位自称是谛天鉴州监的人试图私自闯入神宫，被定玄卫拦下。
你们决定前往神宫了解情况。

records.text: Then take the Civilization Capsule to the Sentinel in Mengzhou
records.zh: 也就该带着「文明之匣」回到梦州，交给岁主大人啦

records.text: What's that... Suoming gave it to you, didn't she?
records.zh: 怎么还拿着这种东西……是锁暝给你的吧。

records.text: Hsin, we'll discuss this more after we find Suoming and handle Suhsin.
records.zh: 心，等找到锁暝，解决溯心后我们再谈吧。

records.text: From my position, I speak from the perspective of Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
records.zh: 按我的位置，自然要站在梦州谛天鉴的角度说话。

records.text: Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming?
records.zh: 如何？对锁暝州监还有什么异议吗？

records.text: That uniform... they're from Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
records.zh: 这副装扮……是梦州谛天鉴的人。

records.text: If it had been you, she might still be here today...
records.zh: 若换做你，她今日或许还在此处……

records.text: The Arbiter and Suoming will not give it the chance.
records.zh: 御者和锁暝不会给祂机会。

records.text: Watcher Liangyu... The way you carry yourself reminds me of an old friend.
records.zh: 椋羽骑使……身形气质，确有故人之姿。

records.text: What will become of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?
records.zh: 「梦枢天罗」之后会如何？

records.text: Seal Master, Boss, Sister Suoming... They had many names for me.
records.zh: 契主，老大，锁暝姐姐……都有。

records.text: Yes... They were willing to die for Huating. Still, I hated the Sentinel for never reaching out to help us.
records.zh: 嗯……他们愿为华亭而死，但我愤恨于「岁主」从未向我们伸出援手。

records.text: Mingting has long coordinated the Ministries of Sentinel Affairs across every city, seeking greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels.
records.zh: 明庭始终在联合各州谛天鉴，探寻瑝珑岁主更多的可能性。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_7_心相迷宫&后日谈_3_9
records.text:
You ask Suoming what became of the people of Mengzhou during the century after Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox was struck down, while "Hsin" was away remolding the Civilization Capsule. Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon called the "Evil Miasma" spread across Mengzhou. Suoming's homeland, Huating, was ravaged as well, and countless lives were lost. The Sentinel, bound by Its own injuries, could offer no help. Suoming took up the title of Intendant and led the Ministry's members against the disaster, each of them carrying a "Providence Lock" the Sentinel had made imbued with Its power. Over the years, the situation in Mengzhou began to stabilize.
 
Suoming tells you that Mingting is working with the Ministries of every city to seek greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels, and that when the time is ripe, you will be needed to act as Arbiter.
records.zh: 你向锁暝询问心月狐遇刺后，心重塑 “文明之匣” 的百年间梦州百姓的状况：岁主遇刺后名为 “恶瘴” 的海蚀现象在梦州蔓延，锁暝的故乡华亭亦受“恶瘴”威胁，生灵涂炭。彼时岁主受困于伤势无法伸出援手，锁暝接过州监之位，带领谛天鉴成员佩戴岁主所制的 “锦妙锁” 对抗危难，令梦州局势趋于稳定。锁暝告诉你，明庭正联合各州谛天鉴探寻瑝珑岁主的更多可能性，待到时机成熟时需御者介入。

records.text: My homeland, Huating, was ravaged by it. Countless lives were lost.
records.zh: 我的故乡华亭受「恶瘴」威胁，生灵涂炭。

records.text: It seems... that "time" is now. Watcher Liangyu, kindly let her through.
records.zh: 看来……那个“时机”就是现在了，椋羽骑使，还请放行。

records.text: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.
records.zh: 昭明商会会给我们提供沿途的掩护，除此以外还有三位身手不错的能人异士。

records.text: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.
records.zh: 而且，兴许是因为御者在今州击退了无相燹主，梦州属地这段时间也很太平。

records.text: The Tacet Discord Outbreak at the Gorges of Spirits grows fiercer every day, and the Threnodian is showing signs of waking... At this rate, even Mengzhou won't come out unscathed.
records.zh: 云陵谷的残象潮愈发猖獗，鸣式亦有苏醒征兆……长此以往，梦州也无法全身而退啊。

records.text: Jingran is surrounded on all sides by children clamoring for a story.
records.zh: 景燃正被缠着他听故事的孩子们团团围住。

records.text: You'd never guess. Lady Hsin came and repaired it Herself!
records.zh: 想不到吧，这是心大人亲自来修的！

records.text: Agh, just a bit earlier and I'd have caught it... I really wanted to see how Lady Hsin did it in person!
records.zh: 唉……要是我再早来一点就好了……真想亲眼看看心大人是怎么做到的！

records.text: The way it shifts very much resembles Mengzhou's Automata Mechanics.
records.zh: 这变形的模样和梦州机关术很像。

records.text: Behind us stands Xuanfang Hold! No retreat! We fight!
records.zh: 身后便是玄方城！无路可退！唯有一战！

records.text: So this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou today. I wouldn't have guessed...
records.zh: 如今的「梦枢天罗」，竟是这样一番景象……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_7_梦枢天罗_9_1
records.text:
You emerge from the mist into a serene landscape of Xuanfang mountains and waterways. It is not what Suoming expected, and her face betrays her surprise. She tells you this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou—the framework that underpins Xuanfang Hold's fundamental order. You wonder if it might be connected to the Civilization Capsule.

In the distance, among the peaks, a massive silhouette catches your eye.
records.zh:
走出迷雾，呈现在眼前的是怡人的玄方山水。面对眼前与预想中的神宫有些不同的景致，锁暝显得有些惊讶，她告诉你这里是「梦枢天罗」，司掌着玄方城的底层秩序，你推测这里或许与「文明之匣」有关。
你注意到远山之间，似乎有一个巨大的人影。

records.text: She's the Sentinel. Her every move could affect Xuanfang Hold's safety.
records.zh: 毕竟祂身为岁主，一举一动都可能牵扯到玄方城的安危。

records.text: (Suoming didn't seem like she'd lost control. She let herself be taken on purpose.)
records.zh: （锁暝不像是没有把握，她是故意被抓走的。）

records.text: (Last time I saw Intendant Suoming, I was still a fresh recruit.)
records.zh: （上次见锁暝州监都是我刚加入组织的时候了。）

records.text: (I heard Intendant Suoming dislikes anything bitter-tasting. These rice cakes might just be...)
records.zh: （我记得有锁暝州监不喜苦味的传闻，或许这份粘糕……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_37_1
records.text: Miss Ciaccona… you… you're not afraid of them?
records.zh: 夏空女士，您……不害怕它们吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_12_1
records.text: Her Tacet Mark... Look, it's flickering! Cantarella, she's...
records.zh: 卡提希娅的声痕……还在闪烁！坎特蕾拉，她……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_12_1
records.text: ...Cantarella, you never did get to say what brought you here.
records.zh: ……坎特蕾拉，之前的事你还没有说完，你为什么会来到颠倒塔？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_12_1
records.text:
The strange woman you saw in Cristoforo's "illusion" suddenly appears and shoots Cartethyia right before your eyes. She then summons an unfamiliar Tacet Discord that blocks Cantarella's attack before vanishing. You want to go after her immediately, but instead choose to stay and try to revive Cartethyia, clinging to a faint hope... But Cantarella tells you that her frequency has completely vanished.
 
Rage flares within you. You realize that the scene matches what you saw in the "illusion."
 
Just then, Cartethyia's Tacet Mark flickers, sparking a glimmer of hope. Cantarella senses that although Cartethyia's frequency is gone, she is still resonating with something.
 
After steadying yourself, you uncover more anomalies within the Tower. To protect Cartethyia's body, Cantarella takes her to the Fisalia estate, and you and Abby set out to track down the killer.
records.zh:
颠倒塔中，你曾在“幻境”中见过的神秘女子突然闯入，在你的面前“射杀”了卡提希娅，并召唤出一只古怪的残象，抵挡下坎特蕾拉的攻击后消失不见。虽欲追杀凶手，但你看着怀中的卡提希娅，还是决定先行治疗，为她争夺一线生机……然而，治疗过后，坎特蕾拉只能表示：卡提希娅的频率已经完全消失。
你愤怒地看向凶手离去的方向……却突然意识到，这番情景，与你在“幻境”中所看到的画面几乎完全重合。
而在此时，卡提希娅的声痕突然亮起，本以为这代表着一丝希望，坎特蕾拉却在感应后道出了更加诡异的事实：卡提希娅的频率虽然消失，但她仍在和什么保持着共鸣。
冷静过后，你也在颠倒塔中发现了更多的疑点……为了查明真相，卡提希娅由坎特蕾拉带回家族的宅邸保护，你则与阿布一同飞出颠倒塔，前去追踪凶手的下落。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_13_1
