records.text: Yes, she's on my radar. I suspect the recent Tacet Discord outbreak in Ragunna City is tied to her presence.
records.zh: 嗯，我也在尝试调查她。我怀疑，拉古那城爆发的残象潮，与她脱不了干系……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_13_1
records.text: Wait, Ragunna City was attacked by a TD Outbreak?
records.zh: 等等，你说拉古那城遭到了残象潮袭击？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_13_1
records.text: Of course. Even if she didn't cause the outbreak in Ragunna City, the connection is undeniable.
records.zh: 拉古那城出现的是黑潮造物，即使这场异变不是因她而起，二者也一定存在什么联系……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_15_1
records.text: During your pursuit of the Thundering Mephis, you learn that Avidius originally came to Ragunna in search of the Quillbearer. But along the way, he discovered something far more meaningful, a chance to be the master of his own destiny…
records.zh: 在追踪“云闪之鳞”的过程中，你得知阿维狄亚本为寻找“执笔之人”而来到拉古那，却在旅途中发觉了更有意义之事，准备由自己重新书写自己的命运……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_1_1
records.text: Mmm—mmm—! Can you smell that? Sweet o' Margherita's Restaurant. C'mon, c'mon, let's go stuff our faces already!
records.zh: 嗯——嗯——大老远就能闻到玛格烈特餐厅的香气，真想现在就去饱餐一顿。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_1_1
records.text: Look! Over there! Isn't that Brant and Roccia? Wow, the Troupe of Fools is putting on a show!
records.zh: 你看，那不是布兰特和洛可可他们吗？喔——愚人剧团正在演出呢！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_1_1
records.text:
On your earlier journey through Septimont, you recovered the Sentinel's Relic from the Earthrend Wedge. To unlock it, you returned to the Black Shores seeking Tethys's aid. Its analysis revealed it to be the Civilization Capsule, likely containing the Sentinel's legacy data. But for reasons unknown, it requires the combined forces of both the Sentinel and the Threnodian to open. With no clear solution, you return once again to Ragunna, hoping to find answers from Cartethyia in the Inverted Tower.

Back in Ragunna, however, the atmosphere is thick with a strange tension. The only splash of color comes from a Troupe of Fools performance. As you and Abby pause to watch, Cristoforo's whisper slips into your ear...
records.zh:
在先前七丘的旅途中，你从彻地之楔处取得了岁主遗留的旧物，为将其打开，你曾回归黑海岸寻求泰缇斯的帮助。而经泰缇斯分析，你得知这个名为「文明之匣」的物件，里面很可能封存了岁主留下的重要底层数据，只是不知为何……它却需要“岁主与鸣式的两股力量”合同才能开启。因此，你再一次回到了拉古那，准备前往颠倒塔寻找卡提希娅，向她询问办法。
再度踏足拉古那城，你与阿布却察觉城中氛围有些异常的压抑，唯有一抹亮色映入眼帘——「愚人剧团」正在演出。你与阿布驻足观看，而克里斯托弗的低语，却不合时宜地在你耳畔传来……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_17_1
records.text: Together, you and Avidius follow the trail of the Dark Tide and discover a Paradimensional Tacet Field that shouldn't be there. Seeking the truth, you step boldly into it…
records.zh: 你与阿维狄亚一路追寻着黑潮的踪迹，发现了一处本不该存在的异维无音区。为了追查到更多情报，你们毅然决定踏入此处……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_18_1
records.text: What happened? Where's Avidius? We crossed inside at the same time.
records.zh: 怎么回事？阿维狄亚消失不见了？我们明明是同一时间跨越的入口。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_19_1
records.text: I'm fine... So, it's gone? Avidius, did you see anything after we got separated?
records.zh: 我没事……异维无音区消失了？阿维狄亚，刚才我们分开后，你有遇到些什么吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_20_1
records.text: They're in Averardo Vault. The Dark Tide creations could be appearing there.
records.zh: ……是埃弗拉德金库。黑潮造物……可能在那里出现了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: Evacuation here is still on track. No anomalies detected in Averardo Vault… yet.
records.zh: 居民转移工作正在有序进行，目前埃弗拉德金库这边，还没有任何异常发生。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: Your assistance is appreciated, Sir Avidius. The residents from Egla Town have all been accounted for.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚先生，感谢您的协助，「庇护所」已经成功接收到埃格拉小镇的居民。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: You and Avidius rush there, only to find most civilians already evacuated, with no signs of Dark Tide creations. Just as doubt begins to set in, the sound of familiar gunfire echoes through the Vault...
records.zh: 你与阿维狄亚赶至埃弗拉德金库，只是得知拉古那的平民大部分已完成转移，并未发现任何与黑潮造物有关的痕迹。正当你疑惑之时，熟悉的枪声却在金库上方传来……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_21_1
records.text: But... the Troupe of Fools hit a storm while ferrying people from the Riccioli Islands. Rough seas out there.
records.zh: 但……愚人剧团在接应黎乔利群岛的住民时，似乎在海上遇到了大风暴……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
records.text: Galbrena, demon wrought from ruin! You are not welcome here.
records.zh: 嘉贝莉娜，来自地狱的火魔……这里，不欢迎你。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
records.text: (And Fenrico... he knew innocents were here, but didn't hold back at all...)
records.zh: （而且芬莱克，他明明知道这里聚集着大量民众，却对此视若无睹，攻击没有任何收敛的迹象……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
records.text: Unless... You're not Fenrico at all. You... Who are you? What do you want?
records.zh: 除非……你不是芬莱克。你……到底是什么人？你的目的又是什么？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
records.text:
Following the gunshots, you witness what appears to be the Discord Slayer firing on civilians, only to realize these "civilians" are actually Dark Tide creations, Tidespawn, in disguise. Avidius accuses her of corrupting them with the very Dark Tide power she wields... 

Suddenly, Fenrico, meant to be stationed at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, appears. He calls the woman "Galbrena" and unleashes a devastating assault. Galbrena takes the blow to shield the civilians behind her. When "Fenrico" demands that you give him the Civilization Capsule, you begin to doubt his true intentions.
 
Tensions erupt. Though pierced by Fenrico's sword, Galbrena "rises from death." Dismissing his words, she hurls her lantern-like Terminal into the air, where it detonates, scattering the Light of Genesis. The burst reveals more disguised Tidespawn as battle erupts…
records.zh:
你们循着枪声前往埃弗拉德金库的上层平台，目睹了“猎魔人”射杀人类的景象……但随后，她却向你们展示了另一个真相：这些“人类”，都是黑潮的造物。阿维狄亚却怀疑，黑潮能够腐化其他造物，而她同样拥有黑潮的力量……
此时，本该身处隐海试验场的芬莱克主座却于此现身，道出女子“嘉贝莉娜”的名号，并对她展开了大范围攻击。而嘉贝莉娜为保护身后的平民，被芬莱克的攻击径直贯穿。“芬莱克”的行为很快令你做出判断，对方也直接表明了来意——他要求你将手中的“文明之匣”交给他。
剑拔弩张之时，被贯穿的“嘉贝莉娜”却“死而复生”。面对“芬莱克”的诡辩，她将腰间的提灯终端抛向空中引爆，起源的光辉如雨泼洒，一众伪装成人类的黑潮造物也终于现出原形。一场战斗也随之爆发……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_24_1
records.text: Avidius, you have received the blessing of my Master. Serve... your true Divinity.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，你已接受过我主的赐福，理应侍奉于……你的神明。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_黑匣子_1_1
records.text: But why does it open up now? Was it when Avidius and I made contact?
records.zh: 但为什么文明之匣会突然开启……是刚才阿维狄亚和我接触到它的时候……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_2_1
records.text: That was Cristoforo's voice just now... Is this another one of his illusions?
records.zh: 进入前有听到克里斯托弗的声音……又是他制造出的幻境吗？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_黑匣子_1_4
records.text:
Amidst the chaos, the Civilization Capsule is accidentally opened through your contact with Avidius, pulling you into its inner space.
 
There, you finally hear Imperator's last message about Rinascita and the origins of Leviathan…
records.zh:
混战之中，「文明之匣」因你和阿维狄亚的接触意外开启，将你卷入了它内部的空间。
你也终于听见了英白拉多最后的留言，那关于黎那汐塔，以及利维亚坦的起源……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_黑匣子_1_6
records.text: You think it's Avidius? But you carry the Dark Tide's power too...
records.zh: 你在怀疑阿维狄亚。但……你同样拥有能够驱使黑潮的力量……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_黑匣子_1_7
records.text: You have access to core data. But Avidius, he might've been swept into the frequency vortex. Hard to say where he's landed.
records.zh: 你拥有核心数据层的权限，而阿维狄亚可能早已被频率洪流卷入，被送出了这里……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_25_1
records.text: Sir Avidius made it out of the rift before you.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚先生，先于你们从那个异空间出来了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_25_1
records.text: I left a mark on Avidius during our fight earlier. With Balor's power, I can tap into his sight. We'll find his trail.
records.zh: 先前战斗时，我在阿维狄亚身上留了一个标记。利用「巴罗尔」的力量，我可以共享他的视觉，寻找他的踪迹。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_25_1
records.text: Dark clouds are gathering over Thessaleo Fells... Something is definitely wrong.
records.zh: 黑云也正在往狄萨莱海脊聚集……一定有什么异常发生了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_25_1
records.text:
Escaping the Civilization Capsule with Galbrena, you learn that the Averardo Vault crisis has passed, but Avidius has vanished.

Using her abilities, Galbrena tracks his location, and together you ride her wind trail toward Thessaleo Fells.
records.zh:
你与嘉贝莉娜自文明之匣中脱出，埃弗拉德金库的危机也已过去，只是……阿维狄亚已不知所踪。
嘉贝莉娜利用能力定位到了阿维狄亚的去向，同时借助她开辟的风轨，你们“走空路”迅速赶往狄萨莱海脊。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_26_1
records.text: We've entered Thessaleo Fells. I can already sense the Tidespawn up ahead...
records.zh: 已经进入狄萨莱海脊的范围了。我能感知到，已经有黑潮造物出现了……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_27_1
records.text: It's very likely Avidius. Right now, everything is riding on us finding him.
records.zh: 很可能是因为阿维狄亚，我们必须尽快找到他。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_27_1
records.text: That Septimontian Gladiator... Our scouts saw him advancing into the depths of Thessaleo Fells.
records.zh: 那位七丘的角斗士……我们看见他向狄萨莱海脊的深处进发了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_27_1
records.text: Thessaleo Fells... It's already... Attention! Deploy all Acolytes to set up temporary Resonance Beacons. Scattering the Light of Genesis will hold back the Tidespawn!
records.zh: 狄萨莱海脊竟然已经……驱役所的成员，立刻架设临时信标，散播起源之光，阻止黑潮造物靠近！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_27_1
records.text: Acolyte Phoebe! A cluster of Tidespawn is marching toward the depths of Thessaleo Fells！
records.zh: 菲比大人，有一部分黑潮造物的频率，正在不断往狄萨莱海脊的深处聚集！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_27_1
records.text:
Tidespawn have already swarmed Thessaleo Fells. There, you witness the true horror of the Dark Tide. Facing Gilberto, who is on the verge of becoming a Tidespawn himself, Cantarella makes the painful choice to end his suffering and preserve his humanity in death.

The departed may rest, but the living must carry on. Avidius has already set out toward the depths of the Fells. Meanwhile, the Acolytes of the Order arrive in time to clear a path for you.
records.zh:
黑潮造物已经在狄萨莱海脊涌现，你也目睹了黑潮真正的恐怖之处……面对即将被转化为黑潮造物的吉尔贝，坎特蕾拉怀着悲痛的心情，给予了吉尔贝解脱，为他保留了至死为人的尊严。
……逝者已逝，生者仍需继续前行。阿维狄亚已经向海脊深处进发，隐海修会的教士们也在此刻赶到，为你们开辟出了一条道路。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_29_1
records.text: But after I left that space, I suddenly felt the Tidespawn's movements. They were converging on Thessaleo Fells. I still wanted... to do something, anything, to stop the devastation.
records.zh: 离开那片空间后，我突然感知到了黑潮造物的动向，它们正在往狄萨莱海脊行进。我仍想……做点什么，去阻止灾难的发生。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_29_1
records.text:
In the depths of Thessaleo Fells, you finally find Avidius. But he has already been implanted with Caligula's memories and deeply corrupted by the Dark Tide.

Sensing the stirrings of Tidespawn, he came here intending to stop the disaster. But his arrival awakened the Fisalias' oldest memories, calling forth countless Tidespawn...

Fate's cruel joke breaks his spirit. He descends into madness, becoming the Mad King Caligula, and raises his blade against you...
records.zh:
在狄萨莱海脊的深处，你们终于找到了阿维狄亚……此时的他，已经被利维亚坦植入了“卡利古拉”的记忆，遭受了黑潮的深度侵蚀。
因感知到黑潮造物的动向，阿维狄亚本想前往海脊阻止灾难，可他的到来，却导致翡萨烈的古老记忆被提前唤醒，无数黑潮造物也因他涌现……
命运的嘲弄使他的精神逐渐崩溃，他逐渐化作“疯王·卡利古拉”，对你们举起了锋刃……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_30_3
records.text: Avidius! Remember who you are. Remember the man you wanted to become!
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，记住你是谁，记住你要成为什么样的人！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_31_1
records.text: Avidius! Remember who you are. Remember the man you wanted to become...
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，记住你是谁，记住你要成为什么样的人……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_42_1
records.text: The Tidespawn have fully retreated. The situation around Thessaleo Fells is improving.
records.zh: 黑潮造物已经尽数退去，狄萨莱海脊的情况有所好转了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_42_1
records.text: Seems like the Order has already transported most of the wounded to Averardo Vault.
records.zh: 看起来，那些受伤的伤员，也已经被修会转运至埃弗拉德金库了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_33_1
records.text: When I was absorbing the Tidespawn, I felt it. Avidius was also born of the Dark Tide.
records.zh: 方才，在吸收黑潮造物时，我确实有感知到，阿维狄亚的本质……同样是黑潮的造物。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_33_1
records.text: Avidius shouldn't have had to bear such a fate... I will carry on his fight. I'll keep writing the story he believed in, the story that gives people hope.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，不该承受这样的命运……我会继承他与命运斗争的决心，将那个充满希望的故事，续写下去。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_33_1
records.text: Let's return to Cantarella and check on the wounded. If Avidius wasn't the Harbinger, that means we missed something...
records.zh: 我们先回坎特蕾拉那边，查看一下伤员的情况吧。代行者另有其人，一定还有什么我们遗漏的线索……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_33_1
records.text:
In the end, Avidius sacrifices his life to stop the Dark Tide outbreak in Ragunna. At last, the hidden Quillbearer, Cristoforo, reveals himself. He invites you to step into the final act and leaves you with a cryptic riddle.

Galbrena hands you the paper crane Avidius left behind. Although she sensed Avidius was a creation of the Dark Tide, the Harbinger itself must be "a real, existing person," which means the true Harbinger is someone else.

The Light of Genesis never revealed Avidius's true form because he had already created his own Truth—one defined by his humanity. You mourn his fate and vow to keep his belief that fate can be defied alive...
records.zh:
最终，阿维狄亚以自己的死亡，遏制了拉古那黑潮的爆发。隐于幕后的“执笔之人”克里斯托弗也终于现身，向你发出了迈入终幕的邀请，并为你们留下了一个谜语般的提示。
嘉贝莉娜将阿维狄亚化作的“纸鹤”交给你，她察觉到……阿维狄亚，同样是黑潮的造物。但“黑潮的代行者”，必须是一个“真实存在的个体”，这也就意味着……代行者另有其人。
而先前，起源之光之所以未能让阿维狄亚“现出原形”，也是因为……阿维狄亚已经塑造出了自己“为人的真实”。你为阿维狄亚的遭遇感到愤慨，并决意将他与命运斗争的信念继承下去……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_34_1
records.text: Your path overlaps with Avidius. The Tidespawn are shaped by the Harbinger's thoughts and memories. Neither the Thundering Mephis nor the Feilian Beringal are native to Rinascita. So...
records.zh: 你与阿维狄亚的行动轨迹重合，黑潮造物会基于代行者的认知与经历被塑形……而云闪之鳞和飞廉之猩，都不是黎那汐塔的原生残象。只是……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_45_1
records.text: But, Lady Cantarella, we all saw it… just now—
records.zh: 可是家主，我们都看见了……刚才那可是……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_45_1
records.text: I'm sorry, Lady Cantarella... and 漂泊者. We... We lost our composure...
records.zh: 对不起，家主……还有，漂泊者，抱歉，是我们失态了……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_45_1
records.text: I saw Fenrico, Mya, and Cartethyia... They all passed through that gate. What exactly lies beyond it?
records.zh: 我刚才看到了芬莱克、蜜芽，还有卡提希娅……他们都走入了那道门。那道门扉之后的国度……究竟是什么？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_45_1
records.text: Avidius was Cristoforo's decoy. He planted that decoy in Septimont for years... When the waters recede, the truth shall come to light...
records.zh: 阿维狄亚，是克里斯托弗故意创造出的“幌子”，他甚至将这个“幌子”在七丘预埋了数年之久……当潮水退去，真相才会逐渐浮现……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_4_1
records.text: Cristoforo... He won't sway me. I've got to keep going.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗……不能受他影响，继续往前吧。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_5_1
records.text:
Cristoforo's whisper pulls you into unconsciousness. When you awaken, you find yourself in a mysterious realm.

Visions of fallen companions appear along the path as Cristoforo's whisper continues. Fighting the unease, you reach a lake where in the distance a vast "Paradise" hangs above.

As you stand in disbelief, several Tacet Discords emerge behind you, not to attack, but to chant the title "Harbinger." Then, from the darkness, a strange woman steps forward. With a single demonic arm, she unleashes a surge of flame that casts you from the realm. Her final words: "Leviathan, I will deliver you... 'her death.'"
records.zh:
克里斯托弗的低语令你陷入了昏迷，再度睁眼，你发觉自己正身处一片神秘的世界。
昔日伙伴们的死亡幻影闪烁路旁，克里斯托弗的低语萦绕不断，你只能强撑着不适，沿道路继续前进。而在一片湖泊旁，你看到……在这世界的尽头，一座巨大的天国正高悬其上……
讶异之时，几只残象自你身后浮现，它们却并未对你发动攻击，只是齐声呼唤着“代行者”的名号。一位神秘的女子也自黑暗中走出，她伸出“怪异的手臂”，以不祥的火焰将你送出了这个世界。你听到了她最后传来的话语：“利维亚坦，我会为你献上……‘她的死亡’。”

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_7_1
records.text: (The only "Harbinger of the Dark Tide" is Fenrico. But he should still be sealing the Dark Tide at the Order's Fabricatorium...)
records.zh: （我唯一知晓的“黑潮的代行者”只有芬莱克，但他现在应该仍在隐海试验场中封印着黑潮……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_7_1
records.text: (That figure I saw... and Cartethyia's murder...)
records.zh: （还有那个奇怪的人影……以及，我所看到的，卡提希娅遇害的画面……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
records.text: You mean the missing frequency, right? We've already cross-checked it against Chimera and Cartethyia's frequency samples left here at the Black Shores…
records.zh: 是指「鸣式宝石」残缺的那部分频率吧？我们已经与奇美拉，还有卡提希娅在黑海岸留下的频率样本进行了比对……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
records.text: Abby? It's a curious case. Even in the deepest databanks of the Black Shores, we found no relevant data...
records.zh: 嗯？关于阿布吗？即使在黑海岸最深层的数据库中，我们也没有发现任何与它相关的资料……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
records.text: (But in that battle against the Journeying Paradise… Leviathan spoke Abby's name.)
records.zh: （在巡游天国战斗时，我曾听到利维亚坦喊出了阿布的名字……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
records.text: (Yet no one else seemed to react. Was it only Abby and I who heard it?)
records.zh: （但当时其他人并没有对此有任何反应，难道只有我和阿布听到了这句话吗？）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
records.text: (Abby's true identity… Perhaps I'll only uncover it on the road ahead.)
records.zh: （阿布的身世……或许，只有在往后的旅途中，我才能找到答案了……）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_9_1
records.text: But I believe what is carved upon this obelisk is…
records.zh: 但我相信，这座石碑上刻的是……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_1_1
records.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.
records.zh: 彻地之楔明明还在压制着底层的黑潮，现在这些状况……完全说不通……总之，奥古斯塔已经带队去桑古伊斯狩原了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_1_1
records.text: I see, Ragunna too… And Avidius... He never bent the knee, never played by the rules. Why is it that fate always strikes hardest at those who dare to defy it?
records.zh: 是吗……拉古那竟然也……还有阿维狄亚，那荒谬无理却绝不低头的家伙……命运偏要从对峙之人身上夺取些什么，才肯罢休么！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_1_1
records.text: Bad. It's the highest point in the Sanguis Plateaus, well beyond the Blightcloud's reach. The Dark Tide has never touched it before.
records.zh: 它是桑古伊斯狩原的至高点，位置上也相对远离黑潮云的覆盖范围，在此之前，那里还从未出现过黑潮侵扰的先例。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_6_1
records.text: We did right by the trust they placed in us. We got all the folks from the Riccioli Islands to safety.
records.zh: 没有辜负大家的信任，我们已经将黎乔利群岛的居民，全部安全送达庇护所。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_5_1
records.text: So... Galbrena was originally a Tacet Discord's name?
records.zh: “嘉贝莉娜”，原本是一只残象的名字？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_6_1
records.text: At this point, Galbrena feels like her true name. But what was her real name?
records.zh: ……我也下意识地将“嘉贝莉娜”当做了她的名字，那她的真名是？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_37_2
records.text: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.
records.zh: 今州重犯伤痕，束手就擒，横竖一刀，或可免遭痛苦。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_22
records.text: (Phrolova and Scar... Their appearance was too well-timed, like they knew our strategy all along. Meanwhile, Cristoforo's just biding his time in the shadows. This must be just the beginning.)
records.zh: （弗洛洛和伤痕……他们出现的时间太过巧合，似乎对我们的计划早有预知。还有一直躲在暗处的克里斯托弗，恐怕这只是他们行动的开端。）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_25
records.text: You wrote Avidius and all of Rinascita into a tragedy, just to prove a point.
records.zh: 为了证明自己的观点，你为阿维狄亚，甚至是为黎那汐塔的人们，“书写”了如此残酷的命运……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_25
records.text: Did Avidius's story stir sorrow and anger in your heart?
records.zh: 阿维狄亚的故事，是否曾让你感到悲悯与激愤？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_25
records.text: Avidius's story stirred sorrow and anger in your heart, I presume?
records.zh: 阿维狄亚的故事，曾让你感到悲悯与激愤。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_35
records.text:
Through the mist, a familiar vision takes shape. Cristoforo's whisper claims this is the truth you cannot escape. On destiny's stage, only you will remain for the final bow.

He claims your plan was doomed from the start. When the Discord Slayer fought to her last breath, your final hope turned to ash. As the Harbinger of the Dark Tide, you already know the only way to change the ending. A sword waits in front of you.

But Galbrena's voice pierces through the mist. She descends, alive and well, shattering Cristoforo's lies. She tells you to look to the sky, where the starlight dispels your doubt. What you must do now is take the next step.

She places a spark in your hand, a flame to carry you forward. Now walk. Through darkness, into the light.
records.zh:
穿过迷雾，一道熟悉的“景象”出现在你的眼前。克里斯托弗的低语告诉你——这便是属于你的真相：在命运的舞台中，只有你一人能够谢幕。
你们的计划早已被他洞悉，当“猎魔人”奉献出自己的一切之时，你们所有的希望，已彻底化为尘埃。而作为黑潮的代行者，若想改变这个结局，方法，你早已知晓……一柄利剑，正伫立于你的身前。
此时，嘉贝莉娜的声音再度响起，她自高天降落至海中，将克里斯托弗的“谣言”击破。她引你看向天空，以星光为你消除了迷茫。而你现在要做的……是坚定地迈出下一步。
嘉贝莉娜也将一枚“火种”交给了你，它将带你走过最初的黑暗。
现在，去踏上那段……黑暗而又光明的旅程吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_38
records.text: Cristoforo thought his script was flawless, but he missed one thing. Even the faintest spark of hope can ignite a blaze when we stand together.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗认为他的剧本已经足够完美，却忽视了微小希望汇聚出的可能。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_38
records.text:
You awaken from the illusion. Your companions are by your side once more, and Galbrena returns atop the back of the Dragon of Dirge.

To reach you, she ignited her own life force, Overclocking her power to tear open the Dark Tide's illusion. Chimera bore part of the cost for her. Meanwhile, when Septimont and your companions were engulfed by the Dark Tide, the Echoes responded to humanity's hope and resolve. They came together in their strongest form to aid. Though the Anchor Stone was destroyed, your companions still followed a different beacon. You, the "Anchor of Hope."

Through the Dark Tide, all of your memories connected. They have learned of Galbrena and Cartethyia's plan too. But Abby can no longer bear the burden of the Gem. Galbrena offers to use her power of devouring to seal the Gem within herself. It is for this very reason that the Fractsidus made her their target.

Cristoforo believed his script to be flawless, but underestimated what small hopes, when united, can become. Now, before the gate of the Paradise, you and your companions stand together. It is time to break it open and cast down the false Divinity that waits beyond.
records.zh:
自幻境中苏醒后，你看见伙伴们都已赶至你的身旁，嘉贝莉娜也在一只“叹息古龙”的帮助下归来。
先前，为了解救落入黑潮的你，嘉贝莉娜点燃了自己的生命，以超频的状态，强行撕裂了黑潮幻境的隔阂。奇美拉，则为她承担了一部分“超频的代价”。
而另一边，伙伴们在落入黑潮之后，黎那汐塔的声骸们对人类的“希望与决心”做出了回应，将力量聚合为更强的形态保护了他们。虽然此前黑潮中的定向锚被毁，但他们依然循着一个“精神的锚点”，抵达了这里——这个锚点，正是你。
他们也通过黑潮与你共享了记忆，得知了嘉贝莉娜与卡提希娅的计划。但……阿布的状况，已不允许它再吸收鸣式宝石，嘉贝莉娜却在此刻提出，自己能够用“吞噬”的力量，将「宝石」暂时保存在自己的体内。这也是残星会将笔锋对准她的理由。
克里斯托弗认为他的剧本已经足够完美，却忽视了微小希望汇聚出的可能。现在，你与伙伴们正集合与天国的门扉之前——是时候，“砸开”这道天国之门，将那虚伪的神明彻底击溃了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_70
records.text: Rinascita will surely know... a lasting dawn.
records.zh: 黎那汐塔，一定会迎来一个……崭新的黎明。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_28_2
records.text: Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, 漂泊者.
records.zh: 嗯，我已经苏醒过来了。漂泊者，我们，拉古那城见吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_28_2
records.text: Scar from the Fractsidus... Did he escape again?
records.zh: 残星会的伤痕……他又一次逃了吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_28_2
records.text: That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.
records.zh: 还有那个克里斯托弗……我会对他发起追猎，不会让他逍遥太久的。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_34_1
records.text: Disaster recovery in Ragunna City is nearly complete. Thank you so much for your help, 漂泊者.
records.zh: 拉古那城的灾后复原工作已经基本完成，漂泊者，辛苦了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_34_1
records.text: You're welcome. By the way, Phoebe, have you seen Galbrena?
records.zh: 举手之劳。说起来，菲比，你有看见嘉贝莉娜去哪了吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_34_1
records.text: Miss Galbrena? When she finished up here, I think I saw her heading to Margherita's Restaurant...
records.zh: 嘉贝莉娜小姐吗？她帮我们完成重建后，好像往玛格烈特餐厅的方向去了……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_32_1
records.text: Miss Margherita, one extra large Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato, please. Thank you.
records.zh: 还有，玛格烈特女士，请来一份「噗噗咩咩好吃到觉醒共鸣力！」口味的冰激凌。超大杯的，谢谢。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_50_1
records.text: But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!
records.zh: 不过大副可不能喝，就由我们，来为大副代尝吧！

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_35_1
records.text:
After the meal, you and Galbrena head toward the harbor. You spot Calcharo, who aided Ragunna in the battle, waving from afar. 

Galbrena mentions she once worked briefly with him back in the New Federation, and that, surprisingly, he's not all that hard to get along with. If you ever find yourself in the New Federation, you will probably have the chance to become better acquainted.
records.zh:
饱餐过后，你与嘉贝莉娜正欲前往码头，看见先前作为“黑海岸外援”出战的“卡卡罗”，远远向你们致以了一个问候。
嘉贝莉娜曾在新联邦与他有过短暂合作，据她所言，或许，对方并不是一个太难接触的人。日后若是去到新联邦，你一定会对他有更多了解的。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_35_1
records.text: If you ever find yourself in the New Federation, you'll probably get to know him better.
records.zh: 日后若是你去到「新联邦」，一定会对他有更多了解的。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_52_1
records.text: Council of Ten was disbanded years ago. After that, all decisions went straight to Primus Fenrico.
records.zh: 「十人委员会」也已经被取消好多年了……之前修会所有的决议，都会集中到芬莱克主座手中决断。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_52_1
records.text: Fenrico… in the end, he broke free of the Threnodian's control and found his own redemption.
records.zh: 芬莱克……最后，他终于摆脱了鸣式的操纵，也算是找到了自己的救赎吧……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_53_1
records.text: Well then, Lady Cantarella. What are your terms...?
records.zh: 那么，坎特蕾拉女士，您的条件是……？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_33_2
records.text: If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!
records.zh: 如果不知道怎么还原受损的建筑，我和斐林先生的共鸣能力可以帮上忙！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_29_1
records.text: Still, breaking me out right under Mingting's nose without setting off a single alarm... Delicious. Tell me, how did you come up with that little idea?
records.zh: 我说，你是怎么想出来那个法子的？甚至能在明庭的眼皮底下，神不知鬼不觉地将我转移走……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_29_1
records.text: You lost the Gem I entrusted to you, Cristoforo.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗，我将鸣式宝石交给了你，现在，你却把它搞丢了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_7_1
records.text: Fighting through more enemies, you and Galbrena finally reach the "gates of hell."
records.zh: 与嘉贝莉娜一同突破黑潮造物的重围，你们终于抵达了“地狱之门”。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_17_1
records.text: Lady Cantarella, how many of your family's potions remain?
records.zh: ……坎特蕾拉女士，家族的秘药，还有多少？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_18_1
records.text: (That visitor from Huanglong... He must know something about Fenrico.)
records.zh: （那位瑝珑的来客，似乎知道一些与芬莱克有关的信息。）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_5_1
records.text: Listen. Every Harbinger of the Dark Tide, Fenrico, Mya, the rest... they all met the same end.
records.zh: 我要提醒你的是，据我所知，所有黑潮的代行者，芬莱克，蜜芽……还有更多人，他们无一例外，最后都迎来了同一种结局。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_5_1
records.text:
You speak with the stranger from Huanglong named Qiuyuan. Dispatched by the Mingting Capital, he is hunting a fugitive while gathering intel on the "Threnodian's Resonator." He had originally sought Ragunna's Blessed Maiden, but instead found Primus Fenrico, who entrusted Qiuyuan with the Lantern of Napoli the Second before giving his life to drive back the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna's sea.

Qiuyuan speaks of your identity as a "Harbinger of the Dark Tide" and warns that all Harbingers share the same fate—death. But you have long since come to terms with that.

Looking at your companions busy in their preparations, you ask Qiuyuan for one favor: to help Rinascita weather this calamity. He replies that the Dark Tide rejects all but Rinascitans, and you are a rare exception. But he promises to defend the surface in your absence.

Before parting, he tells you the Magistrate of Jinzhou sends her regards. Those whom you once aided are still waiting for your return.
records.zh:
为了确认拉古那海底黑潮的情况，你前去与来自瑝珑的陌生侠士「仇远」交谈。得知其受明庭命令，目前正在追捕一名逃犯，而且，他似乎在调查与“鸣式共鸣者”有关的信息。他本想寻找拉古那的圣女，兜兜转转，却找到了那位修会的主座。也是受其所托，他才将“那不盖勒二世的提灯”带到了你们手中。而芬莱克……则以自己的生命为代价，彻底驱散了拉古那海底的黑潮。
言谈之中，仇远提及了你“黑潮的代行者”身份，并提醒你……所有的黑潮的代行者，最后都可能面临同一种结局——死亡。
但你……对此早有觉悟。
你看向伙伴们忙碌的身影，向仇远提出了一个请求：希望他能够帮助黎那汐塔度过这次难关。仇远则表示，黑潮会拒斥黎那汐塔人之外的人进入，你的情况特殊，他并无手段进入其中。但他答应，会在你们深入黑潮之后，协助人们守护好地上的防线。
暂别之际，仇远向你提到：今州令尹，托他向你问个好——你曾经帮助过的那些人，也在等你回去。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_16_2
records.text: So, all available Bloom Bearers have arrived in Rinascita. We're standing guard at Averardo Vault, and Buling is already en route to reinforce Septimont.
records.zh: 黑海岸所有可出动的执花，均已抵达黎那汐塔。埃弗拉德金库这里有我们协同防守，七丘那边，我们也派出了卜灵他们前去支援。

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Let me fall in the storm. May the glory of the Sentinel endure forever."
records.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “请让我于风暴中死去，惟愿我主荣光长存。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Please, don't look at me like that."
records.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “请不要用那样的眼神看着我。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"What?! The fire ring is meant for the audience?!"
records.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “什么？你们这里的火圈居然要观众亲自来钻！”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Decades from now, I believe Rinascita will thrive as a nation of freedom and unity. Don't you think so?"
records.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “几十年后的黎那汐塔，应该会是个自由而团结的美丽国度吧？”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"O, my beloved hometown, do flowers now blanket every corner of your fields?"
records.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “我那令人怀念的故乡，是否已有遍地的鲜花绽放？”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven region. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Even in death, the unblinking gaze of that colossal eye remains fixed on Egla Town."
records.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “即使死去，那巨大眼瞳的视线也从未从埃格拉镇上离开。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"I'm a professional guard, sworn to protect my employer's safety!"
records.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “我是职业保安，保卫雇主平安！”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Its malevolent essence shattered and spread across the land, refusing to fade with the passage of time."
records.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “它的恶念在大地里分裂、滋生，丝毫没有随年岁的流逝而消散。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Only now do I realize that all my efforts were simply to protect an ordinary life."
records.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “这才知道我的全部努力，不过守护了普通的生活。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Thessaleo Fells area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Do fish dream of drowning?"
records.zh: 狄萨莱海脊地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “鱼会做关于溺水的梦么？”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Thessaleo Fells area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"If every component of a ship has been replaced, will it remain the same ship?"
records.zh: 狄萨莱海脊地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “如果把一艘船的所有部件都替换掉，那它还是原来的船么？”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Thessaleo Fells area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"There's nothing in our hands."
records.zh: 狄萨莱海脊地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “尽管我们手中空无一物。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Thessaleo Fells area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"They disdain mirrors that reveal one's true self."
records.zh: 狄萨莱海脊地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “他们憎恨那些能使人看见自己真实面孔的镜子。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Hallowed Reach area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"How does one mend a shattered soul?"
records.zh: 赞悼圣迹地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “心灵破碎了要如何修复？”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Hallowed Reach area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Those passionate plushies look like they're about to wrap you in a warm embrace."
records.zh: 赞悼圣迹地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “热情的他们似乎想要给你一个拥抱。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Hallowed Reach area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Here lies one whose name was writ in water."
records.zh: 赞悼圣迹地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “这里安息了一位把名字写在水上的人。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"A great band doesn't fail—it simply disbands."
records.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “伟大的乐队不会失败，它们只会解散。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"There's a treasure in the chest—just stick your head inside, and you'll see it."
records.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “箱子里面有宝物，你把头伸进去就能看见了。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"I can no longer stop running."
records.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “早已无法停止奔驰。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"On the wings of melody, let me guide you to the river's edge."
records.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “乘着歌声的翅膀，您请随我前往，去那河水边上。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Penitent's End area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Quoth the Raven: Nevermore"
records.zh: 悲叹墓岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “乌鸦重复着：永不复归。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Penitent's End area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Up for another round of dodgeball?"
records.zh: 悲叹墓岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “您能再和我玩一次躲避球游戏么？”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Penitent's End area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Magic exists to prove that humans are masters of deception."
records.zh: 悲叹墓岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “魔术的存在就是为了证明人是一种善于欺骗的动物。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Penitent's End area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Where the streams of life converge, the dead persist in another form."
records.zh: 悲叹墓岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “生命汇流之处，死去之物以另一种方式延续。”

records.text: At the heart of Trattoria Margherita is an oven Echo known as Bakie, tirelessly fueling Ragunna with its roaring flames and delicious aromas.
records.zh: 玛格烈特家庭餐馆的声骸烤炉「焙焙」，以一己之力撑起了半座拉古那城的烟火气，熊熊燃烧的炉灶永不停息！

records.text: Look for Lillibet's divination memories in Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 在狩原寻找有关莉莉贝的占卜回忆。

records.text: An intricate network of waterways weave around the towering spires of Avinoleum. Transform into a Gulpuff, manage your pace, and chase down the river flow.
records.zh: 阿维纽林的巨塔之间，隐藏着无数奇妙的水域通道。灵活掌握浮水的节奏，化身咕咕河豚跃入其中，奔赴源流所在吧。

records.text: A bustling ore trading hub in Tiger's Maw Mine, providing ore purchase and recycling services.
records.zh: 虎口矿场开放给共鸣者交易矿石的平台，提供矿石购买、回收服务。

records.text: A food stall in Tiger's Maw Mine, providing a variety of common food.
records.zh: 虎口矿场开放给共鸣者购买食物的商铺，提供矿场常见食物的售卖服务。

records.text: A Supply Station set up for Acolytes living in the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Butler, the store's Steward, is running low on Sacred Salt, and he's willing to trade.
records.zh: 为照顾生活于隐海试验场中的教士们而设立的物资站，由「服事人」巴德勒管理，他因缺少潮汐圣盐，愿意与你以物易物。

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Vault Underground. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards. 
"Wealth is the only truth in the world."
records.zh: 下层金库地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “只有财富才是世间的唯一真理。”

records.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Vault Underground. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards. 
"A failed transaction means nobody's worse off."
records.zh: 下层金库地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “没有买卖，就没有伤害。”

records.text: The Echo Station in the Averardo Vault, providing access to various locations within the Vault.
records.zh: 分布于埃弗拉德金库下层的声骸车站台，可从此处通往下层金库的各个地点。

records.text: Located in the Averardo Vault, leading directly to the Precious Metals and Artworks Depository.
records.zh: 位于埃弗拉德金库下层，可前往贵金属与艺术品藏区。

records.text: Located in the Averardo Vault, leading directly to the Echo Depository.
records.zh: 位于埃弗拉德金库下层，可前往声骸藏区。

records.text: Located in the Averardo Vault, leading to unknown depths where dark pasts are buried.
records.zh: 位于埃弗拉德金库下层，通往不为常人所知的深处，似乎埋藏着晦暗的过往。

records.text: The Void Storm Zone I in Tidelost Forest. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于覆海原的虚质磁暴Ⅰ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: The Void Storm Zone II in the lands between Tidelost Forest and Wavecleave Cape. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于覆海原与-断流岬交界地带的虚质磁暴Ⅱ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: The Void Storm Zone III in the lands between Mount Gjallar and Ginnungamere Void Storm Monitoring Zone. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于加拉尔冠阶与渐湖磁暴监测区交界地带的虚质磁暴Ⅲ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: The Void Storm Zone IV in Frostlands Transit Port. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh:
位于冰原运输港的虚质磁暴Ⅳ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

*该区域挑战难度较高，建议科考摩托解锁对虚策略模块下的对虚反应装甲后前往。

records.text: The Void Storm Zone V in the borderland between Upphaf Forest Ruins and Provenance Enclave. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh:
位于元林遗址与溯源野地交界地带的虚质磁暴Ⅴ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

*该区域挑战难度较高，建议科考摩托解锁对虚策略模块下的对虚反应装甲后前往。

records.text:
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Frostlands Surface.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in the Upphaf Life Chamber.
records.zh:
部分日灵由于缺少牧者的指引， 迷失在了冰原地表……
找到走失的日灵，并将收集到的青实交还给元林再生舱中的巨日灵吧。

records.text: A cavern in Starblind Crashsite, standing solemnly in the biting wind and snow of the frostlands.
records.zh: 位于盲望之塌的一处山洞，沉默吞吐着冰原之上的风刀雪刃。

records.text: A Dreamscape Node on the Sanguis Plateaus. Complete the challenge to purify this Node and obtain rewards.
records.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可净化该节点，获得奖励。

records.text: It seems the "Lady Miko" is intentionally keeping her distance, and Platya starts to notice. But even if they never meet, she still wants to give her a gift. You suggest asking others from Honami for insight. Chisa comes to mind...
records.zh: 桔梗察觉到“巫女大人”似乎有意躲着自己，但即便不能亲自见到巫女大人，她也想准备一个礼物送给“巫女大人”。你想到了一个人，她也许会知道“巫女大人”的喜好……

records.text: Seek out the lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to Solisia Landing. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.
records.zh: 找到走失的日灵，并将收集到的青实交还给落日堤屿上的巨日灵吧。巨日灵会将青实转为能量送还给日脉悬林……在那里新的日灵将会诞生。

records.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Silent Crag is surrounded by rampaging Exoswarm. Surveying here won't be easy.
records.zh: 位于寂静断崖样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。附近活跃着为数不少的失控隧群，勘探难度因此上升。

records.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Sealed Fissure is protected by Hiyuki's Resonance Ability. Though not severely contaminated by Voidmatter, the tree is frozen under thick ice.
records.zh: 位于封存地样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。受绯雪的共鸣能力庇护，未遭遇过度虚质侵蚀，但被冻结在坚冰之下……

records.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Dimmr Deep sits right at the site of the decisive battle. As a result, the tree's root system is buried under rubble.
records.zh: 位于恒黯之原样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。受决战影响，根系遭碎石掩埋受损……

records.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in Solisia Landing is severely contaminated by Voidmatter. Fortunately, Exostrider components scattered across the area can be used to help restore it.
records.zh: 位于落日堤屿样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。区域内虚质侵蚀严重，好在遗留有大量隧者元件，可用于生态修复工程。

records.text: The Void Storm Zone I in Solisia Landing. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于落日堤屿的虚质磁暴Ⅰ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: The Void Storm Zone II in the Silent Crag. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于寂静断崖的虚质磁暴Ⅱ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: The Void Storm Zone III in the Sealed Fissure. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于封存地的虚质磁暴Ⅲ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: The Void Storm Zone IV in the Dimmr Deep. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
records.zh: 位于恒黯之原的虚质磁暴IV区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

records.text: Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Dimmr Plains. Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in Solisia Landing.
records.zh:
部分日灵由于缺少牧者的指引， 迷失在了黯原各处……
找到走失的日灵，并将收集到的青实交还给落日堤屿中的巨日灵吧。

records.text: A secret research facility hidden deep within the Silent Crag. It is concealed by unique terrain and a high density of Voidmatter.
records.zh: 寂静断崖内部的秘密实验机构，被独特的地形和高强度的虚质所层层掩埋。

records.text: A cliffside road carved into the mountain. Winds from the Mawburrow Desert often whip sand across the surface of this southern section.
records.zh: 依山建成的峡谷公路南段，来自隐喙深腹的风沙时常在道路上肆虐。

records.text: A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi. Its far end reaches the Roya's homeland: Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 横贯拉海洛南部的超长公路，道路尽头便是罗伊人的家乡，浮光林。

records.text: A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods and the Etching Plains, one of the signature joint achievements between the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective.
records.zh: 联通浮光林和蚀刻平原的跨海大桥，是罗伊人与深空联合通力合作的重要象征之一。

records.text: A transparent underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Traveling inside feels like gliding beneath the water.
records.zh: 联通浮光林与坠剑湖的水下隧道，覆盖全程的透明结构令人在穿行隧道时，犹如海中漫游。

records.text: A pagoda of mechanisms in the Land of Xuanfang's Eastern Xuan Peaks. Its complex structure spills a ceaseless Disorienting Fog made up of frequencies that confound Tacet Discords, luring them into traps from which there is no escape.
records.zh: 建于玄方地界东侧，玄幽东岳上的机关楼阁。结构复杂，且不断散发名为隐息雾的烟障，雾中含有令残象感观混乱的频率，借此将残象吸引并困在此处。

records.text: Nestled amidst the towering ranges of the Eastern Xuan Peaks lies a nameless, solitary summit. Now and then, the ethereal notes of a guqin drift from its peak, piercing the clouds and lingering far into the distance. Legends throughout the Land of Xuanfang speak of a Transcendent who watches over this realm. And this lonely peak, as it happens, is where that Transcendent dwells.
records.zh: 在东岳的层峦叠嶂间，藏有一座无名孤峰。峰顶偶有一阵缥缈的琴音悠悠荡开，穿云透雾，余韵悠长。世人常传，玄方地界有仙人坐镇，而此间，正是那位“仙人”的居所。

records.text:
A mysterious girl named Xuanqing asks for your help collecting the Feeling Capsule shards scattered by the Tuntun.
As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.
records.zh:
你受身份成谜的少女璇情所托，帮她收集被屯屯毁坏的「情匣」碎片。
随着事件深入，一段有关过去的岁主「心月狐」的故事也浮出水面。

records.text: A special Echo challenge located in Thessaleo Fells. Some report dreaming while participating, while others dismiss it as mere hallucinations.
records.zh: 位于狄萨莱海脊的特殊声骸挑战，有人说在挑战过程会做梦，也有人认为自己是产生了奇妙的幻觉……

records.text:
The Ragunna City's Synthesis platform allows Resonators to create potions, construct materials, and purify substances with ease.
Be hold—the stage now belongs to the combination reaction.
records.zh: 拉古那城开放给认证共鸣者使用的操作平台，提供合剂制造，物品构造及纯化服务——此刻，舞台属于独特的化合反应。

records.text: Mt. Firmament is home to a special hot spring called Sagaci Springs.
records.zh: 在乘霄山，有着名为灵砂泉的特殊温泉。

records.text:
"Even in shadows untouched by moonlight, fangs and claws remain vigilant."

The Second Coming of Solaris has recreated an important memory. Go to Calcharo Cube to complete the collection of Memory Travelogue.
records.zh:
“即使在月光照不到的阴影中，牙与爪也时刻戒备。”

第二索拉复现出的重要回忆，找到卡卡罗团子，完成【同行忆旅】回忆收集。

records.text: Enter Somnoire: Night City through the anomalous gateway at Startorch Academy and complete the event objectives. (Replay access to Somnoire: Night City unlocks after completing the Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge")
records.zh: 通过星炬学院的异常门扉进入心之集域·夜之城，完成活动任务目标。(完成异闻任务「边缘幻梦」后可重复进入心之集域·夜之城)

records.text: A fishing boat for the waters around the Riccioli Islands. Can be taken out to sea for fishing.
records.zh: 黎乔利海域适用的捕鱼船，可以乘坐出海捕鱼。

records.text: Did you know that in my hometown of Lilyland, there is a huge stage surrounded by a field of flowers?
records.zh: 你知道吗？在我的家乡莉莉兰德，有一个很大的花海舞台。

records.text: I hope our Ephor Augusta can turn everything around.
records.zh: 希望奥古斯塔总督能改变这一切。

records.text: Each is a one-of-a-kind talent. Pretty impressive, don't you think?
records.zh: 你看，个个都是人才，是不是很厉害？

records.text: Hmm... I'd better keep this one away from Camellya...
records.zh: 嗯……可千万不能让椿来……

records.text: Hmm... I'd better keep this one away from Camellya.
records.zh: 嗯……可千万不能让椿来考察这人……

records.text: This one seems all right, but I have a feeling Camellya might think he doesn't have enough brains...
records.zh: 那人看起来不错，但感觉椿可能会觉得他脑子不够聪明……

records.text: Encore has a heart as big as the moon... How did you... Oh, it's you, 漂泊者.
records.zh: 安可肚里能撑船……你居然知道……啊，是漂泊者。

records.text: The Sanguis Plateaus... Might need to keep an eye on it.
records.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原那边……嗯，可能需要注意一下。

records.text: Miss Lupa's been making changes to some of her meals lately...
records.zh: 露帕小姐最近调整了自己的部分餐食……

records.text: Thank you, kind sir. I am from Lilyland. This is my first time visiting the Agon, and I don't know where the entrance is...
records.zh: 谢谢你，温柔的好先生。我来自莉莉兰德，这是我第一次来看比赛，所以还不知道要从哪进去……

records.text: Try this Heartpour! Endorsed by Lupa herself. And now we're offering a limited edition special for the Agon! The first 100 orders get a signed autograph from Ms. Lupa!
records.zh: 饮下这杯心吧！由露帕选手冠名代言，先推出竞技赛特别纪念款！前一百名订购还有亲签赠送！

records.text: Did you say Lupa? Just hearing her name gets me so hyped! I'm her biggest fan!
records.zh: 什么什么？你说露帕我就来劲，我超喜欢她的！！

records.text: It's been ages since I've watched an Agon, but the fights today are no match for that one Augusta was in...
records.zh: 唉……好久没看角斗士比赛了，感觉都不如当年奥古斯塔那场……

records.text: Careful. Carlotta Montelli is not someone you can take lightly.
records.zh: 小心，他们家的珂莱塔可不是一般人。

records.text: Heartpour! Drink up and shine brighter than ever! Endorsed by our legendary Gladiator, Lupa!
records.zh: 饮下这杯心！明星角斗士露帕代言，让你更加闪耀。

records.text: Sigh... What should I do? The Gladiator I'm sponsoring is about to go up against Lupa. The fight's already lost.
records.zh: 唉……怎么办啊，我赞助的角斗士对上露帕了，这不是必输吗？

records.text: If revelation is what you seek, then travel to where the moonlight shines the brightest—Priestess Iuno.
records.zh: 若要寻求启示，你该前往月光最明亮处——那是谕女尤诺所在之处。

records.text: We were deeply moved by Miss Lupa's spirit during the finals, so we decided to stick to our goals by continuing our fight on our own.
records.zh: 在冠军赛中，我们被露帕小姐的精神所打动，我们决定坚持本心，靠自己的力量继续拼搏。

records.text: Is that 漂泊者? Did you see the game between {Male=him;Female=her} and Lupa?
records.zh: 那是漂泊者吧，你看过{TA}和露帕一起的比赛吗？

records.text: I saw Brant's performance before in Lilyland. The captain is so handsome!
records.zh: 之前在莉莉兰德看到了布兰特的演出，船长真的好帅啊！

records.text: And his first mate Roccia is super adorable...
records.zh: 还有洛可可大副的佩洛，真的超级可爱……

records.text: So I want to sell Huanglong spices in Septimont.
records.zh: 所以，我想在七丘贩卖来自瑝珑的调味料。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_6
records.text: Natural Void Storms have never appeared in Bjartr Woods or Sundermere.
records.zh: 自然生成的虚质磁暴，几乎从未在浮光林与坠剑湖一带出现。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_10
records.text: "However, the great discovery beneath Lahai-Roi, the very Pathway that brought the Exostrider here, might show us a way back to the cosmos we lost..."
records.zh: “而拉海洛地下的某种发现，或者说是隧者的「来路」，或许将以未曾设想的方式通往被隔绝的宇宙……”

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_1
records.text: Wait, your reference letter is from the New Federation...? Oh no, it's from Professor Mortefi of Huaxu Academy?
records.zh: 你的入职推荐信是……新联……？不对，是……华胥研究院的莫特斐教授？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_1
records.text: So Professor Mortefi is an old acquaintance of the President?
records.zh: 听起来，莫特斐老师和校长是旧识？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_1
records.text: Back when Professor Mortefi was studying in the New Federation, President Lucilla was the chief editor of its top academic journal.
records.zh: 莫特斐先生尚在新联邦耕读之时，洛瑟菈是新联邦头部期刊的首席编审。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_15
records.text: Ms. Verina must be incredibly gentle and kind. Imagine how lucky her students are!
records.zh: 维里奈学者，一定是一位慈爱又温柔的人吧，不敢想象成为她的学生会有多幸福！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_15
records.text: And the little girl is so cute! Is she Ms. Verina's daughter?
records.zh: 这张照片里的小女孩好可爱啊，是维里奈学者的女儿吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_15
records.text: There's a caption here. Let me see... Verina in Hongzhen...?
records.zh: 照片下面有注解啦……我看看……维里奈于虹镇……？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_2_12
records.text: Ms. Verina must be incredibly gentle and kind.
records.zh: 维里奈学者，一定是一位慈爱又温柔的人吧！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_2_12
records.text: And the little girl is so cute! Is she Ms. Verina's daughter?
records.zh: 啊！这张照片里的小女孩好可爱啊，是维里奈学者的女儿吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_2_1
records.text: Your reference letter is from... the New Federation?
records.zh: 你的入职推荐信是……新联……？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_2_1
records.text: ...Wait, no. It's from Professor Mortefi... at Huaxu Academy?
records.zh: 不对，是……华胥研究院的莫特斐教授？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_17
records.text: No wonder Triumph Avionics and Panovista Transit are getting all the hype at the New Federation World Expo.
records.zh: 也难怪，现在凯旋航电、全景运输在万国博览会上那么多人关注。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_18
records.text: Finally, the downward express of the Starward Riseway, straight from the frostlands to the Institute and Academy.
records.zh: 对，最后一步就是联运椎骨的下行列车，从罗伊冰原转运至研究院和学院。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_19
records.text: "Now in active production!!! The Academy's 100 Great Mysteries!" You can just tell this is from some Ashinohara students...
records.zh: 《学院百大不可思议》锐意连载中？这种标题一看就是苇原的学生起的啊！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_20
records.text: Come on, Gnawee, be good. Let's go back to Bjartr Woods, okay?
records.zh: 啃啃……听话，回浮光林好不好？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_27
records.text: And me! Please bless us with someone filthy rich from the New Federation... preferably Gatsby!
records.zh: 还有我！赐我们小组一个家财万贯的新联邦同学吧，最好是盖茨比！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_32
records.text: Yeah. Mr. Aalto got sent to the New Federation for urgent marine insurance issues, so the application changed at the last minute.
records.zh: 是这样，秋水先生改道新联邦，说是有船险相关的要事处理，所以黑海岸临时变更了申请确认函。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_32
records.text: Sender: Mr. Aalto. Courier: Mr. Wei from Lollo Logistics.
records.zh: 寄件人是秋水先生，承运人是呜呜物流的韦先生。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_4_1
records.text: M-Mr. Mortefi! My apologies! I'll take care of it right away!
records.zh: 莫……莫特斐先生！实在抱歉！我立刻安排！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_4
records.text: Did you get the notice? A batch of long-lost Cassettes from around Bjartr Woods just arrived at the Cassette Depository.
records.zh: 收到通知了吗……研究院的磁带保存间从浮光林的附近新回收了一批数年前遗失的磁带。

records.text: Is General Jiyan still fighting on the front lines? I heard that he hasn't taken a rest for a long time.
records.zh: 忌炎将军还在前线奋战，他是不是很久没休息过了？

records.text: Yeah, no one could talk him out of it. Sigh, General Jiyan used to be a doctor. He should know better than anyone else...
records.zh: 是啊，也没人劝得动。明明将军他从前也做过医生……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_33_1
records.text: I get it. Even though Xinyi's ancestors were from Hongzhen, she came to the mountains later on. While her abilities are impeccable, her way of doing things is still a bit different from the locals here.
records.zh: 大家伙的想法我也理解，辛夷虽然祖上是虹镇的，但毕竟是后来进山，她的能力虽说挑不出毛病，可立身行事还是与虹镇人不大一样。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_33_1
records.text: Letting Xinyi take over was the smartest move I've ever made.
records.zh: 让辛夷做掌事人，是老头子我这辈子做过最明智的决定咯。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_34_1
records.text: I'm not messing with you. Cats in Mt. Firmament don't.
records.zh: 小棠没有和大哥哥开玩笑，乘霄山的猫猫就是不怕水嘛。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_8_1
records.text: Are you guys interested in Mt. Firmament tea?
records.zh: 小伙子、小姑娘，怎么，对乘霄山的茶感兴趣？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_8_1
records.text: I heard it took seven steps to make tea outside this mountain: preparing teaware, warming teaware, putting in the tea, brewing the tea, discarding the first batch, pouring the tea, and then serving the tea.
records.zh: 听说这山外沏茶有着备具、温具、置茶、冲泡、洗茶、出汤、分茶这七道工序。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_63_2
records.text: Mt. Firmament is still a mystery to outsiders, after all.
records.zh: 嗐，毕竟乘霄山对于山外的人来说还是个神秘地界嘛。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_5
records.text: Don't be scared, mommy's here. Shall we go home now?
records.zh: 那要不，我们回家吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_任务_小孩行李箱_1_2
records.text: The stuff on Mt. Firmament can hardly interest Yanning anymore.
records.zh: 乘霄山里的东西，应该很难再让晏宁感兴趣了。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_1
records.text: Well, Zhichun, that's because they come from outside Mt. Firmament.
records.zh: 那些叔叔、阿姨都是从乘霄山外头来的，所以穿着打扮才会和我们不一样。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_1
records.text: What... What's it like outside Mt. Firmament? Is it scary? Grandpa said it's full of monsters...
records.zh: 那、那乘霄山外面是什么样子呀，会不会很可怕……爷爷说，翻过这座山，外面到处都是怪物……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_52_1
records.text: Like why Scarefrost Deer have heart-shaped fur and how Airsailers feed themselves...
records.zh: 比如惊霜狍为什么会长出心形的绒毛、溯空鱼又是怎么吃东西的……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_3
records.text: I-I'm just a little scared. But they seem quite interesting.
records.zh: 稚春有点紧张，可是又觉得那些没见过的叔叔阿姨、哥哥姐姐好像有很意思的样子。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_3
records.text: Mmm... after hearing you tell me all that, I'm suddenly not scared anymore...
records.zh: 唔……听{Male=大哥哥;Female=大姐姐}说完，好像心里一点都不慌了……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_53_1
records.text: It's a much more fulfilling and colorful life outside Mt. Firmament.
records.zh: 乘霄山外的生活更丰富多彩。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_53_2
records.text: I think staying at home and sticking around Mt. Firmament is pretty great.
records.zh: 一辈子待在家、待在乘霄山，我觉得挺好……

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_54_1
records.text: Then you cut them up, marinate them in a jar of sugar overnight, sun-dry them on a warm day, and they're guaranteed to be a treat.
records.zh: 洗净后的果肉用小刀破开，放在糖罐子里渍上一晚，天气好的时候把糖渍果肉晾在太阳底下，出来的果干保准好吃。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_65_1
records.text: Sorry I can't hang out with you this time. Lady Xinyi's got me joining up with the Midnight Rangers from Jinzhou, so I'll be pretty occupied for a while.
records.zh: 只是……嘿嘿，可惜不能陪你到处逛逛了。辛夷大人安排了我和今州派驻的夜归军接洽，估计要忙上一阵子。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_66_1
records.text: You know Mt. Firmament better than the Midnight Rangers.
records.zh: 你比夜归军更了解乘霄山的情况。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_66_1
records.text: Well, I'm a local, after all, so of course I know more than the rangers. Lady Xinyi sent me and Bingge to assist them probably for the same reason.
records.zh: 嗐，咱毕竟是本地人嘛，比起夜归军自然更熟门熟路，辛夷大人差我和秉戈帮衬夜归军，我估摸着也是看中了这个。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_66_1
records.text: Did you come back to visit or see Lady Xinyi?
records.zh: 这回到镇上是找辛夷大人还是来玩啊？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_7
records.text: Zhichun is still little. It's natural for her to be scared of strangers.
records.zh: 稚春年纪小，看到生人觉得紧张也正常。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_46_1
records.text: I haven't even been to many of the places in Mt. Firmament.
records.zh: 甚至连乘霄山的好些地方，我自己也没去过呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_56_1
records.text: Things were dire at the time. It was inevitable that people would get hurt even with the Magistrate and Lady Xinyi holding down the fort.
records.zh: 当时情况急， 即便有令尹和辛夷大人护着，大伙也难免磕着碰着受点伤。

records.text: Thank you, Rover. You ended the conflict with the least price to pay and saved the lives of many Midnight Rangers.
records.zh: 感谢你，漂泊者。你让战事以最小的代价结束，挽救了许多夜归的生命。

records.text: You're back, Rover. Must've been a tiring journey back to the city, right?
records.zh: 你回来了，漂泊者。辛苦了，回城这一路很累吧。

records.text: Averardo Vault at night truly has a charm of its own, doesn't it?
records.zh: 说起来，夜晚的埃弗拉德金库，景色可真是别有风味啊。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院拉贝尔学部_1_1
records.text: Wow, Anya… wow. You were supposed to be defending your thesis and graduating in the New Federation!
records.zh: 你看安雅乔，本来都快从新联邦的高校毕业了，论文都写完了，就差答辩了……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院拉贝尔学部_2_13
records.text: Meetings all *New Federation curse* day long!
records.zh: 一天到晚全*新联邦粗口*在开会了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院拉贝尔学部_1_11
records.text: No... these guys looked like they were from Huanglong...
records.zh: 不是，看起来像是瑝珑面孔……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院拉贝尔学部_1_2
records.text: I don't want to return to the New Federation to study the Sentinel. I don't want to join the Spacetrek Collective. And I don't want to work here either.
records.zh: 拒绝回到新联邦从事岁主研究，不想进入深空联合深造，也不想留校？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院拉贝尔学部_1_2
records.text: If I go back to the New Federation, my research will only become another way for the capital to exploit the Sentinel.
records.zh: 选择回到新联邦，我的研究成果终将成为资本榨取岁主的帮凶。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_24_1
records.text: Who the *New Federation curse* is flashing that at this hour?! I thought the *New Federation curse* Reactor Drive had exploded!
records.zh: 谁他*新联邦粗口*在大晚上的试灯？！我*新联邦粗口*以为炉芯炸了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_24_1
records.text: Safety my ass! I almost ran down there without any *New Federation curse* pants on!
records.zh: 安全个屁！我差点*新联邦粗口*裤子都没穿就冲下来了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_26_1
records.text: Midnight Train? The New Federation's Headless Knight at Buffalo is way cooler...
records.zh: 幽灵列车？感觉不如我们新联邦的布法罗无头骑士呢……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_32_1
records.text: I was going to puke, but I choked it back... This carriage is killing me...
records.zh: 刚想吐出来，又咽下去了……这联运列车，真是要人老命了……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_36_1
records.text: He really lives up to his name... Maybe they can also call him "Abby" for short.
records.zh: ……名副其实的「阿不」。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_39_1
records.text: Wow... Lynae appeared in S.I.G.M.A.'s traffic safety lecture...
records.zh: 哇……琳奈同学出镜了S.I.G.M.A.先生的交通安全小课堂耶……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_39_1
records.text: It's... SO CUTE! I've got to send this to Lynae!
records.zh: 好！可！爱！我要转发给奈奈！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_41_1
records.text: If you are heading to the Roya Frostlands, please do not board the departing section. Boarding this car will delay your journey.
records.zh: 前往冰原的乘客，请不要进入分离车舱，以免耽误您的行程——

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_43_1
records.text: As for the Solis Lens Array Engineering, Professor Mornye is the obvious choice.
records.zh: 引日透镜阵列工程不用说了吧，无脑选莫宁教授。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_45_1
records.text: Actually, there was one minor incident on the Starward Riseway in the past, but thankfully there were no casualties.
records.zh: ……历史上，联运椎骨还真出现过一次小型事故，好在无人伤亡。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_46_1
records.text: Actually, there was one minor incident on the Starward Riseway in the past, but thankfully there were no casualties.
records.zh: ……历史上，联运椎骨还真出现过一次小型事故……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_55_1
records.text: I heard that Franka from your department used to be a Tornado hunter in the New Federation.
records.zh: 听说你们学部的弗朗卡，以前可是新联邦的「龙卷风」猎手。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院通用对话和冒泡1_14_26
records.text: In Huanglong's Yuezhou dialect, this place's name means "The Bridge of Flower Seas."
records.zh: 在瑝珑的越州方言里，这个地名是“花海之桥”的意思。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院通用对话和冒泡1_5_1
records.text: And you're the madman who thinks it's a brilliant idea to throw the whole cosmos into a model and see what it spits out.
records.zh: 你倒像是非要把整片宇宙扔进大模型里的疯子。

records.text: Then when you do go back, could you help me get Brant's autograph?
records.zh: 那你回去的时候，能帮我拿到布兰特的亲笔签名吗？

records.text: I remember the way people live in Lilyland is very different from here.
records.zh: 我记得莉莉兰德的生活习惯和这里差别很大。

records.text: So... Mr. Rabelle is actually from the New Federation?
records.zh: 所以……拉贝尔先生其实来自新联邦？

records.text: He eventually left and traveled to many countries before settling down and spending his remaining days in Lilyland.
records.zh: 后来，他离开新联邦，游历多国，最后在莉莉兰德终老。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院游牧集市生态_16_1
records.text: Our next expedition will be near Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 下次要去浮光林附近考察。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院游牧集市生态_19_1
records.text: We just got a new classmate from Ashinohara. It was wild hearing there are still places where Resonators aren't welcome...
records.zh: 我们这来了个苇原的新同学，我才知道原来还有不欢迎共鸣者的地方……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院游牧集市生态_21_1
records.text: Have you noticed how much easier the road back to Bjartr Woods is to travel?
records.zh: 最近回浮光林的路比之前好走多了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院游牧集市生态_9_1
records.text: I have no idea how Sigrika does it. She's in the lecture hall studying super early every single day.
records.zh: 也不知道西格莉卡怎么做到的，她每天很早就到教室学习了。

records.text: Roccia. We need our First Mate to step up your game this time!
records.zh: 意思是——这次必须得洛可可大副出马了！

records.text: Captain Brant said everything was fine and went to speak to the creature alone. We were all a bundle of nerves, I'll tell you that much.
records.zh: 但布兰特船长说没关系，他独自去和这个大家伙对话，可把我们紧张坏了。

records.text: This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.
records.zh: 这次狂欢节，我们需要扮演的是渴望平等与解放的愚人，而不是曾作为拉古那人的自己！

records.text: There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.
records.zh: 到时候，我们就真的百口莫辩，不可能再洗清自己的冤屈，也无法揭露芬莱克的阴谋与诡计了。

records.text: What kind of fireworks display would fit the grand spectacle of Ragunna's Carnevale?
records.zh: 什么样的烟花，才能衬得上拉古那的狂欢节呢？

records.text: You see the scar on my nose? The Acolytes were so afraid I'd sneeze on the Troupe of Fools that they actually clipped my nose before I boarded.
records.zh: 你看我鼻子上的伤疤——那群教士怕我在愚人船上打喷嚏，上船之前还给我夹了个鼻夹。

records.text: If it weren't for Brant saving me, I'd be breathing through my mouth for the rest of my life!
records.zh: 要不是被布兰特救下，我这辈子都只能靠嘴呼吸了！

records.text: During this Carnevale, we all have to hide our identities and take on roles in the Fool's Troupe as we return to Ragunna City, after so long.
records.zh: 这次狂欢节，大家要隐匿自己的身份，扮演愚人剧团的成员，回到暌违已久的拉古那城。

records.text: In our plays, we sing to condemn the oppression, to shed light on the bloodshed… One day, all of Rinascita will know what Fenrico has done.
records.zh: 在戏剧中，我们以欢歌控诉压迫与血泪——终有一天，整个黎那汐塔都会知晓芬莱克的所作所为。

records.text: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
records.zh: 我想回拉古那城……我的家产还在城里，还没来得及带走……

records.text: And here we have the Layered Yak Short Rib Bake... Must be the family feast main course from Act 3, Scene 6 of "The Lady of Camellya."
records.zh: 还有这道，千层焗烤牦小排……应该是《椿花女》三章六幕中的家宴主菜。

records.text: If Brant manages to snag the Laurel this year, you can bet Troupe Strength will sell like hotcakes. Heh, heh, heh...
records.zh: 如果这次布兰特能在狂欢节上拿到“桂冠”，剧团烈度一定会卖得更好，嘿嘿嘿……

records.text: But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!
records.zh: 但，是要去莉莉兰德的花海，还是去七丘体验竞技带来的感官刺激，还得船长决定！

records.text: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
records.zh: 真、真的没办法了吗……要是去莉莉兰德、去七丘……总有能接纳我们的地方吧……

records.text: The captain said if they're headed to the Riccioli Islands or Septimont, we should arrange for Echoes to help them avoid dragons and safely get to where they want to go.
records.zh: 船长说过，要是他们想要去黎乔利群岛，或者去七丘，我们应该安排声骸帮忙，指引他们规避古龙，安全航向自己想去的地方。

records.text: In the past, some have sought refuge with their families in the Riccioli Islands, while others ventured to Septimont, trading honor for a new identity, all holding onto the hope of one day returning to Ragunna.
records.zh: 像以前，也有人带着家人一起去黎乔利群岛隐居，还有人去了七丘，用荣誉换得新的身份，希望总有一天能回到拉古那。

records.text: Did you hear? About Avidius and the Senate...
records.zh: 听说了吗，阿维狄亚和元老院的事……

records.text: A power struggle. Nothing new. But going up against Augusta is a steep hill to climb.
records.zh: 争权夺势嘛，不过对上奥古斯塔，我看阿维狄亚未必能有胜算。

records.text: Without a strong Forte, Augusta's strength was always going to have limits.
records.zh: 没有足够的共鸣天赋，奥古斯塔的力量终归是有极限的。

records.text: I wouldn't put it like that. Knowing how Augusta operates, Avidius wouldn't have even risen to prominence if she hadn't allowed it.
records.zh: 话不能这么说，按照奥古斯塔的行事风格，若不是她默许，阿维狄亚甚至没有被推到台前的机会。

records.text: Sometimes I wonder if prophecy truly illuminates the path forward... What if it's a chain trapping people in what they want to believe?
records.zh: 有时我也在想，预言究竟是照亮前路的辉光，还是将人们囚困在欲望中的枷锁。

records.text: Haha, I remember Avidius started just as young!
records.zh: 哈哈，想当年阿维狄亚刚刚参加狩猎的时候，也不过是这个年纪吧！

records.text: They all say Avidius is the next Hero of Heroes. That's only because no one's seen my boy Fredrico fight.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚被誉为英雄王最有力的竞争者，人们会这么认为，只是因为他们还没看到我家费德里科的实力罢了。

records.text: Avidius is better suited to lead than Augusta.
records.zh: 比起奥古斯塔，阿维狄亚才是更合适的人选。

records.text: Let's see if Augusta can hold her ground when the storm hits.
records.zh: 就看这次狩猎，奥古斯塔是否能驾驭住风暴……

records.text: Don't worry about me, Leonora. Augusta commands this hunt, and Avidius rides with us. Victory is assured.
records.zh: 不用担心我，蕾欧诺拉。这次出猎有奥古斯塔总督坐镇，再加上有阿维狄亚同行，我们必能得胜归来。

records.text: Barely… This hunt was beyond anything I imagined. Just staying alive took all I had. If it weren't for Ephor Augusta and the others...
records.zh: 侥幸而已……狩猎的规模超出我的想象太多，光是保住性命就已经拼尽全力，倘若没有奥古斯塔总督他们……

records.text: Avidius… his story is so flawless, it's almost unnatural.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚……他的经历无可挑剔到有些诡异……

records.text: Oh, Iuno… Did she run off to the hunting party again?
records.zh: 尤诺她……是不是又跑到狩猎队去了？

records.text: Of course she does. It's Iuno we're talking about.
records.zh: 毕竟是尤诺嘛，做什么都不奇怪。

records.text: Iuno… I've heard tales about her hunts, but nothing like seeing her in action…
records.zh: 尤诺……虽然之前听过她狩猎时的事迹，但亲眼见到还是第一次……

records.text: Strange that Augusta would allow Avidius to join the hunt…
records.zh: 奥古斯塔竟然会让阿维狄亚介入狩猎……

records.text: Strange that Augusta would allow Avidius to join the hunt… without taking any precautions.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔竟然会让阿维狄亚介入狩猎，还如此……毫不设防。

records.text: And now, our Xiaofang... Should I call her Chixia now? She's all grown up and even works as a Patroller! She dropped by recently and told me how she missed that stew.
records.zh: 哎哟……这件事情都过了好久了，小芳也楞个大了，都当巡尉了！前些天她来耍，又跟我说起这件事情，说啊，想那个味道。

records.text: Yeah! And on top of that, it's a pre-Lament lunar soil sample donated by the New Federation!
records.zh: 对啊，更何况那还是新联邦捐赠的，“悲鸣”前的月壤样本耶！

records.text: The chorus from the Whining Aix's Mire rises in your mind, and your fingertips unconsciously tap out the rhythm...
records.zh: 来自怨鸟泽的合鸣在脑海中浮现，你的指尖无意识地敲击着节奏……

records.chapter: 剧情_狩原_桑古伊斯狩原_狩猎者营地_2_2
records.text: The Sanguis Plateaus… It stretches even farther than I imagined.
records.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原……居然比我想象中还要辽阔。

records.text: You want to study the Tacetites of the New Federation? Submit the application. Knock yourself out.
records.zh: 想要研究新联邦的黑石种类？提，都可以提。

records.text: That's what happens when you're directly funded by the New Federation.
records.zh: 谁让他们是新联邦直接资助的呢？

records.text: Well, Ashinohara was devastated by it. I hope to work with Ms. Platya one day at the Black Shores to develop an early warning system for such disasters.
records.zh: 因为苇原受到这样的灾难蹂躏，我想有一天，能去黑海岸和桔梗小姐一起工作，对那些灾难做出预警。

records.text: Just say you're a Roya from the New Federation.
records.zh: 就说我是新联邦的罗伊人好了。

records.text: Tell me about it. The deserts outside the New Federation cities don't have fish like that.
records.zh: 是呀是呀，新联邦城外的那些戈壁可没有这样的鱼。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.2学园庆典_配音冒泡2_8_1
records.text: I had no idea there was such a history... I think I'll sign up for the Bjartr Woods expedition.
records.zh: 没想到还有这样的历史……我打算报名去浮光林考察。

records.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_NPC_进城-边庭_7_1
records.text: It was about the Teal General and the Battle of Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 是青衣将军和关外之战。

records.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_NPC_进城-边庭_8_1
records.text: It's not about the Teal General or the Battle of Norfall Barrens...
records.zh: 不论关外之战，也不谈青衣将军……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_15
records.text: The Starward Riseway is a colossal elevator system connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands, named after its shape.
records.zh: 联运椎骨是连接拉海洛与罗伊冰原的巨型升降系统，因为其宛如脊骨的形状而得此命名。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_15
records.text: Besides the various research departments, the Institute consists of three main facilities: the Starward Riseway, the Collective Factory, and the "Well of the Threnodian."
records.zh: 研究院内除了各个科研部门，还有联运椎骨、联合工厂以及“鸣式深井”这三部分，它们构成了研究院的主要设施。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_18
records.text: But if you ask me... the most unique one is still RRH-251. It didn't rely on the Reactor's glow from the Drive. Instead, it used superconducting Repulsive Force tech, which doubled the train's stability on the Starward Riseway!
records.zh: 但要我说啊……最特别的一代果然还得是RRH-251，没有使用炉光能源核心，而是超导斥力悬浮技术，让车身攀上联运椎骨的平稳度增加了两倍！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_24
records.text: ...I always get sick whenever I take the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: ……我每次上联运椎骨都会吐。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_3_20
records.text: Humans look up at the stars to contemplate our place in the vast cosmos...
records.zh: 人类仰望星空，是为了思考我们在宇宙中的位置……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_3_21
records.text: I once read that humans look up at the stars to contemplate our place in the vast cosmos.
records.zh: 曾经看到过一句话，人类仰望星空，是为了思考我们在宇宙中的位置。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_3_22
records.text: It came from the Spacetrek Collective's very first frostlands expedition. This ancient plant, extinct on the surface for ages, was preserved in the Roya Frostlands ice caps and revived by the Reactor Drive's light.
records.zh: 它来自深空联合的第一次冰原考察，这种地表早已绝迹的远古植物，在罗伊冰原的冰盖间被按下生命的暂停键，又因炉芯的光芒再次苏醒。

records.chapter: 剧情_无光之森洞穴POI_捣蛋猿洞穴_2_1
records.text: Oh, my savior! Don't you remember? In that cave full of hoochiefs back in Dim Forest, you saved me from the gorillas! I, I could have been...
records.zh: 恩人、恩人！你还记得吗，之前在无光之森的那个全是捣蛋猿的洞穴，是你救的我！不、不然的话…...

records.text: This is bothering us so much. Can we call in the almighty Mr. Mortefi?
records.zh: 这，真是没办法，能不能求助一下万能的莫特斐先生帮忙？

records.text: Quiz Number Three answered! Violuna Banyan in Dim Forest.
records.zh: 妙答第三记，紫月榕林中。

records.text: Hello, I am Thirty, a Patroller stationed in Dim Forest. You can always ask me about anything you want to know in Dim Forest.
records.zh: 你好，我是派驻无光之森的巡尉三十！要是想了解无光之森的情况，可以问我！

records.text: This is a station of Huanglong's inspection team in Dim Forest. We test and monitor the soil in the Forest.
records.zh: 这里是无光之森勘查组的据点之一，我们主要负责对无光之森的土壤进行勘查和监测。

records.text: Dim Forest suffers continuously from the toxin spores, which is why the soil means so much to the ecosystem here.
records.zh: 无光之森常年被毒雾孢子污染，土质的变化就更关系到森林生态了。

records.text: I may scare easily... but I wouldn't shirk responsibility. I don't call for backup unless absolutely necessary.
records.zh: 我虽然胆子小了点……但还是很负责任的，自己的工作，不会无故找其他人顶班。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_102_1
records.text: We did this together. You never gave up, and Danjin helped from the outside as well.
records.zh: 嗯，是我们一起努力的结果，你没有放弃，丹瑾也在外面帮了一把。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_102_1
records.text: How about a group photo with Zhongxu, Danjin?
records.zh: 丹瑾，我们和它一起拍个照如何？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_106_1
records.text: Huh? Of course Danjin... Whoops, I meant to say, of course, Danjin the Great crushed it out there!
records.zh: 哎？丹瑾，啊不对，丹瑾大人果然厉害。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_106_1
records.text: Hehe. We took it a bit far, but you did great out there, Danjin.
records.zh: 呵呵，虽然说得很夸张，但丹瑾表现得很好。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_106_1
records.text: Danjin performed well. Her mental state was stable, and she kept her Forte under good control during combat.
records.zh: 丹瑾表现得很好，精神状态稳定，战斗中共鸣能力也控制得很稳定。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_106_1
records.text: Danjin sliced the Myriad Snare clean in half at the entrance of the Skyworks. One strike, and our problem was solved.
records.zh: 丹瑾在悬天构门口，一剑把万囮牢砍成两半，问题就这么解决了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_110_1
records.text: Let's talk alone for a moment. After that whole mission together, what's your opinion of Danjin?
records.zh: 我们单独说说，整个任务执行下来，你对丹瑾的评价如何？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_110_1
records.text: As for Danjin... I'll let her decide for herself. If anything urgent comes up, we may need your help again.
records.zh: 丹瑾的话……就让她自己决定吧，如果有什么要紧事，可能又会需要你帮忙。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_115_1
records.text: A "Danjin Special" Loong Whiskers Crisp. Now that's a one-of-a-kind gift.
records.zh: 要是能尝到一份‘丹瑾特制口味’的龙须酥，那可真就是独一无二的礼物了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_3_1
records.text: You and General Jiyan were at Norfall Barrens and—Ow, gotta take it easier.
records.zh: 你和忌炎将军在北落野——啊，轻点，轻点。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_3_1
records.text: Every Midnight Ranger knows the legends of you and General Jiyan at Norfall Barrens!
records.zh: 你和忌炎将军在北落野的事迹，夜归军里当然无人不晓！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_39_1
records.text: (The mysteries keep piling up... Oh, right, Danjin.)
records.zh: （谜团越来越多了……啊，对了，丹瑾。）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_39_1
records.text: Traverse barrier. Deactivate barrier. Assist Danjin's advance.
records.zh: 穿过壁障。关闭壁障。协助丹瑾前进。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_40_1
records.text: Danjin? Zhongxu and I are deactivating the barrier. Hold on for now.
records.zh: 丹瑾？我和重墟去帮你关闭壁障，稍等一会。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_4_1
records.text: Danjin, the Exiles are one thing, but more importantly, every time the Patrollers found you, the scenes they walked into were—
records.zh: 丹瑾，流放者是一回事，更重要的是，巡尉找到你的时候，现场可是——

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_5_1
records.text: Besides, I want Danjin out of supervision as soon as possible. A few solid field accomplishments would help with that.
records.zh: 而且，我希望丹瑾能尽快脱离监管，她可正需要实打实的功劳。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_5_1
records.text: Is it all right if I leave Danjin under your watch, 漂泊者?
records.zh: 漂泊者，丹瑾能交给你吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_51_1
records.text: What is this place... Danjin, are you all right?
records.zh: 这是什么地方……丹瑾，你没事吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_8_1
records.text: I wish I could stand up and show you that move! Danjin did it with such style and pizzazz, too!
records.zh: 好想站起来比划给你看！丹瑾那动作真是神乎其技！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_8_1
records.text: How long have you and Danjin known each other?
records.zh: 你和丹瑾相处多久了？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_8_1
records.text: Once I actually met her, I found Danjin to be quite lovely. She smiles a lot. Even acts like a child sometimes.
records.zh: 实际接触之后就发现丹瑾还是相当可爱的，很爱笑，有时还表现得像个孩子。

records.text: Beyond Bjartr Woods, in the untouchable heights, stand the Solistrees, abode of the Soliskin.
records.zh: 除了浮光林的地表外，那天空中人类无法抵达的日树亦是日灵们栖息的处所。

records.text: I showed her Bjartr Woods, taught her the way of the Roya, introduced her to every face in the village...
records.zh: 我带她探索浮光林，教她熟悉罗伊族的村落，认识村子里的人……

records.text: I didn't expect anything… but right before you showed up in Bjartr Woods, a message came back.
records.zh: 我本来没抱任何希望……但刚才你在浮光林找到我之前，我收到了一条回信。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_世界_三重冠塔_POI任务_10_5
records.text: He traveled west into Thessaleo Fells, where the three towers of destiny loomed in the distance.
records.zh: 在狄萨莱海脊向西而行，远处，是那三座命运中的高塔。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_黑海岸洄游鱼_12_1
records.text: The Shorekeeper is staring at the Aetherfins.
records.zh: 守岸人正出神地观察着洄游鱼。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_黑海岸洄游鱼_12_1
records.text: Or perhaps I am lost in a fleeting dream at light speed, unable to awaken?
records.zh: 是否我正以光行进的速度，跌入一场片刻又永恒的梦境中？

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_9_1
records.text: Miss Taoqi has already got so much on her plate. I shouldn't be troubling her with this...
records.zh: 桃祈前辈的工作已经够多了，要是再给她添麻烦的话……

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_9_1
records.text: But then we learned that the Tiger's Maw Mine, where the mineral originates, might have the methods and equipment we need.
records.zh: 后来天工得知了它的原产地虎口矿场似乎掌握着关键的方法和设备。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_9_1
records.text: Could you send the samples to the Tiger's Maw Mine for me, if possible? Of course, the Ministry of Development will reward you.
records.zh: 如果可以的话，能请你将样本送往虎口矿场完成加工处理吗？当然天工也会准备一定的报酬。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_19_2
records.text: There is a colossal Tacet Discord under the ground surface of the Tiger's Maw Mine. A serious conflict was incurred among the Mine staff when it was discovered.
records.zh: 虎口矿场地下存在着一只巨大的残象，最初发现它时因处理方式矿场内部爆发了严重的冲突。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_20_2
records.text: But it's not geographical location that made the Tiger's Maw Mine a deposit of so many unique, special minerals...
records.zh: 虎口矿场之所以能生产出许多优质特殊的矿石，并不是依托于地理环境的优势。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_20_3
records.text: However, it can naturally crystalize and deposit and solidify as raw ore in the Tiger's Maw Mine.
records.zh: 但它却能在虎口矿场自然地结晶沉淀，稳定成矿。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_20_6
records.text: Uncle Hong took Lei'li for himself and called him Hong. He accused the latter of caring only for his own ideas and never others'.
records.zh: 鸿伯把雷励当作了自己，称呼他为鸿淼，指责着他只顾着自己的想法而从未考虑过对方。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_20_6
records.text: In that crisis, maybe Uncle Hong and Chengwen had a similar fight, just Modee and Lei'li.
records.zh: 在那次危机中，鸿伯和城文可能也像雷励与莫狄一样发生过激烈的争执。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_12_1
records.text: Maybe written by the miners. Though the Tiger's Maw Mine is not far from Jinzhou, they are constantly kept from going home due to the work.
records.zh: 这大概是矿工们写的吧，虎口矿场虽离今州不远，但因工作的缘故也常年回不了家。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_12_1
records.text: Seems like a book popular with miners. It is only things like this that give life to the Tiger's Maw Mine, where there is nothing but buzzing machines.
records.zh: 像是平日里受矿工们追捧的书籍，也正是这些才让只有机器轰鸣声的虎口矿场有了生活的样子。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_13_2
records.text: Yes, rebooting the Refinery Tower requires sufficient power. Uncle Lei'li, you know the best about the power equipment. What's your advice?
records.zh: 嗯，重启精炼塔需要充足的电源，雷叔叔你对这些装置最了解了，有什么办法吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_13_2
records.text: What are you talking about, Uncle Lei'li? My brother asked me to work with 漂泊者 to reboot the Refinery Tower.
records.zh: 雷叔你又在自顾着说些什么，我是受我哥之托帮助漂泊者一起解决精炼塔重启的问题。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_13_2
records.text: You tell Lei'li about the journal and Uncle Hong's memories.
records.zh: 你将日记和记忆的事情告诉给了雷励。

records.chapter: 剧情_荒石高地_重启雷达_18_3
records.text: "Then come to the Desorock Highland. It's time for you to take over."
records.zh: “那就来荒石高地吧，该换你上岗了。”

records.chapter: 剧情_荒石高地_重启雷达_25_1
records.text: And my job is to safeguard the Desorock Highlands and fulfill my duties as a soldier.
records.zh: 而我能做的，就是好好守护荒石高地，履行好军人的职责。

records.chapter: 剧情_荒石高地_重启雷达_3_1
records.text: The way you put it reminds of the old me who volunteered to come to the Desorock Highland.
records.zh: 你这番话，让我看到了曾经自告奋勇调来荒石高地的自己。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_世界_埃弗拉德金库_POI任务_11_1
records.text: Am I early? Where's that person Carlotta sent...
records.zh: 是来早了吗……珂莱塔安排的人在……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_世界_埃弗拉德金库_POI任务_11_1
records.text: Carlotta promised a generous reward once it's done.
records.zh: 珂莱塔说了，事情办成之后可以要一笔丰厚的报酬。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_世界_埃弗拉德金库_POI任务_17_1
records.text: Processing... Please present your emergency pass to board the train Echo of the Averardo Vault...
records.zh: 请稍等……请您出示紧急逃生用证明，补交紧急逃生用证明后，即可乘坐由埃弗拉德金库维护的声骸列车……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_世界_埃弗拉德金库_POI任务_62_1
