records.text: Are you alright, Phoebe? Do you need a break？
records.zh: 没事吧，菲比，要不要休息一下？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_世界_埃弗拉德金库_POI任务_68_2
records.text: Woohoo! A day off! I heard Margherita's just put out something new on their menu. Perfect timing!
records.zh: 放假放假！听说玛格烈特的厨房要出新品，刚好试试！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_1_一级POI_生态舱_后日谈_9_1
records.text: The trunk has formed a bridge... Such bridges still exist in Bjartr Woods today.
records.zh: 树干构成了桥梁……如今的浮光林里也有这样的桥。

records.text: If you want to return home, I will help you find a way to cross the ocean to Penitent's End...
records.zh: 如果你想要回到家乡，我会帮助你找到穿越海洋前往墓岛的方法……

records.text: Typically, you can only reach Penitent's End by taking the Pilgrim's Sail. But now that we're here, that means...
records.zh: 一般来说……需要通过乘坐朝圣船穿越风暴才能抵达墓岛，但既然能来到这里也就是说明……

records.text: The Echo shakes its head and approaches Phoebe.
records.zh: 声骸摇了摇头，随后贴近了菲比。

records.text: Legend has it that long ago, before the Dark Tide, Penitent's End wasn't the forbidden land it is today.
records.zh: 传说中很多年以前，要比黑潮还要早的时候，这里并不是这样一片危险的禁地。

records.text: Ahem, moving on now... Penitent's End is the final stop in our Ragunna tour.
records.zh: 说起来，墓岛这里正好是我们拉古那游览的最后一站。

records.text: Cross this bridge, and we'll arrive at Thessaleo Fells.
records.zh: 跨过这座桥之后，就是被称为狄萨莱海脊的区域。

records.text: So, now that we're here, what do you think of Thessaleo Fells?
records.zh: 那么，一路走来，漂泊者对于狄萨莱海脊这片区域的印象如何呢？

records.text: After many years, the old nobility, led by the Fisalia family, eventually left Thessaleo Fells.
records.zh: 而经历了漫长的年岁以后，以翡萨烈家族为首的旧贵族们离开了海脊。

records.text: But why do unique phenomena from Penitent's End appear here in Thessaleo Fells?
records.zh: 不过墓岛的特殊现象，为什么会出现在狄萨莱海脊呢？

records.text: Well, let's keep going. We're heading east, and once we cross Thessaleo Fells, we'll reach Averardo Vault.
records.zh: 咳咳，总之，我们还是继续前行吧，向东走，穿过海脊的平原就是埃弗拉德金库了。

records.text: We'll be heading east. Beyond Thessaleo Fells lies Averardo Vault.
records.zh: 我们接下来会向东走，穿过海脊的平原就是埃弗拉德金库了。

records.text: That Echo fled north, and north of Averardo Vault is the Fagaceae Peninsula, which just so happens to be our next destination.
records.zh: 刚刚的声骸是向北逃走的，而我们从埃弗拉德金库向北走就是槲生半岛，原本也是我们旅途的下一站。

records.text: The Echo watches Phoebe warily as she gets closer.
records.zh: 声骸警惕地看着试图靠近的菲比。

records.text: Here we are! You can now see the outline of Oakheart Highcourt, nestled deep within the Fagaceae Peninsula.
records.zh: 我们到了，漂泊者，现在我们已经能够看到槲生半岛深处的青栎庭院的轮廓了。

records.text: But I... 漂泊者, do you remember Lorelei? We encountered her in Nimbus Sanctum with Zani.
records.zh: 但是我……漂泊者还记得上次我们和赞妮在云海遇到的罗蕾莱么？

records.text: I see. That prototype... it was actually lost in an accident during the initial testing. Vanished into a Void Storm. We've had no trace of it since.
records.zh: 原来如此，当年初次测试时……由于一场事故，原型机消失在了虚质磁暴中，至今下落不明。

records.text: I actually heard the original prototype was lost in a lab accident. So... this might be the one that got swallowed by the Void Storm.
records.zh: 听说，当年第一代原型机在实验中遇到事故，下落不明……说不定，这就是那台被虚质磁暴吞没的机器。

records.text: And yet here, in the Dimmr Plains... it finally did. The Soliskin live alongside it. Built a home around it.
records.zh: 而那个没能完成的使命，如今它却在黯原做到了。日灵在此与它共生，它们从黯原中创造了聚落。

records.text: Then he pulled a ring from his pocket and told Carlow he would continue his journey into the depths of Whisperwind Haven, seeking distant horizons.
records.zh: 然后从口袋中拿出一枚戒指，骑士告诉他，自己将向水畔深处继续前进，去到更远的地方。

records.text: But you're different from the knights I've met in town. They don't venture far into Whisperwind Haven, nor do they dare set up camp in the wild. They loiter around town before heading back to the city...
records.zh: 但又和镇上我所见的骑士不一样，他们不会向水畔深处冲锋，不会在野外露营，而是在镇上停留，向城内走去……

records.text:
Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. The name Korlacchi... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...
records.zh:
入冬了，就在这里暂时歇歇脚吧，趁这段时间也可以磨练磨练剑技。
说起来今天遇见了几位过路的骑士，他们似乎也是被骑士传说吸引而来，打算以拂风水畔为起点向更远处进发。
他们的盔甲上都印有家族的骑士纹章，很容易便能辨认出他们的身份，以家族之名，我将……
抱歉，吉安娜，我欺骗了你，科拉基之名……根本不存在。因为大雪的原因，我并没有赶上招揽家族骑士的宴会。
那个名字，不过是从书架上一本骑士小说里摘出的名字……我没有成为被认可的骑士……
对不起……

records.text: Whichever the case, their presence never disrupts the peace in Whisperwind Haven. I doubt anyone would want to be the troublemaker.
records.zh: 不过不管哪种说法，守风车人出现后，拂风水畔也一如既往地祥和，没有人愿意去打破这一片安宁。

records.text: We clung to our notions of the knight's oath, laughingstocks wherever we went, dreaming of exploring Whisperwind Haven and even venturing beyond its limits.
records.zh: 一路上恪守着骑士之道，受人嘲笑着来到这里，梦想着向水畔深处，甚至跨越水畔的更远方前进。

records.text: When the people of Egla Town finally realized that there were newcomers settling in Whisperwind Haven, the nameless knights had already become the Windmill Keepers.
records.zh: 当小镇上的人再次意识到水畔前竟还有人生活时，没有身份、无名的骑士，沦为了守风车人。

records.text: S-So what you're saying is… the Windmill Keepers weren't protecting the Windmills. They were watching over... Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 所，所以……守风车人守护的不是风车，而，而是……拂风水畔。

records.text: He was right. This was the path we all swore to... and he stuck to it until the very end, right here in Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 是啊，这条路不就是我们所选择的骑士道……他也在最后践行着这条道路，向着水畔冲锋消失在了自己的骑士梦中。

records.text: I believe he exists because the essence of knighthood has taken root deep in Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 我想，之所以他会存在，便是因为永不消散的骑士之道在水畔深处生根发芽。

records.text: Everyone who made it here left their marks. The trails they walked, the words they spoke, the tales of the ones who explored the furthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven...
records.zh: 抵达这里的大家，留下的足迹，留下的话语，以及那向水畔深处冲锋的背影可都是实打实地存在过。

records.text: Do you know which part of the fish is the best? Can you practice your sword skills with just a simple wooden pole? Do you know the best path deeper into Whisperwind Haven...?
records.zh: 你知道鱼的哪个部位最好吃吗，你知道如何利用简单的木桩练习剑术吗，你知道怎样才能在水畔深处骑行……

records.text: Yep, and he wasn't like any knight I've ever seen in the city. He was handing out these knight rings to everyone and asking if they wanted to be a knight and explore the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 嗯，他与我在城里见到的骑士打扮不同，而且他好像在四处分发骑士戒指，询问着大家是否有成为骑士的意愿，是否愿意向水畔深处前进。

records.text: As Margherita waves goodbye, you both wait patiently for Carlow to wake up from his hallucination.
records.zh: 玛格烈特向你们挥手离去，你们耐心等待着卡洛从幻觉中醒来。

records.text: You really scared the crap out of me, 漂泊者! You froze up like Carlow when you touched that thing. Luckily, Margherita came by and snapped you out of it.
records.zh: 漂泊者，你刚刚吓死我了，你接触那东西后，就突然变得和卡洛一样，幸亏玛格烈特小姐出现唤醒了你。

records.text: Knights from far and wide would gather here before setting off to the depth of Whisperwind Haven in search of the legend's origin.
records.zh: 后来不少骑士听闻传说而来，以这里为起点，学着传说的骑士向水畔深处进发。

records.text: Ah, those youngsters are just reenacting the knight's play. The Night Reveries are a kind of a performance, too. They can be traced back to the legend of a brave knight who slayed a giant in Whisperwind Haven.
records.zh: 那是小孩间的骑士戏吧，幻想之夜也是一场戏剧，从传说中那位骑士在拂风水畔深处斩落“巨人”开始。

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_4_1
records.text: This is the weather observatory in the Port City of Guixu. You passed out during a battle with the Inferno Rider. Some guys from Lollo Logistics brought you here.
records.zh: 这里是归墟港市的气象观测站，你在和燎照之骑的战斗中失去了意识，被呜呜物流那边的人带过来了。

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_26_1
records.text: Ah, Mortefi. You finally deign to respond to my calls, eh?
records.zh: 莫特斐，你小子终于肯回我的通讯了吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_26_1
records.text: Here's the short version: we still have some spare parts from the Explosive Spears used in the last battle, stored in the Port City of Guixu. They should work if we assemble them.
records.zh: 我长话短说吧，归墟港市中还留着上一次战斗所使用爆裂长枪的备用部件，只要将其组装起来的话，应该还能使用。

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_32_1
records.text: Sorry, got some emergencies back in my lab... If you're interested in this poster, find me at Donglu Research Station in Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 抱歉，所里有些突发情况……如果你对这个通缉令感兴趣的话就去归墟港市那边的东麓研究站找我吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_12_1
records.text: We were trying to take all the parts out of the Port City of Guixu and find somewhere safe to do the assembly...
records.zh: 是这样的，本来我们打算将部件全部运出归墟港市之外的安全地方再进行组装测试的。

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_14_1
records.text: That's some spectacular explosions. Don't you think, Mortefi?
records.zh: 嗯，多么壮观的爆炸……莫特斐，你觉得怎么样？

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_15_1
records.text: Rest assured. Mr. Mortefi said an initiation is needed for them to explode.
records.zh: 放心吧，莫特斐先生说这个长枪如果不启动的话是不会爆炸的啦~

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_37_1
records.text: Please excuse us, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Mimika can be really loud. She probably caused you some trouble back in Port City of Guixu, didn't she?
records.zh: 让客人您见笑了，我家的员工真是太吵了，之前在归墟港市和你一起行动的时候一定没少给您添麻烦吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_23_1
records.text: That mission left a permanent scar on our company. After that, we made it a rule that any major order had to be handled by Resonators with combat skills.
records.zh: 这次订单当成了我司立社以来无法抹去的伤痛，呜呜物流也从此规定大型订单必须要配备有战斗能力的共鸣者。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_机关宅邸危行支线_1_30
records.text: "Qiaoling, the situation in the Norfall Barrens is critical... We only pray the front line holds. Our plan still needs more time..."
records.zh: “悄玲，北落野那边战事告急……希望前线能够顶住。我们的计划，还需要更多时间……”

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_机关宅邸危行支线_17_1
records.text: Xuanfang Hold... I'd really love to see it for myself...
records.zh: 玄方城……真想亲眼看看啊……

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_8_2
records.text: The spores in the Dim Forest have been spreading steadily, and we suspect there are cores continuously producing and spreading them.
records.zh: 无光之森的孢子一直保持着稳定扩散的态势，那必须有一个生产和散播这些孢子的核心。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_8_2
records.text: Senmin has been trying to address the toxic spore issue in the Dim Forest.
records.zh: 我和森敏不一样，森敏始终想解决无光之森的问题。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_8_2
records.text: But I had my reasons for doing this... Did Qiaomu tell you about the situation in the Dim Forest?
records.zh: 但我这样做是有原因的……不知道巧木有没有和你说过无光之森的情况？

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_8_2
records.text: The Dim Forest is infested with toxic spores. Hoochiefs exposed to these spores turn aggressive.
records.zh: 无光之森里蔓延着一种毒雾孢子，被这些毒雾孢子污染了的戏猿会变得狂暴。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_6_4
records.text: Hoohoo and I will still be around. There are so many places in the Dim Forest that are worth exploring!
records.zh: 我和吼吼还会在附近转转，无光之森的危机刚解除，还有很多值得探索的地方呢！

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_1_1
records.text: Researchers in Huanglong seem to dress the same.
records.zh: 你们研究员穿衣服好像都一个样。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_1_1
records.text: The environment becomes less friendly once you go deeper into the forest. The Dim Forest's filled with poisonous spore dust that can be harmful to our health if we inhale it.
records.zh: 再往里走就到了路况比较复杂的区域，无光之森里弥漫着有污染性的孢子尘，直接吸入的话对人体有害。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_1_1
records.text: We are members of the Dim Forest exploration team. I'm Qiaomu, and this is Hoohoo.
records.zh: 我们是无光之森勘查组的成员，我是巧木，这是吼吼。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_世界任务_无光之森的危机_1_1
records.text: Our exploration team's responsible for regular surveys of the Dim Forest.
records.zh: 我们勘查组负责对无光之森的情况进行定期勘查。

records.text: Hmm... It's is still in working condition, and there's enough backup power... Now, according to Mr. Xiangli Yao's instructions... Username, and then...
records.zh: 嗯……检查完毕，设备状态完好、备用电源还有剩……按照相里要之前说的，用户名，然后是……

records.text: Weather here in the Whining Aix's Mire isn't the kindest. The area is covered with fog most of the year, plus the frequent thunderstorms.
records.zh: 怨鸟泽这里环境恶劣，常年笼罩无法驱散的迷雾，还不时有伴有雷暴天气。

records.text: Yes. For the settlers of the Whining Aix's Mire, a thorough extermination of the remains may be the most direct and efficient way, but may not be the best.
records.zh: 是，对生活在怨鸟泽的居民来说，清剿或许是最直接高效的手段，但可能并不是最好的。

records.text: Yes. For the settlers of the Whining Aix's Mire, a thorough extermination of the remains may be the most direct and efficient way, but may not be the best.
records.zh: 而且，就算真的验证过，对生活在怨鸟泽的居民来说，清剿可能也不是最好的方法。

records.text: I'm Jiuyue, a researcher studying the fog in Whining Aix's Mire, from the Academy. I've been researching TD Ecoacoustics in this area.
records.zh: 我是华胥派到怨鸟泽的研究员，九月。主要负责研究这片区域的残象声态研究，目前正在调查这一带的迷雾等异常情况。

records.text: I've been digging through all the data on Whining Aix's Mire, and I think I found a way to make it work. We just have to find the site, reboot the device, clear the fog, and investigate the source!
records.zh: 我可是翻阅了和怨鸟泽相关的所有实验记录，才找到了这么一个可行的方法……寻找站点、重启装置、驱散迷雾、调查源头！

records.text: This place is called the Whining Aix's Mire. Named after the bird-like Tacet Discord, Mourning Aix, that lives here. Additionally, as you can see, this place has a lot of marshes.
records.zh: 这里叫做怨鸟泽，其一是因为盘踞着的鸟形残象哀声鸷，其二嘛，如你所见，是因为这边有着大片大片自然沼泽地形。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_2_4
records.text: Why is that foreign girl in strange clothing riding the cable car over and over again? Hasn't she seen enough of the city?
records.zh: 那位身穿奇装异服的异乡小女孩，来来回回坐了好几趟缆车，是觉得这七丘城怎么看都看不够吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_1_16
records.text: Here, take this card. Try building your deck around it.
records.zh: 嗯……那这张卡送给你吧，你以它为核心组卡试试看。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_2_35
records.text: My body, left scarred by these cards! My life, in ruins. From today onwards, I vow to stop playing!
records.zh: 我被打牌所伤，竟然如此憔悴，自今日始，戒牌！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_1_20
records.text: At the wave of Augusta's hands, bring about winds of resolution.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔之手掠过山城，此地新风拂面。

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_2_40
records.text: Really? I was crying and screaming after I got drunk. And that big bump on the tavern keeper's head was because he rammed into a pillar while he was carrying me?!
records.zh: 真的？我喝多了就又喊又哭的，酒保头上的包也是我抱着他哭诉的时候，把他撞到柱子上留下的？！

records.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_2_24
records.text: Easy! It's Augusta, our Ephor. My turn. Bearing the strength of a thousand men! Fierce and battle-hardened! Full of brilliance! And… Bold with unwavering integrity! And also...
records.zh: 显然是奥古斯塔总督啊！那轮到我，力敌万夫！骁勇善战！锋芒毕露！还有……磊落飒爽，还有还有——

records.text: People from everywhere: Huanglong, Rinascita, Ashinohara, the New Federation...
records.zh: 大家来自许多地方，瑝珑、黎那汐塔、苇原、新联邦……

records.text: You wonder: Is this really a new flavor, or is it the primordial taste of the cosmos, stripped of all pretense?
records.zh: 你不禁开始思考，这究竟是一种全新的调味，还是消解所有调味后的宇宙原初之味？

records.text: (Whispering) Hi nice to meet you I'm Ignatius I'm from the New Federation.
records.zh: （小声）你好很高兴认识你我是伊格内修斯我来自新联邦

records.text: Mm-hmm. During the years I was missing, they moved to Lahai-Roi and took up Academy positions offered by President Lucilla.
records.zh: 嗯。在我失踪后的几年里，他们来到了拉海洛，并在洛瑟菈校长的批示下，开始在学院工作。

records.text: The white plum blossoms look more vibrant now. Is it because of your presence...?
records.zh: 白梅似乎更繁盛了，是因为你在吗……

records.text: Qingxiao, are you... inviting me into your inner landscape?
records.zh: 清宵，你想……邀请我去你的内景？

records.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.
records.zh: 徒儿，你先前接受了心的力量，身体还需要适应，近来又在玄方地界奔波不休，似乎一直没好好休息。

records.text: How do you feel now, Qingxiao? And your Inner Demon... is she taken care of?
records.zh: 清宵，你现在身体情况怎么样了？心魔的事……彻底解决了吗？

records.text: Carlotta, you stay. I have more to discuss with you.
records.zh: 你留下，珂莱塔，我还有事要交代你。

records.text: Go to Whisperwind Haven after dusk. I will inform Scarlet Velvet.
records.zh: 黄昏之后，拂风水畔见吧。红丝绒那边，我会知会他们的。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_角色_珂莱塔线_1_15
records.text: You and Carlotta quickly deduce that the bartender is the contact for Scarlet Velvet. Though he may not understand all of the cryptic messages, nothing of importance escapes him. While the bartender is not optimistic about your meeting with Scarlet Velvet, he doesn't stop you as you followed the rules and found him. It also seems that he has heard of Carlotta's character from Benett. Therefore, he promises to arrange a meeting for you with Scarlet Velvet at Whisperwind Haven at dask.
records.zh: 你和珂莱塔识破为调制酒水的酒保正是红丝绒的秘密接头人，正因如此，他也许并不懂每一句的意义，但不会错过对自己有用的信息。酒保并不看好你们与红丝绒的会面，但碍于规矩，你们确实找到了正确的接头人，况且……贝内特曾向他们透露过对珂莱塔的尊敬，他决定相信贝内特的判断。酒保替你们安排了黄昏后在拂风水畔和红丝绒他们见面。

records.text: As you and Carlotta review the projected data, you notice a pattern of movements between Margherita's, Benett's home, and the vault with only two deviations—Liberty Square and a dock.
records.zh: 顺着投映出的数据记录，你和珂莱塔二人逐一排查，能看到行动点基本在玛格烈特餐馆、贝内特家、金库之间规律性运动，对照着生活的三点一线，唯二存异的地点是城中的自由广场和一个靠水的码头。

records.text: ...What about you, Carlotta? What do you think?
records.zh: ……珂莱塔，你呢，你有什么想法？

records.text: Yes, you try and loosen their lips. If memory serves, they are senior members, having served under my uncle for years. Regulars at Margherita's.
records.zh: 要打听消息吗？我记得，他们俩跟着科波拉有些年头了，算是家族中的老大哥，常去玛格烈特那边聚餐。

records.text: Ah, Tulip coin... Oh! I remember you. You work at the vault, don't you? We had a drink at Margherita's.
records.zh: 是郁金香钱币的郁金香啊……嘶，我想起来了，是金库那边的，我们还在玛格烈特喝过酒。

records.text: So, what do you need? We are just about to wrap up and grab a bite at Margherita's. Still got a lot on our plate today.
records.zh: 说吧，找哥俩有什么事？这边忙完，我们去玛格烈特对付一顿，还有别的要忙呢。

records.text: Oh, Margherita's! Nothing quite like it, hm? And the pizza... Oh, it's a favorite in my circle, too.
records.zh: 玛格烈特啊，那边的披萨口味一绝，氛围也好，我也常和家族里的兄弟们一起去。

records.text: The leader of a network of commoners seeking freedom in Ragunna City. They had close ties with Benett. If he was really stealing, I'd wager they were complicit.
records.zh: 拉古那城里一伙由平民组成的自由团体的头目。那些人原来就和贝内特来往密切，贝内特监守自盗，那他们就是最可能帮着销赃的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_日灵收集引导任务_1_1
records.text: (Contacting) We are terribly short-handed on Shepherds here in Bjartr Woods at the moment. We could really use your help...
records.zh: （通讯中）浮光林中牧者人手紧缺，我们需要你的帮助……

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, and community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"
records.zh: “就在这一年，我们所在的城市被评为全索拉里斯最棒地区，主要原因包括……最低的犯罪率，满意指数第一的社区环境，令人惊叹？但事实的确如此，这座城市总是会给人新的希望——”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else, and the most popular hero story ever. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"
records.zh: “就在这一年，我们所在的城市被评为全索拉里斯最棒地区，主要原因包括……最低的犯罪率，满意指数第一的社区环境，还有最受欢迎的英雄故事——令人惊叹？但事实的确如此，这座城市总是会给人新的希望——”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "So, do you think those Fractsidus goons are involved in this, Yinlin?"
records.zh: “难道吟霖是觉得这里也有残星会那样的坏蛋？”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "Look, 漂泊者! Isn't that Sanhua? Finally, a familiar face!"
records.zh: “漂泊者快看，那个不是散华么！终于在这场电影里找到熟人啦！”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: Following her gaze, the snow-capped mountains above the sea gradually fade into the falling snow. Her words take you back to the moment you first stood on the Central Plains, gazing back at Jinzhou.
records.zh: 你顺着她的目光回头望去，海中雪山的远景正在飘落的雪花中逐渐模糊。她的话让你忽然回忆起第一次站在中曲台地时回望今州城的那个瞬间。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: Completed Theater 2 "Mt. Firmament Inn" - Ending One Unlocked: "Serenity"
records.zh: 【已通关2号影厅「新乘霄客栈」，解锁结局1：「清净」】

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: Completed Theater 2 "Mt. Firmament Inn" - Ending Two Unlocked: "Turmoil"
records.zh: 【已通关2号影厅「新乘霄客栈」，解锁结局2：「浊流」】

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "Holy! Jianxin? Geez, you look awful... What happened to you?"
records.zh: “天哪，这不是鉴心么，你看起来脸色好差……怎么一段时间不见混成这样啦。”

records.speakerZh: 清贫落魄的道士【抱朴守一】
records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "Do you two know me? Jianxin? Could it be one of the names I used during my training years? I see, meeting you here must be fate."
records.zh: “莫非二位认识我么？鉴心？这难道也是小道过去修行时用过的化名之一？原来如此，道法自然，二位在此和我重逢也是一场造化。”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "Um, I'm pretty sure that's Youhu... What should we do, 漂泊者? Should we go help her out?"
records.zh: “额，好像，是釉瑚诶……怎么办，漂泊者，我们要出手吗？”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "No matter where she is, it's the same old Youhu..."
records.zh: “果然，不论在哪釉瑚都是这个样子……”

records.speakerZh: 抱着羊咩的女孩【黑白先知】
records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "Prince Cosmos, meet Princess Cloudy, your new best friend!"
records.zh: “黑咩王子，这是白咩公主，是你的新伙伴！”

records.speakerZh: 抱着羊咩的女孩【黑白先知】
records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "And now, I'm introducing her to Prince Cosmos, because best friends should always meet! And yesterday... it's all fuzzy."
records.zh: “所以，现在我要跟黑咩王子介绍白咩公主，这是他的新伙伴。然后，昨天？昨天的事我记不得了……”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "The circus's final tour was a grand spectacle, but Fenrico still hasn't settled the performance fees."
records.zh: “马戏团的最后一次巡演声势浩大，但芬莱克至今都没付演出费。”

records.speakerZh: 闪亮的金发少女【礼仪副官】
records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "May Ragunna City prosper under the Court of Mercury's guidance."
records.zh: “希望在「水星天宫」的带领下，拉古那城能愈加繁荣幸福。”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "...I've come to see High Adjudicator Fenrico."
records.zh: “……你好，我想找芬莱克执行官。”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text:
The Carnevale has ended.
Ragunna City slumbers on the shore, as though the revelry was a fleeting dream.
You tell yourself that perhaps this is the best outcome.
Debts have been settled. Not all, but you've done what you could.
records.zh:
狂欢节业已落幕。
在不远处，岸上的拉古那城沉睡着，仿佛刚刚发生的盛典只是一场幻梦。
你告诉自己，也许这就是最好的结果。
你收回了过去的债——也许并非全部，但你已做了你能做的一切。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text:
You notice the guards surrounding the stage, but you disregard them, walking straight toward Fenrico.
You meet his eyes calmly.
records.zh:
你发现警卫们团团围住了舞台，密切观察着你。但你如没看到他们一般，径直走向了芬莱克。
你看着芬莱克的眼睛，语气平静地说道：

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "There's no need for that, Fenrico. It's better we speak where the entire city can hear."
records.zh: “不必了，芬莱克。我们的事，还是当着全城人的面说明比较好。”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text:
A peculiar, disorienting scent drifts through the air.
The idyllic waterways of Ragunna City suddenly darken. The Gondolas are replaced by massive, shadowy sea creatures. The boatmen and citizens transform into strange sea folk, their limbs and torsos becoming tails and fins, their necks marked with gill slits...
records.zh:
一股奇异的香味令你头晕目眩。
你看向身旁的拉古那城的清澈水道，它突然变得幽暗、深不可测，其中往来的不再是贡多拉，而是漆黑的海底巨兽，而其上的船夫与市民则变成了神秘的海族，他们四肢与躯干的连接处长着鳍，脖子上有着数道鳃裂……

records.speakerZh: 欧泊般闪耀的少女【新任家主】
records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "Had I been the head of the family back then, I would never have supported Fenrico. I would have chosen to support you."
records.zh: “如果当年我是家主的话，一定不会选择支持芬莱克，而是会选择支持你。”

records.speakerZh: 欧泊般闪耀的少女【新任家主】
records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: "I'll spare you the pleasantries, Chief. I sought you out regarding the High Adjudicator Fenrico."
records.zh: “我也不绕圈子了，行长。我这次找你，是为了芬莱克执行官的事。”

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: The island lies on the outskirts of Ragunna City, a quiet outpost where travelers come and go. This was also the first stop of your return.
records.zh: 离岛位于拉古那城的外围，它是人们进出拉古那城的关口。之前你回到拉古那时，也是在离岛下的船。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
records.text: Accept the regards of the Lord of the Somnoire
records.zh: 接受深层集域之主的致意

records.text: Anslem, where were you during the New Solar Ceremony?! Hyvatia malfunctioned, and Professor Mornye still hasn't recovered from her injuries!
records.zh: 安瑟姆，换日仪式时你去哪里了？！因为海维夏出问题，莫宁教授的伤到现在还没恢复！

records.text: Warren said Hyvatia's parameters were off and told me to go check it out downstairs. But the moment I stepped off the Starward Riseway, I blacked out.
records.zh: 当时魏尔伦那家伙说，海维夏的参数有异常，让我下去检查一下。结果我刚下联运椎骨，就失去了意识。

records.text: I was just trying to help Professor Mornye. How did that end with her tattling to my mother?! Ugh, talk about a disaster...
records.zh: 我好心帮莫宁教授的忙，她怎么去找我妈家访啊！呜呜，飞来横祸啊……

records.text: (Sounds like Mornye gave Yngvar a good thrashing.)
records.zh: （听起来，是莫宁把伊摩尔制服了。）

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_1_1
records.text: Aemeath tilts her head in thought, then smiles at you.
records.zh: 爱弥斯歪着脑袋思索片刻，微笑着看向你。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_1_1
records.text: You see Aemeath crouching near some Snowfluff Seals. Her smile is soft as she reaches out to ruffle the fur on one of their heads.
records.zh: 你看到爱弥斯半蹲在几只雪绒海豹的附近，笑眯眯地伸出手揉搓其中一只的脑袋。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_1_1
records.text: The Snowfluff Seals look dazed, their eyes squinted as they remain still, as if knowing resistance is futile by Aemeath's aura alone.
records.zh: 海豹们一副昏昏欲睡的表情，半眯着眼睛，但没有爬开，似乎都已屈服于爱弥斯强大的气场下。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_3_1
records.text: With Aemeath's gentle humming nearby, you drift into a light, peaceful sleep.
records.zh: 身边传来爱弥斯轻柔的歌声，你逐渐在困倦中陷入了浅梦。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_4_1
records.text: You share your joys and sorrows with Aemeath, and her expressions shift with your words—delight and anger, excitement and concern.
records.zh: 你和爱弥斯诉说着那些或喜或悲的经历，看她的表情因你的言语而被牵引，露出欣慰与不忿，兴奋与担忧。

records.text: Now all we need is an earthquake or some other kind of natural disaster to hit the Dimmr Deep...
records.zh: 接下来要做的，就是等待恒黯之原的一次地震，或其他类似的自然灾害……

records.text: Remember how I told you the Spacetrek Incubation Program rejected my proposal, so I decided to go survey the Dimmr Deep on my own?
records.zh: 你记不记得，之前我说「深空孵化计划」拒绝了我的方案，所以我才决定自己去恒黯之原勘察？

records.text: Before going to the Dimmr Deep, I felt like no one could see how hard I was working.
records.zh: 去恒黯之原前，我觉得没有任何人看得到我的努力。

records.text: A paper titled "A Geological Structure Model of Solaris Using the Dimmr Deep as the Survey Surface," credits "Zenus" as first author and "漂泊者" as second author.
records.zh: 一篇名为《以恒黯之原为探测面的索拉里斯地质结构模型》的论文，第一作者为“泽纳斯”，第二作者为“漂泊者”。

records.text: I selected three coordinates in the outer and inner perimeters of the Dimmr Deep as points to deploy highly sensitive seismographs.
records.zh: 我在恒黯之原的外围和腹地各选取了三个坐标，我想在这些地方投放高敏地震仪。

records.text: Then I plug that data into my seismic model, run the calculations... and bam. I can reverse-engineer the entire geological structure beneath the Dimmr Deep.
records.zh: 根据这些信息，代入到我提供的地震学模型中运算，就可以反推出恒黯之原地下的完整地质结构。

records.text: But if we push the detection surface down to the Dimmr Deep? Humanity's calculation precision for Solaris could increase tenfold.
records.zh: 但如果将探测面下探到恒黯之原，人类对索拉里斯星球结构的演算精度将大幅提升。

records.text: I've always wanted to survey the Dimmr Deep. This place has the highest level of Aleph-1 markers, and is also where it last appeared in Lahai-Roi.
records.zh: 我一直想勘察恒黯之原……这是阿列夫一的气息最浓烈的地区，也是它在拉海洛最后出现的地方。

records.text: I submitted my survey proposal for the Dimmr Deep to the Research Institute. Applied for the Spacetrek Incubation Program too.
records.zh: 我也向研究院发送过我对恒黯之原的勘察方案，还申请了「深空孵化计划」。

records.text: His research proposal is fascinating. But his idea of entering the Dimmr Deep alone is extremely dangerous.
records.zh: 他的研究方案很精彩——但他想只身进入恒黯之原的想法也十分危险。

records.chapter: 剧情_剧情_天城_原生态飞檐_4_8
records.text: It won't help you improve your Overdash technique, but it doesn't violate the regulations either. Off you go, then. "Woosh" to the finish line!
records.zh: 虽然这并不能锻炼飞檐技巧，不过，这好像也并不违反规则。请一鼓作气地“飞”向终点吧！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_14_1
records.text: It looks like a giant hand that braces the very sky above the Dimmr Plains...
records.zh: 在我眼里，它就像托起黯原天空的手掌……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_14_1
records.text: It reminds me of the Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi.
records.zh: 拉海洛的「联运椎骨」……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_14_1
records.text: It looks like the Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi.
records.zh: 它就和拉海洛的「联运椎骨」一样……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_15_1
records.text: This... this is a native Dimmr Plains plant! And it's still thriving! You're incredible!
records.zh: 这……这是黯原的野生植株！而且就和它还在地里时一样新鲜！你太厉害了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_24_1
records.text: He went deep into the Dimmr Deep, hoping to study the planet's geological structure...
records.zh: 他深入恒黯之原，希望深入测量这颗星球的地质结构……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_4_1
records.text: But here in the Dimmr Plains? No Reactor glow. So how are they supposed to charge up?
records.zh: 但在炉光无法企及的黯原，日灵该如何获得能量呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_4_1
records.text: But it's still a MASSIVE leap forward! Soliskin in Bjartr Woods take years to grow up. Peep did it in TWO WEEKS.
records.zh: 但是，它的诞生毫无疑问是跨越性的一步！以往日灵在浮光林中需要数年才能成熟，但小皮只花了两周！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_4_1
records.text: EXACTLY. Where did you GO, Peep?! Without you, our division's future is darker than the Dimmr Plains themselves…
records.zh: 是的……小皮你到底去了哪里啊，没有你，我们学科群的未来将一片灰暗……

records.text: If only I could get to Jinzhou City and meet Master Lingyang... He's the liondance expert...
records.zh: 要是能去今州城里请教凌阳师傅就好了，听说他的狮子舞可是一绝……

records.text: You and Suisui hover around Abby, fanning it and bringing it glass after glass of water. After much effort, it finally "cools down."
records.zh: 你们手忙脚乱给阿布端水扇风，好不容易才让阿布冷静下来。

records.text: Stop—not another word. I know exactly what you Mingting folks are up to. You're plotting to slowly take over the entire Xuanfang Hold market, aren't you?
records.zh: 停，都别说。我知道你们这些明庭来的想做什么，你们不就想慢慢把我们玄方城的生意都吃掉？

records.text: This big promotion is put on by the Zhaoming Commerce Guild and Huizhen Plaza merchants together. The whole idea was for everyone to make a killing together.
records.zh: 这次打折活动，是我们「昭明商会」联合汇珍坊的诸位商家举办的。本来呢，是想大家一起发财。

records.text: Let me introduce you. This is the chief of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's Xuanfang Hold branch.
records.zh: 我来介绍吧，这位是我们「昭明商会」在玄方城分行的行长。

records.text: I'm Suisui, the Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.
records.zh: 昭明商会理事长，穗穗。

records.text: That may be true, but I do have several channels at my disposal. With the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's network, we can easily get these goods flying off the shelves in Mingting, all the way out to Rinascita, and maybe even the New Federation.
records.zh: 也许是这样吧，但我手里掌握的渠道可不止一条。昭明商会手里的经销渠道可以让这些货畅通无阻地卖到明庭，乃至黎那汐塔，甚至新联邦去。

records.text: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will bankroll a full supply and distribution network to sell Mengzhou's products far and wide.
records.zh: 由我们昭明商会出资，搭建向外的供销网络，把梦州的货品卖出去。

records.text: —to show you my thanks! Seriously, Suisui, you're the best.
records.zh: 表演一个非常感谢！谢谢穗穗，你真是好人。

records.text: As the Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild, you're probably planning to seize a share of the Xuanfang Hold market for the Guild. Now that Huizhen Plaza is running a promotion, this is a perfect chance to do some market research.
records.zh: 作为昭明商会理事长的你，应该有让商会进驻玄方城市场的打算。而汇珍坊正做促销活动，你刚好可以来做市场调研。

records.text: Recently, he bought Waterlamp, White Jade Beauty, Soulwrought Jade... and according to Buling, these are all materials for "Soul Summoning."
records.zh: 他在最近购买了水灯花、白玉美人、妙心琢玉……结合卜灵的说法，这些都是“灵魂召唤”相关的材料。

records.text: I get the full picture now. Abby, Buling, listen.
records.zh: 我明白了。阿布，卜灵，听我说。

records.text: I suppose I should address you as "young friend Buling" now.
records.zh: 我该叫你一声“卜灵小友”了。

records.text: You give Buling a brief account of everything that's happened lately.
records.zh: 你们将这段时间发生的事，简要地告诉了卜灵。

records.text: Buling, since you're here, why not stay and cultivate with me a while longer?
records.zh: 卜灵儿，既然你来了，不妨再在我这修行一段时间吧。

records.text: Huh? But I've already promised Encore we'd head off to the New Federation!
records.zh: 哎！先说好，我可是和安可约好了，马上要启程去新联邦玩了啊。

records.text: The reason he spread ghost rumors and told Buling to stay away is—
records.zh: 他散播鬼怪有关的传闻，并要求卜灵不要呆在附近的原因是——

records.text: But Buling's poking around put him on guard, so he's likely moved the TD somewhere else.
records.zh: 然而卜灵的调查让他警惕，所以他应该已经将残象转移了。

records.text: Lyu Yi's memo. From the notes, he's been secretly performing a ritual. However... "He's definitely been scammed," Buling remarked.
records.zh: 店长吕一的备忘明细。从明细上看，店长吕一一直在秘密举行仪式。不过……“他肯定是被骗了啦。”卜灵这样评价。

records.text: Lyu Yi's records of Buling's tabs. Judging by the records, Buling really does love this shop's skewers... "That's not the point!"
records.zh: 店长吕一记载的卜灵的赊账记录。从记录上看，卜灵确实很爱吃这家店的烤串……“重点不是这里吧！”

records.text: Say what you want, but Avidius has what it takes to lead!
records.zh: 不管你怎么说，阿维狄亚确有为王的资质！

records.text: Ephor Augusta is certainly capable. But cries for Avidius to be the next Hero of Heroes grow louder by the day.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔总督实力雄厚，但七丘城中，拥护“准英雄王”阿维狄亚的呼声也已日渐高涨。

records.text: Avidius has braved four successful expeditions into Manes Deep. If that doesn't prove he's fit to be ruler, what does?
records.zh: 阿维狄亚曾四度穿越玛涅斯之底，这难道还不够证明，他拥有为王的资质吗？

records.text: Avidius is a hero, no doubt. Always has been, and he still is.
records.zh: 阿维狄亚是个英雄，从前是，现在仍是。

records.text: That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. My loyalty to the Ephor has never wavered. Her deeds shine as gloriously as the eternal blazing sun. A mere figure like Avidius can never be compared to her.
records.zh: 话不能这么说，埃斯特阁下，我可一直对奥古斯塔总督忠心耿耿。她的辉煌功业如同正午的烈阳，区区阿维狄亚，怎堪与她相提并论？

records.text: The Ephor's deeds are indeed admirable. But I must insist that Avidius, too, is a true Gladiator and a hero deserving of the same glory!
records.zh: 奥古斯塔总督的伟绩值得敬佩，但我还是要说，阿维狄亚无愧于角斗士的荣耀，他是一名真正的英雄！

records.text: I agree with you, Sforza. I have respect for Avidius as well.
records.zh: 斯福尔扎，我同意你的话，我也向阿维狄亚献上同等的敬意。

records.text: Well, folks say the Wootters did live in Septimont City a long time ago. But after the first Dark Tide hit, they all moved out to the Sanguis Plateaus and settled here.
records.zh: 唔，据说很久以前，七丘城中也有呜獭獭居住，但第一次黑潮爆发后，它们就集体迁徙到了桑古伊斯狩原，在这里定居。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_浮光林散点_1_1
records.text: Once you arrive at Bjartr Woods, you make sure to do everything the Giant Soliskin says, okay? Don't make Mama... Don't me me worry.
records.zh: 到了浮光林里要听大日灵的话，不要让妈妈……不要让我担心。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_浮光林通用对话和冒泡_1_13
records.text: Did our ancestors always live in Bjartr Woods?
records.zh: 我们的祖先也一直生活在浮光林里吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_浮光林赫尔琉斯_2_6
records.text: A wider road means faster travel. Between the Academy and Bjartr Woods, our people could move with ease.
records.zh: 宽敞的道路能让族人们更快地往返于学院与浮光林。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_浮光林赫尔琉斯_2_1
records.text: Three hundred Dusk Honeypots! I handpicked them all from Bjartr Woods!
records.zh: 我在浮光林深处采了整整三百颗黄昏蜜罐，才换来了这块玉化木！

records.text: I've got Chongzhou dried peppers, porcelain-and-bamboo vessels, and brocades...
records.zh: 我这有重州产的干辣椒、瓷胎竹编和重锦……

records.text: Any plans Zhaoming Commerce Guild has going forward?
records.zh: 昭明商会那边，之后有什么规划吗？

records.text: According to Suisui, first, we're going to come up with a way to boost Xuanfang's economy. We're going to export our specialty products and make everyone prosperous.
records.zh: 据穗穗所说，我们会先想办法提振玄方地界的经济，把这儿的特产卖出去，让人们富裕起来。

records.text: Meanwhile, we'll bring in products from other regions... This time, I've brought back Chongzhou dried peppers, porcelain-and-bamboo vessels, and brocades. They've become very popular!
records.zh: 同时也会把外面的物产带进来……这次我带了重州产的干辣椒、瓷胎竹编和重锦来，大家都很感兴趣！

records.text: That's the Zhaoming Commerce Guild for you! I visited Chongzhou on a business trip a few years back and happened to pass by your guild. You had products from across all six cities.
records.zh: 真不愧是昭明商会啊……前些年我到重州出差时途经你们商会，看到你们把一庭六州的各色物产都汇聚到了一起。

records.text: There's too much cargo, so Fangzhou uses his Resonance ability for inspections... Don't worry, they're 100% accurate.
records.zh: 货物太多，方周用了共鸣能力在核查……放心吧，保证准确。

records.text: I heard that if you toss a coin into the Four Chime Shaftpost, you'll be blessed by Hsin the Moon Fox!
records.zh: 听说往四鸣井里投币，就能获得心月狐的赐福！

records.text: You think Lady Hsin might have accepted it? My dream is going to come true!
records.zh: 难道心月狐大人悦纳了？我要美梦成真了！

records.text: May I ask why your people don't settle within Bjartr Woods?
records.zh: 请问，你们的聚落为什么不修在浮光林里呢？

records.text: For the Soliskin, Bjartr Woods is home. It is there they rest, grow, and return to the Solistrees at the very end.
records.zh: 浮光林是日灵的家园，它们在其中休憩成长，最后归于日树。

records.text: I see … so only Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods most of the time?
records.zh: 原来如此……所以大部分时候只有牧者会进入浮光林吗？

records.text: Oh, I get it now! Because this camp is near Bjartr Woods, it means a shorter trip and lower transport costs!
records.zh: 原来如此，我懂了！这个营地离浮光林近，大叔来回的路程短，运输成本低！

records.text: So Xuanfang Hold even has self-service shops. How convenient!
records.zh: 原来玄方城里还有自助商店，真是方便啊！

records.text: Miss Fuling's illness is really something else...
records.zh: 那位叫伏翎的姑娘的病真是少见……

records.text: That guy Wuli? He was already waiting at the pickup window before dawn even broke!
records.zh: 那位叫梧黎的男生，早上天还没亮就来取药处排队了！

records.text: He even told the person beside him that thanks to Fuling, he actually got to see the sunrise over Xuanfang Hold for once.
records.zh: 他还跟旁边的人说，多亏有了伏翎，他才能早起看到玄方城的日出。

records.text: Xuanfang is just a rest stop for them. Mengzhou City's next.
records.zh: 这玄方地界是他们的歇脚处，下一站，他们要去梦州本部。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_58_4
records.text: Before Jinzhou was founded, Tacet Discords from the Norfall Barrens ravaged Huanglong's borders...
records.zh: 今州建州前，来自北落野的残象一直威胁着瑝珑边境……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_58_4
records.text: To stand against them, Yuan Fortress and Xuanfang Hold were built.
records.zh: 为了抵挡这些残象，渊城和玄方城相继在我们脚下建立。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_57_1
records.text: Any word from Mengzhou? After all that mess...
records.zh: 梦州那边有消息了吗？出了这么大的事……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_22_9
records.text: I'm not even comparing it to Chongzhou. Even Jinzhou has more kick than this.
records.zh: 不说和重州比，就连今州都比这有味道。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_22_17
records.text: Come try it! Chongzhou noodles, Jinzhou flatbread, Yuezhou fried treats, and Mengzhou soup!
records.zh: 来尝尝看！重州的小面今州的饼，越州的炸货梦州的羹！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_22_26
records.text: What's the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's secret? How are they stocked on everything?
records.zh: 这昭明商会是什么来头啊？怎么什么货都有！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_8_3
records.text: All I know is Ms. Liangyu rarely comes back to the village after she became one....
records.zh: 椋羽姐姐当了定玄卫后，就很少回村子里了……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_2_7
records.text: The savior of Jinzhou... No, wait. The savior of Jinzhou and Xuanfang Hold!
records.zh: 是拯救了今州……啊不，拯救了今州和玄方城的大英雄！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_1_2
records.text: Yes, sir. Jinzhou and Mengzhou have dispatched reinforcements...
records.zh: 嗯，今州、梦州，两州都已派军前来驰援……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_9_1
records.text: Supplies from Chongzhou, Yuezhou, and Zhaozhou will also arrive at Xuanfang Hold before tomorrow.
records.zh: 重州、越州、诏州的物资，也会在明日前抵达玄方城。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_10_6
records.text: Too right. A TD breakout would affect the entire Norfall Barrens... and then we'd have a crisis spanning two cities on our hands...
records.zh: 嗯，残象外逃，必会影响北落野……届时就是两州危机……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_10_14
records.text: We'll just have to switch to Jinzhou or Chongzhou. We need this batch of weapons ASAP...
records.zh: 得向今州或重州的天工下委托，这批武器得尽快……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_5_10
records.text: Between being short-handed, losing Duzhong and Qingzhi, and Liangyu still being on the mend, the Commander is bound to be on edge. He's just not showing it, that's all.
records.zh: 现在人手短缺，杜仲大哥和青枳大姐不在了，椋羽也还在养伤，卫长虽然没有表现，但心里应该也很不踏实吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_4_7
records.text: But... you knocked out most of the people from the Ministry of War all by yourself... Even Liangyu knows about it. She said once she's back on her feet, she absolutely wants to have a round with you!
records.zh: 可是……你一个人把大半个军策府的人都打败了欸……这消息都传到椋羽骑使那去了，她说等养好了伤，一定要和你比试一场呢！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_7_3
records.text: Dad, just come with us... We all move to Chongzhou together, and you can be with your grandson all the time...
records.zh: 老爸，您就跟我走吧……咱们一家搬到重州去，您也能每天见到孙子……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_3_4
records.text: I... Maybe I should check out that new blade-resistant vest from the New Federation tomorrow?
records.zh: 我……要不，明天去市场看看新联邦进口的防刃服？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_6_3
records.text: Mom! I'm home! Where's dad? I've brought him a souvenir from Mingting!
records.zh: 妈！我回来了！爸呢？我给他带了明庭的伴手礼！

records.text: Because there's no Panhua's Restaurant or Trattoria Margherita...
records.zh: 这里既没有攀花饭馆，也没有“玛格烈特”餐馆……

records.text: Welcome to Yuan's Flavors, Xuanfang Hold branch!
records.zh: 欢迎来到「渊中鲜」的玄方城分店！

records.text: Honestly? Not bad. Is this for next year's Carnevale?
records.zh: 哦哦，感觉不错，这是明年狂欢节的剧本？

records.text: Brant's been asking for a celebration, so he commissioned a new batch from me.
records.zh: 布兰特说要搞个庆祝会，在我这里定制了新的烟花。

records.text: Fenrico's vanished. The Blessed Maiden has returned. And we're staring down an entirely new chapter.
records.zh: 如今芬莱克不见踪影，圣女重现人间，这是全新的局势。

records.text: Lord Fenrico's missing, and the Order's attitude is… unsettling. I fear we'd be killed the moment we set foot back there.
records.zh: 芬莱克大人行踪不明，修会又态度暧昧，我害怕回去就会被杀掉……

records.text: I'm headed to Whisperwind Haven to help the Order distribute supplies to villagers in need, which is why it is with me.
records.zh: 我正要去拂风水畔帮助修会的兄弟向贫苦的村民们分发物资，也因此它便跟在我身边。

records.text: The face in the mirror looks so much older now. It's as if I've been lost in a very, very long dream.
records.zh: 镜子里的我老了很多，我像做了一个持续许多年的梦。

records.text: I can't imagine how the Acolytes caring for me managed to endure it… It's shameful.
records.zh: 真不敢想象那些照顾我的修士是如何忍受我的……惭愧，惭愧。

records.text: Ephor Augusta hasn't given a straight answer. Who knows where he's gone?
records.zh: 奥古斯塔总督还没有给出确切的信息。谁知道他去了哪儿？

records.text: That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. Ephor Augusta's radiance is beyond question. On what grounds could she ever deal with Avidius?
records.zh: 话不能这么说，埃斯特阁下，以奥古斯塔总督的光辉，她有什么理由去处理阿维狄亚？

records.text: The Ephor's virtues are beyond reproach. Still, it troubles me that we've heard nothing of Avidius so far.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔阁下的为人当然无可指摘，但如今阿维狄亚迟迟没有消息，这令人十分担忧啊。

records.text: You see? The Ephor has no part in this. Our concern should be finding Avidius's whereabouts.
records.zh: 看吧，此事与总督无关，我们还是关注一下阿维狄亚的去向吧。

records.text: That's how I made a new friend. Her name is Iuno.
records.zh: 现在我有个新朋友了，她叫尤诺。

records.text: When the Dark Tide rose again, it was Lady Cartethyia's voice that guided us through it!
records.zh: 当黑潮再度降临，卡提希娅大人的呼唤引领了我们的前路！

records.text: So long as we pray to Lady Cartethyia, our wishes shall find their answers!
records.zh: 只要肯向卡提希娅大人祈祷，愿望必将得到回响！

records.text: When Lady Cartethyia called, the people of Rinascita heeded with courage. It was with the valiant warriors that we fended off the Dark Tide together.
records.zh: 黎那汐塔人以勇气回应了卡提希娅大人的呼唤，是我们与那些勇士一起抗击了黑潮。

records.text: After the catastrophe, Augusta has truly come into her own.
records.zh: 此次大灾之后，奥古斯塔更是如日中天。

records.text: Still no word on Avidius… and that Priestess…
records.zh: 阿维狄亚尚无消息……还有那个谕女……

records.text: Ephor Augusta is strong, yes, but not that strong. That's exactly my point.
records.zh: 奥古斯塔总督强归强，但也没有到最强的程度，我就想说这个。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_7_2
records.text: The Tethys System recently expanded its frequency feature library and detected a previously unknown, special frequency. In response, the Black Shores dispatched Bloom Bearers to investigate. Valentina informs you that Shorekeeper is now analyzing the abnormal frequency and suggests you meet her for more information.
records.zh: 近日，由于泰缇斯系统扩充了频率特征库，竟意外捕捉到了前所未见的特殊频率，黑海岸调遣各执花前往调查。你从瓦莲京娜处得知，守岸人正在谬误收容所中分析这段异常频率，你可以前去与她确认。

records.text: The Black Shores recovered the Threnodian's Gem not long ago... I mean, Leviathan's essence. The Tethys System ran a deep analysis and expanded its frequency feature library. This enhancement allows us to detect previously unidentifiable special frequencies.
records.zh: 黑海岸此前收容的鸣式宝石……对，就是利维亚坦的核心。近日泰缇斯系统对其进行了深度解析，扩充了频率的特征库，由此探测到了更多此前没能识别的特殊频率。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_28_3
records.text: After leaving the Error Cell, you encounter Buling, who has also sensed the abnormal frequency. Using her Forte, she helps pinpoint the exact location of the shifting coordinates.
records.zh: 你来到谬误收容所外，发现卜灵也来了此处。卜灵称自己也感受到了异常频率，并提出可以使用自己的共鸣能力，帮忙定位坐标。

records.text: Ms. Buling, we understand your concern. But the Tethys System hasn't completed its analysis yet, and your talisman divination isn't always—Ahem, what I mean is, without proper clearance, we can't initiate a high-level response...
records.zh: 卜灵小姐我们明白你的担忧，但目前泰缇斯系统还没给出确切的分析结果，更何况卜灵小姐的占卜也并非每次都能……咳，我是说，现在我们还不能擅自调动高等级响应……

records.text: It's not that we don't trust you, Ms. Buling. It's just... last time, when you dreamed of a black cat dancing ritualistically, it turned out your Casket just had water in it.
records.zh: 我们不是不信你，问题是……你上次说梦见黑猫跳大神，结果是玄机匣进水。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_12_1
records.text: After Buling pinpoints the location, a strange mirage of a city suddenly materializes over the waters near the Black Shores Archipelago.
records.zh: 在卜灵成功定位了坐标的具体位置之后，黑海岸群岛的近海，却凭空出现了一座海市蜃楼。

records.text: Welcome to Startorch Academy, Miss Kuchiba Chisa.
records.zh: 欢迎你加入星炬学院，朽叶千咲同学。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_29_1
records.text: You consider trying to split the mirage from the rift, but before you can act, a hand bursts from the rift and pulls you in. With Buling and Abby's cries fading behind you, you're dragged into the unknown Sonoro Sphere's turbulent depths.
records.zh: 就在你试图对裂隙进行「分离」时，从中突然伸出一只手，将你径直拉入其中。在卜灵和阿布的大喊中，你跌入陌生的风暴漩涡。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_7_3
records.text: A mysterious spatial rift appears, leading to an unknown Sonoro Sphere. Researchers from the Black Shores quickly assemble a makeshift observation platform nearby. You want to enter the rift, but Buling can't shake a sense of dread.
records.zh: 黑海岸各成员已搭建起观测平台，一个通往未知索诺拉的神秘裂隙出现在你们面前。你想前去一看究竟，卜灵却隐有不安的预感。

records.text: (The Spacetrek–Bjartr Bridge is close to the Bjartr Woods. If Outcasts have become bold enough to cause trouble there... something's not right.)
records.zh: （深光大桥离浮光林很近了，流民居然敢到那里闹事，不太对劲。）

records.text: (I should head to Spacetrek–Bjartr Bridge. I can't let the Outcasts stir up trouble in the Bjartr Woods.)
records.zh: （去深光大桥看看，可不能让流民去找浮光林的麻烦。）

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_埃弗拉德金库下层碎片化叙事_20_1
records.text:
This isolation zone was constructed after the completion of the Vault. Considering that certain research and specimens might pose security risks, the family built this isolation zone on the island to house these projects. The zone is divided as follows:

Underground Floor 1: Echo Experimentation Area
Underground Floor 2: Item Storage Area (Decommissioned)
Warning: Items in the isolation zone are extremely dangerous. Please do not enter without proper authorization.
records.zh:
该隔离区建于金库完工后。家族考虑到某些研究和藏品可能会对金库产生安全风险，因此在此岛屿建造了隔离区，用于安置这些项目。分区列表如下：
地下一层：声骸实验区
地下二层：藏品储存库（已废弃）
警告：隔离区中的藏品极度危险，请勿在未获得授权的情况下进入此地。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_1_埃弗拉德金库下层碎片化叙事_3_1
records.text: A landscape painting depicting the scenery of Ragunna City. Similar artworks can be found throughout the Averardo Vault.
records.zh: 一幅描述拉古那城内风光的风景画。类似的画作在埃弗拉德金库中随处可见。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_8_2
records.text: This is where Fenrico collaborated with the Fractsidus.
records.zh: 这里是芬莱克与残星会合作的地方。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_1_1
records.text: 漂泊者, I've been informed of what happened at the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
records.zh: 漂泊者，隐海试验场的事情我已经知道了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_10_1
records.text: Might be because Fenrico is keeping the cost of failure in check.
records.zh: 那或许是因为，芬莱克在控制失败的代价。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_11_1
records.text: Fenrico must have known about this earlier than we ever expected.
records.zh: 这件事芬莱克知道的时间应该比我们料想的还要早得多。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_16_1
records.text: (I wonder if Suisui would be interested in this...)
records.zh: （不知道穗穗会不会对这有兴趣……）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_16_1
records.text: This counts as one of Xuanfang's "local specialties," right? I was thinking, if we could make miniature replicas of them and turn them into little toy trinkets... they might sell pretty well in Yuezhou...
records.zh: 这也算玄方地界的“特产”吧？我在想，若是能复刻外形，制成玩具一类的小物件……放在越州卖的话，说不定会很有市场……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_19_1
records.text: So this is Xuanfang Hold's Autopuppet... Its structure is remarkably intricate...
records.zh: 这就是玄方城的机傀……构造真是精细……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_9_1
records.text: Turns out... back then, both sides of the family were at odds. They didn't want my parents together. My father was young and hot-blooded, and he loved my mother dearly, so he cut ties with his family and ran off with her. They wandered for a while before finally settling down in Yuezhou.
records.zh: 原来……当年我的爷爷与外公两家不和，他们不同意父亲母亲在一起，父亲年轻气盛，又很喜欢我母亲，于是他和家里断绝了关系，和我母亲出走，兜转了一些时日后，最后在越州定居了下来。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_9_1
records.text: So... I came to Xuanfang from Yuezhou all by myself, without telling my father... But when I went to the address my mother gave me, another family was already living there. I worked up the courage to ask a few people, but nobody knew who I was talking about...
records.zh: 所以……我就瞒着我父亲，一个人从越州来了玄方地界……可我按着母亲给的地址找去的时候，那里住的已经是别户人家，我也鼓足勇气问了几个人，但他们都说不认识我说的人……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_9_1
records.text: Here's the thing... My parents are both from Xuanfang. They moved away when they were young and went to Yuezhou to make a living... All my life, they never once talked about going back.
records.zh: 是这样的……我父母都是玄方地界人，他们年轻的时候就离开了玄方地界，去到越州讨生活……我从出生起，直到现在，父亲和母亲一次都没提过要回老家的事。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_11_1
records.text: I'm almost embarrassed to say it, but I studied architecture in Yuezhou, and I've seen my share of cities and gardens across Huanglong, many of them masterworks. But I've never come across mechanical structures as exquisite as these.
records.zh: 说来惭愧，我在越州学的也是建筑，瑝珑各地的城市、园林也见识过不少，其中不乏大师之作，但如此精湛的机关结构，我还从未见过。

records.text: You never know. I heard an octopus clam in the Riccioli Islands once successfully predicted the outcome of Septimont's Great Agon.
records.zh: 也不尽然，我听说黎乔利群岛的章鱼蛤，曾经预测过七丘角斗冠军赛的结果。

records.text: You know, I heard an octopus clam in the Riccioli Islands once successfully predicted the outcome of Septimont's Great Agon.
records.zh: 我听说黎乔利群岛的章鱼蛤，曾经预测过七丘角斗冠军赛的结果。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_历程手册_毕业旅行_3_1
records.text: As for the destination, she recommended the Dimmr Plains.
records.zh: 至于要去哪，洛瑟菈校长也向我推荐了一个地方——黯原。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_历程手册_毕业旅行_3_1
records.text: That's the gist. If you're up for the adventure, meet me at the Dimmr Plains entrance.
records.zh: 事情大概就是这样。如果你愿意同行的话，我们就在黯原的入口处汇合吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_历程手册_毕业旅行_4_1
records.text: But after the Dimmr Plains crisis, my desk is buried in paperwork. I can't spare a single second.
records.zh: 但是黯原的危机过后，我这边需要处理的事情实在太多了！根本抽不出身！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_支线_乘霄山灵异事件_15_1
records.text: Have you lost your mind? It's that Rover! Even Mr. Scar is no match for {Male=him;Female=her}!
records.zh: 你疯了吗？这家伙可是漂泊者！别说我们了，就算伤痕大人也不是{TA}的对手！

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_支线_乘霄山灵异事件_28_1
records.text: Yes, that's me. And you must be the Rover, the hero Madam Xinyi spoke of from Jinzhou and Hongzhen?
records.zh: 嗯嗯，没错。啊……难道你就是辛夷大人所说的漂泊者，那个拯救了今州和虹镇的英雄？

records.chapter: 剧情_1_1_支线_乘霄山灵异事件_5_1
records.text: Madam Xinyi…? So, she heard the rumor too? Not surprising, she always takes everything here seriously.
records.zh: 辛夷大人……？想不到这件事都传到她耳朵里了。不，也难怪。她一向对镇上的事无比关心。

records.text: Uncle Lianfeng, what do you think about continuing hunting those giant TDs? If you happen to get any rare materials, I'm still willing to buy them at a good price!
records.zh: 那不如继续去讨伐那些大型残象吧？获得稀有素材的话我这里可以继续高价回收哦！

records.text: Really? That's good news. Rover's much more reliable than Uncle Lianfeng.
records.zh: 真的吗？漂泊者的话肯定比炼风大叔靠谱多了吧！

records.text: Well, we're heading to the Gorges of Spirits to investigate a giant Tacet Discord found there.
records.zh: 是这样的，我们正准备前去云陵谷那里调查那里发现过的巨大残象……

records.text: Bell-Borne Geochelone lives in the Gorges of Spirits, which is the source of the Qing River flowing through here. I can sense the state of a TD through the remaining frequency in the medium.
records.zh: 鸣钟之龟的所在地是云陵谷，那里正是流经到此处的青河的发源地，我能够通过感知介质里的残留频率感知到残象的状态。

records.text: Plus, it seems that those from the Pioneer Association are planning to go to the Gorges of Spirits along the river.
records.zh: 而且还有一个原因，那些先行公约的人似乎也打算从这里沿着溪流出发，前去云陵谷……

records.text: Yes, that's the story. Later, someone found a rusted ancient bell in the Gorges of Spirits, similar in style to the bronze bell the ancient army used.
records.zh: 是的，故事里是这么说的，后来有人在云陵谷发现了一只锈蚀的古钟，而其制式与瑝珑的铜钟如出一辙。

records.text: This doesn't seem like Luuk Herssen's kind of movie... You reconsider.
records.zh: 似乎不是陆·赫斯会喜欢的电影类型呢……再想想吧。

records.text: Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Luuk Herssen would like... You invite Luuk.
records.zh: 看简介，也许是陆·赫斯会喜欢的电影类型……向陆·赫斯发出邀请吧。

records.text: New Federation students can't stand organ meat... Better swap it all for soft-boiled eggs...
records.zh: 新联邦的学生们不喜欢动物肝脏……都换成流心蛋吧……

records.text: You stroll through the campus with Luuk Herssen. Sharing this moment is a slice of warmth in your day...
records.zh: 你与陆·赫斯漫步在校园的街道上，一同度过了一段美好的时光……

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_44_1
records.text: Ah, Bjartr Woods... My colleagues and I came out here for inspiration once. I still remember the Roya's incredible hospitality.
records.zh: 啊，浮光林……我和同事为了取材来过这里，我对罗伊人那盛情的款待记忆犹新。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_36_1
records.text: It doesn't fit the whole Xuanfang Hold setting.
records.zh: 它和玄方城不太协调。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_37_1
records.text: There's this widespread urban legend in Ashinohara... Says that in the dead of night, swordsmen wielding vegetables duel it out in the streets.
records.zh: 以前有一个在苇原流传很广的都市传说……据说在午夜，会有使用蔬菜作为武器的剑客在街头决斗。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_37_1
records.text: But according to Ashinohara's urban legend, those white radishes can cleave a phone booth clean in half with a single swing.
records.zh: 可在苇原的传说里，那些白萝卜可是能一刀把电话亭切成两半的！

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_37_1
records.text: They tell a similar tale over in the New Federation. Except there, it's cowboys dueling with fish.
records.zh: 在新联邦也有类似的传言，不过内容变成了用鱼进行决斗的牛仔。

records.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_17_1
records.text: Before that Sonoro Sphere's frequency faded out completely, a courier named Lumi came to us, hoping we'd work it into the Second Coming of Solaris.
records.zh: 在那个索诺拉的频率消散之前，一位叫灯灯的快递员找到我们，希望能够在《第二索拉》中复现这里。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_天工部生态事件_9_1
records.text: Blimey, where'd you spring from?! You scared the life out of me!
records.zh: 呜啊？！你从哪里冒出来的，吓死我了……

records.chapter: 剧情_V2.1航海活动支线_岛上的面具人_1_2
records.text: Haven't the slightest clue. Doesn't seem to be from the Riccioli Islands the way she's dressed. Maybe the promise of adventure drew her from the city.
records.zh: 不认识，她的打扮不像黎乔利群岛上的人，或许是来探险的城里人吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_V2.1航海活动支线_岛上的面具人_1_2
records.text: Doesn't seem to be from the Riccioli Islands the way she's dressed. Maybe the promise of adventure drew her from the city.
records.zh: 她的打扮不像是黎乔利群岛上的人，或许是来探险的城里人吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_V2.1航海活动支线_岛上的面具人_5_1
records.text: I-I was thinking... What about this one? You can only find it around the Riccioli Islands. It's extremely rare.
records.zh: 我…我觉得……这种鱼怎么样？它只在黎乔利群岛出现，很珍贵。

records.chapter: 剧情_支线_营地补给失窃案件_1_7
records.text: There are reasons like pants torn by the fangs of a Sabyr Boar or a hat stolen by the Hoochiefs in the Dim Forest...
records.zh: 诸如，执行任务时被碎獠猪的獠牙勾破了裤子、无光之森的戏猿偷走了帽子......

records.text: According to those coordinates, I can say with confidence that this Stingray is the same ship that we salvaged near the harbor of the Whining Aix's Mire a few years prior.
records.zh: 根据那些坐标信息，我可以确定这艘魔鬼鱼号，就是数年前我们在怨鸟泽地区港口附近打捞到的一艘沉船。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_支线_定玄之外·其二_12_1
records.text: There you are, Liangyu! I could use a quick favor.
records.zh: 原来你在这儿啊！椋羽，我正有事要找你呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_支线_定玄之外·其二_12_1
records.text: Liangyu! 漂泊者! Dinner's ready! Hurry, come eat!
records.zh: 椋羽姐，漂泊者{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}！饭好啦，你们快来吃饭！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_支线_定玄之外·其二_3_1
records.text: You need people for the rebuild? Count me in, Liangyu! I want to help, too!
records.zh: 重建缺人？椋羽姐！我也要去帮忙！

records.text: (Just as I thought. Xuanqing is Hsin's Resonator.)
records.zh: （果然，璇情就是心月狐的共鸣者。）

records.text:
This good and pious girl vows three days without meat, if only Yuecheng will try the chili rice cake! —Xuanqing
Then what was that Fish in Vinegar you came by for two nights ago? —Yuecheng
records.zh:
善女愿三日不吃肉，换樾成哥尝试剁椒粘糕！——璇情
那你前晚来买的醋鲙算什么？——樾成

records.text: Coming from the Sentinel of Mengzhou, that's so petty!
records.zh: 明明贵为梦州岁主呢，小心眼！

records.text: Excuse me, miss! Are you here to play with Sister Xuanqing too?
records.zh: 大姐姐，你也是来找璇情姐姐玩的么？

records.text: According to the Sentinel's projections for the continuity of civilization, leaving Norfall Barrens to its fate is the optimal course of action. Mengzhou's borderlands are to be abandoned for the greater good.
records.zh: 依岁主推演文明之序，北落野放任不治，方为至优；梦州边陲，则当弃之以全大局。

records.text: Tell me, Xuanqing. What do you think a single mortal body can accomplish against all of this?
records.zh: 璇情，你凭一介凡人之躯，又能做什么？

records.text: Hsin was talking about abandoning Mengzhou's borders… Was this before Xuanfang Hold was built?
records.zh: 心月狐说要放弃梦州边界……这是，在玄方城建立之前的事？

records.text: (So "I" am that strand of frequency Hsin gave Xuanqing in this memory.)
records.zh: （在这回的记忆中，“我”是由心月狐交给璇情的那段频率吗。）

records.text: As for Xuanqing... I will bring her back myself.
records.zh: 至于璇情……我自会领她回来。

records.text: That tail… it's just like Sister Xuanqing's… A-Are you Lady Hsin?!
records.zh: 和璇情姐姐一样的尾巴……你、你是心月狐大人吗？！

records.text: Thank goodness… Sister Xuanqing told me that if there's ever danger, I just need to follow Lady Hsin's shadow, and I'll be taken somewhere safe.
records.zh: 太好了……璇情姐姐说过，如果遇到危险，只要跟着心月狐大人的影子，就能被带到安全的地方。

records.text: Sister Xuanqing went off alone to the place with all the TDs. Everyone who comes back from there is hurt. I'm so scared for her…
records.zh: 璇情姐姐，她一个人去了残象最多的地方……从那里来的人都满身是伤，我好害怕……

records.text: The one you all look to for guidance... in Xuanfang Hold?
records.zh: 玄方城……最高决策者？

records.text: (The leader of Xuanfang Hold should be Hsin, yet these people believe it's Xuanqing.)
records.zh: （玄方城的最高决策者应该是「心」，这里的人却认为是璇情。）

records.text: Lady Xuanqing, a letter has come from Mengzhou. From Lady Hsin.
records.zh: 璇情大人，梦州城有心月狐大人传给您的信。

records.text: Waaah! I'm sorry, I shouldn't have, Sister Xuanqing—
records.zh: 呜、呜啊！我错了，我错了璇情姐姐——

records.text: (Building Xuanfang Hold was a decision Hsin made during the meeting with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. It had nothing to do with Xuanqing.)
records.zh: （修建玄方城，应该是心月狐在与谛天鉴的会议上所决定，与璇情无关。）

records.text: You're right, Abby. In this reality, Hsin wasn't hurt in the meeting with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, and Xuanqing took over the Civilization Capsule instead to assume command over Xuanfang Hold. She even started building Cloud Shuttles.
records.zh: 阿布说得没错。心月狐没有在与谛天鉴的会议中受伤，接管文明之匣的人变成了璇情，此后都由她来管理玄方城，甚至建造了云梭。

records.text: (It looks like, following the previous memory, Hsin took back the frequency She gave Xuanqing.)
records.zh: （看来上一段记忆后，心月狐交给璇情的那段频率，由祂本人接管了。）

records.text: After the Tacet Discord Outbreak, that girl Xuanqing went to the front lines all by herself. I wanted to do something to help, so I followed her here to care for the wounded.
records.zh: 残象潮爆发后，璇情那孩子一人去了前线。我也想帮她做些什么，就跟着来到这里，照顾受伤的人。

records.text: As Sentinel, I am responsible for every citizen of Mengzhou... including you.
records.zh: 我身为岁主，当为梦州每一人负责，其中……也包括你。

records.text: In the end, the Sentinel took Xuanqing gently by her hand.
records.zh: 最终，祂轻轻握住璇情的手。

records.text: Where's that girl Xuanqing...? I don't see her anywhere...
records.zh: 怎么没看到璇情那孩子呢……

records.text: But… I suppose that's exactly what makes It the kindest Sentinel of Mengzhou.
records.zh: 但是……也正因为如此，祂才是梦州最温柔的岁主大人啊。

records.text: Just like when I was still living in Mengzhou, it was a wonderful, joyful journey.
records.zh: 就像我还生活在梦州时那样——是一趟快乐又尽兴的旅途呢！

records.text: Now, as Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox of Mengzhou, I, Xuanqing—
records.zh: 那么，梦州岁主心月狐的共鸣者，璇情——

records.text: With this, Mengzhou's border will finally be safe…
records.zh: 这下，梦州边境就安全了……

records.text: Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox... Xuanqing.
records.zh: 心月狐的岁主共鸣者……璇情。

records.text: How about you try again? I want to hear you say "Sister Xuanqing"—
records.zh: 比如，听你喊我一声“璇情姐姐”——

records.text: I smell Xuanqing's frequency all over this thing! Has to be one of those Feeling Capsule pieces she was talking about.
records.zh: 这个东西的频率有璇情的味道！这应该就是她说的，那个「情匣」的碎片之一吧。

records.text: Mmm, that's definitely Xuanqing's scent! One of the Feeling Capsule's pieces, for sure.
records.zh: 唔，是璇情的味道！这一定就是她说的「情匣」的碎片之一。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_10_1
records.text: Hsin. Suoming and I are at the Simulacrum Nexus.
records.zh: 心，我和锁暝在「梦枢天罗」了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_13_1
records.text: I've never seen a house like this in Huating. We'd better ask the boss next time. She'll know for sure.
records.zh: 在华亭可没见过这种房子，下次问问老大吧，她肯定知道。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_14_1
records.text: Sixth, before the Evil Miasma, Huating hardly saw any rain. Buildings like this are only found in the rainy regions of Mengzhou.
records.zh: 六，「恶瘴」来临前华亭雨少，这是梦州雨多地区才有的房子。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_15_1
records.text: Still, a structure this grand... brings to mind an old story from Huating.
records.zh: 不过，如此宏伟的……倒是让我想起一件华亭的旧事了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_15_1
records.text: A small matter. Back then, there was no place in Huating more extravagant than the estate of that ruthless ruler.
records.zh: 小事而已，当年华亭就数那黑心主簿的宅邸最奢靡。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_19_1
records.text: Oh, Seal Master, we swore to protect Huating from such fate, did we not?
records.zh: 契主，你我约定华亭不会有这样的未来，对吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_20_1
records.text: Huating's mountains and rivers are clearer and more serene than they were ever before...
records.zh: 华亭已是山清水秀……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_21_1
records.text: The Seventh Seal was very forthright. As part of Huating's Ministry of War, even with a ruler as vile as sin, he couldn't bring himself to defy orders.
records.zh: 七契性子太直，身为华亭军策府的一员，即便主簿恶贯满盈，他难以违抗军令。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_30_1
records.text: Mm, there are wreckages of fallen Cloud Shuttles there. Also... I met Xuanqing there. I suppose you know her?
records.zh: 嗯，有些云梭坠落在那，而且……我还见到了璇情，你应该知道她是谁吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_34_1
records.text: It really is... Aren't you going to introduce those two to me, Suoming?
records.zh: 是啊……锁暝，你不和我说说这两人吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_41_1
records.text: I know the weight of my responsibility. I know they laid down their lives for the real Huating—the home we left behind.
records.zh: 可我知晓肩负的责任，也清楚他们的死是为了在这之外，那真实存在的故乡华亭。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_41_1
records.text: We made a promise. The path of righteousness we vowed to walk from Huating still stretches ahead, and I cannot stop halfway.
records.zh: 我和他们约好了，从华亭起步的正道，还未走到尽头，我不会停在途中的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_41_1
records.text: If only Sister Suoming and the others were here with me.
records.zh: 要是锁暝姐姐和大家都在就好了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_43_1
records.text: How come the others aren't here with you, Sister Suoming?
records.zh: 锁暝姐姐和其他人怎么还没来？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_43_1
records.text: I met with the Sixth Seal, as well. She was always far more eloquent than I was. Without her, we never would have gained support from Huating's people.
records.zh: 六契也见上面了，她远比我能言善道，最终华亭百姓能支持我，她功不可没。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_43_1
records.text: The Seventh Seal still wears that same worried look. None of us loved Huating more than he did.
records.zh: 七契到现在也还是忧心忡忡的模样，要论对华亭的情感，他比我们都深。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_46_1
records.text: The task's done, Hsin. I believe Suoming is pretty satisfied.
records.zh: 心，结束了，我想锁暝很是满意。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_56_1
records.text: I don't know what hole you fiends crawled out of, but don't you dare set foot in Huating!
records.zh: 你们是何处来的邪魔怪道，别想进入华亭！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_65_1
records.text: Oh, you mean Intendant Suoming's friend? Zeqi mentioned her.
records.zh: 噢，你是说锁暝州监的朋友吧？我听则祁提过。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_58_1
records.text: The Evil Miasma confined all life within Huating, just as those towering mansion walls that locked me away from the world...
records.zh: 「恶瘴」困众生于华亭，我困身于高墙深院……

records.text: Relax, I didn't break out of jail. Some acolyte named Phoebe came for us and made the Chamber of Discipline gave us a fair trial.
records.zh: 放心，我不是逃出来的囚犯。在一位名叫菲比的教士的干预下，诫令院对我们进行了公正的审判。

records.text: This place has things you don't find in the city. The shabby feeling of industrialism. Like those you see in movies from the New Federation.
records.zh: 这里可有着城里见不到的那种……破败的工业感，简直就像是新联邦的电影里那样。

records.chapter: 剧情_后空翻挑战·狮童的修业_1_1
records.text: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Xiuyi, a Liondancer at Liondance Troupe! I'm a peer of Lingyang.
records.zh: 忘记自我介绍了。在下修义，是瑞狮团的狮童！论辈分的话，我算是凌阳的师弟！

records.chapter: 剧情_后空翻挑战·狮童的修业_1_1
records.text: Most of the time we practice it on Plum Blossom Poles at Central Plains. While I was in Jinzhou and the space was limited, I set up a temporary platform for the practice. It attracted a great audience to my surprise.
records.zh: 平日大家都是在中曲台地的梅花桩上练习步法。今州城内场地有限，我就搭了个临时的台子热热身，没想到吸引了这么多围观的票友。

records.text: …Hah, I like your spirit. No wonder Aalto says you're a funny person.
records.zh: ……呵，还挺活泼。怪不得秋水也说你是个很有趣的人。

records.text: After the Battle of Norfall Barrens, Tethys issued a new warning based on the data from the battlefield Resonance Beacons and those you provided Aalto and Encore.
records.zh: 北落野大战后，泰缇斯系统根据战场信标传来的数据，综合大战前你帮助秋水和安可收集的数据，发布了一项新预警。

records.text: Although you managed to halt the Ovathrax's hatching, its residual frequencies are still spreading from Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 尽管无相燹主的孵化已经被你阻止，但它残留的频率，正在以北落野为圆心不断扩散。

records.text: It's been a while. You came here as a rookie, and now you're Jinzhou's hero. Looks like the battle at Norfall Barrens really honed your skills.
records.zh: 一段时间没见，训练场的新人已经成为了今州的英雄。看来之前北落野的大战，愈加磨砺了你的战技。

records.text: Valentina and the Black Shores team picked up the latest TD samples from Huaxu Academy just as the warning came through.
records.zh: 预警发布后，瓦莲京娜带着黑海岸的人去了今州的华胥研究院，拿到了最新的残象样本。

records.text: You show Garris the "Bloodpact's Pledge" that you received from Cantarella.
records.zh: 你向加里斯展示了从坎特蕾拉那里得到的“血誓盟约”。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_2_4_1_1
records.text: I'm sorry, Ms. Cartethyia. Irises are not currently on the approved list. Once they bloom, I'll have to remove them.
records.zh: 很抱歉，卡提希娅小姐，鸢尾花未在条约目录内，在鸢尾花盛开后，库浇浇有权清理掉它们。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_2_4_1_1
records.text: Cartethyia nods and silently watches the soil where the seeds were sown.
records.zh: 卡提希娅点了点头，静静地看着地面上的种子。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_2_4_1_1
records.text: Rechecking... Apologies, Ms. Cartethyia. There was a data error. Irises are now listed in the Guidelines. Additional clause detected—
records.zh: 正在查询……抱歉，卡提希娅小姐，刚刚系统数据存在错误，鸢尾花已被录入条约中，条约附加内容——

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_2_4_1_1
records.text: Ms. Cartethyia, based on Black Shores climate data, irises take approximately 80 to 100 days to grow here.
records.zh: 卡提希娅小姐，根据黑海岸气候数据显示，鸢尾花在黑海岸的生长周期大约为80~100天。

records.chapter: 剧情_中曲台地流放者营地POI_2_1
records.text: Ugh, don't even get me started. I was originally tasked with providing assistance in building fortifications over at the Desorock Highland, but those Exiles intercepted me on the way.
records.zh: 别提了，真倒霉。我本来是要去荒石高地那边帮忙修筑防御工事的，路上突然就被这些流放者拦住了。

records.chapter: 剧情_中曲台地流放者营地POI_3_1
records.text: I have to get going, I've wasted too much time already. I wonder how progress have been over at the Desorock Highland.
records.zh: 我得继续赶路了，在这里耽误了这么多时间，也不知道荒石高地那边的工事修筑怎么样了。

records.text: Luuk Herssen looks down at the calico cat that is slowly playing with its own tail.
records.zh: 陆·赫斯低头看了眼三花猫，猫正慢吞吞地拍着自己的尾巴。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_2_7_3_1
records.text: Oh, Cartethyia! Hello there, my loyal patron!
records.zh: 咦？是卡提希娅！老熟客啾！

records.text: May our lives and our journey ahead be illuminated with blessings.
records.zh: 愿大家的生活与旅途永远有爱与光明垂耀。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_2_7_4_1
records.text: Let me think… Cartethyia loves Larus Salad… and Zani's favorite is pizza…
records.zh: 让我想想……卡提希娅喜欢青枝月桂沙拉……赞妮喜欢披萨……

records.text: I offered her support for the paperwork and arranged a medical leave plan with the New Federation, but she chose to stay.
records.zh: 虽然我愿意为她提供一些教学系统方面的支持，也为她沟通了新联邦方面的休学疗养计划。但她还是决定留在这里。

records.text: I'm here for Professor Lucilla's projector repair.
records.zh: 我替洛瑟菈教授来了解下放映机的维修情况。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线彩蛋_莫宁海底隧道共乘_1_2
records.text: I recall that the tunnel runs from Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. I'm near Bjartr Woods now. I could come help you if you need it.
records.zh: 我记得那条隧道是从浮光林通往坠剑湖的。我现在就在浮光林附近，如果前辈需要，马上就可以前往考察。

records.text: I need to be more vigilant to keep the people safe. That's what Chixia said!
records.zh: 我可得盯紧点，要保证居民朋友的安全，炽霞姐就是这么说的！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线彩蛋_你想度过怎样的一生_1_1
records.text: So I went to the New Federation. Then got transferred to the Spacetrek Collective. I was always alone. Threw myself completely into chasing the truth.
records.zh: 之后我一直在新联邦工作，又被调来深空联合。我一直都孤身一人。我将自己的全部精力和时间投入在追寻真理上。

records.text: Interested in contributing to Xuanfang Hold's revitalization?
records.zh: 您要为复兴玄方城出一份力吗？

records.text: I know the two of you grew up together, Fuling. But...
records.zh: 我知道你和他从小就认识，但是……

records.text: I know the two of you grew up together, Fuling. But look around! Where is he? Where is this caravan? Where is our money?!
records.zh: 我知道你和他从小就认识，浮绫。但他和他说的那支商队在哪呢？我们的钱又在哪？

records.text: (This should be the place where Fuling last saw Jianji.)
records.zh: （这应该就是浮绫最后见到简集的地方。）

records.text: What are Exiles from Jinzhou doing in Xuanfang Hold?
records.zh: 今州的流放者，怎么跑到玄方地界来了？

records.text: Your fate now rests with the authorities of Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 等待玄方城发落吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_V2.1航海活动支线_水手的遗藏_1_1
records.text: It's a fishermen's legend passed down for generations on this island. It speaks of Rinascita during the ancient Age of a Thousand Islands, when the Riccioli Islands were ruled by a sailor driven from his homeland.
records.zh: 这个岛上的渔民世代口耳相传，说在黎那汐塔古老的千岛之国时期，黎乔利群岛由一位流亡的水手掌控。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_2
records.text: Folks don't often find their way to Ostina. You bringing good news, I hope?
records.zh: 能来到我们奥第那小镇可不容易。难道，你带来了好消息？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_2
records.text: Yeah. Is Phrolova making any headway with her work? Are we getting back to the real world?
records.zh: 是不是弗洛洛的研究有新进展了？我们可以回到现实世界了吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_4
records.text: There's a fine line between surprise and jump scare.
records.zh: 小心惊喜变成惊吓。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_4
records.text: Oh, it's you. Phrolova is out performing, and we're discussing how to organize a party for her return.
records.zh: 哦！是你啊。弗洛洛不是出去演出了吗，我们在讨论在她回来的那天，该给她办一个什么样的回归派对。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_6
records.text: Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept this. I've also returned everything Phrolova's given me.
records.zh: 谢谢你的好意，但是这些你还是拿回去吧，之前弗洛洛送到我家里的那些，我也已经还给她了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_8
records.text: And look at Phrolova, only a few years older, and yet she's doing extra practice. She even plays me music she writes herself.
records.zh: 看看你们的弗洛洛学姐，她总是会超额完成练习，还会把自己的编曲给您听！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_8
records.text: Lost! That textbook belongs to Phrolova. I borrowed it from her for you so you could read her notes in the margins! Go find it!
records.zh: 丢……那可是我专门为你们向弗洛洛借的她当年的笔记，是很珍贵的学习记录，快去找回来！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_10
records.text: Phrolova and I were meant to go to the city... Maybe I'll send her to look for Triss when we get back. Triss will listen to her.
records.zh: 本来今天要和弗洛洛进城的，嗯……要不等我们回来，让她去叫特莉丝回家？她的话一定可以。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_14
records.text: Betty and I went to every clothing shop in all of the nearby cities just to pick out the right skirt for Phrolova to wear in her performance.
records.zh: 为了给她家弗洛洛买演出穿的裙子，贝蒂丝可算是把周围几座城里的服装店逛遍了。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_14
records.text: I thought Betty didn't want Phrolova to perform. The poor child was so upset she almost ran off from home.
records.zh: 她不是不同意弗洛洛去演出吗？气得那孩子差点离家出走。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_14
records.text: That's just something Phrolova said out of frustration. She's too stubborn and doesn't want to rely on anything, so she's always ill at ease.
records.zh: 她那也不过是气话罢了。弗洛洛太有主见，从不习惯依赖什么，她心里不好受。

records.text: Once, I saw a few tourists from the New Federation in Ragunna.
records.zh: 有一次，我在拉古那城中看到了几个来自新联邦的游客。

records.text: So this is the style of Mengzhou? It's nothing like Jinzhou...
records.zh: 这就是梦州的风格吗，和今州截然不同……

records.text: Phew… are all vases in Xuanfang Hold that dangerous?
records.zh: 呼……难道说玄方地界的花瓶都这么危险吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_世界_最后一次航行_支线任务_2_1
records.text: I've crossed Nimbus Sanctum, seen Lorelei dancing among the stars, and ventured to forbidden lands, through reefs sharp as daggers.
records.zh: 我曾经驾船横越云海，见过罗蕾莱潜藏在星与云之间的身影。也曾去过无人敢于踏足的禁忌之地，穿越尖牙般交错的礁石。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_世界_最后一次航行_支线任务_4_1
records.text: Let me see... Ah, yes. There's a flying TD in Penitent's End called Fae Ignis.
records.zh: 让我想想……啊，对了，年轻人。我记得墓岛附近有一种会飞行的残象，叫幽翎火。

records.text: How was that? Does my performance resemble what Roccia Cube taught me?
records.zh: 怎么样，这段洛可可团子教的表演我学得还像吗？

records.text: We were right to push for a deep investigation at the Starblind Crashsite. The readings are faint, but there's definitely some new satellite debris down here!
records.zh: 深入调查盲望之塌是正确的。虽然信号很微弱，但这里果然有还没被发现的卫星残骸！

records.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节_与相里要约会_1_1
records.text: As the caretaker of Moontree Lodge, and as Xiangli Yao...
records.zh: 无论是出于继承月树屋的使命，还是我个人的意愿……

records.text: Solvein Heartwood from the Dimmr Plains? I've seen pictures of it before. Wait, I think I... I'm starting to remember.
records.zh: 黯原的日脉源木？我之前看过它的照片！等等，我好像……有点想起来了。

records.text: Now I remember. You're workers at the Tiger's Maw Mine.
records.zh: 我想起来了，你们是虎口矿场的工人。

records.text: By pure coincidence, they mistook those siblings from the Tiger's Maw for me and kidnapped them under the cover of night.
records.zh: 机缘巧合之下，他们将来自今州虎口矿场的兄妹误认为是我，趁夜晚将他们绑架。

records.text: I'm trying to get Miss Chixia to... Wait a second?
records.zh: 我正在和这位炽霞小姐……等等？

records.text: (It reminds me of the Sentinel statue in the Gorges of Spirits and the workers at the Tiger's Maw Mine. I saw them use similar abilities to cut stone.)
records.zh: （我在云陵谷的岁主雕像，还有今州的虎口矿场那里见到过工匠们用类似的能力来切割石块。）

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_摩托赛场生态_2_7
records.text: Hey, aren't you helping out in Professor Mornye's research group?
records.zh: 诶，你不是在莫宁教授的课题组那边打下手吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_摩托赛场生态_2_7
records.text: Oh, that's done. Professor Mornye gave me some time off.
records.zh: 哦那边工作已经结束了，莫宁教授给我放了个假。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_摩托赛场生态_2_8
records.text: Oh, that’s done. Professor Mornye gave me some time off.
records.zh: 哦那边工作已经结束了，莫宁教授给我放了个假。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_摩托赛场生态_2_10
records.text: Oh, oh, it's Sigrika! Tiny, but seriously capable!
records.zh: 哦哦哦，是西格莉卡嘛，个子小小的真能干啊！

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_摩托赛场生态_1_8
records.text: Rumor has it the fan club challenged President Lucilla to a marathon showdown in Peaks of Prestige to win the event budget!
records.zh: 我听小道消息说啊，是同好会的一帮人跟洛瑟菈校长约定车轮战打荣耀之丘来拿活动经费！

records.chapter: 剧情_玩法_修理生态监测装置_1_1
records.text: Oh, this is Patroller Xinyi. She's assisting me in identifying the issue.
records.zh: 这位是心宜巡尉，正在帮我想办法解决问题。

records.chapter: 剧情_玩法_修理生态监测装置_1_2
records.text: The monitoring points in the Dim Forest are gradually starting to activate.
records.zh: 无光之森里的各个监测点装置都在陆续开始启用。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_历程记忆手册_星原定格_3_9
records.text: "Heal your spirit in Bjartr Woods—even your fear of the Voidworm!" Perfect, this would make a great caption.
records.zh: “来浮光林进行一次心灵疗愈吧，连直面虚诞虫的恐惧都能治愈！”——很完美，标题就用这个吧。

records.text: The Fox is one of the Sentinels in Huanglong. People often call it "Hsin."
records.zh: 心狐，指的就是心月狐了，瑝珑人大多称之为“心”。

records.text: Like our Sentinel "Jué," Hsin has its own state to protect.
records.zh: 和今州的“角”一样，都是一方岁主。

records.text: But Hsin loves to join in the celebrations with its people.
records.zh: 据说“心”是一位非常喜好热闹、也非常好动的岁主，也喜爱与民同乐，频频混迹在热闹处。

records.text: It's said that if you hear the leaves rustling, it must be Hsin wandering in the woods. Sometimes, it even leaves behind small, whimsical gifts, like this lottery wheel here.
records.zh: 传闻中，当枝叶传来簌簌声时，就是“心”穿行于林间之时。有时候，祂还会在林中留下一些无关紧要、但是惹人高兴的小东西。

records.text: Fighting crime is everyone's duty in Huanglong.
records.zh: 支持打击犯罪可是瑝珑人的义务。

records.text: As you unfold the fan, the Taoyuan Vale reveals itself. Painted from a nearby mountain, the village glows under a dark night sky lit with vibrant fireworks.
records.zh: 你打开折扇，扇面画着从远处的山坡上遥望桃源乡的景象。在灯火辉煌的村庄上方，五彩斑斓的烟花装点着夜空。

records.text: You can see the effort Zhezhi put into this painting.
records.zh: 你看得出来，这幅画显然是花了一番心思。为了采风，折枝大概又去了很远的地方吧。

records.text: Mr. Yuanwu, could you teach me some tricks for walking on these Plum Blossom Poles?
records.zh: 渊武叔，这梅花桩有什么诀窍吗？

records.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name's Danjin. I'm currently visiting all the different regions of Huanglong.
records.zh: 啊，差点忘记自我介绍了……我叫丹瑾，目前正在瑝珑四处游历。

records.text: Memories of the time you sent off Loong Lanterns with Jinhsi and the conversations you shared seem like yesterday.
records.zh: 与今汐一同许愿谈心的时光似乎并未远去。

records.text: —Orders from the Ministry of War. All units are to assemble at once and deploy to the Central Plains to hold the line. No delays.
records.zh: ——军策府有令，我部即刻整装，前往中曲台地布防，不得延误。

records.text: So this was one of the units sent to the Fortress and Gorges War. They say not a single soldier who held the Central Plains ever came home.
records.zh: 这应该是云渊之役的其中一支部队吧。我听说，在中曲台地坚守的士兵们都没能撤回来。

records.text: That's right. Odd thing for me to say, I know... Here in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, we Court of Savantae Artisans usually handle maintenance and repair work.
records.zh: 正是如此。也许这么说有点奇怪，毕竟在「梦枢天罗」之中，一切维护与修缮工作都由我等稷廷工匠完成。

records.text: ...For what it's worth, when the war broke out in the Central Plains, the Sentinel was evacuating the people of Yuan Fortress.
records.zh: ……据我所知，在中曲台地陷入激战时，岁主正在忙于疏散渊城的民众。

records.text: It's a long story. I was leading the Xuanfang Wardens, holding a defense line around the Central Plains.
records.zh: 说来话长。我当时率领定玄卫，在中曲台地附近布防。

records.text: You'll find all three ingredients in the Dim Forest.
records.zh: 这些都能在无光之森找到。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_下半后日谈阳光季节_1_5
records.text: I'm not talking about physical exhaustion, Sigrika.
records.zh: 我说的不是身体上的疲惫，西格莉卡。

records.text: When did the saboteurs' organization infiltrate Xuanfang Hold?
records.zh: 破坏者所属的组织是什么时候潜入玄方城的？

records.text: Miss Liangyu of the Xuan Triad mentioned that she granted you access to use the Skywatch Rings to interface with the Mingshen System.
records.zh: 我听后玄三骑之中的椋羽小姐说，她已经为你开放了调用巡霄环，以及访问「明慎台」的权限。

records.text: Miss Liangyu should've already granted you emergency access to the Mingshen System. I will formally authorize your credentials shortly.
