records.zh: 椋羽小姐应该已经为你开放了「明慎台」的紧急访问权限，我之后会为你进行正式授权。

records.text: ...Wootters? Are you sure that's from Huanglong?
records.zh: 呜獭獭……？你确定这是瑝珑的俗话？

records.text: Ah, the sheer magnificence of the Starward Riseway...
records.zh: 啊，联运椎骨……如此宏伟……

records.text: Ah, the sheer magnificence of the Starward Riseway… I never get tired of this view.
records.zh: 啊，联运椎骨……不管看多少次，它都真是壮观呢……你说是吧，同学？

records.text: I dream of the day I can create something as monumental as the Starward Riseway… at least in size.
records.zh: 唉，希望有朝一日，我也能搞出来一个能够和联运椎骨相媲美的研究成果……至少要像它一样巨大才行。

records.text: It's ridiculous. Really, the final stop should be right outside the dorm block… or maybe in Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 这有点太不合理了。要我说，列车的终点站应该直接放在宿舍门口……或者浮光林？

records.text: Well, if humanity is smart enough to build the Starward Riseway and the Startorch Express, surely we can pull this off too.
records.zh: 联运椎骨也好，星炬列车也好，还不都是人类智慧的结晶嘛。

records.text: The textbook says the Starward Riseway was built based on the Exostrider's greatsword.
records.zh: 课本上说，联运椎骨是以隧者的巨剑为基础建造的。

records.text: Oh, come on, that was ages ago. Back during the Starward Riseway's Phase One trials, right?
records.zh: 那都是多少年前的老黄历了？我记得是联运椎骨一期试运行的时候吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节_与折枝约会_1_1
records.text: I borrowed Uncle Li's stove. Come on, give it a try.
records.zh: 借了一下黎叔的炉子，来尝尝吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节_与折枝约会_1_1
records.text: It's sooo delicious! It's almost as good as Uncle Li's... No, it tastes even better with those extra seasonings.
records.zh: 好好吃——简直和黎叔做的没什么两样了……不，似乎还多加了几样佐料，味道更好了。

records.text: 漂泊者, 漂泊者! From the look of your clothes, are you from beyond Mengzhou?
records.zh: 漂泊者漂泊者，看你的衣裳，你是从梦州之外的地方来的吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_没能忘记你的眼睛_6_1
records.text: She was Roya. She was always going to stay in Lahai-Roi. I planned to go back to the New Federation after graduation.
records.zh: 她是罗伊族人，以后要留在拉海洛，而我准备毕业后返回新联邦。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线彩蛋_日灵8bit音乐_3_1
records.text: Since it will be a Royan composition, naturally, I'll have to return to the Bjartr Woods for inspiration.
records.zh: 既然是罗伊族的音乐，当然要回浮光林附近找找灵感。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线彩蛋_日灵8bit音乐_3_1
records.text: Anyway, we need to get our ideas down first. Meet me just outside of the Bjartr Woods!
records.zh: 总之，先开启企划最重要，我们去浮光林门口集合吧！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线彩蛋_日灵8bit音乐_4_1
records.text: That's a great answer! Since we're at the Bjartr Woods and basking in the light of the Reactor Drive...
records.zh: 这些都是很好的元素！如今我们已经来到了浮光林，并沐浴在了炉芯光辉的照耀下……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_好流民营地_18_1
records.text: Professor Zakarias, you were once accepted by the Solsworn, and they even invited you to return to Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 扎卡里老师，你曾经被昭日者接纳，邀请你回到浮光林。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_好流民营地_19_1
records.text: I understand now, Professor Zakarias. I know what I need to do. But I still wish to know... Why have you not returned to Bjartr Woods?
records.zh: 我明白了，扎卡里老师，我知道我该做什么了，那我还是想问，为什么你不回浮光林呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_好流民营地_19_1
records.text: I-I admit, what I really wanted to know is what I should do to justify my return to Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 我……我承认，我想问如何才能名正言顺地回到浮光林。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_好流民营地_9_1
records.text: How about going to Bjartr Woods for help? They won't turn us down.
records.zh: 去浮光林求助如何？他们不会拒绝的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_好流民营地_10_1
records.text: How about going to Bjartr Woods for help? They won't turn us down.
records.zh: 还是去浮光林求助吧？他们不会拒绝的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_好流民营地_10_1
records.text: This isn't the time to be acting tough. We're going to Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 不是逞强的时候了，去浮光林吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_12_1
records.text: I have to credit Watcher Liangyu for that. She made the training much more effective for me.
records.zh: 先前受椋羽骑使指点，事半功倍呀！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_14_1
records.text: Listen to me first. Decades ago, during a patrol in the Eastern Xuan Peaks, I stumbled into that Pagoda. The structure was constantly shifting, with its paths ever twisting.
records.zh: 先听我说，数十年前我随队巡逻东岳时曾误入雾隐阁，阁中变化不断，通路错综复杂。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_16_1
records.text: Yes! I mean—no offense—but is it true you fought in the Norfall Barrens alongside General Jiyan?
records.zh: 啊，是的！呃，敢问阁下是否曾与忌炎将军并肩奋战于北落野？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_25_1
records.text: But I've rambled enough about my home in Chongzhou. You're a native of Mengzhou, aren't you? Why don't you tell me more about yourself?
records.zh: 不过我老家重州的事已经说过太多，倒是没怎么聊过你的，你是梦州本地人吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_25_1
records.text: That's true. I'm from a small town called Huating. We don't have fancy specialties, but we do have a story that we talk about a lot.
records.zh: 对，我的故乡是名为华亭的小城，没什么特别的物产，倒有个故事为人津津乐道。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_25_1
records.text: Legend has it that nearly two centuries ago, a malevolent fog smothered Huating, bringing nothing but ruin and despair to the people.
records.zh: 相传两百年前，曾有奇异‘恶瘴’侵袭华亭城，百姓受其苦难，民生凋敝。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_25_1
records.text: It's said that their leader is still walking among us today, and has a deep connection to Lady Hsin the Moon Fox...
records.zh: 据说那十人的首领仍存活于世，且与心月狐大人颇有关联……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_5_1
records.text: I see. You Wardens do treat people with sincerity. I'll take your advice.
records.zh: 好，诸位定玄卫果真诚义待人，既如此，我便依你之言。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_9_1
records.text: We've got trouble at the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks. And that Disorienting Fog over the Eastern Xuan Peaks... something's off about it, too.
records.zh: 西峰悬天构近期有异动，东岳隐息雾也有古怪……

records.text: Give me a heads up before you head out... I'll walk you to the Starward Riseway.
records.zh: 走之前记得跟我说一声，我送你到联运椎骨去。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_深空测界台生态_7_15
records.text: Seriously? He's just a bit cold when talking. He's not that scary.
records.zh: 至于吗？人家只是说话冷淡了点，哪有这么吓人。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_深空测界台生态_7_19
records.text: Is that what I think it is? I'm going to be transferred to Professor Mornye's team!?
records.zh: 我没看错吧，接下来要把我调到莫宁教授那去！？

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_深空测界台生态_7_31
records.text: Of course, I remember. It used to carry me around through Bjartr Woods when I was little.
records.zh: 我记得呀，小时候就是它驮着我在浮光林里跑呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_深空测界台生态_3_15
records.text: May there come a day when no such disaster will occur on the lands illuminated by the Reactor.
records.zh: 愿终有一天，炉光照耀的大地上，不会再有那样的灾难。

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_深空测界台生态_7_11
records.text: Phew—This card I draw... will put you in your place...
records.zh: 呼——等我抽到这张牌……你就老实了……

records.chapter: 剧情_联动学院相关生态_1_2
records.text: I'm not sure, that's up to Professor Mornye. If you want details, you should ask her.
records.zh: 我也不清楚。这是莫宁教授的安排，想要知道详细的情况你可以问她。

records.chapter: 剧情_联动学院相关生态_4_2
records.text: Right! I'm sure President Lucilla will get everything sorted!
records.zh: 嗯、嗯！我相信洛瑟菈校长会安排好的！

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_整流车站系列_1_23
records.text: Maji talks about you all the time! Says you're the real innovator at Lollo Logistics. I heard you not only refactored the logical mapping of key routes, but you're also driving our growth metrics!
records.zh: 我听马计前辈提过您很多次，说您是呜呜物流的真正推送，关键链路的底层逻辑全靠您复盘重组，业务也是您在拉高增长曲线！

records.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_整流车站系列_1_23
records.text: Maybe Maji could teach you more about innovation and less about the corporate jargon.
records.zh: 你还是学学马计的创意和拼劲，呜联网黑话这块就算了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_群声共振模拟域引导_1_1
records.text: It's been a while, Valentina. How are things at the Black Shores?
records.zh: 好久不见，瓦莲京娜。黑海岸最近如何？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_6_群声共振模拟域引导_1_1
records.text: I'm Valentina, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores.
records.zh: 我是黑海岸的执花，瓦莲京娜。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_一级POI_天文台主线任务_11_1
records.text: Sure. The view from the Spacetrek–Bjartr Bridge is beautiful, and it'll take us right back to the Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 好，走深光大桥看看风景吧，从那里也能回浮光林。

records.text: Ah, Shorekeeper. Are you also here to join us?
records.zh: 哦，是守岸人呀，你也是来加入我们的吗？

records.text: Camellya won't stop until she's had enough fun.
records.zh: 不尽兴的话，椿大概不会罢休了。

records.text: During the chaotic hide-and-seek, Shorekeeper Cube encounters Camellya Cube...
records.zh: 混乱的捉迷藏途中，守岸人团子和椿团子狭路相逢……

records.text: As long as I have the real {Male=him;Female=her}, I'm the real Camellya.
records.zh: 只要我拥有了真实的{TA}，那么我就是真实的。

records.text: Hehe... I can see you're starting to waver, Shorekeeper.
records.zh: 呵呵……守岸人，我看得出，你已经动摇了。

records.text: We don't follow your orders. Camellya is our chief!
records.zh: 我们才不听你指挥，椿才是我们的首领！

records.text: Roccia is too hungry and has gone into sleep mode. It's Pero talking now.
records.zh: 洛可可太饿了，已经进入待机状态啦，现在说话的是佩洛哦。

records.text: (I think this is Jinhsi's specialty dessert?)
records.zh: （这似乎是今汐擅长的点心？）

records.text: (I think this might be Changli's specialty food?)
records.zh: （这似乎是长离擅长的料理？）

records.text: (I think this is Shorekeeper's specialty food?)
records.zh: （这似乎是守岸人擅长的料理？）

records.text: (Did Roccia just eat a piece of the Anniversary Cake?)
records.zh: （洛可可刚刚吃的似乎是庆典蛋糕的一部分？）

records.text: Abbowser leaves in tears. Meanwhile, the frequencies of Roccia seem to have changed.
records.zh: 布大王哭唧唧地走掉了。另一边，洛可可身上的频率似乎发生了变化。

records.text: I never knew you had such an ambition, Phoebe.
records.zh: 没想到菲比你的志向这么高远。

records.text: Hehe, Primus Phoebe... Now, that sounds like a wonderful investment!
records.zh: 呵呵，主座菲比……说不定是笔不错的投资呢～

records.text: I trust this comes as no surprise. This is simply another commercial expansion. Mr. Calcharo, I presume? I'll sign a contract with you to replace the one you have with Abbowser. From now on, you work for the Montellis.
records.zh: 没什么好惊讶的，不过是普通的商业扩张罢了。卡卡罗先生对吗？我会代替布大王与你们续约，相应的我需要你们接下来为莫塔里工作。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_团团团团转2_7_1
records.text: You finally meet the legendary and super mighty Elite No. 1, who turns out to be none other than your old acquaintance, Calcharo. In the end, you strike a deal: he hands over the newly captured Brant, and you hire him to help settle his debt with Abbowser.
records.zh: 你们终于见到了传说中无比强大的干部一号，果然他也是你的熟人，卡卡罗。你和卡卡罗达成了一笔交易，他将新鲜逮捕的布兰特交给你们，而你需要雇佣卡卡罗，让他师出有名好找布大王算账。

records.text: Cantarella blows a cloud of smoke toward you.
records.zh: 坎特蕾拉吹出一阵烟雾。

records.text: Abbowser seems to be hypnotized by Cantarella.
records.zh: 布大王似乎被坎特蕾拉催眠了。

records.text: Encore, where is Aalto? Is he meddling with things again?!
records.zh: 安可，秋水呢？是不是他又到处乱按了！

records.text: Before you can respond, Cantarella releases another cloud of smoke.
records.zh: 你还想说些什么，但坎特蕾拉又向你撒出了一把烟雾。

records.text: The smoke from Lady Cantarella feels warm and gentle.
records.zh: 这位坎特蕾拉女士撒出的烟雾都很温柔呢。

records.text: Roccia! You and Pero must be the captains of the Cube Adventure Squad! I'm the vice-captain of the Wooly Adventure Squad. We should play together!
records.zh: 洛可可！你有佩洛，一定就是团子冒险小队的老大！我是羊咩冒险小队的副队长，我们可以一起玩！

records.text: Encore saw all the fun you were having and wants to join! So Encore sent Cosmos to take a look.
records.zh: 看你们玩得那么开心，安可也想来玩！所以，安可就让黑咩来看看！

records.text: Changli, have the burn marks on your left hand disappeared?
records.zh: 长离，你左手的灼伤好像不见了？

records.text: 漂泊者, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?
records.zh: 漂泊者，你知道散华、桃祈小姐还有忌炎将军现在何处吗？

records.text: It's OK to act ignorant once in a while, Changli.
records.zh: 这次就笨一点吧，长离。

records.text: When Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the Yin-Yang Balance state, replacing her Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell with Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony.
records.zh: 拥有【少阴】和【少阳】时，卜灵进入【阴阳相生】状态，共鸣解放·飞雷诀替换为共鸣解放·飞雷诀·归一。

records.text:
Qiuyuan can hold up to 600 points of Swordster's Soliloquy.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Basic Attack Stage 3.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing each stage of Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Dodge Counter.
- 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Intro Skill.
- Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be obtained during the Inksplash of Mind state.
- Swordster's Soliloquy is cleared when the Inksplash of Mind state ends.
records.zh:
【挑灯问剑】上限为600点。
·施放普攻第三段时，获得【挑灯问剑】100点。
·施放普攻答剑·质黑相青每段时，获得【挑灯问剑】100点。
·施放闪避反击时，获得【挑灯问剑】100点。
·施放变奏技能时，获得【挑灯问剑】400点。
·【淋漓醉墨】状态期间，无法获得【挑灯问剑】。
·【淋漓醉墨】状态结束时，清空【挑灯问剑】。

records.text: A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by an Intendant. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.
records.zh: 专司观测瑝珑各州岁主、天文和历法的特殊机构，设立于明庭的最高长官称之为“监正”。其余六州下属机构长官称之为“州监”。在岁主相关事务上享有独立的特殊权力，但只有对各州及明庭行政机构的建议和监察权。

records.text: A unique Resonance Ability of Qiuyuan. By perceiving the nature and differences of surrounding frequencies, he can discern an enemy's location and even state of mind. In extreme cases, this perception can be amplified through Sonoro Spheres, bringing to life the mental imagery of his enemies—or even his own.
records.zh: 仇远拥有的特殊共鸣能力。通过感知周围频率的性质和差异，勘破敌人的位置甚至心境。在极端情况下，这种感知可以藉由其他的索诺拉被进一步强化，将敌人或是仇远自己的心境外化为短暂存在的场景。

records.text: The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.
records.zh: 瑝珑都城，政治经济文化中心。

records.text: The Ministry of War is Huanglong's supreme military command, headquartered in Mingting with branches in all six cities. Its leader, the Minister of War, holds supreme command over all military affairs. Authority is delegated to a General in each city, who manages local forces. While Mingting usually appoints these Generals, local Sentinels have the authority to do so in certain special cities.
records.zh: 瑝珑最高军事行政机构，在明庭和六州均有设立，明庭军策府长官称之为“军策尚书”，统领六州军务。各州军策府长官称之为“镇将”，分辖州内军务。一般六州军策府镇将都由明庭任命，部分特殊的州郡则可能由岁主选出。

records.text: An amalgamated horror that often emerges alongside Void Storms. During lulls between Storms, it primarily inhabits the highly concentrated Voidmatter environment of the Mawburrow Desert. The Voidmatter Regulators on its head serve as both its power source and its weakness.
records.zh:
具有高危险性的构造实体，常伴随虚质磁暴一同出现。
在磁暴的非活跃期，主要活动于拉海洛腹地“隐喙深腹”的高浓度虚质环境中。其头部携带的虚质反应炉既是其能量核心所在，也是其关键弱点。

records.text:
A colossal vertical transport system built along the Exostrider's greatsword, connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands.
Its structure resembles a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it connects the deep cavern to the surface and serves as Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.
records.zh:
依托巨剑结构建造、连接拉海洛与罗伊冰原的大型升降运输系统。
其外观呈贯穿地空的脊柱形态，基于轨道推进加速技术实现高速运输，其联通地底与地表冰原，是拉海洛地区的核心交通枢纽。

records.text:
An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.
The Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked.
As the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture.
records.zh:
指七丘角斗士于桑古伊斯狩原地区，针对黑潮及其造物所展开的定向清剿行为。
由于桑古伊斯狩原地形特殊，回音能量常在此聚集，自黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发始，黑潮云即滞留在狩原上空终年不散。受此影响，狩原内黑潮造物活动频繁，黑潮侵蚀范围亦持续扩张。
而在与黑潮的持续对抗中，七丘人逐渐意识到将黑潮造物引导至靠近彻地之楔深根的区域再加以猎杀，可有效抑制黑潮蔓延。自此，“狩猎”逐步演变为一种制度化传统，并成为七丘文化的重要组成部分。

records.text: A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus.
records.zh: 坐落于桑古伊斯狩原下层区域的巨大楔形构筑物，与黎那汐塔岁主英白拉多一同自高天降临，受其所辖。黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发后，彻地之楔被激活，其力场有效限制了狩原上空的黑潮云，使之难以向七丘城区蔓延。受其牵制，衍自黑潮云的黑潮也多被封锁、抑制于狩原底层。

records.text: Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 位于七丘城近郊，为角斗士们横越狭渊、往返桑古伊斯狩原的“空行节点”。

records.text: The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.
records.zh: 位于桑古伊斯狩原的中上层区域，为七丘人世代狩猎黑潮及其造物的主要猎场。

records.text: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.
records.zh: 七丘主岛与桑古伊斯狩原之间的狭长海域。

records.text:
The ruins of a bygone civilization, said to be hidden deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Its entrance is located in the Wastelands. Long ago, it was visited by the three Heroes of Heroes from Septimont.
Legend has it that those who manage to set foot in Manes Deep can hear the whispers of the Heroes of Heroes and thereby gain powers rivaling their own. Some also hold that since the Heroes of Heroes walked this place, the journey to Manes Deep has become an inescapable trial for any who would claim that title.
records.zh:
相传藏于桑古伊斯狩原地下深处的前代文明遗迹，入口位于受蚀地区域，曾是七丘三位英雄王的造访之所。
传说进入玛涅斯之底者，能聆听到英雄王们的低语，并由此获得堪比英雄王的力量。亦有人称，正因历代英雄王皆踏足于此，玛涅斯之底即为英雄成王的必由之路。

records.text: A field nestled deep within Maroonwood. At an elevation approaching Earthrend Wedge and situated in the lower middle level of the Sanguis Plateaus, it serves as the primary battleground where Gladiators engage in deadly combat with the Dark Tide and its creatures.
records.zh: 赤林猎场深处的原野，因其所处位置在高度上接近彻地之楔根基，位于桑古伊斯狩原的中下层地带，故而为角斗士们与黑潮及其造物的死战之地。

records.text: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.
records.zh: 位于桑古伊斯狩原下层受蚀地的失落角斗士小镇。

records.text: The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.
records.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原下层受黑潮侵蚀地带的统称。该区域环境险恶，鲜有人迹。

records.text: A phenomenon unique to the surface of the Roya Frostlands. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian's power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable "existence," becoming impossible to observe directly.
records.zh: 一种在罗伊冰原上层出现的特殊现象。推测其形成原因为该区域的鸣式力量尝试吞噬隧者时，虚质发生了特殊变化，被其影响的事物将处于“存在”不稳定的无法观测的状态。

records.text: The soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens.
records.zh: 隶属于玄方地界的守城士兵被称为「定玄卫」。

records.text:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh:
位于玄方地界西侧，方擎西峰中的机关工厂。
「悬天构」由负责制造机傀的流水线工坊「千形坊」，以及专用于镇压、绞杀强大残象的「万囮牢」共同构成，它们昼夜运转不息，为玄方城提供源源不断的增援与助力。

records.text: Prior to the founding of Xuanfang Hold, Yuan Fortress, a mechanized fortress, was built through collaboration between Zhuojun Atelier and the Ministry of Development. It was designed to defend against the Tacet Discord Outbreak originating from the Norfall Barrens.
records.zh: 在玄方城修建前，「琢钧堂」与天工部曾合力建设了名为「渊城」的机关堡垒，用于抵抗北落野残象潮的入侵。

records.text:
A large-scale war that broke out simultaneously in the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress, aimed at preventing the spread of the Tacet Discord Outbreak from the Norfall Barrens into Huanglong via the Land of Xuanfang. 
Following this war, Jinzhou was formally established. 
Yuan Fortress was ultimately destroyed during the war, and Xuanfang Hold was later constructed upon its ruins.
records.zh:
为了阻止北落野的残象潮从玄方地界向瑝珑其他州域扩散，当年曾在云陵谷与渊城同时爆发了规模空前的战役。
经云陵谷一役，今州才终于建立了起来。
而在渊城战场，渊城被彻底摧毁，但在其废墟之上，玄方城得以建成。

records.text: The leader of the Séance Society, formerly a disciple under Yinlin's parents.
records.zh: 归魂互助会的首领，亦是吟霖父母曾经的弟子。

records.text: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.
records.zh: 猎犬即「幽灵猎犬」，是卡卡罗在新联邦所率领的一支佣兵团。

records.text: A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.
records.zh: 关押在景燃命灯中的回音生物，与景燃之间存在着特殊的契约。

records.text:
Verina can hold up to 4 stacks of Photosynthesis Energy.
Verina obtains 1 stack of Photosynthesis Energy for every Basic Attack 5 on hit.
Verina obtains 1 stack of Photosynthesis Energy after casting Resonance Skill Botany Experiment.
Verina obtains 1 stack of Photosynthesis Energy after casting Intro Skill Verdant Growth.
records.zh:
【光合能量】上限4层。
第5段普攻命中目标时，获得1层【光合能量】。
施放共鸣技能扩繁试验时，获得1层【光合能量】。
施放变奏技能蔓延时，获得1层【光合能量】。

records.text:
Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.
Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.
records.zh:
【灵韵】上限为90点。
常态攻击造成伤害可回复【灵韵】。
施放变奏技能可回复【灵韵】。

records.text:
Danjin can hold up to 120 Ruby Blossom.
Danjin obtains Ruby Blossom when using Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment.
records.zh:
【彤华】上限120点。
施放共鸣技能朱华残章时，回复【彤华】。

records.text: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her damage dealt is increased by 20%.
records.zh: 丹瑾攻击携带朱蚀之刻的目标时，造成的伤害提升20%。

records.text:
Jianxin can hold up to 120 Chi.
Chi is obtained when Normal Attack Fengyiquan hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skill Calming Air is cast.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skills Chi Counter or Chi Parry hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Intro Skill Essence of Tao hits the target.
records.zh:
【气】上限120点。
常态攻击风仪拳术命中目标时，获得【气】。
施放共鸣技能静气循行时，获得【气】。
共鸣技能行气反击或共鸣技能降气反击命中目标时，获得【气】。
变奏技能掌息之要命中目标时，获得【气】。

records.text:
Youhu obtains a random Antique after the Lucky Draw. With an Antique, her next Basic Attack will activate the corresponding Antique Appraisal.
Only one Antique can exist at a time, and the newly drawn Antique will replace the existing one.
records.zh:
进行问祯后，有概率获得不同的祯祥。
拥有祯祥的状态下，点击普攻时，根据祯祥进行对应的奇珍赏。
拥有祯祥的状态下获得新的祯祥，则会用新的祯祥替换掉旧的祯祥。

records.text:
With an Antique, Youhu's next Basic Attack will activate the corresponding Antique Appraisal.
Only one Antique can exist at a time, and the newly drawn Antique will replace the existing one.
records.zh:
拥有祯祥的状态下，点击普攻时，根据祯祥进行对应的奇珍赏。
拥有祯祥的状态下获得新的祯祥，则会用新的祯祥替换掉旧的祯祥。

records.text:
Ciaccona can hold up to 3 segments of Musical Essence.
Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 and Intro Skill recovers 1 segment of Musical Essence.
records.zh:
【音律】上限3格。
施放普攻第4段和变奏技能时，可获得1格【音律】。

records.text: Casting Resonance Liberation Rekindle sends Zani into Infernal Mode.
records.zh: 施放共鸣解放·重燃可进入灼焰形态。

records.text: The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
records.zh:
「悲鸣」是索拉里斯一切灾变态势的统称。
人们牢记一切产生变化的时间，那是从第一声悲鸣开始，而「悲鸣」从未结束。
浪潮不止，悲鸣永不停歇。

records.text: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue.
records.zh: 拉古那城中瞻仰岁主雕像的宗教建筑，包含上下两层，统称为“水星天教堂”。

records.text: A Montelli bank situated at the heart of the Ragunna City.
records.zh: 位于拉古那城中心区域的银行，由莫塔里家族运营。

records.text:
A troupe formed by exiles drifted to the Penitent's End on the Pilgrim's Sails for their supposed "transgressions."
To reveal the truth hidden by the Order, they wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.
records.zh:
以种种“罪行”被送上朝圣船的人们，漂流到悲叹墓岛后，自发组建的剧团。
为了揭露修会的罪恶，让更多世人知晓真相，愚人剧团撰写了诸多剧目，并“戴着镣铐起舞”，于列岛巡回演出。

records.text:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator"—Rover.
records.zh:
调律即调节频率，在索拉里斯，频率是事物的第一判断标准，对频率的调节，也即对事物本质的探究。
黑海岸通过对星图的调律，实现对悲鸣本质的溯源和解析。
在黑海岸历史上，只有过一个人被称之为「调律者」，那就是你。

records.text: A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.
records.zh: 渊武的独家拳术，拳风刚猛狠戾，但若想打得长久，又讲求收放自如。

records.text: Danjin's favorite dessert. It is considered a symbol of good luck and blessings because of its association with loong.
records.zh: 丹瑾最爱吃的甜点，因为与龙有关，被认为有吉祥祈福的寓意。

records.text: A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.
records.zh: 洛可可不离身的巨大手提箱，里面装着各式舞台道具、剧作手稿，同时也是佩洛的住所。

records.text: The Averardo Bank run by the Montellis in the Ragunna City.
records.zh: 即埃弗拉德银行，位于拉古那城内，由莫塔里家族运营。

records.text: A decade ago, the Carnevale was attacked by a giant sea creature and plagued by TD outbreaks. Primus Fenrico intervened to end the chaos, but the event left new wounds for Ragunna City, which was still recovering from the Second Dark Tide.
records.zh:
于十年前的狂欢节发生的残象袭击事件，据说巨大的海兽和残象潮袭击了拉古那。
事件最终在芬莱克主座的介入后平息，但对尚未在第二次黑潮后完全恢复的拉古那城造成了新的破坏。

records.text: The Sanguis Plateaus was once the Septimont frontline against the Dark Tide. Due to the region's unique landscape, Remnant energy gathers here in unusual density, along with a Blightcloud perpetually looming overhead, formed since the first Dark Tide. During High Tide seasons, Gladiators from across Septimont arrive here to hunt Dark Tide creations in the name of glory.
records.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原是七丘对抗黑潮的前沿阵地。由于地形特殊，狩原常年回音能量聚涌，自黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发以来，在异常地貌的加持下，狩原上空始终盘踞着一片无法散去的黑潮云。每逢黑潮涨潮期，无数七丘角斗士便聚集在此，狩猎黑潮造物，追逐荣誉。

records.text:
Ashinohara has long relied on the "miko system" to resist the Threnodian, with each miko organization assigned to a specific territory. The Miko of Flaming Sakura is unique, her responsibility spanning all of Ashinohara.
The Seal of Flaming Sakura is one of her line's secret arts, said to have been created by the very first Miko of Flaming Sakura . It is the only secret art passed down in written form. The seal draws power from the miko herself: the more power she channels into it, the longer it lasts.
The seal's form changes with its caster.
It is said that Hiyuki sealed away part of "her own future" within it—including, some say, a future that cannot be named.
records.zh:
苇原是依靠“巫女制度”与鸣式长久对抗的，各巫女所属的组织各有其负责的区块。而灼樱巫女，便是其中最特殊的一支——在职责划分上，整个苇原都在灼樱的守护范围内。
灼樱封印，便是灼樱流传下的秘法之一，据传是由首任灼樱巫女所创，也是灼樱唯一以典籍形式流传下来的秘法。它可以将灼樱巫女身上的部分力量剥离，形成封印，投入的力量越多，封印的效果也就越长久。
封印的形制受施术者影响，呈现出不同的样式。
据说，绯雪在其中封存了部分“自身的未来”——其中，甚至有一份不可言说的未来。

records.text: Portals in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou that lead to the Heart Realms. Each Inner Threshold requires a corresponding Realm Key to grant passage.
records.zh: 「梦枢天罗」中连接各处心域的通道入口，唯有携带对应的心域秘钥，方可通过心钥井，抵达各心域内部。

records.text: A group founded by Suoming to combat the Evil Miasma in her hometown of Huating. All of its members, save Suoming herself, have since fallen. Using her Resonance Ability, Suoming sealed the frequencies of her nine subordinates within her lock, continuing forward with their will.
records.zh: 锁暝为对抗家乡华亭的「恶瘴」成立的组织，除锁暝外其余成员均已牺牲。锁暝使用自身共鸣能力将手下一至九契的频率存入锁中，带着他们的意志继续前行。

records.text: One of the Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox's manifestations, capable of fulfilling certain duties in Its place in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
records.zh: 岁主心月狐的法相之一，可代替其履行部分管理「梦枢天罗」的职责。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔_万能帮手_26_2
records.text: Nimbus Sanctum... love... Gondola? Something's definitely missing here!
records.zh: 云海……爱人……贡多拉？这肯定缺了什么吧！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔_万能帮手_26_3
records.text: Nimbus Sanctum takes love on Gondola tours? This feels weird, doesn't it?
records.zh: 云海带爱人在游览贡多拉？怎么感觉怪怪的呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔_万能帮手_26_4
records.text: Gondolas love to take people on tours through Nimbus Sanctum. Ah, yes! It's from The Gondola Chronicles in Rinascita: Unofficial History!
records.zh: 贡多拉爱带人在云海游览。对了对了，这就是《黎那汐塔野史》的贡多拉小传了！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔_万能帮手_30_4
records.text: The Queen of the Night will sing to the dance of the Nimbus Wraith. It's from Journey to Nimbus Sanctum in Rinascita: Unofficial History!
records.zh: 夜之女皇会在云海妖精的舞蹈中歌唱，这就是《黎那汐塔野史》的云海游记了！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔_万能帮手_16_11
records.text: Journey to Nimbus Sanctum? Oh no, when did the pages scatter over there? Lifesaver, please, help me out!
records.zh: 《云海游记》！天呐，什么时候散在那了！大救星，求求你帮帮我呀！

records.text: I know you're scared of the High Tide. But it’ll help take some of the edge off once you're in a hunt yourself.
records.zh: 我知道你很害怕「涨潮期」，但你只要亲眼看一次行猎的过程，就不会再胡思乱想了。

records.text: Wait? Guidance? Not interested. The Sentinel is that big, scary, and powerful being, right? It deserves the respect, sure. But as for guidance...
records.zh: 等等，指引？没兴趣啊，岁主就是一个强得吓人的家伙吧，那的确值得尊敬，但要说指引……

records.text: Very good. I hope that in time you will become a Gladiator as renowned as Lupa. I trust you will do your best.
records.zh: 很好，我对你的期望是成为露帕选手那样名扬七丘的角斗士，好好努力吧。

records.text: Let me tell you something. My son's a Gladiator and his next match is about to begin. When you’re visiting Septimont, always make the Colosseum your first stop.
records.zh: 跟你说，我儿子也是一名角斗士，而且马上就要参加比赛了，你去游览七丘城的时候可要直奔大竞技场。

records.text: Accident solved. Luuk Herssen flattens his outfit with a tone so casual you'd think he was just passing by.
records.zh: 危机解决，陆·赫斯拍拍衣角，语气轻松自然得像是纯路过。

records.text: You shake your head to clear out the clutter and refocus your gaze on Luuk Herssen.
records.zh: 你晃了晃脑袋，把这些乱七八糟的思考暂且排除出去，再次盯向了陆·赫斯。

records.text: Luuk Herssen stays silent for two seconds before sighing in defeat and popping the candy into his mouth.
records.zh: 陆·赫斯沉默了两秒，终于叹了口气，认输般把糖放进了嘴里。

records.text: Zhezhi takes a deep breath, almost like gathering her courage.
records.zh: 折枝深吸一口气，像是在给自己打气。

records.text: It's been so long since you last heard Xiangli Yao's voice.
records.zh: 说话的正是许久不见的相里要。

records.text: After bidding farewell to Zhezhi, Qiuyuan, and Xiangli Yao, you resume your exploration with unsolved questions.
records.zh: 与折枝、仇远以及相里要告别后，你怀揣着满腹疑思，再次踏上旅途。

records.text: Ensuring the Gulpuff is held securely in both hands, Jiyan finally speaks.
records.zh: 在确认河豚已经被完全举稳之后，忌炎才开口。

records.text: You share the details of the strange candy and Xiangli Yao's theory with the three of them. Before you can even finish, you notice Jinhsi is a bit out of it.
records.zh: 你转述了那颗奇怪糖果的事，也将相里要的猜想告知了三人。然而话还没说完，你就注意到……今汐的反应，似乎慢了半拍。

records.text: Ciaccona twirls in a small circle, her skirt fluttering to the beat.
records.zh: 夏空抱着琴，转了个小圈，衣摆随着节拍扬起。

records.text: Quality guaranteed! Everyone in Xuanfang Hold knows my name.
records.zh: 我的货，质量有保证，整个玄方城也是有口碑的。

records.text: Fine, when you pass through Yuezhou, make sure to stop by the inn in the southern district. My family runs it.
records.zh: 行，那你路过越州的时候，记得去一趟城南的客栈。那是我家的产业。

records.text: Chongzhou hasn't changed a bit. Say, wanna try some local delicacies?
records.zh: 重州还是老样子，啥子变化都没得。唉，特产你吃不吃？

records.text: There's something strange going on in the direction of the Eastern Xuan Peaks, so keep an eye out while you're on patrol.
records.zh: 玄幽东岳方向有些古怪，待会你巡逻时，记得多留点神。

records.text: I thought we'd never meet again after Mengzhou...
records.zh: 梦州一别，没想到你我还能再见……

records.text: I thought we'd never meet again after Mengzhou...
records.zh: 梦州一别，没想到还能在这儿碰见你。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院办公室_2_17
records.text: Since the new President took office, both New Federation students and our funding have doubled.
records.zh: 自从换了这位校长，新联邦来的学生和经费都翻了倍。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_13_1
records.text: No way. What if it violates the "Dim Forest Hypothesis"?
records.zh: 那可不行，万一触犯“无光之森法则”呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_25_1
records.text: And don't let the names scare you—it's all just marketing.
records.zh: 而且不要被它们的名字吓到，这只是我们的一种营销手段啦。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_29_1
records.text: Probably because… a few days ago, I literally saw that exact "miko" having tea with President Lucilla in her office.
records.zh: 大概是因为……我前几天还在校长办公室里，看到那位“巫女”在和洛瑟菈校长饮茶呢。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_31_1
records.text: Wake up at 7:30 AM, wash and dress in under a minute, scarf down breakfast in five, and absolutely no sweets… Is giving up sugar the price of becoming a Synchronist?
records.zh: 早晨七点半起床在一分钟内完成洗漱，在食堂用五分钟吃完早餐，餐盘里绝对不能出现甜食……与糖分告别，这是成为适格者必须付出的代价吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_5_1
records.text: Remember last time? Your sister Zahira rode a mech reindeer over the Royan Market wall to deliver your lunch… and got caught?
records.zh: 上次，你姐姐扎希拉不是骑着机麋从游牧集市翻墙进来给你送饭，然后被学校逮到了吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_6_1
records.text: I-I'm really scared of heights… Can't we take another route next time…?
records.zh: 我、我真的恐高……下次我们能不能不走这条路……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_13_1
records.text: So the anonymous poster was Lynae?! How did she even figure that out…
records.zh: 那个匿名发帖人，难道是琳奈前辈吗？！她到底是怎么发现的……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_21_1
records.text: I-It's psychological trauma! Yes, that's right! The Synchronist Test scarred me... I'm traumatized! I need a sick-day slip!
records.zh: 是……是心理创伤！对！我在做适格者测试时受到了严重的心理创伤！我需要一张健康假假条……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_25_1
records.text: Note: I, Ramsay, would rather starve in the Mawburrow Desert or jump from the Voidwatch Tower than eat cooked animal liver!
records.zh: 一行留言：我拉姆齐就是饿死，死隐喙深腹里，从对虚数据塔上跳下去，也不会去吃那些烹饪过的动物肝脏！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_25_1
records.text: Due to a peak in detectable Void Storm activity, brief power outages may occur over campus. This is normal and not a cause for panic.
records.zh: 受可监测到的虚质磁暴高峰期影响，近日校园内部分区域可能出现间歇性的短暂停电状况，系正常现象，同学们无需惊慌。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_35_1
records.text: Chisa's top of the class again… How impressive...
records.zh: 千咲同学的成绩又是学级第一，好厉害啊……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_38_1
records.text: Yet humans can think, reason, rise above all things... In a way, we're miracles of the cosmos too.
records.zh: 而我们却能够拥有思维，进行思考，成为万物的灵长……如此说来，人类，也是一种诞生于宇宙之中的奇迹吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_42_1
records.text: Ah, hello! You must be the Rover? Didn't expect to meet you here.
records.zh: 呀，您好，您就是那位“漂泊者”吧？没想到会在这里遇见您。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_42_1
records.text: Haha, Mr. Fulmine, my colleague, mentioned you.
records.zh: 哈哈，是从我的同事“斐林”先生那听说的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院生活区跨区生态_21_1
records.text: Small wonder why Professor Mornye likes it. This should be standard sustenance for all students!
records.zh: 难怪莫宁教授喜欢呢，这才是未来学者应有的饮食方式！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_宿舍副本生态_15_1
records.text: But we can go talk to President Lucilla. She's from the New Federation, too. And with the resources she has in and around the Academy, maybe she can help you contact your family.
records.zh: 但我们可以去拜托洛瑟菈校长。她既熟悉新联邦，又能调用学院资源，说不定能帮你联系上你家人。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_宿舍副本生态_16_1
records.text: Look! I can watch New Federation TV series at school now!
records.zh: 快看！我找到在学院也能追新联邦新剧的方法了！

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_宿舍副本生态_27_1
records.text: You mean Chisa? No. Uh-uh. You're definitely daydreaming.
records.zh: 千咲？不可能吧？你是不是在做梦？

records.chapter: 剧情_学院宿舍前庭碎片化_13_1
records.text: You need to lay off the New Federation conspiracy thrillers...
records.zh: 求你了，平时少看点新联邦悬疑片吧……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院和学院部分对话_4_13
records.text: If the Roya approve, I'd love to set up a camp in Bjartr Woods and study them in depth...
records.zh: 要是罗伊人允许，我真想住进浮光林，狠狠研究它们……

records.text: You Huaxu Academy doctors are just too cautious about everything...
records.zh: 你们华胥研究院的医师，谨慎过头了……

records.text: If you want to go to Xuanfang Hold, you can go alone.
records.zh: 你想去玄方城，你就自己去。

records.text: I know what you're thinking... This whole ruckus has got you scared out of your mind.
records.zh: 爹知道你在想什么……这次的事让你害怕了。

records.text: Let's say today I'm scared, so I run off to Xuanfang Hold. And after I'm there, I get scared again. Then what? Run off to the next place?
records.zh: 今天怕了，跑去玄方城。未来在玄方城怕了，咱们又能跑去哪儿呢？

records.text: You're just trying to scare me so I won't get up at night! You hearing this, Mom?
records.zh: 我看哥你就是想吓我，让我不敢自己起夜！娘，你咋不说他！

records.text: Don't worry, Liangyu is fine. She's just recovering at the Huaxu Academy.
records.zh: 放心，椋羽没事，就是在华胥研究院那里养伤呢。

records.text: As for Yangyang... I hear she'll join the Xuan Watchers over at Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 至于秧秧姑娘……我听说，她要当玄方城的后玄骑使了。

records.text: As for Yangyang, I hear she'll join the Xuan Watchers of Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 至于秧秧姑娘，我听说，她要当玄方城的后玄骑使了。

records.text: It's just... The way Yangyang changed on the battlefield...
records.zh: 只是，秧秧姑娘在战场上的变化……

records.text: If you ask me, Yangyang is an envoy of the legendary Xuanling Bird!
records.zh: 要我说啊，秧秧姑娘肯定是传说中玄翎雀的使者！

records.text: "Mingting Edition Premium Thermostatic Blanket"! A name like that makes me worried you got scammed.
records.zh: “明庭同款臻品恒温被”……这名字，我都担心你被骗了。

records.text: That boy was always scared of pain, even as a child.
records.zh: 那孩子其实很怕疼，小时候就这样。

records.text: C'mon, Wuqing! Tell me all about the battle at Xuanfang Hold!
records.zh: 哥！你快和我说说之前守城战的事嘛！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_每日_华胥院找药材_6_1
records.text: Baizhi seems to be pretty busy at the moment...
records.zh: 白芷她似乎在忙……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_每日_华胥院找药材_12_1
records.text: Doctor Jin from Mengzhou, and the person in charge of treating the wounded.
records.zh: 梦州的矜医生，主要负责伤患的救治工作。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_5_每日_华胥院找药材_25_2
records.text: A token of gratitude from the patients of Xuanfang Hold.
records.zh: 玄方城伤患们的谢礼。

records.text: Something big happened in Xuanfang Hold just recently, after all.
records.zh: 毕竟玄方城这阵子刚经历了变故。

records.text: (Share your experience regarding Autopuppets with Mortefi.)
records.zh: （向莫特斐说明关于机傀的事。）

records.text: Mortefi picks up the Terminal and gives it a quick glance. His face immediately darkens.
records.zh: 莫特斐拿起终端快速扫了一眼，面色随即沉了下来。

records.text: Mortefi lowers his gaze to the Terminal, his fingers moving swiftly across the screen. After a short moment...
records.zh: 莫特斐垂眸看向终端，指尖快速划过屏幕。片刻后……

records.text: Mortefi has sent you a file: Regarding Autopuppets
records.zh: 莫特斐向你发送了一份文件：关于机傀

records.text: Autopuppets. Creations of the Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox of Mengzhou. Powered by Kernels.
records.zh: 机傀，梦州岁主心月狐的造物，以枢芯作为驱动核心。

records.text: Any idea of what might've happened, Mortefi? Should we check the last location first?
records.zh: 莫特斐，你有什么头绪吗？要不要先去最后的定位点看看？

records.text: Heh... Here I am wondering who my savior would be... And it's you, Mortefi...
records.zh: 呵……我还以为是哪路来的救兵……原来是你啊，莫特斐……

records.text: You and Mortefi bring the injured Zhuo Shanyue back to the Ministry of Development of Xuanfang Hold. Later...
records.zh: 你与莫特斐将负伤的琢山月送回玄方城天工部。不久后……

records.text: And who might you be? Sorry, I was too busy ranting at Mortefi just now.
records.zh: ……这位是？不好意思，刚才光顾着跟莫特斐“斗嘴”了。

records.text: You all look worse off than I do, especially you, Mortefi... Heh, cough...
records.zh: 你们一个个脸色比我还难看，尤其是莫特斐……呵，咳……

records.text: I'll return to Xuanfang Hold at a later time if needed.
records.zh: 之后有必要的话，我会再来玄方城。

records.text: He's one of the first people I met when I came to Huanglong from the New Federation.
records.zh: ……他是我刚从新联邦来瑝珑时，最早结识的几人之一。

records.text: Any update on the application, Mortefi? The one about the rogue Autopuppet data...
records.zh: 莫特斐，上次的审批有结果了吗？就是关于异常机傀的数据……

records.text: Hearing those words, Mortefi's expression darkens instantly.
records.zh: 闻言，莫特斐的面色瞬间沉了下来。

records.text: You tell Lenore about the two times you saw the white phantoms.
records.zh: 你将之前两次看见白色虚影的事情告诉了伊诺尔。

records.text: So... you saw white phantoms lingering in Nimbus Sanctum, preaching blasphemous thoughts?
records.zh: 徘徊于云海中的白色幻影，而且还在宣扬着一些亵渎的言论？

records.text: Thank you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} 漂泊者! I swear by Lenore—the name given to me by His Holiness the Primus—that I will repay this kindness with all my heart.
records.zh: 谢谢您，漂泊者大人！以主座赐予我的教名伊诺尔起誓，这份恩情我将用一生偿还。

records.text: After the Dark Tide, it was buried beneath Nimbus Sanctum along with all of its secrets.
records.zh: 二十年前的那次黑潮连同这里的建筑和其中的禁忌一并掩埋在了云海之下。

records.text: That must be the spot Lenore said the record would be. What are the Vitreum Dancers doing over there?
records.zh: 伊诺尔提供的位置就是那吧，琉璃刀伶似乎正围着什么？

records.text: I will cross the treacherous Nimbus Sanctum, battle ferocious Tacet Discords... and, well, I may have to face the wrath of the Queen of the Night herself... Uhh...
records.zh: 我必须穿越诡谲的云海！对抗凶恶的残象……呃，还有可能面对愤怒的夜之女皇……唔……

records.text: I'm Lenore, the dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive in the Order of the Deep. If I make it back alive today, please find me at the Minor Forbidden Archive. I'll do everything I can to repay you!
records.zh: 我是隐海修会小禁书院的院长，伊诺尔。如果我今天能活着回来的话，请来小禁书院找我，我一定会尽我所能报答您！

records.text: Mm. I hope you never lose sight of yours, either. That wish you have always carried, the one that matters most.
records.zh: 嗯，我也希望，你也能一直保持着你那个，最初的愿望。

records.text: And yet, the harm he caused to the Ministry of Development and to Xuanfang is undeniable.
records.zh: 然而，他对天工，对玄方地界造成的伤害是板上钉钉的。

records.text: Liangyu offered us her house. She said we could stay as long as we need… I tried to turn her down, but she wouldn't hear it. So I ended up taking the keys.
records.zh: 椋羽把她家的屋子腾了出来，说如果是我们的话，想住多久都可以……我怎么也劝不过，就只好把钥匙收下了。

records.text: Everyone here is eager to meet you. They're already planning a welcoming feast for when Liangyu gets out of the hospital.
records.zh: 村子里的大家都很想认识你，还说等椋羽出院后，要一起办场接风宴招待你呢。

records.text: I remember Abby has been looking forward to going back for the food, right? After everything it's been through, it's earned a good meal.
records.zh: 我记得阿布一直惦记回今州吃好吃的吧？这一路阿布也很辛苦，找个机会犒劳一下它吧。

records.text: Thanks for your help, 漂泊者, Ms. Zani. We'll make it work!
records.zh: 感谢你们的帮助，漂泊者，赞妮小姐。我们一定会努力工作的。

records.text: Hehe, I asked Ms. Zani to lend me a hand! I mean, I've done odd jobs before, but street vending? That's new.
records.zh: 是我拜托赞妮小姐来这里帮忙的！毕竟，我之前从来没有摆过摊，只在城里打过零工。

records.text: Figured I'd let Zani show me the ropes for a few days. Stocking goods, keeping track of sales, that sort of thing.
records.zh: 我想趁着这几天向赞妮小姐好好学学，进货也好，算账也好……

records.text: But I believe all Septimontians should follow Ephor Augusta's example. Solving the problem should always take priority over following procedure!
records.zh: 但我认为所有七丘人都应该向奥古斯塔总督学习，最优先的应该是解决问题，而不是遵守流程！

records.text: That's right. With the High Tide on the horizon, Augusta's decisiveness and bravery are exactly what we need to weather the coming storm.
records.zh: 是啊，而且七丘即将迎来「涨潮期」，奥古斯塔总督行事果决，骁勇善战，一定会带领我们跨越危机。

records.text: She smiled 'cause you tripped and nearly bit your tongue clean off. The Ephor I know can scare Echoes into silence with a single glare.
records.zh: 那是因为你一进去就紧张得咬舌头还摔倒了吧。实际上，总督可是瞪一眼就能把路边的残象吓成声骸。

records.text: You know, from all the intel I've gathered on Septimont, I got close to nothing on Ephor Augusta's past.
records.zh: 你看，我来七丘后收集的资料里，关于奥古斯塔总督的过去几乎一片空白。

records.text: Greetings, I am Nicco. Envoy from Ragunna. My meeting with Ephor Augusta was arranged in advance. May I wait here?
records.zh: 您好，我是拉古那的使节，名为尼科，与奥古斯塔总督会面的日程先前已经安排妥当，请问我是否在此等候即可？

records.text: Rover? ...That'll be all. Go on ahead, all of you.
records.zh: 漂泊者？好了，你们先去吧。

records.text: The Midnight Rangers salute you and Jiyan, then turn to leave.
records.zh: 夜归军们朝你和忌炎行礼后，转身离开。

records.text: Reporting in, General Jiyan. The Norfall Valley patrol is complete. There are matters to bring to your attention.
records.zh: 报告，忌炎将军，北落峡谷的巡视任务已完成，有些情况要汇报。

records.text: It's been a hundred years, Suoming, and what you feel for them is still strong. Does it hurt?
records.zh: 锁暝，已经过去了百年之久，你对他们的情感还是如此强烈，会很痛苦吧？

records.text: At the sound of footsteps, Suoming moves to put the Vermillion Locks away. When she sees that it is you, she stops.
records.zh: 注意到脚步声，锁暝正要收起玄朱锁，见到是你便停下了动作。

records.text: Mm. I was telling them how Suhsin made a Ninth of its own.
records.zh: 嗯，我在和他们说溯心造了一个九儿的事。

records.text: But Suhsin's imitation was too convincing. I confess, I indulged myself. I let that false Ninth walk beside me longer than I should have.
records.zh: 但溯心仿得太过逼真，我终是有几分私心，让那虚假的九儿陪我走了许久。

records.text: Mm. This year, we'll return to Huating during the winter. It's been far too long since we last saw snow together.
records.zh: 嗯，今年就等冬天的时候再回华亭吧，很久没和你们一起赏雪了。

records.text: It had fallen into disrepair over the years. Most of the detail was gone. But the umbrella's silhouette was still intact.
records.zh: 雕像年久失修，细节早已模糊，但雕像那撑伞的轮廓还留着。

records.text: When I first had the Second Seal forge the Nine Shadows, my hope was that it would give Huating some cover from the Evil Miasma.
records.zh: 当初让二契做这「九方故影」，本就是想替面对「恶瘴」的华亭撑一把遮风挡雨的伞。

records.text: For a moment, Suoming sets her burdens down, slipping into easy conversation with her companions...
records.zh: 锁暝似乎暂时卸下了肩头的重担，沉浸在与伙伴相谈的闲暇之中……

records.text: Done wasting time? Go. See Xuanfang Hold, both of you.
records.zh: 好了，别再扯闲篇，你们逛玄方城去吧。

records.text: Little Snowy Moons are soft and airy, with a delicate sweetness. They are the perfect complement to Huating white tea.
records.zh: 满轮映雪口感松软，味道清甜，跟华亭白茶可以说是天作之合。

records.text: Joy and sorrow flicker across Hsin's face in turn, and every shift in Her expression makes the telling sweeter.
records.zh: 心的神情映着喜悲，祂的每一个反应，都让你更享受讲述故事。

records.text: Rover. We really have to stop "running into" each other like this.
records.zh: 漂泊者，看来我们又一次“偶遇”了。

records.text: Uh-uh. One question, Rover. Those were the terms. But don't worry, the letters and manuscripts are going to someone you trust.
records.zh: 漂泊者，说好了只能问一个问题，不过放心，会有你信任的人来处理这密信与手稿。

records.text: I've got about a hundred questions. But first... It's been a minute, Yinlin.
records.zh: 说实话我有很多想问的，但首先……好久不见了，吟霖。

records.text: Yinlin, I know you only gave me one question, but... was this really a coincidence?
records.zh: 吟霖，虽然你只让我问一个问题，但是……我想知道我们真是偶遇吗？

records.text: Mengzhou. Nowhere else is going to give me anything useful.
records.zh: 看来，还是要去梦州才能有所斩获。

records.text: You and Yinlin trade news of her recent days, and the hours pass in easy company...
records.zh: 你和吟霖聊起了她近来的经历，度过了一段平稳的时光……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_3_1
records.text: Ha... Easy for you to say. What if something does happen to her and Yangyang...?
records.zh: 说得轻巧，小芳秧秧但凡有个三长两短……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_3_1
records.text: It'll be alright, trust me. I checked at Huaxu Academy. They said Chixia's stable now.
records.zh: 没事的没事的，我到华胥研究院那里打听过了，说炽霞的情况已经稳定下来了……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕_衔翎村+战场生态_1_1
records.text: Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...
records.zh: 椋羽都这么说了，应该是真的吧……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕_衔翎村+战场生态_1_2
records.text: Just listen to Liangyu and the others for now...
records.zh: 现在还是乖乖听椋羽他们的吧……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕_衔翎村+战场生态_1_4
records.text: I was one of the lucky ones. Liangyu got us out. But so many of our people... They...
records.zh: 我都还算好的，椋羽带着我们冲了出去……但很多弟兄姐妹……都……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_2_1
records.text: Ha... Easy for you to say. What if something does happen to her and Yangyang...?
records.zh: 唉……说得轻巧，小芳秧秧但凡有个三长两短……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_4_1
records.text: I heard Yangyang went somewhere called the Land of Xuanfang... What kind of place is that, really?
records.zh: 听说秧秧她去了玄方地界……那是个什么地儿啊？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_14_1
records.text: I heard Yangyang went somewhere called the Land of Xuanfang... What kind of place is that, really?
records.zh: 秧秧她去了玄方地界……那是个什么地儿啊？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_14_1
records.text: But... will Yangyang be alright? I heard she went with Chixia, but Miss Panhua said Chixia came back with terrible...
records.zh: 这……秧秧她不会有事吧……？我听说她是和炽霞结伴去的，可听攀花姐说，炽霞回来的时候，都……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_13_1
records.text: Yes. and it's all thanks to that researcher, Baizhi...
records.zh: 是啊……多亏了白芷研究员……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_12_1
records.text: Yes, and it's all thanks to that researcher, Baizhi. I've never seen her look so worried before.
records.zh: 是啊……多亏了白芷研究员……我还是第一次见她着急成那个样子……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_12_1
records.text: Thank goodness she pulled through. Let's take turns watching her so Baizhi can finally get some rest.
records.zh: 幸好炽霞她扛过来了……之后我们轮流照看她吧，也该让白芷休息休息了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_1
records.text: What was that noise just now? Did it come from the Western Fang Peaks?
records.zh: 刚才好大的动静……是从方擎西峰那传过来的？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_2
records.text: Wait, I think I know her. Isn't she... the head of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild?
records.zh: 慢着，我好像认得她……那不是梦州昭明商会的会长吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_7
records.text: I saw Watcher Liangyu bringing in another group of civilians, including some from Jinzhou.
records.zh: 我看椋羽骑使又带回来一批平民……还有今州的人……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_3_2
records.text: With everything that's happened lately, why hasn't Paragon Qingxiao shown herself yet?
records.zh: 唉，最近出了这么大的事，清宵真人怎么还没露面……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_3_2
records.text: Every other time the Land of Xuanfang was in need, Qingxiao the Perfected would descend from the mountain. But this time... could something have happened...?
records.zh: 以前玄方地界出了大事，清宵真人都会下山来……莫非……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_10
records.text: Commander, have you heard anything from Paragon Qingxiao?
records.zh: 卫长，清宵司骑有消息了吗……？

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_3_4
records.text: Hey... it's going to be alright. Paragon Qingxiao was there when it happened. She... she will definitely keep them safe.
records.zh: 别……别担心，他们被困的时候，清宵司骑也在那里，她……一定会护他们无事的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_10_1
records.text: If only Counselor Changli were here. She left for Mingting a few days ago. No telling when she'll be back.
records.zh: 如果长离参事也在就好了……可她前些日子才动身赶往明庭……不知何时才会回来……

records.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_5_1
records.text: Yangyang, 漂泊者... you're heading to the frontlines, aren't you?
records.zh: 秧秧姑娘，漂泊者……你们是要上前线御敌吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: Xinyi, the mayor of Hongzhen, informed you that Jinhsi had only recently departed for Mt. Firmament's peak, in search of the Sentinel. Due to the temporal distortions, what had been days to you was merely moments inside the mountain.
records.zh: 虹镇的管理者辛夷告诉你，因为山内外时间流速的差异，今汐才刚刚从虹镇出发前往乘霄山顶寻找岁主……

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: You confronted a crisis in the Port City of Guixu alongside Yangyang. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper guided you to the Black Shores, a place shrouded in mystery. The Tethys System of the Black Shores had suffered a catastrophic failure, unleashing data-based pollution that corroded everything it touched.
records.zh: 与秧秧一同经历了归墟港市的危情，守岸人将你引导至黑海岸。黑海岸的泰缇斯系统面临着一场灾难，它释放出由数据构成的污染，侵蚀着一切。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: Yangyang and Chixia found you unconscious at the Gorges of Spirits. Together, you decided to head to Huanglong's Jinzhou City, marking the beginning of your journey.
records.zh: 秧秧和炽霞在云陵谷遇到了你，你们决定一同前往瑝珑今州——这正是你如今旅途的起点。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: The current crisis, it seemed, was intricately tied to your forgotten past, and the Lament recorded by the Tethys System during the disaster in Port City of Guixu held crucial secrets...
records.zh: 现如今危机的一切都与你的过去有关，由泰缇斯系统记录的归墟港市悲鸣，也潜藏着诸多谜团……

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: To resolve the chaos caused by the Tethys System, you and the Shorekeeper entered a simulation it had created, reliving the final hour before the Lament struck Port City of Guixu.
records.zh: 为了彻底解决泰缇斯系统的混乱，你和守岸人共同进入了由泰缇斯系统模拟出来的悲鸣前一小时的归墟港市。

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: Rinascita is a nation to the southeast of the Black Shores, making the Black Shores archipelago the perfect starting point for your journey...
records.zh: 而黎那汐塔，就在黑海岸的另一边，如果要动身前往黎那汐塔，黑海岸就是最好的起点……

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: Jinzhou, a border city in Huanglong, had long been a battleground against the Threnodian Ovathrax. The Midnight Rangers, led by General Jiyan, fought tirelessly against the waves of Tacet Discords—nightmarish entities created by the Threnodian—near the Norfall Barrens...
records.zh: 今州作为瑝珑的边陲关隘，常年与盘踞此地的鸣式作战。恰在此时，由忌炎领导的夜归军正在北落野附近对抗由鸣式无相燹主催生的残象……

records.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
records.text: You sought guidance from Sanhua, who directed you to a ferry near Mt. Firmament. There, you encountered Changli, your "Wayfinder" into the mountain.
records.zh: 经由散华的指引，你在乘霄山渡口找到了长离，她正是要将你引入乘霄山的“摆渡人”。

records.text: Not long after, you sensed Cartethyia's abrupt departure from Avinoleum and followed her trail to the city of Gladiators, Septimont.
records.zh: 不久之后，你觉察到卡提希娅毫无征兆地离开了阿维纽林，便也追寻着她的足迹前往拉古那另一侧的尚武之都：七丘。

records.text: Following the clues Fenrico left behind, you traveled to Septimont. There, the Ephor, Augusta, extended an invitation to you.
records.zh: 依照芬莱克留下的线索，你再次前往七丘探查情况，恰巧此时你也受到七丘总督奥古斯塔的邀请。

records.text: In the Sanguis Plateaus, you met Avidius, a rising Hero of Heroes recognized by the Senate. During the final pursuit of the Dark Tide creation known as the Corrosaurus, Augusta prepared to execute her original plan—
records.zh: 你们在桑古伊斯狩原结识了元老院认定的准英雄王阿维狄亚，在追猎黑潮造物「蚀脊龙」的最后关头，奥古斯塔准备施行她原本的计划——

records.text: In Jinzhou, you joined hands with Jiyan and the other Resonators to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak in Norfall Barrens. You also met "little Abby." You ultimately triumphed over and absorbed the Dreamless.
records.zh: 你在今州协力忌炎和今州的大家，平息了北落野的残象潮，收获了一个“小阿布”。也最终成功击败并“吸收”了「无妄者」。

records.text: Determined to bring Iuno back, you traveled to Tetragon Temple in search of clues. Through Avidius's story, you came to understand that existence itself was the sum of memories, feelings, and connections. You decided to Anchor Iuno back into existence through those bonds.
records.zh: 你决定前往四方殿寻找尤诺的线索，却因阿维狄亚的遭遇领悟到存在其实是记忆、情感和联系的总和，你决定用相同的方法将尤诺从混沌之中「锚定」，将她带回这个世界。

records.text: To track down the killer, you joined forces with Avidius, who was pursuing the "Quillbearer." Together, you found the mysterious woman called Galbrena.
records.zh: 为了追踪凶手，你和追寻着“执笔者”的阿维狄亚一同行动，找到了那位自称嘉贝莉娜的神秘女子。

records.text: After witnessing Avidius's tragic fate, the truth finally emerged: you were the new Harbinger of the Dark Tide chosen by Leviathan. To confront both the Dark Tide and the looming Journeying Paradise, you and Galbrena set out once more for Septimont.
records.zh: 在见识了阿维狄亚的结局之后，你和嘉贝莉娜终于发觉，原来你才是被利维亚坦缠上的新一任的黑潮的代行者。为了解决黑潮和即将降临的巡游天国，你们决定再次前往七丘。

records.text: In the end, Cartethyia and Lupa joined forces to bring down Cristoforo's scheme. Peace finally returned to Septimont, and Mya was finally able to rest in peace.
records.zh: 最终在卡提希娅和露帕的共同努力下，粉碎了克里斯托弗的阴谋，终于令七丘重归平静，也让蜜芽得以安息。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_布偶小队历险记_2_1
records.text: You find a Seaside Cendrelis from your bag and hand it over to Fulmine.
records.zh: 你从背包中翻出了一株海浮棘，递给斐林。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_布偶小队历险记_3_1
records.text: Fulmine wants me to take pictures of unique views... Wonder where the Plushies want to visit first?
records.zh: 斐林说想要奇特风景的照片……不知道布偶们想先去哪里看看呢？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_只有风知道的答案_9_1
records.text: The light from those stars traversed countless cold nights to reach Solaris-3. By the time we finally reach that sea of stars, they will not look the same anymore.
records.zh: 那些星光穿过无数寒冷的黑夜才来到索拉里斯，也许等我们真正抵达那片星海，它们早就不是原来的模样了。

records.text: Say, if Paragon Qingxiao and Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox actually went all out, who do you think would win?
records.zh: 你们说，若是心月狐大人和清宵司骑打起来，谁会赢？

records.text: Is that even a question? Lady Hsin is a Sentinel. Who in this world is more powerful than a Sentinel?
records.zh: 这还用问嘛！心月狐大人可是岁主，这世间哪有比岁主还强的人？

records.text: But I heard Paragon Qingxiao can summon countless swords hundreds of meters tall! I'd say she's got a fighting chance.
records.zh: 听说清宵司骑还能唤出无数柄百米高的长剑呢！我倒是觉得不是全无胜算。

records.text: Oh yeah? Lady Hsin can conjure an entire city out of thin air and drop it right on her head. Boom.
records.zh: 那心月狐大人还能凭空造出一座城呢，然后把城“轰”地砸下来……

records.text: ...Then Lady Hsin could just turn all of Xuanfang Hold into one giant Autopuppet that swallows the Paragon whole, swords and all!
records.zh: ……那心月狐大人还能让玄方城变成一只巨大的机傀，一口连人带剑都吞了！

records.text: Then... then Lady Hsin would just conjure another city!
records.zh: 那……那心月狐大人就再建一座城！

records.text: Mmm... When I broke through the restrictions back then, I thought my time as a Celestial was over. But Lady Hsin pulled me back from the brink.
records.zh: 嗯……那时候强行突破禁制，原本以为我的天人生涯就要到此为止，结果是心大人把我捞回来了。

records.text: Ahem! Maintenance duty for Xuanfang Hold, of course...
records.zh: 咳，自然是肩负维护玄方城的工作……

records.text: Alright, fine. Lady Hsin loosened the restrictions so we could use these Autopuppets to explore the Hold. Everyone was so excited about the Waking Moon Festival...
records.zh: 好吧，其实是心大人暂时放宽禁制，让我们借着机傀去逛逛如今的玄方城呢……见朝月会举办，大家都很开心。

records.text: I-I'm fine, really... The doctor said I need to walk and stretch my legs anyway—Ah... look over there, Wuli! Isn't that beautiful?
records.zh: 不、不用啦……医师说了要让我多走走的……啊，那边好漂亮……梧黎你快看！

records.text: But Mengzhou these days... Well. Best not to dwell on it.
records.zh: 梦州现在……唉，不说也罢。

records.text: So, I heard Lady Hsin the Moon Fox has appeared? Where is She right now?
records.zh: 听说心月狐大人现身了？在哪儿呢？

records.text: It was our oversight that caused the public panic. Putting things right was simply our duty, so please, think nothing of it.
records.zh: 但也是我们的疏忽才致民众受惊，善后只是职责所在，不必挂怀。

records.text: Cross my heart. But what about this mister over here? Look... everyone around us thinks he's a bad guy. Grown-ups can get upset, too, you know.
records.zh: 真的。不过这个叔叔要怎么办呢？你看……现在周围的人都误会他了，大人也是会委屈的。

records.text: "I am Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox. A sudden crisis has struck the Sanctum, leaving me trapped in its deepest depths..."
records.zh: “我是岁主心月狐，因神宫突发异变，我被困于深处无法脱身……”

records.text: Actually not bad. Better than the stuff in Mingting, and the texture's richer...
records.zh: 还行，比明庭那个好喝，口感也挺丰富……

records.text: Hmm... though this shop's batch is a little milder than my grandma's... She knew I loved sweets, so she'd always add in extra sugar.
records.zh: 嗯……这家做的味道比我奶奶做的要淡一点……她知道我爱甜，会多放一些糖的。

records.text: Left nothing behind but a tuft of tail fur on the blueprints. That's when it hit them... she was Hsin the Moon Fox in disguise, come to help the Artisans crack what they couldn't!
records.zh: 只留下图纸间的一缕尾巴毛，大家这才发现……她实际是心月狐所扮，来帮天工们突破技术难关的！

records.text: Yeah, yeah, keep making things up. She's a Sentinel! Hsin the Moon Fox doesn't shed.
records.zh: 你就编吧，心月狐可是岁主，祂怎么可能掉毛？

records.text: Grandma... Hsin the Moon Fox isn't coming. Just try not to think about it.
records.zh: 奶奶……心月狐不可能出现的，别等了……

records.text: ...Xuanfang's been doing just fine on its own, even with Hsin the Moon Fox gone!
records.zh: ……就算没有心月狐，玄方地界靠我们不也还是好好的！

records.text: Of course I do! They say that Intendant is no small figure, plus she's got history with Lady Hsin...
records.zh: 当然！据说谛天鉴的那位州监来头不小，还和心大人颇有渊源……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_1
records.text: I remember Lucilla mentioning a sealed rift in the Dimmr Plains.
records.zh: 我听洛瑟菈说，黯原还有一道被封印的裂隙。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_6_1
records.text: I know the Fractsidus has caused Ashinohara its fair share of grief. But personally? I hold no ill will toward you.
records.zh: 我知道，残星会给苇原添了不少麻烦，但我本人对你并无敌意。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_2
records.text: Here. This is the Dimmr Plains map, updated with the latest intel.
records.zh: 给，地下黯原最新的详细地图都在里面了。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_2
records.text: Lucilla hands you the map of the Dimmr Plains. She tells you that Hiyuki is already there waiting for you.
records.zh: 洛瑟菈将地下黯原的地图交给了你。她告诉你，绯雪已经在黯原等待接应你了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_2
records.text: That said, where there's a will, there's a workaround. Hiyuki found one, though it took her some time.
records.zh: 不过，路是死的，人是活的。绯雪花了些时间总算找到了通路。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_2
records.text: Yes. She's been investigating the Dimmr Plains in secret. You'll meet her there.
records.zh: 嗯，她在那之后一直在黯原暗中活动，之后会接应你的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_3
records.text: (An entry point hidden in the Dimmr Plains... Time to get to Bjartr Woods.)
records.zh: （地下黯原的另一入口……该去浮光林了。）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_15_1
records.text: (But the frost seems to be slowing the spread. That frequency... it feels like Hiyuki's.)
records.zh: （冰霜似乎在延缓它被虚质侵蚀的速度，这频率……似乎是绯雪留下的。）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_1
records.text: (This white bird... did Hiyuki leave it here?)
records.zh: （这白鸟，是绯雪留下的吗？）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_8
records.text: Hiyuki, when you fought Denia, did you see anything like a shadowy hand?
records.zh: 绯雪，你和达妮娅交手时，有没有看到过类似黑色的手这种东西？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_9_1
records.text: (If Ashinohara could truly be this peaceful, if their dreams could really come true… then I wouldn't have to raise my blade ever again…)
records.zh: （如果苇原真能有这样平和的日子，实现他们的愿望，也无需再用刀了吧……）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_12
records.text: Hiyuki. Lucilla told me you fought a Threnodian in Ashinohara for a long time.
records.zh: 绯雪，洛瑟菈说你在苇原和鸣式打过很久交道。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_12
records.text: Did you fight in Ashinohara because you were certain you would win?
records.zh: 你是因为有必胜的把握，才前往苇原战场的吗？

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_12
records.text: Before breaking the Seal of Flaming Sakura, Hiyuki mentions the high likelihood that confronting the Threnodian could end in failure. You don't deny it. You don't promise success, only that you'll give everything you have, just as she did back in Ashinohara. Hiyuki sighs, then turns toward the seal.
records.zh: 解开裂隙的灼樱封印前，绯雪向你提及了对抗鸣式失败的可能性，而你也坦言自己并无百分百的成功把握，但求尽力而为——如同当年苇原的绯雪，易地而处，她也会做同样的选择。绯雪叹息一声，转身走向封印处。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_14
records.text: Come on, Hiyuki. The seal is open. We have a job to do... Denia needs us.
records.zh: 走吧，绯雪，封印已经打开，我们还有事要做……比如，达妮娅。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_24_1
records.text: No, Hiyuki. I don't seek Aemeath to confess my regrets.
records.zh: 不，绯雪。我不是为了对爱弥斯诉说我的后悔，才去寻找她的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_24_1
records.text: ...As I learned when I failed to save Ashinohara.
records.zh: ……就像我没能拯救苇原那样。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_6_6
records.text: Directive: I voyaged here to fulfill my mission. Life on this planet has the right to explore the vastness of the cosmos.
records.zh: 理由：我为使命远航至此，这颗星球上的生命亦有探求广阔寰宇的权力。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_18_2
records.text: During Aleph-1's recent activity, impact was successfully contained to the Dimmr Plains.
records.zh: 在本次阿列夫一活跃事件中，未对除黯原区域外的地区产生计划外的影响。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_20_1
records.text: Besides, she's failed one too many times. Drawn one too many futures from herself. And she still insists on walking the path of saving Ashinohara alone, with no intention of stopping.
records.zh: 而且，她失败了太多次，也预取了自己的太多未来。可她又决心继续踏上独自拯救苇原的道路，并不打算就此停下。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_20_1
records.text: In an empty classroom, the Grand Architect contacts the Overseers from various regions. She spares no thought for the Ashinohara miko she once sought to recruit. Hiyuki has already burned through every possible future as a Threnodian Resonator. One day, she too will be reduced to ash by her own wish, just like her sister Gyokuro before her.
records.zh: 残星会会长在无人的教室中，和各地的会监进行了联络。对于那位曾想招揽的苇原巫女，会长不再关心：绯雪预取尽了自己作为鸣式共鸣者的未来，终有一日，也将被她自己的誓愿烧成灰烬——就像她姐姐玉露那样。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_20_1
records.text: Cristoforo, be a dear and run a message to Eris in the New Federation for me.
records.zh: 克里斯托弗，你先去新联邦，帮我送个信给「厄里斯」。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_10_1
records.text: The Threnodian's active cycle is almost here. Death will be a frequent visitor to Ashinohara once more.
records.zh: 鸣式的活跃期快到了，死亡将再次频繁地造访苇原。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
records.text: After Hiyuki, there will be no more Mikos of Flaming Sakura.
records.zh: 自绯雪以后，不会再有下一任灼樱巫女。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
records.text: So that Gyokuro may simply be Gyokuro. So that Hiyuki may simply be Hiyuki. So that Ashinohara will no longer need a Miko of Flaming Sakura.
records.zh: 让玉露只需要成为玉露，让绯雪只需要成为绯雪，让苇原不再需要灼樱巫女。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
records.text: I met someone, Sister. Unlike me, who failed Ashinohara, {Male=he;Female=she} always finds a way to save.
records.zh: 玉露姐姐，近来，我遇到了一个人。与我在苇原的路不同，{TA}总是能成功“拯救”。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
records.text: That must be difficult for you to bear, little Hiyuki.
records.zh: 这对小绯雪而言，有些难以忍受吧。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
records.text: I thought, if only I possessed {Male=his;Female=her} strength. Then my days would not be filled with regret. Ashinohara would be saved.
records.zh: 我想，若我也能如{TA}一般强大，就不会只得到遗憾和悔恨。苇原，亦能得救。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
records.text:
Hiyuki tells Gyokuro how much she still misses her—the longing, the resentment, and finally her wish: to become the Miko of Flaming Sakura who defeats the Threnodian, so that Ashinohara will never need another miko after her.
But Hiyuki admits that meeting Rover changed something in her. She no longer despairs over countless failures. Though she knows a future awaits where she burns to ash, knowing she once had a companion on this path makes the pain easier to bear. 
Before Gyokuro fades away, she tells Hiyuki that she has always been proud of her.
records.zh:
绯雪诉说了自己对姐姐的思念与怨恨，也诉说了自己的誓愿：成为最后一任灼樱巫女击退鸣式，让苇原不再有下一任巫女。
她也说了自己遇到漂泊者后，想法有了些许改变，不再为无数次失败而感到绝望——尽管未来她终将烧却成灰，作为失败的救世主，想到自己也有同行者，她的痛苦也减轻了些许。
玉露在消散前，也诉说了对绯雪的祝福——她一直以绯雪为傲。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_3
records.text: A message arrives for Hiyuki from the Grand Architect: "Ashinohara has vanished in a single day. Congratulations on your wish coming true, Miko of Flaming Sakura."
records.zh: 残星会会长向绯雪拨来了通讯：苇原在一夜之间消失无踪了，恭喜你愿望成真，灼樱巫女。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_1_1
records.text: The very same, but don't let the quick agreement fool you. He's already thinking ten steps ahead. If Ashinohara wasn't in such dire straits, he wouldn't have agreed to forge that blade for you so easily.
records.zh: 是，别看他当时答应得挺痛快，脑子里估计绕过一百个弯了，要不是苇原现在是那副样子，他不会轻易同意给你做那把刀。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_40_2
records.text: Right, now I just need to contact President Lucilla...
records.zh: 好了，现在只要联系洛瑟菈校长就行……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_1
records.text: Aemeath, there's something I want to ask you.
records.zh: 爱弥斯，有件事我想问你。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
records.text: Hiyuki recounts her encounters with the Fractsidus, and the situation in Ashinohara…
records.zh: 绯雪向你讲述了她与残星会的交集，以及苇原的情况……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
records.text: Do not worry over me. As for Ashinohara... Lucilla will assist with the investigation. Once matters here are settled, I will return.
records.zh: 不必担心我，苇原的情况……洛瑟菈会协助我调查，等到这边的情况安稳，我就会动身回去。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
records.text: Lucilla has more reports for me, something about Ashinohara. I should go.
records.zh: 洛瑟菈那边好像还有些苇原相关的报告要我帮忙，我先去她那边看看。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
records.text: Okay. If I can help with Ashinohara, just let me know.
records.zh: 嗯，如果苇原的事有需要，随时联系我。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
records.text: Rest easy. As the "savior" {Male=himself;Female=herself}  taught me, this long road to save Ashinohara was never meant to be walked alone.
records.zh: 安心，就像“救世主”所教给我的，想要救回苇原这条长路，总不该想着由我一人走完。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
records.text:
Hiyuki speaks to you about matters concerning Ashinohara, the Fractsidus, and her future path that she never had the chance to share before. She feels changed by everything that has happened.
Before you part, her white bird flies into your chest and disappears. Hiyuki gazes out the window, looking forward to that distant future of stepping into spring for the first time.
records.zh:
绯雪与你谈及了之前未来得及告知你的，有关苇原和残星会的事，也谈及了自己未来的去向，她似乎的确和之前有所不同了。
在你离开前，她的白鸟飞到了你的心口消失不见。而她看向窗外，第一次期望起那个遥不可及的，步入春日的未来。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_44_2
records.text: Professor! We just got word from President Lucilla, a Void Storm is about to hit up ahead!
records.zh: 教授！洛瑟菈校长那边发来警告，前面路段不久后会生成磁暴！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_50_1
records.text: One thing, though. Denia from the Department of Voidmatters hasn't answered us, and her name isn't on the roster of those who took shelter.
records.zh: 不过老师，虚质科学部的达妮娅一直没有回复，我们在避难名单上也没找到她。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_50_1
records.text: Denia, hm... She'll be fine. The President will have taken care of that.
records.zh: 她的话……放心吧，洛瑟菈校长会照顾到的。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_3
records.text: Chisa is amazing. That giant TD didn't even last a second against her.
records.zh: 千咲同学太可靠了，那么大只残象她只用一下就……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_54_1
records.text: President Lucilla really sent {Male=him;Female=her} to Bjartr Woods by {Male=himself;Female=herself}...?
records.zh: 洛瑟菈校长派了{TA}一个人去浮光林那边啊……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_54_1
records.text: Hah. Whatever else Lucilla may be, she is not a woman who sends students to die.
records.zh: 哼，洛瑟菈虽然有各种问题，但她可不是那种会派学生送死的人。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_4
records.text: My side is progressing well too. President Lucilla's Void Storm reports came at the right moment.
records.zh: 这边的情况也很顺利，洛瑟菈校长他们提供的磁暴的信息很及时。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_5
records.text: Chisa... when summer comes, let's go back to that cafe in Honami together. We can visit Namipon. It asked us to come back and tell it about the Academy, remember?
records.zh: 千咲……等到暑假时，一起回穗波的咖啡厅看看波仔吧？波仔之前不也说过可以回去讲讲学院的事吗？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章生态_3_1
records.text: I know, I know. We get to take it easy 'cause the mikos are the ones carrying the weight for us.
records.zh: 我知道我知道，我们是有巫女大人们护着，才能这么悠哉地过日子。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章生态_5_1
records.text: The legend's gotta be true! She really is Ashinohara's strongest!
records.zh: 传说一定是真的！不愧是无敌的苇原当世最强！

records.text: At your voice, Hiyuki stops her quiet muttering and discreetly closes her fingers around a note in her hand.
records.zh: 随着你的搭话，绯雪停下了口中的默念，似乎悄悄将一张便签握紧在手心。

records.text: Hiyuki sits there quietly, resting against the white bird.
records.zh: 绯雪安静地坐在那里，与白鸟依偎在一起。

records.text: Perhaps next time, I will ask them to try some seeds from Ashinohara as well...
records.zh: 改天，拜托他们试一下苇原的花种吧……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_2
records.text: 漂泊者? Why are you at the Academy? Weren't you supposed to be in charge of the Bjartr Woods sector?
records.zh: 漂泊者？怎么会来学院？我记得你是负责浮光林的部分……

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_2
records.text: I'll leave things here to you, Chisa. It's time for me to get back to my own mission.
records.zh: 这边就拜托你们了，千咲，我也该继续我负责的部分了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_2
records.text: Things have been progressing smoothly. Lynae's working on it too.
records.zh: 学院这边的进度很顺利，琳奈学姐也在。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_41_2
records.text: Me? I'm fine, but the situation in Bjartr Woods is complicated. You need to be careful.
records.zh: 我……我这边没问题的，倒是浮光林那边情况复杂，要多小心。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_54_3
records.text: Lucilla sent a single student to Bjartr Woods?! Has she lost her mind?
records.zh: 浮光林附近都由那位学生负责吗？洛瑟菈疯了？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_1_15
records.text: Research Institute Sector collection is nearly complete. Academy Sector and Bjartr Woods Sector are at fifty percent.
records.zh: 研究院区块符文搜集基本完成，学院区块搜集进度过半，浮光林区块搜集进度过半。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_1_16
records.text: Collection complete for Research Institute, Academy, and Bjartr Woods Sectors.
records.zh: 研究院区块、学院区块、浮光林区块搜集进度均已完成。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_2_1
records.text: ...N-Nothing! Lady Hiyuki, it's just... Ugh, thank you for everything you do! Goodbye!
records.zh: ……没什么的！绯雪大人，嗯……就是……您辛苦了！再见！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_2_2
records.text: (Once business in Lahai-Roi is settled, I'll take it back to Ashinohara.)
records.zh: （待拉海洛事毕，也该……携刀返回苇原。）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
records.text: Hehe, you can afford to be more effusive. Unlike you, who failed Ashinohara time and again, {Male=he;Female=she} is the perfect "savior."
records.zh: 呵呵，话可以说得再满一些，与在苇原屡次失败的你不同，{TA}是个完美的“救世主”。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
records.text: Honami would not be a ruin. And Ashinohara would finally have its true "savior."
records.zh: 穗波的现状不会如此，苇原也将迎来真正的“救世主”。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
records.text: You've crawled through countless defeats, barely protecting Ashinohara from the Threnodian's assault. But what of the future? You are no savior like 漂泊者.
records.zh: 你已历经无数次失败，你的确在与鸣式的战斗中勉力前行，护佑了苇原。可未来呢？你毕竟不是漂泊者那样完满的救世主。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
records.text: From Ashinohara's legends and the Spacetrek Collective's investigative reports, you know who 漂泊者 is by now.
records.zh: 你从苇原的传说故事和深空联合的调查报告中，应当已经认识了漂泊者是谁。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_3_1
records.text: But you defeated it. Again. And one day, you'll drive it away from Ashinohara for good!
records.zh: 但您又一次击退了鸣式，早晚有一天，您会将鸣式彻底从苇原驱逐出去！

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_2_1
records.text: Their biggest financial backer is the New Federation. And of course, they answer to an entire board of investors.
records.zh: 深空联合背后最大的金主是新联邦，他们的行动也必然要对新联邦的投资人团体负责。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_3_5
records.text: What kind of place is the New Federation, anyway? Are they all gonna be like that?
records.zh: 新联邦到底是个什么样的地方啊！那里的人该不会都这样吧？

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_3_2
records.text: (When will we be freed from this nightmare, Ashinohara…?)
records.zh: （苇原，何时才会得到解脱……）

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_7_2
records.text: I'll head to the Dimmr Plains now then, Mornye.
records.zh: 莫宁，那我现在就出发去黯原。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_7_2
records.text: Yes. This temporary passage will take you to the Dimmr Plains, deep within Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 是的。这处临时搭建的通道，就通向浮光林深处的地下黯原。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_8_2
records.text: How about I go first? I wish for peace and safety across the Dimmr Plains.
records.zh: 那，我先许个愿吧？希望你能保护黯原外围平平安安~

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_8_2
records.text: I remember you came across Aemeath's traces before.
records.zh: 我记得，你发现过爱弥斯的踪迹……

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_8_2
records.text:
You reach the Dimmr Plains and find Hiyuki, the Ashinohara miko you met before. She offers you her origami familiar, a way to reach her if you are in need, then departs to track the Fractsidus.
Lucilla will stay behind with the other researchers to monitor the Voidmatter Barriers, while you make your preparations to head toward the Keystone's location alone.
records.zh:
抵达地下黯原后，你见到了那位曾有一面之缘的苇原巫女绯雪。她将自己的纸役白鸟送到了你身上，告诉你若是需要，可以向她祈愿，而后便离开去追踪残星会了。
洛瑟菈将和其他研究员一起留在此处监测虚质防护装置，而你则做好了准备，孤身犯险，前往隧锚所在。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_11_1
records.text: The Soliskin have swept the area. None remain in Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 日灵们已经寻找了一遍，浮光林附近应当没有落单的人了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_11_2
records.text: Everything matches. I'm spotting every Royan rune site in Bjartr Woods on this map.
records.zh: 都对得上，浮光林里的罗伊符文的位置都能在上面找到。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_1_5
records.text: What's your status? I saw you dash straight into the most contaminated area when I passed Bjartr Woods.
records.zh: 你现在情况怎么样，我路过浮光林时看你一头扎进那片污染最严重的区域了。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_5_1
records.text: Yes! Hiyuki, that's it! Such a pretty name, just like Lady Gyokuro's!
records.zh: 对，就是这个名字！和玉露大人的名字一样好听！

records.text: Camellya hums a tune as here eyes drift back to the sea. The melody stirs a sense of familiarity in your heart.
records.zh: 椿看向海面，轻轻哼起某个让你感到极为怀念的调子。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_七丘彩蛋_2_1
records.text: I hear Miss Lupa is the most celebrated Gladiator at the moment? I would enjoy seeing her in action.
records.zh: 我记得，露帕小姐是时下最当红的竞技明星吧？有机会的话，我也想见识下她在赛场上的表现。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_七丘彩蛋_2_1
records.text: I promised Augusta that once everything was settled, I'd come to Septimont City.
records.zh: 之前我和奥古斯塔说好了，事情结束后，就来七丘城看看。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_2_1
records.text: The name listed is… A-Aalto? Th-that can't be right.
records.zh: 完成人是……秋、秋水？这、这不对吧？

records.text: The city and its people shimmer—golden, vibrant, precious.
records.zh: 这座城市和城市中的人们就那样鲜活地流淌着，都是鎏金色的。

records.text: Thankfully, you have no pressing matters to attend to. On such a peaceful afternoon, sharing this moment with Carlotta feels like the right choice.
records.zh: 所幸今天你也没有其他的安排，日间午后，和眼前的少女一同小憩片刻，似乎是一个很不错的安排。

records.text: Time seems to pause between you. Without exchanging another word, you hold each other's gaze. In this silence, you and Carlotta become what she just described—a golden shimmer, vibrant and fleeting, yet infinitely precious.
records.zh: 时光静默，你们默契地看向彼此，不再言语。你和珂莱塔一起，成为她所说的鲜活地流淌着的、鎏金色的一部分。

records.text: Like the "Scarlet Velvet Ribbon" tied to Scarlet Velvet?
records.zh: 就像红丝绒的“红丝绒缎带”？

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_卡提希娅_3_2
records.text: You are slowly lifted into the air. After landing, Cartethyia takes her hands off your eyes.
records.zh: 你感觉被轻轻托起，落到了一处地方，卡提希娅放开了搭在你眼睛上的手。

records.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_坎特蕾拉_2_1
records.text: Oh? You have a keen palate. I procured this tea from Ragunna City.
records.zh: 哦？很敏锐呢。这茶不是我调配的，是在拉古那城里买的。

records.text: I'm still gonna protect it all, in my own "Lynae" way.
records.zh: 我还是会以“琳奈”的方式，守护珍视的一切……

records.text: (You're sure this is exactly the kind of funky-flavored candy Lynae would enjoy.)
records.zh: （……你很确信，这是琳奈会喜欢的“怪味糖果”。）

records.text: Ah—Good times never last! My next class is with Professor Mornye. Can't skip that...
records.zh: 啊——美好的时光总是那么短暂！下节好像是莫宁教授的课来着，她的课我可不好意思再逃了……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
records.text: Ah, I remember now! You must be Ms. Lenore from the something-something Archive of the Sanctuary Affairs Bureau, right? You sent me sympathy letters after I applied for the Order's aid.
records.zh: 啊——我想起来了！圣堂事务局那个什么什么书院的伊诺尔小姐对吧，当时我向修会申请援助，你给我回了好几封慰问信来着。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
records.text: Now, listen to me carefully, Ms. Lenore—I want you to grab every unhappy thought you've got... and direct it squarely at Captain Brant!
records.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，你听我说——现在，把你感受到的所有不开心，统统怪到布兰特团长身上吧！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
records.text: Oh Brant, how could you do such a thing? For shame!
records.zh: 哎呀布兰特怎么这么坏啊！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
records.text: Ms. Lenore, I don't blame a pure soul for being naive. And I won't fault a kind heart for not being kinder.
records.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，我不会责怪单纯的人太过单纯，也不会埋怨善良的人还不够善良。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
records.text: Before leaving, Andreas hands Lenore a list of the Troupe's upcoming performances. He invites her to swing by anytime for a show... and maybe yell at Brant a little while she's at it.
records.zh: 安德烈临走前给了伊诺尔一张愚人剧团的演出计划表，欢迎她随时来看自己演出，顺便也可以找布兰特发发牢骚。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_7_5
records.text: Haha, the Phoebe I know wouldn't care about such things!
records.zh: 哈哈，菲比才不会在乎这些呢！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_1_1
records.text: How are the rebuilding efforts going, Phoebe?
records.zh: 菲比，灾后重建的情况如何？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_1_1
records.text: Another one? Very well, I'll take care of it right after I finish the list from Ragunna City.
records.zh: 又一批？好的，拉古那城内的名单收尾后我立刻处理。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_1_1
records.text: A name suddenly flashes through your mind: Lenore. Did she go to the Fabricatorium? Could her name be on the list?
records.zh: 一个名字出现在你的脑海里，伊诺尔，她最后前往隐海试验场了吗？她会不会也在这份名单中？

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_1_1
records.text: Acolyte Phoebe, I've put together a list of missing Acolytes from the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Acolyte Luther is counting on your help to coordinate the response.
records.zh: 菲比大人，隐海试验场的失踪教士名单已经整理好了，卢德大人希望由您负责善后工作。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_4_3
