records.text: As you stroll through the celebration, Lenore steps onto the stage.
records.zh: 就在你游览庆典时，伊诺尔跳上了舞台。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_4_3
records.text: Hello everyone, my name is Lenore, from the Minor Forbidden Archive of the Order of the Deep. Oh, sorry, now I belong to the Fabricatorium of the Deep… Wait, that's not right either...
records.zh: 大家好，我叫伊诺尔，是隐海修会小禁书院……啊不是，我现在是隐海试验……也不对……

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_4_3
records.text: Hello everyone. My name is Lenore, and I'm an Acolyte of the Order of the Deep!
records.zh: 大家好，我叫伊诺尔，我是隐海修会的一名教士！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_5_1
records.text: Lenore places her hands together in prayer. A faint but steady warmth flows into your body, like a quiet tide of life itself.
records.zh: 伊诺尔向你摆出虔诚祈祷的手势，你感觉一股微弱但是坚定的生机自你身体里散出。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_5_1
records.text: Go to where your heart tells you. And do what you believe is right, Lenore.
records.zh: 去你想去的地方，做你认为正确的事吧，伊诺尔。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_3
records.text: Black water spews from the ground before vanishing just as quickly. In its place stands a girl—Lenore.
records.zh: 黑色的潮水自地下涌出又退去，一名少女出现在了那里——是伊诺尔。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_4
records.text: Lenore, it was Rinascita's kindness that carried you this far. This journey deserves a better ending.
records.zh: 伊诺尔，是黎那汐塔的善意陪伴你走到了今天。我想，这趟旅途值得一个更好的终点。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_4
records.text: Think of your parents who lifted you from the Dark Tide. The Acolytes who raised you. The Nimbus Sanctum ancestors who helped enlighten you. Even Medulius, who offered you a second chance.
records.zh: 想想将你从黑潮中托起的双亲，抚养你长大的教士，给予你启迪的云海先民，想想唯独愿意拉你一把的梅杜利乌斯。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_4
records.text: Death is only another way of escaping reality, Lenore.
records.zh: 死亡不过是换个方向的逃避，伊诺尔。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_5
records.text: Hello. I am an Acolyte of the Order, Lenore. Any harsh work or dirty job you have, do feel free to send them my way!
records.zh: 您好，我是修会的教士伊诺尔，有什么脏活累活请随意使唤我！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_1_1
records.text: The crisis's over, and we wanted to do our part in helping Cantarella. So here I am in Septimont as the visiting pharmacist.
records.zh: 灾难过去，我们也想为坎特蕾拉姐姐做些什么，现在我是特派到七丘的药师啦。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_2_5
records.text: The Troupe of Fools' best shows are with Captain Brant on stage.
records.zh: 愚人剧团的表演，还是布兰特船长的最精彩啊！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_8_5
records.text: Wait, you're 漂泊者, aren't you? I'm Xiaobei, from Jinzhou. We met back at the Tiger's Maw Mine!
records.zh: 呀，你不会是漂泊者吧！我是小北，今州来的，我在虎口矿场见过你！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_8_5
records.text: And it just so happened that Manager Maji pulled some strings with Jinzhou and Septimont through Lollo Logistics and got us official contracts.
records.zh: 正巧那个叫马计的老板通过呜呜物流联系到了今州和七丘方面，走特批通道给了我们补了一份正式合同。

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_8_6
records.text: I'm Xiaobei, from Jinzhou. We met back at the Tiger's Maw Mine!
records.zh: 我是小北，今州来的，我在虎口矿场见过你！

records.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_5_5
records.text: Just when things got tense, my battle-hardened body didn't fail me. A single sidestep and I dodged Lupa's spear just like that!
records.zh: 就在这个危急时刻，千锤百炼的肉体没有辜负我，我一个闪身就将露帕选手的枪尖躲了过去！

records.text: I've already submitted a full report on everything that happened at the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
records.zh: 隐海试验场的事，我已经悉数上报了。

records.text: I will continue to stand guard over Norfall Barrens. I will protect this land we defended together.
records.zh: 此后，我会继续戍守北落野，守护好这片我们一起保卫下的清朗山河。

records.text: Changli invited 漂泊者 and Jinhsi to the group chat.
records.zh: 长离邀请漂泊者、今汐加入群聊。

records.text: 漂泊者, at Mt. Firmament… thank you for stepping in.
records.zh: 漂泊者，乘霄山这一局，承蒙你出手。

records.text: Oh yes. And should anything stand in your way while in Ragunna City, you need only to invoke the Montelli name. I've got your back.
records.zh: 还有，要是在拉古那城内遇到什么情况，报莫塔里家族的名号就行，我在你身后。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线彩蛋_燎照之骑涂装_1_1
records.text:
Spacetrek Collective Research Institute - Field Report (Archived)

Research Topic: Dynamic Characteristics of the Tacet Discord "Inferno Rider" and its Vehicle 
Research Location: Huanglong — Port City of Guixu 
Related Projects: Iterative R&D of the Expedition Motorbike Prototype

I. Background

A powerful Tacet Discord, designated "Inferno Rider," has been observed near the Port City of Guixu in Huanglong. The vehicle it utilizes operates with remarkable stability in post-Lament environments. Its structural design and movement patterns are expected to provide critical reference points for the development of our prototype expedition motorbike.
II. Field Records

Location: Port City of Guixu — Overpass Ruins
By deploying sensors to capture kinetic data, we have determined that the "Inferno Rider" performs well above average in the following areas:
· Control response logic at high speeds.
· Maneuverability across uneven terrain.

III. Technical Applications

By reverse-engineering its movement patterns and structural features, the engineering team has implemented the following improvements to the expedition motorbike prototype:
……………………

Researcher‘s Handwritten Note:
The prototype is finished. I never imagined old tech from my hometown all those years ago would find a new life in an expedition motorbike.

Even now, the mention of the "Inferno Rider" still strikes fear into people's hearts. I cannot erase the shadow cast by that Tacet Discord, nor can I truly give rest to the souls who perished long ago. At the very least, this prototype proves that our ancestors left more than just pain and terror behind.

They also had hope for the future.

This bike will carry forth their will, guarding the path for those who dare to explore.
records.zh:
深空联合研究院 · 考察报告（已归档）

考察课题：残象「燎照之骑」及其载具动态特征
考察地点：瑝珑-归墟港市
关联项目：科考摩托原型机迭代研发

一、背景
在瑝珑归墟港市一带观察到名为「燎照之骑」的强大残象，其使用的载具可以在悲鸣后的环境中稳定运行，载具结构与运动模式有望为科考摩托的原型机开发提供参考。

二、考察记录
地点：归墟港市-高架桥遗迹区域
通过布设感应器捕捉动态数据，发现「燎照之骑」在以下方面表现超出平均水平：
· 高速状态下的操控响应逻辑；
· 非平整地形下的机动能力。

三、技术转化
基于对其运动模式与结构特征的逆向推演，工程团队对科考摩托原型机进行了以下改进：
……………………

研究员的字迹：
原型机完成了。没想到故乡当年的技术，能在今天被运用在科考摩托的开发上。
如今人们说起「燎照之骑」，依然会感到畏惧。我无法抹去残象带来的阴影，也无法让那些早已逝去的魂灵真正安息。但至少这台科考摩托原型机能证明，先祖的牺牲留下的，并非只有伤害和恐惧。
还有对未来的期许。
这台科考摩托会承载他们的意志，守护探索者们前行的路。

records.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_引导短信_纸役发放_1_1
records.text: To all researchers and students involved in Dimmr Plains operations:
records.zh: 各位参与黯原地区相关行动的研究员及同学们。

records.text: 漂泊者, Xiangli Yao, and Patty. Wishes come true. Organize Moonlit Fair...
records.zh: 漂泊者，相里要和小帕，实现心愿，筹办宵月会……

records.text: Xiangli Yao pulls out a tablet showing you four indecipherable files.
records.zh: 相里要调出电子屏，向你展示了四份无法阅读的文件。

records.text: M-My name is Zhezhi. Um... Nice to meet you...?
records.zh: 我、我叫折枝，嗯……很高兴认识你……？

records.text: You notice the painting supplies and pigments Zhezhi is carrying.
records.zh: 你注意到折枝身上带着许多画具和颜料。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线_15_1
records.text: After collecting the necessary data, Xiang-LEE suddenly speaks in Xiangli Yao's voice. It turns out Xiangli Yao is remotely controlling Xiang-LEE to assist you in uncovering Shifan's true desire.
records.zh: 完成声骸数据收集后，相里的声音突然变成了相里要，相里要解释着接下来他会远程操控相里与你同行，了解十番真实的心声。

records.text: You signal Xiangli Yao to transfer the Echo data to Shifan's Terminal.
records.zh: 示意相里要将收集的声骸数据传输给十番的终端。

records.text: My name is Xiangli Yao, and this is the Rover. I apologize for the unannounced visit, ma'am.
records.zh: 我叫相里要，这位是漂泊者，突然叨扰您真是不好意思。

records.text: Ah, yes. They represent the Midnight Rangers. A special touch from Ms. Zhezhi.
records.zh: 哈哈哈，这些可是夜归战士，折枝小姐特意点缀的一笔。

records.text: One by one, the Rangers share their stories of Xiuyuan with Mrs. Heying, as you and Xiangli Yao stand quietly listening on.
records.zh: 不知不觉，你和相里要默契地将空间留给了他们，夜归战士向禾盈分享着修远留下的故事。

records.text: Before that... Thank you, Xiangli Yao and 漂泊者.
records.zh: 在那之前……相里要，漂泊者，谢谢你们了。

records.text: A fine suggestion. I have always admired General Jiyan.
records.zh: 很不错的提议，忌炎将军也是我一直以来最为敬佩的人之一。

records.text: You tell Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi what happened at Mt. Firmament.
records.zh: 你将乘霄山发生的事告知了秧秧、炽霞以及白芷。

records.text: (Wishes... and solutions...? Could this relate to what Chixia said about "someone" at Moontree Lodge making wishes come true? And Xiangli Yao... The name sounds familiar.)
records.zh: （愿望……还有实现方案……？难道他和炽霞所说的，月树屋的“幕后英雄”有关？还有相里要……有些耳熟的名字。）

records.text: Xiangli Yao reaches for a cable-like object at the back of the robot and connects it to his Terminal.
records.zh: 被称作相里要的青年从小机器人背后找到一段类似绳索的物体，将它与手中的终端连接。

records.text: Xiangli Yao, a pleasure to meet you. I regret that I was away during your first visit to the Academy, but I'm glad to finally have the chance to meet you.
records.zh: ——我叫相里要，很高兴见到你。当初你造访研究院时我恰好不在，直到今天才有机会和你见面。

records.text: The next time I heard any news about you was regarding the battle at the Norfall Barrens. This year's Moon-Chasing Festival could only have proceeded thanks to your efforts.
records.zh: 再一次听说你的消息，就是北落野一战的时候，多亏了你带领大家获得胜利，追月节才能顺利举办。

records.text: Command Initiator: Xiangli Yao. Authentication Confirmed. Performing Onboard Diagnostics: No. 231... Onboard Diagnostics Failed...
records.zh: 指令发起者：相里要，通过认证，进行第231次自检……自检失败……

records.text: Xiangli Yao? Geez... You're Mrs. Xiangli Yan's son!
records.zh: 相里要不就是……那个相里衍阿姨的儿子！

records.text: That looks like something from Xiangli Yao's childhood. Could his memories be affecting this Sonoro's frequencies?
records.zh: 看来是他小时候的记忆，这个索诺拉的频率也受到了影响吗？

records.text: Or maybe... he holds the key? Is it similar to what Scar did to me... No, I can't tell for sure yet.
records.zh: 或者说……钥匙？会是和伤痕类似的情况吗……不，还不能下定论。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V1.2追月节主线暗线_1_40
records.text: You uncover Xiangli Yao's connection with the Moontree Lodge and continue exploring to reveal the hidden truth.
records.zh: 你们发现了相里要与月树屋间的联系，为了解真相，你们决定继续前进。

records.text: Sure, if you say so... Now back to the topic. We've been seeing Pascar and Xiangli Yao's past exclusively so far.
records.zh: 不过有些奇怪……这些都是帕斯卡和相里要的经历。

records.text: But why can't we get through the "doors" before Xiangli Yao opens them?
records.zh: 但为何每次只有通过相里要已经打开的“门”，我们才能继续前进？

records.text: Well, we have Pascar and Xiangli Yao to thank.
records.zh: 都是多亏了帕斯卡还有相里要啊。

records.text: We need Xiangli Yao... Pascar, where is Xiangli Yao? Where the hell is he!
records.zh: 相里要……帕斯卡，相里要呢！他人呢！

records.text: Where is Xiangli Yao?! You're nobody compared to him, Pascar!
records.zh: 相里要！相里要呢！帕斯卡，你根本不行!

records.text: You all despise me, thinking I'll never surpass Xiangli Yao, right?
records.zh: 我知道了，你们一定是觉得我超越不了相里要！

records.text: It's Xiangli Yao! He's right behind this door!
records.zh: 是相里要的声音，就在这扇门背后！

records.text: Pascar, it's me, Xiangli Yao. Do you recognize me?
records.zh: 帕斯卡，是我，相里要。

records.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线（第二周）_4_5
records.text: Back in the real world, Xiangli Yao needs to check on Patty's condition and suggests meeting up later. You decide to spend time at Taoyuan Vale.
records.zh: 从索诺拉出来后，相里要还需要确认一下小帕的状况，你决定去山下逛逛再与他汇合。

records.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线（第二周）_4_7
records.text: Have you seen Xiangli Yao's room? It's a perfect example of "order out of disorder." I learned it from the genius.
records.zh: 懂不懂，我这叫乱中有序。再说相里要的房间不也这样嘛，这说明什么？说明天才啊，大抵是如此。

records.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线（第二周）_3_2
records.text: Wow, Baizhi actually smiled! She really should smile more often.
records.zh: 要是白芷平时能像照片里一样，多笑笑就好了。
